name: Syncy
description:
Syncy는 밴드 합주를 준비하는 사람들을 위한 연습 앱이에요.

곡 하나를 올리면 보컬, 드럼, 베이스, 기타 같은 파트로 나뉘어요. 내 파트만 끄고 합주 연습을 하거나, 다른 파트를 들어 보며 곡을 익혀 보세요.

■ 파트별로 듣고 연습하기
· 곡을 파트별 트랙으로 나눠 불러와요
· 트랙마다 음소거와 솔로를 켜고 끌 수 있어요
· 메트로놈과 템포 조절, 구간 반복으로 어려운 부분만 연습해요

■ 핀으로 피드백 남기기
· 파형에서 트랙 줄을 길게 눌러 끌면, 그 구간에 핀이 꽂혀요
· 핀에서 글과 녹음으로 밴드원과 대화할 수 있어요
· 피드백을 받은 사람이 직접 녹음한 패치로 답해요

■ 우리 밴드끼리
· 밴드를 만들고 초대 코드로 밴드원을 초대해요
· 곡, 핀, 대화가 밴드원끼리만 공유돼요
· 모든 기기에서 같은 곡과 같은 핀이 보여요

■ 안내
· Apple 또는 Google 계정으로 로그인해요
· 새 곡을 분리해서 올리려면 곡 분리 서버에 연결해야 해요. 이미 밴드에 올라온 곡은 서버 없이 열 수 있어요
· 설정에서 로그아웃과 계정 삭제를 할 수 있어요

합주 전에 파트를 미리 맞춰 보고, 합주 후에는 핀으로 이야기하세요.

name: Ripenday: Odaklanma ve Hedef
description:
Ripenday, başlamayı kolaylaştıran ve emeğini görünür kılan bir odak uygulaması. Bir hedef seçersin, kısa bir ritüelle odağa girersin; çalıştığın her dakika bahçende bir ağaç olarak birikir.

BUGÜNKÜ EMEĞİNİ GÖRÜNÜR KIL
Küçük ya da büyük, her çalışma sayılır. Bahçen, verdiğin emeğin sakin bir kaydıdır. Ara verdiğin günler bir şey silmez; geri döndüğünde kaldığın yerden büyümeye devam eder.

BAŞLAMAYA EŞLİK EDEN RİTÜELLER
Başlamak çoğu zaman işin en zor kısmıdır. Ripenday odaktan önce kısa bir video ya da birkaç nefeslik bir ritüel sunar. İstemezsen atlarsın; seçim hep sende.

HEDEFİNDEN BUGÜNKÜ KÜÇÜK ADIMA
Hedefini kendi cümlenle yaz, ona ne kadar emek vermek istediğini kabaca belirle ve bugün atabileceğin ilk adımı seç. Odak süresini sen ayarlarsın: 5, 10, 25 dakika ya da sana uyan başka bir süre.

EMEĞİN BAHÇENDE BİRİKİR
Her hedefin kendi ağacı var. Emek durakları, yolun neresinde olduğunu sakin bir dille gösterir. Gelişim ekranında son haftalarına bakar, nereye ne kadar emek verdiğini görürsün.

GÜNÜNÜ VE HAFTANI SAKİN PLANLA
Bugün ne üzerinde çalışacağını seç, haftana gerçekçi birkaç çalışma yerleştir. Boş bıraktığın zamanlar da planın bir parçası.

ÜCRETSİZ KULLANABİLECEKLERİN
• Aynı anda 3 etkin hedef
• 3 ağaç
• Son 28 günün grafikleri
• Odak sayacı, ritüeller, plan ve bahçe
Eski çalışma kayıtların her zaman korunur.

İSTERSEN PRO İLE GENİŞLET
Pro; sınırsız hedef, yeni ağaçlar ve daha uzun dönem grafikleri ekler. Yeni hesaplar 14 gün boyunca Pro'yu kartsız kullanır. Bu süre kendiliğinden ücretli aboneliğe dönüşmez; bittiğinde ücretsiz kullanmaya devam edersin. Pro aylık ya da yıllık abonelikle alınır ve App Store ya da Google Play hesabından yönetilir.

DEHB DENEYİMLERİ GÖZETİLEREK TASARLANDI
Ripenday, başlamakta zorlanma, dikkatin dağılması ve verilen emeği görememe gibi deneyimler düşünülerek tasarlandı. Bir sağlık uygulaması değildir; tanı koymaz, tedavi sunmaz ve tıbbi tavsiyenin yerini tutmaz.

Mac'te ve web'de de aynı hesabınla devam edebilirsin: ripenday.com
Gizlilik: https://ripenday.com/privacy
Kullanım koşulları: https://ripenday.com/terms

name: MindMotion TV
description:
MindMotion TV is a calm, colourful collection of brain games made for the big screen and the Siri Remote. Train your mind, move your body (only if you want to), and play together as a household.

FIVE ORIGINAL GAMES
• Color Reaction - match the target. Every colour has its own pattern, and there's a symbols-only and a one-button version.
• Memory Path - watch a path light up, then repeat it. Spatial, symbol and narrated versions.
• Focus Finder - find every matching item on a calm board. Items never jump around.
• Rhythm Response - listen, then tap the rhythm back. Light-only and untimed versions, plus a simple calibration for your TV and speakers.
• Dual Challenge - quick sums, matching and memory, with optional gentle seated movement you can always skip.

Every game has practice, three levels, Relaxed mode with no timers, pause at any time, and a short summary.

PLAY TOGETHER
Pass the remote between 2 to 6 players. Everyone plays at their own level, a clear handoff screen shows whose turn it is, and you work toward a shared goal instead of ranking each other. Guests can join without signing up.

MINDGARDEN
Each finished activity adds one small discovery to your own garden. Nothing withers, there are no streaks to lose, and it never nags you to come back.

DAILY CIRCUIT
A new short circuit every day - replay it as often as you like.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
Larger text, high contrast, patterns with colours, reduce motion, larger targets, spoken instructions with on-screen captions, extra time, and VoiceOver support. An Accessibility Quick Setup appears before your first game. Every accessibility feature is free.

FREE TO PLAY, ONE OPTIONAL UNLOCK
All five games, practice, Relaxed mode, all accessibility options, one profile with guests, the daily circuit, the starter garden and pass-the-remote play are free.
Premium is a single one-time purchase (no subscription, no ads) that adds adaptive levels and extra game versions, up to 6 profiles, custom circuits and saved presets, the challenge archive, three more garden environments, Together campaigns, optional two-controller play, and detailed history.

Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.
MindMotion TV is for entertainment and general wellness. It is not a medical assessment or treatment, and scores are not a measure of health or intelligence.

name: &Pointer
description:
Pointer is a sketchpad for software developers. Draw linked lists, trees, state machines, and system diagrams with Apple Pencil, and write short technical notes next to them.

INK THAT KEEPS UP WITH YOU
Ink shows on the first touch of the pencil, at the full refresh rate of your iPad. A stroke never changes shape after you lift the pencil.

A CANVAS WITH NO EDGES
Each workspace has a dark canvas that goes on in every direction. Pan with one finger and zoom with two. The pencil only draws, so you never move the canvas by accident.

CARDS INSIDE CARDS
Put a card on the canvas and tap it to open its own canvas. Keep the overview on the top level and the details one level down. Cards go up to 32 levels deep.

THREE TOOLS, NOTHING ELSE
- Pen: white lines in three widths
- Eraser: cuts strokes where you touch them, in three sizes
- Text: typed text boxes, with Scribble support

No colors, shapes, or stickers. The screen stays clear for your thinking.

MADE FOR APPLE PENCIL
- Double tap to switch between pen and eraser
- Squeeze Apple Pencil Pro to open the tool palette at the tip
- On iPads with hover, a dot shows where the tip will touch
- Works with every Apple Pencil model

EXPORT AND BACKUP
- Export any canvas as a vector PDF with searchable text
- A daily backup goes to On My iPad > Pointer > Backups in the Files app
- Back up now, and restore from any backup file

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your notes stay on your iPad. Pointer has no account, no network access, no ads, and no tracking.

Pointer needs an iPad with Apple Pencil and iPadOS 26 or later.

name: 2nd Voice
description:
2nd Voice writes the second voice to your melody. Import a song as a MusicXML file (from MuseScore, Finale, Sibelius, Noteflight and others), the app works out a singable alto part, and you decide bar by bar what you like.

HOW IT WORKS
• Import a song, keep it in the library, open it.
• Pick a style: thirds & sixths, contrary motion, sustained voice, sixths (fauxbourdon) or organum.
• Every section comes with three suggestions (A, B, C). Tap, listen, choose – or use “Choose everywhere” to take one suggestion for the whole song.
• Nudge single notes up or down with a tap.
• Export as PDF or MusicXML.

MUSICALLY CLEAN
• The second voice fits the chords of the song.
• No clashing seconds between the voices and, except in organum, no parallel fifths or octaves.
• The range stays in a comfortable alto register.
• Clef and key signature appear only at the start; key changes are shown in the bar where they happen.

SONGS WITHOUT CHORDS
If your song has no chords, the app suggests fitting ones. You say whether the song is in a major or minor key and how it should end (authentic cadence, plagal cadence or tonic only). The chords follow the melody and can be changed at any time.

LISTEN
• Play melody and second voice with a piano or choir sound, separately or together.
• Choose a suggestion and playback starts there and keeps going. Tapping another suggestion jumps straight to it.
• The tempo is adjustable.

EXPORT AND TRANSPOSE
• Before exporting, transpose everything together: melody, chords and second voice, by semitones or straight to a target key.
• PDF for printing or sharing, MusicXML to keep working in your notation software.

FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Portrait and landscape, with more bars per line on iPad.
• Light and dark mode, German and English.
• Everything stays on your device: no accounts, no ads, no data collection.

Made for choirs and choir directors, vocal groups, music teachers and anyone who needs a second voice to a melody quickly.

name: 3Dez - Gestão de Impressão 3D
description:
O 3Dez é o sistema de gestão para quem trabalha com impressão 3D. Com o app, você acompanha o seu negócio de qualquer lugar, com a mesma conta do painel 3dez.com.br.

PEDIDOS E PRODUÇÃO
• Pedidos com itens, cores e filamentos, prazos, pagamentos e anexos
• Fila de impressão em quadro (kanban): da fila à entrega
• Agenda com entregas e prazos do mês
• PDF do pedido e do orçamento para mandar ao cliente

IMPRESSORAS E ESTOQUE
• Situação das impressoras, progresso e tempo restante da peça
• Estoque de filamentos com alerta de rolo acabando
• Guia de filamentos com temperaturas e dicas

DINHEIRO
• Calculadora de preço: filamento, energia, desgaste da máquina, mão de obra, embalagem, falhas e margem
• Financeiro com faturado, recebido, a receber e despesas por categoria
• Relatórios mês a mês e lista de quem está devendo

CLIENTES E VENDAS
• Cadastro de clientes com histórico de pedidos
• Orçamentos comerciais com desconto e validade
• Envios com rastreio
• Armário de arquivos 3D (STL, 3MF) organizado por pastas

Tudo fica sincronizado com o painel web: o que você muda no celular aparece no computador, e vice-versa. O acesso usa a mesma segurança do painel, com verificação em duas etapas opcional e entrada por Face ID.

Para usar o app é preciso ter uma conta no 3Dez (crie em 3dez.com.br).

name: Aberdeen Fix It
description:
Aberdeen, Washington's See Click Fix empowers residents to report Zoning Nuisance and Public Works concerns in their neighborhood directly and transparently to your local government right from our new See Click App. Promoting a clean, healthy and safe community for everyone. Helping to improve the place we call home. 
Key Features:

-Snap a photo, add a description and submit issues with precise GPS location

-View reported concerns within the community and track resolution times while having open communication with your local government

-Receive notifications when your reported concern is received or resolved

-Promotes community engagement and collaboration

name: Alrateb School
description:
Alrateb School brings your whole school into one app. Parents, students, teachers and drivers each get a home screen made for them, in Arabic or English.

FOR PARENTS
See every child's day at a glance: who is at school, today's lessons and what needs your attention
Get attendance updates the moment they happen, and tell the school in advance about an absence or late arrival
Follow grades, report cards, behaviour points and achievements
Pay school fees online or by bank transfer, view invoices and statements, and top up your children's wallets
Track the school bus live on the map, with stops, pickup times and driver details
Chat with teachers and the school, and read announcements
Join live lessons and parent meetings when the teacher invites you
Keep up with the calendar, events, field trips, activities and teams, and fill in school forms

FOR STUDENTS
A personal home screen with today's timetable, exams and new updates
Join live lessons from your phone or tablet
Rewatch recorded lessons in subject playlists, and like or bookmark your favourites
Read AI lesson summaries, and open books and materials organised by topic
Check exam dates, halls, seat numbers and hall tickets
Chat with your teachers

FOR TEACHERS AND STAFF
Take attendance, run live lessons and post to the class stream
Message parents, students and colleagues
Scan student cards by NFC or QR code for attendance, exams, events, the gate and bus boarding, with a vibration to confirm every scan

FOR DRIVERS
Start a bus trip and share its live location, even with the screen off

MADE FOR MOBILE
Instant push notifications for what matters
Full Arabic and English, with right-to-left layouts
Light and dark themes
Find your school by name or code once; the app remembers it and you can switch schools anytime

Your school gives you your sign-in details. If your school does not use Alrateb yet, ask them to contact us.

name: AntiPanic - помощь при панике
description:
Паническая атака ощущается как катастрофа: сердце колотится, не хватает воздуха, кажется, что теряешь контроль. AntiPanic сделан для того, чтобы в этот момент ты был не один.
Нажми SOS — и приложение спокойно проведёт тебя через приступ. Подскажет, как дышать, вернёт в момент через заземление, напомнит простую правду: это страшно, но не опасно. И это действительно проходит.
Когда станет полегче, рядом будет путь на 30 дней. Каждый день — один маленький шаг: тёплое слово, одна важная мысль и простое задание, которое нужно сделать. Шаг за шагом страх перед симптомами слабеет, а жизнь возвращается. После программы остаётся режим «Поддержка» — короткая практика на каждый день, чтобы не растерять то, что ты наработал.
Внутри всё, что помогает по-настоящему: дыхательные техники, которые снижают тревогу за пару минут; разбор симптомов простым языком, без пугающих терминов; лестница смелости, чтобы постепенно вернуть места и ситуации, которых ты стал избегать; дневник приступов, где видно твои триггеры; и честные истории людей, которые прошли через то же самое и справились.
Всё, что ты пишешь, хранится только на твоём устройстве — мы ничего не собираем и никому не передаём. Приложение полностью бесплатное.
AntiPanic не заменяет врача или психотерапевта, но он всегда под рукой — когда тяжело и когда ты готов двигаться дальше. Ты не сломан. Ты просто перегружен. И ты уже начал разбираться.

name: AstejakoKone
description: AstejakoKone on jakokoneen ja mittakaarien viivamisen mitoituslaskin. Sovellus laskee karan pyörintätarkkuuden, jakolevyn jaot ja kulma-askeleen, kaihtimen kärjen ja viivan syvyyden, syötön liikeradan, asteikon kaaren säteen ja viivojen määrän sekä valmiin kaaren kulmavirheen, jakoetäisyysvirheen ja toistotarkkuuden. Arvoja säädetään liukusäätimillä, asetuksia voi tallentaa ja tekniset tiedot voi viedä PDF-, CSV- tai DXF-muodossa. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta.

name: Babbly: Baby Voice Album
description:
Their little voice is already on your phone, hidden inside hundreds of videos. Babbly finds it.

It listens to your videos, on your phone, and pulls out every moment where your child is talking, babbling, laughing or singing. Then it lays them out by age, from first babble to today.

HEAR THEM GROW UP
• Every moment, grouped by age: 0–3 months, 3–6 months … Age 2, Age 3
• Add a birthday and each moment shows their age, like "2 years 3 months"
• Play them back to back, like stories
• Love the best ones, hide the ones that aren't your child

THE BABBLY FILM (Pro)
One film with their voice across the years, in order, with their age on screen. 9:16, ready for Reels, Shorts and WhatsApp Status. Save it to Photos or send it to the grandparents.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your phone with an on-device sound model. Nothing is uploaded. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE AND PRO
Free: find and play every moment.
Pro, one payment, no subscription: make, save and share the Babbly film.

Note: Babbly recognises children's voices in general, not one particular child. Hide any moment that isn't yours.

name: BATTLEFRAME - Tactical Camera
description:
BATTLEFRAME — Make Everyday Tactical.

Turn everyday scenes into tactical-style footage with BATTLEFRAME, a cinematic HUD camera app for iPhone.

BATTLEFRAME detects and tracks multiple people in real time, adding a dynamic heads-up display (HUD) inspired by tactical games and movies.

Capture photos and videos with HUD graphics and cinematic filters applied directly to your footage. From airsoft games and outdoor adventures to everyday moments with friends, BATTLEFRAME gives your recordings a completely different look.

KEY FEATURES

■ REAL-TIME MULTI-PERSON TRACKING
Automatically detect and track multiple people in the camera view. Each detected person receives an individual tracking frame, ID, and estimated distance.

■ TACTICAL HEADS-UP DISPLAY
Display a live compass, MGRS coordinates, pitch and roll indicators, camera information, and tracking data.

■ FOUR HUD COLOR THEMES
Customize your display with four distinctive colors:
- Tactical Green
- Orange
- White
- Red

■ CINEMATIC VIDEO FILTERS
Give your footage a cinematic look with four adjustable filters:
- Tactical Cinema
- Cinematic Blue
- Gritty Documentary
- Night Ops

Adjust filter intensity to create your preferred visual style.

■ CUSTOMIZABLE HUD
Choose between Full HUD and Clean HUD layouts, three reticle styles (Frame, Split, and Plus), and multiple stabilization levels.

■ THREAT MODE
Add a dramatic tactical effect by randomly highlighting one detected person as a high-threat target. This is a visual effect only and does not assess actual threats or danger.

■ PHOTO AND VIDEO CAPTURE
Record photos and videos with your selected HUD graphics and cinematic filters included in the saved results.

■ JAPANESE AND ENGLISH
Switch between Japanese and English directly in the app.

DESIGNED FOR CREATIVE FILMING

Whether you're capturing airsoft action, creating tactical-style videos, or simply having fun with friends, BATTLEFRAME transforms your camera into a cinematic HUD experience.

IMPORTANT NOTES

BATTLEFRAME is intended for entertainment and creative photography. Distance readings are estimates and should not be used for precise measurements. Person detection performance depends on lighting, distance, and device conditions.

Threat Mode uses a random visual effect and does not perform real-world threat assessment.

No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. Enjoy BATTLEFRAME with a one-time purchase.

Make Everyday Tactical.

name: BloomLab+
description:
BloomLab+ is a seasonal guide for ikebana and flower arranging. It shows which stems are in bloom and at the market where you live, how to condition them, and which vessel each one suits.

NOW
Your home screen shows the stems in season for your region this month. Stems at their peak are marked Shun, and the Japanese solar term for the current fortnight sits at the top. Switch between In bloom (gardens and the wild) and At the market (what florists sell).

STEM PAGES
Each stem has its English, botanical and Japanese names, two season bars for your region (in bloom and at the market), and how well it works in a kago (basket), a nageire (tall vase) and a moribana (shallow suiban), with a reason for each. Mizuage steps help the cut stem drink before you arrange it. You also get vase life, stem length, form, colors, whether it is toxic to pets, and photo credits.

CALENDAR AND SEARCH
See all twelve months at a glance with the number of stems in season. Search by English, botanical or Japanese name, then narrow by month, vessel, role, color or pet safety.

IKERU PLANNER
Choose a vessel and a month. BloomLab+ suggests in-season stems for line, mass and filler, and says why each one suits the vessel.

REGIONS
Southern California is the baseline, reviewed by Valeria, a teacher in the Sangetsu tradition. Other US regions, Northwest Europe, Japan and the Southern Hemisphere are included and marked approximate. You can choose your region, or let BloomLab+ work it out once from your approximate location. Only the region is kept.

LEARN
A short guide to the three vessels, mizuage and how the seasons work, plus a link to Valeria's ikebana classes. Help & guides in Settings has how-to videos.

PREMIUM
Free includes Now, the Calendar, Search, every stem page, the top Ikeru pick for each role and up to 10 favorites. Premium adds:
- Ikeru planner: every in-season stem for any vessel, with saved plans and market lists
- My vessels: your own vases and baskets with their height and opening, so plans fit them
- My garden: mark the stems you grow and see when they are in shun
- Journal: a photo record of your arrangements with date, stems and vessel
- Unlimited favorites

Premium is $3.99 a month or $19.99 a year, and the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. Restore purchases is on the Premium page.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. Favorites, your garden, vessels, plans and the journal stay on your device. BloomLab+ collects no data.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bloomlabplus.com/privacy

name: Both Yes
description:
“What do you want to eat?” “I don't care, you pick.”

Both Yes ends the loop. Pick a deck, both of you swipe yes or no — privately, so nobody's just being polite — and the app reveals only the things you BOTH said yes to. One match? Done. A few matches? Spin the tiebreaker. No matches? The near-misses get a relaxed round, or let the app pick for you.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a deck: Dinner, Movie Night, Date Night, Weekend, Chores — or build your own
• Partner 1 swipes in secret, then hands the phone over (answers stay hidden)
• Partner 2 swipes the same cards
• The app reveals your matches and picks the winner

PLAY ON TWO PHONES
Together but apart? After you swipe, tap “Send to your partner instead” — they get an iMessage link, swipe the same cards on their own phone, and the result comes right back to you. There's also a Both Yes game built right into Messages: start a round without leaving your chat.

REAL MOVIES, REAL PLACES
• In Theaters Now — swipe real movie posters playing near you, then jump to showtimes and the closest theater with directions
• Restaurants Near You — pick a cuisine and swipe real restaurants around you, with directions in Apple Maps
• Dinner and Movie Night winners can jump straight to live picks nearby

YOUR HISTORY
Every decision is saved, so you stop re-picking the same three places.

No accounts. No sign-up. Your answers live on your phone, not on a server. Just the two of you, deciding in seconds.

name: Brilliant Quran
description:
تطبيق «Brilliant Quran - المصحف المحمدي الشريف» هو مصحف رقمي متكامل وموثق برواية ورش عن نافع من طريق الأزرق (604 صفحات • 60 حزباً • 6214 آية بالعدّ المدني الأخير)، مصمم بهوية زخرفية مغربية أصيلة ويعمل بالكامل بدون إنترنت (100% Hors-ligne) وبدون أي إعلانات أو تتبع.

أهم المميزات:
• المصحف المحمدي برواية ورش: عرض مطابق لصفحات المصحف الشريف (604 صفحات) مع إمكانية التبديل إلى وضع القراءة المتصلة، تكبير وتصغير الخط، و3 مظاهر قراءة مريحة للعين (نهاري عاجي، ليلي داكن، ورقّ كلاسيكي).
• حفظ تلقائي لموضع القراءة والعلامات المرجعية: يحفظ التطبيق آخر صفحة توقفت عندها تلقائياً دون أن تتأثر أثناء البحث أو تصفح الإحصاءات، مع إمكانية حفظ علامات مرجعية متعددة.
• التفسير المزدوج بدون إنترنت: يجمع بين «التفسير الميسر» المدمج و«الجامع لأحكام القرآن للإمام القرطبي» مع إمكانية التبديل الفوري بينهما وتكبير الخط.
• البحث القرآني والمعجمي الشامل:
  1. بحث فوري في جميع آيات القرآن الكريم يدعم الرسم العثماني، الإملاء العربي الحديث، وإبدال ورش، مع عرض الآية في نافذة سياقية عائمة (مع 5 آيات سابقة و5 لاحقة) لعدم فقدان صفحة القراءة.
  2. معجم مفردات القرآن وغريبه مع تحليل الجذور اللغوية (لسان العرب) والصيغ الصرفية والمشتقات القرآنية.
• الإحصاء القرآني الدقيق: حساب فوري لتكرار أي كلمة أو جذر في القرآن الكريم، مع توزيعها في السور المكية والمدنية، الأحزاب الستين، والصفحات، مدعماً بلوحة مفاتيح عربية مدمجة.
• التجويد والتدبر وأصول ورش: تفكيك حرفي وحركي لكل كلمة قرآنية، استخراج تلقائي لأحكام التجويد الخاصة برواية ورش (نقل الحركة، الإمالة الصغرى، ترقيق الراءات، تغليظ اللامات، مد البدل)، مع دليل أحكام سجود التلاوة (11 سجدة في ورش) ودعاء ختم القرآن الكريم.

name: Cabas – Courses partagées
description:
Cabas, c’est la liste de courses qui se fait à plusieurs. En couple, en famille ou en colocation : chacun ajoute, chacun coche, et tout le monde voit la même liste, en temps réel.

AJOUTER EN DEUX SECONDES
• Tapez « 2 baguettes, lait, 500 g de farine » : trois articles, quantités comprises.
• Plus de 650 produits reconnus et rangés tout seuls au bon rayon.
• Vos habituels reviennent quand il est temps de les racheter.

SCANNER TOUT CE QUI A UN CODE-BARRES
• Aliments, hygiène, produits pour animaux : photo, marque, Nutri-Score, et les prix relevés en magasin quand ils existent.
• Livres, magazines, médicaments, disques, jouets, objets de la maison.
• Un produit inconnu ? Nommez-le une fois : il sera reconnu la prochaine fois.

À PLUSIEURS, POUR DE VRAI
• Invitez par lien, QR code ou code à 8 caractères.
• Chaque ajout apparaît aussitôt chez les autres, avec la photo de celui qui l’a ajouté.
• « Léa est en magasin » : glissez un dernier article avant qu’elle passe en caisse.
• Notifications regroupées : une rafale d’ajouts, une seule notification.

EN MAGASIN
• Un mode magasin aux grandes lignes, rangées dans l’ordre de votre parcours.
• Un geste pour cocher, l’écran reste allumé.
• « Terminer les courses » : notez le total du ticket, c’est tout.

VOS DÉPENSES, SANS EFFORT
• Le total du mois, le panier moyen, six mois d’historique.

SIMPLE ET RESPECTUEUX
• Sans compte : un prénom, une couleur, une photo si vous voulez.
• Fonctionne hors ligne : les modifications partent au retour du réseau.
• Ni publicité, ni traceur.

name: CareLine - Report Organizer
description:
CareLine is a document folder for your doctor visits, right on your iPhone.

Import paper lab reports, photos of test results and PDFs from the hospital. CareLine files them by date so you can find what you need at your next appointment.

IMPORT
• Scan paper reports, several pages at a time, with automatic edge cropping
• Import many photos or files at once, or open files from other apps with CareLine
• Choose which condition a batch belongs to before importing
• Rotate a sideways scan and recognize it again

ORGANIZE
• On-device text recognition turns test items and values into a table you can check line by line against the original
• File lab reports, imaging, exams, endoscopy, pathology and more
• See every test, visit, treatment and medication on one timeline
• Compare past values of the same test side by side
• Create a visit summary PDF to review at follow-up visits

FOR YOUR FAMILY
• Keep a separate profile for yourself and each family member

STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
• No account; every feature works offline
• Text recognition runs on the device and nothing is uploaded
• Face ID / Touch ID lock and encrypted backups

CareLine is a personal records organizer. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment advice or medical interpretation. Text recognition can make mistakes; the original report always takes precedence.

name: Cerobiz : POS & Billing
description:
Run everyday business operations with Cerobiz ERP. Create sales invoices, quotations, sales orders, delivery notes and returns. Record purchases, purchase orders, supplier returns, receipts and payments, and review ledger and outstanding balances.

Manage products, customers and suppliers, branches, stock transfers and financial periods. Use POS workflows, table orders and kitchen tickets where enabled for your account. Scan product barcodes or QR codes, generate and share PDF documents, and print using compatible thermal printers.

Cerobiz ERP connects to your organization’s configured ERP service. Sign-in and available modules depend on your organization’s account, permissions and server configuration. An authorized business account is required.

name: Chi Li – Expense Tracker
description:
Chi Li shows you where your money goes without the tedious data entry.

LOG IN SECONDS
• Type like a text message: "coffee 4.50 cash", "salary 3200 to bank" — Chi Li works out the amount, category and wallet.
• Home-screen widgets and app-icon shortcuts: open and log.
• A gentle evening reminder, logging streaks, and a "No spending today" button.

YOUR WHOLE FINANCIAL PICTURE
• Multiple wallets: cash, bank accounts, e-wallets, credit cards; transfers between them.
• Budgets by category with alerts at 70%, 90% and 100%.
• Recurring items and upcoming bills — never miss rent, utilities or subscriptions.
• Debts: money you borrowed or lent, interest, due-date reminders, write-offs.
• Savings goals: a car, a trip, an emergency fund.
• Reports: income vs. spending, by category, net worth, and a 30-day balance forecast.
• Import bank statements from Excel/CSV; transfers between your own wallets are detected.
• Attach receipt photos, add tags and people.
• Works in English and Vietnamese, with your currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, KRW, SGD, THB, AUD, VND).

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Your transactions stay only on your phone, encrypted.
• We never sell data, and your financial data is never used for ads.
• No bank passwords needed.
• Lock the app with a PIN, Face ID or fingerprint.
• Export all your data any time; delete your account in the app.

CHI LI PREMIUM (iPhone, iPad)
• No ads.
• End-to-end encrypted cloud backup with a password only you know; restore when you change phones.
• Auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription; cancel any time in App Store settings.

Terms of Use: https://chi-li.web.app/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://chi-li.web.app/en/privacy

name: ChronoBible: Bible in a Year
description:
Read the whole Bible in the order it happened. One year, a little each day, with a short recap that makes it all make sense.

The books of the Bible are not arranged in time order. This plan puts every chapter where its events happened, so you read one story from Creation to the early Church.

WHAT YOU GET
• A 365-day plan in story order, with your own start and finish dates
• Today's reading in a clean reader with adjustable text size
• A short recap after each day's reading: what happened and why it matters
• Audio for every chapter in the King James Version, up to 2× speed
• Two translations to read: King James Version and World English Bible
• A one-line journal for what you noticed each day, kept on your iPhone
• A daily reminder at the time you choose
• Simple ways to catch up when you fall behind

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose when you read and which translation you like
2. Read today's chapters, or listen to them
3. Read the recap and write one line about what you noticed

FREE AND PREMIUM
The reading plan, the Scripture text, the reader and the journal are free. Premium opens the recap for all 365 days and audio for every chapter.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is an auto-renewable subscription, billed weekly, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID Account Settings.

Terms of Use: https://thebibleapp.link/terms
Privacy Policy: https://thebibleapp.link/privacy

name: Ciclo de Tarefas
description: Ciclo de Tarefas é o jeito simples de não esquecer nada que se repete: emitir notas, pagar fornecedores, fazer backup, fechar o caixa, pagar as contas da casa.

name: CINEyenne
description:
CINEyenne is the watchlist that plans your movie night. Collect everything you still want to see, rate in chilies how urgent it is, and the app tells you when to watch what. For movies and series, on iPhone and iPad, no ads.

COLLECT
Type a title, done. Cover, year, runtime and genre arrive from the web; for series the full episode list comes along. Then rate from 1 to 5 chilies how urgently you need to see it and pick which of your services it streams on.

SWIPE
Under "Discover" CINEyenne shows your collection as a card stack. Right: "Yes, watch soon." Left: "Maybe later." Down: watched, into the archive. Up: "How far am I?" with minutes left for a movie and the last episode for a series. Or browse the coverflow and decide with the buttons.

PLAN
Set when you watch: time slots from Monday to Sunday, several per day if you like. Add your mood per day, say more comedy on Fridays and less horror on Mondays. The planner fills the next seven days by urgency, mood and length. Tonight's pick is right at the top of the start screen.

KEEP GOING
Series are planned episode by episode, with a reminder 15 minutes before your slot. If a started series sits idle for a few days, you get a nudge before you lose the thread.

FEEL LIKE IT NOW?
Say how much time you have and CINEyenne suggests what fits tonight: a movie that fits the slot or the next episodes of your series.

STREAM
Add your subscriptions: Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV+, Paramount+, Sky/WOW, RTL+, Joyn, Crunchyroll, MagentaTV, MUBI, YouTube, ARD and ZDF. Every title gets a Stream button: it opens the service and copies the title, so you can paste it straight into the search. The title view also links to the "Wer streamt es?" search (werstreamt.es), where one tap shows where the film or series is streaming right now.

YOUR COLLECTION
Everything in a grid under "Want to see", "Started", "Later" and "Archive", with progress bars and episodes to tick off.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Collection, time slots and services live in your private iCloud database and stay in sync on iPhone and iPad. Sign in with Apple is optional; in Settings you can sign out or delete your account together with all data.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
No ads, no analytics, no server of the provider. Search only queries the public directories of Wikipedia, Wikidata and TVmaze; add your own TMDB and IMDb (OMDb) keys if you like.

In the new design of the Chili app family: Liquid Glass, clear numbers instead of decoration, dark mode, three languages (German, English, Chinese) and a guided first start.

name: CochinealGig
description:
CochinealGig es la app para productores de cochinilla que quieren llevar el cultivo, la cosecha y los ingresos con claridad.

Organiza parcelas de nopal, registra inoculaciones y cosechas, controla el secado y anota cada venta. Luego analiza qué temporada, franja de cosecha y forma de tratamiento generan más ingreso, y comparte un informe en PDF.

Qué puedes hacer

Gestionar parcelas, estado del nopal y lotes de inoculación
Seguir la cola de cosecha (~90 días) y registrar peso, método y franja horaria
Anotar el tratamiento/secado por temporada y forma de secado
Registrar ventas con precio, cantidad y comprador
Comparar ingresos por temporada, hora de cosecha y tratamiento
Generar, exportar y compartir informes PDF
Diseñada para el día a día Interfaz clara, fichas con iconos y pantallas vacías listas para añadir datos. Ideal para ver de un vistazo el pulso del negocio: kilos, ingresos y lotes pendientes.

CochinealGig: cría, cosecha e ingreso, con datos que ayudan a decidir mejor.

name: code.kz
description:
Рабочее приложение для сотрудников медицинских учреждений и сервисных инженеров.

 • Подача заявок на ремонт и обслуживание медицинского оборудования
 • Статус заявки и история работ по каждому аппарату
 • Сканирование кода на оборудовании для быстрого поиска аппарата
 • Чат, аудио- и видеозвонки с сервисной службой
 • Push-уведомления о новых сообщениях и изменениях по заявкам
 • Подписание документов и актов

 Доступ подтверждается администратором после регистрации.

name: Corpus: Greek Hero Training
description:
Corpus measures where you stand — strength, endurance, balance, recovery — against published norms for your age and sex, and trains you toward a Greek hero. Calisthenics, fitness tests and a training log, offline, with no account.

TEST WHERE YOU STAND
• Push-ups, pull-ups, the 12-minute Cooper run, single-leg balance with eyes closed, resting heart rate, VO₂ max and a dry breath hold
• Each result is compared with a published norm for your age and sex. Every norm names its study and its limits; a test with no published norm is logged, never scored
• Step-by-step instructions for every test, and a check-in every four weeks

SEVEN DIRECTIONS, ONE RADAR
• Strength, Agility, the Hunt, Recovery, Depth, Seamanship and Mind, each with its patron
• A radar of your results against your hero, and a compass needle at the biggest gap
• Mind and Seamanship are trained, not yet measured — unscored rather than faked

A HERO TO TRAIN TOWARD
• Perseus, the balanced hero, is free. Training toward Achilles, Atalanta, Orion, Theseus, Pheidippides or Milo of Croton comes with Premium
• Resonance shows how close you are. Mortal, Hero, Demigod — and further degrees once you reach him

CALISTHENICS, RUNG BY RUNG
• 114 bodyweight variations on 16 ladders, easiest to hardest: push-ups, pull-ups, dips, legs, core, hangs, handstand, jumps, crawls, mobility, balance
• Skill ladders with Premium: muscle-up, front lever, back lever, planche, human flag
• Every practice written out: goal, equipment, steps, an easier alternative. No prescribed loads or reps
• A patron for each weekday, and one next step on Today, with the reason

YOUR TRAINING LOG
• Record sets as you go: reps for a movement, time for a hold
• Streaks, an activity grid, the best set of every exercise, and every measurement's change since your baseline

APPLE HEALTH, READ-ONLY
• If you allow it, Corpus reads your VO₂ max and resting heart rate from the Apple Health app — when you ask, or in the background. It never writes anything back, and imported values are marked

THE WORLD BEHIND THE AXES
• A family tree of 80 figures, from Chaos to Heracles, sourced to Hesiod, Apollodorus and Homer, and a map of the myths with the journeys of Heracles, Perseus, Theseus and Odysseus

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. What you enter stays on your iPhone, and everything works offline. Anonymous usage statistics can be turned off
• Export to CSV or JSON, or erase it all. Local reminders, off until you turn them on
• Metric or imperial units. English, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Greek and Italian

CORPUS PREMIUM
Free for good: radar and compass, every test and check-in, the log, Perseus and his degrees, every base practice, Apple Health, export. Nothing you record is ever locked. Premium adds the six other heroes, the five skill ladders and progress charts.
Corpus Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

BEFORE YOU START
Corpus is not a medical device and gives no medical advice: a score compares one result with a population norm and says nothing about your health. Breath holds are dry only, seated or lying down. Never hold your breath in or near water. Stop if something hurts or you feel unwell. Talk to a doctor before training if you have a heart, lung or joint condition, or are pregnant.

name: CutNest Workshop
description:
Plan board cuts around the material you already have. CutNest turns stock, part lengths and blade kerf into an estimated one-dimensional cut layout.

• Keep a stock list by material, length and quantity, with dimensions in millimeters.
• Enter the pieces you need, choose a material and set your saw kerf.
• Review cuts for each board, remaining lengths and any unallocated pieces. Share the cut list as CSV.
• Confirm a complete, current plan to update stock and track offcuts. Return eligible offcuts to stock for another job.

Your stock, cutting jobs, cut plans and offcuts are stored locally. The app has no sign-in, ads, analytics SDK, subscriptions or in-app purchases. iOS backup follows your device settings.

name: Daily Hamster: Logic Puzzle
description:
Daily Hamster is a one-board-a-day logic game with a room full of hamsters waiting at the end of it.

The rule fits in one line: put one hamster in every row, every column and every colored region — and no two hamsters may touch, not even diagonally. That's it. Every board has exactly one solution, and every board can be solved by pure deduction. No guessing, ever.

【100 boards, ten small chapters】
Ten chapters of ten boards. Each chapter adds exactly one new idea: crates that block a cell, yarn balls that want a neighbour, a second breed of hamster that may sit next to its own kind, timed boards, and finally 8x8 grids. Nothing is dumped on you at once — you always have exactly one thing to learn.

【Stars build the room】
Every solve earns up to three stars. Stars bring furniture: a nest, a food bowl, a yarn ball, a plant, a wheel, a lamp, a rug, a seed shelf, a tent, a bean bag. At 110, 235, 250 and 275 stars the whole background changes — the last two rooms also ask for a challenge record (clear 5 Time Attack boards / win 8 Endless boards in a row). Tap any decoration to move it between the front row and the back row — that is the only decorating there is, and it is free.

【Eleven hamsters to meet】
Common, rare, epic and one legendary hamster arrive as you clear boards: cream, pudding, silver fox, panda, golden, rainbow and more. Each one moves in with a small animation. Collect all eleven and a little monument appears in the room.

【A daily board, not a daily chore】
One board a day, the same for everyone, getting slightly harder as the week goes on. A streak counter, the last seven days, and your best run. Miss a day and it simply resets — no penalty, no paywall, no notification begging you back.

【Zero interruptions】
No ads. No energy. No timers pushing you to pay. No account, no login, no push notifications. The whole game works offline and your progress never leaves your phone.

【Free and full】
The first 20 boards, the daily board, and three hints per board are free. A single one-time purchase opens all 100 boards, unlimited hints, a 30-second extension when a timed board runs out, and the two long-run modes: Time Attack (clear as many boards as you can on one 120-second clock that never resets) and Endless (three misses and the run ends). No subscription, ever. Restore it any time.

【Small print】
- Regions are separated by bold borders as well as colour, and every cell has a VoiceOver label.
- Sound and haptics can be switched off.
- English and Simplified Chinese, switchable inside the app.
- Nothing is collected, nothing is tracked, nothing leaves the device.

Daily Hamster is made for the five quiet minutes on the train or before sleep. One board. Then close it.

name: Daywell Team
description:
Daywell is the all-in-one app for restaurant teams. Schedules, chat, training, tasks and checklists live in one place, so everyone knows where to be, what to do and who's on it.

YOUR SHIFTS, ALWAYS UP TO DATE
• See your upcoming shifts and hours for the week
• Request time off and update your availability
• Pick up open shifts from the Shift Marketplace
• Get notified the moment the schedule is posted or a shift changes

TEAM CHAT BUILT FOR THE FLOOR
• Channels for the whole team, each location and each department
• Direct and group messages, threads, reactions and photos
• Announcements leaders can see who has read
• Quick voice huddles for the team

THE PLAY CHART
• Who's on which position right now, filled in from the schedule
• Drag people between positions and see staffing at a glance
• Callout Autopilot finds coverage when someone calls out

TRAINING, TASKS AND CHECKLISTS
• Training plans with progress for every new team member
• Tasks and projects with owners, due dates and subtasks
• Opening, mid-day and closing checklists with sign-off

RECOGNITION AND GROWTH
• Moola rewards to recognize great work
• Team ratings and coaching notes for leaders

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Each restaurant has its own private workspace. Team members join by invitation from their restaurant, and what each person can see depends on their role. Sensitive records stay with leaders, and notifications about them never show details on your lock screen.

Daywell is for restaurant teams whose employer uses Daywell. Ask your manager for an invitation, or learn more at daywellteam.com.

name: DepositGO - Move-In Inspection
description:
Record your rental's condition at move-in and move-out. Dated, sealed photos and a signed PDF give you a clear record when it's time to settle the deposit.

DepositGO walks you through your apartment room by room. For every item, from walls and floors to the oven and the smoke alarm, you pick the condition, add a note and take photos. Each photo is dated and sealed with a SHA-256 fingerprint the moment you take it.

WHAT YOU GET
- A room-by-room checklist in the format your country uses: UK check-in inventory, German Übergabeprotokoll, US move-in checklist, Australian condition report, or a general report anywhere else.
- Dated, sealed photos with a photo list, so anyone can check that nothing was changed later.
- Meter readings with a photo of each meter, keys handed over and smoke alarms tested.
- Signatures from you and your landlord or agent, on the phone.
- One locked PDF in your landlord's language, on A4 or Letter, ready to email.

AT MOVE-OUT
Start the move-out report from your move-in report. The camera shows the move-in photo as a faint guide, so you take the same angle again. Mark each item unchanged, fair wear and tear or new damage, and get a side-by-side comparison PDF.

DURING THE TENANCY
Log a leak or a broken heater with dated photos and note when you told your landlord. Set a reminder for when your deposit is due back.

YOUR DATA
No account and no server. Tenancies, photos and reports stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. An optional trusted timestamp (RFC 3161) sends only the report's fingerprint.

ONE PURCHASE
See a sample report first. One purchase then unlocks everything for good, with Family Sharing. No subscription. The price is shown in the app before you buy. Already bought it? Tap Restore on the purchase screen or Restore purchase in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://familygo.app/depositgo/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://familygo.app/depositgo/privacy/

Works on iPhone and iPad.

DepositGO helps you document condition. It doesn't decide disputes or replace your tenancy agreement or official forms.

name: Dirty Boots IQ
description:
Think you know the outdoors? Dirty Boots IQ is ready to put that confidence to the test.

Challenge yourself with trivia about wildlife, fishing, hunting, camping, trees, mushrooms, and more. Pick your level—Rookie, Woodsman, or Expert—and see how much field knowledge you really have.

Meet Nibbles, your sarcastic squirrel companion. He’s here to celebrate your victories, question your confidence, and take far too much credit when you need a hint.

• Test your knowledge with outdoor quizzes and photo challenges.
• Explore three difficulty levels.
• Solve the Daily Trail Crossword, with letter hints and saved progress.
• Collect scores and badges as you play.
• Enjoy offline quizzes and crosswords wherever your boots take you.

A little knowledge. A little attitude. A whole lot of outdoors.

Dirty Boots IQ is for education and entertainment. Never use quiz answers or photos to determine whether a plant or mushroom is safe to eat. Always check current official regulations before hunting or fishing.

name: DuoList - Scan To-Do Lists
description:
Scan handwritten to-do lists and turn them into editable checklists on your iPhone. Keep writing on paper and take a digital copy of your grocery list, chores, or errands wherever you go.

• Scan a paper list with your camera or choose a photo. DuoList reads your handwriting on your device and turns each line into a list item.
• Review the scan alongside the original. Fix any misread words, add missing items, and check things off as you go.
• Scan the same list again when you add something on paper. DuoList adds new items to your saved list and remembers corrections for future scans of that list.
• Send items from a quick scan to a list in Apple Reminders.

The free version includes Quick Scan and one saved list. Unlock DuoList Full Version with a one-time purchase to keep multiple saved lists and sync linked lists both ways with Apple Reminders. No subscription.

name: Ear Training: Music Theory Lab
description:
Hear music like a musician. Ear Training: Music Theory Lab turns ear training into a short daily habit, with a guided path that takes you from your first notes to reading music and naming chords by ear.

A GUIDED PATH, 5 MINUTES A DAY
• 147 bite-size steps across Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced
• Short lessons, then a quick check so it sticks
• Built around your goals: singing, playing by ear, music school or just for fun

TRAIN EVERY SKILL
• Intervals: from minor 2nds to octaves, going up, down and together
• Perfect pitch: name notes with no reference
• Chords: major, minor, diminished, augmented and 7ths
• Progressions: hear I–IV–V–I, I–V–vi–IV, ii–V–I and more
• Rhythm: tap patterns in time, with feedback on every tap
• Sight reading: treble and bass clef, answered on a piano keyboard
• Practice adapts to you: levels go up as you improve and weak spots come back more often

TOOLS FOR EVERY MUSICIAN
• Vocal range finder: sing low to high and see your range
• Circle of fifths you can tap and hear
• Chord player, reference notes and a metronome with tap tempo

GAMES AND MOTIVATION
• Note Blitz, Interval Memory and Rhythm Taps
• Streaks with rest days, so one missed day doesn't undo your progress
• Badges and progress charts

REAL PIANO SOUND
Every note is a recording of a concert grand piano, not a synthesizer.

SUBSCRIPTION
Ear Training: Music Theory Lab is free to download. Full access needs a subscription: yearly (with a free trial) or weekly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://appgrowthdave.github.io/eartraining-legal/privacy/

name: Elite Vault - Metal Prices
description:
Check indicative gold, silver and platinum prices per gram in your selected currency. Choose a karat or fineness to see the estimated value of the metal in an alloy, or enter your own purity.

The intraday chart uses quotes received during the current session. While the app is open, Elite Vault checks Gold API for new prices every 30 seconds and displays the source timestamp.

Free to use, with no account or ads. Elite Vault is a price reference and does not offer buying, selling or investing.

Choose from eleven languages and nineteen currencies. The initial currency follows your device region when supported. Gold uses KT, while silver and platinum use parts per thousand (‰).

name: Estoy Aburrido: Noticias
description:
Estoy Aburrido es un medio digital mexicano que explica lo que pasa en tecnología, finanzas y política, sin rodeos y con las fuentes a la vista.

QUÉ ENCUENTRAS
• Portada con lo más importante del momento y lo último publicado.
• Cuatro secciones: Tecnología, Finanzas, Política y Última hora.
• Notas completas con imagen, tiempo de lectura y la lista de fuentes consultadas, con enlace a cada una.
• «Nuestra lectura»: un análisis al final de cada nota, siempre marcado como opinión para que no se mezcle con los hechos.
• Comentarios: entra con Apple o con Google y da tu opinión. Todos los comentarios se moderan antes de publicarse.
• Búsqueda por título, tema o persona.
• Lectura sin conexión: las notas descargadas se quedan en tu teléfono.
• Comparte cualquier nota con un toque.
• Modo oscuro y texto ajustable al tamaño que uses en tu iPhone o iPad.

LEER ES LIBRE
No necesitas cuenta para leer. La app es gratuita gracias a la publicidad. Si entras para comentar, puedes borrar tu cuenta y todos tus comentarios cuando quieras desde la app.

CÓMO HACEMOS LAS NOTAS
Las notas se redactan con apoyo de inteligencia artificial a partir de fuentes públicas que citamos en cada texto, y pasan por una verificación dato por dato antes de publicarse. Si ves un error, escríbenos a hola@estoyaburrido.mx: corregimos y lo dejamos anotado.

name: Family Record Network
description:
**Requires a self-hosted account on a Family Network server, set up by someone in your family. No access without that!**

A home for everything your family shares.

Keep your family's news, photos, stories and history together in one place. See what everyone is up to, explore how you're all related, and hold on to the memories that make your family yours.

FAMILY FEED
Share updates, photos and GIFs, tag family members, and react and comment on each other's posts. Birthdays and anniversaries show up right in your feed.

FAMILY TREE
Explore your family three ways: a classic lineage tree, a tidy tree of descendants, or a family wheel with a ring for each generation.

MESSAGES
Chat one-on-one or in groups, and send photos and GIFs along the way.

GALLERY
Browse the whole family's photos together, filter by family or person, and tag who's in each picture.

DIRECTORY
Find anyone in the family, see their profile, and filter by family branch.

LORE
Write down the stories that get retold at every reunion, add photos, and let everyone chime in before the details are lost.

NOTIFICATIONS
Know when someone messages you, tags you in a photo, or posts on your wall.

YOUR FAMILY'S OWN SPACE
Your family's posts and photos live on a server your family runs, not on a public social network.

name: Family Rummy
description:
Family Rummy turns the phones around the table into a card game. One person taps Host, everyone else taps Join, and your hands are dealt — each player's cards stay private on their own phone while the table is shared.

• Play in the same room — on a couch, a road trip, a camping trip. No internet needed.
• No accounts, no ads, no chat, no data collected. Fine for kids.
• Drop out and rejoin: reopen the app and you're back in your seat with your hand.
• The host can pause and resume a game later.
• Nobody around? Practice against three computer players.

Everyone needs Family Rummy on their own iPhone.

name: Fim de Mês
description:
Veja em um só lugar as ofertas dos encartes dos mercados de Catalão, GO.

O Fim de Mês reúne os encartes divulgados pelos supermercados da cidade e transforma cada um em uma lista de ofertas fácil de consultar. Você compara preços e decide onde vale a pena comprar antes de sair de casa.

O QUE VOCÊ ENCONTRA
• Ofertas de hoje, por categoria e por mercado, com busca
• Comparação do mesmo produto entre mercados
• Encartes do dia para ver e ampliar
• Histórico de preço do produto
• Dados do mercado, como endereço, horário e WhatsApp, quando informados

LISTA DE COMPRAS
Monte sua lista e veja o total em cada mercado. Compartilhe pelo WhatsApp com quem vai fazer as compras.

MERCADOS FAVORITOS
Marque seus mercados e veja primeiro o que importa para você.

PREÇO DIFERENTE?
Viu outro preço na gôndola? Avise pelo app para a gente conferir.

SEM CADASTRO
Não precisa criar conta. Sua lista e seus favoritos ficam guardados no seu celular. Não há anúncios.

Importante: as ofertas vêm dos encartes dos mercados e são lidas automaticamente. Preços, validade e estoque podem mudar, então confira sempre no mercado. O Fim de Mês não vende produtos.

Por enquanto, disponível para os mercados de Catalão, GO.

name: Fireside Glow: Fireplace TV
description:
Turn your TV into a warm, crackling fireplace.

Fireside Glow plays beautiful ambient videos on the big screen — a crackling fire, a Christmas scene, a New Year scene — perfect for cozy winter nights, reading, relaxing, or falling asleep.

Just pick a theme on the home screen and press play. It fills the whole screen, with real crackling sound.

- Full-screen fireplace videos with sound
- Mute anytime, or set sound on or off by default in Settings
- Sleep timer — when the time is up, the video stops and a Good Night screen appears
- No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription

One-time purchase — pay once, keep it forever.

name: FitRegion Manager
description:
FitRegion Manager es la app del entrenador personal que trabaja con FitRegion. Lleva al móvil lo que tus agentes hacen por tu negocio: quién te necesita, qué te han escrito y cómo va tu captación.

Inicio
- Los leads que te necesitan ahora, en el mismo orden que en la web: los que tu agente te pasa, los que esperan tu respuesta, los que están listos para agendar y los que llevan más de 24 horas sin contestar por WhatsApp.
- Tu captación de los últimos 7 o 30 días: leads, respuestas, llamadas y clientes nuevos, con las mismas cifras que ves en la web.
- Un toque y estás en la conversación.

Bandeja
- Las conversaciones con tus clientes (chat de FitRegion) y con tus leads (WhatsApp) en una sola lista.
- Filtra por clientes, por leads o por quién espera tu respuesta.
- Los mensajes nuevos llegan solos, sin recargar.

Conversación
- Lee el hilo completo, con lo que ha escrito el lead, lo que ha contestado tu agente y lo que has enviado tú.
- Responde desde el móvil. Si el lead lleva más de 24 horas sin escribir, envía un follow-up aprobado y ve antes cómo lo recibirá.
- Pausa la IA en una conversación concreta para seguir tú, y reanúdala cuando quieras.

Avisos
- Te avisamos cuando entra un lead, cuando un cliente te escribe, cuando un lead te espera o tu agente te pasa una conversación, cuando se reserva una llamada y si tu número de WhatsApp tiene un problema.
- Al tocar el aviso, vas directo a la conversación.
- Tú decides si los activas, y puedes desactivarlos cuando quieras.

Cuenta
- Tu nombre, tu plan y si incluye IA.
- El estado de los avisos en ese dispositivo y el enlace a la política de privacidad.

Antes de empezar
FitRegion Manager es para entrenadores con una cuenta de FitRegion. Entras con el mismo email y la misma contraseña que usas en la web. La app no crea cuentas.

Privacidad
La app no muestra publicidad ni incluye herramientas de seguimiento. No guarda en el teléfono nombres ni mensajes: los pide cada vez que los muestra.

Política de privacidad: https://fitregion.com/privacy-policy
Condiciones del servicio: https://fitregion.com/terms-of-service

name: Flash Roll: Disposable Camera
description:
Remember handing out disposable cameras at a party, then waiting a week to see what happened? Flash Roll brings back the wait, minus the week.

LOAD A ROLL
Pick 12, 24, 36 or 48 exposures. Your first roll is free.

SHOOT WITHOUT A SCREEN
No preview, no retakes, no deleting. Hold to charge the flash, press the shutter, wind the film. Every frame counts.

IT DEVELOPS OVERNIGHT
Your roll goes to the Flash Roll Photo Lab. At 8 am, the envelope arrives. Tear it open and flip through your prints.

CAN'T WAIT?
Rush it back in an hour, or go Instant and see them in four minutes.

THE FLASH LOOK
Party 800 film: bright faces, a dark room, a little grain, and the orange date stamp in the corner. Full-resolution prints, not tiny screenshots.

MAKE A REEL IN ONE TAP
Flash Roll cuts a 15-second reel from your roll. Choose Chill, Upbeat or Party, prints or full frame, our beat, your own song, or no music so you can add a trending sound in Instagram. Then post it.

SHARE IT ANY WAY YOU LIKE
Save every print to Photos, post a 4:5 Instagram carousel, or make a contact sheet.

NO ACCOUNT. NO FEED.
Your photos stay on your phone. No sign-up, no followers, no ads.

Rolls and developing are one-time purchases. Your film follows your Apple Account through iCloud.

name: Flik Signage
description:
Flik turns an Apple TV into a digital signage display. Pair it once with your Flik controller and it plays the slides, pictures and videos you send to it, in step with every other screen at your event.

• Pair in seconds with a six-character code. No typing keys on the remote.
• PowerPoint decks play with their transitions; videos stay in sync across screens.
• Blackout, blackout schedules, standby and hold, all from the controller.
• Keeps a copy of its content and keeps playing if the internet drops.
• The event's own waiting screen and logo when nothing is scheduled.

Flik for Apple TV needs a Flik controller. It does not work on its own.

name: Frame – Photos with Friends
description:
Frame puts your closest friends on your Home Screen. Take a photo or a short video, add a caption, and it lands on their Frame widget moments later. No feed to scroll, no likes to count, no strangers.

YOUR FRIENDS, ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Home Screen widgets in three sizes, plus Lock Screen widgets
• Photos and videos up to 15 seconds, with captions
• React with an emoji or reply in a private chat
• Look back through everything you've shared

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Frame works with a server you choose: run your own, or join a friend's with their invite link
• Your photos stay on that server. Crow Tech doesn't host your account or see your photos
• Notifications are end-to-end encrypted on their way to your phone
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no algorithm

MADE FOR A FEW CLOSE FRIENDS
• Invite friends with a link or a QR code
• Sign in with email, phone number or Apple
• Report or block anyone, and delete your account right in the app

RUN YOUR OWN SERVER
The Frame server is free and open source (AGPL-3.0). Set one up in minutes with Docker or a one-line installer: crow.sg/apps/frame/docs

name: Frigerm
description: Frigerm ਉਹ ਥਾਂ ਹੈ ਜਿੱਥੇ ਅਜੇ ਤੈਯਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਈਆਂ ਸੋਚਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਠੰਡੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਲਈ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸੀਲ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਮੂਲ ਵਾਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦਾ; ਬਾਅਦ ਦੀਆਂ ਚੋਟੀਆਂ «گੂੰਜ» ਵਜੋਂ ਅਲੱਗ ਲਿਖੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਮਿਆਦ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਣ ‘ਤੇ ਤਿੰਨ ਸਵਾਲ ਪੁੱਛੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ—ਫਿਰ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਸੋਚ ਨੂੰ ਤਰੱਕੀ ਦੇਵੋ ਜਾਂ ਪੁਰਾਲੇਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਭੇਜੋ। ਟੈਗ, ਖੋਜ, ਅੰਕੜੇ ਅਤੇ ਐਕਸਪੋਰਟ ਇੱਕੋ ਐਪ ਵਿੱਚ; ਕੋਈ ਖਾਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਸਭ ਕੁਝ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਇਸ iPhone ‘ਤੇ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

name: Fristfuchs: Verträge & Fristen
description:
Fristfuchs behält deine Verträge und Rechnungen im Blick und sagt dir rechtzeitig, wann du kündigen musst.

FRISTEN AUTOMATISCH BERECHNET
Trage Vertragsbeginn, Mindestlaufzeit und Kündigungsfrist ein. Fristfuchs rechnet den letzten Kündigungstag aus und plant einen Puffer für die Postlaufzeit ein.

SCANNEN STATT ABTIPPEN
Scanne einen Vertrag oder eine Rechnung mit der Kamera oder importiere ein PDF. Fristfuchs liest Anbieter, Laufzeiten, Beträge und Fälligkeiten heraus, vollständig auf dem Gerät.

ERINNERUNGEN, DIE ANKOMMEN
Mitteilungen vor jeder Frist und Fälligkeit, auf Wunsch auch im Kalender und in der Erinnerungen-App.

ALLES AUF EINEN BLICK
Die Übersicht zeigt die nächsten Fristen, deine monatlichen Kosten und offene Rechnungen. Das Widget zeigt die nächsten Fristen auf dem Home- und Sperrbildschirm.

FÜR DIE GANZE FAMILIE
Lege eigene Profile an, etwa für dein Kind oder Angehörige.

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
• Keine Konten, keine Werbung, kein Tracking
• Speicherung auf dem Gerät, optional in deiner iCloud mit Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung
• App-Sperre mit Face ID und Sichtschutz
• Verschlüsselte Sicherungen, Export als PDF-Bericht und CSV

Fristfuchs ersetzt keine Rechtsberatung. Prüfe berechnete Fristen bitte immer mit deinem Vertrag.

name: Fuzora
description:
Become a miner with a backpack full of bombs and blast your way through a mine of rock, crystals and strange creatures.

Lay bombs, blow up the soft walls of coal and crystal, and pick power-ups from the rubble: more bombs, a stronger blast, and hearts to heal. Defeat enough of the creatures and the hatch to the next level opens.

DOWN THE MINE
• 21 levels, from small, simple tunnels to vast, winding shafts
• Every enemy behaves its own way: one keeps going straight, another wanders, another hunts you down, and the sapper blasts its own way through with dynamite
• A map of the mountain shows how far you have come

CONTROLS ON IPAD
• Joystick: put your thumb anywhere on the left of the screen
• Or tilt your iPad to steer the miner
• Tap the right of the screen to lay a bomb

ATMOSPHERE
• A 3D mine lit by the miner's helmet lamp
• Explosions, smoke and sparks
• Original music, and sound that comes from where the blast went off

OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTIONS
• Monthly subscriptions for a better start on every board, in the campaign and in multiplayer: 2 or 3 more bombs, or blast strength +2 or +3
• Each renews every month until cancelled; the game is complete without them

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://creatively.dev/fuzora/privacy.html

name: Gaeyeonsi: Dev Decision Sim
description:
Gaeyeonsi is a pixel-art, choice-driven simulation game about responding to real-world IT outages.

2 a.m. Payments are down. Alerts keep firing and your team lead wants answers.
You are the engineer on the incident. Dig through logs and metrics, and make one call after another with limited time and incomplete information. This is not a quiz with a single right answer: every choice has a reason and a cost, and it changes the clues you get, what happens next, and how it ends.

■ How it plays
• Read the dialogue and pick your move, like a visual novel
• Investigate realistic logs, metrics and code for clues
• Payment failures, bad deploys, data loss and other incidents you could meet at work
• Episodes by role: backend, frontend, infrastructure, mobile, data, game development and more
• Difficulty from new grad to senior

■ What you get at the end
• Multiple endings: the same outage ends differently depending on how you respond
• An engineering evaluation and a technical postmortem report
• Compare your score with other players
• Share your result as an image

■ No strings attached
• Play right away without logging in; log in to save your records
• Sign-up never asks for your email, phone number or real name (only a login ID, nickname, role and career level)
• No ads, no in-app purchases
• No permission requests: no camera, location, contacts or notifications
• 한국어 / English

■ Community
Report a bug, or suggest an outage you lived through as a new episode.

Contact: privacy@gaeyeonsi.com

name: Gemmi Wave
description:
Gemmi Wave is a calm yet tricky block puzzle from Leukerbad in the Swiss Alps, at the foot of the Gemmi cliffs.

HOW TO PLAY
Place the three shapes on the 8×8 board. Full rows and columns disappear and score points. Clear several lines in a row to build a combo. The game ends when no shape fits any more.

THE THERMAL WAVE
Every clear fills the thermal meter. When the drop is full, tap it and swipe across a row or column: the thermal wave washes it away completely. The wave gets more expensive over time – use it wisely.

SPRING OF THE DAY
A new puzzle every day, the same for every player. The board starts with shapes and rocks that cannot be cleared. You get three attempts for the daily leaderboard and can practise as much as you like first.

LEADERBOARDS
Compete worldwide: endless mode by day, week and all time, plus the daily ranking of the Spring of the Day. Every result is replayed and checked on the server to keep the lists fair.

RELAX MODE
Hide everything and just watch: the animated mountain landscape with clouds, birds and thermal water, three calm melodies and the sound of flowing water with its own volume slider.

DISCOVER LEUKERBAD
Learn more about the Gemmi and Leukerbad region, the largest alpine thermal resort in Europe, and about local partners.

ALSO
• No account, no sign-up
• No tracking, no advertising ID
• Endless mode also works offline (then without leaderboard)
• Short tutorial on first launch
• English, German, French and Italian
• Music and sound effects can be set separately

Gemmi Wave is an independent game by Trizoun and not a product of Leukerbad Tourism.

name: Genogram Maker
description:
Genogram Maker lets you draw a genogram on your iPhone with one finger. It is built for counselors, social workers, and case managers who need a family map during an interview or while writing notes.

ONE-SCREEN INPUT
• Tap a person to open a four-part ring: name & role, age, gender & status, links
• Drag the links segment onto another person, then pick the relationship
• Presets for a 3- or 4-person family
• Undo and redo
• A short how-to guide for first-time users

GENOGRAM NOTATION
• Marriage, cohabitation, separation, divorce; parent–child, adoption, foster care; twins
• 28 relationship lines: close, conflict, distant, cutoff, focused, controlling, violence, abuse and more
• Client (index person) marker, year of death, miscarriage, stillbirth and induced abortion

SAVING
• Save the finished genogram to Photos as a JPG (add-only access; existing photos are never read)
• Save with names hidden for safer sharing and reporting

PRIVACY
• No sign-up, no login, no server. Nothing you enter is sent anywhere.
• Work in progress is kept only on this device, encrypted, excluded from backups, and deleted after 24 hours.
• Content is hidden in the app switcher.
• Images saved to Photos sync if iCloud Photos is on. Please check your organization's policy.

ADS
The app is free. A small banner sits at the top of the drawing screen, and once a day a full-screen ad plays when you tap "Watch an ad to start" on the start screen. Before the first ad loads, the app asks whether you allow tracking; ads are personalized only if you allow it. Your genogram content is never used for ads, and ads never appear in saved images.

name: Giftora Treasury
description:
Every gift tells a story. Giftora helps you find the right one, and makes it feel like magic.

AI GIFT GENERATOR
• Tell Giftora who it's for, the occasion, their interests and your budget
• Get thoughtful ideas with price estimates and reasons they fit
• Personalization and presentation ideas for each gift
• Save, copy, share or regenerate

MESSAGE STUDIO
• Birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, thank-yous and more
• Romantic, funny, emotional, professional, heartwarming or short and simple
• Edit every word, favorite the ones you love

YOUR AI GIFT TEAM
• Gift Expert chat for ideas and etiquette
• Wrapping Assistant for colors, decorations and presentation
• Occasion Planner with preparation checklists
• Gift Report with a recipient profile, budget analysis and final pick

GIFT COLLECTION
• Save gifts, build collections, add your own ideas
• Search and filter by occasion and category
• Track purchased and given gifts in your history

OCCASION CALENDAR AND WISHLIST
• Birthdays, anniversaries, weddings, festivals and personal events
• Optional reminders before the big day
• Wishlist with target budgets, priorities and savings progress

A TREASURE ROOM OF REWARDS
• Daily rewards, daily challenges and achievements
• Open daily and special chests, with odds shown in the app
• Collect coins, gems, ribbons and gift boxes
• Unlock gift themes and treasure room decorations
Rewards are free, earned by using the app, and have no cash value.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your gifts and rewards stay on your iPhone and work offline
• AI runs only when you ask, and shows what will be sent

name: GoMilli: Get Paid to Post
description:
GoMilli is where creators find brand campaigns and get paid for the views their videos bring.

No follower minimum. No agency. You film with your phone, you post on your own TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or Facebook account, and GoMilli counts the views.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a campaign. Each brand shows its brief, its markets and its rate per 1,000 views before you start.
• Film and post. Short videos, made your way, on your own accounts.
• Submit the link. GoMilli reads the public view count of your video at regular times.
• Get paid. Your earnings show as pending, then available, and you withdraw them through Whop.

EVERYTHING IN THE APP
• Home: your balance, your earnings, your views and your videos posted, day by day.
• Campaigns: open brand campaigns, each brief, the rate and the cap per video. Join in one tap.
• Videos: every video you submitted, its views, its status and what it earned.
• Leaderboard: your rank in each campaign and the videos that work best.
• What works: your recap, your 3 priorities and what top creators do.
• Courses: short lessons to hook, film and post better.
• Messages: talk with GoMilli support and brand teams. Report or block anyone.
• Notifications: new campaigns, validated videos and payouts as they happen.
• Wallet: available balance, pending earnings, history, withdrawals and invoices.
• Invite: share a campaign with a friend.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• The rate and the cap per video are shown before you film.
• Only real views count. Bought or artificial views are excluded, so every creator plays by the same rules.
• Your videos stay yours, on your accounts.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA
• Sign in with Apple, Google or your email.
• We never ask for your social passwords.
• No ads and no tracking across other apps.
• Delete your account at any time from Settings.

GoMilli is for creators aged 18 and over. Earnings depend on each campaign, on the brand accepting your video and on the real views it gets.

GoMilli Creator subscription (optional, auto-renewable): 9.99 USD per month or 39.99 USD per year in the US, local prices elsewhere. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial; if you do not cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, the yearly subscription begins and is charged. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://gomilli.app/en/terms
Privacy: https://gomilli.app/en/privacy

name: GymTrainer: Workout Log
description:
GymTrainer is a free, no-nonsense workout log for people who lift. No account, no ads, no subscription. Your training data stays on your device.

PLAN YOUR PROGRAMS
• Build programs like Push/Pull/Legs or 5/3/1 with workout days, exercises, and target sets × reps
• 870+ exercises with photos, instructions, muscle groups, and equipment, plus your own custom exercises

LOG EVERY SET, FAST
• Last session's weights and reps are pre-filled, so a set is one tap
• Warm-up, drop set, and failure set types, plus per-set notes
• Plate calculator for barbell lifts
• Smart rest timer that remembers your rest times and alerts you on the lock screen

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• History calendar with every session, set, and note
• Progress charts per exercise and weekly training frequency
• Body weight and measurements with trend charts
• Calorie and nutrition targets based on your profile and activity

APPLE WATCH & APPLE HEALTH
• Log sets and run your rest timer from your wrist; workouts sync to your iPhone
• Optional Apple Health sync: saves workouts and body weight, reads heart rate and active energy to enrich your workout details

OPTIONAL AI FEATURES
• AI Meal Scan: snap or describe a meal to estimate calories and macros
• AI Coach: get daily, weekly, or monthly advice based on your training and nutrition
Both use Google Gemini with your own free API key from Google AI Studio. Everything else works without it.

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
No login and no tracking. Export a backup file anytime from Settings.

name: Hauskalkül
description:
Lohnt sich die Immobilie als Kapitalanlage? Hauskalkül rechnet es dir aus: was jeden Monat 
nach Steuern übrig bleibt und wie viel Vermögen du mit der Immobilie aufbaust.
                                                                                         
Du gehst Schritt für Schritt durch Immobilie, Finanzierung und Einkommen. Wo du noch keine Zahl hast, schlägt die App passende Schätzwerte vor, und ein Tipp auf das Info-Symbol 
erklärt jedes Feld.                                                                                                                                                              

DAS ERGEBNIS AUF EINEN BLICK                                                              
• Cashflow pro Monat nach Steuern                                                     
• Rendite nach Steuern pro Jahr                                                            
• Vermögen am Ende deines Anlagehorizonts                                             
• Jeweils im Vergleich zu einer Bundesanleihe mit demselben Eigenkapital                                                                                                         

STEUERN NACH DEUTSCHEM RECHT
• Einkommensteuer ohne und mit Immobilie: zwei Veranlagungen, eine Differenz
• Aktueller Tarif mit Solidaritätszuschlag und Kirchensteuer, Grundtarif oder Splitting
• Abschreibung (AfA) auf den Gebäudeanteil, mit Link zu den Bodenrichtwerten deines Bundeslands
• Grunderwerbsteuer und Kaufnebenkosten je Bundesland
• Prüfung der 15-%-Grenze für anschaffungsnahe Herstellungskosten
• Verkauf vor oder nach Ablauf der Spekulationsfrist (§ 23 EStG)

FINANZIERUNG UND ZEIT
• Eigenkapital, Darlehen, Zins, Tilgung und Zinsbindung
• Restschuld am Ende der Zinsbindung und Anschlusszins
• Laufender und kumulierter Cashflow für jedes Jahr als Diagramm
• Wasserfall vom Mietertrag bis zum Cashflow nach Steuern

EVERYTHING ABOUT AN OBJECT, TOGETHER
