name: JP Brewlog
description:
JP Brewlog is the software for your brewery. Developed by brewing engineer Jan Paul (Weihenstephan) for work in the brewhouse, the cellar and the warehouse.

WORKS WITHOUT A CONNECTION
The app runs on your iPhone. No signal in the cellar? Log everything anyway: readings, additions, cellar work, new tanks, photos. As soon as you are back online, everything syncs in the background.

BREW DAY
Brew day step by step: mashing, lautering, boiling, hop additions with reminders and bitterness units.

FERMENTATION AND CELLAR
Temperature, extract, pressure, pH, CO₂ and oxygen for each tank, as a curve. Centrifuge, filtration, transfer, carbonation, dry hopping. Every tank shows at a glance what is inside and what comes next.

STOCK AND BATCHES
Goods receipt with supplier batch, first in, first out. Silos with layers, minimum stock, defects and blocked batches, yeast bank, CO₂ balance.

TRACEABILITY
From the malt batch to the keg and back, with mock recalls.

RECIPES AND COSTING
Versioned recipes, raw material costs per brew and per hectolitre.

MAINTENANCE AND KEY FIGURES
Maintenance plans for tanks and machines, water, electricity and gas per hectolitre.

FOR THE WHOLE TEAM
Everyone works with their own account. Every entry shows who made it, and every change is kept as a version. Roles for head brewer, brewer, filler and accounting, rights per person, and staff join with an invitation code.

Available in English, German, French, Spanish and Danish.

Signing in requires access provided by your brewery.

name: Jumeliqa Hop
description:
One small jump can make all the difference.

A coin waits just beyond a narrow platform. A row of spikes blocks the obvious route. Somewhere between the two lies the perfect sequence of movements, and finding it is entirely up to you.

Jumeliqa Hop turns simple jumping into a lively platform challenge where every direction requires a little lift off the ground.

Your character doesn't walk casually across the stage. Moving left or right means hopping in that direction, while an upward jump helps you reach higher positions. Learning how these movements work together is the key to collecting every coin and completing each level.

The objective is straightforward: gather all the coins scattered throughout the stage.

Getting them, however, requires more than heading toward the nearest shiny object.

Platforms, gaps, spikes, and dangerous obstacles create routes that demand careful timing and thoughtful movement. Some coins are easy to reach, while others encourage you to reconsider your approach, adjust your position, or find a safer way around a hazard.

Each stage is a compact challenge with its own arrangement of platforms and obstacles.

Study the space before making your move. Notice where the safe surfaces are located, identify the dangerous areas, and consider the order in which you want to collect the coins.
A rushed jump might send your character straight into trouble. A well-timed hop can carry you past an obstacle and into exactly the right position for your next move.
And when things don't go according to plan, there's always another opportunity to try.

Touching a deadly obstacle restarts the level, giving you a fresh chance to discover a better route. If you find yourself trapped in an awkward position, the restart option lets you begin again without waiting for a mistake to happen.

The controls are easy to understand, but the movement creates plenty of interesting situations.

You might need to jump upward before changing direction, approach a platform from a different side, or carefully coordinate several hops to reach a coin surrounded by hazards.
Progress comes from learning the rhythm of the game and becoming more confident with each attempt.

Collected coins also contribute to your in-game balance, which can be used to access additional gameplay options.

Destroy removes obstacles from the current level, helping you explore a clearer route. Double Jump adds another jump for situations where ordinary movement isn't enough. Skip allows you to move past a difficult stage and continue your adventure.

For an extra test of speed, Speedrun introduces a timed challenge. You'll need to combine your knowledge of the level with quick reactions and efficient movement to finish before the countdown ends.

This creates two different ways to enjoy the same playful mechanics: carefully plan each hop or challenge yourself to move with greater speed and precision.

Jumeliqa Hop is built around short, focused challenges that are easy to start and satisfying to master. Every collected coin brings you closer to completing the stage, while every unsuccessful attempt teaches you something about the platforms and obstacles ahead.

There is no need to rush through every decision. Sometimes the smartest move is to look at the entire level, understand the safest route, and then begin jumping.

Other times, a bold sequence of hops is exactly what the situation calls for.

Jumeliqa Hop also features an interface adapted for iPhone Duo, with optimized layouts and controls designed to provide a comfortable gameplay experience on the device.

Find your rhythm, avoid the hazards, collect every coin, and see how far your jumping skills can take you.

Compare and share

Explore the sample vehicle for free. For your own car, make a one-time purchase of a Return Record for a single occasion or a Contract Record for the full lease. You can upgrade an existing Return Record.

Your documents stay on your device. On supported devices with Apple Intelligence available, optional on-device AI can suggest contract excerpts from iOS 26 and help check photos from iOS 27. MEMORIES

name: Meridian: World Geography Quiz
description:
Fly around a 3D globe and learn the world, one flight at a time.

Meridian is a geography game with a plane. Each answer sends you somewhere new. Spin the globe, tap countries, and watch the map teach you as you play.

GAME MODES
- Find the Country: spin the globe and tap the right country. Three tries, with compass hints that tell you which way to look.
- Capital Quest: the globe flies to a country, and you pick its capital from four.
- Flag Flight: a flag appears. Choose the country, then fly there.
- Culture Quiz: landmarks, nature, food and history from every continent.
- Expedition: ten stops starting in Madrid, mixing every challenge.
- Explore: free flight. Tap any country to see its flag, capital and size, or search by name.

MADE TO KEEP YOU COMING BACK
- Ranks from Tourist to Globemaster, badges, streak bonuses and Game Center leaderboards.
- Your progress syncs between your devices through iCloud.
- Works offline. The map and all questions are inside the app.
- Daily reminder, if you want one.
- English, Spanish and Turkish. Switch any time.

FREE AND PRO
Play 3 flights a day for free on Easy difficulty. Meridian Pro unlocks unlimited flights and Hard difficulty with every country, including the smallest.

- Pro Monthly: EUR 2.99 per month

name: MeterGO - Meter Readings
description:
Read your meters in seconds and know your bill before it comes.
Point your iPhone at the meter: MeterGO reads the digits, shows them big so you can check them, and saves the reading with a photo.
Add the prices from your bill once and see what you will pay, or get back, at the end of your billing year.

READ IN SECONDS
Drum counters and digital displays are read on your iPhone. Dial meters and heating oil are typed in a moment. Every reading is checked against your usual use before it is saved.

KNOW YOUR BILL
MeterGO splits your use by day, adds the standing charge and tax, and forecasts the bill for your billing year: about how much back, or how much to pay.
This is an estimate from your readings and tariff; your supplier's bill is binding.

SEE WHERE IT GOES
Cost per month, this year against last year, use per day, day and night rates, solar feed-in. A sudden jump in use is flagged the day you read it, so a leak does not wait for the annual bill.

EVERY METER, EVERY HOME
Electricity, gas in cubic meters or kWh, cold and hot water, heat, heating oil and solar. Several homes, replaced meters and counters that roll over: the history stays one line.

REPORTS AND REMINDERS
A reading protocol PDF with photos for moving out or switching supplier, a yearly summary and CSV export. One reminder on reading day, widgets for your Home Screen, and Siri.

NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up and no supplier login. Readings, photos and tariffs stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. Usage analytics and crash reports stay off until you turn them on.

MeterGO Pro
A yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or a monthly subscription. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. If Pro ends, your readings stay readable and exportable.

Terms of use: https://familygo.app/metergo/terms/
Privacy policy: https://familygo.app/metergo/privacy/

name: Mi Yodea
description:
Who knows the most in your family, and which friend will surprise everyone?

Mi Yodea brings the quiz show to your living room, and now you’re the contestants! Gather around the TV, choose who’s playing, and answer questions against the clock. Who will stay calm as time runs out, and who will find the answer that decides the competition?

Turn time with family and friends into a shared trivia challenge, filled with suspense, laughter, and surprises on the way to first place.

PLAY TOGETHER OR GO SOLO
Compete with up to six players, or test your knowledge in solo mode.

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE
Pick a difficulty level and the knowledge categories you want to play, or let the game choose the categories for you.

EVERY COMPETITION COUNTS
Create a player with a name and an avatar of your choice. Each player earns points from competition games, and the leaderboard lets you follow their points and wins.

A WORLD OF KNOWLEDGE
Explore a range of knowledge categories. The question bank will continue to grow, with updated questions and new categories planned for future releases.

IMPORTANT: The game interface and all questions are currently in Hebrew. Reading Hebrew is required to play.

Available on Apple TV. Play using the Apple TV remote.

name: MikroMittari
description: MikroMittari on tarkkuusmittasovellus ulkomittojen ja akselihalkaisijoiden maarittamiseen tarkoitetun mikrometrin kayttoon. Sovellus laskee nayttotarkkuuden, karan liikkeen, vernierin jaon ja mittapinnan rinnakkaisuuden. Liukusaatimilla saadetaan mittapainetta, kitkaa, kaarena-ukkoa ja nollausta, ja tulokset voi tallentaa ja vieda. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta.

name: Millesime
description:
Aplicația membrilor Millesime pentru degustări, notare și comenzi de vin.
Millesime este aplicația clubului de degustări de vin, gândită pentru membri: te înscrii la evenimente, notezi vinurile de pe telefon și plasezi comenzi — fără hârtie și fără Excel.

Conturile sunt create de organizație. După invitație te autentifici cu email și parolă, îți completezi profilul și ai la îndemână tot ce ai nevoie la o degustare.

Ce poți face în aplicație:

- Vezi degustările și evenimentele viitoare sau trecute, cu date și locuri disponibile
- Te înscrii, schimbi data sau anulezi înscrierea cât fereastra e deschisă
- Notezi fiecare vin pe criterii (culoare, miros, gust, postgust, impresie generală), cu total calculat automat
- Notele se salvează local și se trimit automat când revii online
- Comanzi vinurile dorite, cu cantități și date de livrare; livrarea o face producătorul
- Arăți codul QR personal la intrare, pentru check-in rapid
- Adaugi evenimentul înscris în calendarul telefonului
- Plătești și urmărești cotizația (anuală sau semestrială)
- Vezi istoricul degustărilor, notelor și comenzilor
- Alegi limba (română, engleză, maghiară) și tema luminos/întunecat
- Primești notificări despre evenimente noi, reminder-e și statusul plăților

Pentru staff, aplicația include și scanarea QR la intrare, ca să marcheze prezența participanților.

Millesime este aplicația membrilor — nu este un magazin public de vinuri. Dacă ești membru, descarcă aplicația și autentifică-te cu datele primite de la club.

name: Molebop: Stress Relief Game
description:
Molebop is a 30-second whack-a-mole for the little stresses of an ordinary day.

Open the app and a round starts right away. Moles pop up, each with a speech bubble, and pull a cheeky face if you wait too long. Tap them before they hide. When the 30 seconds are up you see your score, your average reaction time and your best, and you can go again.

What makes it yours: the moles say the lines you pick. You make a target with a nickname, like "Boss A" or "Help desk", dress it with props, pick where it lives, and give it up to 10 catchphrases, such as "Can you get this done by today?" Type your own or add lines from the built-in packs. Every round, the bubbles use your list.

MODES
Chill, Classic or Frenzy. Chill is slower, with two moles at most. Frenzy is faster, with up to five at once. Best scores are kept per mode, so a score always means the same thing. All modes are free.

PROPS AND PLACES
33 costume props across six spots: hair, eyes, mouth, neck, ears and hat. 15 are free. 9 places: Lawn and Office are free; Meeting room, Boss's office, Pantry, Living room, Rooftop at night, Classroom and Beach come with Pro.

HISTORY
Tap your stats on Home to see this week's hits day by day, your last 10 rounds and your best reaction time.

SHARE YOUR SCORE
Make a score card with your mole, score, reaction time and mode, and share it from the share sheet. Lines you type are never on the card (it may show one of the built-in lines), and the nickname is off unless you turn it on.

CATCHPHRASES
Write your own, or pick from the built-in packs. A built-in word filter blocks slurs and hate terms in nicknames and phrases.

PRIVACY
No photos and no camera. No real names: a target only has a short nickname. Everything you type stays on your iPhone. No account and no server; the only thing that leaves is a score card you choose to share.

FREE, WITH ONE PURCHASE
Molebop is free. A small banner sits at the bottom of the home and results screens, and a single ad can appear between rounds, never during one. You can also watch a short ad to try a Pro prop or place for one round, up to 3 times a day. A one-time Molebop Pro purchase removes the ads and adds 18 props and 7 places. No subscription. You can restore it any time in Settings.

Made by Vyvflo.

name: Moment: Share the Now
seller_name: Shenzhen Yuanli Chuangzao Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Moment is a photo-sharing and one-to-one messaging app. Take a photo of what is happening around you, share a little of your day, and reply to something that catches your attention.

Take a photo in the app and cover details you want to keep private before posting. You can add a short caption or a voice recording. Discover shows blurred previews. Share your own photo that day to open other people’s Moments. Each photo can be opened once for up to 10 seconds.

Reply with text or voice and continue in a one-to-one chat. You can also find friends by their app ID and send a friend request. Ayu and Xiaoman are clearly labeled official AI companions.

Sign in with Apple is required. Moment currently uses Simplified Chinese.

name: Moravany nad Váhom
description: Aplikácia obce Moravany nad Váhom obsahuje dôležité informácie o obci. Nájdete v nej informácie o všetkom dianí v obci, potrebné kontakty, aktuálne správy a mnoho ďalšieho. name: Motion Strong Studio
description:
Book your Motion Strong Studio classes in two taps.

Members of Motion Strong Studio in Gelang Patah, Johor Bahru, can use this app to:

• See the class timetable for the next 14 days: Muay Thai, boxing, kickboxing and kids classes, with the coach and the spots left
• Book a class in two taps, and see the cost before you confirm
• Book for your family: pick who is coming when your account has more than one profile
• See your upcoming bookings and cancel with the refund shown before you confirm
• Get a reminder on your phone 2 hours before each class
• Check the timetable even when you are offline (the last one you loaded)
• Buy a package, manage your plan or link WhatsApp on the member website
• WhatsApp the front desk from the app

Sign in with the email and password of your Motion Strong Studio member account. New here? Sign up on our website first, then sign in. Want to look around first? Tap "Try the demo" on the sign-in screen (no account needed).

Motion Strong Studio · 3B, Jalan Suria 1, Pusat Komersial Suria, 81550 Gelang Patah, Johor, Malaysia.

name: Motoring Shelf
description:
Keep a clear record of your vehicle's costs and care.

Motoring Shelf brings fuel stops, servicing, other expenses and receipt photos into one history for each vehicle. Add the details you need, then find them again when it is time to plan a service or share your records.

FUEL AND EXPENSES
Record your odometer, fuel volume and cost. Mark full tanks, partial fills and missed fill-ups so the fuel-economy calculation uses the right intervals. See recorded spending for this month or all time, split into fuel, service and other expenses.

SERVICE AND RECEIPTS
Keep service notes with the work they describe and add up to eight receipt photos per record. Photos are resized for storage. A cloud-only photo may need to download before import. Set your own date or odometer targets. Optional local notifications support dated targets; mileage status uses the odometer reading from the most recent dated record that includes one, without tracking your driving.

A GARAGE THAT FITS YOUR RECORDS
Keep separate histories for multiple vehicles. Choose kilometres or miles, litres or US or imperial gallons, a currency for each vehicle, and your preferred fuel-economy display.

TAKE YOUR HISTORY WITH YOU
Export records to CSV with notes and receipt counts, or create a service-history PDF with service notes and attached receipt images. CSV exports do not include the images. Make a full backup to restore vehicles, records, targets and receipts on another installation. Restoring a backup replaces current records, with a local recovery copy kept first.

ON YOUR DEVICE
Your records work offline without an account. There is no automatic cross-device sync. Backups are not encrypted, so store and share them carefully. Make a backup before deleting the app or changing phones.

Motoring Shelf records information you enter. It does not diagnose a vehicle or replace the manufacturer's maintenance schedule or professional advice.

name: Mulliko
description:
Your own paint from powdered pigment.

Drop pigments on a glass slab, add binder a drop at a time and grind them with the muller. Mulliko predicts the color with a pigment-mixing model and works out the grams for half and full pans.

• Colors that mix like paint, not screen RGB
• Grams for half and full pans, from 1 to 99 pans
• Every save kept as a version
• Your own pigments: vendor, lot, date, notes
• Swatch photos to calibrate tinting strength
• Recipes in a paint box, as pans or tubes
• Markdown and postcard export
• Test sheets and paint charts on watercolor paper, canvas or pastel paper
• Reminders for toxic pigments
• Backup and restore, light and dark appearance

Free: up to five recipes, 41 starter pigments plus your own, gum arabic watercolor binders, every tool, versions, Markdown export, measuring a calibration, backups, and a test sheet on watercolor paper.

Mulliko Pro, a one-time purchase (no subscription):
• Unlimited recipes
• 90 more pigments and all additives
• Wax watercolor, emulsion, oil, crayon and pastel binders
• Postcard PDF, image and HTML export
• Applying a calibration and the batch calculator
• Test sheet: up to four paints, canvas and pastel paper, swatch and mixing charts, sharing as a picture or PDF

No account, analytics, ads or tracking. Your library stays on your device unless you export or back it up.

Predicted colors and amounts are starting points, not measurements. Paint a test swatch before mixing a batch.

name: NETRO نترو

Discover offers for your cards in one place.

Choose your bank and card products to explore offers and eligibility terms with NETRO.
Browse offers, find stores on the map and save favorites for later. Follow the banks, stores and card
products you care about and control your notifications and reminders.

• Discover offers matched to your card products.

Offers follow the issuer's terms and may vary by location and card. Check the source before purchasing.

name: NeulaMittari
description: NeulaMittari on tarkkuusmittasovellus pienta-voisten reikien ja akselien tarkastamiseen. Sovellus arvioi neulan halkaisijan, sylinterimaisyyden, sovitusvaran ja pinnan kunnon. name: NightPayCheck
description:
Understand your night-shift earnings from the hours and rates you enter.

Keep planned shifts and actual hours together, review roster imports, estimate gross pay, and compare the result with your payslip.

• Add shifts manually, paste roster text, or import a roster photo.
• Configure base pay and flat hourly night and weekend extras.
• Review itemized calculations and planned-shift limitations.
• Match payslip categories and save comparisons with their pay-rule context.
• Export JSON backups and CSV calculations.

The current model supports biweekly USD gross pay, weekly overtime after 40 paid hours at 1.5× base, and overlapping flat hourly night and Saturday/Sunday extras.

Taxes, deductions, holiday pay, bonuses, daily overtime, and blended overtime rates are excluded. Review whether these rules fit your workplace. Results are estimates based on your entries.

Save comparisons for two pay periods free. A one-time purchase unlocks additional periods.

Records stay on your device. No account is required.

name: Northern Thai Words (Thai)
description:
Look up Northern Thai (Kham Mueang) words and see what they mean in Central Thai. The app is in Thai, made for anyone who wants to understand or speak the language of Chiang Mai and the North.

MADE FOR
- People moving to or working in Chiang Mai and Northern Thailand
- Partners and families of people from the North
- Students and anyone curious about the Lanna language
- Travellers who want to chat with locals
- Listeners who want to understand Kham Mueang songs

SEARCH BOTH WAYS
Type a Northern word to see its meaning, or type a Central Thai word or meaning to find how northerners say it. For example, "miss you" (คิดถึง) is กึ๊ดเติงหา or กึ๊ดฮอด, "to speak" (พูด) is อู้, "delicious" (อร่อย) is ลำ, "thank you" (ขอบคุณ) is ญินดี.

EVERY WORD SHOWS
- The Northern Thai word and its meaning in Central Thai
- A reading guide on some words
- Notes where useful

WHERE THE WORDS COME FROM
Words are drawn from the Royal Institute dictionary of Thai regional dialects (Northern dialect) and a Peace Corps Northern Thai textbook, plus words people often search for.

WORD OF THE DAY
- A new Northern word on the home screen every day, with a daily notification
- A home screen widget with the word of the day
- Send the word of the day as a greeting card

SAVE AND REVIEW
Save words to your Library, then review your favourites in rounds after 1, 3, 7 and 14 days so they stick.

PRACTICE GAMES
- Match words with their meanings
- Guess the word from its meaning

SHARE AND READ MORE
- Share a word as a picture, or copy the text
- An Articles tab from WordyGuru
- Adjustable font size and dark mode
- Words you have opened before stay readable offline

Free with ads.

name: PackingGO - Packing List
description:
A packing list for your trip, built in about a minute.
Tell PackingGO where you're going, when, who's coming and what you'll do.
It checks the weather there and lists what to pack, with quantities.

A LIST THAT FITS THE TRIP
• Quantities follow the nights, laundry and luggage, so carry-on trips pack light
• The forecast 10 days before you go, climate averages before that, and every change shown before it reaches your list
• Beach, hiking, ski, business, weddings and more add their own gear
• Trips with several stops get each stop's weather

A LIST FOR EVERYONE
• Each traveller gets a list, plus Shared items like sunscreen and the first-aid kit
• Put items in bags, mark what to buy and what to pack last
• Templates for trips you repeat, and your usual items on every list

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
• Three days before, the evening before and on departure morning
• Widgets, a Live Activity on departure day, and Siri: "What's left to pack?"
• After the trip, mark what you didn't use and the next list packs less of it

YOUR LISTS STAY YOURS
• No account and no ads
• Lists are saved on your iPhone and in your iCloud, with automatic backups
• Share as text, PDF or a trip file for another iPhone

name: PaintMates
description:
Eine Person zeichnet, die anderen raten. Spielt in öffentlichen Räumen oder eröffnet einen privaten Raum für eure Gruppe. Eure Mitspieler treten per QR-Code oder Raumcode bei.

name: pdr20: Ukraine Driving Theory

description:
Preparing for the driving theory exam (ПДР) at a Ukrainian MIA service centre? pdr20 has all 1,762 official category B questions from MIA order No. 225 (in force since 10 November 2025), word for word, with the official pictures.

Please note: the app, like the exam itself, is in Ukrainian. Since 30 September 2026, foreign nationals have been able to take the exam in English; this app does not translate the questions.

MOCK EXAM LIKE THE REAL ONE
20 random questions, 20 minutes. After every answer you see whether it was right, and the third mistake ends the exam, exactly as at the service centre.

LEARN FROM MISTAKES
After the exam you get the correct answer to every question you missed, and most questions have an explanation citing the rule it rests on.

45 TOPICS, WORKS OFFLINE, NO SIGN-UP
Practise by topic and repeat your mistakes. All questions and pictures are on your phone. No account, no e-mail.

WHAT IS FREE
One mock exam a day, plus every question with its correct answer and explanations. Unlimited mock exams, topic practice and mistake review come with a single payment: no subscription, no automatic charges, restored on a new phone with the same store account.

Questions come from the official question bank of the MIA Main Service Centre. pdr20 is an independent app, not an official MIA product.

name: Persian Ink
description:
Write Persian with Apple Pencil, review the recognized text, and insert it into a supported app using the Persian Ink keyboard.

In a text field, choose Persian Ink with the globe key. Write in the keyboard's white panel, tap Recognize, then choose a candidate. Persian and English character keys, numbers, punctuation and نیم‌فاصله are also available.

For the one-time setup, connect to the internet, temporarily enable Allow Full Access in the keyboard’s Settings page and tap Download Persian model in the keyboard. Keep it open until installation finishes, then turn Full Access off.

Recognition runs on your iPad after the required Persian model has been installed. Full Access is not needed for normal offline handwriting or character typing. Recognition quality varies with handwriting; review the result before inserting it.

name: Picture Flashcards: Word Games
Pong Orbit

Classic pong, bent into a circle. Your paddle runs all the way around the arena wall, and the ball can come from any side.

name: PrepUp: Meal Prep Planner
description:
PrepUp plans your whole week of meals around your calories, protein and grocery budget, then turns it into one shopping list and one cooking session.

Tell PrepUp your goal, your diet and what you want to spend. You get a full week of meals that fits your targets. Don't like a dish? Swap it, and your calories and protein stay in range.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
• Meal plans built around your calorie and protein targets
• Choose your diet and leave out the foods you don't eat
• Swap any meal in a tap
• Cook from what is already in your pantry

SHOP ON BUDGET
• One grocery list, sorted by aisle
• Price estimates based on whole packs, so you know the cost before you shop
• Share the list and shop together

BATCH COOK
• Step-by-step prep sessions with timers
• Know what goes in the fridge and what goes in the freezer, with reheating notes

SAVE YOUR RECIPES
• Import recipes from text or photos

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Chart your weight with Apple Health
• See your streak and your weekly spending
• Widgets for today's menu and your next prep session

PREPUP PREMIUM
The free version includes a weekly plan with limited swaps and imports. PrepUp Premium unlocks unlimited plans, swaps and imports, store prices, pantry, shared lists and widgets.

name: Pyramid Echoes: The Lost Sun
description:
One night the sun vanished. A shadow rose from the great pyramid and swallowed its light.

In Pyramid Echoes you explore seven connected pyramids with young adventurer Aren and Lumi, a tiny spirit of light. Behind every door something new is waiting: a treasure, a puzzle, a trap – or a new path.

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• Seven pyramids with over 160 richly illustrated rooms
• Lumi's lantern lights up the dark and reveals secret passages
• New abilities: double jump, wall jump, sand dash, diving, slow time and soul sight – and old places open up again
• Guardians and mighty bosses
• Keys, levers, mirrors and symbol stones: fair puzzles you solve by watching closely
• Sun altars save your progress, the map shows where you have been
• Egyptian music and a guided start for new players
• Game Center leaderboards: fastest rescue, most coins, most secrets

FAIR TO PLAY
The whole adventure is playable without buying anything. The shop only sells colours for Lumi and the lantern – no advantages in the game. Ads are optional: watch a short video for gems if you like.

Play in landscape with touch controls (Modern or Retro), gamepad or keyboard.

Pyramid Echoes is free. Optional in-app purchases (colours, gems, rewards without ads) are available but never needed to progress.

name: Remora: SSH Terminal
description:
Remora is a fast, private SSH client for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Connect to your servers, edit files, forward ports and watch your machines — with one app on every Apple device.

CONNECT
• SSH with password, key and certificate login, host-key verification, keep-alive and auto-reconnect
• Mosh: sessions survive Wi-Fi changes, sleep and roaming
• Jump hosts (ProxyJump), multi-hop chains and agent forwarding
• Telnet for network gear, serial consoles over USB and a real local shell on Mac

WORK FASTER
• Autocomplete that knows git, docker, kubectl, systemctl and thousands more commands
• Snippets, command history and a keyboard bar with Esc, Ctrl, Tab and arrows
• Split panes, a 2×2 grid and broadcast input to every pane at once
• Start every session inside tmux so your work survives disconnects

FILES AND SERVERS
• SFTP browser: upload, download, preview and edit files next to your terminal
• Server monitor: live CPU, memory, disks, Docker containers and services
• Local, remote and SOCKS port forwarding

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no analytics, no tracking
• Hosts sync through your own private iCloud; passwords and keys through end-to-end encrypted iCloud Keychain
• Secure Enclave keys that can never be copied off your device
• Face ID lock for the whole app

EVERYWHERE
• One app for iPhone, iPad and Mac — one purchase covers all of them
• Widgets, Siri Shortcuts and Spotlight: open a server in one tap

FREE AND PRO
SSH, SFTP, Telnet, the local terminal and up to 5 saved hosts are free forever. Remora Pro unlocks unlimited hosts, iCloud sync of passwords and keys, Mosh, jump hosts, port forwarding, agent forwarding, start in tmux, the server monitor and Secure Enclave keys.

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://follow-net.com/shell/terms
Privacy Policy: https://follow-net.com/shell/privacy

name: ResideGO - Schengen Calculator
description:
ResideGO counts the days you spend in each country automatically and shows you how many Schengen days you have left and how close you are to a tax-residency threshold.

Your iPhone logs the country of every day in the background. It decides the country on the device from built-in borders and keeps only the country, never your route. From that day log ResideGO works out the rest.

SCHENGEN 90/180
• Days left today and the date you can stay until
• When your next days come back
• Entry and exit days count, as the rule says
• Residence permits, long-stay visas and EU passports you add are taken into account

TAX DAYS
• 183-day counters for any country, by calendar year, your own tax year or a rolling window
• US Substantial Presence Test with its weighted three-year count
• UK Statutory Residence Test day count (midnight rule)
• Your own rules for anything else
• The date you would reach each threshold at your current pace

CAN I GO?
Enter dates and a country, and ResideGO checks the trip against your log and your other planned trips. If it doesn't fit, it suggests a later start or an earlier return. The longest stay finder tells you how long you can stay from a given day and when you can come back for longer.

ALERTS
Reminders when your Schengen days run low, before the day you need to leave, and as a tax counter gets close. Notifications show numbers only, no place names, unless you turn them on.

CALENDAR AND EDITS
Every day in a calendar with flags and country names. Fix a day, add past trips, mark transit days. Fill untracked days from the places in your Photos: suggestions only, nothing is copied or uploaded, and nothing is added until you accept it.

REPORTS AND EVIDENCE
Days per country and rule for each tax year, your Schengen history, and an evidence PDF and advisor CSV with the rule versions used. A raw backup and CSV export are always free.

WIDGETS AND SIRI
Home and Lock Screen widgets with your days left, a Control Center button to pause logging, and Siri questions like "How many Schengen days do I have left in ResideGO?"

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no ads. Your days stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. Analytics and crash reports are off unless you turn them on, and they never include your day log, trips or places.

Estimates from your own log. Not legal, immigration or tax advice. Border authorities and tax authorities decide.

SUBSCRIPTION
ResideGO Pro is a subscription: yearly with a 7-day free trial, or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Family Sharing is supported. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Any unused part of the free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://familygo.app/residego/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://familygo.app/residego/privacy/

name: Reslio: Waiter, POS & Kitchen
description:
Reslio is the work app for café and restaurant staff: waiters, cashiers, the kitchen and managers. You sign in with your business's account. To look around without one, tap "Try the demo".

WAITERS
• Floor plan: free and busy tables, each order's total and time.
• Orders in a few taps: dishes, sizes, notes; send to the kitchen and the bar.
• "Order ready" goes to the waiter of that table.
• A guest calls or asks for the bill: its own sound, and an "On my way" button right on the notification.

NOTIFICATIONS, EVEN WITH THE APP CLOSED
• A different sound for calls, bills, guest orders and kitchen tickets.
• Urgent calls break through Focus.
• An "On shift" switch: no notifications when you are off.

SHIFT CARD ON THE LOCK SCREEN (iPhone)
• Calls, bill requests and ready orders in a Live Activity and the Dynamic Island.
• Updates by itself, without opening the app.

CASH DESK
• Cash, card and QR payments; split by items.
• Discounts, comps and voids approved with a lead's PIN.
• Open and close the till, X and Z reports.

KITCHEN AND BAR
• Tickets per station; mark a dish or a whole ticket ready.
• Stop list: a sold-out dish leaves the menu at once.

MANAGERS
• Menu with photos and prices in four languages, tables and QR codes, staff and roles.
• Daily and period reports, activity log.

GUESTS
Guests order from their own phone through the QR code on the table or in Telegram, no app needed. Their order reaches the waiter for approval.

ALSO
• Sign in with Face ID or fingerprint; scan the business code as a QR.
• Russian, Uzbek, Turkish and English.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: Safelight: Storage Cleaner
description:
Safelight finds what takes up space in your photo library: copies, similar shots, blurry photos, old screenshots and large videos. You decide what goes, and nothing is deleted until you say so. It all happens on your iPhone, with no account, no ads and no tracking, and nothing about your photos ever leaves it.

FREE, ALWAYS
• A full scan of your library, and a storage panel that shows where the space goes
• Every category listed: exact copies, similar photos and videos, blurry shots, bursts, screenshots, screen recordings, large videos and Live Photos
• Exact duplicates cleared without limits
• Swiping with no daily limit: by month, on this day in earlier years or at random, sorting photos into albums as you go
• Screenshots, screen recordings and large videos to review yourself
• 20 smart picks a day from similar photos, blurry shots, bursts and smart clean
• The Tray, where what you choose waits until you delete it all at once, with one confirmation from iOS
• A protected list, and favorites that are never suggested
• A guide to Recently Deleted, so you know when the space really comes back
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen, Siri and Shortcuts, and the Iris theme

WITH SAFELIGHT PREMIUM
• Similar photos and videos, blurry shots, bursts and smart clean, with no daily limit
• Video compression at three settings, with a preview of ten seconds first, each video keeping its date, place and favorite
• Photo compression to HEIC, and Live Photos kept as stills
• A vault behind Face ID for the photos and videos you keep apart
• The Point Disc and Squarepack Lens themes, each with its own icon

Premium comes as a yearly or monthly subscription, or a lifetime purchase you pay for once. What's free stays free: nothing moves behind Premium later.

CAREFUL WITH YOUR PHOTOS
• Nothing is deleted until you choose it, and iOS asks you to confirm every delete
• Each group shows its best shot and why, with a loupe that compares two takes at 3×
• Deleted items wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can change your mind
• With iCloud Photos and Optimize iPhone Storage, Safelight tells you what a delete frees on this iPhone and what it frees in iCloud
• On iOS 26 and later, a long scan can go on with Safelight closed, its progress on your Lock Screen

PRIVATE BY HOW IT WORKS
• No account and no Safelight server: your photos and everything Safelight works out about them stay on your iPhone
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking
• The vault stays in Safelight's own storage on this iPhone, locked whenever you leave it

ABOUT THE SUBSCRIPTIONS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless it's canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before then. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. The lifetime purchase is paid once and doesn't renew.

Terms of Use: https://pages.stackbase.space/safelight/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://pages.stackbase.space/safelight/privacy-policy

name: Scadenze Auto: Bollo Revisione
description:
Scadenze auto e moto sotto controllo: bollo, revisione, assicurazione RC, tagliando e cambio gomme. Segni la data una volta e l'app ti avvisa prima che scada. Gratis, senza registrazione, funziona offline.

La revisione è scaduta il mese scorso e te ne accorgi solo quando ti fermano. Con Scadenze Auto non succede più: tiene il conto delle scadenze dei tuoi veicoli e te le ricorda prima, non dopo.

COSA FA
• Promemoria per bollo, revisione, assicurazione, tagliando, cambio gomme, patente
• Notifica 7, 15 o 30 giorni prima della scadenza: scegli tu l'anticipo
• Quando segni una scadenza come fatta, crea da sola quella successiva
• Più veicoli: auto, moto, furgone, scooter, camper
• Storico spese per ogni mezzo (carburante, manutenzione, assicurazione)
• Nessun account, nessuna registrazione: i dati restano sul tuo iPhone
• La targa è facoltativa e non esce mai dal dispositivo

PER CHI È
Per chi ha un'auto e dimentica il bollo. Per chi ha auto e moto e non sa mai quando scade la revisione. Per chi gestisce i mezzi di famiglia o del lavoro e vuole tutte le scadenze in un posto solo.

IMPORTANTE
Le date delle scadenze le imposti tu. L'app non è collegata alla Motorizzazione, all'ACI o ad altre banche dati pubbliche e non calcola importi dovuti: bollo e revisione cambiano per regione, veicolo e anno. Verifica sempre le date presso le fonti ufficiali.

name: Silencer: TV Cleaner
description:
Silencer tidies up your smart TV: it switches off the preinstalled ads and tracking, puts on a clean new home screen, and turns your iPhone into the remote.

How it works
1. Switch on ADB debugging in your TV's developer options. The app shows you how, step by step, for your TV's maker.
2. Put your iPhone and TV on the same Wi-Fi. Silencer finds the TV by itself.
3. Look over the apps it will switch off, keep any you want, and start the cleanup.

What the cleanup does
· Switches off preinstalled ad, tracking and promotion apps. They are only switched off, never deleted.
· Puts on a clean new home screen: a clock, your apps and your inputs, with no ad slots.
· Backs everything up first, so you can put the TV back the way it was at any time.

After the cleanup
· Change the theme, or use your own photo or a plain colour as the background; arrange the dock and apps from your iPhone.
· Add widgets and screensavers to the home screen, such as weather, world clock, sleep timer, volume limit and photo screensaver.
· Use your iPhone as the remote: touch pad, volume, Back and Home, and type on your iPhone straight onto the TV.

Please note
· Your TV needs to run Android (Android TV or Google TV), on the same Wi-Fi as your iPhone. Samsung, LG and other TVs that don't run Android won't work.
· Some TVs don't let the home screen be changed. Silencer tells you once it's connected; you can then just switch apps off, or use it only as a remote.
· No account, and no data collected. Everything happens between your iPhone and your TV.
· The new home screen comes from the open-source project Clean Your TV (MIT License), credited in the app.

name: Simplifies Caja
description:
Simplifies Caja es el punto de venta de tu barbería, salón o peluquería canina, pensado para la tablet del mostrador.

Cobra servicios y productos en efectivo, débito, crédito o transferencia, y combina más de un medio de pago en la misma venta.

Ve la agenda del día junto a la fila de quienes llegan sin hora, toma turnos directos y agenda reservas para cada profesional.

Abre la caja con su fondo, registra retiros con su comprobante, entrega el turno a quien sigue y cierra el día con la cuadratura de cada medio de pago.

Revisa quién está atendiendo, en colación o disponible, y coordina a tu equipo desde el mismo mostrador.

Vende productos y gift cards y controla el stock de tu sucursal.

La app es para los negocios que ya usan Simplifies: entra con la cuenta de tu negocio.

name: SIRAJ Player
description:
Join your group on a SIRAJ learning journey. Enter the room code provided by the host, choose a nickname and explorer portrait, and get ready for the challenge.

• Join a game room without creating a participant account.
• Choose an age and explorer profile for the appropriate participation group.
• Read the question, wait for the answer phase, and select your answer on your phone.
• Follow journey stages and team results together on a shared display.
• Adjust sound and motion preferences in settings.

Journeys include questions about the Quran, Prophetic Sunnah, good character, Islamic knowledge, science and mathematics. The host controls room content and settings; the journey selects questions according to participation settings and ages.

SIRAJ requires an internet connection and an active room prepared by a host. This player app is for joining the journey. Room creation and question-bank management are available to hosts through SIRAJ's administration service.

Use a nickname rather than a full name or private information.

Support: info@majal.sa
https://majal.sa/request-quote/

name: Slow Pieces
description:
Slow Pieces turns your own photos into jigsaw puzzles that you piece together at your own pace. On a warm wooden table under the lamp, with gentle music, rain or the sea in the background.

YOUR PHOTOS AS PUZZLES
Pick a photo from your library or from Files, or take one. You choose the format, the crop and the number of pieces: from 12 pieces for a quick break to 500 pieces for long evenings. Or start with one of 56 starter pictures, from coast and sea to a snowy village.

LIKE A REAL PUZZLE TABLE
• Pieces with a cardboard edge and a soft shadow that click quietly into place
• Take them out of the box or tip them all onto the table
• Zoom in with two fingers; “Whole board” brings you back
• Turn pieces if you like it trickier
• A table of wood, felt or stone, and six table settings from tea time to Advent

CALM SOUND
18 gentle pieces of music, soft noise and nature sounds like rain, sea, forest and a crackling fire. With a sleep timer.

HELP WITHOUT PRESSURE
No clock, no score, no rush. A hint shows a piece that fits, a faint ghost image lies on the board, edge and inner pieces can be sorted apart. Every move is saved, so you carry on whenever you like.

SEND A PUZZLE
Send a puzzle with your photo to family and friends. Anyone with Slow Pieces opens it with a tap.

TRY IT FREE
Free: puzzles with 12, 30 and 70 pieces, all starter pictures, three pieces of music, rain, sea and noise, and all tables. The full version is a one-time purchase with no subscription, for the whole family: 150, 300 and 500 pieces, turning pieces, all music and nature sounds.

• No ads, no account
• Your photos stay on your iPad; the app collects no data
• Works offline
• In English and German

An app by Annico from Berlin.
Privacy: https://leiseteile.annico.eu/privacy

name: SOMA - Rede de profissionais
description:
O SOMA é a rede de profissionais para quem quer crescer junto.

No app você encontra serviços, benefícios e conexões reais — e também apresenta o seu trabalho para a comunidade.

O que você pode fazer: • Descobrir serviços de profissionais da rede
• Aproveitar benefícios e vantagens exclusivas
• Montar seu perfil com foto, banner e sobre
• Cadastrar e gerenciar seus próprios serviços
• Criar benefícios vinculados aos seus serviços
• Acompanhar avisos, eventos e a comunidade

Tudo em um só lugar, com a identidade da rede SOMA.

name: Southern Thai Words (Thai)
description:
Look up Southern Thai (Pak Tai) words and see what they mean in Central Thai. The app is in Thai, made for anyone who wants to understand or speak the dialect of Southern Thailand.

MADE FOR
- People moving to or working in the South, such as Hat Yai, Nakhon Si Thammarat, Surat Thani or Phuket
- Partners and families of people from the South
- Students and anyone curious about the Southern dialect
- Travellers who want to chat with locals
- Children of Southern families who grew up elsewhere and want to follow their elders

SEARCH BOTH WAYS
Type a Southern word to see its meaning, or type a Central Thai word or meaning to find how southerners say it. For example, "to speak" (พูด) is แหลง, "delicious" (อร่อย) is หรอย, "why" (ทำไม) is ไซ, "tomorrow" (พรุ่งนี้) is ตอเช้า, "pineapple" (สับปะรด) is ยานัด.

EVERY WORD SHOWS
- The Southern Thai word and its meaning in Central Thai
- A reading guide on some words
- Short example phrases on some words

WHERE THE WORDS COME FROM
Words are drawn from the Royal Institute dictionary and a Peace Corps Thailand Central Thai to Southern Thai dictionary, plus words people often search for.

WORD OF THE DAY
- A new Southern word on the home screen every day, with a daily notification
- A home screen widget with the word of the day
- Send the word of the day as a greeting card

SAVE AND REVIEW
Save words to your Library, then review your favourites in rounds after 1, 3, 7 and 14 days so they stick.

PRACTICE GAMES
- Match words with their meanings
- Guess the word from its meaning

SHARE AND READ MORE
- Share a word as a picture, or copy the text
- An Articles tab from WordyGuru
- Adjustable font size and dark mode
- Words you have opened before stay readable offline

Free with ads.

name: SpelWereld
description:
SpelWereld bundelt tien korte puzzel- en avonturenspellen in één app. Kies een spel, stel het formaat van je bord of kaart in en probeer je eigen record te verbeteren.

• **Cijferdoolhof** – Navigeer door het doolhof en bereik de doelen in de juiste volgorde.
• **Edelstenen combineren** – Verwissel aangrenzende edelstenen en maak rijen van drie of meer.
• **Boerderij** – Zaai de gevraagde gewassen, laat ze groeien en oogst je doelen.
• **Oceaanavontuur** – Ontdek de kaart en verzamel alle schatten.
• **Kleuren combineren** – Maak kleurreeksen en voltooi de opgegeven doelen.
• **Stad bouwen** – Plaats gebouwen en wegen en verbind je bestemmingen binnen de tijd.
• **Magische puzzel** – Herstel de afbeelding door stukken te schuiven of te verwisselen.
• **Ruimteavontuur** – Verzamel alle sterren, ontwijk obstakels en bereik de uitgang.
• **Dieren redden** – Doorzoek het bos en vind alle dieren.
• **Voedsel combineren** – Maak combinaties en voltooi de opdrachten op het voedselbord.

Speel alle tien spellen offline. Bekijk na elke ronde je score, tijd of aantal zetten en vergelijk je prestaties met je eerdere resultaten. Speel dezelfde uitdaging opnieuw of kies een ander formaat. Je persoonlijke records en recente resultaten worden op je apparaat bewaard.

Even stoppen? Pauzeer je spel en ga later verder. Ook wanneer je de app verlaat, wordt de timer gepauzeerd en blijft je spel bewaard.

Pas geluid, trillingen, animaties en extra herkenningspatronen aan je voorkeur aan. Deel zelf een scorekaart of meld je naar keuze aan bij Game Center om met een internetverbinding de bijbehorende online ranglijsten te bekijken.

name: Stax: budgetteren
description:
Stax laat zien wat je deze maand nog kunt uitgeven en wat je opzij zet. Je verdeelt je geld vooraf over budgetten en spaarpotten, en elke boeking van je bank hoort bij een budget.

ALLES DRAAIT OM BUDGETTEN
Groepen met budgetten erin, zoals Wonen met Huur en Energie. Een budget begint elke maand opnieuw, of spaart door: een spaarpot of een doel met bedrag en datum. Stax laat zien of je voor of achter loopt en hoeveel je per maand nog moet inleggen.

GEEN BANKKOPPELING
Je haalt zelf een export uit de app of website van je bank en leest die in. Stax werkt met camt.053 (XML, zoals veel Nederlandse banken die geven) en met CSV. Bij CSV herken je de kolommen met een voorbeeld uit je eigen bestand en pas je ze zo nodig aan. Boekingen die er al zijn, worden overgeslagen.

SLIM INDELEN
Stax deelt nieuwe boekingen automatisch in met regels die het van je leert. Een boeking kun je splitsen over meerdere budgetten. Overboekingen tussen je eigen rekeningen worden herkend, en terugbetalingen kun je koppelen aan de uitgave, zodat het budget klopt.

SPAARREKENING EN BETAALREKENING SAMEN
Spaarpotten tellen altijd op tot het saldo van je spaarrekening. Geld dat je uit een pot opneemt, houdt Stax bij.

VAN JOU
- Werk alleen op je telefoon, of verbind met je eigen Stax-server.
- Geen account bij ons, geen advertenties, geen analyse.
- Een back-up is één bestand dat je zelf bewaart en dat ook werkt tussen server en app.
- Openen met Face ID.

Stax is gratis. De broncode is in te zien op GitHub.

name: Stone Staff
description:
Stone Staff is the phone app for the Stone Systems team: the customer success managers, team leads, closers and specialists who look after our customers. It is for Stone Systems staff only. You sign in with your CSP account and see exactly what CSP lets you see.

INBOX
• The customer threads you follow, texts and emails together, newest first
• An Unread-only switch, and push notifications for new messages, missed calls and voicemails
• Reply by text or email without leaving the thread
• Review the reply CSP's AI drafted, edit it if you like, and send it

CALLS
• Your line rings on your phone like any call, on the lock screen too, around the clock
• Call a customer from the dial pad or from their thread, as your line or a local number
• Your call history with recordings, voicemails, transcripts and notes

CUSTOMER BRIEF
• Before you call back, see the account at a glance: status, onboarding progress, contacts, upcoming meetings and recent call summaries

Made for being away from the desk, the app does communications only. Tasks, notes, billing and customer edits stay in CSP on the desktop.

Accounts are created by Stone Systems; the app has no sign-up.

name: TAXbasco
description:
TAXbasco collects your receipts, reads them and sorts them into business and personal. In the end every receipt sits as a PDF in a tidy archive, and you know in summer what the tax office will want next spring. No account, no server, no ads.

CAPTURE
Scan a till receipt, pick a photo, share a PDF from Mail, send a train ticket from Wallet or load a CSV from PayPal, your credit card or Amazon. TAXbasco appears in the share sheet and also takes e-invoices (ZUGFeRD, XRechnung) straight from the XML. Amazon orders become one receipt per item, each with its warranty.

READ
Merchant, date, gross, net and VAT are recognised by the app itself. Text recognition and the language model run entirely on your device, even more accurately with Apple Intelligence. You also get a suggestion for area and category that you check at a glance.

SORT: HOT OR MILD
New receipts wait as a card stack. Swipe right for business, left for personal, up for return or later, down for archive only. With haptics, undo and a one-liner when the stack is empty. If you prefer lists, swipe in the receipt list instead.

PDF ARCHIVE
Every receipt becomes a PDF with metadata and checksum and lands in folders by year, area and category, in iCloud Drive if you like, visible in the Files app. Re-sort a receipt and the file moves along. Duplicates are recognised by content.

REMINDERS
Return deadlines, pending refunds, warranty ending four weeks ahead, cancellation deadlines of subscriptions and invoices falling due. The app spots subscriptions from recurring amounts and suggests them.

OVERVIEW AND YEAR COMPARISON
Business income and costs, deductible personal spending, categories compared with last year. Turn the device sideways and it becomes a balance: income on the left, spending on the right, receipts sliding as you tilt.

TAX FORECAST WITH HEAT SCALE
From receipts, salary and a few inputs TAXbasco estimates income tax, solidarity surcharge, VAT and trade tax for Germany and tells you how much to set aside per euro earned. In landscape a chili thermometer shows how hot the payment will be, from bell pepper to Carolina Reaper. All figures are estimates and no substitute for tax advice.

EXPORT
A ZIP with all PDFs of the year, a receipt list and a CSV in DATEV format for your accountant.

TOGETHER WITH HABENERO
If you write invoices with HABENero, open invoices show up in TAXbasco. Tap "Paid" and HABENero knows.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything lives on your iPhone or iPad and, if you choose, in your private iCloud so all your devices share the same state. Sign in with Apple is optional, and you can delete the account with all data at any time in Settings. No vendor server, no analytics, no ads.

For iPhone and iPad in Design 2.0 of the Chili app family: Liquid Glass, dark mode, a widget with this month's spending, Shortcuts and three languages (German, English, Chinese), switchable inside the app. Tax rules and DATEV export are tailored to Germany.

name: TheBuch Rider
description:
TheBuch Rider is the app for delivery partners on TheBuch, a fresh meat delivery service.

Go online whenever you want, get delivery requests from meat shops near you, and earn on every trip.

GO ONLINE YOUR WAY
• Go online and offline whenever you want
• Choose the store you deliver for, or all stores
• Get delivery requests with the earning shown upfront
• Accept or decline each request

SIMPLE DELIVERIES
• Clear steps for every trip: reach the store, pick up, deliver
• Navigate to the store and the customer with Google Maps
• Confirm pickup with the store's code
• See every item, quantity and category before you pick up
• Call the store or the customer from the app
• Cash orders show exactly how much to collect

EARNINGS AND PAYOUTS
• See what you earned today, this week, this month and this year
• A list of every trip with its earning
• Withdraw your earnings to your UPI ID
• Track your trips, rating and on-time record

Your location is shared only while you are online, so you get nearby requests and customers can follow their delivery. It stops as soon as you go offline.

Want to ride with TheBuch? Download the app, sign in with your phone number and complete your KYC. We review it and get you on the road.

Questions? Write to us at hello@thebuch.in

name: Tilely: Desen Boyama
description:
Tilely ile renkli desenleri tamamla, örneğe bakarak kareleri boya ve ayna simetrisini keşfet!

Okul öncesi, 1. sınıf ve 2. sınıf için hazırlanan üç kademede toplam 900 bölüm seni bekliyor. Her kademede 300 farklı desen bulunur. Basit renkli şekillerle başla; hayvanları, nesneleri ve simetrik desenleri tamamlayarak ilerle.

name: TISA® Business Pro
description:
TISA® Business Pro puts your TISA business phone system in your pocket. Make and answer calls on your business number from anywhere, so customers reach you, not your personal mobile.

FOR TISA BUSINESS CUSTOMERS
Sign in with a one-time QR code or link from your company administrator at business.tisa.one. No passwords to type, and each phone has its own login that your administrator can remove at any time.

CALLS
- Make and receive calls on your business line, even when the app is closed or the phone is locked
- Choose which business number your calls show
- Transfer calls: hand over straight away, or talk to your colleague first
- Merge calls into a three-way conference
- Hold, mute, keypad, speaker, Bluetooth and car audio
- Encrypted calls, with a live call quality indicator
- Voicemail at a tap
- Emergency numbers go through your phone's own mobile network

YOUR TEAM
- See which colleagues are free, ringing or on a call
- Call or transfer to any colleague in one tap

CONTACTS AND CALLER DETAILS
- Your company address book and CRM contacts, as your administrator chooses
- Know who is calling: caller name, the number they rang and the menu option they chose

BUSINESS SMS
- Send texts from your company's approved sender name, with templates and delivery status

MOBILE
- Check your TISA business mobile usage: data left, plan and renewal date

Calls and SMS are charged to your company's TISA account at its usual rates.

TISA® is a registered trade mark of 9Eons Limited.

name: TOeGO
description:
Mit TOeGO erfassen Sie Ihre Arbeitszeit direkt auf der Baustelle. Wählen Sie die Baustelle und Ihre Tätigkeit aus und tippen Sie auf „Start“. Wenn Sie eine Pause machen oder die Tätigkeit wechseln, buchen Sie das mit einem Fingertipp. Zum Feierabend stempeln Sie aus.

In der Monatsübersicht sehen Sie für jeden Arbeitstag, wie lange Sie gearbeitet haben, welche Pausen Sie gemacht haben und auf welcher Baustelle Sie im Einsatz waren. Fehlt eine Buchung, können Sie die Zeit direkt in der App nachmelden.

Auch Urlaub und Krankmeldungen erledigen Sie unterwegs. Wählen Sie den Zeitraum, senden Sie die Meldung an Ihren Betrieb und verfolgen Sie unter „Meine Anträge“ den Bearbeitungsstand. Ein Attest können Sie sofort beifügen oder später nachreichen.

Für die Nutzung benötigen Sie einen aktiven Mitarbeiterzugang von Ihrem Betrieb. Sie melden sich mit Ihrer TOeGO-ID und Ihrem Passwort an. Für Zeitbuchungen ist eine Internetverbindung erforderlich.

name: TrackUp Tracker
description:
TrackUp keeps you connected to your vehicles, wherever they are. Using the TrackUp GPS tracker
 installed in your car or bike, the app shows your vehicle's live location and alerts you the moment
 something important happens.

 LIVE TRACKING
  • See all your cars and bikes on one map in real time
  • Check speed, ignition status and whether a vehicle is moving or parked
  • Share a vehicle's live location with family or friends

 INSTANT ALERTS
  • Ignition ON / OFF notifications
  • Geofence alerts when a vehicle enters or leaves an area you set
  • Overspeed alerts
  • Late-night driving alerts when the engine starts after midnight
  • Watchdog mode to warn you if a parked vehicle is started
  • Power-cut alerts if the tracker is disconnected from the battery

TRIPS & REPORTS
  • Full trip history with route playback on the map
  • Distance, duration and stops for every trip
  • Download and share trip reports as PDF

VEHICLE CONTROL
  • Remote engine cut-off and restore (on supported trackers)
  • Per-vehicle settings for alerts and notifications

HOW IT WORKS
TrackUp works with GPS tracking devices installed by TrackUp. Your account is created by our staff when you bought our service 
after contacting our support team after  tracker is installed simply log in with your registered mobile number and the one-time code sent to you.

Need help? Contact TrackUp support from inside the app.

name: Tripsitter: Festival-Helfer
description:
Du bist im Awareness-Team eines Festivals. Die Nacht ist lang, die Musik laut – und ins Safe-Space-Zelt kommen Menschen, denen es nicht gut geht: überhitzt, Kreislauf weg, Panik, Horrortrip, nicht mehr ansprechbar, Freund verloren. Und manchmal pöbelt einer rum.

Jede Notlage braucht etwas anderes – und wer zu lange wartet, dem geht es schlechter:

• Wasser bringen und richtig dosieren – kleine Schlucke statt literweise
• Kissen stapeln, damit die Beine hochkommen
• Gemeinsam ruhig atmen, bis die Panik nachlässt
• Die richtigen Worte finden: beruhigen statt Druck machen
• Stabile Seitenlage im richtigen Moment
• Notruf 112 wählen, wenn es ernst wird
• Verlorene Freunde suchen und Menschen in die Ruhezone begleiten

Jede Lösung im Spiel beruht auf echten Erste-Hilfe- und Awareness-Tipps. Nach jeder Nacht siehst du, was gut lief und was du dir merken solltest.

SPIELMODI
• Festival: fünf Nächte, jede schwieriger
• Festival-Wochenende: endlos – wie lange hältst du durch?
• Bunker-Rave: die härteste Nacht von allen

Mit Karma kaufst du Verbesserungen und stellst Helfer ein, die mit anpacken.

Tripsitter ist ein Aufklärungsspiel von Open Mind. Es fordert nicht zum Konsum von Drogen oder Alkohol auf, sondern zeigt, wie man anderen in Notlagen hilft. Es ersetzt keinen Erste-Hilfe-Kurs. Im echten Notfall: 112.

Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

name: Tropie
description:
Tropie, c'est le carnet de lecture pensé pour la romance. Tes PAL, tes coups de cœur, tes book boyfriends et tes plus belles citations, enfin rangés au même endroit.

TA BIBLIOTHÈQUE, BIEN RANGÉE

• Des étagères claires : En cours, Lus, PAL, Wishlist et Abandonnés.
• Ajoute un livre en scannant son code-barres ou en cherchant son titre : la fiche se remplit toute seule.
• Suis ta lecture page après page, avec ton rythme et ta date de fin estimée.

UNE FICHE À LA HAUTEUR DE TES LECTURES

• Note l'intrigue, les personnages et le style en cœurs, et le spicy en flammes.
• Tropes, personnages préférés et détestés, avis, ambiance en photos, la chanson du livre.
• Les alertes de contenu signalées par la communauté, avec un mode anti-spoil.

TES CITATIONS, TOUJOURS SOUS LA MAIN

• Photographie la page : tropie lit le texte, tu gardes la phrase qui t'a marquée.
• Un mur de citations à feuilleter, rangé par livre, par genre ou par coups de cœur.
• Une citation du jour, chaque matin.

PARTAGE TES LECTURES

• De belles cartes prêtes pour ta story : livre terminé, citation, film ou série.
• Ton bilan de l'année, façon Wrapped, à partager en décembre.

LIS AVEC TES AMIES

• Des lectures communes où chacune avance à son rythme.
• Les messages restent cachés tant que tu n'as pas atteint la page : zéro spoiler.

TON UNIVERS DE LECTRICE

• Des statistiques mois par mois : livres, pages, tropes et autrices préférés.
• Des badges, des défis chaque mois et un bingo de lecture.
• La roue des envies, quand tu ne sais pas quoi lire ensuite.

NE RATE AUCUNE SORTIE

• Suis tes autrices : tropie te prévient la veille et le jour de la sortie de leurs nouveaux livres.
• Les films et séries tirés de tes romances, au cinéma et sur les plateformes.

ET AUSSI

• Les couleurs de l'appli peuvent suivre la couverture de ta lecture en cours.
• Trouve un livre neuf ou d'occasion, ou une librairie indépendante près de chez toi.
• Mode jour et mode nuit.

Tes données t'appartiennent : pas de publicité, rien n'est revendu. Chaque notification et chaque e-mail
se règle à part, et jamais plus de deux notifications par jour.

name: Tupfer – Gentle Reminders
description:
Tupfer reminds you of the small things that do you good: drink some water, take a breath, stretch, text someone you like.

SET TIMES OR AT RANDOM
Add reminders at set times – or let them surprise you: say three times at random between 9 am and 8 pm. Different times every day, never too close together.

EVERY DAY A PAINTING
Each reminder has its own colour. Once you have done it, dab it – right from the notification or in the app. A watercolour dab appears on your sheet, and every day becomes a little painting of its own.

YOUR GALLERY
All your days gather in your gallery. No pressure, no streaks, no points – just colour.

COMPLETELY PRIVATE
No account, no server, no ads. Everything stays on your device.

name: TVStat
description:
TVStat shows what your Apple TV is, what it is doing right now, and what it can play.

Live
A two-minute timeline for processor, memory, network and heat. Every track shares one axis, so a spike lines up across tracks. Open any track and move a cursor back through time. Switch to 10 minutes or 1 hour.

Statistics
Current, minimum, maximum and average for every core and live reading.

Graphs
Every reading that changes gets its own graph.

Hardware
Model, chip, P-cores and E-cores, L1 and L2 cache, RAM, swap, Metal GPU, Neural Engine and controllers.

Network
Wi-Fi and Ethernet details, link speed, MTU, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, gateway, DNS and TCP counters. Time connections to your gateway.

Storage
Capacity, free space, APFS volume details and a real read and write speed test with IOPS.

Playback
Dolby Atmos, Dolby Digital Plus, Dolby Vision, HDR10 and HLG support. Display modes, audio channels, sample rate, and HEVC, AV1 and VP9 decoders.

Data export
Turn on a local web server for Prometheus or JSON, or push readings to an address you set. Off until you turn it on. Disk space has its own switch and only goes to your local network.

Home screen banner
Processor, memory and network from your last session, on the Top Shelf.

Settings
Four themes, text size, line weight, units, which tabs show, track order and update speed.

One payment. No subscription, ads, account or analytics. TVStat sends nothing to the developer.

Not shown: exact temperature, fan speed, voltage, power draw, live clock speeds and GPU load. Heat shows the four levels tvOS reports.

name: Versephia
description:
Versephia makes learning the Bible a joy you come back to every day.

THE DAILY
Nine rounds, one from every game, the same for everyone each day. Keep your streak going and see how your friends did.

THE JOURNEY
Walk the whole story of Scripture, one stop at a time, on an illustrated map. Each stop opens with a short story card and checks what you learned with varied questions: multiple choice, true or false, put events in order, match, build the verse, and find places on the map. Miss one and it comes back until you get it. Checkpoints review what came before, and the finale earns a seal. Up to three new stops a day takes you through all 365 in a year.

NINE GAMES
- Bible Trivia, facts from cover to cover
- Guess Who, from the words that describe them
- Is It Biblical? Scripture or popular saying?
- What Came First? Put the story in order
- Name the Location and Find on the Map
- Learn the Language: the Hebrew and Greek behind familiar words
- Guess the Reference and Guess the Story

MEMORIZE
Flash cards for the 200 verses people quote most, by theme. Show the reference or the verse, flip when you are ready.

EXPLORE
Live through Passion Week day by day and hour by hour, walk through the Tabernacle item by item, and travel the journeys of Paul.

COMPETE
Create a group for your family, small group, class or church and share a six-letter code. Everyone's Daily score counts toward Today and This Week leaderboards. You can also challenge a friend to the very same questions in any game.

ACHIEVEMENTS
Earn 36 badges for streaks, journeys, perfect runs and more.

Written for every Christian tradition, with the World English Bible throughout. Contested questions of dating and authorship are presented as views, not settled fact.

FREE AND PRO
Free: The Daily, six games, Memorize, the full Old Testament Journey (90 stops), Passion Week, Compete groups and achievements.
Versephia Pro, one purchase with no subscription, adds the other five journeys (Poets & Prophets, Life of Jesus, New Testament Books, Greek & Hebrew, and Everything), three Deeper Study games, the Tabernacle and the Journeys of Paul. Family Sharing included.

Versephia is sponsored by the Forest Home GO Year, a gap year of discipleship for 18 to 22 year olds.

name: Verses for the Walk
description:
Verses for the Walk gives you a Bible verse each day for what you're actually going through.

Choose the topics that fit your life right now, like Anxiety & Worry, Grief & Loss, Marriage, Money & Provision, Temptation, or Hope. Your daily verse, home screen widget, and reminders come from those topics, so Scripture speaks to your real situation.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 41 life topics, each with hand-picked verses from the New American Standard Bible (NASB)
• A short reflection with every verse to help you understand and apply it
• An introduction and a written prayer for every topic
• A daily verse that changes each morning
• Home screen and Lock Screen widgets for iPhone and iPad, plus desktop widgets for Mac
• An optional daily reminder at the time you choose
• Save your favorite verses
• Share verses as a clean image or as text
• Search topics and verses
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking

TOPICS INCLUDE
Anxiety & Worry, Fear, Depression & Sadness, Grief & Loss, Loneliness, Stress & Overwhelm, Anger, Forgiving Others, Guilt & Shame, Temptation, Addiction & Freedom, Doubt, Discouragement, Weakness & Strength, Sickness & Healing, Money & Provision, Work & Career, Decisions & Guidance, Waiting & Patience, Marriage, Parenting, Family & Relationships, Friendship, Rejection & Heartbreak, Self-Worth & Identity, Pride & Humility, Jealousy & Contentment, Peace, Hope, Gratitude, Joy, Courage, Faith & Trust in God, Salvation & Grace, Heaven & Eternal Life, Suffering & Trials, Rest & Sleep, Prayer, God's Love, Spiritual Growth, and Protection & Safety.

One app works across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

name: Volksschulkinder – Lernspiele

• Silben zählen, Reimwörter, Gegenteile, Wortarten, Satzzeichen

RATEN & WAHRNEHMEN
• Farben, Formen, Obst & Gemüse, Tiere, Verkehrszeichen
• Jahreszeiten & Wetter, Wochentage & Monate, Schreiben üben

SO LERNT ES SICH LEICHTER

Keine Werbung, keine Käufe, keine Anmeldung, keine Statistik und keine Analyse-Programme von Dritten. Beim Spielen stellt die App keine Verbindung ins Internet her. Volksschulkinder ist ein privates, nicht kommerzielles Projekt von WebCoding.at und kein Angebot einer Behörde oder Schule.

name: Wayloom
description:
Wayloom – Personal Exploration Studio
Turn everyday outings into meaningful experiences with Wayloom, your personal space for discovering interesting places, organizing adventures, preparing essentials, and preserving memorable moments.
Whether you're planning a weekend escape, exploring a new destination, or organizing a simple day trip, Wayloom helps you bring your ideas, plans, and reflections together in one thoughtfully designed app.
Discover & Organize Places
Build a personal collection of places you want to explore. Record interesting details, practical visiting tips, personal preferences, and useful information to make future outings easier to organize.
Prepare with Personalized Kits
Create preparation kits for different activities and adventures. Organize essentials, clothing, equipment, comfort considerations, and estimated costs so you can approach each outing with confidence.
Plan Your Routes
Design personalized itineraries with multiple stops, planned activities, schedules, transportation details, and budget estimates. Keep your outing plans organized and mark them as completed as you explore.
Capture Your Experiences
Create meaningful journal entries about the places you've visited and the experiences you've enjoyed. Record personal discoveries, memorable details, reflections, and highlights that you can revisit anytime.
Stay Organized with Your Personal Dashboard
Get a clear overview of your saved places, preparation kits, upcoming routes, and journal entries. Follow your progress, revisit favorites, and access practical planning tools from one convenient space.
Helpful Features
	•	Five dedicated sections for exploration and planning.
	•	Personal destination and discovery collections.
	•	Customizable preparation kits.
	•	Multi-stop itinerary planning.
	•	Budget planning and expense estimates.
	•	Reusable preparation checklist.
	•	Personal experience journal.
	•	Favorites, progress indicators, and collection insights.
	•	Search and filtering for easy organization.
	•	Offline storage for your personal records.
	•	Simple editing and management of saved entries.
Designed for Everyday Exploration
Wayloom brings together practical organization and personal reflection in a clean, welcoming experience. From the first idea to the final memory, every part of your outing has a place.
Plan thoughtfully, explore freely, and keep the moments that matter.
Wayloom — Every journey has a story.

name: WzState
description:
WzState is the mobile companion to the WzState CRM for real-estate brokerages. It is for sales reps and sales managers whose organization uses WzState — sign in with the workspace and account your company gave you.

Today — one screen for your day: overdue and due tasks, new leads that nobody has called yet, and unread conversations. Managers also see their team: who has what, and which leads are still unassigned.

Leads — search your leads, open one, and call or WhatsApp in a tap. When you come back from a call, the app asks how it went and logs it on the lead's timeline. Create follow-up tasks, mark them done or snooze them.

Inbox — your WhatsApp Business conversations with customers in one place. Reply, use approved templates when the 24-hour window is closed, assign a conversation to a colleague, and get notified when a customer writes.

Units — search primary units and resale listings while you are on the phone with a customer, then share a unit with the lead on WhatsApp or note their interest.

Notifications tell you when a lead is assigned to you, a task is due, or a customer writes. Arabic and English, right-to-left included.

An organization account on WzState is required. Accounts are created by your company's administrator.

name: xSetup

xSetup is the friendly companion for every printer you own. Add a printer in about a minute, print photos and documents, scan paper to PDF, and get step-by-step help the moment something goes wrong — all in one beautifully simple app.

SET UP ANY AIRPRINT PRINTER — FAST
• A guided wizard finds printers on your Wi-Fi automatically
• Prefer to type it? Add a printer by IP address or scan its QR code
• Or pick from the system AirPrint list
• Print a test page to confirm everything works

PRINT PHOTOS & DOCUMENTS
• Choose photos straight from your library — or import PDFs, images and text files

SCAN TO PDF
• Use your iPhone's camera to scan documents with automatic edge detection

name: ZoviMajstora
