Preuzmite ZoviMajstora i pronađite pravog majstora za svoj sljedeći projekat.

name: Тривога: мої місця
description:
«Тривога: мої місця» показує повітряні тривоги та повітряні цілі України на мапі й відповідає на головне запитання: що відбувається біля мого дому, роботи чи рідних — просто зараз.

МОЇ МІСЦЯ
• До трьох місць зі своїми назвами: «Дім», «Робота», «Мама» — як вам зручно
• Кожне місце має власний статус: тривоги немає, загроза або повітряна тривога
• Власний радіус сповіщень для кожного місця: 10, 25, 50 або 100 км

МАПА ТА ЦІЛІ
• Тривоги за районами та областями на мапі
• Повітряні цілі за типами, з напрямком руху
• Орієнтовний час підльоту до вашого місця
• Список цілей із відстанню до вашого місця

СПОВІЩЕННЯ
• Початок і відбій тривоги у вашій області
• Сповіщення, коли ціль наближається до вашого місця
• Тихі години: вночі менш термінові сповіщення приходять без звуку, а найважливіші — як зазвичай
• Радіорежим: голосові оголошення про цілі поруч, поки застосунок відкритий

ДЛЯ РІДНИХ
• Надішліть рідним посилання на місце, ціль або розділ — вони відкриють потрібне вікно в застосунку
• «Я в безпеці» — коротке повідомлення в один дотик
• Найближче укриття в Apple Maps

ВІДЖЕТ
Статус вашого місця на екрані «Додому» та на екрані блокування.

ПРИВАТНІСТЬ
Без реєстрації, реклами та аналітики. Точні координати залишаються на вашому пристрої: на сервер сповіщень передається лише приблизна позиція (до 1 км), назва місця та радіус.

ДЖЕРЕЛО ДАНИХ
Дані про тривоги та цілі надає NEPTUN (neptun.in.ua).

ВАЖЛИВО
Застосунок — інформаційний сервіс на основі відкритих джерел, а не офіційна система оповіщення. Позиції цілей приблизні й можуть запізнюватися або бути відсутніми. Під час тривоги завжди діяйте за офіційними сигналами та прямуйте в укриття.

name: حصصي - منبه حصص المعلم
description:
حصصي يرتّب يومك الدراسي ويذكّرك بكل حصة قبل موعدها، حتى والتطبيق مغلق.

صُمّم للمعلم والمعلمة في المدارس السعودية: تُدخل حصصك مرة واحدة، والتطبيق يتكفّل بالباقي طوال الأسبوع.

ماذا يقدم لك حصصي؟
• تنبيه قبل كل حصة بالوقت الذي تختاره، مع اسم المادة والفصل.
• شاشة «اليوم» تعرض حصتك الحالية والوقت المتبقي، والحصة التالية.
• أوقات الحصص والفسحة تُحسب تلقائيًا من بداية الدوام ومدة كل حصة.
• عدد حصص مختلف لكل يوم، مثل ست حصص يوم الخميس.
• انسخ جدول يوم إلى يوم آخر بلمسة.
• واجهة عربية بسيطة، وبياناتك محفوظة على جهازك فقط.

حصصي برو
• توقيت شتوي وصيفي ورمضان، والتطبيق ينتقل بينها تلقائيًا في تاريخها.
• ودجت للشاشة الرئيسية وشاشة القفل تعرض حصتك الآن والتالية.
• ملاحظات لكل فصل: وين وقفت في الدرس، والواجب، ومواعيد الاختبارات مع تذكير صباح يوم الاختبار.
• مشاركة جدولك كصورة مرتبة، ونسخة احتياطية تنقلها لجوالك الجديد.

الاشتراك
حصصي برو متاح باشتراك شهري أو سنوي، مع تجربة مجانية لمدة أسبوع على الاشتراك السنوي. يُخصم المبلغ من حساب Apple عند تأكيد الشراء، ويتجدد الاشتراك تلقائيًا ما لم يُلغَ قبل ٢٤ ساعة على الأقل من نهاية الفترة الحالية. يمكنك إدارة الاشتراك أو إلغاؤه من إعدادات حسابك في App Store.

شروط الاستخدام: https://asaher.com/hesasi/#terms

name: ضمّة: رفيقة الأم والحمل والطفل
description:
«ضمّة» رفيقتكِ اليومية من أول أسبوع حمل حتى يكبر طفلكِ. تطبيق عربي أولًا، متاح حاليًا مجانًا، ويحترم خصوصيتكِ: بلا حسابات، بلا إعلانات، وكل بياناتكِ على جهازكِ فقط.

• سجّلي الرضعة والحفاض والنوم بلمسة واحدة أو بصوتكِ
• تذكير بالرضعة والتطعيم والدواء والماء، حتى والتطبيق مقفول
• «رُفيدة» تجيبكِ على آلاف الأسئلة وتفهم لهجتكِ، بلا إنترنت
• كلماته الأولى: أكثر من 100 صورة حقيقية بصوتها ونطق عربي صحيح
• ترجمة البكاء، والمراحل وطفرات النمو، والقيلولة القادمة
• أصوات حقيقية تهدّئ طفلكِ: مطر، بحر، دقات القلب، «شششش»… وصوتكِ أنتِ
• حكايات قبل النوم بطلها طفلكِ، بصوت دافئ حقيقي
• حملكِ أسبوعًا بأسبوع، ومؤقت الطلق، وعدّاد الركلات
• سلّمي الطفل للجدة بورقة جاهزة على واتساب، ووضع الجدة بأزرار كبيرة
• رمضان للحامل والمرضعة، والسبوع والعقيقة، ورحلة الأربعين
• قفل برقم سري، ومزامنة مع زوجكِ بلا حسابات

«ضمّة» تقدم معلومات عامة للتوعية ولا تغني عن الطبيب، ولا تحدد جرعات الأدوية أبدًا. في الطوارئ اتصلي بالإسعاف فورًا.

name: فطنة — تدريب القدرات
description:
تدرّب على القدرات مع فطنة، وراجع إجاباتك بعد كل جلسة.

تدريب كمي ولفظي، وتقييم أولي، ومحاكاة بأقسام موقّتة. يمكنك استئناف الجلسة المحلية على الجهاز نفسه، وعرض النتائج المكتملة المحفوظة في حسابك من الموقع والتطبيق.

استخدم حساب فطنة نفسه، وتظهر لك الأنشطة بحسب صلاحية حسابك. لا توجد عملية شراء داخل التطبيق.

فطنة منصة تدريب مستقلة، وليست جهة الاختبار الرسمية، ولا تضمن درجة محددة.

name: منصة ذي قار الكروية
description:
منصة ذي قار الكروية تجمع مباريات وبطولات الفرق الشعبية في محافظة ذي قار في مكان واحد، من الناصرية والشطرة وسوق الشيوخ إلى سيد دخيل والغراف وباقي الأقضية والنواحي.

تصفّح كل شيء دون تسجيل أو إنشاء حساب:

• النتائج المباشرة: النتيجة ودقيقة المباراة تتحدث لحظة بلحظة. • أحداث المباراة: الأهداف وضربات الجزاء والبطاقات الصفراء والحمراء، مع اسم اللاعب والدقيقة. • الترتيب: جدول الدوري يتحدث بعد كل مباراة، مع المجموعات وأدوار خروج المغلوب. • الهدافون: قائمة هدافي كل بطولة. • الفرق واللاعبون: صفحة لكل فريق بلاعبيه، وبطاقة لكل لاعب بأهدافه وبطولاته يمكنك مشاركتها مع أصدقائك. • البحث: اعثر على أي فريق أو بطولة أو لاعب بسرعة. • الإشعارات: تابع فريقك أو بطولتك المفضلة ليصلك إشعار عند انطلاق المباراة ومع كل هدف وبطاقة.

لمنظمي البطولات: لوحة تحكم بسيطة لإضافة الفرق واللاعبين والمباريات، وتسجيل الأحداث مباشرة من الملعب. الدخول إلى لوحة التحكم مخصص للمشرفين ومنظمي البطولات فقط، أما الجمهور فيتصفح دون حساب.

حمّل التطبيق وكن قريباً من فريقك.

name: 시세24
description:
시세24는 바쁜 직장인을 위한 경제 미디어예요. 매일 시장을 읽어 주는 인사이트와 24시간 실시간 시세를 한 앱에서 만나 보세요.

■ 매일 받아 보는 경제 인사이트
코스피와 반도체가 오늘 왜 움직였는지, 다음에 지켜볼 숫자는 무엇인지 매일 한 편으로 정리해 드려요. 거래소, 공시, 한국은행 같은 원자료를 직접 확인하고, 표와 그래프로 한눈에 보이게 풀었어요.

■ 시장을 흔드는 일정, 경제 캘린더
미국 고용, 물가, 금리 발표처럼 시장을 움직이는 일정을 한국 시간으로 알려 드려요. 발표까지 남은 날짜도 바로 보여요.

■ 경제 뉴스를 한곳에
꼭 봐야 할 주요 뉴스와 지금 많이 읽히는 뉴스를 한 화면에서 확인해요.

■ 24시간 실시간 시세
장이 끝난 저녁과 주말에도 삼성전자, SK하이닉스, 미국 주식, 비트코인의 지금 시세를 보여 줘요.

■ 장 마감 후에도 내 종목 손익
보유 종목과 평균 단가를 넣어 두면 평가금과 수익률을 실시간으로 계산해요. 입력한 내용은 내 폰에만 저장돼요.

■ 지표 한눈에
환율, 유가, 미국채 금리, 변동성 지수, 공포탐욕 지수를 홈에서 바로 확인해요.

※ 시세24의 정보는 투자 참고용이며, 매수나 매도를 권하지 않아요. 주말과 야간의 국내 종목 가격은 실제 주식이 아닌 해외에서 거래되는 선물형 상품 가격이에요.

name: 찰칵98 - Y2K 빈티지 디카 & 필름카메라
description:
"요즘 휴대폰 카메라는 너무 선명해서 그 시절 감성이 안 나요."
찍는 순간 1998년으로 시간 여행을 떠나는 진짜 Y2K 빈티지 디카 & 35mm 필름 카메라, [찰칵98]을 만나보세요!

복잡한 유료 구독이나 회원가입 없이, 90년대 실버 컴팩트 디카 특유의 뽀샤시하고 청량한 색감, 직광 플래시 감성, 주황빛 날짜 도장, 인화지 하단 여백 손글씨·스탬프 꾸미기, 그리고 어제 찍은 갤러리 사진을 1998년 필름으로 바꿔주는 '사진 암실'까지 한 번에 담았습니다.

■ 왜 '찰칵98'을 지금 바로 써봐야 할까요?

1. 찍는 순간 완성되는 6가지 독창적인 Y2K 디카 & 필름 색감
단순히 색만 입히는 흔한 필터가 아닙니다. 1998년 초기 디지털 센서 특유의 빛 번짐(블룸)과 필름 입자감을 정교하게 재현했습니다.
• CyberCCD 98 (기본 무료): 98년 실버 디카 특유의 차가운 시안빛 하이라이트와 뽀샤시한 피부톤
• Classic Gold 35 (기본 무료): 따스한 오후 햇살을 닮은 골든 앰버 35mm 필름 색감
• PartyFlash 00: 밤거리와 실내에서 터지는 강렬한 일회용 카메라 직광 플래시 감성
• Harajuku Soft 02: 몽환적이고 부드러운 파스텔 디퓨전 포켓 디카
• Tokyo Emerald 400: 깊은 청록빛 그림자와 선명한 초록이 살아있는 ISO 400 필름
• Seoul Mono 400: 거친 입자감과 깊은 대비가 돋보이는 스트리트 흑백 필름

2. 주황빛 레트로 날짜 도장 ('98 11 09)
• 90년대 카메라 우측 하단에 선명하게 찍히던 주황색 LED 날짜 각인을 그대로 재현했습니다.
• 연/월/일('YY MM DD), 월/일/연, 일/월/연, 촬영 시각(TIME), 날짜 끄기(OFF)까지 5가지 모드를 촬영 전 언제든 바꿀 수 있습니다.

3. 인화지 여백 손글씨·스탬프 꾸미기 & 4배 확대 뷰어
• 사진을 찍으면 크림화이트 인화지 프레임에 담겨 바로 확인하고, 두 손가락으로 최대 4배까지 확대해 디테일을 감상할 수 있습니다.
• 인화지 하단 여백을 터치해 그날의 기분, 여행지, 짧은 일기를 5가지 펜 잉크 색상과 16종 레트로 스탬프로 예쁘게 각인해 보세요.

4. 어제 찍은 갤러리 사진도 1998년 감성으로! [사진 암실 현상소]
• "이미 기본 카메라로 찍어둔 사진인데 어떡하죠?" 걱정하지 마세요!
• 앨범에 있는 과거 사진들을 여러 장 불러와 원하는 디카·필름 색감으로 한 번에 일괄 현상할 수 있습니다.
• 사진 속에 기록된 실제 촬영 날짜(EXIF)를 자동으로 읽어와, 그날의 정확한 주황빛 날짜 도장까지 감쪽같이 복원해 줍니다.

5. 진짜 카메라를 쥔 듯한 수동 다이얼 손맛
• 드르륵 돌아가는 금속 썸휠 다이얼 햅틱으로 셔터스피드, ISO 감도, 노출보정(EV), 화이트밸런스를 직접 조절할 수 있습니다.
• 딜레이 없이 즉시 찍히는 경쾌한 기계식 셔터음과 필름 와인딩 사운드로 촬영의 즐거움을 더해줍니다.

name: おじコレ -おじさんコレクション- カード × パズル
description:
町に、マナーを守らない者をゆるさない怪人たちがあらわれた！
立ち向かうのは、町のふつうのおじさんたち。
「おじコレ（オジサンコレクション）」は、おじさんのカードを集めてチームを作り、同じ色の玉をなぞってつなげるパズルで怪人と戦う、カード集め＋パズルのゲームです。

【遊び方はかんたん】
・同じ色の玉を、指でなぞって3つ以上つなげるだけ
・長くつなぐほど、連鎖するほど、おじさんたちの攻撃が大きくなる
・必殺ゲージがたまると、おじさんの必殺ワザが自動で出る
・大連鎖で「連チャン」に突入すると、敵は動けず、特殊な玉が降ってくる！

【集めて楽しい、おじさんのカード】

・同じカードがダブると、そのおじさんが少しずつ強くなる（星5つまで）
・図鑑で、集めたカードをいつでもながめられる

【ストーリーは紙芝居で】
・第一話から第二十話まで。話ごとに、ちがう怪人とちがう町の場所
・かけ湯をしない、返却期限を守らない、乾杯を断る、そんな人を、怪人はゆるさない
・戦いの中で、新しいおじさんが仲間になることも

【敵のカードも集めよう】
・怪人と構成員を倒すと、たまに敵のカードを落とす
・全二十話をクリアすると「ハード改」が開き、強くなった怪人ともう一度戦える。ハード改でしか手に入らない「改」のカードも

【毎日のおたのしみ】
・毎日1つの無料パック
・毎日のおつかい3つ。全部できたらパック券
・ログインボーナス（続けて来なくても、日数は進みます）

【お金はかかりません】
・アプリの中で、お金を払って買うものはありません
・おじコインやパックは、遊んで手に入れるものだけです
・広告で運営しています

【やさしい設定】
・BGM と効果音は、それぞれオン・オフと音量を変えられます
・光の点滅や画面のゆれをおさえる設定があります

このゲームに登場する人物・怪人・団体は、すべて AI で生成した、実在しない架空のものです。

从相册选择或直接拍照，点选照片主体，配合保留、擦除和撤销微调边缘。选择喜欢的白边，再为贴纸取一个名字。

为每枚贴纸记录感受，用简洁的心情图标和文字，保存照片背后的故事。

【让收藏动起来】
在网格和自由落体之间切换。轻轻拖动贴纸，或倾斜、摇晃手机，看收藏跟着动起来；落体画布最多展示 150 枚贴纸。

用网格、落体或自由排列制作月度分享图，调整贴纸顺序，把自己的生活片段导出为 PNG 图片。

按日期、月份或关键词查找贴纸，选择需要的内容。支持透明 PNG 贴纸导出，也可打包导出所选贴纸与相关记录。

name: Fusecore: Merge Defense
description:
Merge modules. Fuse six Mythic towers. Hold the core.

Fusecore is a merge-defense strategy game with no ads and no energy timers. Build a 6x6 matrix of modules, power your neighbors and stop the waves circling your base. Every run is a puzzle you win by planning, not by luck.

WHY IT PLAYS DIFFERENTLY
Skill beats luck: summon odds and pity counters are always on screen, and the six Mythic recipes are fixed, so every module feeds a plan.
Every slot matters: live arrows show how neighbors power each other. Position counts as much as raw power.
Short runs, saved every wave. Pause any time. Fully offline, no ads, no energy. 
Daily Ops and friend challenges: three new ops every day, plus same-seed duels with real friends. No PvP bots, no disconnects.
Learn real strategy: a coach explains every run and names the lesson (expected value, compounding, space, reading threats).

HOW A RUN WORKS
Summon a module with Alloy, drag twins together to raise their tier, place them where neighbors boost them most, then fuse the right trio into a Mythic. Enemies walk a loop around your matrix. If one finishes a lap it hits your Shield. Hold out for 60 waves. Wave 1 waits until you start it, and you can tap the info icon on anything for plain-language rules and numbers.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• 10 module types in 3 tiers and 6 Mythic towers with fixed, plannable recipes
• A 60-wave campaign with wave traits: swarms, armor, cloaking, regeneration and more
• Aether Chip upgrade rolls with the odds and pity counters shown. Chips are earned in play and cannot be bought
• Three Daily Ops every day, each with its own modifier and an online daily board
• Friend challenges: share a code, play the same seed, best of 3 attempts
• Tech Lab, relics, a full illustrated Guide and strategy lessons
• Color-blind patterns, reduced motion and haptics options

FREE TO DOWNLOAD, FAIR TO PLAY
Free: the full 60-wave campaign on Easy and Normal with Mythics 1-3, all three Daily Ops, friend challenges with all six Mythics, Tech Lab up to level 6, every relic, the full Guide and speeds from 1x to 4x.
Commander Edition (one-time purchase): Hard mode (Warlord), Endless mode, Mythics 4-6 in campaign runs, Tech Lab levels 7-12 and two board themes.
Optional extras: Recruit Pack (one-time), Medal & Shard Doubler (one-time), Supply Cache (Medals and Shards, fixed contents, no randomness) and the Command Pass subscription.
Nothing that decides a leaderboard score is for sale. Daily Ops and challenges use the same standard loadout for everyone.

COMMAND PASS (OPTIONAL AUTO-RENEWING SUBSCRIPTION)
Command Pass is available as Command Pass Monthly (1 month) or Command Pass Yearly (1 year). It adds a daily Supply Drop, the premium row of a 30-tier monthly season track and 1.5x run Medals. The yearly plan starts with a 1-week free trial for eligible new subscribers. The price is shown in the app and on Apple's purchase sheet before you confirm.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel it any time in your device's Account Settings (Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions).
• Any unused part of a free trial period is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

For iPhone and iPad. Languages: English, Arabic (full right-to-left layout), Korean, Japanese, German and French. No account needed. Campaign runs work offline; Daily Ops boards and friend challenges need a connection.

name: Vakada Taste Orbit
description:
A little curiosity can lead to a whole new flavor. Vakada Taste Orbit helps you explore ingredient pairings, keep your own kitchen ideas and turn combinations into meals.

START WITH AN INGREDIENT
Browse thirty ingredients across vegetables, herbs and aromatics, fruit, grains and pulses, dairy and eggs, and pantry essentials. Read flavor descriptors and practical preparation notes, search the library and keep favorites close.

FOLLOW ITS FLAVOR ORBIT
Explore curated pairings around your chosen ingredient. Read short explanations about flavor, aroma and texture, then select the ingredients you want to bring together. The same pairings are available in a list view.

MAKE YOUR OWN COMBINATIONS
Build a combination of two to six ingredients, give it a name and add notes and tags. Save an idea for later and return to edit it as your tastes develop.

FROM PAIRING TO PLATE
Browse fifteen included recipes or find recipes that match your selected ingredients. See explicit match counts and which selections are missing from a result. Search recipes, filter by time or vegetarian options, and save favorites.

COOK STEP BY STEP
Open a recipe, adjust its servings and follow the ordered instructions. Use step timers where provided, resume your cooking progress and optionally record the outcome in your cooking journal.

KEEP WHAT YOU DISCOVER
Return to saved combinations, favorite ingredients and recipes, and completed cooking sessions. Build a personal record of the ideas you want to try again.

EXPLORE OFFLINE
The ingredient catalog, pairing explanations and recipes are included in the app. Search, save and cook without an internet connection. Your personal records are stored locally on your device.

Pairing suggestions come from a curated collection. Your combinations help you explore that collection and find matching recipes.

Pick an ingredient. Follow its orbit. Make something delicious.

name: めだか鉢 - 睡蓮鉢のめだかを眺める
description:
睡蓮鉢を真上から眺めるアプリです。開くと、すぐに鉢が見えます。

■ 水面に触れる
水面に触れると波紋が広がり、めだかがさっと散ります。少しすると、えさかと思って、またゆっくり寄ってきます。指でなぞると、なぞったあとに小さな波紋が続きます。

■ 季節と、朝・昼・夕方・夜
端末の日付と時刻で、鉢の中が移り変わります。
・春：睡蓮の若葉と、桜の頃に浮かぶ花びら
・夏：大きな睡蓮の葉と花。6月の夜は蛍
・秋：色づいていく葉と、もみじ・いちょうの落ち葉
・冬：静かな水面と、寒い朝の薄氷
日の出と日の入りに合わせて光が替わり、鉢の影の向きも動きます。夜は水面に月が映ります。

■ 水の音と、季節の声
水の音に、季節と時刻の声が重なります。朝のすずめ、初夏の夜のかえる、夏の夕方のひぐらし、秋の夜の鈴虫やこおろぎ、冬の風。音はすべて端末の中で作っています。音量を決めたり、消したりできます。消音スイッチを入れている時は鳴りません。ほかのアプリの音楽と一緒に流せます。

■ はじめから使えるもの
・黒の睡蓮鉢と、黒めだか3匹（iPad は5匹）
・季節と朝昼夜の移り変わり
・水の音と季節の声、音量
・時計の表示、横向き、iPad

■ Pro（1回の購入）
・鉢は5つ：黒の睡蓮鉢・白磁の鉢・信楽焼の鉢・瑠璃の鉢・木の桶
・5つの品種を足せます：楊貴妃・幹之・白めだか・青めだか・ヒメダカ（黒めだかと合わせて6品種）
・品種を混ぜて、15匹まで（iPad は25匹まで）
・季節を止める：「夏のまま」のように、好きな季節で止められます。朝昼夜は時刻のままです
Pro は1回のお支払いで全部使えます。定期的な支払いはありません。

■ 目と電池に気を配って
しばらく触れないと、画面を少し暗くします。描く回数をおさえ、端末が熱い時は動きを減らします。充電しているあいだは、画面をつけたままにできます。

■ ないもの
広告なし。ログインなし。通知なし。えさやりや水替えの世話はなく、めだかが死んでしまうこともありません。選んだ鉢や数は、端末の中だけに保存します。

name: Part 107 Pass
description:
Pass the FAA Part 107 written test with answers you can check.

107 Pass is a study app for the FAA Remote Pilot (UAG) knowledge test. Every question comes with a three-part explanation and a citation to the exact 14 CFR section it tests. Tap the citation and you see the regulation text, the sentence that answers the question, and a link to the full section on eCFR.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 330 original questions across all five ACS areas — Regulations, Airspace, Weather, Loading & Performance, Operations
• 24 chart and figure questions built on original diagrams: airspace lines, airport data blocks, obstacle symbols, MEF, METAR, LAANC grids
• Three-part explanations: why the right answer is right, why each wrong option is wrong, and the regulation behind it
• A citation on every answer: the section, the quoted sentence, and a link to eCFR
• Timed exam simulation: 60 questions, 120 minutes, 70% to pass — the same shape as the FAA test
• Spaced repetition: a question you miss returns the next day, and a question you get right twice moves to 3, 7, 16 then 35 days
• Nine study cards and three chart primers for the last week: the numbers the test repeats, the traps, and how to read the symbols
• Progress by domain, a review-missed queue, and resume where you stopped
• Optional daily study reminder, scheduled on your device

FREE TO TRY
30 questions and a 10-question mini exam are free. One in-app purchase unlocks the rest of the bank and the full 60-question exam. No subscription, no account, no ads.

HOW IT IS BUILT
Every citation is checked against a bundled eCFR snapshot (2026-11-01) at build time, so the regulation you read is the regulation that answers the question. The questions are original and written for this app: the FAA does not publish its question bank, so no app can honestly sell you "real FAA questions".

107 Pass is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by the Federal Aviation Administration. Always confirm current requirements with the FAA before you fly.

name: Askbefore
description:
Το Askbefore σάς βοηθά να οργανώσετε τα έγγραφα, τις προθεσμίες και τα επόμενα βήματα για τη διαμονή σας στο Μαυροβούνιο. Απαντήστε σε ερωτήσεις που προσαρμόζονται στις επιλογές σας και δείτε ενδεικτική αξιολόγηση ανά ενότητα, μαζί με ένα σχέδιο δράσης κατά προτεραιότητα. Επιλέξτε λίστα για εργασία, εποχιακή εργασία, επιχείρηση, ακίνητο, οικογένεια ή σπουδές, σημειώστε όσα έχετε ετοιμάσει και προσθέστε τα δικά σας σημεία.

Συγκεντρώστε ημερομηνίες λήξης αδειών, ανανεώσεις ασφάλισης και ραντεβού, με προαιρετικές τοπικές ειδοποιήσεις. Καταγράψτε εισόδους και εξόδους για να υπολογίζετε τις ημέρες παραμονής σε κυλιόμενο διάστημα 180 ημερών. Σε περίπτωση απώλειας διαβατηρίου, επικείμενης λήξης άδειας ή άλλου απρόοπτου, ο οδηγός συγκεντρώνει βήματα και στοιχεία επικοινωνίας. Η εφαρμογή λειτουργεί χωρίς λογαριασμό και οι καταχωρίσεις αποθηκεύονται στη συσκευή σας. Για τις απαιτήσεις της δικής σας περίπτωσης, συμβουλευτείτε την αρμόδια αρχή.

name: Zip & Tumble: Pocket Park
description:
Pull a zipper and the map changes. A bridge stitches itself across a gap, the lining opens to reveal stairs, and a bobbin shuttle carries Tumble from dock to dock. Inside this cloth bag, a tiny fairground is yours to explore.

Drag each zipper pull to a notch, then tap a connected landing to hop there. Slide gold all the way across to join a bridge, pull mint back to uncover stairs, and park rose on the middle diamond. When two zippers cross, the order matters.

At Bobbin Works, tap the car to board and drag its blue pull to ride the rail. Hop off for a ticket, call the car back, or send it empty to another dock to release a lock.

- Explore 16 trails across Carousel Court, Button Bay, Moonlight Midway, and Bobbin Works.
- Try 27 Work Orders with different starting docks, ticket locations, and exit locks.
- Earn one star for reaching the exit, one for collecting every ticket in the run, and one for finishing within the move target. Fill your Patch Book as you collect tickets across the park.
- Ask for a hint, undo a move, or replay a trail to find a shorter route. Progress is saved so you can pick up where you left off.

Play offline at your own pace, with no ads or sign-in.

name: Undertow: Wave Battles
description:
Tap the sea, raise a wave, and watch enemy ships capsize.

UNDERTOW is a naval strategy game where the ocean is your weapon. Every wave you send travels across the water, bounces off walls and rocks, and slams into hulls. Time it right and a single swell can sink a whole fleet.

CAMPAIGN
90 levels across 9 seas: ice floes, volcanic islands, the deep, corsair bays, the gold route and the end of the world. Every sea has its own chart, its own tricks and its own boss, from the Kraken to the Dutchman's ghost ship.

WAVES AND POWERS
Send waves, tsunamis, whirlpools and lightning. Pick your fleet before each battle: frigates, galleons, harpooners, boarding ships and bomb ships, each with its own role.

MODES
• Voyage: a roguelike run with a shop, passives and relics, plus a daily challenge with a global leaderboard.
• Endless Sea: one battle that never ends. How many rounds can you survive?
• Arena: set your defense, attack other captains' fleets and climb the leagues each season.
• Level editor: build your own levels, publish them, and play what the community makes.

Also: a shipyard with sails and wakes to unlock, achievements, daily missions, friends and fleets, and a ghost of your best run to race against.

Plays offline, in landscape, with one finger. In English and Spanish. No ads.

name: Plomigo
description: Practice more intentional framing with 35 composition challenges. Try overlays in an interactive illustrated scene, capture two attempts, and compare them with a divider. Use the camera or import selected photos when you choose. Keep written observations or voice notes up to 60 seconds, then revisit stories in your gallery. Export JPEG photos, a PDF Photo Story, or separate M4A audio. No account is required. Your work stays on your device; camera and microphone access are optional.

name: Дачный блокнот
description:
Дачный блокнот — офлайн-журнал участка. Заведите сезон, отметьте грядки, посев и высадку, ведите дела и записывайте урожай. Повторяющиеся дела можно напомнить локально, в выбранное время. Записи хранятся только на устройстве. Их можно выгрузить в CSV или сохранить файлом копии и восстановить позже.

Приложение не подключается к серверу, не требует аккаунта и не подсказывает, когда сеять. Сроки и заметки выбираете вы.

name: Pulli Dawn
description:
Before sunrise, a Tamil doorstep is swept, sprinkled with water, and given its kolam: a pattern of rice flour wound in a single line around a grid of dots. Pulli Dawn is a practice book for that moment — on your own step, a balcony tile, or a sheet of paper, whenever and wherever you keep the custom.

The opening screen is the doorstep. A dark, wet threshold holds a pulli grid; a brass lamp flickers at the edge; your finger lays the line of flour. Trace a sikku (chikku) kolam — one line that winds around every dot without touching it and closes back on itself — and the app tells you the instant the loop closes. A missed or grazed dot simply glows; nothing here is marked a failure.

Choose your grid. Straight lattices (5-5, 7-7, 9-9, 11-11) and diamond idukku grids (1-3-5-3-1 up to 15-to-1) set the canvas. Draw freely, or switch on a faint traditional guide and trace over it.

A book of sixty patterns. Sikku kolams (neli), ruled padi kolams, and dot-joining figures — a lotus, the overflowing Pongal pot with its sugarcane, an eight-point star, a Margazhi lattice — each with its name, its grid, and the morning it belongs to. Search by name, filter by family or grid, and keep favourites.

A Margazhi calendar. The thirty mornings of the Tamil month of Margazhi laid out as a row of thresholds. Finish a kolam and that morning holds its thumbnail; or photograph the real kolam on your own step with the in-app camera. Outside Margazhi, the same row quietly keeps your everyday practice streak.

My kolams. Every drawing and photograph you keep, ready to revisit, trace again, or share as an image.

Learn as you go. A bundled how-to covers holding the flour between thumb and forefinger, laying out a dot grid in chalk, and a glossary of pulli, sikku, padi and idukku — all readable offline.

Pulli Dawn is a drawing tool, not a colour-powder rangoli painter, has no social feed or accounts, and includes no religious instruction or astrology. It works completely offline, every time.

name: PIT STUDIO
description:
テントをどこに立てるか、カートを何台並べられるか、整備中に人が通れるか。PIT STUDIOで、搬入前にピットの配置を試せます。

ピットの広さを決めて、テント、レーシングカート、タイヤラック、工具箱などを指で配置します。上面図で全体を見渡し、歩行ビューで車両や備品の間を歩いて確認できます。

・テントのサイズや色を選び、幕を区画ごとに開閉。上・左・右への半分折りにも対応します。
・床マットの縦横の枚数を指定。カゴ車の積み方やカートの配置も変更できます。
・LiDARなどで別途スキャンした3Dファイルを読み込み、自分の備品を配置できます。
・編集はオフラインで使えます。レイアウトは端末に自動保存され、画像や再編集用ファイルとして書き出せます。

備品は配置検討用の簡易モデルです。搬入時には実機の寸法をご確認ください。

name: Niwascape
description:
Niwascape is a Japanese garden that never ends. You sit inside an old temple hall, looking out across its veranda, and the garden drifts slowly past: raked white sand, islands of moss, ponds with stone bridges and koi, stepping-stone paths, a dry stream. Nothing is a recorded video. The garden is drawn in real time as it goes, and it never runs out. There is nothing to do but watch.

FOUR SEASONS
• Spring: fresh light-green leaves, azaleas in flower, cherry petals in the air.
• Summer: deep greens under a strong sun.
• Autumn: red maples, golden ginkgo, bright red dodan shrubs and fallen leaves on the moss.
• Winter: snow, bare branches and yukitsuri ropes over the pines.
Automatic follows the calendar, or you can choose a season yourself.

MORNING TO NIGHT
Morning, day, evening, or night with the stone lanterns lit. Add morning mist at any hour, from light to thick: it gathers near the ground and hides the far hills.

FIVE KINDS OF SCENE
Open raked sand with stone groups (karesansui), moss islands, ponds with islands, bridges and koi, stepping stones leading to a stone water basin, and a dry stream. They take turns as the garden passes.

BUILT ON REAL GARDEN RULES
Fifteen stones in groups of five, two, three, two and three – or seven, five and three – as at Ryōan-ji, and any three stones form an uneven triangle. Straight lines are raked parallel to the veranda, and rings circle each stone group. Trees play their traditional roles: a black pine at the heart of the scene, maples to catch the evening sun. Beyond them, wooded hills are borrowed into the view (shakkei), as at Entsū-ji. Every part follows the rules of Japanese garden design as garden makers and guides describe them.

YOUR VIEW
• Choose how often stone arrangements, moss islands, ponds, stepping-stone paths and dry streams appear.
• On iPhone and iPad, drag with one finger to turn the view, and use two fingers to raise or lower your eye. Turn on "Tilt to move the view" to look around by tilting the device.
• On Mac, drag to turn the view and scroll with two fingers to raise or lower it.
• Show or hide the veranda, change the drift speed, or create a new garden.

A CLOCK TO LEAVE ON
Show a clock over the garden: six fonts, size, opacity and position, white or black, 12- or 24-hour, seconds, and the date written the way your region writes it. "Keep screen on" stops the screen from locking while you watch.

IPHONE, IPAD, IPHONE DUO AND MAC
Made natively for every screen. On iPhone Duo, the garden fills the outer screen and the inner screen, upright or sideways. On Mac, Niwascape runs as a native app.

In English, Japanese, German and French. No ads, no account, no data collected. If you enjoy it, you can leave a tip in Settings.

The words of the garden – karesansui, shakkei, tsukubai and more – explained: https://www.gyuniku.jp/apps/niwascape.php

name: 〇〇で〇〇する
description:
何をしようか迷ったときに。場所と行動をルーレットで順番に決めるアプリです。

■ ランダム
まず場所を決め、その場所に合う行動を抽選します。結果は端末に保存され、ホームの「前回の結果」から見返せます。

■ カスタム
好きな場所と行動をセットに登録して、自分だけの抽選ができます。カスタム抽選は何度でも利用できます。

■ 選ばれた場所を検索
結果画面から、「近くの公園」のような検索語で、選ばれた場所を探せます。

ランダム抽選は、結果を保存してから次の抽選まで1時間です。動画広告を視聴できる場合は、残り時間を最大5分短縮できます。

name: 023.hr
description:
023.hr is the app of 023.hr, the news portal of Zadar, Croatia. It brings news from Zadar and Zadar County and the information you need before leaving home. The content of the app is in Croatian.

NEWS
• Front page and sections: Zadar, County, News, Sport and others
• Latest news as it is published, with a choice of your own sections
• Photo galleries and video in articles
• Saved articles and search

WEATHER
• Current conditions and a temperature curve for the next 12 hours
• Sea temperature, wind, sunrise and sunset, air quality and pollen, humidity and pressure
• Official weather warnings
• Weather for towns in Zadar County

SERVICE CENTRE
• Announced power and water outages, today and tomorrow
• Choose your town and street to see only the outages that affect you. The address stays on your phone.
• Road conditions, ferry and bus notices and traffic in Zadar
• Emergency clinic, pharmacy and on-call services

WASTE COLLECTION
• Collection schedule for your street in Zadar
• A reminder the evening before collection, if you turn it on

AND MORE
• Daily lunch menus of Zadar restaurants with prices
• Calendar of events in Zadar and the county
• Live radio stations from Zadar County, also with the phone locked
• Obituaries
• Send a tip to the newsroom: photo, video or message
• Notifications of your choice
• Light and dark theme, adjustable text size
• Read the last loaded news without an internet connection

The app requires no registration. No banner ads or pop-ups.

name: 3S Nexus CRM
description:
3S Nexus CRM, kurumsal satış ve sevkiyat sürecini yürüten iş uygulamasıdır. Fırsatın açılmasından teklife, siparişe, irsaliyeye ve planlı sevkiyata kadar olan iş aynı yetki düzeni içinde izlenir. Uygulama şirketin kendi CRM sunucusuna bağlanır. Hesabı şirket yöneticisi açar.

Fırsatlar satış ekibinin önündeki işi tutar. Teklifler hazırlanır, onaya gider ve revize edilir. Onaylanan teklif siparişe döner. Siparişler şirket kayıtlarına aktarılabilir. Cari hesap, stok ve iskonto bilgisi satış kalemleriyle birlikte görüntülenir.

Sevkiyat ve operasyon planlaması siparişin sahaya çıkmasını düzenler. Sevkiyat planı oluşturulur, planlanan ve hazırlanan sevkiyatlar ayrılır, revizyon talepleri izlenir. Satış irsaliyesi ve taslak irsaliye bu akışın içindedir. Depo hazırlığı, lojistik operasyon ve stok yeterliliği aynı süreçten okunur.

Yöneticiler fırsat, teklif ve sipariş raporlarında ciro, iskonto, kârlılık, ekip performansı, açık sipariş ve sevkiyat planını görür. Menü ve işlemler role göredir. İş olayları, kullanıcının seçtiği bildirimler olarak gelir.

3S Nexus CRM, ofis ve saha ekibinin aynı ticari kayıt üzerinde çalışması için tasarlanmıştır.

name: 3S One
description:
3S One, Logo ERP verilerinize güvenli erişim sağlayan mobil iş uygulamasıdır.

• Panel: sipariş, tahsilat, belge ve para durumu özeti
• Faturalar, siparişler, irsaliyeler
• Cari ve stok listeleri, bakiyeler
• Vade, çek, senet ve banka hareketleri
• Raporlar ve firma/dönem seçimi
• 3S Yazılım destek talepleri
• Koyu/açık tema, Face ID

Kurumsal müşteriler için tasarlanmıştır. Kullanım için geçerli API bağlantısı ve lisans gerekir.

name: 4ByFreak Wholesale
description:
4ByFreak Wholesale is the buying app for licensed motor vehicle dealers who buy cars wholesale from 4ByFreak.

See every car the moment it posts, with real photos, mileage, colors, location and our known-flaws disclosure. When you want one, slide to secure it at the listed price. Nobody else can buy it after that.

Then finish the deal from your phone:
• Sign the bill of sale in the app
• Wire payment with your PO number in the memo
• Get the owner's contact and the release sheet once your wire lands
• Track every car you've bought from secured to picked up
• Message our team directly from each deal

Turn on notifications to hear about new cars first, and when your car is released for pickup.

Dealers only. Apply in the app with your dealer license; we review every application, usually within one business day. All sales are as-is, dealer to dealer.

name: AaronSynth
description:
Play light as geometry.

AaronSynth is a tactile video instrument for iPhone. Turn a live camera, a selected photo, a looping video, or the built-in oscillator into luminous scan lines. Shape the image with signed sweeps, modulation, phosphor response, and optical feedback.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Use Touch to drag, pinch, and turn the scan directly. A one-time Pro Mode unlock adds the Simple dial banks, complete Advanced control desk, and photo/video source imports. Live cameras and the internal oscillator remain available without an unlock. The Pro unlock is offered at no charge, with no subscription. Assign dials to the monitor's X/Y surface and save your settings as personal patch memories. Six factory patches give you places to begin.

BUILD MOVING IMAGES
Route two waveform generators, a ramp, and microphone modulation into the scan. Adjust line density, intensity, beam glow, phosphor afterimage, independent Signal Noise and CRT Noise, colorization, and regeneration. Work in portrait, landscape, or the expanded performance view.

KEEP A PERFORMANCE
Record processed video at 60 fps with optional microphone audio, or capture a still frame. Choose Original 1280 × 960 H.264, 1080p H.264, or 4K UHD HEVC output. Movies save to Photos when access is allowed, and a local copy remains in Films for playback, sharing, and retrying a save.

HD and 4K use native output canvases for the beam, phosphor, and rescan camera. The physical raster still has up to 480 scan lines, and rendering cannot recover missing source detail. Higher resolutions use more power, memory, and storage. Imported video loops silently; its soundtrack is not included in recordings.

ON YOUR DEVICE
No AaronSynth account, advertising, tracking, or analytics. Apple handles the optional Pro Mode unlock through the App Store. Your media and patches are processed locally. Camera, microphone, and Photos permissions are requested when you use the relevant features. The internal oscillator works without them.

Requires iOS 18.2 or later.

name: Acervo: Your Collection
description:
Acervo is the catalog of your collection: watches, coins, banknotes, stamps, trading cards, records, pens, scale models and whatever else you keep.

CATALOG IN SECONDS
• Photos from several angles, brand, model, reference, year, condition, box and papers.
• Free-form features for each item: case, dial, caliber, edition, print run.
• Price paid and purchase date to follow how your collection gains value.
• Search and filters by category, authenticity and movement type.

KNOW WHAT IT'S WORTH (PREMIUM)
• AI identification from photos: the app fills in brand, model, year and features and suggests what to check to confirm authenticity.
• Estimated value on the used market of your country, in your currency, with a minimum, typical and maximum range and the basis of the estimate.
• International reference from eBay listings.
• Full valuation with web search and collection analysis.
• Estimates updated automatically every month.
• Find groups, forums, articles and videos about your model, in your country and abroad.

FIND OTHER COLLECTORS
• See how many Acervo collectors own the same model as you. The count is anonymous.
• Show up for them only if you want, with a nickname. Nobody sees your name, email or collection.
• Ask for contact with one tap: Instagram, WhatsApp or email only appear when both people accept.
• Block or report anyone who bothers you.

SHARE AN ITEM
• Send a link to an item and choose what shows: photos, brand, model, year, groups found and, if you want, the estimated value.
• Price paid, city, email and notes never go in the link. Stop sharing whenever you want.

REPORT
• Total estimated value, gain over what you paid, charts by category and brand.
• Spreadsheet to download, handy for insurance and inventory.

IN THE CLOUD, ON YOUR DEVICES
• Sign in with your email (no password) and your collection is saved in the cloud and synced across devices.
• Works offline: changes go to the cloud when you're back online.
• Without an account, everything stays on your device.

PRIVACY
• No ads and no tracking.
• Delete your account and all your data at any time, inside the app.

PLANS
• Free: up to 5 items and 3 photos per item, with catalog, report and cloud.
• Premium: unlimited items, up to 20 photos per item and every AI feature. Monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription; cancel anytime in the App Store settings.

Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Chinese and Japanese.

Estimates are AI-generated market references and don't replace a professional appraisal.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://arialgamer.com.br/acervo/privacidade/

name: ACT Form Tools
description:
ACT Form Tools is the data-collection app of ACT (Aiming Change for Tomorrow) International for field surveys in Pakistan and Azad Jammu & Kashmir. Enumerators, supervisors and teachers use it to fill the survey forms assigned to them, with or without internet.

Built for the field
• Works offline: forms download to your iPhone or iPad once; fill them anywhere and they upload automatically when the internet returns.
• Every question in English and Urdu, in clear Nastaliq script.
• Answers are saved on the device as you type: nothing is lost if the battery runs out or the app is closed. Continue drafts at any time.
• Quick number entry with + / − buttons, automatic totals and built-in checks that catch mistakes before you move on.
• One-tap GPS location and photos taken inside the form.
• Skip logic shows only the questions that apply.

Surveys in the app include household listing of out-of-school children, school assessments, village profiles, non-formal education centre assessments, teacher training needs, household back-checks and teacher validation of out-of-school children lists.

Who can use it
The app is for project staff. Accounts are created by the project administrator; sign in with the username and password you were given. You only see the forms assigned to you.

Privacy
Survey data is sent over encrypted connections and used only for the survey. Location and camera are used only when you tap the GPS or photo button. Privacy policy: https://ftools.act.org.pk/privacy.html

name: Ad Revenue Watch
description:
A free app to check your AdMob and AdSense estimated earnings every day.
See today's estimate and the change from yesterday the moment you open it, or glance at a Home Screen widget without opening the app at all.

FEATURES
• Estimated earnings for today, yesterday, this month, last month and the last 7 days, with day-over-day and month-over-month changes
• 7-, 30- and 90-day trend charts with comparison to the previous period
• AdMob vs. AdSense breakdown
• AdMob by app, ad unit, format and country (impressions, clicks, eCPM, CTR, match rate and more)
• AdSense by site, country, day and month (page views, clicks, page CTR, page RPM and more)
• Home Screen widgets in small and medium sizes
• Multiple Google accounts (works with AdMob only, AdSense only, or both)
• Accounts with different currencies or time zones are never mixed; optional conversion to a currency you choose
• Light and dark mode, larger text support
• Shows the last fetched data and time when you're offline
• Demo mode to try it without connecting an account

READ-ONLY, MINIMUM PERMISSIONS
• The app only asks for read-only access to view your earnings reports (AdMob: view reports, AdSense: read-only)
• It cannot change ad or site settings, or do anything related to payments
• Earnings data travels only between your device and Google. It is never sent to the developer's servers
• You sign in on Google's own screen, so the app never sees your password
• Disconnect anytime in the app or from your Google Account settings

MADE IN JAPAN
Designed and developed by Retrock, a software company in Japan.

PLEASE NOTE
• Amounts are Google's estimated earnings and may differ from your finalized payments.
• This is an independent app and is not provided or endorsed by Google LLC.
• The app is free and shows ads.
• AdMob, AdSense and Google are trademarks of Google LLC.

name: AdiLink
description:
AdiLink brings tachograph information, saved archives and workshop reports together on your iPhone.

Connect a compatible VDO DTCO tachograph over Bluetooth to view the live information it makes available, including driver activity, driving and rest times, speed and clock readings.

• Live data: review supported driving, rest and working-time readings for each driver, with separate indicators for unavailable or outdated values.
• TachoTimer: use DTCO-synchronised countdowns with visual and audible indications.
• Archives: download supported driver-card and vehicle-unit records, keep completed files on your iPhone and synchronise them with your company’s Aditex storage.
• Analysis: review recorded activities on a daily timeline, examine events and faults, and filter infringement analysis by regulation and Mobility Package rules.

name: Aimora You
description:
A local matchmaking record tool where you can set your ideal partner criteria, register profiles of potential matches, and document each date's time, location, atmosphere, and details. It allows rating compatibility, chat comfort, and personality, automatically summarizing affinity trends, match fit, and dating statistics, generating rankings and data charts.
All data is stored locally on this device, requiring no registration or login, with no ads or subscription fees. It helps you move beyond subjective impressions, rationally reviewing each encounter to gradually find like-minded people for photo shoots.

name: Airconet Business
description:
Airconet Business lets hotels, offices and condo buildings control all their split air conditioners from one app.

Your staff see every building, floor and room on a live floor plan. One tap turns a room, a floor or a whole building on or off.

FOR HOTELS

FOR OFFICES AND CONDOS

ALERTS

TEAM ROLES
Owner, manager, reception, technician and viewer – each with the right access.

Works with Airconet Wi-Fi AC modules. Energy reports, statistics and monthly reports are on the Airconet Business web dashboard.

An Airconet Business company account is required. To get started, contact your company owner or visit airconet.net.

name: AirDigest: Intelligence Notes
description:
AirDigest uses Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system built into your device, to turn a reel into one short article you can read, listen to and keep.

Copy a reel's link and paste it in AirDigest, or share it to the app. AirDigest watches the reel using Apple Intelligence and writes the article on your iPhone or iPad. There's no account, and no server of ours.

How AirDigest uses Apple Intelligence
Apple Foundation Models, on the device, write the draft, clean it up, file it by topic and find what the reel recommends. On iOS 27 they also read the images in a reel with no words. Around them, Vision reads the text on screen, App Intents bring your articles to Spotlight, Siri and Shortcuts, and a speech model in the app, Whisper small, hears what is said. No article is written in the cloud, not even Apple's.

Paste, or share
Copy a reel's link and paste it in AirDigest, or share it to the app and stay where you are. You can also choose a video from Photos or Files. Reels up to 90 seconds, or up to 45 when the screen is full of text.

Summarize
One page for each reel: a title, one line, In short, and any steps or list it gives, with its links, caption and transcript. Where AirDigest can place a part, a time beside it opens the reel's own lines. Ask for a long version whenever you want one.

Bookmark
Everything you add stays in your library with its still, by date, by topic and by words. Pin, archive and rearrange. There's no feed, nothing is suggested, and the list ends. An article you read comes back a week and a month later, as one quiet row, with no notifications.

Recommendations
A film, a book, a place, a song or an app the reel names lands in the article's list and in a list across your reels, one tap from Maps, Books, TV, Podcasts or Music. It can miss one.

Listen and share
Read aloud with your device's voices. Share an article as text, with the reel's link, or as an image, with the creator's handle. Export everything as Markdown.

Your language
Choose your language on the first screen. AirDigest shows it and writes in it: English, Spanish, French, Japanese, German, Portuguese, Italian, Korean or Simplified Chinese.

What it costs
Your first 5 new articles are free. Reading, listening, sharing, notes and long versions stay free. After that, a pass: 30 days, a year or Lifetime. Passes never renew: you pay once, and nothing charges you again.

Your privacy
We collect nothing: no account, no analytics, no ads. Your articles stay on your device and in your own iCloud. The video is held only while AirDigest watches it, then deleted; one still stays as the cover.

For iPhone and iPad
AirDigest runs on iPhone, including iPhone Duo, and on iPad. Your library follows you through your own iCloud. Writing needs Apple Intelligence: iPhone 15 Pro or later, iPhone 16e, iPad mini (A17 Pro, A20 Pro), or an iPad with M1 or later. On other devices you can read the sample. Apple Intelligence may not be available in every region or language.

Apple Intelligence writes each article and AirDigest doesn't check a reel's claims, so details can be wrong; the link back is at the end of every article. A reel and its ideas belong to its creator.

AirDigest works with public posts you share from Instagram. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram, Meta or Apple. Apple Intelligence is a trademark of Apple Inc.

name: Airme by Roam Dhuniye
description:
Airme lets you make free voice calls to friends and family over the internet. Just sign in with your Maldives mobile number and call anyone who uses Airme, over Wi-Fi or mobile data, with no call charges.

SIMPLE TO START
• Sign in with your mobile number and a one-time SMS code. No passwords.
• Find people by typing their number, then tap or swipe to call.
• Not on Airme yet? Send them an invite by SMS in one tap.

NEVER MISS A CALL
• Your phone rings even when Airme is closed or your phone is locked.
• Missed calls stand out in red, so you can call back in one tap.

A CLEAR CALL HISTORY
• See incoming, outgoing, missed and declined calls, with times and call length.
• Repeated calls from the same person are grouped together.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Calls are encrypted and never recorded.
• Nobody can browse a list of users. People can only find you if they know your number.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Delete your account at any time, right in the app.

Calls use your internet connection. Your mobile operator may charge for data. Both people need Airme to call each other.

Airme is made by Roam Dhuniye.

name: Al-Badr Live Lessons
description:
Al-Badr Live Lessons brings together Sheikh Abdur-Razzaq Al-Badr's lessons at the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah, so you can follow them live or review them afterwards. The app is in Arabic.

• Live: listen to the lesson as it starts, with a notification when the broadcast begins.
• Recordings: each book's lessons in order, playing even with the screen locked, with a notification when a new recording is available.
• Where the lesson stands: see how far the Sheikh has reached in the book, with the book file when one is available, to prepare for the next lesson.
• Your choice: follow only the lessons you want, and get only their notifications.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your choices stay on your device.

This is an unofficial app made by students of knowledge. It is not affiliated with the Sheikh or his website. The lessons come from the Sheikh's website al-badr.net and its live broadcast.

name: Alif Count: Dhikr Counter
description:
Say your dhikr out loud, and Alif Count counts for you.

No more holding a counter while you cook, drive, or care for your family. Wear one AirPod or put your phone down, start listening, and keep your heart and hands free. Every SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, and Allahu Akbar is counted as you say it.

DAILY DHIKR
• SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah, Astaghfirullah
• SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil Azim
• La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
• Allahumma salli ala sayyidina Muhammad
• Hasbunallahu wa ni‘mal wakil, the Dua of Yunus, Ya Latif, and Allah
• Only the full phrase counts, so saying part of it doesn’t add to your total
• Add your own dhikr or short dua: type or paste the Arabic, or just say it and the app writes it for you

THE 99 NAMES (ESMA’UL HUSNA)
• All 99 Names of Allah with their meanings
• Each name shows its traditional (ebced) count, ready as your goal
• Search by name or meaning

THE QURAN
• The whole Quran, page by page like the Madinah mushaf (604 pages, 30 juz), in the Madinah mushaf font (King Fahd Complex)
• Turn on Latin letters above or below each verse, in English or Turkish style spelling
• Tap Done after each page and Alif Count remembers where you left off
• Read a khatm together: share the 30 juz with family (for example Dad juz 1–8, Mom 9–18), and everyone sees the pages read

GROUP DHIKR
• Set a shared goal with family and friends, like 600 together
• Share the invite link; friends join with just their name, no account needed
• See everyone’s progress live, and finish together

MADE FOR DAILY LIFE
• Keeps counting with the screen off
• Works great with AirPods and wireless earbuds, even in a noisy kitchen
• A gentle tone shortly before your goal and a chime when you complete it
• Choose all sounds, goal sounds only, or silent
• Tap the counter to count by hand at any time, with a gentle buzz on every tap
• After-prayer tasbih: 33 SubhanAllah, 33 Alhamdulillah, 34 Allahu Akbar, moving on by itself
• History of your dhikr by day, week, and all time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your voice is never recorded or stored by Alif Count
• Your counts and history stay on your phone

Alif Count is a personal project, named for the first letter of the Arabic alphabet, and made with love for my mother and everyone who remembers Allah throughout the day.

I’d love to hear your ideas. You can send me a message right from the app.

Please keep me in your prayers.
— Erkam

name: Almost There: Countdown Widget
description:
Count down to the moments you can't wait for: a trip, a birthday, a wedding, a concert, Christmas. Almost There puts them on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, then goes live in the final hours with a ticking countdown in the Dynamic Island.

LIVE WHEN IT MATTERS
In the last hours before your flight, the doors opening or midnight on New Year's Eve, your countdown ticks to the second on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. A reminder puts it live with one tap, right on time.

BEFORE, DURING AND AFTER
Weeks out it shows the days to go. During a trip it shows Day 3 of 7. Afterwards, how long ago it was. Yearly events like birthdays and anniversaries roll over by themselves.

REMINDERS THAT BUILD THE EXCITEMENT
100 days, 30 days, a week, tomorrow, and a celebration with confetti when it's finally here.

BEAUTIFUL WIDGETS
• Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets, and StandBy
• Lock Screen widgets: ring, countdown and one-line
• Coming Up: your next countdowns in one widget
• Your own photos, 14 colour palettes, big number, ring and boarding-pass layouts

QUICK TO SET UP
One-tap holidays (Christmas, New Year, Easter, Valentine's Day and more). Bring in birthdays from Contacts and events from Calendar. Ask Siri "How long until Lisbon?"

SHARE THE EXCITEMENT
Turn any countdown into a story card for Instagram or Messages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No account. Your countdowns, notes and photos stay on your iPhone.

ALMOST THERE PRO
Unlimited countdowns, live Lock Screen countdowns, every widget size and style, photo backgrounds, milestone reminders and imports. Try it free for 7 days, then subscribe yearly or monthly, or buy it once for lifetime access. Free: 3 countdowns with small widgets and a reminder on the day.

name: Alshy
description:
Alshy is asyk atu, the knucklebone game of Kazakh and Uzbek courtyards, made for people who shot asyks as kids in the aul or the mahalla yard and still follow it at the World Nomad Games.

Open the app and you are already in a sunny courtyard with a line of asyks on the kon. Toss an asyk to see who throws first. The landing side is called out every time: alshy, taike, buk or shik. Then pull back from the saka, watch the short arc, and let go. The bones scatter under real physics. Knock an asyk clear of the kon and it is yours, and you throw again. Miss and the saka goes to the other side.

Your rivals have habits of their own. Aigerim aims carefully, Timur throws as hard as he can, and Ermek ata only ever plays bank shots off the courtyard wall, and wins on them.

The tour covers 24 yards: an aul near Shymkent, a Tashkent mahalla, an Almaty courtyard, a Samarkand school yard, a Turkestan bazaar lane and a steppe camp. Each yard has its own line length, its own local rule and its own ground. Packed earth runs true, dust grabs, asphalt skids and felt slides long and quiet.

Every asyk you win goes into your kalta, dyed red, green or blue the way children dye them. Mark your keepers, or dye one yourself in the Dye Pot with a colour caught by the camera or taken from a photo. Earn the lead-filled saka and the carved saka, which hooks as it slides.

The Erezhe rule book shows the four sides in drawings, the kon and the throwing mark, the yard variants, and a glossary of Kazakh and Uzbek words as players actually say them.

A new yard is set every day, so you can build a streak, collect medals and come back for the next leg of the tour.

No accounts, no ads, no stakes. Asyks are collection pieces only, and everything stays on your device.

name: Answerwell: Interview Practice
description:
Walk into your next interview calm. Answerwell helps you practise real interview questions out loud, with a plan built around your role and your interview date.

SET UP IN A MINUTE
Tell Answerwell your role, your level, when your interview is and what feels hardest. You get a plan of 5 mock interviews spread before the day. Roles: General, Software engineer, Product manager, Sales, Marketing and Customer support, at entry, mid or senior level.

FULL MOCK INTERVIEWS
Each session has 5 questions, from a warm-up to a closing question. Questions are read aloud, and you answer out loud for up to 2 minutes each. Like a real interview, your feedback comes at the end.

FEEDBACK YOU CAN USE
• A score for the session and for every answer
• Your pace, filler words, long pauses and answer length
• A check of your story: situation, task, action and result
• Up to 3 specific fixes, a stronger opening line and an example answer
• Redo your weakest answer and see the change

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Follow your scores session by session, and see how the areas you picked are improving.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your recording isn't kept. Only the text of your answer is sent to create feedback, and it isn't stored. Your answers and scores stay on your iPhone. You can reset your profile or delete all your data at any time.

FREE AND PRO
Your first full mock interview, with its summary, is free. Answerwell Pro gives you unlimited mock interviews and quick questions for $6.99 a month, or $39.99 a year with a 3-day free trial.

name: Antistress: Calm Toys
description:
Small, quiet toys for a busy mind. No sign-up, no goals, no score to chase — just touch.

Open a room, put your finger on the screen and let your thoughts slow down. Every toy reacts to touch with gentle movement, soft sound and a little tap you can feel.

15 CALMING ROOMS
• Fireplace: toss on logs and fan the flames, on a moonlit beach, in a forest clearing or under snowy mountains
• Bubble wrap: ten different sheets — a heart, a sunflower, jumbo bubbles, stars, a moon — then it starts again
• Fluffy pets: stroke a ginger, grey tabby or tuxedo cat until it purrs, or make a husky pant and howl
• Magic globe: shake your phone and watch snow, gold sand or bats swirl and settle
• Liquid light: stir glowing ink with your finger
• Rainy window: wipe the mist off the glass and watch the city lights through the rain
• Koi pond: call the fish over and feed them
• Zen garden: rake slow lines through soft sand
• Kinetic sand: press it, slice it, watch the layers fall
• Jelly friend: squish, stretch and fling
• Lava lamp: slow glowing wax that drifts, splits and merges
• Fireflies: a night meadow full of slow, blinking lights
• Fidget board: chunky switches, clicky keys and a detented dial
• Light harp: strum rays of light
• Breathe: follow a glowing orb to slow your breathing, with a soft tap at each breath

MADE TO BE CALM
• Real recorded sounds: purring, crackling wood, rain on the window
• Gentle haptics: feel every pop, click and flicker
• Color themes for day and night
• Works fully offline, nothing to download later
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no data collected

Whether you need a minute between meetings, something for anxious hands, or a quiet moment before sleep, antistress is always one tap away.

name: AquaDose

name: Archer Shooter: Bow & Arrow
description:
Draw the bow, follow the aim dots and hit the bullseye. Archer Shooter is an archery target shooting game where every arrow counts.

You have only a few arrows in each level. Hit every target before your quiver is empty, and hit the center for a BULLSEYE and more stars.

AIM AND SHOOT
• One-finger controls: drag to draw the bow, release to shoot
• Aim dots show the start of the arrow path
• Arrow physics: power, angle and gravity all matter
• Bullseye, Good or Hit: the closer to the center, the higher the score

MANY KINDS OF TARGETS
• Classic archery target boards
• Balloons to pop, one arrow or many
• Targets that move up, down and across
• Flying targets
• Wood and glass walls in the way
• Towers of blocks: break them and knock the target down

50 LEVELS, 5 WORLDS
• Green Valley, Desert Canyon, Autumn Lake, Frozen Castle and Moon Forest
• Each world adds a new idea and ends with a challenge level
• Timed levels for fast archers
• Earn up to 3 stars in each level

APPLE SHOT
• Hit the apple on the training dummy's head, not the dummy

DUCK HUNT
• Shoot the ducks, but not the blue birds

• 20 hunt levels plus an endless hunt

ENDLESS MODE
• New target and hunt levels made for you every time
• 3 lives: how far can you go?
• Choose your difficulty: fewer aim dots make it harder

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Play offline, no Wi-Fi needed
• Left-handed mode
• Short levels for a quick break

If you like archery games, bow and arrow games or target shooting, pick up your bow and become the best archer shooter.

Draw. Aim. Bullseye!

name: Archivia: Document Scanner
description:
Archivia turns your phone into a document archive you can actually search.

Point at a page: the edges are found automatically, the page is straightened and the text becomes searchable. Search "bill" or "IBAN" and the document turns up, even if you never renamed it.

A NAME THAT SAYS WHAT IT IS
Once the text is read, Archivia gives the document a sensible name, like "ID card Mario Rossi" or "Bill Energia Chiara – October 2026". If you rename it yourself, your name stays.

YOUR PERSONAL DOCUMENTS, NEATLY LAID OUT
ID cards, driving licences, passports and health cards get a Details tab: name, tax code, number, issue and expiry dates, each one copyable with a tap and editable by hand. When a document has expired or expires soon, you see it on the thumbnail.

LOYALTY CARDS, ALWAYS READY
Scan your supermarket card: Archivia reads the barcode and redraws it sharp, with the screen at full brightness for the checkout scanner.

ORGANISED WITHOUT EFFORT
- Ready-made folders: personal documents, home, health, car, work, receipts
- Grid or list, pinch to choose how many columns you see
- Pin documents to the top, sort by date or name

SHARE ONLY WHAT'S NEEDED
- PDFs with searchable text, in three sizes (also for attachments with size limits)
- Just some pages, or JPG images
- Print, copy the text, or send to a nearby iPhone by bringing the phones together

TRULY PRIVATE
Scans, text and folders stay on this iPhone. Archivia has no account, doesn't use the internet and collects no data. Lock it with Face ID, and your documents stay hidden in the app switcher.

BACKUP
Export your whole archive as a .zip file with a PDF for each document, in its folders. New phone? Reopen it with "Import from Files".

Archivia speaks English, Italian, French, Spanish and German.

name: ArgueNot: Argument & Debate AI
description:
Who's right? Let the referee decide.

ArgueNot turns everyday arguments into a quick, fair game: two people, one phone and an AI referee.

HOW IT WORKS
• Each of you writes your side in secret, then passes the phone. The other person never sees what you wrote.
• Pick the referee's style: Fair, Harsh or Funny. The style changes the tone, never who wins.
• Tap FIGHT and watch an arcade-style brawl while the referee reads both sides.
• Get the verdict: a winner or "you're both wrong", a score split, the reasons for each side, a middle ground and one line of roast.
• Share the result card to your story.

FAIR FIRST, FUNNY SECOND
The referee judges arguments, not people. It ignores tricks hidden in your text. If something sounds serious or unsafe, it skips the jokes and points you to help instead.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your texts are sent to the AI only to get the verdict and are never saved on the phone.

ARGUENOT PRO
You get 1 free verdict every day. Go PRO to see every verdict in full and keep going after the free ones. Choose a weekly or yearly plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID settings.

For entertainment only.
