name: Ars Memorandi
description:
Ars Memorandi is the memorisation app for Freemasons. Learn your ritual work by heart – your part in the lodge, the chapter or any degree – line by line, at your own pace, on your own phone.

Made by a Freemason for brethren of all obediences. The app contains no ritual texts: you add only the text your own lodge or Grand Lodge allows you to have.

WHAT THE APP DOES
• Your part, clearly marked – Add your ritual as a Word file, a PDF or by pasting. Choose your office and the app highlights your lines and the cue just before them.
• Proven learning methods – First letters, fill in the blanks, recall from memory and review at the right moment, so the words stay with you.
• Cue partner – The app speaks the other officers' lines. You answer.
• Full rehearsal – Walk through the whole ceremony in order. The app waits at your lines.
• Today – Tell the app when the ceremony is. Every day one clear button is ready: a few minutes is enough.
• Progress – See per line how well you know it. Tap a line to practise it right away.

EVERYONE CAN TAKE PART (Ars Participandi)
For brethren for whom an office would otherwise become too much: larger text and more contrast, reading aloud at your own pace, following the whole ritual, a gentle vibration just before your turn, large buttons or one-button control (also with a foot pedal), search, bookmarks and notes, and your text on paper.

PRIVACY AND THE RITUAL
• Your texts and progress stay on your phone. No account, no cloud, no server; nothing is ever sent to us.
• Protect your rituals with a 5-digit code; your texts are then stored encrypted.
• Reminders never mention a ritual.
• For speaking practice the app uses your phone's own speech recognition, which may work online.

34 LANGUAGES
Afrikaans, Čeština, Dansk, Deutsch, Eesti, English, Español, Français, Hrvatski, Íslenska, Italiano, Latviešu, Lietuvių, Magyar, Nederlands, Norsk bokmål, Polski, Português, Română, Slovenčina, Slovenščina, Suomi, Svenska, Türkçe, Ελληνικά, Български, Русский, Српски, Українська, עברית, العربية, 日本語, 繁體中文, 한국어

PRICE
Try the full app free for 7 days. After that you buy it once and it is yours for life. No subscription. 10% of every purchase goes to Masonic charities.

For Entered Apprentices, Fellowcrafts and Master Masons, officers and Past Masters, and for Royal Arch, Mark and Scottish Rite work.

Ars Memorandi is a personal initiative by Joost Walraven (Netherlands) and not an official publication of any lodge or obedience.

Support: https://www.arsmemorandi.com · info@arsmemorandi.com

name: Artlet
description: Every drawing has a story. Artlet brings your creations together in beautiful albums, so you can watch their imagination grow, one masterpiece at a time.

name: artstamps
description:
One artwork a day, printed as a postage stamp.

Every midnight, artstamps brings you a new work from the open collections of public museums: a painting, a print, a drawing or a small object you'd walk straight past in a gallery. Each stamp sits on a wall tinted from its colours, with a sentence or two from the museum about why it matters. When you want more, Read more opens the museum's full notes.

LOOK CLOSELY
Tap the stamp to see it fullscreen. Tilt it under your finger and watch the light catch the paper.

SHUFFLE
Not today's mood? Shuffle for a random artwork from thousands across four collections.

COLLECT
Keep the stamps you love in your album. Collected stamps stay on your iPhone, with their pictures, so they open instantly, even offline.

WIDGETS
Put today's stamp on your Home Screen in three sizes, on your Lock Screen, or in StandBy. The Album widget brings back the stamps you've collected.

THE MUSEUMS
• Art Institute of Chicago
• Cleveland Museum of Art
• SMK – National Gallery of Denmark
• Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam

Every image is in the public domain or free to share, and every stamp credits its museum and links to the full record there. artstamps is an independent project and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by any of these museums.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking and no analytics. The app talks only to the museums and fetches as little as it can. Your album never leaves your phone.

Questions, corrections, or a museum you'd like to see? Write to hi@fffelipe.com.

name: As Batak: Eşli, Tekli, Gömmeli
description:
As Batak, Türkiye'nin en sevilen kart oyunu Batak'ın beş ayrı modunu tek uygulamada toplar. Hepsi çevrimdışı, hepsi ücretsiz.

OYUN MODLARI
• Koz Maça — Maça daima kozdur; herkes bağımsız olarak kaç el alacağını söyler. Klasik başlangıç modu.
• Tekli İhaleli — Açık artırmalı ihale; ihaleyi alan kozu kendi seçer ve kontratı tutturmak zorundadır.
• Gömmeli Batak — 3 oyuncu, 16'şar kart ve yerde 4 kapalı kart. İhaleyi alan koz ilan eder, 4 kart gömer ve yerdekileri alır.
• 3-5-8 — 3 oyuncu, ihale yok: hedefler 8, 5 ve 3 olarak elden ele döner. Tur içinde önceki elin farkına göre kart alışverişi yapılır.
• Eşli İhaleli — 4 oyuncu, 2 takım. İhaleyi alanın ortağı elini herkese açar (yer) ve o eli ihaleci oynar; "çiz" deyip hepsini alırsan partiyi anında kazanırsın.

FARKI NE?
Rakiplerin ezber senaryolara göre oynayan sıradan botlar değil. HER MOD İÇİN AYRI eğitilmiş, kendi kendine oynayarak (self-play) öğrenmiş yapay zeka botları. Çıkan kartları ve kimin hangi renkte kartı kalmadığını takip eder, elin son kartlarında hesap yaparlar. Hamleleri öngörülemez: aynı durumda bazen farklı, ama hep mantıklı oynarlar. İnsan zekâsına yakın, ezberlenemez bir rakip deneyimi hedefliyoruz. Yapay zeka botlarımız gelişmeye devam ediyor: her yeni eğitimde daha güçlü.

MASANI KENDİN SEÇ
• Kart yüzü: sade ya da klasik resimli Papaz, Kız ve Vale.
• Kart arkası: Maça, Kafes ya da Madalyon deseni.
• Masa rengi: yeşil, bordo ya da lacivert çuha.
• 15 avatar: kendine ve botlara avatar seç; istersen masada avatarsız oyna.
• Oyuncu ve bot isimlerini özelleştir.

ORTAK KURALLAR
• Renk takip etme zorunluluğu ve koz kuralları her modda geçerlidir.
• El sonunda söylediğini tutturana puan, batana ceza.
• Parti uzunluğunu ayarlardan seçersin: el sayısı ya da hedef puan (mod başına ayrı ayarlanır).

ÖZELLİKLER
• Tamamen çevrimdışı — internet gerekmez, her yerde oynanır.
• Beş mod, mod başına ayrı eğitilmiş yapay zeka rakipler.
• Zorluk ayarı: Kolay / Normal / Zor — az, orta ve tam eğitilmiş yapay zeka botları.
• Oyun hızı: beklemek istemeyenler için 2x ve 3x.
• El el skor tablosu ve mod başına kişisel istatistikler.
• "Nasıl Oynanır" ekranında her modun kuralları.
• Ses efektleri arka planda dinlediğin müziği kesmez; telefon sessizdeyken susar.
• Ücretsiz; reklam ve uygulama içi satın alım yok.

Keyifli oyunlar! Geri bildirimlerin oyunu ve botları daha da iyi yapıyor.

name: AskMike: Car History
description:
**Your car's history. All in one place.**

Meet AskMike: Car History - the simple way to keep track of your vehicles, MOTs, servicing and important documents.

No more searching through paperwork or trying to remember when your next MOT is due. Keep everything organised in one convenient app.

**EVERYTHING YOUR CAR NEEDS**

**MOT Tracking & Reminders**
View your vehicle's MOT information and stay ahead of important dates with helpful reminders.

**Your Car's History**
Build a digital record of your vehicle's maintenance, servicing and repairs. Keep useful information together for future reference.

**Documents & Receipts**
Store service records, MOT documents, invoices and receipts in organised folders, ready whenever you need them.

**Manage Multiple Vehicles**
Keep track of more than one car from a single account. Switch between vehicles and view their individual histories.

**Garage Bookings**
Find participating garages, request appointments and keep your vehicle connected to its servicing history.

**Car Wash Loyalty**
Collect loyalty rewards at participating car washes and track your progress towards free washes.

**MADE FOR UK DRIVERS**

Whether you drive one car or manage several, AskMike helps you stay organised and keep on top of vehicle maintenance.

Download AskMike and start building your car's history today.

name: Audioguide Ilmtal
description:
Unser Audioguide nimmt dich mit auf eine abwechslungsreiche Entdeckungstour durch die beiden Städte Bad Berka und Blankenhain sowie den idyllischen Dammbachsgrund mitten im wunderschönen Weimarer Land! Auf dem 17 Kilometer langen Rundwanderweg erlebst du Geschichte, Kultur und Natur auf unterhaltsame Weise – in deinem eigenen Tempo und mit spannenden Storys direkt auf den Ohren. 
Was hat der deutsche Fußball mit Blankenhain zu tun? Wie hätte ein Gewitter beinahe das Waldbad ruiniert? Und welche Spuren hat Goethe in Bad Berka hinterlassen?
Hier erfährst du es! Kopfhörer auf und los – das Ilmtal hat viel zu erzählen!

name: AVANT CAMERA
description:
Cinema in Your Pocket.

AVANT CAMERA is a cinematic video camera for iPhone, built around one simple idea: beautiful color should begin the moment you press record.

Powered by the AVANT color engine, the app brings expressive, film-inspired color to your footage in real time. Shape your visual style, fine-tune your look, and capture everyday moments with a cinematic feel.

FEATURES

• Real-Time Cinematic Color
Preview AVANT color while you shoot, and switch the look on or off instantly.

• Creative Color Control
Fine-tune your image with AVANT's color controls and Grade Code system.

• Apple Log & SDR
Shoot with Apple Log on compatible devices, or use standard SDR capture.

• Professional Video Recording
Capture in 24 or 30 fps, with FHD and 4K options depending on device capabilities.

• Exposure & White Balance Control
Adjust your camera settings and lock exposure and white balance during recording.

• Video Stabilization
Choose stabilization options to suit your shooting style and device performance.

TRY AVANT CAMERA FOR FREE

Save your first three videos for free. Unlock unlimited video saves with a one-time purchase of AVANT Pro.

No subscription. Just your camera, your color, and your vision.

AVANT CAMERA — Cinema in Your Pocket.

name: Avelsta: Sail Analytics
description:
Avelsta analyses your sailing and helps you sail faster.

RECORD YOUR SAILS
Start a recording before you cast off: the phone's GPS tracks your course, screen off, even without network. Back ashore, the sail becomes a session with the wind estimated from weather models.

IMPORT YOUR NKE LOGS
Drop the files of your NKE system (Box WiFi, Processor HR): Avelsta splits your outings into sessions automatically and computes speeds, angles, distances and manoeuvres.

MEASURE YOUR POLAR %
Compare your speed with your boat's polar, point by point. Build your own polar from your sails, or start from more than 500 reference polars.

WEATHER ROUTING
Compute the fastest route with your boat's polar and several forecast models (ECMWF, AROME, ICON…), taking coastlines and depths into account.

SAIL AS A GROUP
Create a group for your club, crew or fleet: follow the boats live on the map, replay the race together and share your sessions with your coach.

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Discover Avelsta with a sample sail or your own logs, with no account. Sign in with Apple or Google.

name: AVEM
AvtoBrend
description:
AvtoBrend is a car classifieds marketplace for Azerbaijan. Browse new and used cars, compare prices and contact sellers directly.

• Listings: cars, motorcycles, trucks, buses and special vehicles
• Search by make, model, year, price, mileage and fuel type
• Real photos, detailed specs, market price indicator
• Call or message the seller on WhatsApp in one tap
• Post a listing for free — add photos straight from your phone
• Favourites — save the cars you like
• Notifications when a price drops or your listing is about to expire
• Every new listing is checked by a moderator; suspicious listings can be reported

Accounts are shared with the avtobrend.com website. Available in Azerbaijani and Russian.

name: BalancedTerritoryDesigner
description: Balanced Territory Designer helps service teams divide prepared geographic units into capacity-aware territories. Review demand, net service capacity and adjacency, compare candidate allocations, and preview boundary changes before applying them. Freeze a handoff with traceable assignments, then use follow-up observations to create the next revision.

name: BangBangBeam-cyberpunk-
description:
「Bang Bang Beam（バンバンビーム）」は、懐かしい手遊び「ため・ビーム・バリア」をサイバーパンクの世界観と3拍子のリズムアクションに進化させた、
1対1のハイスピード心理戦バトルゲームです！
　※地域によって「パンパンビーム」「CCレモン」「千溜め」「寿司じゃんけん」「ウルトラマンゲーム」などと呼称される手遊びです。

【基本ルールはシンプル＆奥深い！】
「バン！・バン！・アクション！」の3拍子のリズムに合わせ、中央の時間バーが消えきる前に3つのコマンドから出す手を予約しよう！
・CHARGE（チャージ）：バッテリーを1つ溜める（無防備になるため相手のビームに注意！）
・BEAM（ビーム）：チャージを1つ消費して攻撃！相手がチャージ中なら1ダメージ！
・BARRIER（バリア）：相手の通常ビームを完全に防ぐ！
・ULTIMATE（必殺技）：チャージを4つ満タンまで溜めると黄金の必殺技ボタンが解放！バリアも残り体力も貫通して一撃勝利！

【KUMITE（組手）サバイバル＆世界ランキング】
次々と現れる個性豊かな10人のサイバーファイターたちと連戦する「KUMITE」モードを搭載！
バトルのテンポは「標準」「高速」「超高速」の3段階から選択可能。Game Center対応の世界ランキングで全国のプレイヤーと最高連勝記録を競い合おう！

【ポイント交換＆戦略アイテムシステム】
バトルに勝利するたびに「1ポイント」を獲得！集めたポイントは、初期体力を増やす「ハート」、1ターン目からビームが撃てる「電池」、必殺技すら一度防ぐ「防弾チョッキ」、バトル中に使える「回復薬」「エナジードリンク」など多彩なアイテムと交換可能！

【80種類以上のコレクションアイコン】
連勝記録やキャラクター撃破などの条件を達成して、全80種類以上のプレイヤーアイコンをアンロックしよう！

name: Bark Diary: Dog Bark Monitor
description:
Leave an old phone at home near your dog. It listens, and your own phone shows when your dog barked, howled or whined, for how long and how loud.

- A diary of the day and a 24-hour bar, so you can see if it was one bark at the mailman or an hour after you left
- An alert when the barking goes on
- Mute alerts for an hour when you know why
- If the phone at home stops listening, you get told
- The "I'm leaving home" button marks when you were out

With Bark Diary Plus:
- Hear what is going on: ask for a 10-30 second recording (the phone at home plays a tone first)
- Record a message in your voice, or let a calming sound play when barking starts
- "I'm leaving home" switches on by itself when you leave, and off when you're back
- Your own alert rules (how long, how loud, only while you're out)
- Family members follow the same diary
- 48 hours of history and bark sounds

Plus is $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year, with the first week free. One subscription covers the whole household's diary. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; you can manage or cancel it in your Apple account settings.

Sound is analysed on the phone at home. Nothing is recorded or sent unless you ask for it.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://barkdiary-trial.bekirgoxel.workers.dev/privacy

name: Barquecon Pulse
description:
Barquecon Pulse is the mobile app for the Barquecon industrial IoT platform: one app for every Barquecon industry. It is a business app for organisations that monitor their equipment with Barquecon. Sign in with the account your administrator or Barquecon created for you to see your sites, devices, live readings and alerts.

What you can do
- See every industry your organisation runs on Barquecon as an illustrated tile on the Industries tab, with its devices and open alerts. The app knows 29 industries, among them cold chain, manufacturing, fleet, solar, worker safety, agriculture, water, HVAC, air quality and fire systems. An organisation with one industry opens straight on it.
- Open an industry as an illustrated scene of its site. Every device is a pin that moves with its live reading and shows its status.
- Open a device: an animated illustration at the top (tanks fill, fans and pumps turn, needles move with the readings), every reading with its unit, a history chart and the device's alerts.
- Industry views: a line board for manufacturing (OEE per line, line state, an andon board of open alerts), routes for fleets (each vehicle's recent track, geofence, harsh braking and overspeed alerts), workers for safety (a man-down banner, a card per worker tag), soil zones for agriculture (soil moisture, the irrigation valve), a heatmap for solar (power per inverter, the current of each string) and excursions for cold chain.
- Acknowledge alerts from the alerts inbox, if your role allows it (a read-only viewer seat cannot).
- Keep working on a weak connection: the last data received stays on the phone under an "Offline" banner that says how old it is, and an acknowledgement made offline is sent when the platform can be reached again.
- Add a device (owners and administrators): scan the QR code on a Barquecon device's label, or type its serial number and setup code, name it, pick a site and set its Wi-Fi. You can also change a device's Wi-Fi, remove a device, and delete your account from the Account tab.
- Cold-chain monitoring kit: devices are judged against the kit's 2 to 8 °C limits, and an Excursions screen for the last 6 hours shows time above 8 °C, degree-minutes, the peak temperature and door openings.

Device status comes from the alerts your organisation's Barquecon platform raises; the app does not invent limits of its own. Animations follow your phone's reduce-motion setting.

Who it is for
Business users. There is no sign-up in the app: accounts are created by Barquecon or by your organisation's administrator. Without an account the app shows only the sign-in screen.

Good to know
- No in-app purchases and no ads. Alerts appear inside the app; this version sends no phone notifications.
- Adding a device needs the owner or administrator role and a Barquecon device with its label. Wi-Fi is set over the device's own setup network, not Bluetooth.
- Barquecon's own sensor hardware is at the pilot stage and not certified yet. LoRaWAN sensor onboarding is not available in this version.
- Signing out removes the data kept on the phone, including acknowledgements not yet sent.

Privacy
To sign you in, the app sends your work e-mail and password to the Barquecon platform; it also sends your acknowledgements. No advertising or analytics SDK. The illustrations are built into the app; nothing is loaded from other sites. The camera only reads a device's label QR code, and local network access (iPhone) and location are used only to join that device's setup network; the app never reads or sends your location. The Wi-Fi password you type goes to your own device, not to Barquecon. A LoRaWAN sensor form is in the app but not available in this version; if used, the sensor's DevEUI, JoinEUI, AppKey, name and site would go to the Barquecon platform. On Android, Google's code scanner (ML Kit) reads the QR code on the phone and sends diagnostics to Google. Privacy policy: https://platform-iot.barquecontech.com/legal/privacy

name: BEAT SWEEP: Rhythm Puzzle
description:
Move, rotate and drop two-tone 2×2 blocks. Build a 2×2 square of one kind and the scan line sweeps it away in time with the music.

Clear four or more squares in one sweep to start a streak that climbs ×2, ×3, ×4. A square carrying a gem drags every connected matching block with it. Every move and every clear plays a note on the song's scale, so tidying the board becomes part of the music.

DAILY SET
One song and one board a day, the same for everyone. Share your run as a spoiler-free line and a card.

DIFFICULTY AND STARS
Gentle, Standard, Hard and Expert. Earn a star for finishing, for a ×2 streak and for a ×4 streak on every track. Finish any track on Hard to open Expert.

LEARN BY PLAYING
No manual. Your first run shows one line under the board with the next thing to try.

YOUR MUSIC, YOUR STAGE
Pick a mood and energy and make a track in one tap, or bring your own audio and build a stage around it.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
A stripe pattern that tells the two block kinds apart, reduced motion, left-handed layout, and game controller and keyboard support. When the phone runs hot, the board draws lighter so play stays smooth.

name: BIM Atlas
description:
BIM Atlas pone el modelo de tu obra sobre el mapa real, en sus coordenadas, junto a las fotos, las incidencias y los planos. Es la misma plataforma que usa tu equipo en el ordenador, preparada para el teléfono y la tableta, para llevarla a pie de obra.

EN LA OBRA
• Haz fotos y fotos 360 que quedan situadas en el mapa, con la dirección hacia la que apuntaba el teléfono.
• Apunta incidencias, ensayos y notas en el sitio exacto donde están.
• Sigue el estado de cada marcador: pendiente, en curso o resuelto.

EL MODELO EN SU SITIO
• Modelos IFC y de Revit colocados con sus coordenadas ETRS89/UTM sobre el mapa, la ortofoto y el terreno.
• Recorre el edificio planta a planta, haz cortes y míralo como lo vería una persona desde la calle.
• Consulta las propiedades de cada elemento.
• Planos georreferenciados, superpuestos al modelo.

TRABAJO EN EQUIPO
• Invita a quien trabaja contigo, a toda la cuenta o a una obra concreta, y decide qué puede hacer: sólo mirar, trabajar en la obra o coordinarla.
• Lo que se apunta en obra lo ve al momento la oficina, y vuelve a Revit con el complemento de BIM Atlas.

PARA QUIÉN
Ingeniería civil, edificación, topografía, dirección de obra y propiedad.

Necesitas una cuenta de BIM Atlas. Puedes crearla gratis desde la app.

name: BIRD HUNTER: Sky Challenge
description:
Take aim with BIRD HUNTER!

Drag anywhere on the screen to aim, then release to fire. Enjoy colorful 2D arcade action with simple controls and 100 rounds to conquer.

AIM, RELEASE, FIRE
Track birds across the sky, time your shots, and reload carefully. Build combos with consecutive hits and challenge fast bonus birds.

UPGRADE YOUR GEAR
Earn points as you play and improve your gun’s reload speed. Discover permanent equipment upgrades and useful consumable items in the shop.

MAKE EVERY SECOND COUNT
Use extra reloads, quick reloads, additional time, and freeze-time items to help you through challenging rounds.

REACH THE HALL OF FAME
Clear all 100 rounds and join hunters from Korea and the United States in the shared Hall of Fame.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Switch between Korean and English. Turn music, sound effects, and vibration on or off individually.

Free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases include permanent equipment upgrades and consumable items.

name: Blessed: Learn Catholic Faith
description:
Blessed teaches the Catholic faith step by step, in short daily lessons. Every lesson cites the Catechism of the Catholic Church by paragraph number, quotes the Bible, and ends with three questions that explain each answer.

Blessed is for anyone who wants to learn: the curious, adults preparing for Baptism or becoming Catholic (OCIA, formerly RCIA), Catholics coming home after years away, parents teaching their children, and parish catechists running a class.

WHAT YOU CAN LEARN
• Start Here: the whole faith in twelve lessons (free)
• The Apostles' Creed, line by line (free)
• A catechism for children ages 7 to 11, in 24 weekly lessons (free)
• Preparing for Baptism, for adults, parents and godparents (free)
• Becoming Catholic: an OCIA companion, and coming home after time away (free)
• The Seven Sacraments and The Mass, Explained
• The Ten Commandments, and Grace, Virtue and Sin
• Mary and the Saints, and Death, Judgment, Heaven and Hell
• Learning to Pray, The Bible the Catholic Way, and Church History
• Answers to Hard Questions: purgatory, the Pope, Mary, confession and more
• Catholic Social Teaching

READ THE BIBLE
The whole Catholic Bible, all 73 books, in modern English and in Catholic order, with search and a place-keeper. Free for everyone.

PRAY EVERY DAY
• A Prayer Book with 93 prayers: the essential prayers, prayers at Mass, Marian prayers, litanies, hymns, the Stations of the Cross and prayers for every need. Free for everyone, always.
• A guided Rosary, bead by bead, with Scripture, a meditation and sacred art for each of the twenty mysteries.
• Today: the day in the Church's calendar, its liturgical color, the Mass readings for Sundays and holy days, a prayer, and a review question.

JOIN THE CLASS
Every lesson can be taken as a catechism class led by Gabriel: an opening prayer, the teaching in short parts with "pause and think" questions, the Word of God, a reflection for your notes, the quiz, and a closing prayer. Finish a course and receive a certificate of completion for your own study.

A GUIDE BESIDE YOU
Gabriel, your guide in the app, offers a short word and a Bible verse each day, encouragement after each lesson, and a blessing when you finish a course. Every word is written ahead of time. Blessed has no AI chatbot.

ASK A QUESTION
Type a question such as "Why confess to a priest?" and Blessed answers with its own lessons, showing the Catechism paragraphs and Bible references for each answer.

FOR PARISHES AND FAMILIES
Lessons in the class courses come with leader notes for a one-hour class: a goal, an opener, discussion questions, an activity and a closing prayer. Present mode shows any lesson in large text on an iPad or a TV.

GUIDED LEARNING
• Find your way: answer a few questions and Gabriel suggests a learning path for where you are, from curious to becoming Catholic to coming home. Your next lesson waits for you each day.
• Practical guides: how to go to Confession, an Examination of Conscience, your first Mass, praying the Rosary, reading the Bible, and becoming Catholic. Each one ends with a next step.

YOUR PROGRESS
Mark each lesson done with one tap, see your progress course by course, and show only the courses you haven't finished. Progress is kept on your device.

HONEST AND PRIVATE
• Every course is open for your first fourteen days. After that, one payment unlocks every course for good. No subscription, and nothing is charged when the fourteen days end.
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Everything works offline.
• Bible verses are from the Douay-Rheims Bible and the World English Bible, both in the public domain.
• Sacred art is public domain, credited in the app.

Blessed is an independent app by Aquarius Mobile Studios. It is not an official publication of the Catholic Church, the Vatican or any diocese, and it is not endorsed by them. It teaches what the Church teaches and points you to your parish and your priest for the sacraments.

Questions or ideas: Support@meetamsai.com

name: BLIND WAR
description:
계급은 숨겨졌다. 승부는 시작됐다.

저 나무 가림막 속 병정은 지휘관일까요, 이등병일까요?
BLIND WAR는 상대 병력의 계급을 모르는 상태에서 한 수씩 겨루는 턴제 전략 보드게임입니다. 상대의 계급은 전투에서 공개되고, 대결이 끝나면 다시 가려집니다. 기억과 추론이 다음 수의 무기가 됩니다.

[높은 계급이 전부는 아닙니다]
이등병은 별 수와 관계없이 지휘관을 이깁니다. 상병은 대령을 잡고, 중사는 정면 두 칸 저격으로 중위를 노립니다. 예외 상성을 기억하고 병력을 움직이세요.

[지형이 길을 바꿉니다]
중앙 하천을 우회하고, 산으로 저격 사선을 막고, 준위로 지형을 드나드세요. 상대 진영 전체가 더 이상 이동하거나 공격할 수 없다면 포위 승리입니다.

[배치부터 시작되는 전략]
12계급, 진영당 14명. 내 진영 끝 두 줄 안에서 병력을 직접 배치하거나 빠른 고정 배치로 시작할 수 있습니다. 산·하천·숲이 놓인 11×13 보드에서 컴퓨터와 대결합니다.

[손안의 나무 전장]
나무 가림막과 계급 명판, 전투 공개 연출, 평상시·전투 BGM, 효과음과 햅틱을 담았습니다. 소리와 진동은 각각 켜거나 끌 수 있습니다.

현재 버전은 컴퓨터와의 1:1 대전과 맵 1종을 제공합니다. 온라인 대전은 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

name: Blink: Dating & Crossed Paths
description:
Blink is a dating app for real-life moments.

You pass hundreds of people every day: in a café, on the tram, at a concert. Blink shows you the ones whose path crossed yours, so you can match with someone you were already close to.

CROSSED PATHS
• See people who were in the same area around the same time as you.
• Each crossing shows whether it was the same moment, the same day or the same place.
• Your location is reduced to an area of about 150 m and a one-hour slot on your phone. Exact coordinates never leave your device.

MATCH AND CHAT
• Like, pass or send a Super Like.
• When you both like each other, it's a match and you can start chatting.

EVENTS
• Find small, public plans nearby, like a coffee, a run or a museum afternoon, and ask to join.
• Host your own plan and choose who joins.

SAFETY AND PRIVACY
• Block, report or unmatch anyone at any time.
• Reports are reviewed by our moderators.
• Turn location off, delete your location history or delete your account whenever you want, right in the app.
• No ads and no third-party tracking.

Blink is for adults aged 18 and over.

Blink is made by Kivo Studios in the Netherlands.
Privacy: https://blinkdate.app/privacy
Terms: https://blinkdate.app/legal/terms/
Support: support@blinkdate.app

name: Bodyci Learning
description:
**Welcome to Bodyci Learning!**

Exercise your mind, challenge your math skills, and make learning an adventure!

Bodyci Learning combines interactive educational games with optional heart-rate-aware gameplay assistance, creating a learning experience that responds to you.

**PLAY MATH DUEL**

Put your arithmetic skills to the test in Math Duel, a colorful mathematics card game featuring friendly characters and interactive challenges.

Choose your difficulty, solve equations using number cards, and compete against Bun Bun in exciting math battles.

Whether you're practicing the basics or taking on harder problems, Math Duel makes mental exercise fun and engaging.

**MEET YOUR BODYCI COMPANION**

Your friendly Bodyci robot companion is here to lend a helping hand!

During gameplay, Bodyci can provide assistance with math problems, helping you continue your learning adventure.

**OPTIONAL APPLE WATCH INTEGRATION**

Bodyci Learning supports optional Apple Watch heart-rate monitoring through Apple Health.

With your permission, live heart-rate readings can be used to trigger automatic assistance during gameplay when configured conditions are met.

Bodyci can help with a math problem while you continue playing, creating an interactive learning experience that responds to heart-rate information.

Apple Watch monitoring is completely optional. You can enjoy Math Duel without an Apple Watch.

**FEATURES**

- Interactive mathematics card battles
- Multiple difficulty levels
- Friendly animated characters
- Optional Apple Watch heart-rate monitoring
- Heart-rate-aware gameplay assistance
- Learning progress tracking
- No account required to play
- No advertisements or third-party tracking

**LEARNING THROUGH PLAY**

Bodyci Learning brings together mental exercise, interactive challenges, and technology to make practicing mathematics enjoyable for learners of different ages.

**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**

Bodyci Learning is an educational entertainment application, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, measure, prevent, or treat stress, frustration, or medical conditions.

Heart-rate monitoring is optional and requires a compatible Apple Watch and appropriate permissions.

name: Bools
description:
bool is the fastest way to go from free to hanging out.

Flip the switch when you're free. Your friends see you're down to bool, and anyone can Knock to hang out. Say yes and you're booling: talk it out, pick a spot, and go.

No group chats. No "wyd." Just who's free right now.

FLIP TO BOOL
• One switch: busy or bool. It flips back on its own when your time's up.
• Flip it from your Lock Screen, a Home Screen widget, or Control Center without opening the app.
• Turn on Do Not Disturb and bool sets you to busy for you.

KNOCK
• See which friends are down to bool, all in one row you can flick through.
• Knock a friend, or a whole group at once, to hang out.
• Hold to send your voice with your Knock.
• A white ring means they have bool open right now.

BOOLING
• Once someone says yes, you're booling together.
• Hold to talk, walkie-talkie style. Voices can play out loud even on your Lock Screen.
• Slide into a live call when you'd rather just talk.
• Anyone in your group can jump straight into the group's bool.

THE MAP
• See where friends are, only if they choose to share.
• Share your exact spot, a rough area, or nothing, friend by friend.
• Tap a friend's pin to get their freshest location.

GROUPS
• Save your people as a group, give it a photo, and Knock everyone at once.

MADE FOR YOUR REAL FRIENDS
• Find friends from your contacts. Numbers are scrambled on your phone before they're checked.
• Block or report anyone in a tap.
• No ads. We never sell your data.

Not ready to sign up? Tap Try the demo to look around with made-up friends.

bool is for people 18 and older.

name: Boringware Email
description:
Email is a Gmail client in the spirit of Sparrow: one fast, focused window
for your mail on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Your mail lives in a local SQLite
database, so the inbox opens instantly and full-text search answers in
25 milliseconds. Archive, star, label, delete: each action commits locally
the same frame you trigger it, then replays to Gmail through a durable queue.

A unified inbox across all your Gmail accounts, color-coded customizable
swipes, an inline reply bar on every conversation, and a people panel with
past threads and contact details. Gatekeeper lists every address that
writes to you and lets you allow or block them, one at a time or every
sender a filter matches. No analytics and no mail routed
through our servers.

name: BOX CLOCK: WOD Timer
description:
BOX CLOCK is an interval timer built for functional fitness and interval training. Four formats, AMRAP, EMOM, TABATA and FOR TIME, with a boxing bell for every segment, so you can see and hear it from across the gym.

• FOR TIME: counts up from 00:00. Tap Done when you finish and that time is your score. You can set a time cap.
• AMRAP: counts down a fixed time. Get as many rounds or reps as possible before it ends.
• EMOM: do the set reps at the start of each interval. Whatever time is left is your rest.
• TABATA: defaults to the classic 20 seconds of work and 10 seconds of rest × 8 rounds, switching and cueing for you.
• Bells play even in silent mode. Your music keeps playing and is only lowered briefly for each cue.
• Choose when to vibrate: workout starts, each round starts, rest begins, 10 seconds left, final countdown, workout ends.
• The screen stays on during the countdown and the workout. Before you start, it checks media volume, Low Power Mode and battery and warns you about anything that could get in the way.
• Switching apps or locking the screen pauses the timer. If the app is closed, crashes or the phone shuts down, it reopens at the last pause point. Tap Resume to carry on.
• Combine your result with a photo, or copy the result as text to share.
• Available in Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and English, switchable inside the app.

No network, no account, no ads and no tracking. Settings and workout progress stay on your iPhone. Photos are combined on your iPhone and only leave the app when you tap Save or Share.

name: Breezy Triangle
description: A friendly wind-triangle helper for sailors and learners. Solve apparent or true wind, compare setups, play with the triangle in Lab, and pick up the basics—built for learning and planning, not for navigation.

name: Brick Pocket
description:
Pick it up, flip the power switch and hear the beep.

Brick Pocket brings back the pocket LCD console everyone had in the '90s: a 10×20 dot-matrix screen, seven-segment score counters, big round buttons and a beeper that plays the soundtrack of your childhood.

Four classics on one handheld:
• A – Falling Blocks: rotate, slide and drop pieces to clear full rows.
• B – Road Rush: dodge the oncoming cars, hold ROTATE for turbo.
• C – Snake: eat, grow and squeeze through new mazes.
• D – Brick Breaker: bounce the ball and smash every brick.

Just like the original
• Set SPEED and LEVEL before every game, from a gentle start to "how is that even possible"
• Unlit pixels faintly visible on the LCD, hi-score on every game
• Square-wave beeper sounds and pause cup icon
• Six handheld colors to choose from
• One-thumb friendly, works offline, no ads, no accounts

name: BrickLedger
description:
BrickLedger is a quiet workbench for the side of the hobby nobody photographs: the loose bricks in the drawer, the pieces that went missing the last time you moved, the set you half finished two winters ago.

Open a set and it lays out the full inventory — every brick, plate and tile with its colour, its quantity, and the spare parts that came in the box. Tick off what you already have and the running shortfall stays in front of you; when you are done, BrickLedger hands you a tidy list you can send to a parts dealer or keep for the next order.

Between builds it does the quieter jobs: a catalogue you can search by number, name, category and colour, the sets each part appears in, and a shelf that remembers what you own so you know before you start whether the bricks are already there.

Made for one hand, a workbench, and the box lying open beside you.

name: BumpRail: Counter Tickets
description:
BumpRail is the front-counter ticket rail for a lunch window. The large stub is the order you are calling. Tap Bump and that ticket leaves; the next number moves up immediately.

The Window tab keeps how many tickets you bumped this shift and shows the number now at the front. More holds the privacy link and a support email. Tickets stay on the phone.

First launch loads a lunch rail, 104 Chile verde through 111 Agua fresca, so the window is ready before the rush. Offline. No account.

name: By1 Courier: Deliveries
description:
By1 Kurye is for approved By1 couriers. Signing in requires a courier application approved through our website.

• Go online and receive nearby delivery offers
• Accept or decline with a timed offer screen
• Arrive, pick up and deliver step by step
• One-tap directions and customer calling
• Amount to collect and cash tracking
• Daily, weekly and monthly earnings and payout history
• Profile, vehicle and bank details

Location is used only while you are online and during deliveries. Using location in the background can increase battery use.

name: By1 Food & Groceries
description:
Order from restaurants and markets with By1 Yemek and By1 Market.

• Restaurants and markets in one app
• Offers and coupons
• Product options and order notes
• Follow every step of your order, and the courier live on the map
• Pay on delivery in cash or by card; the app never asks for card details
• Favourites, saved addresses and reviews
• Light and dark themes; Türkçe, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, العربية

Available service areas are shown in the app; more areas are coming.

We respect your privacy: no ads, no tracking. Your phone number is visible only to the business preparing your order and the courier delivering it.

name: By1 Partner: Business
description:
By1 Partner is for restaurants and markets working with By1. Signing in requires a business account invited by By1.

For businesses
• Instant notifications for new orders
• Order board: new, preparing, waiting for courier, on the way
• Menu, photo, option and stock management
• Opening hours, minimum basket and delivery fee
• Daily revenue, order history and reviews

The same panel works on the web: panel.by1market.com

name: Bynzor
description:
Bynzor is an on-device record-and-compare desk for U.S. renters and move coordinators tracking a building’s Certificate of Insurance (COI) requirements before move day—no account, no cloud sync.

Bynzor is not an insurer, broker, or law firm. It does not underwrite coverage, sell insurance, or decide whether a COI is valid. The building manager decides acceptance. You use Bynzor to keep your own field notes and comparison marks on this iPhone.

How it works:

1. Req Card — Copy Certificate Holder, Additional Insured, liability limits, submit-to email, and deadline from the building packet into one checklist.

2. COI Check — Import the mover’s COI PDF or photo. Mark each field Match, Missing, or Wrong legal name for your own comparison, then copy a short “fix these lines” reply draft.

3. Returns — Log every rejection with reason and version. See how many revision rounds remain before move day.

4. Pass Proof — When management tells you the COI was accepted, archive that note and export a one-page personal record for the moving crew.

Built for co-ops and high-rises as a personal desk—not a property portal, and not legal or insurance advice. Everything stays on your iPhone.

name: Caebing - Cabin Wardrobe Play
description:
Caebing is a cozy leisure app built around a single forest home. A quiet forest cabin where dressing up and decorating share one scene. Style a forest character and arrange the cabin on the same stage, so every outfit appears inside the room you are furnishing. There is no account to create and no cloud profile to manage. Your layouts, looks, and unlocks stay on this device.

Most dress-up apps keep outfits on a blank stage, and most home apps keep rooms separate from style play. Caebing joins both in one cabin view. Change a sweater, then drag a chair beside the window. Save a picnic look, then rotate a lantern on the shelf. Character and furniture share one forest nest, so styling and decorating feel like one ritual instead of two modes.

Open the Cabin tab to build your forest nest. Browse furniture by seat, table, decor, and rug, then place pieces into the room. Drag items to fine-tune position, rotate a selected piece, bring it forward, or remove it when the layout no longer fits. Rugs settle underfoot while other pieces layer above the character, keeping a clear cabin floor plan. When the arrangement feels right, save the layout on this device and reopen it later without starting over.

Switch to Dress-Up to mix tops, bottoms, dresses, full sets, shoes, and accessories. Slot-aware styling keeps combinations tidy: choosing a dress or a full set clears conflicting tops and bottoms so the look stays coherent. Preview every change on the cabin stage in real time. Name and save multiple outfits, then cycle through them when you want a fresh mood for the same room. Forest-day shirts, campfire vests, berry picnic skirts, maple sweaters, soft boots, hats, and themed sets offer seasonal variety without leaving the cabin.

Extras gathers furniture and attire in one collection grid. Filter by furniture or attire, open a piece for a closer look, and see what is already unlocked versus what still waits in the catalog. The vault maps your progress so you know what you own and what you can still bring into the nest.

Calm controls and local care

A collapsible bottom shelf keeps tools close without crowding the cabin. Category chips, soft tab transitions, and short feedback keep browsing light. Mood opens Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, About Us, clear local cache, and reset cabin layout whenever you need to tidy this device. Everything you create stays local. There is no forced upload and no social feed.

Caebing is for anyone who wants slow creative play: arranging a soft chair by a warm rug, pairing a picnic skirt with trail boots, saving a named look, then returning tomorrow to rotate a lamp and try another combination. It is dress-up and cabin decorating in one forest home, built for unhurried evenings rather than competitive goals.

Open Caebing, step into your forest cabin, and shape a quiet place that feels like yours.
