name: Caffade
description:
How much of today's coffee might still be in your system?

Log when you had a coffee. Caffade estimates how many milligrams of caffeine remain now and adds up the estimates from each cup.

• See the past 16 hours and the next 8 hours on a dotted timeline.
• Tap a record to change the time, or delete it when you no longer need it.
• Use the app without an account. Records are stored on your iPhone.

The estimate assumes 95 mg of caffeine per cup and a five-hour half-life. Actual caffeine content and metabolism vary. The app does not measure caffeine in your blood.

name: Captionsly
description:
Say it. Caption it.

Captionsly turns spoken words into editable captions for your portrait videos. Import a clip, choose the spoken language, and make the captions your own. From a get-ready-with-me routine to a quick tutorial, keep your words easy to follow.

CAPTION ON YOUR DEVICE
Generate captions with Apple's on-device speech recognition. Choose an interval of up to 60 seconds, including a section from a longer video. Available languages depend on your device and Apple's supported language models.

REFINE EVERY WORD
Edit the transcript and fine-tune caption timing. Split or merge captions, switch between short and phrase captions, and follow your clip with the waveform timeline and caption list.

MAKE IT YOURS
Start with a style preset, then adjust the font, size, color, background and position. Highlight each spoken word or reveal words as they are spoken. Preview your captions before exporting.

READY TO SHARE
Export a captioned MP4 to Photos or share it through your favorite apps. Export keeps the video's full duration, and your original file stays unchanged.

KEEP YOUR PROJECTS CLOSE
Projects save automatically on your device so you can return to them later. Restore projects from Trash for up to 30 days. Video, audio and caption processing takes place on your device; your projects are not uploaded to an account or synced between devices.

BEFORE YOU START
Captionsly supports portrait videos on iPhone and iPad running iOS/iPadOS 26 or later. Sign in with Apple or Google to use the app. An internet connection is needed for sign-in and may be needed for the initial speech-model download. Recognition requires a supported device and language.

All features are included, with no in-app purchases or subscriptions.

name: Cardigami: Pop-Up Cards
description:
Cardigami turns the fold of your phone into a pop-up greeting card.

Pick a card. Write a few words. Close the phone and hand it over. On the cover screen they see a sealed envelope with their name - and the moment they open the phone, paper rises out of the fold: a three-tier birthday cake with flickering candles, a Christmas tree in falling snow, one big crimson heart, a velvet ring box that opens with the hinge.

Every scene is real paper engineering, rendered live: V-folds that lean as the card closes, platforms that lift, cut-outs that cast soft shadows on the page. Tilt the phone and the scene shifts with real depth. Open slowly and watch it build.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• The hinge is the control. The card follows every degree of the fold.
• A sealed envelope on the cover display while the phone is closed.
• Split layout when open: your card on one page, your words on the other.
• On other iPhones, drag to open the card.

THE CARDS
• Birthday - cake, candles, balloons, bunting and a confetti burst
• Christmas - a tree that stands up, ornaments that glow, snow that falls
• Love - a heart that rises from the fold, with hearts floating up
• Winter Village - lamplit houses, pines and a snowman under a paper moon
• Bouquet - tulips and daisies that sway, petals that drift
• Fireworks - a paper skyline and a sky that keeps exploding
• The Question - a velvet ring box that opens with the phone. You know the rest.
• Liftoff - a rocket that leaves the launch pad once the card is open

SEND IT ANYWHERE
Save your card as a vertical video - the envelope, the opening, your message - and send it in Messages, WhatsApp, Reels or Stories. Anyone can watch it open, Duo or not.

YOUR WORDS, YOUR HAND
Three letterings (script, serif, rounded), a “to” and a “from”, and a message in your voice. Cards you make are saved on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. No network access. Nothing you write ever leaves your phone.

Three cards are free. One purchase unlocks every card - now and in future updates - and removes the small “Made with Cardigami” mark. No subscription.

name: Cards & Daggers
description:
Cards & Daggers is a real-time 1v1 card battler you play in first person. You don't watch a board from above. You hold the weapon.

Every match starts with a draft. Build a deck of weapons, potions, and artifacts, choose a champion to lead it, then fight a real opponent online with no turns and no waiting for your move. Swing a cursed sword, drink a potion mid-fight, call in a magical raccoon. Seconds matter, and so does every card you played a moment ago.

Between matches you grow your collection. There are 60 cards to unlock, champions with their own abilities, and levels that make both stronger while opening up new tricks. Rewards land the moment you earn them. Nothing is stuck behind a timer, and there are no ads.

• Real-time 1v1 PvP with no turns
• First-person combat using the gear you drafted
• 60 cards to collect, from cursed swords to magical raccoons
• Champions with unique abilities and powerful deck synergies
• Level up cards and champions to unlock new abilities
• Instant rewards, no wait timers
• Weekly leaderboards to climb

Find your combo, trust your reflexes, and take the fight online. Download Cards & Daggers and start your first duel.

name: Carry Book: Golf Yardages
description:
Carry Book is a yardage book for your own clubs, bound in virtual leather.

There's one page per club, with your carry in big type, the total, roll and loft, the gap to the clubs either side, and a note to yourself in pencil. Turn the pages with a real page curl, or jump to any club from the contents.

AFTER THE RANGE
Tap Edit and pencil in your new numbers. Nudge the carry, total and loft up or down a yard or a degree at a time. Wedges keep their three-quarter and half swings too.

SEE YOUR GAPS
The gapping chart at the back shows every club's carry and roll side by side, with big gaps marked in red, so you can see where your bag needs a club.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Six leathers, from saddle tan to racing green
• Gold, silver or blind-pressed lettering
• Five papers, including a dark Night paper
• Your name, home club and handicap on the bookplate
• Yards or metres
• Choose the 13 clubs in your bag (plus your putter)

ON YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch app shows one club per screen. Turn the Digital Crown to your club and read the carry.

IPHONE AND IPAD
A single page on iPhone and a two-page spread on iPad. Your book stays the same on all your devices through your own iCloud.

It's a book of your own distances, not a course guide, so there's no GPS, no course maps and no location permission. It starts with a sample bag so you can see how it works, then you make it yours.

PAY ONCE, NO ADS WHATSOEVER
One purchase, with no subscription, no in-app purchases and no ads. No account and no tracking either: your book stays on your devices and in your own iCloud.

Terms: https://www.sciencemadevisual.co.uk/carry-book/terms · Privacy: https://www.sciencemadevisual.co.uk/carry-book/privacy

name: Cartes sur table - jeu d'amis
description:
Cartes sur table, c'est le jeu de questions qui fait parler toute la tablée. Trois formats de cartes se mélangent dans une même partie, et à la fin tombe le verdict, avec ses prix, un classement aux points et un titre pour chaque personne.

QUI EST LE PLUS SUSCEPTIBLE DE
La carte décrit une situation que tout le monde a déjà vécue, et le groupe désigne quelqu'un. La révélation montre qui a voté pour qui.

TU PRÉFÈRES
La carte propose deux options qui se valent. Chaque personne choisit en secret, puis le vote du groupe tombe. Le camp de la minorité a toujours quelque chose à expliquer.

QUI ME CONNAÎT LE MIEUX
La dernière carte met une personne au projecteur. Ses trois réponses restent secrètes, et le reste du groupe tente de les deviner.

DES POINTS ET UN VERDICT
Voter comme le groupe rapporte des points, deviner juste aussi. Le verdict distribue ensuite ses prix, du prix du radar à celui de l'électron libre, puis affiche le classement de la partie. Personne ne repart sans son titre.

UNE IMAGE À PARTAGER
Le verdict tient sur une image prête à envoyer dans la conversation du groupe ou à garder dans tes photos, en trois styles au choix.

UN TÉLÉPHONE OU UN SALON EN LIGNE
Sur un seul téléphone qui passe de main en main, le jeu fonctionne sans réseau. En ligne, tu ouvres un salon, tu partages son code et tout le monde joue sur son propre téléphone, de 2 à 10 personnes.

TROIS TONS
Le ton Léger se joue en famille ou entre collègues. Complice permet de se taquiner entre amis. Piquant s'adresse aux proches qui se connaissent bien, avec des petites gênes, de la mauvaise foi et un peu d'ego. Aucune carte ne parle d'alcool, de sexe, de politique ou de religion.

1 700 CARTES
Les 1 700 cartes sont écrites en français pour le jeu. Aucune carte ne revient dans une partie, et ton téléphone garde en mémoire celles déjà jouées pour ne pas te les resservir tant que le paquet n'est pas épuisé.

À TON RYTHME
Choisis 5, 10, 15 ou 20 cartes, de la partie éclair au marathon. Le jeu se joue aussi à deux, avec un verdict pensé pour le duo.

GRATUIT
Le jeu est gratuit. Une pub peut s'afficher entre deux parties, jamais pendant une partie. Un achat unique, Sans pub, la retire pour de bon, sans abonnement. Il n'y a pas d'inscription, un prénom suffit.

name: Casbeat
description: Learn DJ mixing through hands-on audio simulations and practical challenges. Synchronize beats, align musical phrases, and balance frequencies using virtual decks and realistic controls. Practice transitions between tracks with different tempos and genres. Build complete DJ sets while managing musical energy and flow. Test your skills in timed exams and unexpected mixing scenarios. Review performance metrics, identify mistakes, and refine your technique through repeatable exercises. Progress from basic beatmatching to independent set construction.

name: CatLens
description:
CatLens is a journal for the little moments you notice about your cat. Take a photo, record a short video, or pick media that’s already downloaded to your iPhone. CatLens organizes each observation on your device.

• Read a short summary and a single ring chart that brings together visual cues. The shares are a reference for observation, and unavailable results are marked as such.
• Review detected cat sounds when a video has a usable audio track.
• Find completed observations in your journal. Add your cat’s name, revisit an entry, or share its summary card.

Analysis works offline without an account. Available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese.

name: CCX GYM - Nové Zámky
description: Vitajte v našej inovatívnej mobilnej aplikácii, ktorá vám umožní ešte pohodlnejšie a efektívnejšie využívať všetky výhody nášho fitness centra. S touto aplikáciou môžete jednoducho a rýchlo nakupovať permanentky priamo z pohodlia vášho smartfónu. Či ste doma, v práci alebo na cestách, stačí niekoľko dotykov a máte svoju permanentku k dispozícii kedykoľvek a kdekoľvek.

name: CellarPinCue
description:
CellarPinCue on työkalu perinteisten kellarien suunnitteluun ja ympäristön arviointiin. Syötä sijainti, mitat, hautaussyvyys, peitemaa, seinämateriaali ja ilmanvaihto — sovellus arvioi vuoden lämpö- ja kosteusvaihtelun sekä auttaa valitsemaan sopivat juurekset ja hedelmät.

Mitä voit tehdä: • Luo ja tallenna useita kellarisuunnitelmia laitteellesi
• Katso 12 kuukauden lämpötila- ja kosteuskäyrät sekä riskikuukaudet
• Saat ehdotuksia peitemaasta, eristyksestä, ilmanvaihdosta ja kosteussuojasta
• Vertaa jopa kolmea suunnitelmaa rinnakkain
• Arvioi sopivuus perunalle, porkkanalle, sipulille, valkosipulille, omenalle ja päärynälle
• Kirjaa omat mittaukset ja vertaa niitä arvioon

Kaikki tiedot pysyvät laitteella. Ei rekisteröitymistä — ydinominaisuudet toimivat offline.

name: CEST Business
description:
CEST Business includes five full speaking practice tests.

• Take Parts 1 through 5 with the same time limits as the exam
• Hear each question and the tone that starts your answer
• Read the model answers and notes, and listen to the model audio
• Record your own answers and play them back
• Mark each scored question Got it or Retry, then practice only the ones marked Retry

Recordings play only on your device. Nothing is sent to a server. There is no automatic scoring and no login.

name: CEST Simulator
description:
CEST Business のスピーキング模試を、5回分練習できるアプリです。

・Part 1 から Part 5 まで、本番と同じ制限時間で受験できます
・質問の音声と、回答開始の音が鳴ります
・模範解答の音声と、日本語の解答解説を読めます
・自分の回答を録音して聴き返せます
・「できた」「もう一度」で自己チェックし、もう一度の問題だけ練習できます

録音は端末の中だけで再生します。サーバーへは送りません。自動採点はありません。ログインも不要です。

name: CGQI One
description: CGQI One provides a convenient way to explore revenue summaries, organize plots, review field visit schedules, analyze price and margin totals, check curing capacity, and log field notes. Move between overall conditions and individual entries while comparing variety, bud size, maturity, projected revenue, and profitability across plots in a clean, structured workspace. Track margins after salt costs and batch processing stages with built-in timers and alerts, and set pricing and daily capacity within one central hub.

name: Chamoun's Way
description:
Get the best experience with the Chamoun's Way Official App:

Best Prices
- Ordering directly from the Chamoun's Way app saves you money (including any delivery fees).
- Be the first to know about discounts & coupons.
- Our best prices are always shown in the app.
- Earn free food with rewards points.

Convenient
- Re-order your favorites in seconds.
- Get your food fast. Chamoun's Way Official App orders reach the kitchen first.
- Skip the search. Just tap Chamoun's Way.

Reliable
- Real-time order tracking.
- Accurate pickup and delivery time windows.
- Secure payments using bank-level encryption.

Support a Local Business
- You're helping a local business every time you use the Chamoun's Way app!

name: Chapbook: Notes
description:
Chapbook is a notebook that knows which of your notes are settled.

Every page can be a Draft, In Review or Firm. A meter on each notebook shows how much of it is firm, and Show what's left lists the pages that still need work. Everything you capture starts as a Draft, so Drafts is your inbox: raise a note's certainty or move it, and it's handled.

FIRM MEANS FIRM
Firm pages open read-only, so a settled note can't be changed by accident. Unlock one when it really needs to change.

NOTEBOOKS, SECTIONS AND PAGES
• Organize pages in notebooks and sections, with Quick Notes for everything else
• Pin the pages you use most, tag them, and drag them into order
• Trash keeps deleted pages until you empty it
• Open a page in its own window on iPad and Mac

A REAL EDITOR
• Headings, bold, italic, lists, quotes and code, with Markdown shortcuts as you type
• Checklists you tick with a tap
• Links between pages: type [[ and pick one
• Images and PDFs inside a page, and Scan Document on iPhone and iPad
• Full undo and redo

FIND ANYTHING
Search every page as you type, with your words highlighted in the list and in the page. Your notes also show up in Spotlight.

CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
• Share text and links from any app into Quick Notes
• A widget with your pinned and recent notes
• A New Note control for Control Center and the Lock Screen
• Shortcuts and Siri: create a note, add to one, or open one
• Continue a page on another device with Handoff

YOUR FILES, YOUR WAY
Every page is a plain Markdown file in iCloud Drive › Chapbook, or in any folder you choose. Import a folder of Markdown files or single .md and .txt files, images included. Export a page as Markdown, plain text, PDF or HTML.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking and no analytics. Your notes stay on your devices and in your own iCloud Drive.

New here? The Getting Started notebook shows everything in a few pages.

name: CharlotteBookStore
description: Welcome to your one-stop online children’s bookstore, designed to make finding the right books for babies, toddlers, young readers, and growing kids simple, fun, and convenient. Our app gives parents, grandparents, teachers, caregivers, and young readers an easy way to discover children’s books across a wide range of ages, interests, reading levels, and subjects. Whether you're looking for a bedtime story, an educational book, an exciting adventure, or a new favorite series, our store makes it easy to search, browse, and shop. Find books quickly using our convenient search functionality. Customers can search for books by: ISBN Book title Author Subject or category Keywords Reading level Age range Our search experience is designed to help customers find specific books while also making it easy to discover new titles.

name: Chiếu Dạ
description:
Chiếu Dạ là một trò chơi giải đố ánh sáng lấy cảm hứng từ mỹ thuật phương Đông.

Trong mỗi màn chơi, bạn xoay những tấm gương đồng để đổi hướng tia sáng, nối các hạch sao và khôi phục những bức tinh đồ đã phai mờ. Mỗi cú chạm xoay gương 90 độ. Đường sáng có thể bị chặn, tách thành nhiều nhánh hoặc đòi hỏi bạn phải quan sát toàn bộ bàn cờ.

Điểm nổi bật:

• 10 màn giải đố được thiết kế thủ công
• Cơ chế xoay gương và dẫn sáng dễ hiểu
• Hệ thống gợi ý, hoàn tác và đặt lại
• Đánh giá ba sao theo số lượt xoay
• Phong cách thị giác tối giản, đậm chất phương Đông
• Âm thanh, phản hồi rung và chế độ giảm chuyển động
• Không cần tạo tài khoản

Hãy quan sát đường đi của ánh sáng, tìm ra hướng xoay chính xác và đưa từng hạch sao trở về với bầu trời.

Chiếu Dạ có thể tải miễn phí.

Ứng dụng này chỉ dành cho mục đích giải trí, không liên quan đến cá cược tiền thật, phần thưởng tiền mặt hoặc bất kỳ vật phẩm nào có giá trị thực tế. Ứng dụng không cung cấp bất kỳ tính năng thưởng hay rút tiền nào.

Bạn phải đủ 18 tuổi để sử dụng ứng dụng này.

name: ChifEd Magnet Board
description:
Four magnet boards for explaining music, to a whole class or a single student. Drag magnets on, move them around while you talk, and draw over the top. Nothing is checked or corrected: you decide what's right.

PULSE BOARD
Drag time signatures, notes, rests and hearts onto the board. The hearts beat in time and the notes stay silent, so students can clap them. Tap a heart to show its divisions as dots.

STAVE BOARD
Write on one stave or two with clefs, notes, rests, sharps and flats. Use coloured balls and pictures before students are ready for note heads, and add letter names, numbers or solfa.

CIRCLE OF FIFTHS
Start with a whole circle or an empty one and fill it in with major keys, minor keys and key signatures in treble, bass, alto or tenor clef. Lay the spinner over it and turn it to focus on one key at a time.

KEYBOARD DIAGRAM
Put coloured balls, letters, numbers, solfa and pictures on the keys of a two or three octave keyboard. Place pictures over the groups of two and three black keys, and colour keys in.

MADE FOR LESSONS
- Big enough for a whole class to follow, and just as useful one-to-one
- Pens, a highlighter and an eraser on every board, with undo and redo
- Each board stays just as you left it, ready for your next lesson
- Only the Pulse Board makes a sound; the other three are silent on purpose
- Works offline

Build something wrong on purpose and ask what's wrong, and why. Our apps assist teachers; they never replace them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, adverts or tracking. Magnet Board collects no personal information, and your boards stay on your iPad.

name: Choghadiya Panchang
description: Choghadiya provides local Choghadiya periods, tithi, nakshatra, yoga and karana, supported festival and fasting decisions, and solar/lunar eclipse visibility. Select a city worldwide or optionally use your location. Times follow the selected city's time zone. Choose English, Gujarati, Hindi or Bengali independently of your calendar tradition. Save places on your device. Unsupported religious rules and missing solar events are explicitly marked unavailable or unconfirmed. Optional weather and AI explanations require an internet connection; AI explanations can be mistaken. Confirm important observances with a source for your tradition. Never look directly at the Sun without certified solar protection. Also available on the web at https://choghadiya.net.

name: Cigars Passport
description:
Cigars Passport is a directory and social club for cigar lounges across the United States.

Find lounges, cigar shops, and bars with a cigar area near you, with hours, contact details, amenities, and the brands each place lists on its own website.

See events, tastings, and meetups. RSVP, and make plans with friends.

Check in when you arrive and collect a passport stamp. Keep going back and your stamp upgrades from Guest to Regular, Patron, and beyond.

Follow friends, share your member band, and scan a friend's band to find their profile.

Cigars Passport is for adults 21 and over. It does not sell tobacco or link to tobacco sales. All purchases happen in person at the lounge, where staff check ID.

name: CineCube: Color Match & 3D LUT
description:
Match the exact color grade of any film frame on your 4K videos and photos in one tap, then export industry-standard 3D .CUBE LUTs for your desktop workflow.

CineCube is a professional color grading studio and 3D LUT builder engineered for filmmakers, colorists, photographers, and video creators. Load any movie still, reference shot, or one of 12 built-in cinema looks to transfer its tonal balance, color palette, and contrast to your footage while keeping skin tones natural.

Try every pro grading tool free on your first 2 photo exports. No account required and no watermarks.

WHY CREATORS USE CINECUBE

- Instant Reference Color Match
Drop in any reference frame to transfer its mood and color science in real time. Built-in Skin Tone Protection prevents unnatural shifts on faces.

- Real-Time 60fps 4K & ProRes Video Grading
Grade high-bitrate video with a live before/after split wipe and frame-accurate timeline scrubber. Export ready-to-publish presets for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, YouTube 4K, and 2.39:1 Scope, or render full-quality masters in 10-bit HEVC, Apple ProRes 422, and 1080p H.264.

- Camera LOG to Rec.709 Normalization
Transform flat camera footage before grading with 20 built-in color space transforms for Apple Log, Dolby Vision HLG, Sony S-Log3 and S-Log2, Canon Log 3 and Log 2, DJI D-Log and D-Log M, Panasonic V-Log, Fujifilm F-Log2, ARRI LogC3 and LogC4, Blackmagic Film Gen 5, RED Log3G10, and Nikon N-Log. Includes automatic LOG profile detection and custom input .CUBE profile import.

- 3-Way Color Wheels, Curves & Selective Color
Shape shadows, midtones, and highlights with precision 3-way color wheels, 6-zone photometric exposure controls, a 5-point parametric tone curve, an 8-channel HSL color mixer, and targeted 3D color qualifiers for sky, foliage, water, and skin.

- Optical Film Emulation
Add organic film halation around high-contrast edges, lens bloom, highlight glow, 3-stage sharpening, and 35mm film grain with true 24fps temporal motion on video.

- 3D .CUBE LUT Generator & On-Device Vault
Export standard 17x17x17, 33x33x33, or 65x65x65 .CUBE LUT files directly to Files or AirDrop for DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Lightroom, CapCut, VN, LumaFusion, and field monitors. Import existing .CUBE LUTs from your desktop library to grade on iPhone and iPad.

- 20-Photo Batch Grading & 16-Bit Lossless Export
Apply a unified grade across up to 20 photos at once. Save in 16-bit TIFF, lossless PNG, HEIC, or high-bitrate JPEG, or generate a 2048px Cinema Palette Poster with extracted HEX swatches.

- 100% On-Device Metal Pipeline
All rendering runs locally on Apple Silicon using Metal and CoreImage. Your photos and footage never leave your device.

CINECUBE PRO

Unlock unlimited 4K/ProRes video exports, batch photo processing, Camera LOG normalization, and .CUBE LUT exports with an Annual Studio Pass, a Weekly Creator Pass, or a one-time Lifetime unlock. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://majidaljishi.com/en/projects/cinecube/privacy
Terms of Use: https://majidaljishi.com/en/projects/cinecube/terms

name: Cinelog — Watchlist & Diary
description:
Cinelog is a calm, private place to keep track of what you watch.

Add a film or a series, give it a colored tile and a few genre tags, and drop it into one of four buckets: Watchlist, Watching, Watched, or Dropped. Rate the ones you've finished with a half-star tap, jot a note, and you've got a film diary that's entirely your own.

For series, Cinelog goes episode by episode. Tell it how many seasons and episodes a show has, then tap as you go — it keeps a running percentage, and the moment you finish the last episode it marks the whole show as watched. The Up Next tab gathers everything in progress, points you at the exact next episode, and keeps your watchlist in a tidy queue. Can't decide? "Surprise me" draws one at random from your list.

The Stats tab turns your own entries into a quick picture: hours watched, average rating, how many titles you've finished each month, and your most-watched genres — all drawn as clean charts.

A few things worth knowing:
– Everything is typed in by you. Cinelog is not wired to any film database, which is exactly why it needs no internet and never stalls waiting on a server.
– Hours watched come from the runtimes and episode lengths you set — nothing is guessed from outside.
– Browse your collection by genre, filter it by type or status, search it, and favorite the ones you love.
– There are no accounts, no ads, no tracking, and no subscriptions. It's free and complete.

Your taste in movies is nobody's business but yours. Cinelog keeps it that way — on your device, and only there.

name: City2Go
description:
City2Go shows what's on today, tomorrow, this weekend and beyond in Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Goa, Kochi, Surat and Thiruvananthapuram.

TODAY
The day by the hour, with today's picks and the counts for tomorrow, the weekend and the week.

BROWSE
Pick a date, a category (music, comedy, theatre, art, workshops, food, nightlife, kids, sport and more), an area of the city, or everything that is free.

EVENT PAGES
Date, time, venue, price and the organiser's description, with directions, add to calendar, share, and a link to the organiser's or ticketing site for tickets.

MY PLAN
Save events with the bookmark. The list lives on your phone and works offline.

SEARCH
Find an event, a venue or an artist in seconds.

The listings are the same as on delhi2go.in and the other city sites. They are gathered every morning from organisers and ticketing platforms and link back to the source. City2Go does not sell tickets and has no account or sign-up. Event names, posters and details belong to their organisers.

name: CityCruise
description:
CityCruise is your plug for going out in Lagos. Find places worth the trip, see what's on this weekend, and plan the whole day with your people, all in one app.

FIND PLACES WORTH THE TRIP
• Nearly 300 places and growing: restaurants, bukas, lounges, rooftops, beaches, parks, galleries, cinemas, game centres and more
• Filter by area, vibe, budget and what you want to do
• Honest reviews from real people, opening hours, prices and directions
• Weekend getaways too: waterfalls, hills, history and resorts a few hours from Lagos

PLAN THE WHOLE DAY
• Make a plan for a date, a day out with friends, a family Sunday or a weekend away
• "Plan it for me" builds a day from real places, open at the right time and within your budget
• See drive times between stops, with a heads-up when you'll hit bridge traffic
• Surprise mode for dates: they only see each stop 30 minutes before it starts

PLAN IT TOGETHER
• Share one link in your group chat. Friends vote on places and dates and say if they're in, no app needed
• Invite a co-planner to build it with you
• Chat inside the plan and get "It's set!" when the plan is locked in

STEAL A PLAN THAT WORKED
• Explore itineraries shared by other CityCruisers and make one yours in a tap
• Ratings and reviews show which plans actually helped
• Share your own plans and earn points when people use them

WHAT'S ON THIS WEEKEND
• Every Thursday: events, ready-made plans and picks for you
• Concerts, festivals, plays and hangouts with spots left

EARN AS YOU EXPLORE
• Points and badges for reviews, place suggestions and shared plans

Made in Nigeria. Know a spot we don't have? Suggest it in the app and we'll add it.

name: Closeta: AI Try-On
description:
See it on you before you buy.

Closeta is a free AI fitting room. Pick a piece from a partner brand, take a photo of yourself or choose one from Photos, and see how it looks on you in about 20 seconds.

· Shop & try: browse partner brands' pieces for sale, women's and men's
· One photo is enough: stand facing the camera in even light; the app shows you how
· Before and after: drag to compare your photo with the try-on
· Buy from the brand: open the brand's own product page to order. Closeta never handles orders or payment
· My fits: results are kept only on your phone, and you can delete them any time

Privacy
· Your photo is used only for that one try-on. Closeta doesn't keep it
· No account, no name or email
· Every result is labeled AI-generated

Note
Try-ons are AI-generated styling previews, not a guarantee of size, fit or exact color. Check the size chart before you order. For users 18 and older, using photos of themselves only.

name: Cloth Hop
description:
The picnic is over, but the tablecloth is still on the clock. Help it slip out from under the dishes and make it to the nap basket.

START WITH THE CORNERS
Tap the red clips to release the cloth. Fold a stitched corner to clear a snagged exit. When a table gives you a Slip Mat, place it under a dish before the first pull. A mat is especially useful on a striped rough spot.

READ THE HEM
Drag in the direction of an open arrow. Flick quickly past paper cups and glide slowly past plates and foam blocks. Short strokes give you room to change pace between dishes. The cue below the board shows which dish the hem will reach next.

TURN AT THE RAIL
Some tables have a bend. Pull toward the first arrow until a side path lights up, then swipe in the new direction. When two exits open, your choice changes the order in which the remaining dishes come free.

MAKE IT TO THE BASKET
Pull the cloth all the way out with every dish upright. A steady getaway earns three stars. Watch the cloth roll up, tie itself in a knot, and hop into the basket.

THE PICNIC TRAIL
Play 16 handcrafted puzzles across four picnic stops. Revisit a table to beat your best, or open Fresh Spread for a different daily layout. Enable tap-to-pull controls to aim with the arrows and take short Glide or Flick strokes. The game works offline and saves your best scores on your device.

name: CloudBox – كلاودبوكس
description:
CloudBox brings your private file vault to your iPhone. Connect to your organisation's own CloudBox server by typing its address or scanning the QR code from Admin → Mobile app, then sign in with your usual account (two-step verification supported).

• Files — browse folders in a list or grid, sort, search everything, star and pin, colour folders.
• Upload — photos and videos, files from the Files app, a camera photo, or scan documents to PDF. Large files upload in parts and resume after a hiccup.
• Share — create external links with a password, expiry date and download limit, or share with people on your CloudBox.
• Offline — keep files and whole folders on your iPhone; they update automatically.
• Connected sources — open Nextcloud, Dropbox and Google Drive connected to your CloudBox, and copy files in either direction.
• Notes, Recent, Shared with me, Trash with restore, and your devices under Account.

Fully native, in English and Arabic with right-to-left layout, light and dark mode, and an optional Face ID lock. Your files stay on your own server — no ads, no tracking.

Requires a CloudBox server, version 2.1 or later, reachable over HTTPS.

name: Clube VKUDAKA
description:
Clube VKUDAKA is the subscription club of VKUDAKA Moda com Essência, a Brazilian womenswear brand with its own tailoring.

As a member, you get early access to every new collection, clothing rental included in your plan, invitations to exclusive events, and store credit on every purchase.

WHAT YOU'LL FIND IN THE APP

• Early access: see new collections before everyone else and reserve your favorite pieces.
• Rental included: book looks from the collection for special occasions at no extra cost.
• Exclusive events: confirm your attendance at fashion shows and member gatherings.
• VKUDAKA credit: track the credit you earn on every purchase and use it whenever you want.
• Your subscription in one place: follow your plan, orders, and benefits.
• Full profile: manage your personal data, addresses, and preferences.

The app content is in Portuguese (Brazil).

Questions: vkudaka300@gmail.com

name: Cờ Tư Lệnh: Commander Chess
description:
Cờ Tư Lệnh là trò chơi cờ chiến thuật do Đại tá, nhà văn Nguyễn Quý Hải sáng tạo. Mỗi bên có Tư lệnh, Sở chỉ huy, Bộ binh, Dân quân, Xe tăng, Công binh, Pháo binh, Cao xạ, Tên lửa, Không quân và Hải quân, đánh nhau trên bàn cờ 11 × 12 có biển, sông và hai ngầm.

HỌC CHƠI TỪ ĐẦU
• 12 bài học ngắn, mỗi bước là một nhiệm vụ trên bàn cờ thật. Đi sai thì có lời giải thích, bí thì bấm Gợi ý.
• Thẻ quân ghi tầm đi, tầm ăn và điểm của từng quân.
• 12 thẻ mẹo và trang Luật nhanh để xem lại bất cứ lúc nào.
• Gợi ý ngắn hiện đúng lúc trong những ván đầu.

ĐẤU VỚI MÁY HOẶC VỚI BẠN
• Máy có ba mức: Tân binh, Chỉ huy, Tư lệnh.
• Hai người chơi trên một máy, bàn cờ tự quay theo lượt.
• Ba chế độ thắng: Tổng lực, 4 trận, Tính điểm.
• Đồng hồ 10, 15, 30 phút hoặc không giới hạn; chơi đủ 19 quân hoặc 17 quân.
• Đi lại nước, xin hòa, đầu hàng, xem biên bản nước đi.

THEO DÕI TIẾN BỘ
• Lên quân hàm theo điểm kinh nghiệm và mở thành tích.
• Lưu lịch sử các ván và xem lại từng nước.
• Ván đang chơi dở được lưu, lần sau mở app chơi tiếp.

CHƠI KHÔNG CẦN MẠNG
App chơi hoàn toàn trên máy: không quảng cáo, không cần tài khoản, không thu thập dữ liệu nào.

Luật trong app theo bộ luật năm 2021 của tác giả và loạt video bài giảng của tác giả.

name: Codent
description: Codent follows up with every patient who left with unscheduled treatment, using personal texts they actually read, walking them through their treatment, cost, and insurance, then booking straight into your PMS. Our mobile app gives you the freedom to focus on what’s most important, even when that takes you out of the practice. Engage with patients, respond to questions from our treatment coordinator team, and much more.

name: CoilCanvas
description:
Turn a single paper teardrop into a whole bloom. CoilCanvas is a quilling studio for designing patterns, estimating how much paper to cut, and printing full-size guides to place each piece.

Arrange coils, teardrops, leaves, and arcs on a portrait canvas. Build a ring of petals, mirror a motif, or repeat a shape along a curve in Pattern Lab. Try a different palette on the same layout to see how the finished piece could feel.

Cut with a plan. Measure the paper you used for a trial piece and record it in Sample Notes. Compare the estimated demand with the full strips and offcuts you have on hand. Review suggested cuts, leftovers, and estimated purchasing costs before you start rolling.

Take your design to the worktable. Print a full-size Bench Sheet on A4 or US Letter. Check the print with the 50 mm ruler, then use the part key to match each numbered outline to its shape, color, paper, and quantity. Large designs span overlapping pages.

Track the pieces you've made and the paper you actually used. Keep notes on each batch, deduct paper from stock when you choose, and export material lists or making records as CSV files.

Start with an editable rose study or a blank canvas. Your projects are saved on your device, and the studio works offline.

name: CompressIt: Photos & PDF
description:
CompressIt shrinks photos and PDFs directly on your iPhone or iPad. Your files never leave your device.

Hit the 2 MB limit on a visa form. Fit a scan under your email's attachment cap. Free up storage without digging through your library.

WHY COMPRESSIT
• 100% on-device. No servers, no uploads, works in Airplane Mode.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Clean, quiet design built around Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.

FOUR COMPRESSION MODES
• Light: fast optimization with minimal visible change
• Balanced: the recommended everyday setting
• Max: the smallest files, up to 85% smaller
• Target Size: pick a size in KB or MB and CompressIt aims for it, at or below your limit

PHOTOS AND PDFs
• Compress photos from your library
• Compress multi-page PDFs from Files and iCloud Drive
• Convert images to PDF, JPEG, PNG or HEIC
• Turn heavy HEIC photos into universally compatible JPEG

COMPARE BEFORE YOU SAVE
• Before/After slider to see the difference
• 2.5x magnifier to check text and fine detail

PRIVACY TOOLS
• Remove EXIF data (location, capture time, camera info) before sharing

SAVE AND SHARE
• Save straight to Photos in one tap

name: Consignerie Traiteurs
CookFast: What to Cook Tonight
description:
Can't decide what to cook tonight? CookFast picks one dinner idea for you, matched to your tastes and the time you have, so you can stop wondering what to eat and start cooking.

HOW IT WORKS
• Answer five quick questions once: anything you don't eat, what you're eating for, how long you've got on a weeknight, the kind of food you like, and anything you never want to see.
• Each night, get one dinner idea: a real cooking video matched to your answers. Short on time? Choose 15 or 30 minutes and CookFast looks for quick meals first.
• Like it? Tap "Cook this" and CookFast turns the video into a written recipe with ingredients and steps. Not feeling it? Tap "Show another".

SAVE RECIPES FROM TIKTOK AND YOUTUBE
Found a cooking video you love? Paste the YouTube or TikTok link and CookFast makes a recipe from the video that you can follow: an ingredient list and numbered steps. No more pausing and rewinding.

YOUR OWN RECIPE KEEPER
Every recipe you cook or add is saved in your own library. Search it, filter it, and tick off ingredients as you cook.

MORE DINNER IDEAS FROM OTHER COOKS
Short of meal ideas? Browse recipes other cooks have turned into written recipes in the community section.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
CookFast is free and has no ads. You sign in with Google or Apple, and your recipes and answers are kept with your account. You can delete your account and data at any time from inside the app.

CookFast is not affiliated with YouTube or TikTok. Videos stay on the creator's channel and are credited in every recipe.

name: CordKeeper
description:
CordKeeper helps you know which firewood is ready to burn and how long your woodpile will last. Log each stack, track moisture readings as it dries, and record the wood you bring in through the heating season. No account and no internet connection needed.

EVERY STACK IN ONE PLACE
• Name, species, location, and the date it was split and stacked
• Size from length × height × depth, or enter a delivered amount
• Feet and cords, or meters and cubic meters
• Grouped into Ready to Burn, Seasoning, and Used Up

SEASONING ESTIMATES
• A ready date for each stack based on 20 species
• Adjusted for split size, cover, and sun and wind exposure
• Progress bar for every stack that's still drying

MOISTURE READINGS
• Log meter readings with the date and where you measured
• Chart of readings against your moisture target
• Drying rate and a projected ready date from your own readings
• A stack shows as Ready only when a reading meets your target

HEATING SEASON
• Take Wood records what you bring in, with quick ¼ and ½ cord picks
• Season total against your goal, by month and by species
• Weekly average and how many weeks your ready wood will last
• Approximate heat value of the wood you've burned

CORD CALCULATOR
• Full cords, face cords, and volume from stack measurements
• Multiple rows and any piece length
• Add the result straight to your woodpile

REMINDERS AND DATA
• Optional reminder on the day a stack is expected to be ready
• Export your log as CSV and back up everything to a file
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your records stay on your iPhone

Seasoning dates and heat values are estimates for planning. Use a moisture meter to confirm wood is dry, and follow your stove manufacturer's instructions.

name: Cossacks Rush
description:
The steppe is restless. Wolves come out of the night, devils crawl from the river mist, witches circle on their brooms — and a lone Cossack stands on an island near Poltava, ready to hold it to the last.

Cossacks Rush is a fast top-down action game played with one thumb. Steer anywhere on the screen, and your hero fights on his own: chain cuts into combos, dash through the crowd and unleash powers that throw enemies across the meadow.

THREE HEROES
• Oko — two curved shablyas, a whirling tornado and a horilka firebomb
• Tur the Hetman — a golden bulava he throws and catches, a war cry that staggers everything around him
• Hray — a flintlock pistol, iron bombs with a burning fuse and a field cannon that fires six grenades at once

35 WAVES, FIVE BOSSES
Wolves, rabid dogs, devil pigs, bears, snakes, knife-throwing chorts and fire-casting witches grow stronger every wave. Then the bosses come: the Storm Devil, Mars, the pirate Admiral with his sharks and whirlpools, the Cyclops and his brothers, and the Angry Pan with his bandits.

GROW STRONGER
Every level brings a gift: more damage, more health, faster cuts. New abilities unlock as you survive, and at wave 21 they evolve into even stronger forms.

A LIVING STEPPE
Sunrise, rain, storms and night roll over the island as the waves go on, through the meadow, the sunflowers, the orchards and the old village by the church.

• One-thumb controls, made for playing on the go
• Fully offline — no account, no internet needed
• No ads, no purchases, no data collected
• English and Ukrainian

name: Coverlabel Recall
description:
Coverlabel is for someone learning a labeled diagram: a heart, a plant cell, a map, a machine. A photo of the page is not a quiz. Coverlabel puts a piece of tape on each printed label and asks you to name what is underneath.

Start from an empty screen with Try a sample diagram. It is a drawing of the human heart with eight labels, all due today. You do not need your own textbook. Tap Start review, say the name, then tap Show answer. Got it waits longer. Missed comes back tomorrow.

For your own page, tap Add. Take a photo or choose one photo. Coverlabel reads the printed words on this phone and places a cover on each label. Move a cover, change an answer, or draw a cover where a label was missed. Save the diagram.

Today shows what is due. Trouble spots are labels you have missed more than once. Drill trouble spots reviews only those. Hide one leaves the other labels visible as a hint. Hide all covers every label.

Diagrams stay on this iPhone until you delete them. There is no account and no sign-in. Coverlabel does not upload the photo or the answers.

name: Crew Airport Notes
description:
Crew Airport Notes is a private briefing book for pilots and cabin crew. Keep the practical, hard-won knowledge about each airport — and share it only with the crew you invite.

WHY CREW USE IT
• Parking stands and taxi tips, ground handling and GPU availability, crew transport and hotels, food and local tips — organised per airport.
• Critical warnings pinned to the top of an airport, so nobody misses them.
• "Still accurate?" — crew confirm a note with one tap, and notes not confirmed for 6 months are flagged as possibly outdated.
• Every note shows who added it and who last edited it, with date and time (local and UTC), plus full edit history with undo.

FAST ON THE RAMP
• Quick Add from anywhere in a few seconds.
• Checklist templates per category with yes / no toggles (e.g. Lav, Trash removal, GPU, Roaming).
• Attach photos and PDFs; photos are shrunk automatically to save space.
• Search airports by ICAO, IATA or city; name, runways, elevation and frequencies fill in automatically.
• Works fully offline and syncs automatically when you are back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Invite-only lists. Nothing is public.
• Roles: Owner, Admin, Editor, Viewer — plus per-member extra access (for example a loadmaster who may add notes only to Cargo at one airport).
• Invites by email or link expire after 7 days and work once.
• Option to hide crew names from viewers.
• Face ID / passcode lock, dark mode by default.
• Delete your account any time in Settings.

DISCLAIMER
For crew reference only. Not for operational use. Always follow official AIP, NOTAMs, and company procedures.

name: CribTag
description: CribTag is a local-first workshop companion for anyone who lends tools, tracks consumables, and wants receipts when something comes back broken. Build a digital crib for your garage or jobsite: assign hang tags to drills, saws, ladders, and specialty gear. See what is on the wall, what is out on loan, and who owes a return date. Loan receipts stay on device so you can settle up without digging through texts. Consumable fuse meters remind you when oil, blades, or batteries are due. Warranty notes and fault stamps capture what failed before so the next repair is faster. Designed for homeowners, makers, and small crews who share gear but hate spreadsheets. Widgets surface overdue loans at a glance. Everything runs offline on your iPhone; your inventory never leaves the device unless you export it. Free to use. No account required.

name: Cross Road Duel
description:
Cross Road Duel is a crossword you play against someone.

Both players see the same 15×15 crossword with clues. Pick a word, type it and place it. You score for the letters you place yourself: rare letters are worth more, and coloured squares double or triple a letter or the whole word. A wrong word passes the turn, so think before you place it. The bank at the edge of the board shows which letters are still missing.

• Two kinds of puzzle: a 15×15 crossword or an 11×11 arrowword.
• Five rule sets: Classic, Blitz (five minutes each on the clock), Equal value, No clues and First to 150.
• Level up, earn titles and 21 badges, follow your statistics and find your nemesis.
• Play solo to learn the board, with a crossword of your own.
• Take on a random opponent. If nobody else is waiting, the game finds you one within half a minute, so you never wait long.
• Get a notification when it is your turn.
• Invite a friend with a six-character code, or challenge a player by their player name.
• The daily duel: everyone gets the same crossword each day. Play it on your own and compare your points on the daily list.
• Every move has 72 hours, like a correspondence game. Take your turn when it suits you.
• Zoom in with two fingers or the + and − buttons. Works in portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad.

Crosswords follow the New York Times rules: every square is in two words, every word has at least three letters, and the grid is symmetric. Clues are written for the game. Swedish and English each have their own words and crosswords.

No ads, no purchases and no tracking. You can play solo and the daily duel without an account. To play against others you sign in with Apple, Google or Microsoft and choose a player name. Other players can report a player name, and you can delete your account in the app at any time.

name: Crystal Flow: Gem Puzzle
description:
Step into Crystal Flow and put colourful crystals in order. Tap a tube to pick up a gem, then move it to an empty tube or onto a gem of the same colour. Study the arrangement, plan your moves and finish each puzzle within its move limit.

From your first easy levels to advanced challenges, every puzzle is generated to be solvable, so there is always a fresh arrangement to work through. Crystal levels with veiled gems and frozen tubes arrive as you progress and keep the challenge interesting.

COLLECT 100 CRYSTALS
Win levels to earn tickets and open the crystal globe. Crack it with a few taps and see which gem appears, from common stones to rare and mythic finds. Collect them all and fill your collection.

CHOOSE YOUR HELP
Undo a move, ask for a hint, add a tube or shuffle when you are stuck. Helpers can come from rewards, daily bonuses or the shop.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Available in English, Italian, French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Adjust music and sound effects, turn on colour symbols for easier gem recognition, or enable reduced motion in Settings.

ADS AND PURCHASES
Crystal Flow is free to download and contains ads and optional in-app purchases. Rewarded videos are always optional and show the reward before you watch. "No Ads" removes banners and ads between levels. Purchases are never required to start playing.

Progress is stored on your device. Deleting the app or its data may erase it.

Support: berthuslabs@gmail.com

name: Cue Maker
description:
From paper script to iPad.

The cues you once pencilled into the script margins now go down with Apple Pencil. Record the run-through, and during the show the app has the next cue ready ahead of time. Cue Maker, built for stage managers.

■ WORK — Mark cues on the script
· Import a PDF script and place each cue with Apple Pencil on the line where it is called.
· Lighting, sound, fly, deck and video each have their own colour, so departments stand apart at a glance.
· Anything you write in the margins stays as a note, and handwriting is converted to text on the iPad itself.
· When the blocking changes, drag the cues and notes with it.

■ REC — Time your cues in the run-through
· Turn on REC and do your run, and the time each cue goes is logged.
· Turn REC on again and the cues you have already timed keep their times.

■ SHOW — From standby to GO
· Following your run-through record, it brings up the next cue ahead of time and tells you when it is due.
· The script turns its own pages as the show goes on.
· If the show runs late, adjust on the spot. Called and missed cues are marked separately.
· When the curtain comes down, you get a summary of that night's running time.

■ CUE SHEET — No script? Use a table
· For concerts and events that follow a running order, build the show as a cue sheet table.
· Handwriting in the cells turns into text, and once the show starts you tick off each item as it passes.
· A show stopwatch is built in.

■ ON SITE
· Everything from writing cues to running the show works without internet. After your subscription renews, just connect once.
· There is no separate account to create; subscriptions are billed through your Apple ID. Keep a separate project for each production.
· Your scripts and records are saved only on your iPad, and they are included when you back up the iPad to iCloud or a computer.
· The app follows your iPad's language: English or Korean. In English, cues use the usual theatre shorthand (LX, SQ, Fly, Deck, VID).

■ GOOD TO KNOW
· Marking cues on a script requires Apple Pencil. Cue sheet tables also work with your finger.
· Requires an iPad with iPadOS 17 or later.

■ SUBSCRIPTION
· Cue Maker is free to download. Writing cues and notes, REC, running a show and creating projects require a subscription. The sample script can be viewed without one.
· Monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions are available, and your first subscription starts with a one-month free trial.
· Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends.
· Manage or cancel in Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
· If your subscription ends, you can still open past scripts and cues. Writing cues, REC and running a show open again when you resubscribe.
