Privacy Policy: https://cue-maker.pages.dev/legal/en/privacy

name: CueLedger
description:
Every entrance, in its place.

CueLedger gives stage teams a clear desk for the moments behind a show. Build a cue sheet, keep props ready and carry rehearsal notes into the next run.

COMPOSE THE RUNDOWN
Set cue start times and durations, choose from Lighting, Sound, Stage and Props, and add instructions. A four-channel timeline shows how the moments fit together.

CHECK SHARED PROPS
Save prop names, storage locations and available copies. Mark each prop ready. CueLedger flags unprepared props and overlapping cues that need more copies than are available.

CALL WITH CLARITY
Follow the next cue or mark individual cues called. Keep called status separate from readiness, reset a cue when needed and add rehearsal notes for the next run.

KEEP EVERY SHOW
Search shows by name or venue, archive completed productions and duplicate a rundown for a fresh run. Review cue readiness, channel mix and planned run lengths in Insights.

TAKE THE SHEET WITH YOU
Export printable PDF cue sheets, CSV cue lists or a complete JSON backup. Restore a backup through the file picker when you need it.

Start with clearly marked sample shows or create your own. No sign-in or purchase is required. Core planning works on the device without special hardware.

CueLedger is a planning reference. It does not control stage equipment. Always confirm physical conditions and crew readiness before calling a cue.

name: Culture Center Raleigh
description:
Culture Center Raleigh is the home base for the eXp Realty community at the Raleigh Culture Center. Stay connected with your fellow agents, find out what's happening, and reserve the spaces you need, all from your phone.

EVENTS, TRAINING & WEBINARS
- See upcoming events, trainings, and webinars on one calendar
- RSVP in a tap and add events straight to your phone's calendar
- Get reminders before the events you've signed up for
- Recurring events appear automatically, so you never miss the weekly ones

CHAT WITH YOUR COMMUNITY
- Follow announcement channels from Culture Center leadership
- Send direct messages to other members, with photos, replies, and reactions
- Push notifications for new messages and reactions (you choose which ones)
- Report anything inappropriate and block members you don't want to hear from

BOOK SPACES
- Reserve the ICON Conference Room, the Capper Conference Room, the common space, or the garage
- See your bookings and get a reminder before they start

MEMBER SPOTLIGHTS & CELEBRATIONS
- Celebrate member achievements, milestones, and birthdays

HELPFUL RESOURCES
- Quick links to the NC Real Estate Commission, NC REALTORS(R), NAR, and our trusted partners

PRIVATE AND SECURE
- Sign in with your account and unlock the app with Face ID or Touch ID
- Delete your account and data at any time, right in the app

Culture Center Raleigh is a private community app for eXp Realty agents and team members affiliated with the Raleigh Culture Center, or others invited by an administrator. New accounts are approved by an administrator.

ELIGIBILITY: This app is for adults only. You must be 18 years of age or older to use it, the same minimum age required to apply for a real estate broker's license in North Carolina and/or to join eXp Realty. Culture Center Raleigh is intended for real estate professionals in North Carolina.

name: DaBeamci
description:
Build a structure. Add weight. See what holds.

DaBeamci is a 2D physics building game where you connect beams, place loads, and test your designs.

Experiment freely in Sandbox, or take on Campaign challenges with specific goals and constraints. Discover how your structures respond to added weight, wind, and earthquakes, then improve your design and try again.

BUILD AND EXPERIMENT
Connect joints with wood or steel beams, attach loads, and explore different structural designs.

TAKE ON CAMPAIGN CHALLENGES
Work with level-specific requirements, budgets, and environmental conditions. Refine your structures and earn stars.

WATCH YOUR DESIGNS RESPOND
Run the simulation to see how your structure moves, holds together, or breaks under stress.

CHOOSE YOUR CONTROLS
Use Drag or Two-tap placement. On supported iPhones, haptic feedback helps you feel beam connections and successful load placement.

PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose English, Korean, or Japanese in Settings.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS
Campaign progress and preferences are saved on your device.

Core gameplay works offline, and no account is required. Physics is simplified for gameplay and experimentation.

name: Daijoubu Home: Japan Rentals
description:
Daijoubu Home is the home-search app made for foreigners in Japan.
Find your perfect room from 40,000+ listings across Japan, in 10 languages.

【Key features】
・Search by train time: e.g. "within 45 minutes of Shinjuku"
・Find homes near your Japanese language school or workplace
・Compare rents at a glance on the map
・Chat with our staff in your own language
・Check room availability instantly
・Every move-in cost shown upfront: deposit, key money, brokerage fee
・Apply right in the app: just scan your residence card

【Support for life in Japan】
Garbage collection calendar, moving guide, currency converter and more.

【Languages】
English, Japanese, Vietnamese, Burmese, Mongolian, Bengali, Filipino, Hindi, Indonesian, Khmer

Operated by 東京不動産株式会社 (Real estate license: 東京都知事(1)第106628号)

name: Daily Quran: Quiet Moments
description:
Less scrolling. More time with the Quran.

Your phone can be a place to pause. Daily Quran: Quiet Moments brings you three ayahs, a moment to reflect, and a simple way to return to the Quran each day.

ARABIC AND ENGLISH MEANING
Read the original Arabic alongside an English translation of the meaning by Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com. Choose Arabic, English meaning, or both. The interface follows your language settings, with right-to-left navigation in Arabic.

A MOMENT FOR YOUR DAY
Explore 24 themes, including patience, gratitude, mercy, trust, hope, prayer and reflection. Short three-ayah sessions help you begin. Open an ayah in its full surah to read what comes before and after it. Editorial context notes are clearly separate from the Quran text and translation.

KEEP THE QURAN CLOSE
Membership includes daily ayah widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Tap a widget to open its full ayah in the app. Each widget size uses complete ayahs selected to fit its space.

BEGIN WITH ONE COMPLETE SESSION
Your first three-ayah session is free, and you can replay that same session. Annual membership unlocks subsequent daily readings, additional themed sessions and daily ayah widgets.

THE FULL QURAN REMAINS FREE
All 114 surahs are included offline. Save ayahs, keep your reading place and return whenever you like. Full Quran reading, bookmarks and reading continuation do not require membership.

A QUIET PLACE TO READ
Adjust your text size and choose light or dark appearance. No ads, no app account and no social feed. Bookmarks and reading preferences stay on your device; cross-device reading sync is not included.

ANNUAL MEMBERSHIP
Eligible new subscribers can start with a 7-day free trial. After the trial, Apple charges the annual price shown before purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Restore purchases is available in the app.

Arabic text: Tanzil Uthmani, version 1.1. English meaning: Talal Itani, ClearQuran.com, Allah Edition. Both source texts are reproduced unchanged with attribution. Membership provides reading sessions and widgets; the full Quran remains freely accessible.

Privacy Policy: https://solid-web.tech/quran/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: hello@solid-web.tech

name: Daisy & Coral: Ocean Keepers
description:
Two sisters wake up as mermaids! The sneaky Devil Science lab turned Daisy and Coral into mermaids, and the only way back is a magic antidote. Swim through real seas from around the world, collect the ingredients and become human again.

Made for little kids (ages 3 and up). Every story, mission and hint is read aloud, so children who cannot read yet can play on their own. There is no game over.

SWIM THREE REAL SEAS
• Singapore: coral reefs around Sisters' Islands
• Korea: the busy beach of Busan
• India: the clear blue water of the Andaman Islands
Each sea has its own fish, landmarks and a big friendly boss to win over together.

CLEAN THE OCEAN
Pick up plastic and nets, recycle them and earn shell points. A cleaner sea means happier animals.

RESCUE AND COLLECT
Free tangled turtles and fish, fill your sea animal book, and learn which animals to keep a safe distance from.

MAKE IT YOURS
Dress up with tails, tops, hair, glasses and traditional outfits. Build a mermaid house from recycled pieces, decorate it and invite friends to visit. Adopt cute pets and mix potions in the lab.

PLAY TOGETHER
Up to 4 iPads can swim in the same sea with a simple picture code. There is no chat, players can only wave.

SAFE FOR KIDS
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No tracking, no third-party analytics
• Links for grown-ups (feedback, support) sit behind a parent gate
• Play right away without an account. An optional login (a name and 4 pictures) keeps progress safe.

Languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese and French.
More seas will arrive in free updates.

name: DaysBack
description: DaysBack makes yesterday as easy to record as today. Create your own habits and see the last seven days together. Tap any day to record it or undo a mistake. Open Calendar to fill in an older date, and manage names and records in Habits. Everything stays on your device. Set effective-date weekday or interval rules, exclude pause dates while keeping check-ins, and compare equal-length periods with daily reflections. Catch up several missing included dates together: select, inspect the exact dates and confirm once. Current rules and pauses are checked again before saving. Review the actual recorded/included breakdown by weekday, with extra marks shown separately.

name: DCGTV
description:
DCGTV — Mustang pride. Wherever you are.

Stay connected to Dallas Center-Grimes athletics with DCGTV, the official streaming and athletics companion app from the DCG Booster Club.

Whether you're watching from home, traveling, or following your favorite Mustang teams, DCGTV makes it easy to stay connected.

Features include:

• Live Sports: Find upcoming DCGTV livestreams and watch the Mustangs in action.

• Game Schedules: Browse upcoming athletic events, including game dates, times, and locations.

• Away-Game Coverage: Find links to broadcasts hosted by other schools and organizations.

• Video Highlights: Watch Mustang Full Gallop, Senior Spotlight, and other DCGTV videos.

• Game Details: Quickly access information about upcoming competitions.

Supporting DCG Athletics

DCGTV is provided by the DCG Booster Club, a nonprofit organization supporting Dallas Center-Grimes students and athletics.

Our livestreams are free to watch thanks to our sponsors, volunteers, and supporters.

Download DCGTV and experience Mustang pride wherever you are!

name: Deckhand: Server Agent
description:
Deckhand puts your servers, a real terminal and AI coding agents in your pocket — no laptop needed.

BETA: Deckhand is in active development. Many more features are on the way with every update, and your feedback shapes what comes next.

CONNECT IN SECONDS
• Add any Linux server over SSH with a password, an imported key, or a new Ed25519 key created on your iPhone
• Host keys are pinned on first connect, so you are warned if a server ever changes
• Connections come back quietly after dead spots

A REAL TERMINAL
• Full xterm-compatible terminal with Esc, Ctrl, Tab and arrow keys
• Sessions stay alive in tmux or screen — reconnect and pick up exactly where you left off

AI AGENTS THAT WORK ON YOUR SERVER
• Bring your own key: Claude, OpenAI, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible model
• The agent reads files, runs commands and edits code on your server — and asks before it changes anything
• Destructive commands (rm -rf, DROP DATABASE, force pushes, reboots) always need your OK
• Or use your existing ChatGPT or Claude subscription: run Codex or Claude Code on your server and follow every step natively in the app
• Pick the project folder for each task

CONNECTIONS (MCP)
• Add MCP servers like GitHub, DeepWiki or Context7 once and use them in every agent
• Sync them to Codex and Claude Code on your server with one tap

VOICE
• Optional on-device speech-to-text with OpenAI's Whisper — speak your task, nothing leaves your iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no tracking, no Deckhand server
• Keys stay in your iPhone's Keychain; requests go straight to your server and the provider you chose

Coming next: server dashboards, logs and services, Docker, Git, file browser, deploys, uptime checks, notifications and much more. Follow the roadmap on GitHub.

name: Dedot: To-Do List & Planner
description:
Dedot is a clear, calm to-do list and day planner for everyday life. Say what’s on your mind, see your whole day on one timeline, and get through the week without the clutter.

PLAN MY DAY
Tell Dedot your day the way you’d say it, like “pick up flowers at 3pm, gym at 5pm, call Mom at 8pm, read before bed,” and it turns it into a plan for today, fitted around what you already have. It all happens on your iPhone. With Apple Intelligence, it reads your words even more closely.

TYPE IT THE WAY YOU’D SAY IT
Write “gym tomorrow at 7pm” and Dedot sets the day, the time and even the list for you.

TASKS AND EVENTS, SIDE BY SIDE
Today shows your tasks and your calendar events on one timeline, hour by hour, with what’s next always in view. Turning on Calendar is up to you.

YOUR WHOLE WEEK, AT A GLANCE
See what’s done, what’s in progress and what’s due tomorrow in one simple stack.

A LIST FOR EVERY PART OF LIFE
House, errands, health, family, friends, travel and anything else you need, each with its own object. Arrange Home the way you like it.

ALSO IN DEDOT
• Reminders for any task, and an optional morning summary
• Routines and custom repeats
• Checklists and notes inside tasks
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Optional iCloud sync
• Five app icons to choose from
• Built for larger text and Reduce Motion

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your tasks stay on your iPhone and, if you turn it on, in your own iCloud. We can’t see them. You can export or delete everything yourself in Settings.

SUBSCRIPTION
Dedot needs a subscription: yearly, with a 7-day free trial, or monthly. Prices are shown in the app before you buy and may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://dedot.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://dedot.app/privacy

name: Deepvale: Idle Mine Town
description:
Grab your pickaxe and head underground! In Deepvale you start with a tiny coal shaft and grow it into a deep, multi-floor mine with a lively town on the surface.

DIG DEEPER
Open shafts, upgrade the elevator and warehouse, and haul your ore to the surface. Every new floor brings a new ore, a new world and a permanent bonus to all your income. From coal to gold, from gold to crystal…

7 CONTINENTS
Mine your way from Anatolia across Africa, South America, Asia, North America and Antarctica, all the way down to the Ocean Floor. Each continent has its own ores, guardians and album sets.

BUILD YOUR TOWN
Use the ingots from your mine to build the Town Hall, Blacksmith, Market, Inn, Academy and more. Every building gives your mine a permanent boost.

COLLECT MANAGERS
Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary managers from 4 origins, each with their own skill. Fire up their skills to multiply production. No manager is locked behind luck: collect shards and unlock the one you want.

SEND EXPEDITIONS
Send your managers to faraway lands. They come back with ingots, manager shards and gems.

EXPLORE AND FIGHT
Dig through the foggy mine map: find chests, ancient relics and shiny veins. Defeat the guardian monsters blocking your path with your managers.

NEW EVENTS ALL THE TIME
The Crystal Cave refreshes every week: collect crystals, climb the reward tiers and win the week's epic manager. Seasonal events like the New Year Festival bring their own currency, advent calendar and exclusive rewards.

NEW VEIN
Once you've dug deep enough, reset your mine, earn permanent Vein Stars and progress even faster.

GUILDS AND LEAGUES
Join a guild, add friends and climb the rankings.

WORKS WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Your managers keep earning while the game is closed, and construction and expeditions keep going.

CLOUD SAVE
Link your account with Apple or Google and take your progress to your new phone.

Ads only if you want them: no interstitials, rewarded videos are completely optional.

Playable offline.

name: DegreeLeaf
description:
DegreeLeaf is a greenhouse fieldbook for growers and gardeners who want to see how daily temperatures add up over a season. Enter the daily high and low, use your own base temperatures, and trace each heat-unit total back to the readings that contributed to it.

• Keep plantings separate. Create crop, greenhouse, and batch profiles. Log temperature, humidity, weather, light, and photos. Enter a single day or fill in several days at once.
• Follow heat accumulation by stage. See daily contributions, stage totals, and the gap to each target you set. Enable optional local threshold reminders and check off milestones when you observe them.
• Compare saved readings. Match dates across two batches, find days outside your temperature limits, or review temperatures and heat units before and after a task or observation. Missing dates stay visible.
• Carry notes into the next season. Track tasks, record their outcomes, and save period reviews and personal references. Reuse your own plans when starting the next planting batch.
• Explore a separate example fieldbook. Try heat replay, batch comparisons, and task reviews with fictional readings from two greenhouses. Example edits stay separate from your personal records.

No account is required. Your personal records are stored on your device. Export CSV files or save a full local backup. DegreeLeaf summarizes your recorded data for personal reference. The app interface is in English.

name: Deploy Center: Hand Deploys
description:
Deploy Center shows which of your Vercel projects and Render services have commits that are not live yet, and lets you deploy them by hand, from your iPhone or iPad.

It is made for people who turned off auto-deploy to save build minutes, and still want to ship from anywhere.

WHAT IT DOES
• Lists your projects and services: building, failed, waiting, up to date
• Shows how many commits and merged pull requests wait for each one
• Deploys the newest commit of the production branch, after Face ID
• Rolls back to the previous live deploy, after Face ID
• Follows a deploy until it is live or fails
• Widgets for the Home Screen: waiting pull requests, builds and failures
• Optional notes when something newly waits or fails (checked in the background when iOS allows it)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no server of ours: the app talks directly to api.vercel.com, api.render.com and api.github.com
• Connect to Deploy Center on your Mac: it hands over its keys through your iCloud Keychain (end-to-end encrypted) or a QR code. Your Apple ID is the account
• Keys you type in stay in this device's keychain only
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
The demo mode shows made-up projects, so you can see every screen before you add a token.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Vercel access token or a Render API key. A GitHub token is optional and only needed for private repositories.

Deploy Center is open source (MIT) and has a companion app for the Mac.

Deploy Center is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Vercel, Render, GitHub or Anthropic.

name: Dhamma Library
description:
Dhamma Library is a calm, simple reader for the early Buddhist texts: the discourses of the Buddha and his disciples, preserved in Pāli and other ancient languages, with modern translations.

BROWSE THE WHOLE CANON
Explore the three baskets (the Discourses, the Monastic Law and the Systematic Treatises) collection by collection. Jump straight to the Long, Middle, Linked and Numbered Discourses, the Dhammapada, the Sutta Nipāta, the Udāna, the Itivuttaka and the verses of the first monks and nuns.

READ IN ENGLISH, IN PĀLI, OR BOTH
Read a translation on its own, the original Pāli on its own, or both side by side, line by line. Adjust the text size, and choose Light, Sepia or Dark to suit the time of day.

MANY TRANSLATIONS AND LANGUAGES
Each sutta shows every available translation, in English and dozens of other languages. Choose your preferred language in Settings.

SEARCH
Search the texts by word or phrase, or go straight to a sutta by its number, such as "mn 10" or "sn 56.11".

A VERSE EACH DAY
Begin each day with a verse from the Dhammapada, in English and Pāli.

READ ANYWHERE
Save texts for offline reading, bookmark the suttas you return to, and pick up where you left off.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your bookmarks and history stay on your device.

Texts and translations are courtesy of SuttaCentral (suttacentral.net) and their translators, many of whom have generously dedicated their work to the public domain. Dhamma Library is an independent app and is not affiliated with SuttaCentral.

name: Dice of the Reckoning
description:
**ROLL THE DICE. DEFY YOUR FATE.**

Welcome to Dice of the Reckoning, a fantasy RPG where every roll matters, every card offers a new possibility, and every victory must be earned.

Enter a world of elemental magic, powerful enemies, and seven mysterious towers. Build your hero, collect extraordinary cards, and discover whether strategy and fortune can carry you to victory.

**MASTER THE ELEMENTS**

Roll five elemental dice and use their combinations to unleash powerful attacks, cast spells, heal wounds, and defend against your enemies.

You have three rolls each turn. Choose which dice to keep, which to reroll, and when to play your cards. Every decision matters.

**COLLECT 280 UNIQUE CARDS**

Discover cards across Fire, Water, Ice, Wind, Earth, Spirit, and Chaos.

Build your seven-card hand, experiment with different combinations, and unlock new strategies as your collection grows.

**CONQUER SEVEN ELEMENTAL TOWERS**

Explore seven towers featuring 700 encounters. Face increasingly challenging opponents, discover powerful bosses, and unlock the mysterious Chaos Tower by conquering the six elemental towers.

Progress through each tower independently, switching between adventures whenever you choose.

**BUILD YOUR LEGEND**

Create your hero from 20 illustrated character portraits, develop powerful abilities, and permanently improve your attributes.

Earn rewards through battle, discover new cards, visit tower shops, and strengthen your hero for the challenges ahead.

**DESIGNED FOR PLAYERS, NOT ADVERTISERS**

- Play comfortably with one hand.
- Play offline. No internet connection required.
- No in-game advertisements.
- No loot boxes.
- No pay-to-win mechanics.

Just you, your hero, your cards, and the dice that determine your fate.

**EVERY VICTORY IS EARNED**

There are no guaranteed wins. Smart decisions, careful planning, and a little luck determine your fate.

Lose a battle? Learn from it, improve your strategy, and try again.

**YOUR RECKONING AWAITS**

Seven towers. Hundreds of battles. Thousands of possible strategies.

How far will your dice take you?

name: Dimenova
description:
Planning a kitchen, hallway, or bedroom refresh often means guessing how much paint, tile, or flooring to buy. Paper notes get lost. A basic calculator does not keep wall lengths with the room they belong to.

Dimenova is an offline room measurement and material estimate app for rectangular spaces. Measure a room, turn those figures into paint, tile, or flooring estimates, and save the work inside a named project on this device.

HOW TO USE
Open Home or Tools and pick the job you need.

Area, perimeter, and volume use rectangle formulas only: length x width, and length x width x height. Length totals measured segments such as wall runs or trim. Paint estimator uses wall sizes, openings you choose to deduct, coats, coverage from the tin, and wastage. Tile estimator uses room size, tile size, and wastage, then rounds up. Flooring estimator uses room size, coverage printed on the pack, and wastage, then rounds packages up. Length, area, and volume converters change units both ways.

Create a project for one room or job. Save named measurements such as north wall. Add a calculation straight to that project. Open History to revisit completed results. Edit or delete a measurement. Remove a saved estimate from a project. Sort, search, duplicate, or delete projects. Set default length, area, and volume units, number precision, and light or dark theme.

Material results are planning estimates. Actual needs depend on your measurements, product coverage, surface condition, pattern layout, extra coats, and cutting waste. Dimenova does not assume a universal coverage value. Enter the number printed on the tin or pack.

WHO IT IS FOR
Homeowners, renters, and DIY renovators who want clear rectangular room math and material estimates without an account.

No login. No ads. No subscription. No tracking. Projects, history, and preferences stay on this device. Reset App Data removes them.

Dimenova does not measure with a camera, draw floor plans, or calculate irregular or circular rooms. Length units include mm, cm, m, in, ft, and yd. Enter coverage from your paint tin or flooring pack. Results are for planning, not a contractor quote.

name: Dividilo
description:
Dividilo divide le spese di gruppo in tre passi. Niente account e niente email: una persona fa il conto e agli altri basta WhatsApp.

Chi ha pagato? Quanto? Per chi? Dividilo trova il minor numero possibile di pagamenti e prepara il messaggio per il gruppo.

Gli amici aprono il link al conto senza scaricare niente, toccano il proprio nome e vedono subito quanto devono e a chi. Ti pagano con PayPal, Revolut o Satispay in un tocco e segnano «Ho pagato»: a te arriva la notifica.

• Spese per tutti o solo per alcuni
• Importi uguali o diversi
• Promemoria pronti da mandare
• Immagine del conto da condividere

I conti restano sul tuo telefono e il link per gli amici è cifrato. Gratis.

name: DockClear: Bay Door Board
description:
DockClear is for warehouse dock leads who need to mark a bay door occupied or clear as trailers arrive. The bay wall itself seats the next waiting trailer or releases that door in one tap, and the yard count changes from the same door state.

Open Doors. Six sample bays are already on the wall. D-14 holds trailer T-4418 and D-18 holds T-2291. Three trailers wait in line: T-8804, T-1156, and T-6702. Tap a clear door and that next trailer moves onto the plate. The occupied count at the top changes immediately. Tap an occupied door and the trailer returns to the line.

Trailers shows who is waiting and who is already at a door. Swipe an assigned trailer to clear that bay.

Yard shows how many doors are clear and how many are occupied for the shift. It reads the same bay wall.

More shows the support email and the privacy policy address. DockClear works offline. There is no account and no purchase.

name: DolmADB
description:
DolmADB 是一款运行在 iPhone 和 iPad 上的 Android ADB 客户端，用于在同一 Wi-Fi 下连接已开启无线调试的 Android 设备。

主要功能
• 局域网扫描：按真实子网掩码自动识别网段，也支持手动输入 CIDR 或 IP 区间
• Shell：直接在 iPhone 上执行 adb shell 命令并查看输出
• 文件管理：浏览、上传、下载 Android 设备上的文件
• Logcat：实时查看设备日志，支持过滤与导出
• 屏幕镜像：将 Android 屏幕实时投射到 iPhone
• 远程遥控：方向键连发、按键输入，适合电视盒子等场景
• 应用管理：查看已安装应用，并可一键安装 Dolm 系列应用

使用前提
1. 在 Android 设备上开启「开发者选项 → USB 调试」
2. 用数据线连接电脑执行 adb tcpip 5555，将 ADB 切换到无线模式
3. 确保 iPhone 与 Android 设备连接同一 Wi-Fi

隐私说明
本应用不收集任何个人数据。所有连接均在本机与局域网内的 Android 设备之间直接建立，不经过任何服务器。

name: DolmPhone
description:
DolmPhone 是一款基于 Linphone SDK 的 iOS SIP 软电话，界面为中文，支持真实 SIP 注册、呼出、接听、通话中控制与通话记录。

主要功能
• SIP 账号：支持最多 3 个账号，UDP / TCP / TLS 三种传输方式
• 高清语音：RTP 音频、回音消除与编码协商，底层基于 Linphone SDK
• 来电识别：锁屏状态下以系统全屏来电界面显示
• 通话控制：静音、免提、保持、DTMF 按键
• 通话记录：本地保存最近通话，可一键回拨
• 铃声设置：内置多种铃声，音量可调

使用说明
1. 在「设置」中添加 SIP 账号（服务器地址、端口、用户名、密码）
2. 注册成功后即可拨号或接听
3. 来电时锁屏会弹出系统来电界面，滑动接听

隐私说明
本应用不收集任何个人数据。SIP 账号信息仅保存在本机，所有通话信令与媒体均在你的设备与你的 SIP 服务器之间直接传输。

name: DoPop
description:
DoPopは、やることと期限を入力して、iPhoneのカレンダー、リマインダー、またはその両方に登録できるアプリです。一回・毎日・毎週の繰り返しを選べます。必要に応じて時刻、通知、メモも設定できます。

日本語と英語に対応しています。初回に選んだ言語は、あとから設定で切り替えられます。

name: Doughdaddy's Doughnuts
description:
Get the best experience with the Doughdaddy's Doughnuts Inc Official App:

Best Prices
- Ordering directly from the Doughdaddy's Doughnuts Inc app saves you money (including any delivery fees).
- Be the first to know about discounts & coupons.
- Our best prices are always shown in the app.
- Earn free food with rewards points.

Convenient
- Re-order your favorites in seconds.
- Get your food fast. Doughdaddy's Doughnuts Inc Official App orders reach the kitchen first.
- Skip the search. Just tap Doughdaddy's Doughnuts Inc.

Reliable
- Real-time order tracking.
- Accurate pickup and delivery time windows.
- Secure payments using bank-level encryption.

Support a Local Business
- You're helping a local business every time you use the Doughdaddy's Doughnuts Inc app!

name: Dowel Drop
description:
Pull the sticks. Drop the ball. Don't let the tower fall.

Dowel Drop is a satisfying 3D physics puzzle. Each level is a wooden tower full of colored sticks. Pull them out one by one to guide every ball into the box of its color — but be careful: some sticks hold tiny houses, heavy stones and wobbly planks.

• 50 levels that get bigger and trickier
• Up to 4 balls and 4 colors to sort
• Counterweights, tipping planks and falling stones
• Earn 3 stars by finding the perfect solution
• One free hint that recharges as you play
• Relaxing wooden sounds and haptics
• Play offline, no account needed

Think before you pull. One wrong stick and it all comes down!

name: Downbeat Practice Bars
description:
Downbeat is for someone practicing a part against a steady click who wants to know which bar rushed and which bar dragged.

A voice memo keeps the recording. A metronome only clicks. Neither one writes, bar by bar, how early or late you were. Downbeat lines the take up to the tempo you set and leaves that reading on the take.

Start from an empty screen with Try a sample take. It is a short scale at 96: bar 4 is late, bar 9 is early, and the other bars sit on the click. Tap Hear to listen to one bar. It stops at the end of that bar.

For your own playing, name the take and set the tempo and how many beats are in a bar. Open a recording from Files, or record while the click plays. Two bars count in, then the recording starts. A bar that will not line up says Could not line up. Downbeat does not fill in a number.

Mark Practice again on a bar you want to redo. Close the app and the mark is still there. Change the tempo and the bars are measured again.

Takes stay on this iPhone until you delete them. There is no account and no sign-in. Downbeat does not tune pitch and does not upload the recording.

name: DrapisVelurne
description:
DrapisVelurne vous accompagne pour choisir et personnaliser votre linge de maison.
Parcourez notre sélection de draps, housses et plaids en coton, puis créez votre propre motif grâce à l’atelier DIY. Importez vos visuels, ajustez-les et imaginez une literie qui vous ressemble, douce et unique. Vous pouvez conserver vos projets, sauvegarder vos coups de cœur et préparer votre commande à votre rythme.

name: Draw Melody: Sketch to Music
description:
"Draw a line. Hear it before your finger lifts.

Draw Melody turns a drawing into music while you are still drawing it. A bar
sweeps across the page, and every line it touches lights up and sounds. There
is nothing to read, nothing to set up, and no wrong notes to hit.

DRAW IT, HEAR IT
- A note sounds under your finger as you move, not after you press play
- Higher up the page is a higher note. Left to right is time
- Draw while it plays. The loop never stops for you
- Rub out part of a line and the rest keeps going

COLOUR IS THE INSTRUMENT
- 20 inks, 20 instruments. Pick a colour and you have picked a sound
- Soft Key, Marimba, Bells, Flute, Harp, Kalimba, Music Box, Steel Pan,
  Strings, Organ, Horn, Chime and more
- Five marks: Pen, Marker, Brush, Pencil, Spray
- Two papers. Warm white, or Neon, which changes the room the sound sits in

SHAPE IS THE RHYTHM
Most drawing-music apps chop your line into equal ticks, which is why a scribble
comes out flat. Draw Melody reads the corners of your line instead. A smooth
curve sings. A zigzag taps. A circle loops. The shape you draw is the rhythm
you hear.

119 DRAWINGS TO START FROM
- Animals, Faces, Food, Toys, Vehicles, Nature, Sky, Space, Things, Shapes,
  Textures and Tunes
- Open one, press play, change one line. That is the whole tutorial
- Every category has free drawings in it

IT CANNOT COME OUT WRONG
- Five scales and twelve keys: Bright, Moody, Major, Minor, or every note
- Tempo, length, swing and notes per beat when you want them, out of the way
  when you don't
- The lattice behind the paper keeps you in key and in time without saying so

THE BAND PLAYS ALONG
- Drums, bass and an arpeggio, switched on part by part
- One dial from almost nothing to a full groove
- Build a piece up to four parts long, and past that with Pro

TAKE IT ANYWHERE
- Video in 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9, with the drawing lighting up as it plays.
  Ready for Reels, TikTok, Shorts or a square post
- WAV when you want it lossless, M4A when you want to send it
- MIDI, so your drawing opens in GarageBand or Logic as real, editable notes
- Exporting is free. It is not behind the paywall

BUILT FOR ANY SIZE OF HAND
- One thumb. Big targets. No menus to learn first
- iPhone and iPad
- Apple Pencil pressure and tilt change the weight of the line
- A small tap on every note, if you like that
- VoiceOver throughout

QUIET AND PRIVATE
- No ads
- No account, ever
- Works with no signal
- Nothing you draw leaves your phone unless you export it

DRAW MELODY PRO
Every drawing, every ink, and pieces with no length limit. Monthly, yearly, or
one payment that never renews. Export stays free either way.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
A subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before
the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account
settings.

Terms: https://drawmelody.app/terms
Privacy: https://drawmelody.app/privacy"

name: DreamFolio
description:
DreamFolio is a thoughtful place to keep the dreams you want to remember. Capture the fragments that remain when you wake: a familiar face, an impossible landscape, a feeling, or a story that seemed completely real. Give each dream a title, write as much as you recall, and choose its waking date so that every memory has a place in your journal.

Describe how a dream felt with a mood, note its vividness, and mark whether you were aware that you were dreaming. Add your own tags for places, people, objects, and recurring themes. You decide what those labels mean. DreamFolio organizes what you record without assigning hidden meanings or making psychological or medical claims.

Return to your Dream Journal to browse entries in date order, search across titles and narratives, or narrow your view by mood. Use the dream calendar to revisit a particular morning and see the stories saved on that date. Open any entry to read the complete narrative, refine a detail, update its tags, or remove a memory you no longer wish to keep.

Collections give your journal another dimension. Gather dreams about travel, childhood places, flying, or any subject that matters to you. Name each collection, add a short note, and choose the entries that belong together. A dream can appear in more than one collection while remaining a single journal entry.

Insights turn your own records into simple descriptive patterns. Explore the moods you have logged, see which tags appear most often, and revisit lucid dreams in a dedicated timeline. These views reflect your saved entries rather than predictions or interpretations. As your journal changes, the summaries change with it.

Before bed, write an evening intention: something you would like to notice, remember, or approach with curiosity. Your intention history lets you revisit those quiet thoughts over time. A practical journal guide offers gentle suggestions for recalling details and building a comfortable writing habit.

Choose the appearance that feels right for your morning or evening routine. Start with editable sample entries to explore the journal, then remove the examples when you are ready to make the space your own. DreamFolio keeps the focus on your words, your observations, and the small details that would otherwise fade.

name: DryStack Gauge
description:
DryStack Gauge adalah alat estimasi yang dirancang untuk perbaikan dinding batu yang disusun kering (tanpa mortar) di Indonesia. Semua data disimpan secara lokal di perangkat Anda.

Estimasi bagian dinding mencakup empat langkah: memilih jenis perbaikan (penambalan, pembangunan ulang, atau pengerjaan permukaan) serta fungsi dinding; memasukkan dimensi di lokasi (dalam meter atau sentimeter, dengan perhitungan volume secara waktu nyata); memilih profil batu dan memperhitungkan batu yang dapat digunakan kembali (berdasarkan berat atau jumlah unit); serta (opsional) memasukkan biaya satuan dan ongkos transportasi (per perjalanan atau total). Halaman hasil menampilkan total volume, jumlah batu baru yang diperlukan, jumlah perjalanan transportasi, dan rincian biaya. Saat menyimpan, aplikasi akan memberi tahu Anda jika terdapat proyek serupa di masa lalu dan menyimpan riwayat versi.

Selain itu, alat ini memungkinkan Anda untuk mengelola proyek (menggabungkan beberapa bagian dinding), mengelola pustaka profil batu dengan pengambilan sampel berat satuan, melampirkan foto lokasi (dilengkapi alat gambar/anotasi manual), membandingkan penggunaan material aktual dengan estimasi (untuk mengkalibrasi rasio kg/m³), mengekspor data dalam format PDF atau CSV, serta melakukan pencadangan atau impor data lengkap melalui format JSON.

Antarmuka aplikasi menggunakan bahasa Indonesia. Harap diperhatikan: alat ini tidak menilai integritas struktural, tidak melakukan estimasi volume berbasis kecerdasan buatan (AI), tidak menghitung kebutuhan mortar, dan tidak melakukan sinkronisasi ke cloud. Untuk dinding penahan tanah atau proyek di mana fungsi dinding tidak didefinisikan, aplikasi hanya akan menampilkan volume dan tidak memberikan rekomendasi khusus terkait pengadaan batu.

name: Dustback Dealer
description:
Every scratch tells a story. At Dustback Dealer, your job is to spot the difference before a rusty mistake fills your shelves.

Step behind the counter of a secretive Wild West shop where unusual customers arrive with guns in different conditions. Some look freshly polished. Others have seen better days. One careful look is all it takes to make your decision.

IS IT NEW OR RUSTY?

Examine each gun and decide whether it is NEW or RUSTY. Every gun can appear in three different conditions, including one clean version and two rusty variations.

Get the inspection right to earn a point. Mistake a rusty gun for a new one and it becomes part of your unwanted stock.

A LITTLE RUST CAN CAUSE BIG TROUBLE

Rusty stock does not disappear on its own. When a buyer arrives, you have a chance to clear it.

Direct their attention towards the painting behind the counter. While they are looking away, use the APPLY GLUE action to give the rusty gun a quick cosmetic makeover.

Choose the right moment and complete the sale. Get caught in the act and the buyer walks away.

KEEP YOUR STOCK UNDER CONTROL

Every wrong call brings you closer to trouble. If three rusty guns pile up in your stock, your run is over.

The longer you play, the more important every decision becomes.

WHAT MAKES DUSTBACK DEALER DIFFERENT?

• Simple NEW or RUSTY inspection decisions
• Three visual conditions for each gun
• Unusual customers and a distinctive Western setting
• Buyer distraction and timed restoration challenges
• Rusty stock management with a three gun limit
• Endless arcade gameplay focused on improving your score
• Straightforward touch controls
• Completely offline single player gameplay
• No advertisements, accounts or internet connection required

ONE COUNTER. ENDLESS DECISIONS.

Dustback Dealer combines careful observation, quick decisions and a playful touch of mischief into a compact arcade experience.

Study every detail, keep your stock clear and see how far your judgement can take you.

How long can you keep the counter open?

name: Earshot: Live Captions
description:
Earshot helps you follow the conversation on your iPhone and hear replies privately in your earbuds.

FREE EVERYDAY TOOLS
• Live captions transcribed on your iPhone
• Repeat recent speech with Apple’s on-device voice
• AirPods button controls and Shortcuts
• Private mode for on-device captions and Repeat

EARSHOT PRO
• What to say: a short suggestion for your next reply
• Check it: look up a question or claim
• Recap and customizable AI actions
• Continuous AI explanations and direct Realtime audio
• Head tilt, pocket knock and name triggers

CHOOSE YOUR PROVIDERS
AI assistance requires your own API key for a supported provider, or a compatible model server. Cloud voices also use your own provider account. Provider usage is billed separately and is not included in the Earshot Pro subscription. Captions and Apple-voice Repeat work without an AI key.

YOUR PRIVACY CONTROLS
Captions are transcribed on the iPhone. Audio is not saved. AI actions send conversation text to your selected provider; optional Realtime sends accepted audio passages to OpenAI. Cloud voices receive the text they speak. Local voice enrollment stores a mathematical voice profile in this iPhone’s Keychain. Private mode disables AI and cloud voices.

Designed for iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Earbuds are needed for spoken output. Head tilt requires compatible AirPods motion support. Earshot is a conversation aid; captions, AI answers and voice matching can make mistakes. Obtain permission before sharing other people’s speech with cloud services.

Earshot Pro is an optional auto-renewing yearly subscription. See the in-app purchase screen for your local price. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy: https://www.trustygenius.com/earshot/privacy
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Easy Sell
description:
Easy Sell is a mobile POS and business management app for shop owners, cashiers, and managers.

Sell faster
• Create new sales quickly
• Manage products, prices, and stock
• Scan barcodes and attach product photos
• Keep customer records in one place

Grow your business
• CRM and marketing tools
• Client management
• Marketplace access
• Reports for sales, products, cashiers, and operations

Stay in control
• Multi-store and team management
• Finance and cashbook tools
• Settings for company, receipts, scanners, and notifications
• Secure sign-in with email, phone OTP, or Google

Whether you run a small shop or a growing retail business, Easy Sell helps you sell, track inventory, manage customers, and understand performance from your iPhone.

Need help? Contact support through the in-app feedback options or the Support URL listed on this page.

name: Echora.
description:
Echora is a calm turn-based puzzle on a tiny grid. Step, wait, and loop your route into a single shadow that replays your moves. Work with that echo to hold switches and shade yourself from beams, then reach the exit.
Plan one path so the next you can finish the job. Chapters unfold from simple plates to timing waits and beam cover. Collect chapter portraits in Gallery as you clear stages. Undo across a Loop when you change your mind, and continue mid-echo sessions when you return.
Spend Sundials to support your run when you choose. Beautiful light-and-shadow stages reward clear thinking over speed.

name: Edmonton Trip Companion
description:
Make Edmonton your next great adventure.
 Edmonton Trip Companion brings places, daily plans and local inspiration together in one easy-to-use city guide. Explore the river valley, discover cultural attractions and create a journey that fits your interests.
 Browse places on an interactive map or switch to a list. Search by name, filter by category, save favourites and mark the places you have visited.
Add your own places with a location, photo and personal notes. Keep your discoveries alongside the city’s attractions.
 Create daily itineraries, add places or custom activities, reorder stops and set visit times. Save multiple plans or generate a suggested itinerary based on your interests, available time and budget.
 Find day ideas for different times and moods. Save a challenge, follow its checklist and capture your experience with notes and photos.
 Explore English-language guides and video links about Edmonton, local culture, seasonal experiences and nearby day trips.
Browse practical tips, city facts and editorial event listings to help you prepare for your visit.
 Your saved places, plans and memories stay on your device. No account is required.
 Maps, external articles, videos and directions require an internet connection. Travel estimates are approximate. Event schedules, opening hours and admission details may change; confirm them with the venue before visiting.

name: Edu Flash
description:
Edu Flash premení tvoje študijné materiály na kartičky a pomôže ti ich naučiť sa.

Tri spôsoby, ako pridať kartičky:
• S pomocou AI – skopíruj zabudované zadanie, vlož ho spolu so študijným textom do ľubovoľného AI chatu a odpoveď vlož späť. Hneď z nej vznikne balíček.
• Z obrázka – vyber alebo odfoť obrázok, okolo každého miesta nakresli obdĺžnik a pomenuj ho. Z každého miesta vznikne kartička, pri ktorej ťukneš na správne miesto na obrázku.
• Zo súboru – otvor hotový balíček vo formáte CSV alebo Markdown, aj zdieľaný z inej aplikácie. Importované súbory sa zaradia do skupín podľa názvu.

Zdieľaj balíčky so spolužiakmi ako odkaz alebo QR kód. Odkaz sa otvorí priamo v aplikácii. Balíčky si usporiadaj do vnorených skupín.

Uč sa vlastným tempom s otázkami s výberom odpovede aj s ťukaním na obrázok, s vysvetlením pri každej odpovedi a s krátkymi animovanými návodmi.

Tvoje balíčky zostávajú v zariadení. Anonymné štatistiky používania sa odosielajú iba s tvojím súhlasom a pomáhajú zlepšovať študijné materiály.

name: Element Booking
description:
Element Booking lets you book an appointment at your nail salon from your phone.

It works with salons that run ELEMENT AIO. Add your salon once: scan its QR code with your phone's camera, tap the link your salon sent you, or type its salon code. You can add more than one salon.

Want to look around first? Try the demo salon: a made-up salon where nothing is booked or sent.

Book: pick your services, a day and a time. The menu and the open times come straight from your salon.

My appointments: your upcoming appointments in one place. See one, or cancel it, from the app.

Reminders: the app reminds you before an appointment. Reminders are set on your phone and you can turn them off.

Call and Directions: one tap to call your salon or get directions.

My info: your name, phone and email are filled in for you next time. "Forget me on this phone" removes them.

Your details are sent only to the salon you choose to book with, over a secure connection. There are no ads and no tracking in the app.

You need a salon that runs ELEMENT AIO to book. Ask at the front desk for its QR code or salon code.

name: Element Dojo
description:
Under moonlight, over magma, through storm and void — nine fighters meet in a pixel-art dojo.

ELEMENTAL REACTIONS ARE THE REAL COMBOS
Freeze a foe, then hit them with fire for a Steam Burst. Soak them, then electrocute the whole crowd. Purify a curse with light, shatter flames with ice — a dozen reactions make every hit a decision.

NINE FIGHTERS, NINE STYLES
Blaze the fire swordsman, Frost the ice claw, Volt the lightning blades, Umbra the shadow scythe, Tide the water spear, Terra the unstoppable earth hammer, Sol the holy knight who answers every blow, Li the wandering sword cultivator with homing flying swords and a myriad of swords that fuse into one, and Qiao, whose bare-handed palms unleash golden dragons.

IMPACT YOU CAN FEEL
Hit-stop, screen shake, slow motion, camera punch-ins and haptic feedback. Small and big supers with full-screen cinematics. Perfect parries, dashes through enemies, jump kicks, dizzies and knockdowns.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Versus: pick your fighter and stage and take on the CPU
• Elemental Tower: eight floors, a new boon after every win, health carries over, a boss at the top
• Street Brawl: a side-scrolling beat-'em-up — smash crates, grab weapons, defeat elites. Hammer, spear, greatsword, daggers, bow and discs each bring their own skill

ALSO
• 10 stages and 5 colours per fighter
• Original pixel effects and an original soundtrack
• Touch controls and Bluetooth controllers
• English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese
• Pay once: no in-app purchases, no ads, plays offline

name: Elf TV
description:
Elf TV - Your Christmas Elf’s very own television!

What if your Christmas Elf had their very own TV?
Introducing Elf TV – a tiny Christmas television packed with festive entertainment, straight from the North Pole!
Turn your iPhone or Apple Watch into a miniature TV and give your Elf something special to watch this Christmas.

WHAT’S ON ELF TV?

SANTA LIVE
Tune in for special broadcasts from Santa himself. He’s got messages just for your Christmas Elf!

ELF NEWS
Get the latest breaking news from the North Pole. From reindeer training to mysterious cookie disappearances, there’s always something happening!

FIREPLACE
A cosy little Christmas fireplace, complete with flickering flames and the sound of crackling fire.

CHRISTMAS RADIO
Enjoy festive Christmas music with charming little animated scenes.

ELF TV MIX
Can’t decide what to watch? Sit back and let Elf TV choose! Enjoy a selection of Christmas programmes, just like a real television.

A LITTLE BIT OF CHRISTMAS MAGIC

Designed to look like a real miniature television, Elf TV is the perfect addition to your Christmas Elf’s festive setup.

Simply choose a channel, place your device beside your Elf and let the Christmas magic begin!

No subscriptions. No ads. Just a little Christmas magic.

Elf TV – Your Christmas Elf’s very own television.

name: EMBERLINE: Dice & Rails
description:
Race through 48 routes, shape your six-face die, and chase bigger combos. Upgrade your train, try three special modes, and roll once daily.

A quick switch. A charged boost. A roll that changes the ride.
Take control of a spark-powered train in EMBERLINE, an offline arcade runner where sharp reflexes meet a die you can make your own.
RIDE A CHANGING RAILWAY
Travel through 48 routes across four frontiers. Switch lanes, hop broken rails, brace for low beams, and navigate curves, narrow bridges, tunnels, and branching tracks. Gather crystals and keep your combo alive.
BUILD YOUR ENGINE
Unlock three trains, improve four permanent modules, discover 24 relics, and collect distinctive finishes. Configure all six faces of your energy die with powers such as Overdrive, Aegis, Magnet, Repair, Double Spark, and Pulse.
FIND YOUR FAVORITE RUN
Follow the campaign, chase distance in Endless Route, or return for a fresh Daily Route. Three special modes bring their own rhythm:
	•	Railbreaker: charge quickly and smash wooden barriers.
	•	Dice Storm: start with a full die charge and roll powers more often.
	•	Crystal Rush: collect dense crystal trails with recurring magnet and score boosts.
ROLL FOR YOUR DAILY SPARK
Visit Daily Dice for one free roll each day. Every face earns Embers, and every seventh roll adds a bonus. Missed days never erase your accumulated progress.
KEEP THE JOURNEY GOING
Earn route stars, complete milestones, track personal records, and pursue Frontier goals after the campaign. Save your progress locally and resume an unfinished run when you return.
No account, ads, or in-app purchases. Play offline and tune sound, haptics, and motion to your preference.
Embers are virtual game currency earned through play and have no cash value.

name: eOffice UNM
description: eOffice UNM adalah aplikasi persuratan Universitas Negeri Makassar. Pengguna dengan akun institusi dapat melihat surat masuk dan surat keluar, memantau perjalanan surat, serta menindaklanjuti disposisi sesuai peran dan kewenangannya. Notifikasi dapat diaktifkan melalui profil.

name: ErgVale
description:
Your BikeErg. Your power zones.

ErgVale helps you follow power-zone training using your Concept2 BikeErg. Connect your PM5, establish your personal zones and see your current power zone as you ride.

When an instructor calls Zone 3, match the effort to your own Zone 3 watt range. Play your class separately and use ErgVale as your riding dashboard.

SET YOUR ZONES
• Complete a 20-minute FTP test.
• Choose an 8-minute test for a provisional estimate.
• Enter average watts from a previous 20-minute BikeErg test.
• Eligible completed tests automatically update your FTP and seven power zones.

SEE YOUR RIDE
• Live watts and current power zone.
• Cadence, speed and elapsed time.
• Optional live heart rate.
• BikeErg and heart-rate connection indicators.
• Background Bluetooth recording when switching apps.
• Automatic pause after three minutes of confirmed inactivity.

FINISH AND SHARE
• Review workout averages and time in each power zone.
• View average heart rate when available.
• Share a workout summary picture or export a FIT activity file.
• Keep up to ten recent workouts and delete them individually or together.

OPTIONAL MUSIC CONTROLS
With permission, view and control playback from Apple’s Music app. Finish your session to save the ride, pause authorized Music playback and disconnect sensors.

No account required. No advertising. Workout history is stored locally on your device.

Requires a Concept2 BikeErg with a compatible Bluetooth-enabled PM5. Heart-rate and Music features are optional. Classes are not included, and instructor cues are not imported automatically.

FTP values are training estimates, not medical or laboratory measurements. The shorter test provides a provisional estimate.

ErgVale is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Concept2, Peloton or Apple.

name: Espacios Access
description:
**Access — Residential Access and Package Management**

Access is designed for authorized security and reception staff at residential communities using Espacios.

Simplify daily security operations, entry validation and package management from one convenient application.

**Access Control**
- Scan and validate QR codes for visitors, deliveries and reservations.
- Review destination information before authorizing entry.
- Register authorized entries quickly and efficiently.

**Package Management**
- Register packages received at your residential community.
- Identify the intended resident.
- View pending and delivered packages.
- Record deliveries to maintain an organized history.

**Community Management**
- Access your assigned residential communities.
- Work with information associated with each property.
- Keep access and reception operations organized.

**Integration with Espacios**

Access works alongside Espacios, the app residents use to manage visits, deliveries and reservations.

Residents generate their QR codes through Espacios, and authorized personnel validate them using Access.

**Important:** Access is intended for authorized staff at residential communities using the Espacios platform. An account provided by the appropriate property administration is required.

name: EthicalASTU
description:
EthicalASTU turns your All Star Team Up box scores into real stats, so the real hoopers stand out from the trolls.

SCAN THE BOX SCORE
Pick a screenshot of the GAME STATS screen. Your iPhone reads every player's line right on the device: points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, shooting splits and grade, plus the score and the game clock. Check it, fix anything, save.

FAIR, PER-24 STATS
Every stat is per 24 minutes and pooled across all counted games, so one hot quarter can't fake a record. Games posted before the 4th count only for the team that was winning. Lines with under 8 total stats don't count.

QUITS ON THE RECORD
A grayed-out name plus the quit message marks a verified quit. Quit count and quit rate show on every profile.

XBOX-VERIFIED PLAYERS
Link your Xbox to claim your gamertag. Your card shows your gamerpic, and gamertag changes are logged. Every game already logged under your gamertag moves onto your card.

NO DOUBLE COUNTING
Duplicate uploads are caught by file, image and game content. Matching uploads confirm a game. Mismatches get flagged, and anyone can report a fake game.

LEADERBOARDS AND CARDS
Leaderboards for points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, threes, shooting percentages, win % and more. Every player gets a polished metal card: Rookie, Bronze, Silver, Gold or Emerald.

EthicalASTU is a fan-made stat tracker. It isn't made by, sponsored by or connected to 2K, the NBA or Microsoft.

name: Fahrlingua: German Theory Test
description:
Fahrlingua helps you prepare for the German driving theory test – even if German isn’t your first language.

LEARN IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• 22 languages: Deutsch, English, Türkçe, العربية, Русский, Українська, Polski, Français, Español, Italiano, Português, Tiếng Việt, 简体中文, हिन्दी, Bahasa Indonesia, 日本語, 한국어, Nederlands, Dansk, Svenska, Norsk, ไทย
• Questions in languages other than German/English are translated automatically with Apple's translator – the German original is always shown
• Bilingual mode: every question also shown in the original German, so you learn the exact terms used in the exam
• Read-aloud for every question
• Exam vocabulary: 69 German terms with article, translation, pronunciation and flashcards
• Practise the exam in German only

YOUR PERSONAL AI DRIVING TUTOR
• Understand every question: the AI tutor explains it in simple words and answers follow-up questions
• Runs privately on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence – no data leaves your device

LEARN SMARTER
• Smart sessions repeat exactly what you haven’t mastered yet (spaced repetition)
• Mistake trainer and bookmarks
• Exam readiness score, daily goal, streak and daily reminder
• Home and Lock Screen widgets: readiness, streak and exam countdown
• Sign Blitz: name as many signs as you can in 60 seconds

EXAM-STYLE SIMULATION
• 30 questions, 45 minutes, error points – modelled on the theory test rules
• Result history and mistake review

FAIR PRICE – NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Start free: 96 questions, 1 exam simulation, Sign Blitz
• 30-day pass: pay once, ends automatically – never renews
• Lifetime: pay once, keep forever

IMPORTANT NOTICE
Contains 360+ original, unofficial practice questions written from the German Road Traffic Regulations (StVO). This is NOT the official question catalogue and is not affiliated with TÜV, DEKRA or any authority. Traffic rules change – content may be outdated or contain errors. Provided without warranty; passing the exam is not guaranteed. Use it alongside your driving school and official materials. The AI tutor requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence; AI answers can be wrong.

name: Famelion
description:
Famelion hilft älteren Menschen und ihren Familien, Betrugsversuche früh zu erkennen. Ich habe die App für meine eigenen Großeltern begonnen: große Schrift, ruhige Bedienung, Vorlesen auf Knopfdruck.

NACHRICHT PRÜFEN
Sie bekommen eine SMS, eine WhatsApp oder einen Anruf und sind unsicher? Text einfügen oder abtippen, Famelion schätzt ein, ob es nach einer bekannten Masche aussieht, zum Beispiel „Hallo Mama, neue Nummer“, falsche Polizisten, Gewinnversprechen oder angebliche Bankmitarbeiter. Die Prüfung läuft auf meinem eigenen Server in der EU. Der Text wird dafür nicht gespeichert.

WARNUNGEN AUS IHRER GEGEND
Famelion zeigt aktuelle Warnungen, etwa von der Polizei, und gemeldete Maschen in Ihrer Umgebung. Wichtige Warnungen kommen als Mitteilung aufs iPhone.

DIE FAMILIE IM BOOT
Angehörige können Sie beim Einrichten unterstützen und werden auf Wunsch benachrichtigt, wenn etwas nicht stimmt. Was die Familie sehen darf, bestimmen Sie selbst und können es jederzeit ändern.

MASCHEN-RADAR UND TIPPS
Kurze, verständliche Erklärungen zu den häufigsten Tricks, damit Sie sie beim nächsten Mal sofort erkennen.

TREFF UND SPIELE-SALOON
Austausch mit anderen in der Nähe und Gedächtnisspiele im Western-Saloon, mit Vorlesen und großer Schrift.

EINFACH ZU BEDIENEN
- große Schrift und klare Knöpfe
- Vorlesen jeder Seite
- funktioniert auch mit wenig Erfahrung am Handy
- Hinweis-Seite, wenn das Internet fehlt

DATENSCHUTZ
Keine Werbung, kein Verkauf von Daten, kein Tracking. Die KI läuft auf meinem Server in der EU. Ihr Konto können Sie jederzeit selbst löschen.

Wichtig: Famelion gibt Einschätzungen und Hinweise. Eine KI kann sich irren. Im Zweifel legen Sie auf und rufen die Person unter der Ihnen bekannten Nummer zurück, im Notfall die 110.

Famelion ist zum Start kostenlos.

name: Famespot: Filming Locations
description:
Famespot shows you the real places behind your favorite movies, series, music videos and video games.

• OVER 5,000 PLACES WORLDWIDE
Filming locations, landmarks, celebrity-related places, music video spots and video game locations on an interactive map.

• NEARBY ALERTS
As you walk around, Famespot notifies you when you pass near a place, even when the app is closed if you allow it.

• THEMED TOURS
Follow ready-made routes (hip-hop, series, rock, sports, most visited…) and see the itinerary on the map. Rate the tours you enjoyed.

• SEARCH AND FILTERS
Browse places by country, city or theme, and filter by category or decade.

• DETAILED PLACE PAGES
Current photo, address, description, other places from the same universe, and one-tap directions in your navigation app.

• 8 LANGUAGES
French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese and Japanese.

• FREE, NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up, no targeted ads. Your location stays on your phone: it is never sold or shared.

Famespot is not affiliated with any studio, artist, brand or rights holder. Titles and names mentioned are used only to describe the places.

name: Fax Booth
description:
Walk in, pay once, leave.

Fax Booth sends a fax from your iPhone for one flat price, with no subscription and no account. If it isn't delivered after 4 tries, your credit comes back on its own.

SEND A FAX IN A MINUTE
• Take photos of your pages, or choose photos or a PDF you already have.
• See the exact black-and-white page we send, before you pay.
• A free cover page comes with every fax.

KNOW IT ARRIVED
You get a receipt with the fax carrier's own numbers: pages transferred, call length and time. Save it as a PDF.

IF THE LINE IS BUSY, WE KEEP TRYING
You can close the app. We try up to 4 times and tell you how it ended. A number that can't take a fax? Fix it and send again without retaking anything.

NEED TO RECEIVE A FAX?
Rent your own fax number for 7 or 30 days. It doesn't renew. Faxes you get open right in the app, and Save puts the PDF in the Files app.

PRICES
• 1 fax, up to 5 pages: $0.99
• 5 faxes: $3.99
• 15 faxes: $9.99
• Fax number: $2.99 for 7 days, $6.99 for 30 days
Credits don't expire. Nothing renews.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up. A recovery code moves your credits to a new phone. We delete your pages within about 24 hours of the final result. The App Store handles every payment, and we never see your card.

US and Canada fax numbers only.

name: Featherclip: Video Compressor
description:
Featherclip makes big videos small enough to send, share, or keep, without them ever leaving your iPhone.

Pick a size and Featherclip fits it. Choose Email (25 MB) or another common limit, or type your own, and it works out the best quality that fits. Or pick a preset for a quick shrink.

FIT ANY SIZE LIMIT
• Set a target size in MB and get a file that fits
• High, Medium, and Small presets for quick compression
• HEVC for the smallest files, or H.264 for older devices and websites
• Keeps HDR when it can

EDIT BEFORE YOU SHRINK
• Trim to just the part you need
• Crop to square, 9:16, 4:5, or 16:9
• Change the speed from 0.5× to 4×, with natural-sounding audio

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your device. Your videos are never uploaded.
• Location and other metadata are removed by default
• No account, no sign-up

WORKS THE WAY YOU DO
• Compress several videos at once
• Tap Share in Photos and choose Featherclip to compress without opening the app
• Save to Photos or share in a tap, and optionally delete the original

FREE. NO ADS.
Featherclip is free, with no ads and no subscription. If it saves you some space, there's an optional tip jar. Tips don't unlock anything. They just say thanks.

name: FEDECOLDE
description: Herramienta para deportistas licenciados. Sistemas de resultados en Tiempo Real. Anuncio de Eventos. Entrenador personal de deportes electrónicos.

name: FieldSketch
description:
Plan the day, document work on site, and turn field records into reports. FieldSketch brings project tasks, work logs, inspections, measurements, and material transactions together on your iPhone.
- Plan and track site work. Schedule tasks, set reminders, track milestones, and see project progress based on completed tasks.
- Document what happened. Capture work logs with photos, record measurements by point, run inspection checklists, and track issues through resolution.
- Follow material movements. Log receipts, usage, returns, and adjustments. View stock on hand and review the transactions behind it.
- Explore trends and share reports. Compare projects, review output and measurement trends, and open the source records behind chart points. Export PDF reports, CSV data, and chart images.
- Use practical field tools. Convert units, calculate area, volume, and slope, check device inclination, convert between WGS 84 and Web Mercator, and draw sketches linked to field records.
FieldSketch works offline. Keep your records and attachments on your device, then export a backup or share a report when you choose.

name: Fincaria: Cadastre & SIGPAC
description:
Independent, unofficial app. Not affiliated with the Spanish Cadastre, FEGA, the Agenzia delle Entrate or any government body. Data from public sources (Spanish Directorate General for Cadastre, FEGA, Agenzia delle Entrate), with no legal value.

Tap the map and see your plot. No need to pick a province or town first: Fincaria finds any piece of land in Spain and Italy from its cadastral reference, its address, its polígono and parcela, or its coordinates.

Made for people with land: farmers, owners of a finca or a casa rural, anyone buying or inheriting a plot, and the agronomists, estate agents and surveyors who work with land every day.

FIND ANY PLOT
• Search by Spanish cadastral reference (14 or 20 characters), address, «polígono 8 parcela 20», Italian foglio and particella, or coordinates, all in one box
• «Where am I?»: puts you on the map and tells you which plot you are standing on
• Aerial photo, map and terrain relief
• Clear plot card with area, land use and crops, in English
• Buildings in Spain: floors above and below ground, year and use, and the list of flats, shops and garages with their area

SIGPAC FIELD BY FIELD
In Spain you see the SIGPAC enclosures (recintos) with their land use and slope. Exactly what you need for the PAC farm subsidy, or to know what is really on a plot before you buy it.

MY LAND, ALWAYS AT HAND
• Save your plots with a name, notes and photos
• Reminders for what you cannot forget, like the PAC deadline
• They work with no signal: out in the countryside they are still there
• PDF card to show or send (our own design, with no legal value)

MEASURE BY WALKING
Measure area and distance by tapping the map, or walk the boundary with GPS and Fincaria draws the outline and gives you the hectares and acres. Approximate measurement: for legal boundaries, ask a surveyor.

FOR PROFESSIONALS
• Clients and folders
• PDF with your logo
• Export to KML, DXF and GeoJSON
• Lists of hundreds of plots: paste the references and you are done
• Share with your client by link, nothing to install

FREE AND PLANS
Search, plot cards, «Where am I?» and map layers are free, with 2 saved plots and one measurement a day. The 7-day pass (paid once, does not renew) and the Fincas subscription unlock unlimited plots, notes, photos, reminders, offline use, unlimited measuring and the PDF card. Profesional adds clients and folders, your logo, export, lists and sharing. No ads and no account needed.

Coverage: Spain and Italy. Navarre and the Basque Country keep their own land registry, so only SIGPAC is shown there; Trento and Bolzano are not included in Italy.

Privacy: https://basel1905.com/fincaria/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://basel1905.com/fincaria/terms.html

name: Fishbone: Tiny Steps
description:
Stuck on something you keep putting off? Fishbone breaks it into small steps, then shows you only the next one.

GET IT OUT OF YOUR HEAD
Type or say what's on your mind. AI turns it into small steps, or you can write your own.

SEE ONE THING
Your next step sits front and centre, with everything else out of sight. Tick it off and the next one appears.

DO IT FOR ME
Hand a step to the AI. It can research, make a plan or draft a message, then save the result with your task.

STILL TOO BIG?
Make any step smaller with one tap.

FOCUS MODE AND WIDGET
Work on one step on a quiet screen, with a short timer if you want one. A home-screen widget shows your current step, and you can tick it off right there.

BUILT FOR ADHD BRAINS, AND ANYONE STUCK ON THE START
Fishbone is a planning tool. It doesn't diagnose or treat any condition.

FISHBONE PRO
Your first fishbone is free. After that, Fishbone Pro is a monthly auto-renewing subscription that includes 10 fishbones and 5 autocompletes each month. A fishbone is a brain dump or "make it smaller". An autocomplete is one "Do it for me". Top-ups are available for more. Writing your own steps is unlimited.

Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://fishboneapp.com/terms
Privacy: https://fishboneapp.com/privacy

name: Fisk-e: Tabletop Flick Racing
description:
Pull back, aim and flick! Fisk-e is a tabletop racing game where you guide your cap to the finish line with one finger.

150 LEVELS, 5 WORLDS
Race across a desk, a kitchen, the city streets, a frozen lake and a neon playroom. Every world brings new surfaces and surprises: puddles, potholes, slippery ice, conveyor belts and more.

EASY TO PLAY, HARD TO MASTER
• Drag back to set the power, release to flick
• Add spin to curve your shot around corners
• Fly over fences with trampolines, use boosters, magnets and fans
• Finish with few flicks and no falls to earn 3 stars

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Endless Table: the track keeps building as you play
• Table of the Day: a new challenge every day
• Against the Clock, Limited Flicks and Dark Table modes
• 2 Players: take turns on one phone and challenge a friend

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Unlock caps, flags and trails, complete sets for rewards, open boxes and spin the Lucky Flick every day.

GAME CENTER
Compete on the Endless, Table of the Day and Total Stars leaderboards. Your progress is saved to iCloud.

Fisk-e is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: FitKey
description:
FitKey（フィットキー）は「進化するキーボード」です。
画面の大きさや持ち方に合わせて形を変え、使うほど言葉を覚えて、あなた専用に育っていきます。

■ あなたの手に合わせる（無料）
・キーボードの高さ・幅・左右の位置を自由に調整
・片手で打ちやすいミニモード
・iPhone横向き、iPhone Duoを開いた時、iPadでは広い画面向けの配置に自動で切り替え

■ 空いた場所がトラックパッドに
・キーボードの横の空いた所を指でなぞるだけでカーソル移動
・よく使う絵文字をトラックパッドの上に表示、すべての絵文字もワンタップ
・スペースキー長押しでもカーソル移動

■ 無料で使える便利機能
