name: Fitted Wardrobe Planner
description:
Plan a fitted wardrobe between two side walls, from alcove measurements to materials, an interactive 3D preview and preliminary workshop schedules.

PLANNING AID & SITE VERIFICATION
This is a concept and workshop planning aid, not a verified survey, structural report, manufacturing approval or quotation. Verify the opening, material thickness, hardware, fixings and site conditions before ordering or cutting. Hardware-specific clearances and load capacity need checking with the selected system.

MEASURE IN MILLIMETRES OR US INCHES
Enter top and bottom widths, left and right heights and usable depth in millimetres, decimal inches or common fractions. Switching units preserves canonical millimetres, using exact 1 in = 25.4 mm. Cut output keeps millimetres with approximate inch references. Spread warnings highlight variations; width readings do not identify individual wall taper.

PLAN THE CONSTRUCTION
Choose 1–6 bays, hinged doors or sliding panels, long hang, double hang or shelves, and 0–4 internal drawers per bay. Plan a 30–100 mm levelling base, independent side scribe margins and a fitted ceiling fascia. Supported sliding-track deck and headers are included in the planning output. Blocking issues stop cutting and export; warnings still require review.

CHOOSE MATERIALS & FINISHES
Select construction material, offered thickness and finish separately for carcass, fronts and back. The bundled generic catalogue includes painted MR MDF, melamine-faced chipboard, oak-veneered MDF, birch plywood and 6 mm MDF backs. Painted MDF accepts preset colours or a custom sRGB hex colour. Visible side margins and ceiling fascia can match carcass or fronts; supporting base and track boards follow the carcass. Grain, edge treatment and sheet stock follow each material. Different finishes never share a nested sheet.

SEE IT IN YOUR ROOM
Use the Finishes step or return from Preview. Change wall colours and choose oak boards, light or dark laminate, tiles, carpet or polished concrete with tone options. Room choices change the preview only. Rotate and zoom the offline 3D wardrobe; toggle doors open or closed. Woodgrain and room textures are generated locally. On-screen colours are approximate - check physical samples before ordering.

WORKSHOP OUTPUT
Review assembly-grouped parts with raw and finished dimensions, material, thickness, finish and edge treatment. Inspect sheet layouts labelled by stock, finish and size. Share PDF, cut-list CSV and hardware CSV through the device share sheet. All outputs remain preliminary planning documents.

PRIVATE, LOCAL PLANNING
No account, advertising, analytics or tracking SDK. One project is saved in private on-device storage, including material and room choices. No room photos, camera access or network catalogue. Exports are generated on request in private temporary cache and handed to the destination you choose.

ONE UPFRONT PURCHASE
All planning features are included. No in-app purchases or subscriptions. The interface is in English.

name: Fjord Fruit Odyssey
description:
Et lite drag. En myk bue. Et eple som lander rett i kurven.

Velkommen til Fjord Fruit Odyssey, et fargerikt ferdighetsspill inspirert av norske fjorder og frukthager. Hold på frukten, dra bakover og slipp. Finn den gode buen, ta høyde for fjordbrisen og samle dagens innhøsting.

REIS LANGS FJORDEN
Oppdag 24 håndlagde utfordringer fordelt på fire stemningsfulle områder: Hardanger, Sognefjorden, Nordfjord og Midnattssol. Underveis møter du bevegelige kurver, steiner og skiftende vind. Her handler det om gode kast, litt tålmodighet og gleden ved å prøve igjen.

ET NYTT LITE RITUAL
Dagens innhøsting gir deg en ny utfordring hver dag. Spill så mange ganger du vil, og prøv å slå din egen beste poengsum. Ingen nedtelling. Bare deg, frukten og kurven.

HVER FRUKT HAR EN HISTORIE
Fyll fruktboka med epler, pærer, plommer og flere fargerike bekjentskaper. Les små fakta og enkle tips om å ta vare på maten. Appelsinen er en solfylt gjest i denne fantasihagen!

FINN DIN EGEN RYTME
• Dra, sikt og slipp med én finger.
• Se kastets bue før du slipper.
• Samle opptil tre stjerner på hvert nivå.
• Treff på rad gir flere poeng.
• Øv i fred med ubegrensede kast.
• Lås opp seks frukter og seks mestringsmerker.
• Tilpass spilllyder, følbare tilbakemeldinger og visuelle effekter.
• Spill liggende på iPhone, helt uten nett.

Ingen konto, reklame eller kjøp i appen. Fremdriften lagres på enheten din. Hele spillet er på norsk bokmål.

name: Fleet Checkout
description:
Fleet Checkout helps authorized staff inspect shared vehicles, record checkout and return mileage, and keep signed forms and supporting evidence together.

Mark damage on the vehicle diagram, compare existing marks with new return damage, capture vehicle photos, and scan gas receipts with Apple’s document scanner. Assigned reviewers can inspect returned vehicles and approve their availability. Administrators manage vehicles, staff access and completed-form recipients.

Use the same account and submitted records on the native app and web workspace. An internet connection and authorization from your fleet administrator are required.

name: Flik: A New Way to Share
description:
Give it a flick. Watch it arrive.

Flik turns nearby sharing into something you can see and feel. Choose original photos, videos or links, pick your Mac, iPhone or iPad, then make a small wrist flick or swipe the floating paper upward.

PHOTOS, VIDEOS AND LINKS — FREE
Browse your accessible Photos library or share supported items from compatible apps. Videos preview muted. Received links open in the default browser. Select a stack and send one at a time or send it together.

A LITTLE MAGIC ON YOUR MAC
The free Flik Connector brings arrivals onto your display as floating papers. Save to Downloads by default, choose Clipboard mode, move papers by an edge, or gather them into a stack. Drag a grouped stack to Desktop or a Finder folder, or save it into a folder you name. Mac sending supports file selection and drag and drop to nearby devices.

IPHONE AND IPAD, TOO
Choose a nearby device without a QR code for mobile-to-mobile sharing. Keep Flik open on the receiver and tap Accept, or open Receive to wait for nearby invitations. Save arrivals to Photos or Files through their previews. Adaptive layouts support iPhone, iPad and compatible Duo displays.

ORIGINALS, ON YOUR CHOSEN DEVICES
Flik prepares and verifies original files before release. The developer does not run a cloud inbox or file relay. iCloud-only originals download before sending. Library is persistent local storage, not an expiring cache.

FLIK PRO FOR DOCUMENTS AND FILES
Free download. Photos, videos and links stay free. Unlock document/file sending for US$1.99 per month or US$14.99 lifetime. Localized App Store prices apply. Monthly subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before renewal; manage or cancel in Apple Account settings. Lifetime is a separate one-time purchase. Restore eligible purchases in Flik Settings.

GETTING STARTED
For Mac transfers, AirDrop the bundled signed and notarized Connector to your Mac, drag it into Applications and open it once. Add devices in Flik to pair, then reconnect when nearby. Compatible Mac with macOS 14+ required; mobile app requires iOS/iPadOS 17+. Wi-Fi/Bluetooth and Local Network access are needed. Keep Flik foregrounded on receiving iPhones/iPads; iOS can suspend background apps. Performance depends on devices, network conditions and iCloud download time.

No separate Flik account required. Independent; not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

Privacy: https://flik-declann.declann-tan-9532.chatgpt.site/privacy.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Floesaw
description:
Before refrigerators, people cut their ice out of a frozen pond.

In Floe Saw you mark the pond, saw the blocks, and pole them down an open channel to the icehouse. Straight cuts give good blocks. Rushed cuts wander, and thin ice will not forgive you.

Your breath is the clock. Watch it fade along the top of the screen.

- Lay your own grid, then saw every line by hand
- Floating blocks that bob, drift and bump
- Icehouse orders that want blocks in a set order and size
- Thin ice, snowfall and edges that thaw through the day
- A full season across five ponds
- A shared season total from every player

Cold hands, straight lines.

name: Floorprint: LiDAR Room Scanner
description:
Floorprint measures rooms with the LiDAR sensor of your iPhone and turns them into a floor plan with dimensions.

Important first: the app needs an iPhone with a LiDAR sensor (iPhone 12 Pro or newer, Pro models only) and iOS 17 or later. On other devices it cannot scan rooms.

HOW IT WORKS
Give the room a name, walk through it slowly and point the camera at walls, doors, windows and furniture. The app uses Apple's RoomPlan for this. After saving, you see the floor plan with wall lengths. Pinch to zoom in.

WHAT IS MEASURED
• Walls, doors, windows and openings
• Floor area and ceiling height
• Furniture and objects such as bed, sofa or table, with their dimensions

ONE ROOM OR THE WHOLE APARTMENT
• Whole apartment in one scan: you get the layout in one shared coordinate system. Over long distances the scan can drift by up to about 10 cm.
• Room by room: usually more accurate. In the developer's own test, wall lengths were within about 1 to 3 cm of a laser distance meter.
• Rooms scanned in the same session can be merged into one apartment model.

EXPORT
For each room you can export:
• A readable summary as JSON, in meters, rounded to the millimeter, with a confidence level
• Apple's raw data as JSON
• A 3D model as USDZ
• The floor plan as SVG

Share via the share sheet or the Files app.

TIPS FOR GOOD SCANS
The app shows short hints. For example: close roller shutters in front of glass walls, and keep some distance from mirrors or capture them only briefly. Glass and mirrors can confuse the sensor.

PRIVACY
• Free, no ads
• No account, no tracking, no analytics
• The app sends no data to the developer or to third parties
• Your scans stay on your device unless you share them yourself

TIP JAR (OPTIONAL)
If you like the app, you can leave a small tip in the app, in three sizes. It is a pure thank-you and unlocks nothing. All features are always free.

IMPORTANT NOTE ON ACCURACY
Measurements are approximate. Floorprint is not a substitute for professional surveying. Please check important dimensions, for example before buying furniture or materials, with a tape measure or a laser distance meter.


In German the app is called Heim-Scan.

name: Foldboard
description:
Foldboard is a keyboard made for iPhone Duo: type with one hand, left or right, or with both hands on the open screen.

IT FOLLOWS YOUR HAND
• It looks at how you hold the phone and comes to that side on its own.
• With both hands on the open Duo, it splits in two, one half under each thumb. On the outer screen, it goes full width.
• A thumb swipe or a tap on the other side moves it right away.

MADE FOR YOUR THUMB
• One hand left, one hand right, full width or two hands.
• Adjust the width, the distance from the edge and the key height.
• Your usual phrases above the keys and your emoji in the free space: one tap.

ALL THE BASICS
• QWERTY and AZERTY, accents on long press.
• Auto-correction and word suggestions.
• Capital letter at the start of a sentence, double space for a period.
• Slide on the space bar to move the cursor.

MAKE IT YOURS
• 8 color themes and 4 fonts.
• 4 typing sounds and the vibration strength you like.

PRIVATE
Foldboard never sends what you type. No internet access, no account, no ads. Full Access is only used for vibrations, sounds and your settings.

TRIAL AND PURCHASE
Every feature is free for 3 days, with no subscription. After that, Foldboard Pro is a one-time purchase. One-hand typing, full width, QWERTY and AZERTY stay free.

name: Foldmaxxing
description:
Your iPhone Duo was made for this.

FOLD IT. COUNT IT.
Every time you fold or unfold your Duo = +1. That's it. That's the game. And it's weirdly addictive.

30-SECOND SPEEDRUN
3... 2... 1... FOLD! How many can you do in 30 seconds? Post your record and dare your friends to beat it.

FAKE SCREEN BREAKS
Glowing hinge lines, dead pixels, half the screen going black... They look SO real. Share them and watch your friends panic. (Relax - your screen is fine.)

27 SECRET HINGE SOUNDS
The creak plays live while the hinge moves - faster = louder. Creaky coffin lid, rusty gate, submarine hatch, glitchy modem... Nobody tells you how to unlock them.

LEADERBOARDS
World and country rankings for today, this week and all time. Finish in the top 3 of your country and win a gold, silver or bronze cup.

STREAKS
Fold every day and keep the fire alive.

SECRET ACHIEVEMENTS
34 achievements. No hints. Figure them out yourself.

Plus: live 3D hinge, home-screen widget with your all-time total, Game Center, English and Russian.

Made for iPhone Duo - the app needs a foldable iPhone to count folds.

How many times can YOU fold?

name: Foldorder
description:
Foldorder is for anyone who prints a short zine, handout, or booklet on a copier and needs the page numbers on each sheet before they fold.

Without it you copy a table from a website, or you fold a test sheet and find page 3 on the back of the cover. Foldorder builds that table for the job in your hand.

NEW JOB
Name the booklet. Type how many pages it should have. Choose A4 or Letter, saddle fold or single leaf. If the count is not a multiple of four, Foldorder pads to the next multiple and tells you.

READ THE SHEET
Each screen is one piece of paper. The numbers are the pages that print on this side. Flip to the back of the same sheet. Saddle fold shows a left and right page with the gutter in the middle. Single leaf shows one page on the front and one on the back.

FOLD AND MARK
Open Folded order to see reading order: 1, then 2|3, then 4|5, through the back cover. Stamp Folded or Sewn on a sheet you already finished. The next unfinished sheet sits on top when you open the job again.

EXPORT
Export schematic makes a PDF of every sheet, front over back, through the system share sheet. Foldorder does not send pages to a printer and does not lay out your text.

Try a 16-page sample from an empty home screen. Jobs stay on this iPhone. No account and no sign-in.

name: Foldyard
description:
Το Foldyard συγκρίνει δύο χάρτινα αεροπλάνα με πραγματικές ρίψεις στο ίδιο πεδίο. Είναι για μάθημα, για οικογένεια, ή για όποιον θέλει το δίπλωμα που ταιριάζει σήμερα, όχι τη μία τυχερή πτήση.

Γράφεις το μέγεθος του χαρτιού, το άνοιγμα φτερών και το δίπλωμα. Διαλέγεις μία ερώτηση: απόσταση, χρόνο στον αέρα, ή πόσο απέχει η προσγείωση από τον στόχο. Οι ρίψεις εναλλάσσονται, ώστε κάθε σχέδιο να πετά με τον ίδιο ρίπτη και τον ίδιο άνεμο.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς

1. Στην αριστερή κάρτα δημιούργησε την έκδοση αναφοράς. Στη δεξιά αντέγραψέ την και άλλαξε το δίπλωμα. Μπορείς επίσης να ανοίξεις το επεξεργάσιμο παράδειγμα και να αλλάξεις τους αριθμούς.
2. Διάλεξε την ερώτηση: απόσταση, αιώρηση ή απόκλιση.
3. Άνοιξε τη σειρά ρίψεων και φτιάξε τους γύρους. Με δύο σχέδια, ο ένας γύρος είναι ΑΒ και ο επόμενος ΒΑ.
4. Πάτησε έναρξη δοκιμής. Χρονομέτρησε με το μεγάλο κουμπί, γράψε τη μετρημένη απόσταση και σημείωσε πού προσγειώθηκε.
5. Άνοιξε τη σύγκριση. Η γραμμή είναι το εύρος των πραγματικών αποτελεσμάτων. Το λευκό σημάδι είναι η διάμεσος. Ο ρόμβος είναι η μία καλύτερη ρίψη. Μια υψηλότερη καλύτερη ρίψη μπορεί να χάνει, αν η διάμεσος είναι χαμηλότερη.
6. Κάνε εξαγωγή του διαγράμματος ως εικόνα και των καταγραφών ως λογιστικό φύλλο. Μπορείς να βγάλεις όλο το πείραμα ή μόνο το τρέχον φίλτρο.

Ο κενός χρόνος μένει κενός και δεν αποθηκεύεται ως μηδέν. Η άκυρη ρίψη μένει στο αρχείο με τον λόγο της και μένει έξω από τη διάμεσο. Αν αλλάξεις ένα αεροπλάνο που έχει ήδη πετάξει, η εφαρμογή φτιάχνει νέα έκδοση. Οι παλιές ρίψεις κρατούν το δίπλωμα με το οποίο έγιναν.

Χωρίς λογαριασμό και χωρίς δίκτυο. Οι δοκιμές μένουν στη συσκευή.

name: Fool's Hand
description:
The sun does not rise, and the world has fallen asleep on its feet.
On the morning the deck that decided fate was overturned, a "Fool" who has spilled every memory opens his eyes.

Fool's Hand is a pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder built on the tarot's "Fool's Journey." Fight with poker hands, collect Charms to build your own style, meet the twenty-one broken Arcana one by one, and win back the memories you lost.

■ How you fight
• Every turn you are dealt eight cards and play up to five of them as a poker hand.
• [Attack] deals Chips × Mult as damage. [Guard] turns your Chips into Block.
• Cards pop up one by one as the score stacks. The bigger the numbers get, the bigger the screen and sound get with them.
• A monster's next move (its intent) is always visible, so reading the board and picking your build decide the fight.
• Swap cards with your Wheel cards, and wait for the right moment to go for the hand you want.

■ Build your own deck
• More than 100 Charms. Place Charms whose effects depend on their order into your 5 slots.
• 48 Blessings to choose after each battle. Level them up and pair them to evolve them.
• Card enhancements (Bonus, Mult, Wild, Glass, Steel, Stone, Gilded, Lucky) and editions (Foil, Holo, Poly).
• Seal a monster's Soul onto a card at the altar, or fuse two Souls into a new Charm.
• Light the Constellations with Stardust to stack permanent upgrades.

■ The story
• Three Acts and the final "World." Every Act has a Gatekeeper and an Arcana boss waiting.
• The bosses are not enemies. They are "Unplayed Fates." The moment they fall, they turn upright again and say what they always wanted to say.
• The Dealer at the Green Table, Granny Coin, Yeoul the altar keeper, rival Jack, and Thirteen at the death registration window. New conversations open every time you return.
• Dark but hopeful, with a spoonful of humor. There are four endings.

■ Modes
• The Fool's Journey: the main mode, through three Acts and the World to an ending. Clear it to unlock Fate Grades (difficulty).
• The Endless Tower: an endless mode where the Acts never stop. How high you climb is your record.
• Today's Fortune: a daily challenge once a day, where everyone plays the same deal with the rule of the day. Your score goes on this device's ranking.
• Codex: your own book of monsters, Charms, Blessings, poker hands, endings and Memory Fragments.

■ Recommended for
• Anyone who likes card games that score with poker hands
• Anyone looking for a short roguelike that keeps you saying "one more round"
• Anyone who likes pixel art, tarot atmosphere, and a quiet, strangely warm story

■ Easy to enjoy
• Animation speed 1x / 2x / 3x, screen shake off, reduced motion, reduced flashing, vibration on or off
• One tap to choose, press and hold for details
• Keep playing offline; your journey is saved automatically after every action
• Landscape only. Available in Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), German, French and Russian

■ Our fair-play promise
• This is the first version. There are no ads and no purchases: everything is open from the start.
• No sign-in needed. Your progress is saved only on your device, and the app collects no personal data.
• There are no gacha pulls, energy limits, paid revives, sold power-ups, or season passes.

* Fool's Hand uses poker hands, but it is a card game with no real-money betting. In-game Gold is virtual currency and cannot be exchanged for cash.

Credits (art, music, fonts): https://foolshand.hivemindlabs.co/support/#credits

name: ForceBag
description:
ForceBag은 메모 목록을 활용해 예측과 선택 연출을 구성하는 공연·연습용 도구입니다.

여러 메모를 만들고 각 목록에서 원하는 항목을 지정한 뒤, 공연 화면의 두 자리 숫자 입력과 함께 선택한 위치에 항목을 표시할 수 있습니다. 편집 화면에는 원래 작성한 순서가 유지됩니다.

주요 기능
• 여러 메모와 항목 목록 저장 및 편집
• 메모별 연출 항목 지정
• 손가락 움직임을 따라가는 홈 화면 페이지 전환
• 라이트·다크 테마와 메모 글자 크기 조절
• 개인 사진 배경과 블러 강도 설정
• 화면 비율 선택

메모와 설정, 선택한 배경 사진은 기기에 저장됩니다. 계정 가입이나 인터넷 연결 없이 사용할 수 있습니다.

이 앱의 홈 화면과 아이콘은 공연용 화면입니다. 다른 앱을 실행하거나 해당 서비스에 접속하는 기능은 제공하지 않습니다.

name: Forensics Bluetooth Logger
description: The Forensics Detectors Bluetooth Data Logger streams real-time measurements from your FD-600M gas analyzer directly to your smartphone. Logged data is saved to a file for straightforward export, manipulation, and in-depth analysis.

name: Fourstack RPN Calculator
description:
Fourstack is a scientific calculator built around a four-level RPN stack, with the look and feel of a classic LCD calculator.

CALCULATE
- RPN with x, y, z, t stack, or algebraic entry
- f and g shift functions: trigonometry, logarithms, powers and roots, statistics, combinations and permutations, polar and rectangular conversion
- FIX, SCI and ENG display formats, digit grouping
- Full precision shown below the result

LEARN AS YOU GO
- Hold any key to see what it does, with an example and its effect on the stack

UNITS
- Convert length, area, volume and more with two wheels, then apply the result to x

VOICE
- Hold the voice key and speak a calculation
- Recognised entirely on your iPhone; your voice never leaves the device

MAKE IT YOURS
- Four built-in skins and a Workshop to design your own
- Share a skin as a picture and a file

SCREENSAVER
- Solar system with real planet data from NASA fact sheets
- Or the weather for a city you choose, from Apple Weather

ALSO
- Home screen widgets
- Settings and your own skins sync through your iCloud

PRIVACY
Fourstack collects no data. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your voice is recognised on your iPhone and never leaves it. Fourstack never asks for your location.

name: FQCPro
description:
FQC Pro is a real-time audio frequency counter and signal analysis tool for iPhone.

Measure audio frequencies using your iPhone’s built-in microphone. FQC Pro displays frequency in Hz or kHz, identifies musical notes, and monitors signal levels in real time.

Go beyond frequency measurement with FFT spectrum analysis and a live waterfall display. Explore frequency components, adjust FFT resolution, select waterfall frequency ranges and colour themes, capture spectrum data, and export results as CSV files.

Designed for audio testing, electronics, signal analysis and anyone who wants to explore the frequencies around them.

name: Freegram Chat
description:
Freegram — домашний мессенджер для своих: соседей по дому и району, клубов, команд и друзей. Здесь уже общается наше сообщество — теперь и в приложении для iPhone.

• Личные чаты и группы, голосовые и видеозвонки
• Фото, видео, голосовые сообщения и кружочки
• Своя страничка: расскажите о себе постами и фото
• Каталог открытых групп вашего города
• Закреплённые сообщения, поиск по переписке, ответ прямо из уведомления
• Тёмная тема

Безопасность. Перед началом каждый принимает правила сообщества. На любое сообщение, человека или группу можно пожаловаться, любого — заблокировать. Жалобы рассматриваем в течение суток.

Вход — по адресу почты и коду: без пароля и без номера телефона.

name: Frequency Master Lite
description:
Frequency Master Lite, from INVC (Industrial Noise & Vibration Centre), helps you capture and understand a noise problem – the hum from a transformer, the whine of a fan, the drone of distant machinery.

Press Start and the app records the sound and a video together for 20 seconds (or as long as you choose), showing the frequency spectrum building up as it records. It then shows you:

• A time plot of the noise level over the recording, in dB(A), dB(C) and/or dB(Z) 
• A frequency plot showing which pitches the sound contains, with narrow band, octave and 1/3-octave views 
• Tones marked automatically with their frequency, so you can see exactly what pitch a hum or whine is 
• A cursor to read off the frequency and level at any point

Select part of the recording to analyse just that section, and zoom in on either plot.

SHARE OR SAVE A REPORT 
Add your details, where the recording was made, a description of the noise and up to five photos, then send everything (plot images, data files, photos and the video) by email or messaging, or save it in a folder of its own on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
No account, no adverts, no tracking and no internet connection. Everything stays on your iPhone or iPad unless you choose to share it.

ABOUT THE LEVELS 
Phone and tablet microphones are not measurement microphones. Until you calibrate, the app uses a typical figure for iPhone microphones, which gives a sensible starting point, but levels remain approximate, even after calibrating against a sound of known level (Menu › Calibrate). Tonal frequencies are reliable without calibration, and how far a tone stands out from the background is a good guide. The app is not a calibrated or certified sound level meter, and its results are not suitable for legal, regulatory or compliance purposes. See Help › Accuracy & limitations in the app.

For better accuracy you can connect a USB measurement microphone and calibrate it; each microphone keeps its own calibration.

PERMISSIONS 
• Microphone – to measure and record sound (required) 
• Camera – to record video with the measurement and show a live picture on the opening screen (optional) 
• Location – only if you tap "Use my GPS location" in the report form (optional)

name: FretMitra Strum
description:
FretMitra Strum is a strumming coach for your guitar. Pick a pattern, hear it played on a recorded acoustic guitar, and strum along at a tempo that suits you. When you are ready, build your own patterns stroke by stroke.

PRACTICE STRUMMING
• 31 built-in patterns, from Steady downstrokes and Old Faithful to rock, pop, reggae, ballad, boom-chick, waltz and 6/8 strums.
• Browse patterns by style or by time signature.
• See every stroke, with the count above it, light up as it plays.
• Set the tempo with − and +, the Slow, Normal and Fast presets, or tap it in on iPad.
• Turn the guitar sound and the clicks on or off, and choose the chord you hear.

CREATE YOUR OWN PATTERNS
• Strumming Pattern Creator: tap strokes onto a grid of twelve rows, from bass notes and full strums to palm mutes, muted chucks and stops.
• Shape the feel with velocity for each stroke, held notes and swing.
• Undo an edit or revert to your last save, then save your patterns on your device.
• Practice any saved pattern straight away.

DESKTOP EDITOR
• Open Pattern Creator in a web browser on a computer on the same Wi-Fi and edit your patterns on a larger screen. Everything you save there is saved on your iPhone or iPad.

SHARE YOUR WORK
• Export a pattern as a file and share it, or import one from Files.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Each screen has its own help page, explaining the strokes and how to read a pattern.

No ads, no account, no tracking and no in-app purchases. Everything is included, works offline, and stays on your device.

Made for iPhone and iPad by Secalyx Technologies LLP.

name: FrigMate
description:
Stop letting good food go to waste in the back of your refrigerator. FrigMate is the smart refrigerator, freezer, and pantry inventory manager that combines reusable NFC tags, on-device computer vision, and AI meal planning to keep your kitchen organized and effortless.

Whether you love using reusable physical NFC tags on your food containers or prefer a fast digital tracker with virtual tags, FrigMate makes checking groceries in and out take just seconds.

SMART NFC TAG SCANNING & 1-STEP CHECK-IN
• Smart Scan Routing: Simply hold your iPhone near any NFC tag. If the tag matches an item in your fridge, FrigMate opens the Check Out / Edit screen. If the tag is empty or new, it automatically opens the Add Inventory form.
• 1-Step Read & Write: Link a physical NFC tag and write the item's name, notes, quantity, unit, and storage location directly onto the tag in a single tap.
• Automatic Tag Sync: Partial check-outs update the remaining quantity stored on the NFC tag, while full check-outs automatically erase the tag so it is ready to reuse on your next container.
• No NFC Tag? No Problem: Use built-in Virtual Tags to track any item without physical NFC stickers, or choose from 55+ food icons when you don't need a photo.

SNAP A PHOTO TO IDENTIFY & COUNT ITEMS
• On-Device Vision Recognition: Take a photo or pick from your library—FrigMate automatically identifies fruits, vegetables, dairy, meats, beverages, and packaged foods using on-device Vision and OCR text recognition.
• Automatic Item Counting: Estimates how many items are in the photo and recommends the ideal storage zone (Cooler, Freezer, Crisper, Door Shelf, or Pantry) and default shelf life.

AI MEAL PLANNER & SHOPPING ASSISTANT
• Ask AI for Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner: Turn what is currently in your fridge into delicious meals. FrigMate builds a tailored chef prompt prioritizing ingredients that are expiring soon and lets you launch ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, or any AI app in one tap.
• AI Shopping List Recommendations: Ask AI to suggest groceries that pair with the ingredients you already have at home, build a weekly essentials list, or plan high-protein meal prep.

AUTO-RESTOCK SHOPPING LIST
• Automatic Restocking: When you check out the last of an item from your refrigerator, FrigMate can automatically add it to your Shopping List.
• 1-Tap Missing Staples: Quickly spot and add common kitchen staples (like eggs, milk, butter, or greens) that aren't currently in your fridge.
• Seamless Restock to Fridge: Tap "Restock" on any shopping list item to check it straight into your refrigerator with its name, quantity, unit, and storage location pre-filled.

EXPIRATION ALERTS & KITCHEN DASHBOARD
• Live Status Dashboard: See your Total items, Expiring Soon count, and Expired count at a glance, plus instant "Use First" meal suggestions.
• Custom Expiration Reminders: Separate default expiration windows for Cooler (14 days) and Freezer (30 days), with configurable early-warning notifications before food goes bad.
• Private & Offline-First: All inventory data and food photos are stored locally on your device—no account or subscription required.

name: Fungi Fieldbook.
description:
Fungi Fieldbook is a clean, fast, and minimalist app designed specifically for wild mushroom hunters, nature hikers, and amateur mycologists. Easily catalogue your mushroom sightings in the wild, log habitat characteristics, save photo records, and keep precise location notes—all in one secure place.

No forced account registration, no cloud tracking, and zero ads. Just a pure local field notebook to document your wild discoveries!

Key Features:

Detailed Sighting Profiles: Log species name, genus, caps/gill descriptions, substrate, and habitat details.

Photo & Location Journal: Store visual records and precise spot notes locally for every finding.

Smart Search & Filter: Quickly browse past sightings by habitat type, season, or species notes.

100% Private & Offline: All field logs, coordinates, and images remain strictly on your local device.

Minimalist Interface: Built on a streamlined 5-screen structure designed for quick field entries deep in the forest.

name: GameStash
description:
GameStash is your ultimate companion to discover, claim, and track 100% legal free PC and mobile games from top stores including Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG, and more!

Never pay for a game that is about to go free. GameStash aggregates verified, limited-time giveaways and store promotions in real time so you never miss a drop.

KEY FEATURES:

• 100% Legal & Verified Deals:
Browse official giveaways from Steam, Epic Games Store, GOG, and direct publisher stores. No tasks or sketchy third-party keys.

• Direct Store Access:
One tap brings you directly to the official store page where you can claim the giveaway straight into your account.

• Library & Savings Tracker:
Mark games you have claimed to keep your feed clean. Easily hide claimed games and watch your total savings counter grow with every free drop.

• Smart Countdown & Calendar Sync:
View exact time remaining before a deal expires. Add reminders directly to your Apple Calendar with a single tap.

• Powerful Filters & Sorting:
Filter by platform (Steam, Epic Games, GOG, PC), hide DLCs or loot, and sort by newest, ending soon, or most popular.

• Privacy First:
No registration, no accounts, no ads, and zero data tracking. Your preferences and claimed games stay entirely on your device.

Download GameStash now and build your dream game library without spending a dime!

name: Gatejam: Block Slide Puzzle
description:
Slide every candy block out through the gate of its colour. Simple – until the gates start moving.

Every 3 moves, all gates slide one slot on around the frame. A ring next to the move counter shows how many moves are left before the next shift, and ghost outlines show where each gate will be. So the question is never just “which block goes next?”, but “where will its gate be when the path is free?”. Free a lane, wait one move, catch the gate as it arrives.

• 60 levels in three chapters: Easy, Tricky and Hard, with a few designed head-scratchers on the way
• Every level is verified by a solver: there is always a way out within the moves you get, and perfect play earns three stars
• Out of moves? Take +5 moves for a short video or for coins, or simply try again
• Boosters when you need them: the Hammer smashes one block, Freeze holds the gates for 3 moves, Undo takes back a move (the first one in each level is free)
• A new daily level every day, the same for everyone, with a streak
• Six block skins: earn Wood, Pastel and Mono with stars and Neon with a 7-day daily streak; Candy is free, Glass comes with Remove ads
• Every block and gate is drawn in code: soft bevels, glowing gates, light and dark mode, a less-motion setting
• Plays offline, in 18 languages

Free to play with optional ads between levels from level 8 on, never after the daily level. Purchases: Remove ads (with 200 coins and the Glass skin) and a Starter pack, once each, and coin packs whenever you like. No random rewards, no loot boxes, no account.

Plan the order. Catch the gate.

name: Gather Displays
description:
Gather Displays shows your church's Gather screens on an Apple TV or iPad.

Pair a screen in seconds. Open Gather Displays and a six-digit code and QR code appear. In Gather, go to Campus → Screens → Pair a TV, then enter the code or scan the QR code with your phone. Choose which published screen it should show, and you're done.

Your screens stay current. Announcements, upcoming events, full-screen artwork and Watch video come straight from what your team publishes in Gather Campus, following its schedule. Event slides carry a QR code that takes people to the event details on their own phone.

Built for lobbies, hallways and kids' areas:
• Runs full screen and keeps the display awake
• Rotates slides automatically; use the remote (or tap on iPad) to go back, pause or skip ahead
• Plays HLS and MP4 video streams
• Hides published content immediately if the connection to Gather is lost, and reconnects on its own
• Disconnect a screen from Gather at any time, and it returns to a fresh pairing code

Private by design. Gather Displays has no sign-in, no tracking and no ads. It stores only a pairing key for the one screen it shows, and that key can't open any other part of Gather.

Requires a Gather workspace and a staff member with permission to publish screens in Campus.

name: GatherHoist
description:
Learn to recognize maritime signal flags, build flag hoists and interpret signals in context.

GatherHoist is an offline training app for the International Code of Signals. It combines a searchable reference with interactive exercises, explanations and local learning history.

GUIDED MISSIONS
Work through 20 missions with 120 sourced teaching questions. Topics include look-alike patterns, single-letter meanings, repeated letters and numerals, substitutes, the decimal exception, a complete answering exchange, context checks and a mixed assessment.

BUILD AND CHECK HOISTS
Arrange flags in order, repair a starting hoist, use substitutes and check your response. Hints, explanations and step-by-step replay help you review how you reached an answer.

CHOOSE YOUR PRACTICE
Select recognition, meaning or hoist-order practice. Choose eligible flags, set 5, 10 or 20 questions, and turn timed practice on or off. Recognition practice supports all 40 flag characters; meaning and hoist exercises use the characters supported by each mode.

EXPLORE THE REFERENCE
Browse 26 letter flags, 10 numeral pennants, 3 substitutes and the answering pennant. Search by character, name or available meaning, and read relevant conditions and source references.

REVIEW YOUR LEARNING
Distinguish completed missions from mastered ones. Mastery requires at least 80% independently correct in one full attempt. Revisit up to 10 missed or assisted questions per review. Progress is saved locally without an account.

COMPARE YOUR OWN FLAG PHOTO
Take a still photo or choose one image with the system photo picker. Select a reference flag to compare patterns, then inspect its conditions and official source. Photos are processed on device and discarded when you leave the page. Comparison is manual; the app does not automatically identify flags.

OPTIONAL PRACTICE REMINDERS
Choose a daily reminder time, send a test notification or turn reminders off in Settings & sources. Reminders are scheduled locally on your device.

OFFLINE AND FOCUSED
Training content works offline. No account or in-app purchases. This build can open a remote page. Camera and notification permissions are optional. No microphone or location access is requested. Opening a publisher's website or downloading an iCloud photo requires an internet connection.

TRAINING USE AND LIMITATIONS
GatherHoist is an independent educational app. It is not intended for navigation, operational signaling, emergency communication or certification. Exercises may simplify or adapt published material and do not form a complete official examination bank. Consult current official publications and applicable procedures for operational use. Practice results do not establish professional competence.

GatherHoist is not affiliated with or endorsed by IMO, NGA or the U.S. Coast Guard.

name: Geborweg
description:
Voor gezinnen die op reis gaan met jonge kinderen, biedt Geborweg de mogelijkheid om babyuitrusting te huren of te kopen. Je kunt in je stad kijken naar kinderwagens, autostoelen, reisbedjes en wiegen. Kies losse artikelen of een handig reisset met korting, passend voor de duur van jouw uitstap. 
Bekijk de details van elk product, maak je keuze en volg je bestelling stap voor stap in de vertreklijst. Zo neem je alleen mee wat je nodig hebt en reis je lichter met je gezin.

name: Geode: Encrypted Photo Vault
description:
Geode is a photo vault only you can open. Every photo and video is encrypted on your iPhone or iPad before it's saved or backed up, so no one else can see them: not us, not Apple, and not someone who picks up your phone.

No sign-up, email or phone number. No ads, no trackers, nothing sold.

Hide photos and videos
• Move photos and videos out of your camera roll. Geode checks that each one is safely backed up before iOS asks you to delete the original.
• Keep original dates and places, or leave the location out.
• Locked albums ask for Face ID every time they open.

Encrypted, and backed up to your iCloud
• Every file gets its own 256-bit key (XChaCha20-Poly1305).
• Backups go to your own iCloud, already encrypted. We never see your keys or your photos.
• Vault Health shows what's backed up and checks that every backup still opens.

Only you can open it
• Face ID or Touch ID, plus a passcode that's separate from your device passcode.
• Forgot your passcode? A printable Recovery Kit gets you back in. We can't reset it, because we never have it.

Never held hostage
• Opening and exporting everything is free, forever, whether or not you pay.
• Export to Files, back to Photos, or as a password-protected .zip.

Geode Plus
Try every Plus feature free for one month. Plus adds unlimited photos and videos, search, duplicates, slideshows, and sync between your iPhone and iPad. Free holds up to 100 photos and 10 videos on one device at a time, with backup and export included.

Plus costs $29.99 a year, $4.99 a month, or $49.99 once for Lifetime (US prices). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and are charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel them in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://geode.koing.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://geode.koing.dev/privacy

name: Ghost Cards: Pass & Play
description:
One phone. Two players. One card to avoid.

Start with six safe cards and one ghost card. Remember the ghost, then let one player rearrange the cards by hand before handing over to the other player to draw a card. A safe draw removes one card and swaps your roles. Draw the ghost and you lose. If only the ghost remains, the next player to draw loses automatically.

• Move cards by hand while neighboring cards make room.
• Tap to confirm a choice, or toss a card upward to draw it.
• See the ghost’s location again whenever roles change.
• Pass one screen between two players, or use separate views on supported dual-display devices when available.
• Hear card sounds on actual card crossings and see the ghost animation on the losing player’s side.

Free, with no ads, in-app purchases, or account registration. Gameplay runs locally on your device.

The optional dual-display feature requires a compatible device and uses a camera capture session after explicit consent. Camera images are not saved, analyzed, or uploaded. Single-screen pass-and-play remains available without an outer display or camera permission.

name: Ghost Relay: Time Loop Puzzle
description:
You can't solve it alone. But you can solve it with yourself.

In Ghost Relay, every run you play is recorded. Tap LOOP and time rewinds: a ghost of your past self replays your exact moves while you play alongside it. Need a door held open? Send a ghost to stand on the plate. Laser in the way? Let a past self stand in the beam and become your shield. Plan who stands where, and when, then pass the baton to the next run.

Every level is handcrafted and checked by a solver, so every puzzle has a real solution and a true par to beat.

FEATURES
• 30 handcrafted time-loop puzzles across five worlds: Echoes, Timing, Light, Interference and Flux
• A fresh idea: cooperate with recordings of yourself
• Pressure plates, colour doors, lasers, ghost shields and time switches
• Turn-based: think as long as you like, every move is one step
• Beat par to earn three stars and find the perfect relay
• Step-by-step undo, instant restart and a hint for every level
• Stuck? Watch the built-in solution replay
• Swipe or on-screen D-pad controls, soft ambient music and crisp haptics
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, including the iPhone Duo
• No ads, no tracking, no account, fully offline

Every world adds a new twist to the same simple idea. Record a run, loop, and team up with yourself.

name: GlisLou
description:
GlisLou est une conciergerie de ski. Nous sélectionnons du matériel haut de gamme, le préparons et le faisons parvenir à votre lieu de séjour, pour que la première journée commence sur les skis plutôt que dans une file d'attente.

SEIZE PIÈCES, CINQ COLLECTIONS
Skis all-mountain, de piste et freeride, snowboard, chaussures de ski, boots, casque, masque photochromique, protection dorsale, veste trois couches, pantalon, doudoune, gants, bâtons en carbone, housse et montre altimètre. Chaque fiche présente la maison, l'histoire de la pièce, les tailles disponibles et une fiche technique de quatre mesures établie par nos conseillers.

VOTRE PROFIL DE GLISSE
Niveau, terrain de prédilection, taille et pointure : nous calculons pour chaque équipement un pourcentage d'adéquation. Vous choisissez selon votre façon de skier, et non selon l'ordre d'une vitrine.

UN SÉJOUR, UNE PANOPLIE
Choisissez une station, une date de premier jour et une durée : nous assemblons cinq pièces adaptées au terrain. Remplacez chacune d'elles par une autre de la même collection, ajustez le nombre de personnes, et voyez le montant de la location se mettre à jour à chaque changement.

SIX ADRESSES D'ALTITUDE
Chamonix–Mont-Blanc, Courchevel 1850, Val d'Isère, Megève, La Plagne et Les Deux Alpes. Pour chacune : altitude, domaine skiable, période de saison, caractère de la neige et équipements conseillés par la maison.

RÉSERVER, PUIS SUIVRE
Déposez votre demande avec les coordonnées de livraison, la station et vos dates. Notre équipe vérifie la cohérence de la demande et la disponibilité du matériel avant de confirmer la préparation, puis l'expédition. Le règlement s'effectue à la livraison, sans acompte ni règlement anticipé. Chaque commande reste accessible avec son détail, son matériel et les étapes de son suivi.

VOTRE ESPACE
Un compte pour retrouver votre profil, vos pièces favorites et vos réservations ; des coordonnées modifiables à tout moment ; les conditions d'utilisation et la politique de confidentialité accessibles depuis l'application.

GlisLou — Paris · Alpes

name: GO-ME
description:
GO-ME – Messina at Your Fingertips

Discover Messina, explore its most fascinating places, and plan your visit with GO-ME, your digital travel guide to this beautiful Sicilian city.

Whether you're visiting on a cruise, exploring Sicily, or simply looking for something new, GO-ME helps you discover Messina in an easy, intuitive, and personalized way.

DISCOVER MESSINA

Explore monuments, churches, squares, scenic viewpoints, and local attractions. Find useful information, photos, and interesting facts about the city's most remarkable places.

INTERACTIVE MAP

Explore attractions directly on the map, discover nearby places, and follow walking routes along real city streets.

PERSONALIZED ITINERARIES

Choose what you'd like to see and create your own itinerary. Organize your stops and follow your route on the interactive map.

PERFECT FOR CRUISE VISITORS

Only have a few hours in Messina? Discover places and itineraries to help you make the most of your time ashore.

YOUR TRIP, ALWAYS WITH YOU

Save your favorite places and itineraries. With an optional free account, you can keep your travel plans and access them again later.

EXPLORE OFFLINE

Access previously available content and routes on your device even when your internet connection is limited. Some features require an internet connection.

AVAILABLE IN FOUR LANGUAGES

Explore Messina in Italian, English, Spanish, and German.

GO-ME is your starting point for discovering Messina, one unforgettable place at a time.

Download GO-ME and start exploring!

name: Golf Medals: Side Game Scorer
description:
Score the golf “Olympics” side game (diamond, gold, silver, bronze, iron) plus nearest-the-pin and long drive with a tap — and see exactly who pays whom.
No sign-up, no login.

■ One-handed, on the cart
・All four players on one screen, no scrolling
・Tap names in the order they hole out: gold, silver, bronze and iron are given automatically
・Or tap a cell directly. Tap again to undo
・On pin and drive holes, just tap the winner. No winner? It carries over
・Chip-ins (diamond) get a full-screen celebration

■ Your house rules
・Points for each medal, scrap iron, 3-putt penalty
・Rate per point, a cap on what one player pays, rounding of payments
・Pin and drive points with carry-over (optionally reset at the turn)
・Your default rules are remembered for the next round
・Edit any hole during or after the round — the settlement updates instantly

■ Settle and share
・“Who pays whom” with the fewest payments
・Awards: Diamond, Most medals, Pin king
・One image with every player, ready for group chats
・Front-nine summary at the turn, and shareable standings anytime

■ More fun with friends
・Watch: friends enter a 6-digit code to follow the standings on their own phone (view only)
・All-time balance and a medal cabinet for each player
・Move your records to a new phone with a transfer code

■ Ads and Remove Ads (in-app purchase)
・The app is supported by ads. No full-screen ads while you enter scores
・“Remove Ads” is a one-time purchase that removes ads forever
・Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Restore a previous purchase from Settings

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tomople.com/privacy/golfmedal/

name: Gravarrow
description:
Enter the Abyssal Gravity Observatory, where arrows do more than show direction—they generate force.

Gravarrow is a physics strategy game built around directional gravity fields. Instead of moving an orb directly, you rotate, position, activate, and combine arrow instruments to influence acceleration, momentum, and trajectory. Overlapping fields create new possibilities, including curved paths, braking zones, orbital corrections, and timed convergence points.

FIVE DISTINCT GAME MODES

• Gravity Shift
Redirect gravity and guide every orb into its target zone. Adjust field directions, avoid hazards, and study how combined forces change the path.

• Orbit Keeper
Balance velocity, radius, direction, and field strength to maintain a stable orbit around a gravity core.

• Zero Gravity
Navigate using limited directional impulses. Every pulse changes velocity, so timing and resource management are essential.

• Field Collision
Synchronize multiple moving orbs and bring them together inside a designated zone at a controlled relative speed.

• Survival Drift
React to unstable fields in real time. Switch instruments, redirect momentum, and survive changing hazards.

KEY FEATURES

• 100 handcrafted missions across five gameplay programs
• Physics-based acceleration, momentum, damping, and force-field interaction
• Rotatable, movable, switchable, and locked arrow instruments
• Continuous gravity fields and limited-use pulse controls
• Trajectory planning, orbital balance, timed collisions, and survival challenges
• Three-star mission ratings and progressive unlocking
• Mission-specific goals, hazards, timing rules, and scoring conditions
• Optional trajectory preview and field-radius display
• Haptic and reduced-effects settings
• No registration, advertising, subscriptions, or in-app purchases

Each mission is a physical experiment. Observe the chamber, configure your instruments, launch the simulation, and refine your strategy. Small changes in angle or strength can transform the entire result.

Plan the field. Predict the motion. Stabilize the abyss.

name: GreatOrder
description:
GreatOrder – Gestión de pedidos para comercios

GreatOrder es la aplicación de gestión de pedidos de Greatfood, diseñada para que los comercios administren sus operaciones de forma rápida, sencilla y en tiempo real.

Desde una sola aplicación, tu equipo puede recibir pedidos, gestionar su preparación, coordinar despachos y operar la caja.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

• Estación de pedidos
Recibe pedidos en tiempo real, organiza su preparación y actualiza sus estados.

• Gestión de despacho
Controla los pedidos listos para entregar y agiliza la atención de clientes y repartidores.

• Caja
Gestiona pedidos presenciales y operaciones de caja desde una interfaz práctica.

• Notificaciones
Recibe alertas de nuevos pedidos para mantener tu operación al día.

• Múltiples tiendas
Selecciona tu tienda y accede a sus operaciones desde una misma aplicación.

DISEÑADA PARA TU NEGOCIO

GreatOrder ofrece una experiencia simple, rápida y enfocada en el trabajo diario de tu equipo.

GreatOrder forma parte del ecosistema Greatfood. Para utilizarla necesitas una cuenta de comercio activa en Greatfood.

name: Greek English French Crossword
description:
Solve crosswords in Greek, English or French. If a clue stumps you, one tap shows it in the other two languages, and every word you find appears in all three.

The clues test general knowledge, from history and mythology to culture and science. This is a word game and not a language course, so it suits anyone who enjoys crosswords and puzzles and likes seeing the same word in another language.

A translation for every clue
Stuck on a clue in Greek or French? The translate button shows it in all three languages. The answer stays hidden until you solve the word.

Vocabulary in three languages
Each word you solve also appears in the other languages, such as OLYMPUS, ΟΛΥΜΠΟΣ and OLYMPE. At the end of a level, all its words are together in one list.

11 themes
More than 500 levels in each language, grouped into themes such as Mythology, Byzantium, Modern history and Science & inventions. Each theme has its own levels.

Daily Crossword
365 crosswords in each language, one for every day. Each one you solve gives you 3 hints, and every 7 days in a row earns you 5 more.

700 levels in each language
From small 6-word crosswords up to bigger ones with 14 words. Each language has its own levels and its own progress, and you can switch language with one tap on the home screen.

Hints when you're stuck
Use light bulbs to reveal a letter or a whole word. You earn bulbs each time you finish a level for the first time, plus 3 more each day you play.

Play offline
All levels are inside the app, so you can play without an internet connection. Your progress is saved automatically.

Appearance and keyboard
• Auto, light or dark appearance
• Built-in English, Greek or French (AZERTY) keyboard, no accents needed
• Sounds that don't stop your music and turn off with one switch

No ads, no purchases
No account needed and no personal data collected.

name: GridKraft Cascade Arena
description:
Place a piece, clear a line, and watch nearby blocks tumble into the gaps. One good move can set off a chain reaction across the board.

• Fusion – Build cascades and put special blocks to work.
• Adventure – Clear the target blocks in 40 levels and earn up to three stars per level.
• Block Storm – Match four blocks of the same color and keep your board open as new blocks push in from the edges.
• Bluetooth duels – Challenge a nearby iPhone or iPad. Cleared lines rain down as attack blocks on your opponent’s board.

With GridKraft on Apple TV, put a solo run on the big screen or show both boards side by side during a duel. TV Arena uses the same local network. The duel itself runs over Bluetooth.

GridKraft is free and ad-free.

name: Groussoynz
description:
A knitter's glossary, and the app that does the arithmetic behind every word.

NEEDLE SIZE
The same 5 mm needle is a US 8, a UK 6 and roughly a Japanese 10. In the Needle box, type the size printed in your pattern or tap the chart, and read it in metric, US, UK/Canada and Japan at once. Crochet hooks too, from letter sizes like H-8 to Japanese /0 hooks.

YARN WEIGHT
CYC 0 (Lace) to 7, with UK names and Australian ply beside each number, plus typical needle and hook ranges and metres per 100 g. All on the Yarn shelf.

WPI
Wraps per inch. Wind a mystery yarn around a ruler, count the wraps, and the Yarn shelf suggests which weight it probably is.

YARDAGE
Yards or metres, straight from the ball band. Enough yarn? takes the length the pattern calls for, the length one ball holds and the balls in hand, adds spare for swatching, and writes your shopping list. It even checks your stash for a same-weight yarn that is long enough.

GAUGE (TENSION)
Count stitches and rows over 10 cm or 4 in, on the pattern and on your own swatch. Swatch rescales the cast-on and the row count for you. Pattern says 20 stitches, you get 22, so cast on 110 instead of 100, rounded to the stitch repeat you set.

STASH
The Basket keeps skeins and projects: maker and colourway, weight category, length and grams per ball, balls, needle size and notes.

DC vs SC
The classic mix-up: a UK double crochet is a US single crochet. The Stitch dictionary in the Notions pouch lines up US and UK terms for crochet and knitting, explains common abbreviations, and adds body measurement and ease charts for hats and sweaters.

PINNED
Any conversion can be pinned or found again under recent rows, also in the Notions pouch.

OFFLINE
Your basket and notes live on this iPhone only. No account, and it works with no signal at the yarn fair.

name: GuitarVibe: Guitar Tuner
description:
A tuner you will enjoy looking at, and everything a guitarist reaches for after it: a metronome, backing tracks to play over, and every chord shape you might have forgotten.

TUNER
The head of your instrument on screen, with strings that really vibrate. Pluck a string: GuitarVibe finds it on its own, the needle settles where the note is, and the string turns green when it is in tune. Chevrons show which way to turn the peg. When all the strings are in tune, the instrument plays itself a chord.
• Acoustic and electric guitar, ukulele
• Standard tuning and ten more for guitar: Drop D, a half step down, DADGAD, open G and others
• Your own tunings, made right on the head (Pro)
• Chromatic mode for any note (Pro)
• Reference A from 430 to 450 Hz
• Precise, Normal or Relaxed: how close counts as in tune
• A reference note for each string, at a touch
• Choose a string by hand and it tells you when it is an octave too high, before it snaps

METRONOME
A wooden pendulum that swings with the clicks, from 30 to 250 BPM. Tap the tempo, choose 1 to 12 beats a bar, accent the first one or not, split each beat in 2, 3 or 4. Slide the weight to change the tempo. It keeps playing with the screen locked or over another app.

JAM
Backing tracks to play along with: blues, rock, pop, funk, groove, rumba, reggae, country, neo soul and acoustic, each in four parts: drums, bass, guitar and keys.
• The chord being played, large, and the next change coming
• The whole chord chart, bar by bar
• Slow it down or speed it up without changing its pitch, move it to another key without changing its tempo
• Mute a part, or hear one alone (Pro)
• Loop the bars you are working on
• A count-in before the first bar
• A click on the track's own beat (Pro)
• Touch a chord to see how to play it
Two tracks are in the app; the others download the first time you choose them, then play offline.

CHORDS
12 roots and 17 kinds of chord, each with the shapes a teacher shows: the open shape first, then the shapes up the neck. Swipe through them, touch the diagram to hear it, touch a note under it to hear that string alone.
• Easy shapes for the hard barre chords
• Slash chords such as D/F# and G/B
• A capo, and the tuning set on the tuner
• Search a chord the way you write it: F7, Bbm7, A/C#, or in solfège
• The seven chords of any key, and progressions to play (Pro)
• Favourites, and lists of your own (Pro)
• Left-handed diagrams, and dots showing fingers, notes or intervals

Letters or solfège for the note names, light or dark appearance, in 14 languages.

FREE AND PRO
The tuner, the metronome and the chord library are free, with no time limit: every instrument, every tuning of the list, every chord and its shapes, the capo, the search and Favourites. Four backing tracks are free too, with their tempo, key, loop and chord chart. GuitarVibe Pro adds every other track and each new one, the parts and the click, your own tunings, chromatic mode, lists of your own and the chords of every key: one payment for life, or a monthly subscription billed through your Apple Account and renewed every month until you cancel it in Settings. The prices are shown in the app, in your own currency.

The microphone is only used to hear your strings. Nothing is recorded.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://guitarvibe.app/privacy

name: Gwarant
description:
Gwarant trzyma paragony, terminy i pisma reklamacyjne na Twoim iPhonie — lokalnie, bez konta, bez reklam i bez subskrypcji.

CO ROBI
• Skanuje paragony aparatem lub z galerii (OCR Vision na urządzeniu, pl-PL + en-US). Przed zapisem możesz poprawić każde pole.
• Pilnuje terminów: zwrot przy zakupie na odległość (zwykle 14 dni od otrzymania towaru), okres gwarancji (jeśli został udzielony) oraz odpowiedzialność sprzedawcy za niezgodność towaru z umową (zasadniczo 2 lata od wydania).
• Generuje pisma: reklamację z tytułu niezgodności z umową, oświadczenie o odstąpieniu od umowy oraz reklamację gwarancyjną — z podglądem, edycją i eksportem do PDF.
• Przypomina lokalnymi powiadomieniami przed końcem terminu oraz o 14 dniach na odpowiedź sprzedawcy po oznaczeniu pisma jako wysłanego.
• Robi kopię zapasową plikiem .gwarant, eksport CSV oraz udostępnianie domownikowi przez AirDrop lub Wiadomości (bez iCloud w tej wersji).

PRYWATNOŚĆ
Wszystkie dane zostają na urządzeniu. Nie zakładamy konta, nie wysyłamy paragonów na nasze serwery i nie śledzimy Cię reklamami. OCR działa lokalnie przez framework Vision firmy Apple.

WAŻNE — TO NIE JEST PORADA PRAWNA
Gwarant pomaga uporządkować dokumenty i przygotować szablony pism. Nie zastępuje indywidualnej porady prawnej. Terminy i uprawnienia zależą od rodzaju umowy (np. zakup online vs. sklep stacjonarny), treści gwarancji i Twojej sytuacji. Aktualne informacje konsumenckie publikuje UOKiK:
• niezgodność towaru z umową: https://prawakonsumenta.uokik.gov.pl/reklamacja/niezgodnosc/
• odstąpienie od umowy: https://prawakonsumenta.uokik.gov.pl/prawo-odstapienia-od-umowy/
• gwarancja: https://prawakonsumenta.uokik.gov.pl/reklamacja/gwarancja/
• wzory pism: https://prawakonsumenta.uokik.gov.pl/wzory-pism/

Bezpłatna i całkowicie opcjonalna — używaj tyle, ile potrzebujesz.

name: Halos & Horns: Bluffing Game
description:
You can see your own pieces. Your opponent's pieces all look like "?".
Halos & Horns is a 6×6 board game of hidden identities, bluffing and mind games between angels and devils.

■ Easy to learn
• Place your 4 angels and 4 devils however you like
• Each turn, move one piece one square forward, back, left or right
• Move onto an opponent's piece to capture it — and only then find out what it was!

■ Three ways to win
① Get one of your angels out through an exit in the far corners
② Capture all 4 of your opponent's angels
③ Make your opponent capture all 4 of your devils

Is that bold piece charging forward an angel… or a devil you want them to take?
Bluff, read your opponent, and outsmart them.

■ Three ways to play
• Play vs AI: choose Easy, Normal or Hard
• Chat with the AI Game Master: play by typing moves like "Move B2 forward", with live commentary and tips
• Two players: pass one phone back and forth

■ Bluff review
After each game, see what the AI thought each of your pieces was.
Find out which bluffs fooled it and which ones it saw through.

■ More
• Illustrated tutorial for first-time players
• Two character styles to choose from
• Lose to the AI and a grinning devil fills the screen!
• Available in English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese

■ Notes
• Free to play (contains ads)
• Chatting with the AI Game Master needs an internet connection and has a daily limit. Watch a video ad to get more chats

name: Handicap Journal
description:
Handicap Journal is the golf diary for players who want to lower their handicap and understand why their score is what it is. Log a round in seconds, hole by hole, and see exactly where your strokes go: off the tee, on approach, around the green or on the putting surface. 

Record each hole with quick taps for fairway, green, putts, bunkers and penalties. Or switch to detailed mode and track every shot by lie and distance to get strokes gained against a built-in baseline. Your Handicap estimate follows World Handicap System formulas and updates after every round, with a 30-day trend, a goal tracker and a course handicap calculator that shows which holes you get strokes on. Build your own course library with tees, rating, slope and hole stroke indexes, and attach photos of scorecards, courses and tricky greens. 

Then turn insight into improvement. Handicap Journal finds your weakest area and builds a weekly practice plan around it, with timed drills, a practice log and progress charts for every drill. Reminders cover upcoming rounds, practice days and a weekly summary.

name: Harbor Smash
description:
Harbor Smash is a physics puzzle game about one cannon and a lot of cargo. Tap where you want the cannonball to land and knock every crate, barrel and bottle off the dock, raft or shipwreck. Each level gives you a limited number of shots, so choose your target well: rafts tilt and tip over, some are roped together or drift on the current, and powder barrels set off chain explosions.

GAME MODES
• Raft Raid: 500 levels on docks, rafts, a rowboat and shipwrecks, with a boss level every 10 levels.
• Smugglers' Cave: 20 treasure levels in a sea cave, played with three kinds of ammo: Slime Ball, Tar Ball and Powder Bomb. It opens after Raft Raid level 10.
• Adventure: Raft Raid and Smugglers' Cave levels in turns.

BOOSTERS
• Heavy Shot: a much bigger and heavier cannonball.
• Broadside: a short burst of small cannonballs at the spot you hold.
• Powder Keg: kegs drop onto the tallest stacks. Tap a keg to blow it up.

REWARDS
Earn up to 3 stars in every level, collect the Daily Bounty, complete Shipyard stages, open Treasure Map chests and sail the daily Treasure Trail. Levels play out in 20 weather and light settings, from misty mornings to thunderstorms and moonlit nights.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play. The game shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases: No Ads, coin packs, a Starter Pack, the Captain's Chest, Treasure Trail islands and Rescue (extra shots when you run out).
• An internet connection is required.
• Your progress is saved on your device. No account is needed.
• English only.

name: Health Export Free
description:
Health Export Free reads your daily body weight and step count from the Health app and turns them into clean JSON or CSV files, or sends them to your own HTTPS web API. It is made for people who want to automate their health data with Shortcuts without using the Health actions inside Shortcuts.

WHAT YOU GET
- The last 7 completed days, recalculated every time (today is never included)
- Weight: the latest measurement of each day, in kg
- Steps: the daily total as merged by the Health app across your devices and apps
- Days without data stay empty (null). They are never filled in with 0.
- JSON with a simple, fixed structure: time zone, period, and one entry per day
- CSV in UTF-8 with a header row (date, weight_kg, steps)
- Save the file anywhere with the Files app

SEND TO YOUR OWN WEB API
- Any HTTPS endpoint, using POST or PUT
- Build the URL, query parameters, headers and body from templates with placeholders such as ${days}, ${period.start} and ${secret.token}
- JSON bodies are parsed before the data is inserted, so the request is always valid JSON
- Check the exact request in a preview before sending. Your token is masked.
- Your API token is stored in the iOS Keychain and can only be used in headers
- Sending from Shortcuts can be limited to Wi-Fi

SHORTCUTS AND AUTOMATION
Three actions are available in the Shortcuts app:
- Export daily health data as JSON
- Export daily health data as CSV
- Send daily health data to your web API
Combine them with "Save File" or your own automations to build a daily routine.

PRIVACY
- Read-only access to weight and steps. The app never writes to the Health app.
- No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
- Your data goes only to the files you save and the server you set up. The developer never receives it.
- Output history keeps only the time and result, never your health data

GOOD TO KNOW
- Days are calculated in Japan Standard Time (Asia/Tokyo), regardless of your device's time zone.
- The app's interface is currently in Japanese only.
- iOS does not allow apps to read health data while your iPhone is locked. For daily automation, use a Shortcuts automation that runs when you open an app you use every day.

name: Heartpost
description:
Send someone your heartbeat – and let them feel it.

Heartpost measures your heart rate with Apple Watch or AirPods Pro 3 and turns it into a gentle haptic heartbeat. Send it in iMessage, and your loved one feels the exact rhythm of your heart on their iPhone – every speeding up and slowing down included.

HOW IT WORKS
• Measure: 10–15 seconds with Apple Watch or AirPods Pro 3
• Feel: your iPhone plays the rhythm as a lifelike "lub-dub" vibration
• Send: as an interactive iMessage bubble – tap it to feel the heartbeat
• Remember: your Heart Journal keeps every heartbeat you measure or receive, with notes

HEARTPOST+ – ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Longer measurements: 30 and 60 seconds
• Full Heart Journal with no time limit
• Themes, including Valentine and Gold
• Haptic styles: Soft, Strong and Butterflies
• A personal message with your heartbeat
With Family Sharing, your partner gets it too. Receiving and playing heartbeats is always free.

PRIVACY
Your heart rate stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking. A heartbeat only leaves your phone when you send it.

Heartpost is not a medical device and is not intended for diagnosis or health monitoring.

name: HeartPulse
description:
你的心跳，一部手机就能听见。

HeartPulse 把 iPhone 的摄像头和闪光灯变成一枚光学传感器。把食指指腹轻轻盖在镜头和闪光灯上，30 秒后，你就能看到自己的心率。

不需要手表，不需要手环，不需要任何额外硬件。

【30 秒，读出心跳】
· 实时波形：测量过程中能看到每一次搏动的波形
· 智能提前结束：信号稳定后 10 秒即可出结果，不必干等
· 结果即时呈现：BPM、测量时长、质量评级一屏看完

【双算法，只为更稳】
频域 FFT 主频分析与时域峰值检测同时运行，两路结果交叉校验：一致时取平均，差异过大直接判定信号不可靠并提示重测——不给你一个不准的数字。

【盖错镜头也不用管】
多摄机型自动识别当前镜头。连续 3.5 秒没有信号，自动切换到超广角或长焦，屏幕上会显示正在使用哪一颗。你只需要把手指放上去。

【心率之外，还有 HRV】
SDNN 与 RMSSD 两个心率变异性指标，配合测量时长一起记录，用来观察恢复状态与压力水平的变化。

【用久了才看得出变化】
日 / 周 / 月三种趋势视图，带均值虚线与 2σ 异常点标注，哪天明显偏离自己一眼就能看到。历史记录支持导出 CSV。

【顺手记血压】
手动录入电子血压计读数，或从「健康」App 导入。按《中国高血压防治指南》自动分级，收缩压、舒张压、脉搏一次记全。

【数据留在你的手机里】
所有测量记录只存在本机，不上传服务器，也不需要注册账号。经你允许后，结果才会写入 Apple「健康」App（仅「良好」及以上评级会自动同步）。

【怎么用】
1. 打开 App，点「开始测量」
2. 食指指腹完全盖住摄像头与闪光灯，轻触即可，不要用力压
3. 保持静止、自然呼吸，等 30 秒

手指冰凉、刚运动完、心律不齐时结果偏差会比较大，建议避开这些状态。

【免费与解锁】
免费可体验 2 次完整测量。之后一次购买即可永久解锁全部功能，无订阅、无广告。

【重要说明】
本应用基于摄像头光学信号估算心率，仅用于日常健康参考与自我观察，不构成医疗诊断，不能替代医疗器械或医生的判断。如感到不适、或怀疑心律异常，请及时就医。

name: HeatList: Simple To-Do List
description:
Most to-do apps turn into a second job. HeatList is the opposite: one stack of cards, and the three at the top are all you need to do right now.

Talk or type. Drag what matters to the top. Watch it glow. Get it done.

ORDER IS PRIORITY
• Drag a card up and it's more important. That's the whole system.
• Your top three glow as "Now". Everything else waits quietly in "Later".
• No due dates, tags, projects or settings to keep up with.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
• The add bar is always there. Press Return and keep typing the next one.
• Tap the mic, say it, and pause. The card adds itself.
• Ramble "call mom, buy milk and email Sarah" and get three tidy cards.

HELP WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Break It Down turns a big, vague card into a few small first steps.
• Suggest Now picks your top three and tells you why.
• Everything has Undo, and it all runs on your device with Apple Intelligence.

FEEL THE PROGRESS
• Swipe right to finish, with a satisfying check and a 4-second Undo.
• The Done Bin shows what you finished today, yesterday and before.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone, iPad and Mac.
• On iPad, and on iPhone Duo when it's unfolded, Now and Later sit side by side, split at the fold. Drag a card across to promote it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up.
• Your tasks and your voice are never sent to us or to any AI service.

HEATLIST PLUS: ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
HeatList is free to use. Plus is a one-time purchase that syncs your cards across iPhone, iPad and Mac with your own iCloud account. Buy it once and it works on all of them.

Apple Intelligence features need a device that supports Apple Intelligence, with it turned on. Without it, HeatList works the same, minus those extras.

Put the three things that matter on top, and start.

name: HintHalo
description:
Remember every hint they drop, and turn it into the perfect gift right on time.

They mentioned that cookbook in March. Your sister loved that scarf in a shop window. Your partner said something about noise-cancelling headphones weeks ago. HintHalo keeps all of it in one place so thoughtful gifts stop depending on your memory.

MEET WHISPER, YOUR AI GIFT ASSISTANT
Type or talk to Whisper the moment you hear a hint, and it saves the idea to the right person. Stuck for ideas? Tell Whisper who you're shopping for and your budget, and get suggestions that actually fit.

SAVE IDEAS FOR EVERYONE YOU LOVE
Give each person their own list of hints and gift ideas, complete with links to find them. When an occasion comes around, your shortlist is already waiting.

NEVER MISS A BIRTHDAY AGAIN
Track birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with countdowns for every date. Reminders arrive early, so you have time to shop and skip the last-minute panic.

SNAP IT, SAVE IT
See something they'd love? Take a photo of any gift or product. HintHalo identifies it and saves it as an idea in seconds.

TRACK ORDERS UNTIL THEY ARRIVE
Forward shipping emails to your personal HintHalo address and follow every package in one place. Know exactly when each gift will land.

CELEBRATE THE SEASON
Seasonal themes bring a little holiday spirit to your gift planning all year round.

FREE AND PRO PLANS
HintHalo is free to use with 10 Whisper chats per day, 3 photo scans per month and up to 5 people. Upgrade to HintHalo Pro for unlimited chats, scans and people.

HintHalo Pro is available as a Yearly subscription for $14.99 with a 7-day free trial, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase for $39.99. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The yearly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Be the person who always remembers. Download HintHalo and start saving hints today.

Terms of Use: https://hinthalo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hinthalo.com/privacy

name: hiss
description:
hiss es tu diario de discos. Escuchas un álbum entero, le pones nota y, si quieres, lo cuentas canción a canción.

PUNTÚA COMO ESCUCHAS
· Medias estrellas, de ½ a 5.
· Pista a pista: diez casillas por canción y una marcada como temazo. La nota del disco puede salir de la media.
· Reseñas en texto, cortas o largas.

COMPARTE TU NOTA
· Tarjetas para Stories con estética de casete: solo la nota, tu reseña o tus pistas.
· Se comparten desde la hoja de iOS a Instagram o a donde quieras.

TU SEÑAL
· Tu perfil dibuja cómo repartes tus notas, de la media estrella a las cinco.
· Cuatro discos favoritos, tu colección y tu lista para escuchar.

TU GENTE
· Sigue a tus amigos, mira qué han escuchado y dale a me gusta a sus reseñas.
· Te proponemos gente con tu gusto y discos a partir de lo que puntúas.

SIN ANUNCIOS
hiss no muestra publicidad ni te sigue por otras apps. Tampoco reproduce música: te lleva a escucharla a Apple Music, Deezer o Spotify.

Hecho en España, en español.

name: Holmreach
description:
Holmreach är ett hashi-pussel – "brobyggande", det japanska pusslet som också säljs som Hashiwokakero. Varje ö har en siffra. Siffran anger hur många broar som måste röra sig till den. Koppla ihop öarna tills alla antal uppfylls, ingen bro korsar en annan och hela ögruppen blir ett sammanhängande nätverk av övergångar.

Den sista regeln är den som de flesta glömmer, och den som gör pusslet värt att spela: att betala för varje siffra är inte tillräckligt. Två perfekta små öar utan något mellan dem är en tavla som inte är färdig.

**Två tryck, en övergång**

Tryck på en ö för att plocka upp den, tryck på en annan för att lägga en bro mellan dem. Tryck på samma par igen för en andra bro, och återigen för att ta bort båda. Broar går längs en rad eller en kolumn och endast mellan öar som kan se varandra – en ö som står mellan blocken som sträcker sig, så en övergång är alltid ett val gjort i det öppna.

**En ledtråd som resonerar från din position**

Be om hjälp och spelet löser den tavla du faktiskt har byggt, inte den det kom med, sedan pekar det mot en övergång där siffrorna redan har bestämt – och säger vilken av de tre orsakerna gäller: siffran lämnar ingen annan övergång, spannet behöver
båda broar, eller siffrorna avgör detta övergång. Om du har byggt något som inte fungerar, säger ledtråden det tydligt: *broar kan inte korsa*, *det ödet är redan betalt*, *det ödet kan inte betala vad det skyller*.

**Trettio brädor, tre böcker, ett svar varje**

Källor: sju gånger sju, åtta till tio öar. Kanaler: nio gånger nio, tio till femton. Ljudet: elva gånger elva, fjorton till nitton. Varje bräde genomgick spelets egen lösningsprogram innan släpp, vilket räknade de färdiga arrangemang som dess siffror tillåter. Ett svar, aldrig två – en bräda med ett andra svar är ett fel, inte en funktion, och lösningsprogrammet vägrar skicka ut sådana.

**Tyst**

Inga timer. Inga poäng. Inga reklam, inga in-app-köp, inget konto, inga analyser och inget nätverkskod av någon typ – spelet fungerar i flygläge och efter att världens servrar har tystnat. Ljud och haptik kan stängas av.

Ångra, töm och starta om är gratis och alltid tillgängliga, så en bräda kan förstöras och rensas utan att kostna mer än tiden.

name: HookBoard: Shop Key Board
description:
HookBoard is the labeled hook wall at a shop desk. Staff see which keys are hanging and which are out, then tap a hook to hand a key to someone or hang it back.

Eight hooks open with the board: front door, stockroom, till drawer, alarm panel, office, delivery gate, safe box, and van spare. Stockroom and Office start out, so the count on the Board is already useful. That count changes the moment a key leaves or returns.

Out lists only the keys that are off the wall, with the person who has each one and when it left. Open a slip to put that key back on its hook.

Names and times stay on the iPhone. No account, no ads, and no network. Free to use.

name: HOP Butik
description:
HOP Butik to zakupy na żywo prosto z naszego butiku. Oglądaj transmisje i krótkie filmy z nowościami, a produkty, które Ci się spodobają, dodawaj do paczki jednym kliknięciem — bez wychodzenia z filmu.

CO ZNAJDZIESZ W APLIKACJI
• Transmisje na żywo — prezentujemy nowe kolekcje, odpowiadamy na pytania i pokazujemy, jak ubrania wyglądają w rzeczywistości.
• Filmy z produktami — przeglądaj nagrania w wygodnym pionowym feedzie.
• Ponad 800 produktów — ubrania, obuwie i dodatki ze zdjęciami, opisem i dostępnymi rozmiarami.
• Paczka — zbieraj zakupy z kilku transmisji i opłać je razem.
• Wygodna dostawa — kurier lub paczkomat, z mapą punktów odbioru.
• Bezpieczne płatności online albo za pobraniem.
• Historia zamówień i statusy wysyłki w jednym miejscu.
• Powiadomienia o startach transmisji i promocjach.

JAK TO DZIAŁA
1. Włącz transmisję lub film.
2. Kliknij produkt, wybierz rozmiar i dodaj do paczki.
3. Gdy skończysz zakupy, wybierz dostawę i zapłać.

Logowanie przez Apple, Google, Facebook lub e-mail. Konto możesz usunąć w każdej chwili w ustawieniach profilu.

Do zobaczenia na live!

name: Hotline: Her Work Number
description:
Hotline is the work phone, regulars list and money tracker for dancers and nightlife entertainers.

He used to call your cell. Now he calls your hotline.

YOUR WORK NUMBER
• Give out a work number instead of your personal one.
• Already have one (Google Voice, a second phone)? Use it from day one.
• Every text sits next to his notes, so you never mix up who said what.

YOUR REGULARS
