• His drink, his job, his birthday, what he spent with you and when he was last in.
• Log tonight in a tap: he came in, he spent, a quick note.
• Share your number from the app in one tap.

YOUR MONEY
• Log a shift and see what you really made after the house fee, tip-outs, fines and the ride home.
• Your net per hour, your best nights, and a goal to put money toward every shift.

SAFER TOGETHER
• Flag a number for what happened: didn't pay, grabby, followed you. Other dancers see what happened and how many of us said so. Never your name.
• Club notes from other dancers: house fees, dance prices and how the club treats you.

HOTLINE PRO
Pro adds your own Hotline number, unlimited texting from it, and "working tonight" to your regulars at once. Pro is $29 a month or $249 a year, charged to your Apple ID when you confirm. It renews automatically at the same price unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the period ends, in your App Store subscription settings.

For adults 18 and over. Texts through Hotline are for keeping in touch about the club: no photos, nothing explicit, nothing illegal.

Terms of Use (Apple's standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Hotline terms: https://hotlinedancer.com/terms
Privacy: https://hotlinedancer.com/privacy

name: Hubstakk
description:
Hubstakk is the operations platform for Design Ink Corporation and its teams. It brings orders, art, production, purchasing, shipping, tasks and schedules into one place, so every job moves from quote to the loading dock without falling through the cracks.

This app is for Design Ink employees and partners. You need a Hubstakk account from your administrator to sign in.

ON IPAD
• Boards: sketch, annotate and lay out ideas on an infinite canvas with Apple Pencil — pressure-sensitive ink, highlighter, lasso, shapes and pages.
• Apple Pencil double tap and squeeze switch tools the way you set them in iPadOS Settings.
• Export boards as PDF or PNG straight to the share sheet — Files, AirDrop, Mail.

EVERYWHERE
• Tasks: spaces, sections, due dates, comments and mentions for your team.
• Calendar: shared team and personal calendars.
• Orders, art approvals, production schedule, purchase orders and shipping — whatever your role gives you access to.
• Messages with your team.
• Fully bilingual: English and Spanish.
• Password reset links from Hubstakk emails open right in the app.

Hubstakk shows only what your role allows; your administrator manages access.

name: Hungry Leaf
description:
You are a Venus flytrap. Your phone is your mouth.

Bugs fly in, land on your open leaves, walk around, groom and leave. Close your iPhone Duo to snap shut. Whatever was sitting on the leaves at that moment is caught. Maybe.

While the trap is closed, the outer screen shows only the green outside of the plant. No score, no hints. Open it again to find out what you caught.

CATCH WITH TIMING
• Close fast, before a jumpy mosquito gets away
• Read the tells: a ladybug lifts its shell before it flies, a grasshopper winds up its back legs before it jumps
• Snap right after a bug brushes a trigger hair for a Perfect Snap and double points

LET IT DIGEST
Keep the trap shut long enough. Open too soon and your catch wriggles out.

WATCH OUT
Wasps sting. Raindrops, seeds and leaves land too, and snapping on nothing wastes energy. Your trap has five snaps, and they slowly grow back.

FILL THE HERBARIUM
14 species, from ants and house flies to the legendary golden scarab. The album shows nothing about a species until you catch it: no silhouettes, no names, no spoilers. Some visitors only come out at night.

DRAWN LIKE AN OLD BOTANICAL BOOK
Ink outlines, watercolor and paper grain, with a soundscape to match.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
The fold is the controller. Also plays on other iPhones: press and hold the screen to close the trap.

One purchase. No ads. No in-app purchases.

Terms of Use: https://mga-ict.com/fly-catcher/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://mga-ict.com/fly-catcher/privacy.html

name: IAM Academy
description:
O IAM Academy é o app dos alunos do Inglês AutomaticaMente. Por ele você agenda suas aulas de inglês ao vivo, entra na aula e acompanha o seu progresso, tudo pelo celular.

AULAS AO VIVO, 1 A 1
Cada aula é ao vivo, só você e o professor. Você escolhe com quem quer estudar e marca o dia e o horário que cabem na sua rotina.

AGENDA SIMPLES
Veja os horários livres de cada professor e agende em poucos toques. Precisou desmarcar? Cancele com antecedência e o crédito volta para a sua conta.

CONHEÇA OS PROFESSORES
Veja o perfil de cada professor antes de marcar a aula.

MINHAS AULAS
Todas as suas aulas em um só lugar: as próximas, as que você já fez e o botão para entrar na aula na hora certa.

SEU PROGRESSO
Acompanhe seu nível, sua sequência de estudos e quantas aulas você fez no mês.

AVISOS NA HORA
Receba lembretes das aulas e saiba quando uma aula for confirmada ou cancelada.

ENTRADA RÁPIDA
Depois do primeiro acesso, entre com Face ID ou Touch ID.

Para usar o app é preciso ter uma conta de aluno do Inglês AutomaticaMente.

name: IFC Viewer & Calculator
description:
IFC Calculator & Viewer opens IFC models for architects and project planners.

Create a project and import an IFC file, or open the included sample building. The model appears in a 3D view. Select an element to read its name, type, storey, material, and the quantities stored on it. Fit the view, isolate a selection, hide elements, and show one storey at a time. Measure a length by choosing two points in the model.

Takeoff groups building elements by type, storey, or material. Totals use the quantities already in the file, such as area, volume, length, and count. Openings already included in those quantities are not subtracted again. Spaces are listed on their own. Elements with no quantities are listed separately, so you can see what the file did not include. Export the takeoff as CSV.

Projects and models stay on this device. The app has no account. The first open of a large model can take a while. The next open uses the saved view. Very large models may not open on a phone.

name: iMessenger
description:
¿Qué es iMESSENGER?

iMESSENGER es un sistema inteligente de comunicación omnicanal desarrollado por Grupo Comercial y Tecnológico. Está diseñado para sincronizar de manera fluida un widget de chat web interactivo con una aplicación móvil para agentes de soporte.

Cuando un cliente o visitante escribe en tu página web, la solicitud llega de inmediato al celular de tu equipo de atención al cliente, garantizando respuestas rápidas y eficientes sin importar dónde se encuentren. 

Características Principales:
- Sincronización Web-Móvil en Tiempo Real: Conecta las consultas iniciadas desde el widget de tu página web directamente con la bandeja de entrada móvil de tus agentes.
- Gestión Eficiente de Conversaciones: Organiza todos los chats de forma clara, permitiendo visualizar conversaciones abiertas, pendientes o cerradas para un control total del soporte.
- Respuestas Rápidas y Plantillas: Optimiza el tiempo de tus agentes configurando mensajes predeterminados para saludos (día, tarde, noche) y respuestas frecuentes a requerimientos comunes.
- Asignación y Cierre de Casos: Permite a los agentes administrar el estado de cada chat (activo, en seguimiento o cerrado), manteniendo trazabilidad y orden en el servicio al cliente.
- Interfaz Ágil y Corporativa: Diseñada específicamente para equipos de soporte moderno, ofreciendo una experiencia limpia, rápida y fácil de usar desde el celular.

name: Inkkept
description:
Inkkept is a notebook for your iPad. Write and draw by hand, bring in PDFs and mark them up, and keep it all in notebooks on a shelf.

Three promises shape the app.

Free and unlimited. Make as many notebooks, folders and pages as you like. There is no notebook cap and no trial that runs out.

Built so you don't lose a note. Inkkept saves a version of a notebook when you close it after making changes, so you can go back to an earlier copy. Deleted notebooks wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days. Pick a folder in Files and Inkkept backs up your whole library there daily or weekly, and you can restore any notebook from a backup.

No subscription trap. You don't need an account. Export Everything saves each notebook as a PDF and as a notebook file whenever you want, so your notes are never locked inside the app.

WRITING
- Pen, ballpoint, pencil and highlighter, with your favorite colors and sizes one tap away on the toolbar
- Stroke and pixel erasers
- Lasso to move, resize, recolor or delete what you wrote
- Lines, rectangles, ellipses and arrows
- Text boxes with formatting
- Blank, lined, grid or dotted paper, light or dark, in Letter or A4
- Write with Apple Pencil, or turn on drawing with your finger

PDFS AND IMAGES
- Import PDFs from Files or drag them in, then write right on the pages
- Insert a PDF into a notebook you already have
- Tap links inside a PDF, and jump around with its table of contents
- Add pictures from Photos, Files or the camera, or scan paper documents straight onto a page
- Export a notebook or a few pages as a PDF

FIND THINGS
- Search your whole library or one notebook
- Search reads your handwriting and the text in PDFs, photos and scans, on your iPad
- Bookmark pages and see every page at once in the page grid, where you can reorder, duplicate, move or export them

KEEP IT TOGETHER
- Folders and subfolders, in a grid or on a shelf
- Covers in solid colors, seven patterns, a photo or the notebook's first page
- Four themes: Pastel, Minimal, Midnight and Paper. A theme changes the app around your pages and leaves your ink alone
- Sync between your iPads through your own iCloud account

PRIVACY
Inkkept collects no data. There are no ads, analytics or trackers. Your notes stay on your iPad and, if iCloud is on for this iPad, in your own iCloud account, which the developer can't read.

Questions or problems: support@inkkept.com

name: InkPanel: Tone Grams
description:
InkPanel is for people printing a manga page who need the ink before the run. Page size, panel layout, tone density, screen lines, and the copy count become grams to scoop and how many 250 g jars to open. The page on screen is the manuscript: panel borders, tone dots, speed lines, and a balloon.

Splash tones the whole page. Tiers tones one panel of three. 4-koma and grid tone two panels of four. This is a print estimate from film thickness. It does not letter, publish, or collect comics.

Page
Pick a panel layout and watch the manuscript redraw. Set the page size, tone density, screen lines, and copies. The gram stamp updates beside the page.

Pages
Open a filed page back onto the manuscript, or delete it.

Tones
Read the screen-line deposit behind the number.

Filed pages stay on the phone. No account and no network.

name: Inward: Cell to Quark
description:
How small does the world go? Inward lets you find out with your fingers.

Start with a living cell 20 micrometres across and keep zooming. Pass through organelles, the crowded inside of the cytoplasm, a ribosome building a protein, the atoms of an α-helix and the hydrogen bonds that hold it together. Then dive into a carbon atom: its electron clouds, the nucleus, a proton, the quarks inside it. Finally go beyond what has ever been measured: preons, the great desert of grand unification, vibrating strings and the quantum foam of the Planck scale, at 10⁻³⁵ metres.

THE BEST CURRENT MODELS, HONESTLY LABELLED
Every level is marked as experimentally confirmed, hypothesis or speculation, so you always know where knowledge ends and prediction begins. A live scale ruler shows exactly where you are, from micrometres to femtometres and beyond.

TAP ANYTHING
Tap a mitochondrion, a ribosome, a quark or a string to see what it is, how big it really is and what it does. Choose "Show only this" to hide everything else and study it on its own.

LOOK AROUND FROM THE INSIDE
Step inside the cell and turn your phone: the 360° view follows your movement as if you were standing among the organelles.

MADE FOR EXPLORING
• Real-time 3D scenes rendered on your device, smooth on iPhone and iPad
• Pinch to zoom, drag to orbit, two fingers to move
• Full-screen mode for teaching, presenting and screenshots
• Share any view as an image
• English and Turkish
• Works offline. No ads, no accounts, no data collected

Great for curious minds, students and teachers in biology, chemistry and physics classes.

name: IOOI
description:
접었다 펴면, 거울처럼 똑같이.

IOOI는 iPhone Duo를 위한 데칼코마니 앱이에요. 펼친 안쪽 화면의 종이에 그림을 그리고, 접어서 바깥 화면의 종이 뒷면을 문지른 다음, 다시 펼쳐 보세요. 문지른 자리만 반대쪽 종이에 거울처럼 천천히 나타나요.

■ 이렇게 놀아요
1. 그려요 — 펼친 종이 양쪽에 손가락이나 Apple Pencil로 그려요. 색과 붓 굵기는 옆 버튼에서 골라요.
2. 접고 눌러요 — Duo를 접으면 바깥 화면이 종이의 뒷면이 돼요. 찍고 싶은 자리를 문지르면 돼요. 누르기 도구는 작게, 보통, 넓게, 지우개 중에서 골라요.
3. 펼쳐요 — 문지른 자리만 반대쪽 종이에 거울처럼 찍혀 나와요. 누르지 않은 곳은 그대로예요.

■ 이런 점이 좋아요
• 화면 가득 종이 — 종이가 가장자리까지 꽉 차요. 도구는 모두 옆 버튼에 있어서 그림을 가리지 않아요.
• 접은 채로도 — 바깥 화면에서 누르기, 되돌리기, 지우기를 할 수 있고 폴더도 그대로 보여요.
• 폴더로 정리 — 종이에 이름을 붙이고 폴더로 나눠요. 폴더는 탭을 눌러 접었다 펼 수 있어요.
• 자동 저장 — 그리는 대로 저절로 저장돼요.
• 스티커로 내보내기 — 배경 없는 스티커, iMessage 스티커, 사진, PDF, 이미지로 내보내요.
• Apple Pencil — 기울이면 선이 굵어지고, 쓰는 동안 손바닥은 무시해요.

■ 개인정보
서버도, 광고도, 계정도 없어요. IOOI는 이용자의 정보를 수집하지 않고, 그림은 내 기기 안에만 저장돼요.

■ 알아두세요
IOOI는 접고 펴는 iPhone Duo에 맞춰 만들었어요. 접히지 않는 iPhone에서는 누르기 화면만 보여요.

name: IPM Connect
description:
IPM Connect accompagne les équipes IPM dans le suivi quotidien des admissions et de la relation avec leurs contacts. Retrouvez vos conversations, vos dossiers et vos actions à venir dans un espace adapté à votre rôle.

ÉCHANGEZ AVEC VOS CONTACTS
Consultez vos conversations WhatsApp professionnelles, répondez aux messages et partagez des photos, des documents ou des messages vocaux. Repérez les échanges non lus et ceux à traiter.

GARDEZ LE FIL DE CHAQUE DOSSIER
Retrouvez les coordonnées, la formation, le statut et l’historique de vos leads. Ajoutez des notes et organisez les prochaines étapes du suivi.

ORGANISEZ VOS RAPPELS
Consultez vos rappels et vos tâches, planifiez vos relances et suivez les actions terminées.

SUIVEZ VOTRE ÉQUIPE
Les managers disposent d’une vue sur les disponibilités et l’activité de leurs conseillers. Les superviseurs peuvent consulter les appels en direct et les archives accessibles selon leurs autorisations.

APPELEZ DEPUIS VOTRE ESPACE IPM
Passez et recevez des appels WhatsApp avec une ligne Meta compatible et les autorisations nécessaires. Les appels passés depuis le mobile ne sont pas enregistrés et ne peuvent pas être écoutés en direct. La sonnerie des appels entrants nécessite que l’application soit ouverte.

UN ACCÈS PROFESSIONNEL
IPM Connect est réservé aux équipes IPM. Un compte fourni par votre administrateur et une connexion Internet sont nécessaires. Les fonctionnalités disponibles dépendent de votre rôle, de vos droits d’accès et de la configuration de votre organisation. Pour obtenir un accès ou de l’aide, contactez votre administrateur IPM.

name: IPSC Timer & Score
description:
IPSC Timer & Score es el compañero de entrenamiento y competencia para tiradores de tiro práctico (IPSC).

SHOT TIMER CON EL MICRÓFONO
• Detecta cada disparo con el micrófono del teléfono y registra draw, splits y tiempo total con precisión de milisegundos.
• Beep de inicio con retraso aleatorio, par time y sensibilidad ajustable para polígonos ruidosos.
• Graba video del string y salta a cada disparo para revisar tu técnica.
• Modo práctica en seco: detecta el clic del percutor.
• Funciona sin señal: tus strings se sincronizan al recuperar conexión.

PUNTUACIÓN CON UNA FOTO
• Fotografía el blanco y la app detecta los impactos y los clasifica en A, C, D o Miss.
• Pensada para blancos reciclados: compara la foto del blanco parchado con la de después del string y cuenta solo los impactos nuevos.
• Detecta impactos dobles y respeta la regla de la línea según el calibre.
• Calcula puntos y Hit Factor en Minor o Major.

EJERCICIOS Y DISEÑO DE CANCHAS
• Diseña etapas en una vista cenital: blancos de papel, metales, no-shoots, paredes, líneas de falta y posición de inicio.
• Calcula disparos mínimos, puntos máximos y tipo de curso.
• Plantillas clásicas: Bill Drill, El Presidente, Blake Drill y más.

COMPETENCIAS
• Crea matches con etapas y tiradores de tu club.
• Resultados por etapa y generales con el método IPSC (porcentaje de etapa y puntos de match).
• Exporta los resultados a CSV.

ACADEMIA
• Lecciones en video por categoría y nivel: fundamentos, desenfunde, recargas, transiciones, movimiento y reglamento.
• Cada lección puede incluir un ejercicio para practicar lo aprendido.

ANALÍTICA
• Evolución de Hit Factor, draw, splits y precisión.
• Histograma de splits, consistencia, distribución A/C/D/Miss, actividad diaria y récords personales.

Inicia sesión con tu cuenta de Google y lleva tu historial a cualquier dispositivo.

IPSC Timer & Score es una herramienta de entrenamiento y registro. Practica siempre bajo las normas de seguridad de tu polígono y la supervisión de un Range Officer. En competencias oficiales prevalece el tiempo del timer del RO.

name: ivy 2048
description:
A soft little take on 2048, made for quiet moments.

Swipe, match equal numbers, and meet a new little friend with every kind of tile. Start with Mochi the kitten, reach Starlight at 2048, then keep growing toward even more friends.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME
Choose a 3 x 3, 4 x 4, or 5 x 5 board. Each size keeps its own best score, so you can enjoy a tiny challenge or a little more room to think.

MOVE YOUR WAY
Classic swipe keeps things familiar. Glide play lets you make multiple deliberate moves without lifting your finger: glide, pause, or turn for the next move.

A LITTLE ROOM TO TRY AGAIN
Undo one move, including the tile that appeared. Autosave remembers your current board, while a separate quick-save bookmark lets you return to a game you saved on purpose.

MEET IVY'S FRIENDS
Discover 19 original illustrated characters in ivy's friends gallery, from kittens and bunnies to a sleepy moon and a dreamy friend cuddling her calico kitten.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No ads, accounts, in-app purchases, subscriptions, timers, or internet connection needed to play. Your progress stays on your device. Gentle haptics can be switched off, and animations respect Reduce Motion.

PLAY COMFORTABLY
Made for iPhone and iPad in portrait and landscape, with VoiceOver directional actions and keyboard arrow controls.

A little pink place to slow down.

name: Izipizy
description:
Keep your daily Macro Coins in one clear place. Set your Protein, Carbs and Fat budgets, then log whole or half coins with a tap. See what remains, review your entries and undo a tap when you need to.

Izipizy works without an account. Your phone, widgets and companion watch share the same approach, with English and Hebrew, light and dark themes, and accessible controls. Export your log to a file and import it when you choose.

Optional Health connections read steps and weight, save weights you enter, and export dietary energy for your logged coins. One P coin equals 200 kcal, one C coin 160 kcal, and one F coin 120 kcal; half-coins use half those amounts. Your budgets do not count as food intake. Undo removes the corresponding calorie entry when the phone next reconciles successfully. Health permissions are yours to grant or revoke.

Izipizy is a personal tracking tool. You choose your budgets; it does not prescribe a diet or infer nutrient grams from your coins.

name: Jadeite A - Phương Phỉ Thúy
description:
PHƯƠNG – PHỈ THUÝ JADEITE A | CỬA HÀNG NGỌC PHỈ THÚY MYANMAR TẠI HÀ NỘI

PHƯƠNG – PHỈ THUÝ JADEITE A là địa chỉ chuyên kinh doanh ngọc phỉ thúy (Natural Jadeite) Myanmar tại địa chỉ 1A Tràng Tiền, phường Cửa Nam, thành phố Hà Nội, cung cấp đa dạng sản phẩm từ vòng bản, vòng chuỗi, nhẫn ngọc, mặt dây chuyền đến các thiết kế trang sức chế tác riêng.

name: Japan Route Atlas
description:
An encyclopedia for getting to know Japan's national routes, one road at a time.
Explore facts about 459 routes: lengths, endpoints, road conditions and connecting routes. The app is free, with no advertising or in-app purchases.

FIND A ROUTE
Search by number, place or road name. Filter by endpoints, prefectures, length, sea sections, bridges, tunnels and other road characteristics.

DISCOVER ROAD FACTS AND CONNECTIONS
Read actual road lengths from the Road Statistics Annual Report, endpoints and waypoints from the national-route ordinance, and figures for bridges, tunnels and narrow sections. Explore connections recorded in the 2021 Road Traffic Census and parallel routes with the same two endpoints in the ordinance.

EXPLORE THE MAP
Tap or search for a municipality to explore its national routes. Prefecture borders stand out, and city labels appear in priority order as space permits. The selected municipality name stays visible.

ABOUT THE DATA
Core features work offline. Maps and figures reflect the dates of their sources and do not indicate current road conditions, access or permitted travel directions. This is not a navigation or driving-directions app.
Place names in the ordinance retain the Japanese original and may include former municipalities. Source conventions can omit connections and municipalities, so the lists are not exhaustive.

Main sources include Japan's MLIT Road Statistics Annual Report 2025, 2021 Road Traffic Census and National Land Numerical Information, the national-route ordinance, Japan Post, and © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Sources and adaptations are listed in the app.

Japanese and English interfaces are included. Municipality names can be shown in romanized form. Ordinance place names and some proper road names remain in Japanese.

name: Jenvori
description:
Jenvori turns what you want to say into a card worth sending.

Choose what the card is for and a style, write your message, and add a few favorite photos. Jenvori fills in the background, illustrations, and decorations, and sets your words on top as clean text you can change any time. Save it to Photos and send it in any messaging or social app.

CARDS FOR EVERY MOMENT
• Invitation: birthday parties, housewarmings, graduation parties, family dinners. Add a headline, names, date, time, venue, and address
• Greeting: birthdays, holidays, New Year, a new job
• Thank You
• Heartfelt: missing someone, anniversaries, apologies, goodbyes, encouragement
• Announcement: a move, a graduation, and other personal news

SIX STYLES
Warm Paper, Modern Bloom, Playful Pop, Quiet Night, Soft Collage, Bold Type.

MAKE IT WITH YOUR PHOTOS
Add up to 3 photos and Jenvori arranges them into the design, leaving clear space for your words. No photos? You get an illustrated card instead.

MAKE IT YOURS
Change the words whenever you like. Want a different look? Tap Regenerate for a fresh version. The earlier one stays in your drafts.

SAVE AND SEND
Save your card to Photos as a high-quality image in one tap. Jenvori only asks to add photos, never to read your library. Your cards are private until you choose to post them.

FIND IDEAS (OPTIONAL)
Post a card if you want to share it. Browse cards other people have posted by topic, save favorites, leave a comment, or send a free thank-you gift.

YOU CONTROL WHAT YOU SEE
Report any card or comment, block people you don't want to see, and hide cards you're not interested in.

MADE FOR FOLDABLE IPHONE TOO
Folded or unfolded, Jenvori lays itself out for the screen you're using. Cards keep their proportions, buttons and text fields stay a comfortable size, and the system controls stay where you expect them. Whichever screen you make a card on, it saves as the same 1080 × 1350 high-quality image.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with Apple, Google, or your phone number. Delete your account in Settings at any time.

Jenvori is free. There are no in-app purchases or subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.jenvoriapp.com/jenvori/TermsCoditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.jenvoriapp.com/jenvori/PrivacyPolicy.html

name: Jnoc Audio
description:
JNOC Audio is a multitrack audio editor for iPhone and iPad. Record, edit, make voices sound clear and professional, and save your work in the format you need. Everything happens on your device.

ENHANCE SPEECH Removes background noise and echo, then gives the voice a warm, clear studio sound, evens out loud and quiet words, and sets the loudness podcasts and streaming services expect. Choose how strong it is, and bring back some of the room if you want it to sound natural. Compare with the original at any time, or restore it.

CLEAN UP ANY SOUND Removes hiss, fans, traffic and air conditioning, finds and removes mains hum, and cuts low rumble, on any recording, not just voices.

MULTITRACK EDITING • Record while your project plays, in mono or stereo, pause and carry on in the same take, and watch the sound as you record • Cut, trim, set the volume of each piece, reverse it, or change its speed with or without changing the pitch • Fade in and out by dragging: sideways for the length, up or down for the shape of the fade • Tap and hold a piece to slide it earlier or later, leave gaps, or move it to another track • See all your tracks, or one track filling the screen, and drag tracks up or down to reorder them • Undo and redo everything

TRACKS AND EFFECTS Volume, pan, mute and solo on every track, shown right under the track's name. Effects on every track: noise gate, EQ, compressor, character (phone, radio, lo-fi, bit crush, overdrive and more), chorus, flanger, phaser, tremolo, auto-pan, stereo width, pitch, echo and reverb. Muted tracks, and the others when one is soloed, are greyed out so you always know what you'll hear.

LEVEL POINTS AND DUCKING Draw a track's volume over time with level points. Auto-ducking lowers your music while people talk and brings it back up in the pauses, with the amount and fades you choose.

MONO AND STEREO Every piece shows whether it is mono or stereo, and stereo pieces show both sides. Make a piece mono or stereo, keep only its left or right side, swap the sides, or split a stereo recording into two tracks, ideal when two microphones were recorded into one file.

OPENS ALMOST ANYTHING WAV, AIFF, MP3, M4A, Apple Lossless, FLAC, OGG, Opus, WMA, AC3 and many more, plus the sound from your videos in Photos or Files.

SAVES IN ANY FORMAT WAV, MP3, M4A (AAC), FLAC, AIFF, Apple Lossless, OGG Vorbis, Opus, WMA, AC3, MP2 and CAF. Choose bit depth, bit rate, sample rate, mono or stereo, set the loudness, add a title and artist, or save every track as its own file. Exports are kept in the Files app and can be shared anywhere.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN.



By Jnoc Production.

name: Jury of Peers
description:
We debate every day. Now there's a place built for it.

Jury of Peers is a debate platform for everyone. Pick a topic, from politics to pizza toppings, and argue it out face-to-face on live video, solo or with your whole team. The audience votes on who made the better argument.

LIVE VIDEO DEBATES
• Start a debate in seconds: pick a topic and category, name your team, and invite people to each side.
• Make it Public so anyone can watch and vote, or Private so only the people you invite can get in.
• A video room built for phones that keeps the active speaker front and center.
• Add a moderator to run the mics and the clock, or try the courtroom-style format with a judge and jurors, just for fun.

BACK UP YOUR POINTS
• Share links, photos and documents right in the room.
• Keep your sources organized in your personal Evidence Locker, with folders you can set up as you save.

THE CROWD DECIDES
• Audience voting with live tallies.
• Earn your Debater Score for sharp, fair argument and climb the Top Debaters leaderboard.

COMMUNITY
• Post your takes, run polls, share links, and tag friends with @mentions.
• Groups, direct and group messages, events, and quick video calls.
• Rate the fit on Classy or Trashy.

STAY INFORMED
• Find your elected officials and representatives by ZIP code.
• News, national statistics, music and film.

Notifications for messages, mentions, invitations and results mean you never miss a debate.

Jury of Peers is a debate and community platform. It is not a court, a legal service or a source of legal advice, and nothing on it is a legal ruling. Argue the issue, not the person.

name: JustPDFit!
description:
JustPDFit is a free PDF toolbox for iPhone and iPad. Turn photos and supported text files into PDFs, combine documents, scan paper pages and manage your files in one place.

YOUR PDF TOOLS
• Convert JPG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, BMP and GIF images to PDF.
• Convert TXT, Markdown, CSV and JSON text files to PDF.
• Merge PDF files and other supported files in the order you choose.
• Scan paper documents with the camera and save them as PDFs.
• Extract selected pages from an existing PDF.
• Add a simple text annotation to a PDF page.
• Preview, share, organize and delete saved PDFs.
• Open compatible files via the iOS Share menu.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Supported conversions happen locally on your device. Your documents are not uploaded to our servers. No account, no ads, no analytics, no watermarks.

Works on iPhone and iPad, with 27 interface languages. The app follows your device language and lets you choose another one in Settings.

name: Kabegoshi: Two-Player Escape
description:
One wall between two rooms. You can’t see the other room. Only your voices get through. Escape together.

Kabegoshi is a co-op escape game for two. Each player opens a different room on their own phone. Don’t look at each other’s screens: describe what you see, share clues out loud, and solve the puzzles together.

■ One purchase, two players
Paid episodes only need to be bought by the player in Room A. Room B is always free. Episode 1 is free for both.

■ The answer is in the other room
The code for your door is on a calendar in their room. The key to their door is in the painting on your wall. More than half of the puzzles only open when you talk it through.

■ Pass items through the hatch
Put an item in the hatch in the wall and a 4-digit handoff code appears. When the other player enters it, the item arrives in their room. Nothing to connect or pair. No internet needed.

■ Play solo, too
Choose “Solo” to move between both rooms on one device.

■ Episodes to play
Episode 1: Grandpa’s Bathhouse (free)
Locked in the men’s and women’s baths of a neighborhood bathhouse that just closed. The wall between them doesn’t reach the ceiling. Your voices carry.
Episode 2: Grandpa’s House, Upstairs and Downstairs (paid for Room A and Solo; Room B is free)
You’re split between the upstairs and downstairs of a two-family house, sending things up and down the dumbwaiter and lining up the birds on the persimmon tree together.

■ Great for
・Friends, couples and families looking for a game to play together
・Fans of escape rooms and puzzle games
・Players who want fair, logical puzzles

No ghosts and no jump scares. No ads, no sign-up.
Hints are free, as many times as you like.
Switch between English and Japanese in the menu. A Japanese player and an English player can play together: the answers are the same. iPhone and iPad can play together, too.

This story is fiction and has no connection to any real place, company or person.

name: Kadren: Goal & Action Partner
description:
We all have projects, habits, and personal goals that stay on our to-do list for weeks: finishing an online course, tackling a weekend home cleanup, coding a side project, or committing to an early-morning workout. Kadren is a dedicated productivity companion that bridges the gap between intention and execution through mutual accountability and focused teamwork.

How Kadren Powers Your Productivity:
1. Personal Action Tracker

Organize the tasks and habits you have been putting off. Create clear, actionable checkpoints, track completion status, and keep your daily to-do list structured and distraction-free.

2. Purpose-Driven Activity Boards

Browse and join specific task initiatives or create your own call for action. Whether you need a co-working partner for study sessions, a workout companion, or a collaborator to help kickstart a creative project, find others working toward the exact same milestone.

3. Coordinated Task Workspaces

Once you commit to a shared goal, coordinate logistics seamlessly. Built-in collaborative group threads and direct check-in channels let participants align schedules, share progress updates, and maintain mutual momentum without switching between different tools.

4. Built-In Accountability

Shared commitments turn procrastination into progress. Checking in with dedicated accountability partners keeps motivation high and ensures everyone crosses the finish line.

Turn lingering to-dos into completed achievements.

Download Kadren today and conquer your goals together.

name: Kaflarnia
description:
Kaflarnia to mały warsztat z dwoma stołami. Przy odlewie ustawiasz wilgoć, piasek i ubicie, potem czytasz rysy i gęstość. Przy wypale trzymasz ryk, żar i stos, potem czytasz siniznę i wygięcie.

Idziesz po kolei. Bez żyć, bez zegara, bez reklam i bez konta.

• 64 szczeble odlewu — ustaw wilgoć i czytaj rysy
• 78 szczebli wypału — ustaw ryk i czytaj siniznę
• Księga bierze tylko rachunki, które sam zostawisz
• Ścieżka idzie po kolei; zamknij bieżący szczebel, a otworzy się następny
• Z progu zostawiasz opinię, możesz też dołączyć zdjęcie dachówki

Kaflarnia nie zbiera i nie wysyła danych. Nie ma analityki ani reklam. Usunięcie aplikacji opróżnia warsztat.

name: Kakikaki: Japanese Handwriting
description:
Kakikaki is a handwriting app for children and for anyone starting Japanese. Learn how to write each character by tracing it with a finger or Apple Pencil.

■ Three steps for every character
Each character goes from "Trace" to "Write" (writing over a faint guide) to "No model" (writing from memory). Trace a stroke in the correct order and the app moves on to the next stroke automatically. Apple Pencil pressure is supported.

■ What you can practice
・Hiragana (all free)
・Katakana
・Kanji (the 1,026 kanji taught in Japanese elementary schools, by grade or by reading)
・English (the alphabet A–Z and the numbers 0–9)
The app follows your device language (Japanese or English). In English, kana and kanji readings are shown with romaji.

■ Easy to keep going
Finish a word to earn a star; write every character of the word with no model to earn a crown. Collect medals, check what you remember with reading and writing quizzes, and keep a practice streak.

■ For the whole family
Each person has their own records. Photos can be used as avatars.

■ Safe for kids
・No ads.
・No data collected. Records stay on your device and are never sent to a server.
・Purchases and links to outside websites are behind a parental gate.
・Practice works offline.

■ Free and paid
Free: all hiragana practice, 1 quiz a day, 1 person
"Unlock everything" (one-time purchase): katakana, kanji and English practice, unlimited quizzes, up to 10 people
Katakana, kanji and English can also be bought one at a time. A single purchase unlocks that practice only; the quiz and people limits stay. Purchases support Family Sharing.

name: Kakurasu by Solviq
description:
Kakurasu is a calm, clever number-logic puzzle from Japan. Ink cells so that every row and every column adds up to its clue. The twist: each cell is worth its position. In a row, a cell counts its column number; in a column, it counts its row number. Every cell has its weight.

Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved by logic alone. No guessing.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• Today's Daily and this week's Weekly are free, with no ads
• Each morning a new paper lands on top of the stack; earlier days wait underneath
• Catch up on any of the last 7 days
• Keep your streak going

HIDDEN SUMS
Harder boards hide some of their clues. Fewer numbers, deeper thinking, even on a 6×6 board.

LEARN THE LOGIC
• An interactive tutorial teaches the rules on real boards, step by step
• Seven techniques, from Too Big and Must-Have to What-If
• After each solve, see the puzzle's Logic Path: the techniques it took

MADE FOR THINKING
• Tap to ink, tap again to dot, or pick Ink or Dot directly
• Tally rings fill as your sums grow
• Limited hints that point to the next idea, not just the next easy cell
• Finish without hints for a Pure solve
• Sumi mode hides the rings for purists

THE LIBRARY
• 1,050 hand-graded puzzles in 7 packs, from 4×4 Beginner to 8×8 Expert, including tall portrait boards
• The first 5 puzzles of every pack are free

QUIET AND PRIVATE
• Light and dark themes
• English, Türkçe, 日本語
• Fully offline, no account
• Animations are reduced in Low Power Mode and with Reduce Motion

SIMPLE, FAIR PRICING
Kakurasu is free to download. Past dailies and free Library puzzles show a short ad after you finish, never during play. One purchase, Unlock Everything, opens the full Library and removes all ads for good. No subscription.

Made by Solviq, an independent puzzle studio.
Questions or ideas: solviq.puzzle@gmail.com

name: Kalorimeter: Hitung Kalori AI
description:
Kalorimeter membantu kamu mencatat makan dengan cepat dan memahami kalori serta gizimu setiap hari. Tanpa akun dan tanpa iklan: catatanmu tersimpan di perangkatmu.

CATAT MAKAN DENGAN CARAMU
. Foto makanan, ketik, atau ucapkan apa yang kamu makan, lalu AI memperkirakan kalori, protein, karbohidrat, lemak, dan gizi lainnya (Kalorimeter Plus)
. Pindai barcode produk kemasan
. Catat manual, simpan makanan favorit, dan salin menu dari hari lain
. Tinjau dan ubah hasilnya sebelum disimpan, lengkap dengan pratinjau "Bagaimana jika?" (Kalorimeter Plus)

COACH DAN ASISTEN SUARA (KALORIMETER PLUS)
. Tanya Coach soal target, tren berat badan, ide menu, atau latihanmu. Coach menjawab berdasarkan catatanmu sendiri.
. Ngobrol langsung dengan asisten suara untuk mencatat makanan dan mengecek progres tanpa mengetik.

TARGET YANG MASUK AKAL
. Target kalori dan makro dihitung dari profilmu dengan rumus yang teruji
. Target Adaptif menyesuaikan target setiap minggu dari tren berat badanmu (Kalorimeter Plus)

LEBIH DARI SEKADAR KALORI
. Air minum, puasa intermiten, berat badan, lemak tubuh, dan ukuran tubuh
. Latihan beban: rencana per hari, set, repetisi, dan beban, plus pustaka 870+ gerakan latihan
. Grafik progres dan ringkasan mingguan
. Tantangan Mingguan opsional bersama pengguna lain (18+)

TERHUBUNG DENGAN IPHONE-MU
. Sinkron dengan Apple Health: berat, gizi, langkah, dan latihan
. Widget kalori, protein, air, dan catat cepat
. Pintasan Siri dan tombol di Pusat Kontrol
. Cadangan opsional ke iCloud milikmu
. Tersedia di iPhone dan iPad, dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan 19 bahasa lain

PRIVASI
Tidak ada akun wajib, iklan, atau pelacakan. Data hanya dikirim saat kamu memakai fitur yang membutuhkannya, misalnya fitur AI. Penjelasan lengkap ada di Kebijakan Privasi.

KALORIMETER PLUS
Fitur AI memerlukan langganan Kalorimeter Plus, bulanan atau tahunan, dengan uji coba gratis 7 hari bagi pengguna yang memenuhi syarat. Plus mencakup batas aksi AI harian dan menit asisten suara bulanan yang ditampilkan di aplikasi. Pembayaran ditagihkan ke akun Apple ID saat pembelian dikonfirmasi. Langganan diperpanjang otomatis kecuali dimatikan paling lambat 24 jam sebelum periode berjalan berakhir, dan biaya perpanjangan ditagihkan dalam 24 jam sebelum periode berakhir. Kelola atau batalkan langganan di pengaturan Apple ID. Sisa masa uji coba gratis hangus saat kamu membeli langganan.

Kalorimeter bukan alat kesehatan dan tidak menggantikan saran dokter atau ahli gizi.

Kebijakan Privasi: https://kalorimeter.id/privacy
Syarat dan Ketentuan (EULA): https://kalorimeter.id/terms

name: KAPI: dobre misli za svaki dan
description:
Aplikacija Kapi svakodnevno donosi male kapi (misli, citate i ideje) i potiče čitanje i promišljanje bitnih životnih tema. Čitanje traje manje od 3 minute – dovoljno da te nešto potakne, a ne optereti. Ako ti se misao ne sviđa preskoči je ili iskoristi za poticaj. Nizovi i bodovi služe za tvoju motivaciju i otključavanje dodatnih opcija.
KAKO RADI
• Svaki dan nova kap: misao na prvom ekranu, kratko objašnjenje na drugom.
• Želiš dublje? Uz mnoge kapi postoji dodatni tekst i izvor – knjiga iz koje je misao.
• Osobni zadatak: pretoči pročitano u djelo i spremi ga na listu Napravi, uz podsjetnik.
• Biraš teme koje te zanimaju, a povremeno stigne i nešto novo.

GRADI NAVIKU
• Niz dana čitanja, bodovi i postignuća.
• Zaštitnici niza kad propustiš dan.
• Moj slap: vidi kako se kapi s vremenom skupljaju.
• Tjedni sažetak pročitanog.

S DRUGIMA
• Čitaj s prijateljem i potičite jedno drugo.
• Podijeli misao koja te dotakla kao lijepu sliku.

KONFERENCIJE I RADIONICE
Ako si bio na konferenciji ili radionici, upiši kod i svaki dan dobivaj kratke materijale koji nastavljaju ono što si čuo.

Tekstovi su odabrani iz knjiga koje potiču osobni rast, kreativnost, pomaganje drugima i zdrav život.
Aplikacija je besplatna. Prijava nije potrebna – napredak možeš spremiti e-mailom kad želiš.

Kap po kap čini slap.

name: Kazel Expo
description:
Kazel Expo brings Turkey to Europe: food, shopping, live music and culture on one festival weekend. With the official app you have everything with you – from your ticket to the line-up.

Discover festivals
• All upcoming Kazel Expo festivals with date, city, venue and countdown
• Line-up, artists, opening hours and directions at a glance

Tickets
• Choose tickets in the app and buy them securely on our checkout page
• Your tickets with QR code always with you – even without internet
• Save tickets as PDF or pass them on to friends

Directory and offers
• Find businesses from our festivals, see their offers and message them right in the app
• Follow businesses and get a notification when there is a new offer
• Order offers and pay on handover or online

Always up to date
• Notifications about entry times, line-up and ticket sales
• The Kazel Assistant answers your questions instantly
• Five languages: Deutsch, Türkçe, English, Nederlands, Français

To see your tickets, sign in with the email address of your order and a code – no password needed. Create an account to see your tickets, messages and orders on every phone. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

Questions? Write to info@kazelexpo.com.

name: Kazoekata
description:
Kazoekata is a study deck for Japanese counters, the words you add when you count things: people, long objects, days, floors, and the rest of daily life.

Forty counters cover everyday use and JLPT N5–N4. Open one and you get:

- What it counts
- A short way to remember the sound change
- Readings from 1 to 10, with the irregular ones marked
- How to ask "how many"
- Example sentences with furigana

The quiz drills the readings that do not follow the obvious pattern, such as さんぼん, ひとり, よにん, and ついたち. A right answer is marked. A miss is explained, and that reading waits in Practice until you clear it.

Set a daily goal of 5 or 10 counters. The app keeps a streak and your best quiz score. Mark a counter learned when it sticks, and save the ones you want to come back to. Progress stays on this iPhone. There is no account.

The first 15 counters and a short quiz are free. Full Access is a one-time purchase. It opens all 40 counters and the full quiz on the Apple ID that buys it. It is not a subscription.

name: KEMET: Lives of the Nile
description:
Begin in an artisan household in Thebes, 1258 BCE. Each season brings choices about work, learning, family, worship and the stores that keep your household alive.

BUILD A LIFE
Learn a profession, develop your skills, manage grain and materials, repay debts and care for your health. Your choices shape relationships and can bring consequences years later.

FOLLOW THE NILE
Establish trade routes between settlements, respond to changing city economies and build a reputation with local contacts. Or devote your routes to temple service, supporting shrines and earning religious prestige. Rivalries, promises and political influence can change what comes next.

LEAVE A LEGACY
Follow one life from youth to its end, record its story in your chronicle, begin again or continue through an eligible heir in lineage mode.

HISTORY WITH HUMAN STORIES
Documented historical anchors follow their course. Personal encounters and economic quantities are authored gameplay, with in-game notes explaining sources and uncertainties. Royal Origins adds a dramatized Merneptah chapter with a fixed historical accession.

FREE TO BUILD YOUR FUTURE
The original household includes the core professions, trade, temple service and lineage. Earn Royal Origins and established household starts through play, or purchase permanent early access. Paid and earned origins have the same benefits. Journal of Lapis is an optional cosmetic palette. No subscriptions or ads.

Gameplay and earned progress are stored on your device. Apple purchases can be restored using the same Apple Account; restore does not recover local life saves or earned progress after deletion. Internet is needed for store purchases and restoration.

name: Kep: AI Expense Tracker
description:
Kep turns bank alerts, screenshots and receipts into an expense log, in seconds.

Every day brings a few bank or e-wallet alerts: money in, money out, rent, electricity. You screenshot them and forget, and by the end of the month you can't remember where the money went. Retyping it into a spreadsheet takes longer than the transaction itself. Kep takes the message you already have and logs it for you.

CAPTURE IT ANY WAY
• Copy a balance alert and tap Paste
• Pick a screenshot of your transaction history, or snap a receipt with the camera
• Share straight from your banking app, MoMo, ZaloPay or Messages: pick Kep in the share sheet
• Tap Voice: "coffee 45 thousand", "salary 15 million". Or type a quick entry

READS LIKE A LOCAL
• Finds the amount (500.000, 1.200.000đ, 1,5 triệu, 45k), money in or out, the sender or recipient, the note and the date
• One history screenshot or several SMS alerts become separate entries, skipping balance and fee lines
• Built for Vietnamese banking messages, and reads English ones too
• Every entry appears as a card you can review and edit before it goes into your log

WHAT'S LEFT THIS MONTH
The home screen shows what you spent today and this month's money in, money out and what's left.

A MASCOT THAT FEELS YOUR WALLET
Kep dances when there's plenty left this month, sweats when you've almost spent it all, and faints when you're in the red.

RECURRING BILL REMINDERS
Rent, electricity, school fees: set the day of the month and Kep reminds you before it's due, with notifications scheduled on your iPhone.

PRIVATE, WORKS OFFLINE
No bank login, no account, no ads, no tracking. Text in photos and your voice are recognized on your iPhone. Your log stays on your device.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE (OPTIONAL)
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, Kep uses the on-device model to read tricky messages more carefully. Other iPhones still read offline with Kep's own reader.

KEP PRO
The free version includes 15 automatic reads a month (paste, camera, photo, voice, share). Manual entries, bill reminders and the mascot are always free. Kep Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription:
• Unlimited reads
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Export your log to CSV for Numbers, Excel or Google Sheets

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Kep is available in Vietnamese and English.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kep.escbase.xyz/privacy/

name: KerfAtlas
description:
Turn raw lengths into a thoughtful plan. KerfAtlas brings cut planning, material records and finished project history into one calm workshop companion.

PLAN WITH THE REAL NUMBERS
Enter stock length, kerf, piece sizes and quantities. A best-fit arrangement groups your pieces into stock lengths and shows material yield. Each piece includes one kerf allowance.

FOLLOW EVERY CUT
Read proportional cut maps and mark pieces as you work. Finish a plan to save useful remaining lengths. Set your own minimum remnant size.

GIVE OFFCUTS ANOTHER CHANCE
Keep stock specifications and saved remnants organized by material. Start a new plan from a specification or an individual remnant. Remnant sources are consumed when a plan is finished.

UNDERSTAND YOUR MATERIAL
Compare planned and finished project yield, piece counts, stock lengths and remainders. Search your finished archive by project or material.

TAKE YOUR WORK WITH YOU
Share a plan as a PDF, export cut lists as CSV, or save a JSON backup of your workshop. Restore a valid backup after confirmation. Choose millimetres or inches for display; entries and cut-list files use millimetres.

Editable sample projects help you explore the full workflow. No sign-in or purchases are required. Planning and file generation run on your device.

KerfAtlas is a planning aid for one-dimensional cuts. Its best-fit heuristic does not guarantee the minimum stock count. Always verify dimensions and follow your equipment instructions before cutting.

Support & feedback: tanerb894@gmail.com

name: Keyly: Keyboard Themes & Fonts
description:
Your keyboard, your style. Keyly gives your iPhone keyboard 1,700+ themes, real mechanical keycaps, satisfying typing sounds and light effects that glow on every tap, all while typing just like the iPhone keyboard you know.

  ◆ 1,700+ THEMES FOR EVERY MOOD
  Coquette, liquid glass, kawaii candy, Y2K chrome, cyber neon, anime, galaxy, cottagecore, pixel retro, dark luxury and many more. New looks are added regularly.

  ◆ MECHANICAL KEYBOARDS
  • SA keycaps: tall, sculpted and two-tone
  • Pudding keycaps with RGB underglow
  • Vintage typewriter keys and slim low-profile keys
  • Classic Black RGB: every tap sends a rainbow wave along the row, the column or in a ring

  ◆ DESIGN YOUR OWN
  • Turn any photo into your keyboard background
  • Choose key shapes, colors, gradients, prints and cute key ears
  • Add animated RGB lighting
  • Share your design with friends using a code or a QR link

  ◆ FEEL EVERY KEY
  • 21 typing sounds: mechanical, clicky, typewriter and more
  • 55 tap effects: hearts, sparkles, ripples, fireworks, neon waves
  • Gentle haptics on every key
  • 180+ key fonts and fancy text styles

  • Same key sizes and spacing as the iPhone keyboard, with no dead zones
  • Word suggestions, next-word predictions and autocorrect
  • Slide the space bar to move the cursor, hold a key for accents
  • Emoji keyboard with search
  • 45 typing languages, including Vietnamese (Telex, VNI, VIQR)

  ◆ PRIVATE BY DESIGN
  Keyly never collects, stores or uploads what you type. Words it learns stay on your iPhone. "Allow Full Access" is used only for typing sounds and to sync the theme you pick in the app.

  Settings › Keyly › Keyboards › turn on Keyly and Allow Full Access. Then hold the globe key in any app and choose Keyly.

  Unlock every PRO theme, effect, sound and DIY option, with no ads.

The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before that. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

  Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: KhanhHoa-Review
description:
KhanhHoa-Review is where locals and travellers share honest reviews of restaurants, cafés, hotels, spas, tours and every place in Khanh Hoa — Nha Trang, Cam Ranh, Phan Rang and beyond.

• A transparent Trust Score for every place, based on review quality, profile verification and owner response rate.
• Scam alerts: report problems and see places with confirmed complaints.
• Write reviews with photos and ask owners questions directly.
• Browse by category, find places near you, or search by voice.
• Save favourites and get notified when someone replies.
• Available in Vietnamese, English, Chinese, Russian and Korean.

Business owners can claim their profile, keep details up to date and reply to reviews.

name: Kinfolk: Whereabouts & Events
description:
Kinfolk is live location sharing for the people you actually want to see. Go live for the walk home, the dinner, or the trip across town. Share your location while it matters, and the share ends when you arrive or when you stop it.

Kin get the exact spot on the map. Folks see the neighbourhood, so family and friends nearby know you are on the way. You decide who sits in which circle, and you can change it when life changes.

The plan for the night lives on the same map. An event has a place, a time, and the people you invited. Head out and share your live location toward it. A group can follow the arrival together, then the map goes quiet.

You start every share yourself. Ghost for an hour when you want the evening to stay private. A place you care about stays hidden until you choose to show it. Kinfolk does not sell where you are.

Kinfolk is for families and friends on iPhone and Android. Real-time location sharing, a map for the people already out, and a plan you can actually meet at.

See them when it matters.

Kinfolk uses Apple's standard Terms of Use (EULA): www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kiss & Cry Business
description:
Kiss & Cry Business is the app for figure skating photographers. Your profile is seen by the people who use Kiss & Cry — skaters' parents and the skaters themselves, who follow results and protocols there.

A PROFILE PARENTS AND SKATERS SEE
• Your name or your studio's, a short and a full description, and a profile picture
• A portfolio of up to twenty pictures
• The contacts you choose to show: phone, website, Instagram, Facebook, e-mail and a chat in the app

THE COMPETITIONS YOU WILL BE AT
• The competitions to come, in your country and worldwide
• One tap marks that you will be there — your profile appears on that competition's page
• The nearest ones are shown on your profile too

CONVERSATIONS
• People using Kiss & Cry can write to you from your profile
• You talk to the Kiss & Cry team in the app (More → Write to us)
• A notification for every new message

STATISTICS
• How many people opened your profile — day by day, over the last week and month
• You see numbers, never names

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your profile, every change to it and every picture are reviewed by hand before they go public.
• By publishing a picture you confirm you hold the rights to it, including the consent of the people shown or their guardians.
• An account with an e-mail address is needed; it can be deleted in the app.
• Kiss & Cry is an independent project, not affiliated with PZŁF, ČKS or the ISU.

Clubs and coaches will soon get a place of their own here.

name: Kitty Bop: Cat Games for Cats
description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a toy your cat will want to catch.

Bugs crawl and hide. Mice scurry into boxes. Birds peck and take off. Fish swim under lily pads, a laser dot darts across the floor, and a ball of yarn rolls away. Your cat swats the screen, and a new one runs in.

Turn on Carousel and the games change on their own, so your cat keeps hunting without you touching a thing.

MADE FOR PAWS
- Large hit area, because a paw is not a finger
- Colors cats see well: blue and yellow
- Hold the pause button to stop, so your cat can't pause by accident
- Works without Wi-Fi

KEEP YOUR CAT INTERESTED
- Insects hide under leaves and peek out
- After a few misses, one runs up close
- A rare golden bug shows up now and then
- The game gets faster or slower to match your cat
- Record your own voice to call your cat to the hunt

SET UP THE HUNT
- Bugs, spiders, flies or all of them mixed
- Choose how many, how big and how fast
- Endless play or until the last one is caught
- Live preview: change the count, size and speed and see it right away
- Laser colors, yarn thread and other settings for each game
- Timer for 5, 10 or 15 minutes
- Normal, quiet or no sound

FILM THE BEST MOMENTS
Turn on the front camera and Kitty Bop makes a short video of your cat's catches, with a slow-motion replay of the best swat and music. Save it or share it.

ONE PROFILE FOR EACH CAT
Add a name, photo and birthday. Set a daily play goal and follow catches, records, streaks, medals and a weekly review.

Your videos, voice recordings and stats stay on your device. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: Kivora Compass
description:
Kivora Compass is a mathematical tool for fans of board games and role-playing games. From calculating the probability of a dice roll, analyzing character attack potential, to tracking each dice roll during a real game session, everything is gathered in one application.

THE LAB – EXPLORING PROBABILITY

Enter any formula such as 2d6, 1d20+5, or 4d6kh3 to see the entire distribution of results. The application provides the mean, median, range, dispersion, and most likely outcome. You can check the probability of reaching a specific score, view distribution graphs, and compare multiple formulas to see which option is more advantageous.

COMBAT – CALCULATIONS IN COMBAT

Set attack stats, opponent armor, critical hit range, advantages or disadvantages, and damage per hit. Kivora Compass calculates hit rate, critical hit rate, miss rate, and expected damage per turn and per round. You can also compare attack effectiveness against different armor levels, estimate the chance of taking down a target, and analyze the chances of saving a roll with a die.

GAME NIGHT – MONITOR THE GAME

Create a game session, add participants in turn order, and record the results from actual dice rolls. The application can roll the dice automatically or allow you to input results from physical dice rolls. Actual results are continuously compared with theoretical probabilities, along with fairness assessments, charts, history, and statistics for each player. You can also export all data to a CSV file.

ROLL – ROLL THE DICE YOUR WAY

Roll any formula with visual dice effects. The pieces kept or discarded are clearly displayed. Save your favorite formulas to your dice bag for quick access, review history, and compare results with expected probabilities.

Additionally, quick reference tables help you look up common scenarios such as the sum of 2d6, the target of d20 when advantageous or disadvantageous, the probability of at least one outcome appearing, and how to cast attribute points.

name: Kneadlog - Gentle Bond Archive
description:
Kneadlog is a cozy pet journal for iPhone. Keep short scraps from your day, turn them into first-person diary pages in your pet’s voice, chat with Soft Whisper, track care, and browse a polaroid memoir board. Diaries, pets, and chat history stay on this device by default.

A PET DIARY FROM THEIR POINT OF VIEW
Open Today, jot a few words, optionally attach a pet photo, and tap Generate pet diary. Kneadlog crafts a short first-person page in your roommate’s tone and pins it to Memoir. Type or use voice input. Diaries are for everyday warmth, not medical advice.

SOFT WHISPER THAT REMEMBERS THIS CHAT
From Today, open Soft Whisper to talk as if your pet is listening. Replies stay in character for the species you chose. Soft Whisper can recall recent chat turns saved on this device so follow-ups can use what you already said, and will not invent details it never heard. Help runs only after you ask — never in the background.

PET PROFILES FOR REAL NESTS
Add roommates with a name, photo, and species: cat, dog, rabbit, hamster, chinchilla, reptile, or a custom species label. Keep care cadences, growth marks, and optional behavior notes. Free nests hold up to 2 pets; Premium raises that to 5.

MEMOIR AS A POLAROID BOARD
Memoir is not a social feed. Browse tilted polaroids by time, filter by pet, mood, or range, and export the board or a month collection as a shareable image. Yearly memoir export unlocks with Premium.

LOCAL FIRST, CLEAR WHEN YOU ASK
Core journaling works offline. Nest data, Soft Whisper history, Soft Coins, and Premium status for this Apple ID stay on device. Camera, Photos, and Microphone are requested only when you tap those actions. On this device, Kneadlog may check a still for human likeness so people-focused shots can be blocked; it does not build a face identity database or collect biometric face templates. When you ask for diary help, Soft Whisper, or a behavior note, text and any selected pet image go securely to kneadlog.com. Skip those assists anytime. Deleting the app removes local nest data.

SOFT COINS AND PREMIUM
New installs receive 50 Soft Coins. Without Premium, each diary generation, Soft Whisper reply, or behavior note costs 5 Soft Coins, with a confirm step before Soft Coins are spent. Premium skips Soft Coins for those assists while active, keeps diaries and Soft Whisper unlimited under Premium perks, supports up to 5 pets, and unlocks yearly memoir export. Soft Coin packs and Premium are in-app purchases through Apple. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Account Settings.

WHY KNEADLOG FEELS DIFFERENT
Many pet apps focus on logs or reminders alone. Kneadlog is a small nest: first-person pet diaries, Soft Whisper with on-device short-term chat memory, species-flavored voices including custom companions, a polaroid memoir you can export, and local-first design with optional network help only when you tap ask.

Write one soft scrap. Let your roommate answer in kind. Kneadlog is for everyday affection — not diagnosis, training guarantees, or veterinary care. 


Subscription Plans:
Weekly Crest, Price: $1.99 / 1 week,
Monthly Privilege, Price: $4.49 / 1 month,
Half-Year Charter, Price: $16.99 / 6 months,
Annual Oath, Price: $27.99 / 1 year

User Agreement
https://kneadlog.com/volcanologic/volcanological/UserAgreement.html

Privacy Policy
https://kneadlog.com/volcano/volcanoes/PrivacyPolicy.html

Subscription Terms
https://kneadlog.com/volcanoism/volcanology/SubscriptionTerms.html

name: kokemori
description:
A tiny girl, a moss forest, and slow days together.

Tend the dried moss and the forest turns green, patch by patch. Play with her in the tent by day, and with the snail at night: moss matching, moss territory, and moss ball making.

Turn on the focus timer and she tends the forest while you work. When it ends, you both take a rest.

• Works fully offline
• No ads, no purchases
• Your data stays on your device
• Japanese / English

name: Kotinda
description:
Kotinda livre vos repas et vos colis à Pointe-Noire.

REPAS
• Choisissez un restaurant, composez votre commande (portions, accompagnements, piment) et suivez-la en direct.
• Le restaurant confirme, prépare, et un livreur Kotinda vous l'apporte.
• Vous voyez le livreur sur la carte et vous pouvez l'appeler depuis l'app, sans échanger de numéros.

COLIS
• Un document, un carton, un achat à récupérer : indiquez l'adresse de retrait et celle de livraison.
• Le prix est affiché avant d'envoyer, selon la distance et la taille du colis.
• L'expéditeur ou le destinataire paie la course, à la remise.

PAIEMENT À LA LIVRAISON
• En espèces ou par Mobile Money, au livreur. Rien n'est prélevé dans l'application.
• Un code à 4 chiffres, affiché dans votre app, confirme la remise.

ENTREPRISES
• Les entreprises peuvent être facturées au mois : rien à payer au livreur, un relevé des courses chaque mois.

LIVREURS ET RESTAURANTS
• La même app sert aux livreurs et aux restaurants partenaires : connectez-vous avec votre compte pro et votre espace s'ouvre.
• Livreur : passez en ligne, acceptez les courses proches, suivez l'itinéraire et vos gains.
• Restaurant : recevez les commandes en direct, gérez votre carte, encaissez à la caisse et suivez vos statistiques.
• Les comptes livreurs et restaurants sont validés par l'équipe Kotinda.

Kotinda (« envoyer » en lingala) est un service de Résidence Feuille.

name: Kronos Translator Keyboard
description:
Kronos Translator Keyboard translates as you type, right inside any app. Write in English, tap send, and the other person reads it in their language.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Translation runs entirely on your iPhone with an on-device AI model. Your messages are never sent to a server, and it keeps working offline.

WORKS IN EVERY APP
WhatsApp, iMessage, Instagram, email, notes: switch to Kronos with the globe key and type as usual. A live preview shows the translation before you send it.

TRANSLATE WITH CONTEXT
Turn it on and Kronos uses your last few sent messages to get names, gender and tone right. That context stays on your phone too.

A REAL KEYBOARD
Autocorrect, suggestions, emoji with search, number and symbol pads, and quick language switching.

99 THEMES
Colour themes from Sunset to Lavender, plus character keyboards: a cat whose eyes go wide, a frog that catches flies, a croc that snaps, an otter that blows bubbles, and holiday and Igbo-inspired designs. The characters react only to the key you press, and you can turn animations off.

LANGUAGES
English to French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Dutch, Czech, Romanian, Swedish, Ukrainian, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay and Filipino.

FREE AND PRO
Kronos is free with 4 themes and 10 live translations a day. Kronos Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks all 99 themes and unlimited live translations.

The translation model (about 500 MB) downloads once inside the app, then everything runs on-device.

name: KRU
description:
Ne rate plus un concert, une expo ou une soirée par peur d'y aller seul.

KRU te montre ce qui se passe ce soir et ce week-end dans ta ville, et t'aide à y aller avec d'autres personnes : seul·e, en duo ou avec ta bande.

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE
• Fais défiler les sorties comme des stories : concerts, expos, musées, théâtre, stand-up, soirées, sport…
• Choisis tes thèmes, change-les à tout moment.
• Touche « On y va » : KRU te propose jusqu'à 5 crews qui te ressemblent (goûts, âge, ambiance).
• Discute avec ton crew, envoie des messages vocaux, fixez le rendez-vous, prenez vos places.
• Ou vas-y sans crew : tes billets en un geste et un rappel avant la sortie.

CRÉE TA SORTIE
Partie d'échecs, run du dimanche, soirée appart, expo entre amis : propose ton propre événement, public ou privé.

EN CONFIANCE
• Profils vérifiés (selfie + pièce d'identité) pour rejoindre un crew.
• Signalement et blocage en un geste, modération sous 24 h.
• Notes après chaque sortie.

KRU est réservé aux personnes majeures. Disponible à Paris, Londres, Madrid et Genève.

name: Kunwork
description:
Kunwork ishi bor odamlar va mohir ustalar bir-birini topadigan ilova. Santexnik va elektrikdan tortib tozalash va repetitorgacha, Kunwork bilan bepul e’lon joylaysiz, ishonchli ustalarning takliflarini solishtirasiz yoki o‘z kasbingiz bilan daromad qiling.

BIR E’LON, BIR NECHTA TAKLIF

Ishni bir gap bilan yozing va surat qo‘shing. Shu ishni qiladigan ustalar o‘zi narx va vaqt bilan taklif yuboradi, siz esa ularni baholari va avvalgi ishlari bilan yonma-yon solishtirasiz. Hech kimga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib yurish shart emas.

DAVLAT TOMONIDAN TASDIQLANGAN USTALAR

Shaxsi davlat MyID tizimida tasdiqlangan ustada maxsus belgi bo‘ladi.

MANZILINGIZ SIZDA QOLADI

Xaritaga asoslangan ilovalardan farqli o‘laroq, Kunwork sizni hech qachon jonli xaritada ko‘rsatmaydi. Siz tanlamaguningizcha usta faqat tumaningizni ko‘radi, gaplashish esa ilovadagi chatda, raqamingizni bermasdan.

BUGUN BUYURTMA BERING, ERTAGA DAROMAD QILING

Hammasi bitta hisobda. Profil’da bir bosishda buyurtmachidan ustaga o‘ting va buyurtmalar ola boshlang. Ikkinchi ilova ham, qayta ro‘yxatdan o‘tish ham kerak emas.

ISHLAGANINGIZ TO‘LIQ O‘ZINGIZGA

Kunwork komissiya olmaydi, taklif yuborish esa bepul. Narx va ish vaqtini o‘zingiz belgilaysiz, kasbingiz va tumaningizga mos yangi buyurtmalar esa bosh sahifangizga tushadi.

TOP: SIZNI BIRINCHI KO‘RISHADI

Ko‘proq buyurtma kerakmi? TOP profilingizni bosh sahifa va qidiruvning eng yuqorisiga chiqaradi.

KRANDAN TO‘Y FOTOGRAFIGACHA

Santexniklar, elektriklar, konditsioner o‘rnatish va ta’miri, tozalash, ko‘chish, mebel yig‘ish, bo‘yoq va ta’mir, kompyuter ta’miri, avtoelektriklar, bog‘dorchilik, repetitorlar, enagalar, fotograflar va tadbir xizmatlari.

Kunwork’ni yuklab oling: birinchi e’loningizni bepul joylang yoki bugunoq daromad qilishni boshlang.
