name: Last Light: The Apartment
description:
It's night, and you've come to an old apartment building looking for your mother. The power is failing, the stairwell keeps getting longer, and the things behind the doors would rather you didn't find her.

Last Light is a roguelike deckbuilder played by lantern light. Every card has two faces: with the lantern on it does one thing, in the dark it does another. Every enemy shows you two intents, one for each light. Each turn you decide which one you would rather face, and the lantern only holds so many charges.

- 73 two-faced cards that change with the light, plus 12 fusions of old objects
- Many ways to build a deck: burn, chill and brittle, electric load, marks, or flipping the light every turn
- 20 habits and 12 charms that bend every run in a different direction
- Read both intents, then choose: light the lantern or stay in the dark
- Doors, peepholes and notes: pick which flat to enter and what to risk
- House rules taped to the doors, and a room that fights too: knock over a table, pull the fire extinguisher, open the fuse box
- A story told across five chapters, with four endings
- Hand-built rooms, an original soundtrack, film grain you can switch off
- No ads, no timers, no account

Chapter 1 is free. A single purchase unlocks Chapters 2 to 5 (Locked From Inside, The Main Fuse, The Book of Names and The Last Roll Call) and all four endings.

Chapter 1 takes about 30 minutes. A full playthrough of all five chapters takes around 2 to 3 hours, depending on how often the building gets you. Seeing all four endings takes more than one night.

Available in English and Turkish.

name: LaunchMyStore POS
description:
LaunchMyStore POS turns an iPhone or iPad into the till for your LaunchMyStore shop. Your products, stock, customers and orders are the same ones you sell online, so the shop and the counter stay in sync.

Sell fast
• Tap your favourites, search by name or SKU, or scan a barcode with the camera
• Add custom sales, discounts and tax, and sell or redeem gift cards
• Take payment in cash, by card or with a gift card, or split the bill
• Email the cart to a customer

One till, the whole team
• Sign in once with your LaunchMyStore account
• The owner and each staff member unlock the till with their own PIN
• Hand the till over without signing out

Run the counter
• Open and close shifts with a cash float, and record cash in and out
• End-of-day reports, refunds and an activity log
• Live stock from your online store, updated with every sale
• If the connection drops, sales are saved on the device and sent when you are back online

For restaurants and cafés
• Take orders at the table on a phone
• Send them straight to a kitchen display

Good to know
• You need a LaunchMyStore store with Point of Sale turned on. Sign in with the email and password you use for LaunchMyStore.
• There are no in-app purchases.
• Questions? Write to support@launchmystore.io

name: Leap Hopper
description:
Step into the enchanting realm of Leap Hopper, a thrilling single-player arcade adventure that breathes fresh life into timeless checkers mechanics! Take command of a daring emerald hopper as you glide across shifting checkered grids, executing elegant aerial captures over stationary ladybugs to clear the board before the relentless countdown clock strikes zero.

TWO DISTINCT DISCIPLINES OF MOVEMENT
Every stage sharpens a unique facet of your spatial intellect:
• Straight Leap Mode (Turkish Checkers Tradition): Soar strictly along orthogonal vectors—north, south, east, and west. Scan vertical and horizontal corridors to chain consecutive leaps.
• Diagonal Leap Mode (Western Checkers Tradition): Maneuver diagonally across alternating tiles. Calculate sharp corner-to-corner trajectories to sweep past your targets.
Levels strictly alternate between these disciplines, demanding swift mental agility and tactical flexibility.

DYNAMIC SHAPE-SHIFTING ARENAS
Break free from traditional square borders! Leap Hopper transforms the playing field into an array of geometric marvels:
• Heart Silhouettes: Navigate curving perimeters and tapered focal points.
• Beveled Octagons & Hexagons: Adapt your routes around trimmed diagonal edges.
• Diamond Rhombuses & Crosses: Weave through constricted corridors and expansive centers.
• Hollow Donuts: Steer clear of the void in center-deprived rings.

TREACHEROUS HAZARDS & LIVING PREDATORS
The pond holds dark secrets as your journey deepens:
• Toxic Mushrooms (Stage 6+): Sprouting across advanced arenas, these noxious fungi are fatal upon contact. Step or soar across a toxic cap, and your hopper instantly bursts into a comic cloud of cartoon smoke!
• The Stalking Spider (Stage 11+): An active, eight-legged predator that skitters across the board, advancing one tile whenever you execute a move. Outmaneuver its pursuit or get caught in its grasp!

TACTICAL JOKER & GOLDEN FORTUNE
• Shimmering Gold Coins: Harvest gleaning coins scattered across the tiles to accumulate wealth with smooth airborne trajectories.
• Joker Boost: Running low on precious seconds? Spend 200 hard-earned coins to summon the Joker power-up, gaining +15 clutch seconds of breathing room.

MESMERIZING PRESENTATION & RESPONSIVE CONTROLS
• Fluid, physics-inspired arc jumps with directional head turns and responsive shadow tracking.
• Organic idle motions: delicate ladybug wing twitches, pulsating poisonous spores, and menacing spider creeping.
• Soothing ambient soundtrack crafted for focus, paired with tactile acoustic effects and triumphant confetti showers.
• Designed exclusively for single-player offline sessions—no accounts, no subscriptions, no connectivity constraints.

Hop into the action, hone your spatial reflexes, and conquer every geometric trial in Leap Hopper!

name: Leaptime
description:
Leaptime is time tracking for organisations. Sign in with your work Google account and your time is one tap away: start a timer, pick the project, stop it when you are done, or fill in the day afterwards.

Your week at a glance. Every entry you record, grouped by day, with the week's total next to what your organisation expects. Edit, split or duplicate an entry in two taps.

Reports. Your hours by project, by day or by person, for any period, with vacation and sick days counted the way your organisation counts them. Managers see their team; admins see everyone.

Reminders that know your calendar. Start-of-day, end-of-day and fill-in reminders on your work days only, never on a holiday or a day off, plus your own custom reminders.

Messages. Announcements from your organisation arrive inside the app, with the unread count on the app icon.

Leaptime is for organisations: your company sets up its workspace, its projects and its clients, and you sign in with the Google account it gave you. Reviewers and visitors can try the demo organisation from the sign-in screen.

Privacy: https://leaptime.develeap.com/privacy
Support: https://leaptime.develeap.com/support

name: Leirverk
description: Aplikacja służy do wynajmu sprzętu na wycieczki i do ogrodu. Możesz ustalić termin wynajmu, liczbę uczestników wyprawy oraz stworzyć własną listę potrzebnego wyposażenia. W katalogu znajdziesz dostępne produkty, między innymi namioty, grille i zestawy narzędzi. Dostępne są również gotowe, przetestowane w terenie plany wypraw, przygotowane przez zespół. Możesz dodać dodatkowe usługi, takie jak czyszczenie sprzętu lub zestaw części zapasowych. Na bieżąco śledzisz postęp przygotowań, kwotę wynajmu oraz kaucję, aby wszystko było jasne przed wyjazdem.

name: Let Me Off!
description:
Everyone wants off the bus, and they all want off right now! Tap the passengers in the right order, clear the aisle and empty the bus before the doors close.

Let Me Off! is a cozy, chaotic puzzle game on a little toy bus packed with very particular passengers. Every passenger walks the way they're facing. If the way is clear, they hop off through a door or an open window. If someone's in the way... bump! That costs a move.

WHO GETS OFF FIRST?
Tap a passenger to send them walking in the direction of their arrow
Think ahead: the door counter shows how many moves you have left
Chain exits back to back for sweet, rising combos
No clock on the main route: take your time, then tap

A BUS FULL OF CHARACTERS
Grandma won't get up while anyone ahead of her is still on board
The passenger with the big bag takes two spots and can't turn around
The sleepyhead jolts awake when you tap him
The lost tourist spins around the moment he bumps into anything
The snack vendor turns his neighbors as he gets off
The phone zombie turns every time you tap anyone
The guy by the door insists on getting off last
Standing passengers slide forward every time the bus brakes
Double-decker buses: passengers come down the stairs one at a time

5,000 STOPS AND COUNTING
A carefully tuned difficulty curve with easy breathers between the tricky stops. After stop 5,000, the route just keeps going.

DAILY RUN AND WEEKLY LEAGUES
Every day, everyone rides the same bus. Finish the Daily Run, post your best score and climb from the Neighborhood League all the way to the World League.

HANDY BOOSTERS
Let Me Off!: everyone with a clear path gets off at once
Window Out: one passenger hops out the side window
Turn: point a passenger exactly where you need

PLAY ANYWHERE
Short stops fit a commute or a coffee break. The main route works without an internet connection; Daily Run and leagues need one.

Let Me Off! is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including No Ads, which removes all forced ads.

Next stop: yours!

name: Liansheng Sports
description:
Liansheng Sports helps you understand the game, practice with a plan, and keep track of what you learn.

Explore 51 illustrated lessons across eight sports, including running, basketball, football, swimming, badminton, tennis, cycling, and strength training. Learn how to set up a movement, follow it step by step, and spot common mistakes. Field diagrams and examples make rules easier to understand.
- Learn at your own pace. Search the offline library, save favorite lessons, and pick up where you left off.
- Plan your practice. Start with one of 15 training templates or build your own schedule with drills, sets, targets, and rest intervals.
- Log each session. Use the built-in timer or enter your duration manually. Add notes and compare saved sessions side by side.
- See your progress. Review your learning and training history, browse weekly and monthly trends, and set optional local reminders.
- Keep a copy. Back up and restore your library with JSON, or export a PDF report of your learning and training activity.
Lessons and core training tools work offline. No account is required.

name: Libemax Timbratrice Mobile
description:
Permette di far timbrare i tuoi dipendenti con i badge NFC usando lo smartphone o tablet come se fosse una timbratrice.

Ogni dipendente avrà un badge NFC (classica tesserina in plastica) avvicinandolo allo smartphone o tablet verrà riconosciuto dal sistema e la timbratura verrà inviata automaticamente tramite wifi/3g/4g a server in cloud.

Timbratrice mobile un'app per avere con sè una timbratrice sempre a portata di mano, oppure può essere anche installata all'ingresso dell'ufficio.

Per chi? Per capicantiere se hai bisogno di massima mobilità o per essere installata all'ingresso dell'ufficio e diventare una vera e propria timbratrice.

Come funziona? Ogni dipendente avrà un badge NFC e potrà timbrare avvicinando il proprio cartellino al dispositivo, in automatico l'app invierà l'orario e la sua posizione.

Un'ottima soluzione per far timbrare gli operai nei cantieri o per evitare grosse spese per acquistare una timbratrice.

Per maggiori informazioni:
http://www.apprilevazionepresenze.com/it/132/timbratrice-mobile

Scarica l'app per Android:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=it.libemax.timbratricemobile

name: Light Notes: Film Photography
description:
Light Notes is a notebook for film photographers who want to keep track of what they shot, how they developed it and how they printed it.

FILM AND EXPOSURES
Keep records for rolls and individual sheets. Log cameras, lenses, film stock, shooting ISO, aperture, shutter speed, filters, locations and notes. Add a phone reference photo to help identify each exposure.

CAMERAS, LENSES AND FILM
Choose equipment and film from the offline reference catalog or enter your own. Record camera backs and frame formats, and keep your equipment details available while logging exposures.

DEVELOPMENT
Record developer, dilution, time, temperature, agitation and notes for each roll or sheet.

DARKROOM PRINTING
Link prints to their source exposures. Record paper, grade, exposure, developer and toners. Keep print versions, reference photos, and dodge-and-burn annotations together.

PHOTOGRAPHIC TOOLS
Look up film-specific reciprocity guidance where verified data is available. Compare approximate black-and-white filter previews while preserving the original color reference photo.

YOUR NOTEBOOK, ON YOUR PHONE
Photography records and reference photos stay on the device. Core notebook features work offline. Optional address searches and some device dictation services require an internet connection.

Light Notes does not currently include cloud sync or notebook backup/export. Catalog sources, credits and licenses are available in the app.

name: Light Up Linton
description:
Light Up Linton is the Christmas lights map for Linton, Indiana.

FIND THE GOOD ONES
Every house worth a slow drive-by, on one map. Red bulbs are Naughty List houses that neighbors spotted. Green bulbs are homes in the contest, and blue bulbs are businesses.

GET ON THE NICE LIST
Enter your own house or business in the free decorating contest. Prizes for 1st Place Home, 2nd Place Home, and Best Business. Most flakes wins.

SPRINKLE YOUR FLAKES
Everyone gets a bag of 10 flakes. Sprinkle them on your favorite Nice List houses, all on one or spread around town. Change your mind? Take them back and move them.

SPOTTED A GREAT ONE?
Add it to the Naughty List with just the street address, so everyone else can find it too.

YOUR SLEIGH
Turn on the sleigh to see where you are on the map while you drive around. Your location stays on your phone. And please, let a passenger work the map.

Be a good neighbor: enjoy the lights from the street, don't knock on doors, and drive slow.

Sign-ups for the contest close Tuesday, December 1.

name: Limitless: Contractor CRM
description:
Limitless is the all-in-one platform for contractors and home-service businesses. It puts your leads, estimates, jobs, crew, and marketing in your pocket.

GET ALERTED THE MOMENT IT MATTERS
• New lead notifications from your website, quote widget, QR codes, and website visitors
• Know when a customer opens your estimate, comes back to it, or is ready to buy
• Instant alerts when an estimate is accepted or an invoice is paid
• New review alerts, so you can thank customers or respond fast
• A morning digest of today's jobs, pending estimates, and follow-ups

RUN THE FIELD
• Crew see their assigned jobs, get reminders, and hear about reschedules
• Snap job-site photos with your phone's camera, tagged with GPS
• Log drive-by leads and place yard signs on a live field map
• Leave field notes on a job for the whole crew

CLOSE MORE WORK
• Build and send estimates, and track every view
• Have customers sign in person on your phone or iPad
• Manage your pipeline, contacts, and tasks
• See which marketing actually drives jobs

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
• Choose exactly which notifications you get, with quiet hours and snooze
• Role-based access: owners, salespeople, and crew each see what they need

Limitless is for businesses with a Limitless account. Sign in with your existing team login.

name: LinenBetween
description:
LinenBetween is a landscape puzzle game about making openwork lace for a royal banquet. Every commission gives you a piece of linen and a pattern to match. Stitch bridges to hold the fabric you want to keep, then pull threads to open holes in the right places.

A single stitch can save the narrow strip between two diamonds. Later commissions challenge you to work with fewer stitches or think carefully about which end of a thread to pull first.

Preview a move before committing, undo a misstep, or ask for a hint when you’re stuck. Explore illustrated examples in Craft Notes, and revisit your finished pieces in the Collection. Your progress is saved on your device.

name: Lisual
description:
Lisual es la app de los clientes de Lisual para seguir el avance de su obra desde el teléfono o la tablet, con las cámaras instaladas en el lugar.

TU OBRA EN VIVO
• Mirá la cámara en tiempo real, en 4K cuando la conexión lo permite, con zoom.
• Última foto, foto en vivo, timelapse y comparación Antes y Ahora.
• Archivo de fotos por día y calendario de la obra.
• Grabaciones de la cámara, control de movimiento y luz en los equipos compatibles.

INTELIGENCIA DE OBRA
• Dashboard con personas, maquinaria y horas trabajadas por día.
• Entradas y salidas, materiales, acopio y seguridad e higiene.
• Buscador de fotos, Rayos X, mediciones sobre la foto y reporte PDF listo para compartir.
• Chat de obra: preguntale a la IA qué pasó en tu obra.

ALERTAS
• Avisos cuando la obra se para, cuando la cámara deja de mandar fotos, cuando llega un material o cuando el clima no deja trabajar.
• Elegí qué te llega y a qué número, obra por obra.

FOTOS EN LA OBRA
• Cuando estés en una de tus obras, la app te ofrece sacar fotos del avance y las sube solas a tu contenido, ordenadas por obra y fecha.

MARKETING DE TU PROYECTO
• Piezas para redes con las fotos de la obra, editor de video, vivo en redes y newsletter para tus compradores e inversores.

Modo claro, oscuro o automático, guía paso a paso en cada función y soporte por WhatsApp.

Para usar la app necesitás una cuenta de cliente de Lisual con cámaras activas.

name: Lobby: 3D Voice Chat
description:
Lobby is the social app where you hang out with friends in voice, video and 3D.

SERVERS AND CHANNELS
Create your own server and invite your friends. Chat in text channels, share photos and files, reply and react.

VOICE AND VIDEO
Join a voice channel with one tap. Turn on your camera, share your screen and watch together.

3D ROOMS
Walk around 3D rooms like the Lounge and the Cinema with your avatar: people nearby sound closer, people far away sound quieter. Sit down, wave and send emoji.

DRESS UP YOUR AVATAR
Collect coins with the daily reward and buy hats, glasses, crowns and more in the shop.

LOBBY+
• 2,200+ custom emoji: 3D, animated and blob packs
• Lobby+ exclusive items
• 2 server boosts and 100 MB uploads
• Double daily reward
Lobby+ is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

A SAFE COMMUNITY
Report or block any message or user with one tap; reports are reviewed within 24 hours. Zero tolerance for objectionable content. Lobby is for ages 18+.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://lobi.qd.je/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lobi.qd.je/privacy

name: Local Books Companion
description:
Local Books Companion turns your iPhone or iPad into a barcode scanner for Local Books on Mac and Windows.

Open a supported document in Local Books, connect your paired device, and scan items as you work. Scanned items appear on the open document, where you can review them before saving.

Look up an item by barcode or enter the code manually. With the relevant inventory features and staff permissions enabled, use assigned work to receive stock, count inventory, and pick or pack orders.

For live company workflows, pair the companion with your Local Books Office host and sign in to your company with your staff account.

name: Loop Lilt: Untangle Puzzles
description:
Untangle colorful loops, release hidden pegs, and solve exciting puzzles! Plan your moves, overcome tricky obstacles, and complete each level. Use hints, undo moves, and challenge your brain with fun and relaxing gameplay.

Can you untangle every loop?

name: Lucid Dream Training & Journal
description:
Lucid Dream Training & Journal is a lucid dreaming app with binaural beats sleep audio and a private dream journal, for iPhone and iPad. No account, no ads, no subscription. Works offline. Everything is open for 17 days, then your journal and a 15-minute nightly session stay free forever.

You look at your hands and think: I am dreaming. Nothing wakes you.
The street stays, the light is still wrong, and what happens next is yours to decide.

That moment is lucidity. People stumble into it once, then spend years trying to get back. This lucid dream trainer helps you find it on purpose.

LUCID DREAMING SESSIONS, ONE TAP AWAY

One big button starts the night.

• Binaural beats made live on your phone: two tones, one per ear, nothing streamed. Stereo headphones needed.
• Dream Dive: a 4 Hz beat in the theta waves range over soft pink noise, 15 to 90 minutes.
• Sleep sounds under the tones: soft surf by default, or rain sounds, wind and brown noise with Premium.
• A guided breathing exercise opens every session: a short meditation at a pace you set, such as 4-6-4, then your energy balloon.

HOW TO REMEMBER YOUR DREAMS

Name one thing from last night's dream. Gone before your feet hit the floor.

Recall starts one way: writing it down before it fades. So this lucid dream journal (a dream diary, if you prefer) opens in one tap and auto-saves every keystroke. A 4 a.m. entry survives a crash. Search every entry and filter to the lucid nights.

LEARN HOW TO LUCID DREAM, NIGHT BY NIGHT

• A 7-night guided path into lucid dreaming: dream recall, reality checks, dream signs, induction (MILD and wake-back-to-bed), stabilizing, dream control, free flight.
• Five original field manuals: a session start to finish, reaching Focus 10, Focus 12 and expanded awareness, the vibrational state and out-of-body practice, recall, and wake-initiated lucid dreams (WILD). Built for OBE and astral projection practice too.
• Mark each manual as read and see how far you have come. Every one ends with guidance for tonight.

THEY ASK FOR YOUR TRUST. THIS ONE HANDS YOU THE FILES.

Four declassified documents on consciousness research, in full and offline: the 1983 US Army report "Analysis and Assessment of Gateway Process," a US government work in the public domain, plus two research bulletins and a program brochure from CIA files released in 2003. Historical record, not endorsement. (Not affiliated with any agency or organization named in them.)

YOUR DREAMS NEVER LEAVE YOUR PHONE

A dream journal only works if you can be embarrassing in it. No account, no analytics, no cloud, no server. No AI reads your dreams. The App Privacy label says the same: Data Not Collected.

Now the proof: turn on airplane mode. The journal, the sessions, the manuals and the whole archive keep working, because nothing was ever leaving. (The App Store handles buying and restoring Premium. Voice capture runs on the device only.)

17 DAYS OF EVERYTHING, THEN FREE FOREVER

• Everything open for 17 days. No card, no account.
• Then free forever, no ads: your whole journal with search, calendar, export and backup; Dream Dive at 15 minutes; Field Manual 1; your first milestones and share cards.
• One purchase unlocks the rest, no subscription, nothing renews: the 7-night path, your dream signs, your own breathing pace, the silent visual session, all five manuals, the whole archive; "Deep Journey," 90 minutes; "Expanded Awareness," 45 minutes from Focus 10 into Focus 12; Dream Dive up to 90 minutes; "Night Voyage," a full night of sleep audio with faint REM-window cues; on-device voice capture; and Aurora Drift, the premium scene.

WHAT THIS IS NOT

Not a medical device, and not a promise. It does not treat, diagnose or fix anything, and no app can hand you a lucid dream. It trains the habits.

Not for use while driving. Consult a doctor before use if you have epilepsy, a heart condition, a psychiatric condition, or a sleep disorder.

Start free tonight. The rest is practice.

name: Lumhor — Khmer Keyboard
description:
Lumhor Keyboard

Type Khmer with a layout built around Khmer letters, subscripts and vowels. Lumhor is a free keyboard from Moonberry Tech.

- Tap or flick to compose Khmer letters, subscripts and alternate vowels.
- Get offline word and phrase suggestions.
- Switch between Khmer, Latin letters and numbers.
- Edit components and undo accepted suggestions.

Lumhor is intended for adults aged 18 and over. No account, subscription or invitation code is required. There are no ads or in-app purchases. Prediction quality varies.

PRIVACY AND OPTIONAL RESEARCH
Ordinary keyboard text is not uploaded automatically. Research participation is optional and off by default. Adults may deliberately write fictional Khmer examples, review and export them, and choose whether to submit the reviewed file on the research website. Do not include private messages, real identities, passwords or authentication codes. Automatic checks cannot detect every private detail.

Optional aggregate measurements contain no typed text and apply only inside the app typing lab. The keyboard extension collects no usage metrics in other apps and does not require Full Access. Offline predictions use statistical language data.

Support: team@moonberrytech.com
Privacy: https://moonberrytech.com/lumhor/privacy/
Research: https://moonberrytech.com/lumhor/research/

name: Lumiverho
description:
Lumiverho kirjaa lumeen ja jäähän jääneet jäljet ja auttaa palauttamaan paikan lähtiessä. Se sopii lumivaellukseen, pilkille ja lumella lepäämiseen.

Kirjaa ensin lumen lähtötila. Kuvaa kuopat, avannot, kasat ja kulku-urat käytön aikana, ja ota tasoitettu kuva ennen lähtöä. Kolme vaihetta pysyvät samassa kohteessa, jotta ennen ja jälkeen on helppo nähdä rinnakkain.

Jokaiselle jäljelle voi merkitä syyn ja korjauksen: täyttö, pinnan tasoitus, kasan hajotus tai uran harjaus. Pakkauslista tarkistaa, että varusteet, roskat ja ruoantähteet lähtevät mukaan. Saapumiskuvaa ja tasoitettua kuvaa vertaamalla näet, onko lumi puhdas, heikosti jäljellä vai yhä näkyvissä.

Avoimet työt kootaan yhteen. Kauden kohteet, suljettujen osuus, jäljet ja jääreiät näkyvät kirjassa, ja tekstin voi viedä ulos. Kuvat ja merkinnät säilyvät tässä puhelimessa.

name: Lumo Deep
description:
Deep beneath the waves lives Lumo, a tiny jellyfish who glows brighter with every pearl.

Guide Lumo through the silt of the ocean floor, gather the glowing pearls and reach the clam gate before the sea comes crashing down.

• Dig through soft silt, but whatever rests on top of it will fall.
• Push stones sideways to clear a path, or drop them where they're needed.
• Pearls and stones roll off each other: plan your moves or start an avalanche.
• Grumpy crabs patrol the tunnels, hugging the walls. Never touch one… unless you can drop a stone on it and turn it into a shower of pearls.

Features
• 10 handcrafted levels, from a gentle first dive to the Abyss
• Simple drag-and-hold controls designed for one thumb
• Glowing hand-drawn art, haptics and a soothing soundscape
• Play offline, anywhere. No ads, no accounts, no data collected

name: Luna Kidz
description:
Luna Kidz is a creative playroom where kids from 4 to 13 make their own picture books, songs and games together with Luna, a friendly AI guide who talks, reads and cheers them on.

TALK WITH LUNA
Kids tap Luna and simply talk. She answers out loud, helps them shape their ideas and tells them when it's time to tap Make. Talking with Luna is free.

PICTURE BOOKS READ ALOUD
Kids describe a story and Luna writes it, draws every page and reads it to them in a real flip book, with music in the background. They can choose from 20 picture styles, from watercolour to comics.

SONGS
Kids make their own songs with lyrics about anything they imagine, then listen in the music player while they play. Luna even dances along.

GAMES
Kids describe a game and Luna builds it: flat games, 3D worlds or games seen through their own eyes. Every game is cartoon play, never scary or bloody.

THEIR OWN CHARACTERS
Kids pick from many starter characters or draw their own heroes, and use them in their books and games.

PIANO AND LEARNING
- A rainbow piano that teaches by colour and ear: play freely, copy Luna's notes, or follow the glowing keys to learn a song
- Learn with Luna: short spoken lessons on any topic, followed by a quick three-question quiz

15 ANIMATED WORLDS
Starry Night, Under the Sea, Candy Clouds, Dino Cave, Laser Tag, Pixel Quest and more. Every world moves and changes places, and some characters walk right up to say hello.

BUILT FOR PARENTS
- Kids never sign up alone. A parent adds each kid from their own account, using only a nickname
- A parent PIN locks kids inside Luna Kidz, on our servers too, not only on the screen
- Set a monthly budget for each kid, or leave it open
- Read, check and delete anything your kid has made
- No ads, no public sharing and no tracking in kids mode
- Kids' voices are used live to talk with Luna and are never stored
- Stricter safety filters on every request
- English and Spanish

HOW IT WORKS
Luna Kidz uses a parent's Nova Art account. Kids profiles need a Nova Art family plan or the Kids add-on. Things kids make use credits from the parent's account; talking, learning and the piano are free.

Terms of Service: https://lunakidz.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lunakidz.com/privacy

name: LUNA Salon Board
description:
LUNA Salon Board is the front desk board for nail salons and spas. It puts the whole day on one screen so the owner, the front desk and every technician know who is next.

SEE THE WHOLE DAY
• One column per technician, with every appointment, break and walk-in
• Day and week views, drag to move or resize an appointment
• Online bookings land on the board right away

KEEP TURNS FAIR
• Automatic turn list for walk-ins
• Choose the turn rule that fits your salon
• Clock technicians in and out, with an optional PIN

CHECK OUT FAST
• Service total, tax and tip in one screen
• Split tips between technicians, split a bill across two payment methods

KNOW YOUR NUMBERS
• Daily income, receipts and close-out report
• Totals by technician, hours and payroll summary
• Client list with visit history and notes

STAY IN THE LOOP
• Get a notification on your phone when a client books online
• Works on iPhone and iPad, in English and Vietnamese

LUNA Salon Board is for salons that already have a LUNA account. Sign in with the email and password of your salon account. Technicians sign in with the login their salon owner gave them.

Questions: support@2themoon.digital

name: Lusone
description:
Lusone is a personal logic puzzle journal for quiet camp life reasoning.

Solve 96 tent-and-tree puzzles and daily challenges with no countdown or time limits. Completion time is recorded for star ratings. Use deduction to place tents around trees following row and column numbers, and watch your camp journal record your daily progress. All puzzle content is free to play offline, without ads or accounts.

name: LWCC Connect
description:
Stay connected to Living Word wherever you go.

The Living Word Christian Church app is your central place to stay connected with church life throughout the week.

Watch services and messages, stay up to date on upcoming events, sign up for LIFE Groups and church activities, access Bible reading plans and other resources, give securely, receive important church updates, and more, all from one convenient place.

Whether you’re checking what’s happening this week, growing in the Word, getting connected with others, or finding your place to serve, the Living Word app makes it easier to stay informed, involved, and connected.

Mobile app version: 6.24.7

name: Mala & Café - Guarda-Volumes
description:

Chegou antes do check-in do hotel? Seu voo sai apenas à noite? Não deixe suas malas atrapalharem seus passeios!

Baixe o Mala & Café e descubra uma maneira mais leve de viajar!

**Mala & Café — Guarda-Volumes Inteligente.**

name: MangaDuo Reader
description:
MangaDuo is a reader for the manga and comic files you already own, made for iPhone Duo. Read one page at a time with the phone closed; open it and the same page becomes a two-page spread. Pages turn like paper, and you can turn them with your voice.

WHY WE MADE IT
Hold a folding iPhone in landscape and you are holding the shape of an open book. Most readers treat the screen as one flat panel: the spread misses the fold, a gap opens between the pages, or a page straddles the hinge. arcion Inc. built a reader that treats the fold as the gutter of a book, first for our own use, and now as MangaDuo.


WHAT IT DOES

■ Open it, and you are already on a spread
On the outer screen you read one page at a time. Open the phone and hold it in landscape, and the same place in the book becomes a two-page spread. Right-to-left or left-to-right can be set for each book. The inner edges of the pages sit flush against the fold, and a wide illustration drawn across a spread is shown as one piece.

■ If the pairing is off, shift it by one page
A cover or a color insert can push the pages out of step. Tap “Shift Page” in the reader and the pairing in that section moves by one page. The app remembers it for each book.

■ Pages turn like paper
Hold a page with your finger and turn it slowly, or tap to turn it in one motion. Tap near the edge and the page flicks over; tap further in and it lifts and settles. On a spread, the page rises over the spine and its back shows the page underneath. Three speeds, or switch Page Curl off and pages slide.

■ Choose the paper and the shadow in the gutter
“White”, “White Paper” with a faint grain, or “Cream Paper”. “Center Shadow” in the middle of a book can be turned on or off. Margins take the page’s paper color, not a black band.

■ Turn pages with your voice
Say a word and the page turns. MangaDuo listens for words in the app’s language. In English the defaults are “next” and “back”, and you can change them to any words you like in “Voice Page Turning” settings. If your device can’t recognize the app’s language on the device, MangaDuo listens for the English words “next” and “back” instead. Recognition runs entirely on your iPhone, and no audio is stored or sent anywhere. Handy when your hands are busy.

■ Bring in the files you already have
ZIP, CBZ, RAR, CBR and folders of images. Pick them in the Files app or the share sheet and they appear in your Library. Japanese (Shift_JIS) file names are read correctly.

■ Volumes are gathered into series
Volume numbers are read from the file names and the same title is grouped as one series. When you finish a volume, the next one is a tap away. You resume where you left off.

■ Colors that follow your iPhone
Light and dark follow the iPhone’s appearance setting (“Match iPhone”). Pick from four light and five dark backgrounds and eight accent colors, and set how many columns the Library shows.

■ Also for iPhone and iPad
On a non-folding iPhone you read one page at a time, even in landscape. On iPad, landscape gives you a two-page spread.


ONE PURCHASE, NOTHING ELSE
Buy it once and it is yours. There is no subscription, no in-app purchase and no advertising.


PRIVACY
Nothing is collected. There is no account, no sign-in, no analytics and no advertising. The books you import are stored only on your device and are never uploaded. Voice recognition runs on the device as well; no audio leaves the phone. The developer never sees your files or hears your voice.


PLEASE NOTE
MangaDuo is a reader for files you already own. It does not sell or distribute comics. Password-protected RAR files and multi-part RAR archives are not supported.


REQUIREMENTS
iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad (iOS 26 / iPadOS 26 or later)
MangaDuo is available in 13 languages, including English, German and Japanese.
Voice Page Turning needs a device that supports on-device speech recognition.


SUPPORT
Requests and bug reports: info@arcion.jp
Developed by arcion Inc.

name: Manifest Match
description:
Manifest Match is a cozy chain puzzle with a gentle twist: every win reveals an affirmation, and every chapter closes with a short self-care ritual you can bring into your day.

CONNECT AND BLOOM
• Drag across 3 or more matching charms (suns, moons, hearts, clovers and stars) to clear them
• Long chains charge the Supernova and Resonance powers
• 120 levels across 12 chapters, with rocks, pearls, ice and buds introduced along the way
• No timers, no lives, no waiting for energy

SMALL STEPS, REAL LIFE
• Collect a positive affirmation with every new level you beat
• Activate each petal with a quick voice, reading, breathing or tiny-action moment
• Every 10 levels, a short ritual helps you turn an intention into a concrete next step

MAKE IT YOURS
• Add your photo and name to the garden portal
• Collect frames, magic trails, crests and painted worlds with Light you earn by playing
• Play in English, Portuguese or Spanish

AURORA PASS (OPTIONAL)
• Six-moment guided rituals with read-aloud support
• Rotating daily practices and a ritual library
• Three intention circles in the community

Aurora Pass is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your store account at confirmation and renews each month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings. Light packs are optional one-time purchases and only unlock cosmetic items.

Your progress stays on your device. The community is optional and moderated, and you can report or block anyone.

Manifest Match is a game. Affirmations and rituals are symbolic self-care practices; they do not promise financial, health or personal results.

name: Mappily
description:
Mappily keeps your trips in one place, on your phone.

SAVE PLACES
Save the cafes, beaches and spots you want to visit. Add a note, sort them into categories, and find any of them in seconds.

PLAN EVERY DAY
Build your trip day by day. Add stops, set a time and a reminder for any stop, reorder them, and check them off as you go.

SEE IT ON THE MAP
Every saved place appears on the map, so you can see what is close to where you are.

TRACK YOUR SPENDING
Add expenses right from each stop. See what you have spent against your budget, by category and by day, and know the cost per person.

SPLIT THE BILL, AMBAGAN STYLE
Divide a trip's cost between your group, see who has paid, and keep track of who still owes.

SHARE A TRIP
Send a whole trip to a friend with one link. They open it in Mappily and import their own copy.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your trips are stored on your phone, so you can open them, check off stops and add expenses without a connection. A trip only leaves your phone if you choose to share it with a link. Searching for new places needs internet.

FREE TO START, PRO IS ONE-TIME
Start for free. Mappily Pro is a single one-time purchase, not a subscription.

name: Marbling Master: Ebru Puzzle
seller_name: LISAN BILISIM VE YAYINCILIK TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Can you marble it?

Marbling Master turns ebru, the centuries-old Turkish art of painting on water, into a calm puzzle. Drop paint onto the tray, pull a stylus or comb through it, then lift the paper and watch your print appear. Every level shows a target pattern made from a secret recipe of moves. Can you work out the order, the places and the directions?

PLAY THE REAL THING
Every drop pushes the colours around it, every stroke pulls them along. The water behaves like a real marbling tray, so tulips, hearts, combed waves and tides form the way they do in a workshop.

40 LEVELS IN FOUR CHAPTERS
Drops, Stylus, Comb, Master. Each early level teaches one idea; later ones combine them. Earn up to three stars per level with a match score and a difference view that shows exactly where your print differs from the target.

FREE MARBLING
No target, no limits: eight pigments, three drop sizes, stylus and comb. Lift the paper whenever you like and share your print as a picture.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Stuck? Watch a short ad for a hint or to skip a level. Offline friendly, one-handed portrait play, no timers. English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean.

Ebru is on UNESCO's list of Intangible Cultural Heritage. Marbling Master is our love letter to it.

name: Math Before Beddy
description:
Math Before Beddy is parent-led math practice for kids, made for adult parents and caregivers to use at bedtime. You operate the app, read a short math story aloud, ask one math question at your child's level, and talk it through together. No worksheets, no lesson prep, and you don't need to be a "math person."

BACKED BY RESEARCH

In a randomized study of 587 first graders published in Science, children who regularly did short math stories with a parent finished the school year nearly 3 months ahead in math. Children whose parents felt anxious about math gained the most.¹ Math Before Beddy is built on the same idea: a short story, one question, and you beside them.

HOW IT WORKS

• Read tonight's story. A new true story arrives every day and takes about a minute to read aloud.
• Ask one question. Each story comes with a question for every level from Pre-K through Grade 5, so brothers and sisters can share the story and each answer their own question.
• Get help when you need it. Open a hint, then the answer and a short explanation of why it works. Parent tips suggest what to say and how to keep things calm.
• Finish on a good note. Mark the evening done, say goodnight, and watch the week fill with stars.

WHAT YOUR CHILD PRACTICES

Questions follow a grade-by-grade skill plan: counting and patterns, place value, addition and subtraction, multiplication and division, fractions and decimals, time and money, measurement, shapes and angles, and reading data. Pick the level that fits your child and change it whenever school work moves on. Math Before Beddy is extra practice alongside school, not a replacement for it.

MADE FOR REAL FAMILIES

• Seven levels, Pre-K through Grade 5
• A profile for each child, with their own age and math level
• A library of past stories to revisit family favorites
• Optional bedtime reminders on the days you choose
• Dark and light themes

BEDDY PLUS

App access requires a Beddy Plus subscription or active trial. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers who have never had a subscription to this app. After the trial, the yearly subscription renews automatically unless canceled. A monthly plan is also available. Prices, billing frequency, and eligible offers are shown before purchase and may vary by store or region. Cancel through your app store before the trial ends to avoid the first charge.

PARENT-LED AND PRIVATE

Math Before Beddy is for adults to lead shared math practice. Children do not need to operate the app independently. There are no child accounts, ads, social features, location tracking, camera access, contact access, microphone access, or child voice recordings.

Questions or feedback: support@mathbeforebeddy.com

¹ Berkowitz et al. (2015), "Math at home adds up to achievement in school," Science 350(6257):196–198. Math Before Beddy is not affiliated with the study's authors.

Privacy Policy: https://mathbeforebeddy.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://mathbeforebeddy.com/terms.html

name: MathBooks: Math Notebook
description:
MathBooks is a maths notebook that works things out as you type. Write expressions, equations and formulas in plain text and see exact answers instantly, typeset beautifully.

EXACT ANSWERS, NOT JUST DECIMALS
Get fractions, square roots and π exactly: 1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2, sqrt(8) = 2√2. Switch to decimals with one tap.

SOLVE WITH STEPS
Type an equation and it is solved, with every step shown: linear, quadratic, cubic, trigonometric and rational equations, inequalities, and systems of up to six equations. Rearrange formulas, factor and expand polynomials, and see derivatives and integrals worked out step by step.

SLIDERS AND LIVE GRAPHS
Make any variable a slider and watch every graph and answer update as you drag. Press play to animate it. Plot several curves, polar and parametric curves, shaded regions and 3D surfaces. Pan, pinch to zoom and tap to read values; roots, intersections and turning points are found for you.

EXPLAIN WITH APPLE INTELLIGENCE
Tap Explain next to a solution and get the working explained in plain words, written on your device. Private and offline. (Requires a device with Apple Intelligence.)

SCAN OR WRITE MATHS
Photograph printed or neat handwritten maths, or write it with your finger or Apple Pencil. It is read on your iPhone and you can check it before it is added.

DATA AND STATISTICS
Add tables of data and get summaries, regression lines with R², scatter plots and histograms.

UNITS, CONSTANTS AND FORMULAS
Calculate with units and convert between them (60 km/h to m/s). Insert physical constants and ready-made formulas for geometry, physics, finance and structural engineering, plus templates for beams, columns, projectiles, loans and more.

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Nine themes, from Light and Dark to Midnight, Ocean and Paper
• iCloud sync across your devices
• iPad sidebar for your notebooks
• Share any cell as an image or export a whole notebook as a PDF
• Works offline, with no account, no ads and no tracking

Great for students, teachers, engineers and anyone who wants a smarter calculator that shows its working.

name: MDB Viewer - ACCDB Opener
description:
Open Microsoft Access MDB and ACCDB databases on your iPhone and iPad. Browse records, search your data and export it into formats you can use elsewhere.

Browse databases from Files, keep tables open as you explore, freeze up to three columns and inspect records in a focused detail view. Copy values and save exports using the system file interface.

BROWSE AND UNDERSTAND YOUR DATA
Explore tables, column types and relationships. Inspect individual records and long text fields. Search across tables, combine filters, apply multi-column sorting and save views for later.

QUERY AND EXPORT
Use the read-only SQL worksheet to query a local SQLite snapshot, including joins across tables. Export table data as CSV or TSV, or export a database to an Excel workbook, SQLite database, SQL dump or ZIP archive of delimited tables. Preview supported embedded images and extract supported attachments from the row inspector.

LOCAL PROCESSING
Database parsing, searching and conversion run on your device. The app works with a private copy and leaves your original database unchanged. It keeps local indexes to reuse when browsing, and does not require an account or a Microsoft Access installation.

COMPATIBILITY
Designed for readable tables in MDB and ACCDB files. MDE and ACCDE support is limited to readable table data. Forms, reports, macros, VBA, linked tables and Access saved queries are not supported. Modern encrypted or password-protected ACCDB files are not supported. Compatibility varies by database features and file condition. Initial indexing of large databases can take time and disk space.

Microsoft Access is a trademark of Microsoft. This app is independent and is not affiliated with Microsoft.

For support or feedback, contact us at support@maxcode.com.

name: MDPreview
description:
Markdownを開いて、読むことに集中。

MDPreviewは、iPhone・iPadでMarkdownファイルを閲覧するためのアプリです。ファイルアプリから文書を開き、見出し、リスト、表、コードブロックなどを読みやすく表示します。原本は読み取り専用で開きます。

■ 文書をすっきり表示
見出し、箇条書き、チェックリスト、引用、表、リンクに対応。コードブロックはボタンを押してコードだけをコピーできます。

■ 自分に合う読み心地
システム連動・ライト・ダークを切り替えられます。フォント、文字サイズ、行の高さ、本文の幅、余白、コードの折り返しを調整できます。背景・文字・リンク・コード背景の色も変更できます。

■ 最近の文書をすぐに再表示
最近開いたファイルを端末内に最大50件保存。履歴は個別でもまとめてでも消去でき、元のファイルは削除されません。

■ 複数の文書を並べて確認
iPadや対応するiPhone Duoでは、文書を別ウィンドウで開けます。本文はウィンドウごとに独立し、履歴と表示設定を共有します。新しいウィンドウの作成は、OSが許可する端末・画面で利用できます。

■ ファイルと画像について
対応形式は .md、.markdown、.mdown、.mkd。最大20 MB、UTF-8およびBOM付きUTF-16／UTF-32に対応しています。
外部画像は初期状態で読み込みません。設定を有効にすると、文書内のHTTPS画像を配信元から取得します。ローカル画像・相対パス画像は現在未対応です。
文書内のWebリンクは標準ブラウザーなどで開きます。閲覧履歴と表示設定は端末内に保存され、アプリ独自のクラウド同期は行いません。

iOS／iPadOS 17以降に対応。

name: Mecabrain – Diagnostic auto
description:
NO ADAPTER? TYPE YOUR CODE
Your garage gave you a fault code (P0300, P0420…)? Type it into MecaBrain and get it explained before you pay. With an ELM327 OBD2 adapter you can also read and clear codes yourself.

Mecabrain turns your iPhone into a real car diagnostic tool: it reads fault codes, explains them in plain language and guides you all the way to the repair.

FREE, NO LIMIT
• Read fault codes (OBD2) from every control unit
• Clear faults and turn off the warning light
• Radio PIN code
• MecaBrain workshop news

A MULTICULTURAL TEAM: AN ALGORITHM ADAPTED TO EACH COUNTRY
Faults are not the same from one country to another: vehicles, fuels, climates and driving habits all differ. Our multicultural team knows the faults typical of each country, and the MecaBrain algorithm is adapted to the country.

BUILT BY PEOPLE FROM THE TRADE
MecaBrain is developed by a team of engineers and technicians from major car manufacturers and from the field (garages, workshops).

AN IN-HOUSE ALGORITHM, ASSISTED BY ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
At the heart of MecaBrain is our own diagnostic algorithm: on its own it solves about 70% of faults. Assisted by artificial intelligence, it reaches about 90%.

MECABRAIN ANALYSES
• Every fault explained: probable causes, checks to carry out, whether it is safe to keep driving
• Cross-analysis of several faults
• Live engine data and graphs
• Sound diagnostic: record your engine at idle
• Visual diagnostic: photograph a spark plug or a part
• Magnetic analysis of ignition coils
• Power measurement and guided road test
• Mileage check to help spot odometer tampering
Your first analysis is free on most of these features.

MECABRAIN PRO
Unlock every analysis with the MecaBrain Pro subscription (monthly, yearly with a 7-day free trial, or lifetime), or buy credits one at a time. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel it in your Apple account settings.

COMPATIBLE ADAPTERS – PLEASE READ
Mecabrain reads your car through an ELM327 OBD-II adapter. On iPhone, only Wi-Fi or Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) adapters work: classic Bluetooth adapters are not supported by iOS. Check your adapter before buying.

NO ADAPTER? YOU CAN STILL USE IT
Type or paste the fault codes shown by any scanner or garage report (P0300, P0171…).

YOUR ACCOUNT FOLLOWS YOU
Sign in once: your purchases follow your account, so you can change phone without losing anything.

Mecabrain is a diagnostic aid and does not replace a qualified mechanic for safety-critical repairs.

name: Mechanica AI
description:
We're revolutionizing the service industry.

Mechanica AI is one app for getting service work done. Customers snap a photo of the job, answer a few questions and get an instant estimate. Independent service providers find work, bid on jobs and run their business from the same place.

FOR CUSTOMERS
- Marketplace: browse services across construction trades, home services, auto and more
- Photo-based instant quote: add photos, describe the job and get an estimate
- Mechanica reviews every request and confirms the final price before any work starts. No payment is taken in the app.
- Neighbors: a neighborhood board to ask questions, share news and find recommendations

- Provider portal with open jobs: see the scope, photos and town for each job and place your bid
- CRM for business clients: leads from your website and the Marketplace in one inbox
- Calendar, content and opportunities tools

- Browse capital requests posted by Mechanica service providers and bid with your amount, rate and term
- Accepting a bid only starts an introduction through Mechanica. No money moves in the app.

Mechanica connects customers and service providers. Contracts for the work are between the customer and the provider.

name: Mechanova Lab
description: Mechanova Lab is a personal mechanical automata workshop for makers who enjoy turning creative ideas into moving objects. Explore and document gear trains, cams, crank sliders, linkages, and other movement mechanisms with their measurements and design notes. Plan miniature machines and kinetic sculptures by tracking assembly progress, parts, materials, budgets, and working hours. Keep a searchable component library with dimensions, suppliers, stock quantities, and organized storage locations. Record each movement experiment with cycle counts, RPM, smoothness, stability, noise, and friction observations. Build editable step-by-step motion sequences and play an animated gear-and-crank preview to explore the order and timing of movements. Your workshop records, reference photographs, designs, and test results are saved privately on your device and remain available without an internet connection.

name: Meditaring
description:
Meditaring is an eyes-free meditation companion. Sound and gentle taps carry each breath, so your eyes can stay closed and the screen can stay dark. When you notice your mind has wandered, tap anywhere to mark a return. Noticing is the practice: a return is a success, never a mistake.

Every sit grows a ring on your tree. Wide rings for long sits, thin ones for short. After four weeks, rings settle into the heartwood. Missed days leave only a thin dormant line: the tree never withers.

SIX PRACTICES
• Natural breath
• Cyclic sigh: a nasal inhale, a short top-up, then a long exhale
• Box breathing, at counts you choose
• Body scan, guided part by part by a soft voice
• Loving-kindness
• Open awareness

EYES-FREE
• Tones and haptics pace the breath, or haptics alone
• Sit for a set time, or open-ended until you choose to end
• Tap anywhere to mark a return, or press your AirPods or the Lock Screen control
• Lay the phone face down to sit in silence
• Two-finger tap to pause
• A bell each minute, background noise, tones or singing bowls, all synthesized on your iPhone

GENTLE BY DESIGN
• A four-week starting plan that moves on with the days you sit
• One line on why you sit, in your own words, that comes back now and then
• Carve a word in a ring
• A daily reminder that never scolds

AROUND YOUR IPHONE
• With headphones, sounds placed around you, held still as you turn your head with AirPods
• Widgets, a Live Activity, Control Center and Siri
• Works with Apple Health: save sits as Mindful Minutes and ratings as State of Mind, if you choose
• Sits kept in your own private iCloud

No account, no ads, no tracking, no purchases. Meditaring is not a medical device and makes no medical claims.

Most of Meditaring was written with AI (Claude, by Anthropic). The app contains no AI features.

name: MeiQian Notes
description:
MeiQian Notes is a quiet writing app. You write a few lines, and it turns them into a long image worth sharing.

WRITE, THEN SHARE
Tap Generate and you get a vertical card: generous margins, serif body text, your signature and the date at the lower left, a small brand mark at the lower right. No gaudy frames, no QR codes. Just clean text.

SEVENTEEN SKINS
Rice paper, kraft, midnight, magazine cream, gradients, solid tones. Each skin has its own text colours and paper texture. Swipe the strip or flip the fanned card deck on the share screen and the image redraws instantly.

ADD PHOTOS
Pick a few pictures from your library and drop them into a note — up to nine. The layout takes care of itself: one full-width, two side by side, three in a row, four in a square, more in a three-column grid. Corners, spacing and cropping are all handled.

TYPOGRAPHY YOU CONTROL
Three typefaces and three line-height steps. Chinese punctuation automatically avoids the start and end of lines, so line breaks read naturally.

SIGNATURE, DATE, WATERMARK
Keep the signature, keep the date, or keep neither. A card with nothing but text is sometimes the most striking.

NO SAVE BUTTON, NO SIGN-IN
There is no save button while you write, and nothing to sign up for. Notes and photos live only in the app on your phone — they are never uploaded or shared.

WORKS IN AIRPLANE MODE
Write, add pictures, lay out, generate and save with no connection at all. Every asset ships inside the app.

SMALL THINGS
· A different nature photograph every weekday on the home screen, with today's date
· Each note in the list previews in its own skin colours, with a photo count when it has pictures
· Search and bulk delete

No servers, no data collection, no ads, no cross-app tracking. Photos are chosen with the system picker — the app never reads your library — and the ones you pick are compressed and stored inside the note. Saving to your photo library writes only the one image you confirm.

Support: nyfxyw@163.com
Privacy: https://newyifu.com/privacy/meiqian-notes.html

name: MemoryProof
description: MemoryProof helps you turn spoken commitments into clear, confirmable proof strips so nothing important slips through the cracks. After a meeting or conversation, open Capture Dock and record who promised what, the context, and an optional due date. The Open Docket keeps urgent items visible. When it is time, affirm or contest what was said, then close each strip as kept, partial, or broken. The Circle view shows a Reliability Index per person so patterns stay honest without awkward guesswork. Vault holds your closed history with search and filters. Export a plain-text summary when you need to share what was agreed. Widgets surface the next confirm due on your Home Screen. Quick actions and local reminders nudge you before dates slip. Designed for freelancers, account leads, and anyone who lives on verbal agreements. MemoryProof is built for clarity and follow-through on your device.

name: MERA SHOP: Buy a Robot
description:
MERA SHOP is the MERA Robotics shop for Unitree robots: humanoids, robot dogs, hands, accessories and training. We check every robot before shipping.

THE ROBOT IN YOUR SPACE, AT 1:1 SCALE
Place the robot on your own floor through your phone camera. The model has real dimensions, so you see right away how much room it takes and how it looks next to your furniture. In augmented reality you can view G1, R1, H2, H1, Go2, A2 and B2, among others.

• Unitree robot dogs: Go2, AS2, A2 and B2, wheeled versions included

• used G1 Edu robots with a condition description
• a training day with a trainer
Every version shows its specifications, what is in the box and availability: in stock or made to order.

MERA OS
MERA OS is the system Edward Warchocki uses to talk to people in more than 70 languages. The Talk, Vision, Motion, Host and Live modules give a robot live voice conversation, object recognition on camera, gestures in time with speech, the role of an MC and live streams. ORDERING

IN THE APP
• the shop in 24 languages, in the language of your phone
• Home Screen shortcuts: Robots, MERA OS, Cart
• shop links from emails open the app
• share a robot offer with one tap

Questions: contact@merarobotics.com. We usually reply within one business day.

name: METAR Pro
description:
METAR Pro turns raw aviation weather into a clear, glanceable instrument panel. See the wind against the runway, scrub through the TAF and check density altitude for 7,881 airports worldwide — before you head to the airfield.

WIND & RUNWAY
• True-north wind compass drawn with the airport's real runway geometry
• Suggested runway with headwind, tailwind and crosswind for every runway end
• Optional crosswind limit that color-codes the components
• Pin your preferred runway per airport

TAF TIMELINE
• The full validity period with prevailing conditions and TEMPO / PROB overlays
• Drag across the timeline and the whole screen switches to the forecast at that time
• Change-group chips for FM, BECMG, TEMPO and PROB

SKY, HISTORY & PERFORMANCE
• Cloud profile with layers, ceiling, vertical visibility and precipitation
• 24-hour history chart for wind, visibility, temperature, pressure and ceiling
• Density altitude and pressure altitude from field elevation, QNH and OAT
• QNH or QFE, your choice

AIRPORT INFORMATION
• Radio frequencies, coordinates, elevation, time zone and sunrise / sunset in UTC
• German aerodrome frequencies from the official DFS AIP dataset
• Raw METAR and TAF with one-tap copy and share

WIDGETS & EVERY SCREEN
• Home Screen widgets in small, medium and large — follow your home airport or pin any airport
• Designed for iPhone, iPad split view and the Mac
• Light and dark themes with VFR / MVFR / IFR / LIFR flight-category colors
• Units your way: kt, km/h, m/s, mph · ft, m · °C, °F · hPa, inHg · km, SM

FAST, OFFLINE-FIRST AND PRIVATE
• Search airports offline by ICAO, IATA, city or name
• Weather cached on your device with automatic refresh
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking

IMPORTANT
METAR Pro is a situational-awareness tool. It is not an approved source of operational flight information, does not provide NOTAMs and does not replace an official weather briefing. Wind directions and runway headings are shown in degrees true. The suggested runway is calculated from wind and runway geometry — it is not the runway in use reported by ATC or ATIS.

Weather data: NOAA Aviation Weather Center. Airport and runway data: OurAirports. German frequencies: DFS Deutsche Flugsicherung GmbH (CC BY 4.0).

name: MeteoAstra
description:
MeteoAstra, c'est la météo en direct, simple et fun, pour toute la famille.

• Radar : la pluie et les nuages satellite en direct, le passé et la prévision, les éclairs en temps réel et une alerte foudre.

• Orages et tornades : le risque près de chez toi, les bons réflexes, le compte éclair-tonnerre et des vidéos d'orages du monde entier.
• Ciel : le ciel étoilé en 3D vu de chez toi (constellations, planètes, Lune), et même le ciel vu depuis la Lune.
• Espace : la Terre, la Lune et le système solaire en 3D, Mars et ses robots, les satellites et les fusées.
• Kaijus : des combats de monstres météo dont la force dépend de la vraie météo, seul ou en ligne.

Gratuite, sans publicité. Créée par un papa avec ses enfants.

name: MEXAL
description:
MEXAL es un experimento colectivo. Empieza sin producto y sin destino: lo que llegue a ser lo decidimos entre todos.

PROPÓN
Escribe en el foro qué debería ser MEXAL. Adjunta imágenes, comenta y apoya las ideas que te gusten.

MEXAL ELIGE
Las ideas con más fuerza se eligen para construirlas.

CONSTRUYE
Mira en qué estamos trabajando, qué necesitamos y ofrece tu ayuda: programar, diseñar, saber de algo, difundir…

LA HISTORIA
Cada paso queda documentado, capítulo a capítulo, desde el Capítulo 0.

Cada persona recibe un número de participante según el orden real en que llega. Sin anuncios, sin likes personales, sin popularidad: solo ideas y gente construyendo algo que no existiría sin esta comunidad.

Un espacio cuidado: puedes denunciar contenido inapropiado y bloquear a quien te moleste. No se tolera el contenido ofensivo.

name: MGRS Field Map: GeoTIFF
description:
MGRS Field Map turns your iPhone or iPad into a field map with the military grid built in. Import your own GeoTIFF map for free and use it with no signal.

COORDINATES
• Live crosshair coordinates in MGRS, UTM and Lat/Lon (DD, DMS, DDM) at the same time
• MGRS / UTM grid overlay with labels at every zoom level
• Search and go to any coordinate in any format

YOUR OWN MAPS (GEOTIFF)
• Import GeoTIFF maps: scanned topographic sheets, drone orthophotos, DEMs
• Placed automatically from the file's coordinates (WGS84, UTM, Web Mercator)
• Stored on your device and usable with no signal
• Free keeps one map (up to 100 MB); PRO keeps any number

MARK, DRAW, MEASURE
• Pins with MIL-STD-2525 style unit symbols (38 unit types, 12 echelons), civilian icons and IPB icons
• Tactical lines and areas for training and planning: phase lines, boundaries, axes of advance, objectives and more
• Distance and bearing on every segment, in degrees, 6400 mils or 6000 mils
• Snap to pins and vertices for exact points
• Range rings, circles, bearing lines and sectors

ELEVATION & 3D
• Spot elevation for any point, elevation report export (CSV)
• 3D terrain view: tilt and rotate the map

PROJECTS & DATA
• Save work as projects on the device
• Import / export KML, KMZ, GPX, GeoJSON · full backup and restore
• GPS position, track recording and compass
• 12 languages

WHAT WORKS OFFLINE
Coordinates, grid, imported GeoTIFF maps, your saved data, measuring, GPS and compass work with no signal. Street and satellite maps and online elevation need an internet connection.

FREE AND PRO
Free: street map (OpenFreeMap), MGRS + Lat/Lon DD, up to 5 pins/lines/areas, 1 saved GeoTIFF map (up to 100 MB), colour pins and civilian icons, measuring, GPS, compass and 3D terrain.

PRO unlocks: Esri satellite imagery with labels and Esri Outdoor map, UTM / DMS / DDM, unlimited items and saved GeoTIFF maps, military symbols, IPB and tactical graphics, range rings / sectors / bearing lines, projects, backup / restore, KML export and elevation report export.

SUBSCRIPTION
• MGRS Field Map PRO — Monthly (1 month) or Yearly (1 year), auto-renewing.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

PRIVACY
All your data stays on your device. No account, no tracking, no cloud.

This app is a navigation and planning aid. Always verify positions with official maps and equipment.
