name: Mina Akıllı Kumanda
description:
Mina, iPhone'unu akıllı TV'nin kumandasına dönüştürür. Evdeki Wi-Fi üzerinden çalışır; ek cihaz, kurulum ya da hesap gerekmez.

TV'Nİ KENDİSİ BULUR
Uygulamayı açtığında aynı Wi-Fi'daki televizyonlar saniyeler içinde listelenir. İlk bağlantıda TV ekranındaki onayı ver ya da çıkan kodu gir; bir daha sorulmaz.

DESTEKLENEN TELEVİZYONLAR
• Samsung (2010 ve sonrası)
• LG (webOS ve 2012–2013 NetCast)
• Google TV / Android TV'li modeller: Sony, TCL, Xiaomi, Philips, Arçelik, Beko, Grundig ve diğerleri
• Philips Saphi ve Titan OS
• Vestel Sanal Kumanda'lı modeller: Vestel, Regal, Toshiba, Hitachi, JVC
• Panasonic Viera
• Roku TV

ÖZELLİKLER
• Dokunmatik yüzey: kaydırarak menülerde gez, dokunarak seç
• Ses, kanal, güç, geri, ana ekran ve menü tuşları
• Kapalı TV'yi telefondan açma (ağ bekleme modunu destekleyen TV'lerde)
• Koyu tema ve titreşimli geri bildirim
• Reklam yok, hesap yok, takip yok

MINA PRO
Temel kumanda her zaman ücretsiz: 1 TV'yi yön, ses, kanal ve güç tuşlarıyla kullanırsın. Mina Pro ile:
• Sınırsız TV
• Klavyeyle yazma
• Rakam ve medya tuşları

Mina Pro, yıllık üyelik ya da tek seferlik ömür boyu satın alma olarak sunulur. Ödeme, satın almayı onayladığında Apple hesabından alınır. Yıllık üyelik, dönem bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmedikçe otomatik olarak yenilenir; App Store hesap ayarlarından yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsin.

Not: Telefon ile TV aynı Wi-Fi ağında olmalı. Yalnızca kızılötesiyle çalışan, ağa bağlanmayan televizyonlar desteklenmez. Mina bağımsız bir uygulamadır; TV üreticileriyle bağlantılı değildir.

Gizlilik Politikası: https://minasmart.app/tr/privacy/
Kullanım Koşulları: https://minasmart.app/tr/terms/

name: MiniMat
description:
Short yoga and meditation, made for you.

MiniMat builds a guided session around how you feel right now. Tell it your mood, what your body feels like and what you want from the practice. Choose 10, 15 or 20 minutes. It plans the rest.

Put your phone at the top of your mat, press start, and follow the voice. There is nothing to watch and nothing to tap. Every direction is given relative to your phone, so you always know which way to face.

HOW IT WORKS

Settle in: one minute of breathing to arrive.
Move: gentle yoga poses, each held for about a minute, chosen for your mood, body and goal.
Sit: a short seated meditation: a body scan, counting the breath, gratitude and kindness, or open awareness.
Savasana: final rest, ending with a soft bell. You lie down with your feet toward the phone, so there is no turning around.

WHAT YOU GET

A different session every time. Poses are chosen from a library of 32, so it stays fresh.
Calm, natural voices. Choose a female or male voice. Energizing sessions use a brighter voice.
A simple animation inside the timer circle shows how to do each pose.
Original background music that moves with each phase, from settling to flowing to stillness.
A color-coded timer ring that shows where you are and what comes next.
Four color themes and a night mode.
Your screen stays awake during a session.
No account, no sign-in, no ads. MiniMat collects no data.

MADE FOR REAL LIFE Ten minutes is enough. Tight neck and shoulders after a long day at a desk, a wired mind before bed, or a low-energy morning: MiniMat picks poses and breathing that suit how you actually feel.

MiniMat is for general wellness and relaxation. It is not medical advice. If you have an injury or a health condition, or you are pregnant, check with your doctor before you practice, and stop if anything hurts.

Questions or feedback: unlimited.tedworks@gmail.com A production of Universal Tedworks.

name: Missoula Trains
description:
Is a train blocking Greenough Drive? Missoula Trains tells you before you get to the tracks.

A sensor at the Greenough Drive rail crossing in Missoula's Rattlesnake neighborhood watches the crossing's warning lights, so you can see at a glance whether the road is clear or blocked, and for how long.

LIVE STATUS
• See whether Greenough Drive is clear or blocked, updated every few seconds
• A running timer shows how long the current train has been blocking the crossing
• Today's trains, total minutes blocked, and the longest wait

FREE TRAIN ALERTS
• Get a notification the moment the gate goes down, with a train-whistle sound
• Optional "all clear" alert when the crossing opens again
• Only alert me if a train has been there 3, 5, 10 or 15+ minutes
• Set commute windows, like weekday mornings and evenings, so alerts only come when you're on the road

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
No sign-up, no email, no phone number. Turning alerts off deletes your settings from our server.

A neighborhood project from Gecko Designs in Missoula. Alerts are free; if they save you a wait, you can chip in for server costs.

Status comes from the crossing's warning lights and may occasionally be delayed or wrong. Never rely on Missoula Trains in an emergency.

name: MJU.display Player
description:
MJU.display Player ist der Player für das Digital-Signage-System MJU.display. Die App macht aus einem iPad oder iPhone ein Display, das zentral im Backoffice von MJU.display verwaltet wird.

So funktioniert es:
• App starten – sie zeigt einen sechsstelligen Kopplungscode und einen QR-Code.
• Im Backoffice unter „Displays › Display koppeln“ den Code eingeben oder den QR-Code scannen.
• Das Display übernimmt sofort das zugewiesene Programm (Seiten, Playlists, Zeitpläne).

Was die App für den Dauerbetrieb mitbringt:
• Vollbild ohne Statusleiste, Bildschirm bleibt an.
• Videos und Audio starten automatisch.
• Bei Verbindungsproblemen eine ruhige Hinweisseite mit automatischem Neuversuch; sobald das Netz zurück ist, läuft das Programm weiter. Zugewiesene Inhalte werden lokal zwischengespeichert.
• Hoch- und Querformat.
• Kopplung bleibt auch nach Neustart der App erhalten.

Die App benötigt ein Konto bei MJU.display (Backoffice). Sie enthält weder Werbung noch In-App-Käufe und kein Tracking.

name: MKlass
description:
MKlass is the official app for Master Klass Academy students and parents.

Students
• Take assigned SAT and academy practice tests in a focused, full-screen test mode
• Review results and correction notes
• Get notified about class notices and new assignments

Parents
• Secure sign-in with Face ID
• View your child's attendance, test scores, and invoices
• Receive notifications for announcements, test results, check-ins, and payment reminders

An active Master Klass Academy account is required.

name: ModelPeek
description:
ModelPeek 是一款离线 3D / CAD 模型查看器，专为 iPhone 和 iPad 设计。

打开文件后，ModelPeek 会在设备本地把模型转换成适合移动端渲染的格式，然后提供流畅的查看体验。模型不会上传到任何服务器，也不需要登录。

支持的格式
• STEP（.stp / .step / .p21）
• IGES（.igs / .iges）
• BREP（.brep）
• STL（.stl）
• OBJ（.obj）
• glTF 2.0（.glb / .gltf）
• VRML（.wrl / .vrml）
• NWD / NWC / NWF（Navisworks 文件格式）

主要功能
• 旋转、平移、缩放，一键适配全部
• 选择树与对象选择，长按节点可隐藏、隔离、凸显
• 移出观察与分层爆炸图，方便查看装配内部
• 对象审查批注，可导出给建模方
• 深色 / 浅色主题，中英文界面
• 支持从「文件」App、AirDrop、邮件中直接打开

name: MOMENT - 하루를 한장의 기록으로
description:
매일 마주하는 평범한 길목도 계절과 시간에 따라 전혀 다른 빛을 띱니다.
MOMENT는 하루 단 한 장, 눈앞의 풍경을 아날로그 폴라로이드 인화지에 담아내는 가장 고요한 기록장입니다.

[주요 기능]

• 하루 한 장, 4:3 즉석 폴라로이드 카메라
복잡한 보정이나 여러 번의 촬영 대신 하루 한 번의 셔터에 집중합니다. 촬영 직후 서서히 현상되는 인화지 위에 20자 이내의 짧은 한 줄 메모를 만년필 감성으로 남길 수 있습니다.

• 고스트 카메라 & 전자 수평계
어제 찍은 풍경을 반투명하게 겹쳐 보여주는 '고스트 가이드'와 정밀한 전자 수평계를 통해, 매일 같은 장소에서 계절이 변해가는 과정을 흔들림 없이 기록할 수 있습니다.

• 오늘의 색 3가지 & 월간 컬러 팔레트 스트립
촬영된 풍경에서 그날을 대표하는 3가지 색상을 자동으로 추출합니다. 한 달 동안 차곡차곡 쌓인 색상들은 캘린더 상단의 '이달의 컬러 팔레트 스트립'과 계절 그라데이션 바로 완성됩니다.

• 아날로그 필름 데이터백 스탬프
사진이 찍힌 동네 이름, 날씨와 시야, 바라본 하늘의 나침반 방위(예: 서쪽 하늘), 해발고도, 그리고 실제 렌즈 노출값(초점거리·조리개·셔터속도·ISO)이 인화지 하단에 정교하게 각인됩니다.

• 감성 도감 & 발자취 지도
'해 질 녘', '쾌청한 날', '노을 웜톤', '하늘 쿨톤' 등 날씨와 색감별로 지난 폴라로이드를 모아보거나, 지도 위에 꽂힌 컬러 핀을 따라 내가 풍경을 남긴 발자취를 돌아볼 수 있습니다.

• 한 달 만근 보상 & 100% 온디바이스 프라이버시
한 달의 기록을 꾸준히 채우면 폴라로이드 인화지 카드와 원본 사진을 사진첩에 소장할 수 있는 잠금이 해제됩니다. 모든 사진과 기록은 외부 서버로 전송되지 않고 오직 사용자의 기기 내부에만 안전하게 보관되며, 기기 변경 시 백업 파일 하나로 간편하게 복원할 수 있습니다.

name: Momenta: Video, Chat & Live
description:
Momenta — make every moment shine.

Short videos, chat, live streams, games and AR effects — all in one fast app.

VIDEOS & REELS
• Following and For You feeds, trends
• Duet, remix and repost
• Tap "Not interested" and the feed adapts to you
• Video series and scheduled posts

CHAT & CALLS
• Text, voice and round video messages
• Files, reactions and disappearing messages
• Voice and video calls
• Saved Messages — a private chat only you can see

LIVE
• Go live with followers in real time, with live chat
• Filters and beauty mode

CREATE
• Reels, posts, 24-hour stories and AI portraits — in one tap
• AR effects, filters and stickers
• Creator insights and statistics
• Comment controls: pin, hidden words, slow mode

GAMES
• Tank Battle — play with a friend
• Quick games and Spot the Difference

SAFETY
• Report and block
• Community guidelines and moderation
• Delete your account right in the app

8 languages: Uzbek (Latin & Cyrillic), Russian, English, Kazakh, Tajik, Turkmen, Turkish.

Privacy Policy: https://momenta.uz/privacy
Terms of Use: https://momenta.uz/terms

name: MoMoMong
description:
Forest, river, sea, city... Trash is pouring in from all kinds of places.

Tap the trash to clean it up and protect Momomong, the eco-monster.

Use the right cleaning tool for each kind of trash, along with cookie items, to help Momomong explore safely!

Answer Momomong's questions about the environment and learn how to protect it, too.

After you've seen the ending, you can take on Endless Exploration and set a record for how long you can protect Momomong.

------------

In a quiet forest, you find a little blue-green egg.

You clean up heaps of trash to protect the egg, and soon it hatches.

Out of the egg comes Momomong, an eco-monster!

With your help, Momomong wants to travel the world and learn many new things.

From now on, you are Momomong's guardian.

Explore the world with Momomong and overcome the many polluted places along the way.

And help our Momomong grow into a true eco-monster!

name: Monster Truck Hills
description:
Vroom! Monster Truck Hills is a simple, happy driving game made for young children.

Hold anywhere on the screen to drive, and let go to slow down. That's it! Bounce over bumpy dirt hills, fly off big jumps, splash through mud pits and squash old junk cars on the way to the finish flag.

It all starts at the stadium: the lights are on, the crowd is cheering, and your name is up on the big screen. Grab your ticket to drive, or visit the merch stand to pick a new truck.

• One-finger controls little kids can master right away
• A brand-new track every drive: big hills, fast downhills, jumps and valleys
• No losing, no timers, no game over. Every drive ends at the finish flag
• Grab coins to unlock 10 monster trucks: a dino, a shark, a fire truck, a dragon, an ice cream truck and more
• 12 paint jobs: flames, polka dots, rainbow, tiger stripes, checkered flag, gold...
• 7 tracks: Dirt Hills, Mud Bog, Junkyard, Desert Dunes, Snowy Peaks, Candy Mountain and low-gravity Moon Bounce
• A friendly voice cheers kids on, so they don't need to read
• Works on iPhone and iPad

For grown-ups
• Ads are a small banner on the home and store screens only, never while driving, and every ad request is child-directed (no personalized ads)
• Coin packs and a one-time Remove Ads purchase are behind a grown-up question
• No accounts, no chat, no personal information collected

The voice in this app is AI-generated.
Made by The Weekend Companies.

name: Moodrank: Winter Mood & Light
description:
Moodrank turns how you feel into one small thing you can actually do.

Two taps, your mood and your energy, and Moodrank suggests a few short actions that fit right now: the time of day, how much light is left, the season and the weather where you are. Each one tells you why it was picked, and most take only a few minutes.

MADE FOR THE DARK MONTHS
Short days are hard. Moodrank knows when the light is going, so it won't send you for a walk after dark, and it nudges you outside while there's still daylight.

IT LEARNS WHAT WORKS FOR YOU
After you try something, Moodrank asks if you did it. Over time, the things that help you rise to the top.

WHEN IT'S ALL TOO MUCH
Tap "This is a lot" and Moodrank skips suggestions and shows a helpline for where you are.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your check-ins stay on your iPhone. Optional Apple Health adds sleep and steps and can save each mood to State of Mind. Lock the app with Face ID.

MOODRANK PLUS
- Light planner: today's daylight window, a reminder an hour before dark, and your time in daylight from Apple Watch
- Insights: what you finish most, by mood, energy, time of day and sleep
Plus is available monthly, yearly with a one-week free trial, or as a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple Account settings.

Also: a Home Screen widget with the daylight left today, and a daily reminder at the time you choose.

Moodrank is a wellbeing tool. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you might hurt yourself, contact local emergency services.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://moodrank.mndapps.co.uk/privacy.html

name: Mookee Scanner
description:
Mookee Scanner is the door app for organisations that sell tickets and products with Mookee.

You need an invitation from your organisation: sign in with the Mookee account your organiser invited, pick the organisation, and you are ready to scan.

• One camera for every event — scan any ticket and see instantly whether it is valid, already used or for another event
• Scan for a single event or product when you staff one door or one desk
• Check guests in and out, search tickets by name or code
• Order coupons: mark orders as shipped or delivered at the pickup desk
• Scan history on the device, sound and vibration feedback, torch for dark venues
• Sign in with e-mail and password, Google, Facebook or Apple, with two-step verification

Mookee Scanner does not sell tickets and you cannot create an account in the app. Organisations set up their shop on mookee.io.

name: Morse Armada
description:
Battles are won at the end of the wire.

Morse Armada is a hand-drawn steampunk naval battle where you fire by tapping coordinates in Morse code on a brass telegraph key. Short press: dot. Long press: dash. One wrong letter and your cannonball drifts off target!

LEARN MORSE WITHOUT NOTICING
• The Telegraph Academy teaches you the code two letters at a time, the proven Koch method.
• Hear it, see it, and even feel it through vibrations.
• Battle grids are labelled with the letters you know: the more you learn, the bigger the battles.

THE FREQUENCY WAR
A full story campaign across the Ætheria archipelago: decode intercepted messages, uncover a ten-year-old secret, and face bosses who jam your signals, lie about their shots or transmit faster and faster.

THE AUTOMATON ARENA
10 charming robot opponents, each with its own personality, tactics and star challenges.

CAPTAINS' DUEL
Two players, one phone: place your fleets in secret and take turns firing in Morse.

• Steam gauge, sonar and barrage special shots
• Codex with mnemonics, mastery tracking and look-alike signals
• Original music, 1930s cartoon animation, English and French

Free to start: Academy lessons 1–5, the first 3 automatons and Chapter 1 of the story. Unlock the full game with a single one-time purchase: no subscription, no ads.

name: Mossbury Garden
description:
Mossbury Garden is a plant shop with a working clinic at its heart.

Describe what you see on the leaves, stems or soil and the clinic traces the signs to likely causes and a plain course of care — what to do, why it works, and what to expect next.

Shop six shelves of care goods: nutrition, protection, soil, tools, root care and growing equipment. Every product carries its full label — ingredients, dosage and safe handling.

Check out with saved addresses and pay cash on delivery; orders are tracked from confirmation to your door. Sign in to keep a basket, saved goods, addresses and order history. 

Questions? Send feedback from the app and a person replies.

name: MOTIFOLK: Unspoken Signals
description:
What if an entire island had something to say, but not a single word you understood?

Welcome to MOTIFOLK: Unspoken Signals, an illustrated puzzle adventure where communication is something you discover, not something you are told.

The island's curious creatures speak through gestures, expressions and mysterious glyphs. Watch what they do, notice what they need and experiment with the symbols they share. Then use the Signal Wheel to build a message of your own.

A simple offer might help a thirsty creature. A carefully placed warning could keep a friend out of danger. As the language grows, even the smallest change to a symbol can transform what you mean.

LEARN A LANGUAGE THROUGH PLAY

Discover the meaning of unfamiliar glyphs through observation and experimentation. Combine symbols, explore their relationships and learn from each creature's reaction.

MAKE EVERY MESSAGE COUNT

Arrange glyphs on the Signal Wheel, choose your intent and send a signal. Creatures respond according to what they understand, giving you new clues for your next attempt.

EXPLORE AN ISLAND OF STORIES

Travel through four distinct regions and 24 handcrafted encounters, from simple introductions to more involved challenges of cooperation and understanding.

BUILD YOUR LIVING LEXICON

Keep track of the meanings and communication rules you uncover. Each discovery adds another piece to the island's visual language.

A WORLD YOU CAN TAKE ANYWHERE

Enjoy the complete experience offline, with no account required, no advertisements and no tracking.

MOTIFOLK is about paying attention, thinking creatively and finding common ground without saying a word.

Observe. Compose. Signal. Understand.

name: Mr Remind: Reminders & To-Dos
description:
Mr Remind is the simple reminder app for people with too much on. Get it out of your head in two seconds, get nagged only about what really matters, and stop putting things off.

CAPTURE IN TWO SECONDS
Type or hold the mic: “Call the bank tomorrow 10am !!”. The time, the priority, lists and repeats are picked up as you type. No forms, no fiddling.

THREE KINDS OF IMPORTANT
• Must – keeps reminding you until it’s done
• Should – reminds you once
• Could – waits quietly until you have time
Quiet hours are respected, so nights stay calm.

DONE OR SNOOZE, RIGHT FROM THE NOTIFICATION
Tick it off or push it back without opening the app. Put something off too often and Mr Remind asks what the plan is.

MORE THAN A TO-DO LIST
• Ideas – parked properly, with a weekly nudge to explore one
• Waiting on – track what other people owe you and get a nudge to follow up
• Lists – type #work or #home, then filter with one tap
• Steps – a small checklist inside any to-do
• Repeats – “every Monday”, “1st of every month”, “every weekday at 7”
• Photos – attach a receipt or a note to a to-do
• Upcoming – the next three weeks by day, with your calendar alongside
• Doing now – focus on one thing, with the rest queued “after this”

AI THAT SAVES TIME (optional)
• Brain dump – paste or speak a messy paragraph and it becomes separate to-dos with times and priorities
• Break into steps – turn a big, scary task into small first steps

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Home and lock screen widgets: tick off or snooze from the widget
• Siri and Shortcuts: “Add to Mr Remind”
• Long-press the app icon for quick actions
• iPhone, Android and mrremind.com stay in sync, and the app works fully offline

YOURS, AND PRIVATE
• Morning plan, evening wrap-up, weekly summary and a monthly clean-up
• Face ID lock
• Your profile, your day, your favourite lists
• No ads, no tracking, never sold. Export or delete everything anytime.

Free. Made for busy people.

name: Multiplayer Games: 2 Player
description:
Game night on one phone. Multiplayer Games has 12 games for 2 to 12 players. Hand the phone across the table for a quick duel, or pass it around the room for a party game. It all runs on one phone and works offline. There's no sign up.

DUELS ON ONE SCREEN
Each of you holds one end of the phone.
- Tap War: tap your side as fast as you can and pull the line into their half.
- Reaction: wait for green, then tap. Go too early and the point is theirs.
- Air Hockey: one paddle each, first to 5 goals.
- Pong: slide your paddle and don't miss the ball.
- Tic Tac Toe Glow: the classic, lit up in neon.
- Four in a Row: drop your discs and line up four before they do.
- Math Duel: you both get the same sum. Fastest right answer scores.
- Boom Chip: everyone hides a bomb under one chip, then you take turns picking. Find a bomb and you lose. 2 to 4 players.

PARTY GAMES, PASS THE PHONE
- Imposter: everyone sees the secret word except one player. Give one-word clues, then vote out whoever is faking it.
- Charades: hold the phone on your forehead while your friends shout clues. Tilt down when you get it, tilt up to skip.
- Truth or Dare: pick one on your turn. Skipping costs you a point.
- Most Likely To: read the card out loud, count to three and everyone points.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
Spin the wheel once a day for coins. Win games to earn XP and level up. Spend your coins on table themes like Candy Pop, Deep Ocean and Lava.

FREE TO PLAY
Most games are free, with a short ad between some rounds. You can open a locked game for a while by watching an ad.

VIP gets you every game and every deck with no ads. If you only want the ads gone, Remove Ads is a one-time purchase.

VIP is an auto-renewing subscription (weekly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. It renews unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings. If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms: https://multiplayer-games.up.railway.app/terms
Privacy: https://multiplayer-games.up.railway.app/privacy
Support: https://multiplayer-games.up.railway.app/support

name: Mutlaka Uğra: Gezilecek Yerler
description:
Görmeye değer ne varsa.

Mutlaka Uğra, Türkiye'de şehir şehir gezilecek yerleri bir arada gösterir. Yaşadığın şehirde henüz görmediğin yerleri de, gideceğin şehirde neyi görmen gerektiğini de buradan bulursun. Beğendiğini kaydet, gidince işaretle; gittiğin her yer Türkiye haritanda bir nokta olur.

NE VAR

• 70'ten fazla şehirde 5.000'den fazla yer: camiler ve kiliseler, tarihî yapılar, müzeler, antik kentler, kaleler, köyler, çarşılar, doğa alanları, plajlar
• Şehir sayfasında kategoriye ve ilçeye göre süzme
• Her yerde fotoğraf ve yol tarifi
• Yakınımdaki yerler: bulunduğun yerin çevresindeki gezilecek yerler
• Kaydet: gitmek istediğin yerleri bir listede topla
• Gittim: gittiğin yeri işaretle, tarihini düzeltebilirsin
• Türkiye haritam: gittiğin yerler haritada; istersen paylaşım kartı olarak paylaş
• Bazı şehirlerde yürüyüş rotaları: durak durak, aradaki yürüyüşle

DÜRÜST BİLGİ

Yer sayfasında bilginin kaynakları yazar. Bir yer kapalıysa ya da bir bölümü kapalıysa bunu açıkça belirtiriz; durumunu bilmiyorsak "belirsiz" deriz. Saat ve bilet bilgisi sık değiştiği için yazmıyoruz, gitmeden yerin kendi sitesinden kontrol et. Fotoğrafların sahibi ve lisansı her fotoğrafın üstünde yazar.

HESAP

Hesap açmadan da kaydedebilir, gittiğin yerleri işaretleyebilirsin; kayıtların telefonunda durur. Üye olursan kaybolmaz ve mutlakaugra.com'da da aynı listeyi görürsün. Hesabını uygulamanın içinden silebilirsin.

KONUMUN SENDE KALIR

Yakınımdaki yerleri bulmak için konumunu yalnız telefonunda kullanırız; bize gönderilmez.

Ücretsiz. Reklam yok.

mutlakaugra.com

name: My Roza Tracker
description:
Keep a clear record of your missed rozas and the days you make them up.

My Roza Tracker is a personal fasting journal for mumineen using the Misri (Bohra) Hijri calendar. Organize entries for Rajab ul Asba, Shabaan ul Kareem, and Shehr e Ramadaan, with Hijri and Gregorian dates together.

RECORD MISSED ROZAS
Tap a past day in the calendar, choose Travelling, Sick, Uzur, Pregnant, or Lactating, and save the entry. Roza types are clearly labeled and color coded:
• Farizat — Shehr e Ramadaan, in red
• Sunnat — Shabaan ul Kareem, in yellow
• Tatawwo — Rajab ul Asba, in blue

RECORD HOW EACH ROZA WAS COMPLETED
Mark a roza as Made up and record the completion date. Farizat entries can alternatively be marked Gave Kaffarat. Sunnat and Tatawwo entries do not show the Kaffarat option. Your original missed date and reason stay in your history.

SEE WHAT REMAINS
Filter by month, Hijri year, and status. Switch between detailed cards and a compact list. Entries stay organized with Farizat first, Sunnat second, Tatawwo third, and oldest dates first within each type.

TRACK THE RAJAB 10-YEAR NEEYAT
Mark each Hijri year in which you complete the Rajab roza neeyat. See progress toward 10 years at a glance, including how many years are completed and how many remain. This tracker is separate from missed-roza entries.

KEEP DEADLINES IN VIEW
Farizat entries show the last day before the following Shehr e Ramadaan as the make-up deadline. Rajab and Shabaan entries have no deadline. Overdue entries remain visible and editable.

BACK UP AND EXPORT
Save a JSON backup through Files and restore it on a compatible installation of My Roza Tracker. Backups include missed-roza records and completed Rajab neeyat years. Review a backup before replacing data, with a local recovery copy kept before a restore. Export all records or a filtered list to Excel, including summary totals, Rajab neeyat progress, and detailed dates.

A PERSONAL JOURNAL
No account, advertising, or automatic sharing of your roza entries with the developer. Calendar and tracking features work offline. You choose where to save or share exported files.

My Roza Tracker is an independent personal record-keeping app, not affiliated with or endorsed by ITS52. Calendar views identify reference-checked months; other dates are calculated using the Misri calendar. It does not provide religious rulings or medical advice.

Support: insiya.shabbir@gmail.com

name: MyFamilyTree+
description:
MyFamilyTree+ keeps a family tree on your device. Names, dates, places, notes, and photos stay in the app. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.

Build the tree
Start with one person, then add a parent, a spouse, or a child. You can create someone new or link a person already in the tree. Keep more than one tree, and switch, rename, or delete a tree from the tree list.

Record a life
Save given names, a surname, a suffix, and sex. Mark a person as living. Birth and death dates can be written the way you would say them: 13 Mar 1866, 1866, about 1866, before 1900, or between 1860 and 1865. Add a place and notes.

Other events can be a christening, a burial, an occupation, or a label of your own. A marriage or divorce can have a date and a place.

Photos
Take a photo or choose one from your library. The primary photo is shown on that person's card in the tree and in the people list.

Find someone
Search the current tree by name, or by an exact birth year.

Move a copy
Import a GEDCOM 5.5.1 file from another genealogy program. Export GEDCOM, or export an archive that includes the photo files as well as the tree. On export, you can omit the details of living people and keep their names only. The file is shared through the system share sheet. MyFamilyTree does not send it anywhere on its own.

On this device
Deleting a person removes that person, their events, and their photos from this device. Deleting a tree removes the tree and everyone in it. Your phone or tablet may still include the app's files in a device backup you have turned on. That backup belongs to your device account, not to MyFamilyTree.

name: MyFavoStamp
description:
MyFavoStamp is the staff app for stores that run a Favo Stamp loyalty programme. Sign in with the username and PIN from your store administrator, scan your customers' QR codes, and keep their loyalty cards up to date at the till.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with your staff username and PIN.
2. Scan the customer's QR code with your phone camera.
3. Add their stamp or points, or confirm a reward.

FEATURES
• Check-in QR, Scan and Redeem right at the top of the screen
• Fast QR scanning with the phone camera
• Review customers' reward requests
• Profile screen for your staff account
• Simple design that cashiers learn in minutes

This app is for staff of stores that use Favo Stamp. Customers use the separate Favo Stamp app to carry their cards. To get your store started, visit favostamp.com.

name: Myna Cx
description:
Myna puts your AI agents in your pocket. If you run a service business such as roofing, HVAC, a med spa, a dental practice, solar installation or an agency, Myna's AI agents answer customer texts and web chats, qualify leads and book appointments for you. This app lets you watch every conversation as it happens, step in when a customer needs a person, and keep your contacts, tickets and calendar close at hand.

Myna is for existing Myna accounts. Create your account on the web at myna.cx, then sign in here with your email and password or an email code.

SEE EVERY CONVERSATION
- A shared inbox for every SMS and web chat your AI agents handle
- Filter by Needs review, Starred or Takeover so the conversations that matter come first
- Search by name, tag or intent
- Read the full thread, with internal notes and whether a human has taken over

TAKE OVER WITH ONE TAP
- Jump into any customer conversation and reply yourself by SMS or web chat
- AI replies pause for that contact while you are in control
- Add internal notes your team can see but customers cannot
- Hand the conversation back to the AI when you are done

LEAD FOLLOW-UP THAT KEEPS GOING
- See how your agents are performing: engagements, response rate and a live funnel from first outreach to closed
- Spot what needs you: takeovers waiting, conversations needing review and overdue tickets
- Review lead status, history and details for every contact in one place

CONTACTS IN CONTEXT
- Look up any customer with their status, tasks, notes, appointments and conversation history
- Call or text straight from the contact card
- Keep customer details up to date from anywhere

TICKETS ON THE GO
- Open, assign, comment on and close support tickets
- See priority, category, due date and status at a glance
- Link each ticket back to the conversation it came from

APPOINTMENT BOOKING, AT A GLANCE
- Your calendar shows every appointment your AI agents schedule
- Switch between agenda, day and month views
- Filter by calendar or agent and reschedule in seconds

STAY IN CONTROL OF YOUR AGENTS
- Check each agent's health, including delivery, response rate and errors
- Pause or resume an agent with a tap
- Review the agent's channels, engine and live funnel

BUILT FOR TEAMS AND AGENCIES
- Agency users can switch between client workspaces in seconds
- Team members see what their role allows
- Light and dark themes that follow your device

WHO IT IS FOR
Roofing and exterior contractors, HVAC and home services, med spas and clinics, dental practices, solar companies, and marketing agencies managing AI agents for their clients. If your business wins customers by responding quickly, Myna helps you keep an eye on every conversation without sitting at a desk.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
Your data travels over encrypted connections. Myna does not show ads and does not sell y.our data.

Need help? Email support@myna.cx or visit https://myna.cx.

name: Mynah Music
description:
Mynah plays the music you already own, from the server you already run.

Point it at Navidrome — or any Subsonic or OpenSubsonic server — and your library arrives whole: albums, artists, playlists, starred songs, search, and the words to a song if your server has them. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is matched against a catalogue, and there is no account to make. Your server is the account.

THE RECORD IS THE INTERFACE

An album goes on the platter and spins. The cover becomes the label. The vinyl takes its colour from the art — black, a tinted pressing in the cover's own colour, or two of its colours marbled together — and the room behind it is washed in the same palette. To move through a song, circle the record with your finger, the way you would nudge a turntable by hand; it lands where you lift. A long album is cut into sides, and the deck shows you which side you are on. Play it at 45 if you like.

COVER FLOW, BACK WHERE IT BELONGS

Turn an iPhone sideways anywhere in the library and it becomes a wall of album art, flush to the edges, the way iPhone OS did it. Tap a cover and the row opens where it sits, with the songs beside the sleeve. On iPad it is a full-screen mode of its own.

LOSSLESS, AND OFFLINE

FLAC, ALAC, MP3, AAC, Opus, Vorbis, WAV — whatever is on your server, at whatever quality you choose, with transcoding when you want to spend less data. Download an album and it plays with the server out of reach, on a plane or underground.

IT FITS THE PHONE

The lock screen, the Dynamic Island, AirPlay and your car's display all show what is playing. Background audio, hand-off to the Music app's own player, VoiceOver throughout, Reduce Motion respected. On iPad the deck is the room and the library is a drawer you pull from the left.

AND YOUR APPLE MUSIC LIBRARY

No server yet? Mynah will play the Apple Music library already on your device instead, on the same turntable. One switch in Settings.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO TELEMETRY

No analytics, no crash reporter, no advertising, no third-party SDKs, no tracking. Mynah talks to your server, and to Wikidata and YouTube when you open an artist's page to find that artist's own accounts and newest videos. That is the whole list.

Mynah needs iOS 26 and a Subsonic-compatible server of your own. It is not affiliated with Navidrome.

name: MyPortion: Study & Worship
description:
MyPortion helps individuals and families make time for meaningful personal study and family worship. Create your profile, choose your study preferences, and build an agenda that complements weekly meeting themes and the needs you select.

PLAN YOUR STUDY
• Create individual and family profiles.
• Balance weekly meeting themes with personal study priorities.
• Use customized agendas, adjust individual suggestions, and open suggested source material on jw.org.
• Export agendas as PDF or Word documents and add study time to your calendar.

KEEP YOUR THOUGHTS TOGETHER
• Write notes and organize your study library.
• Import supported documents for your own study.
• Choose scenic or solid-color dashboard backgrounds.

RECORD WITH PERMISSION
• Start and stop recordings yourself.
• Continue an active recording while the screen is locked or another app is open.
• Use downloaded on-device AI models for supported transcription and summarization features. Model downloads require internet access, storage, and a compatible device.

MyPortion is free to use. Optional one-time tips support development and unlock no features or content.

MyPortion is an independent NSF Labs planning guide. It is not affiliated with, sanctioned, sponsored, or endorsed by Watchtower Bible and Tract Society or jw.org. Suggested publication links open the original source on jw.org. MyPortion supplements personal study and family worship and does not replace normal meeting preparation or personal judgment. Record only when lawful and permitted. Public redistribution of app-related materials is prohibited by the app’s License and Responsible Use Agreement.

name: Naeokku - My Own Aquarium
description:
Faces from your photos become fish in your very own aquarium.

A clear glass tank under a single light in a dark room. Pick a photo of yourself, your family or friends, and a fish of a random species is born with that face. Give it a name and raise it.

■ Fish made from your photos
• Finds the face in your photo and blends it onto the fish's head
• Side profiles stay side profiles; glasses and expressions stay too
• Face detection and compositing happen entirely on your device — photos are never uploaded

■ A tank that feels alive
• Every fish swims at its own pace and personality, and comes looking for food
• Feed them and they swim over to eat; bond with them and they come to the glass and follow your finger
• Real-time glass, light, ripples and bubbles

■ Raise, expand, decorate
• Grow fish up to level 20 with food and care
• Expand your tank through 6 sizes to meet bigger and rarer species
• 48 species from goldfish to sunfish, sharks, deep-sea fish and fantasy fish
• Place sand, plants, castles, glass tunnels and more yourself

■ Hidden surprises
• Rare golden, pure white and aurora colour variants
• Spot hidden moments — a sunfish sunbathing, a puffer puffing up, a flying fish leaping — and collect them
• Night falls on the tank and deep-sea fish softly glow
• Fish made from the same photo swim side by side, and milestones are celebrated

■ Codex and memories
• A species codex and memories of every fish you raised

■ Offline, no sign-in
• Start right away, everything is saved on your device

※ Species and colour variants are decided by chance. The odds for every species and variant are shown in the game before you adopt.

name: NavLog Pro
description:
NavLog Pro teaches you to complete a VFR paper navigation log the way your examiner expects: by hand, one column at a time, understanding every number.

PLAN THE ROUTE
• Enter a departure and destination from 12,000+ US airports
• See your route over the FAA sectional chart
• Get checkpoints every 10 to 20 nautical miles, with the reason each one was picked
• Pull forecast winds aloft for your departure time, or type them in from your briefing
• Get a cruise altitude recommendation that explains direction of flight, terrain, airspace, winds and climb performance

LEARN THE MATH
• Teach mode walks through all 13 columns: true course, wind correction, headings, variation, deviation, true airspeed, groundspeed, time and fuel
• An animated wind triangle shows why the numbers come out the way they do
• Wrong answers get a hint that names the mistake, like "East is least, West is best"

SEE IT SOLVED
• Fill the whole navlog instantly
• Tap any cell for "show me how", with the formula and your own numbers

GET CHECKRIDE READY
• An oral quiz about your own route: airspace, fuel reserves, checkpoints and diversions
• Print a kneeboard PDF, or a blank form to practice on paper

YOUR CREW
The Instructor, the Briefer, the Controller and the Examiner each explain their part, and you fly as your own avatar.

FOR TRAINING USE ONLY
NavLog Pro is a training aid. It is not an approved source of aeronautical information and is not for actual navigation. Always use current charts, an official weather briefing and your aircraft's POH.

NAVLOG PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Planning a route and your first lesson are free. NavLog Pro unlocks the full navlog, unlimited lessons, the Examiner's quiz and PDF export. Plans: monthly, yearly (with a free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://navlogpro.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://navlogpro.app/privacy

name: NC Softphone
description:
NC Softphone puts your company phone system on your iPhone and iPad. It connects to your FusionPBX phone system through Odoo, so every call shows who is calling and what you have going on with them.

CALLS
• Ring on all of your extensions, even when the app is closed
• Answer from the lock screen with the standard iOS call screen
• Hold, mute, speaker, transfer, keypad tones and a second call
• Caller name and company from Odoo before you answer

RECENT CALLS AND VOICEMAIL
• Every call from the phone system, across your extensions
• Listen to call recordings and voicemail in the app
• AI summaries and transcripts of your calls (when enabled in Odoo)

TEXTING
• Send and receive text messages and pictures from your business numbers
• Team inbox: see who owns a conversation, take it, share it or hand it over

CONTACTS AND FOLLOW-UPS
• Find Odoo contacts by name or number, right from the keypad
• See a contact's opportunities, quotations and tickets
• Your Odoo follow-up activities, one tap to call

NC Softphone requires an Odoo database with NC Automation's phone integration and a FusionPBX phone system. Pair the app by scanning the code shown in Odoo.

name: NeoAozxLab
description: NeoAozxLab is a science experiment app that lives right on your phone. No account registration or cloud synchronization is required—simply open the app and start experimenting. It features four distinct experimental modules: Optics, Fluids, Elements, and Challenges. You can construct optical paths and adjust wavelengths, pour reagents and tilt your phone to observe how the liquids shift, combine elements to see what they produce, or tackle specific challenges involving light refraction, dual-mirror reflections, and chemical titration. The app leverages your device’s built-in gyroscope and haptic feedback, and offers the option to use your camera or photo library to import materials and save records of your experiments. It is the perfect choice for anyone who wants to explore science through hands-on practice while keeping all their data stored locally.

name: Ner: Discover Hanukkah
description:
Ner (Hebrew for "candle") turns the eight nights of Hanukkah into a short journey you take one evening at a time.

EACH NIGHT
• A short illustrated story about Hanukkah's history and customs
• A Hebrew word with its meaning and pronunciation
• A quick puzzle: Complete the Word, Letter Assembly, Mystery Word or Vocabulary Match
• Light that night's candle on your hanukkiah
• A gift to open

GET READY BEFORE HANUKKAH
• Countdown to the first night
• A free practice night and the blessings, so you're ready on night 1

LIGHTING TIMES
• Sundown times for 20 cities, worked out on your device
• Friday and Saturday times that account for Shabbat
• Optional reminder before lighting
• Home-screen widget

Sources are listed for the stories. No account and no ads, and nothing leaves your phone.

The practice night and night 1 are free. Unlock nights 2–8 with one purchase.

name: Nexo by Qodexia
description:
Nexo reúne las aplicaciones de tu organización y la gestión de proyectos en una experiencia diseñada para iPhone.

• Accede con tu cuenta Nexo y abre las aplicaciones que tienes asignadas.
• Organiza proyectos y tickets en listas, tableros y otras vistas de trabajo.
• Consulta y actualiza tareas, comentarios y archivos desde el móvil.
• Guarda tus aplicaciones favoritas para acceder a ellas rápidamente.
• Conversa por texto o voz con los agentes disponibles en tus aplicaciones.
• Gestiona tu cuenta, la apariencia y el cambio seguro de contraseña.

Nexo utiliza controles nativos de iOS y se adapta a la apariencia clara u oscura y al tamaño de texto del sistema.

Requiere una cuenta Nexo proporcionada por tu organización. Las aplicaciones y funciones disponibles dependen de los permisos y servicios habilitados para tu cuenta.

name: Nightwake - Survive the Night!
description:
You just need to sleep until 6 AM. Something in the room has other plans.

Nightwake is a short, tense horror game about the most vulnerable thing you do every night: closing your eyes.

FALL ASLEEP. IF YOU CAN.
Fill your sleep bar before morning. The longer you stay asleep, the deeper you sink, and the faster it fills. But while your eyes are closed, you see nothing and hear only the house.

FIX IT BEFORE IT REACHES YOU.
Open your eyes and the room has changed. The clock has stopped. The wardrobe door is open. A pale hand is gripping the windowsill. Something is breathing under the bed. You have seconds to set it right, then you have to go back to sleep.

EVERY NOISE COULD BE NOTHING.
Footsteps, knocks, a distant giggle. Most of what you hear in the dark means nothing at all. Some of it doesn't. You'll only know when you look.

FIVE NIGHTS. THEN THE LONG NIGHT.
Each night brings a new threat and less time to react. Survive all five and unlock the Long Night, an endless mode where the sun never comes up, the house keeps getting worse, and your only goal is to last a little longer than last time.

MADE FOR FOLDING
On iPhone Duo, closing your phone closes your eyes. The outer screen goes dark while you sleep, and opening the phone is waking up. On iPhone and iPad, a single tap does the same.

FEATURES
• A horror game you play with your eyes closed
• Five handcrafted nights, each with a new threat
• The Long Night: an endless survival mode with a personal record
• Quick, tense fixes: wind the clock, shut the wardrobe, close the window, shine a light under the bed
• A sleep-depth system that rewards staying asleep
• Atmospheric sound design and haptic heartbeat (on supported devices)
• Short sessions: a night takes about four and a half minutes
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no tracking
• Fully playable offline

Best played at night, in the dark, with headphones.

Contains jump scares and frightening imagery.

name: Nimlo
description:
A little courage. A long way up.

Meet Nimlo, a tiny spider on a journey through a beautifully dark world. Attach your web to glowing anchors, build momentum, and let go at just the right moment. Every landing brings you closer to the way out.

MAKE EVERY THREAD COUNT
Your silk is limited. Plan your route, collect glowing fireflies to replenish it, and turn a careful swing into a daring leap.

EXPLORE NINE MISSIONS
Climb through moonlit forests, mossy ravines, forgotten rafters, a greenhouse, and a crystal cavern. Discover new challenges as each mission opens the path to the next.

WATCH THE WORLD AROUND YOU
Avoid thorny ledges and time your moves around creatures in your path. In Fire World, flames burn along your web: find your next anchor before the thread gives way.

PLAY BY TOUCH
Tap an anchor to attach. Hold left or right to build your swing. Double-tap to let go, or to jump while standing. Drag sideways on a surface to move.

TAKE THE NEXT LEAP
An in-game tutorial helps you begin. Checkpoints let you retry the next stretch, and completed missions remain open for another climb.

One purchase. No ads, in-app purchases, or subscriptions. Play offline, with no account required.

name: Nova HC
description:
Nova HC is the official app for Nova Healthcare candidates and staff. Everything you need, from your first application to your weekly shifts, in one place.

NEW TO NOVA?
• Register for an account in minutes
• Fill in your job application form step by step – your answers are saved as you go
• Book and attend your interview
• Complete your required training
• Upload your documents, such as ID, right to work and certificates

ALREADY WORKING WITH US?
• View your upcoming shifts
• Photograph and upload your timesheets
• Request holidays and see their status
• Complete forms and reviews
• View your history and personal details

STAY UP TO DATE
• Get notifications when your application moves forward, an interview is booked or something needs your attention

SAFE AND SECURE
• Quick sign-in with Face ID
• Your details are sent securely to Nova Healthcare

You need a Nova Healthcare account to use this app. New candidates can register directly in the app.

name: NovaWing: Seasonal Flight
description:
Take flight in NovaWing, a colourful spacecraft adventure across five changing seasons. Dodge creatures, learn each guardian's patterns, and build a ship that fits your way of flying.

Explore 150 chapters across Spring, Summer, Rainy, Autumn and Winter. Earn mastery points from first clears, collect gold through play, and choose from weapons, defences, engines and support upgrades. Preview your next purchase in the hangar-style shop and practise with your ship before your next flight.

Play in landscape with touch controls on iPhone and iPad. Adjust music, ambience and effects separately, or enable reduced motion in Settings. The campaign works offline.

Optional in-app purchases offer permanent equipment and a gold-coin bundle. An internet connection and an eligible Apple account are needed for purchases. Campaign progress and unspent coins are saved on the device. Permanent App Store purchases can be restored; consumed coin bundles are not restorable.

name: NudgelyPro
description:
Instead of telling you what to do, it gives you a simple structure: frame the real question, name two to five genuine options, choose the criteria that matter, and score the trade-offs. Keep the decision open while you think, commit when you are ready, and return later to record how it actually felt.

A calmer way to think:
• A four-step decision builder with weighted criteria
• Transparent scoring that you can understand and revisit
• Five thoughtful templates for work, money, travel, home, and boundaries
• A private journal with search and status filters
• Reflection notes and lessons after the outcome is clear
• Gentle insights into the categories and criteria you return to
• Optional JSON export that you control

name: Nuri Bible
description:
Nuri Bible turns the scroll into Scripture.

Instead of an endless feed of noise, Nuri gives you one verse at a time, full screen, from the King James Bible. Swipe for the next. Save the ones that speak to you. Share them as beautiful verse cards.

FREE, FOREVER
- The whole King James Bible, with search
- Listen to any chapter read aloud
- The Scroll feed and the Verse of the Day
- Explain any verse: what it means, what it can mean for you today, and two verses to read alongside
- A daily five-question Bible quiz, the same for everyone
- Highlights and saved verses
- Three reading plans and a daily streak
- 3 Bible questions a day in Ask
- Today's 60-second story and 3 verse card designs

NURI BIBLE PRO
- All 86 reading plans, including every book, every theme and Bible in a Year
- All 31 sixty-second stories
- All six verse card designs
- 50 Bible questions a day in Ask (fair-use limit of 500 a month)

Ask answers questions about Scripture, faith and prayer with AI (Google Gemini), and every verse it cites is checked against the King James text. It asks your permission before sending anything. Explain sends only the verse itself, never anything you type.

An account is optional. Sign in with Apple, Google or email to back up your streak, plans and highlights.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, weekly, monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm (after the trial). It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://nuribible.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://nuribible.com/privacy.html

name: Odd Stack: Stacking Game
description:
Odd Stack is a physics stacking game about building the tallest tower you can out of things that were never meant to be stacked.

A crane swings back and forth with an everyday object hanging from it. Tap anywhere to let go. There is no snapping and no auto-align: every object keeps its exact position and angle, and real physics decides whether it stays.

130 EVERYDAY OBJECTS
Sofas, washers, pumpkins, bicycles, vending machines, pianos, cows and rockets, each with its own shape and weight. Every new object you stack joins your collection.

POWER-UPS
After each fall, pick a power-up for your next run: a slow crane, a wider base, or lighter loads. Grab power-up tokens floating in the sky as your tower grows.

24 ACHIEVEMENTS
Height goals, tricky stack combos and skill challenges, like ten perfect drops in a row.

YOUR BEST TOWER ON DISPLAY
Your record tower stands on the Home screen until you beat it.

LIVES
Use a life after a fall to put your last safe stack back and keep going. You get 3 free lives every day. You can also watch two short ads, or buy a pack of lives.

Odd Stack is free to play with ads. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off the ad after a fall for good.

name: Oddfolio
description:
Oddfolio is a pocket atlas of obscure occupations. Each local day unlocks one new plate — subway pushers, fortune-cookie writers, paper marblers, neon benders, iceberg movers, and more — while earlier plates stay open forever.

Explore rare trades across six industrial drawers:
• Field & Harvest (FLD): Foraging anomalies, apiculture, and agricultural rarities
• Transit & Flow (TRN): Passenger rail handlers, canal tenders, and transit specialists
• Sensory & Lab (SEN): Olfactory testers, sleep study evaluators, and acoustic certifiers
• Ritual & Civic (RIT): Ceremonial artisans, bellfounders, and historic civic custodians
• Craft & Precision (CRF): Neon tube benders, paper marblers, and manual guild masters
• Extreme & Remote (EXT): Glacial monitors, lighthouse technicians, and deep-sea riggers

Key Features:
- Today: Discover the featured unlock of the day, track catalog completion, and jump directly into the full curatorial brief.
- Atlas: Browse the complete 36-plate repository. Filter by trade drawer codes, search tools and techniques, or inspect unreached entries.
- Saved: Bookmark notable occupations for fast recall on your personal workbench.
- Desk: Adjust tactile haptics feedback, review the field onboarding guide, read expanded editorial field notes, and access offline support.

Every plate includes an operational overview, typical tools of the trade, myths to distrust, historical curiosities, and related vocations. Category atmospheric textures and long-form notes ship directly within the app binary.

Oddfolio operates completely offline on your device. There are no user accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking frameworks, and no advertising. Pure editorial nonfiction designed for curiosity.

name: OfflineMate
description:
OfflineMate
Equipment rentals, managed offline.
OfflineMate helps small local businesses manage equipment from registration and rental orders to returns and deposit settlement. Keep daily rental work on your device and continue working when there is no internet connection.
No account is required. Use it to organize cameras, tools, event equipment and other items you rent out repeatedly.
An equipment register that stays organized
Save names, categories, device codes, photos, daily rates and deposits. Search by name, category or device code. Scan QR codes and barcodes to register equipment identifiers, or generate a QR label for an existing code and save it to Photos.
A clear rental and return workflow
Record customer details, contact information, rental dates, rates, deposits and notes. Filter orders by active, overdue or returned status, and search by customer, equipment or contact details. Record deposit deductions when equipment comes back and review rental charges and deposit refunds.
Equipment readiness at a glance
View rental history in each equipment profile. Mark idle equipment as needing service to prevent new rentals. Equipment on rent must be returned before its service status can change.
An offline workbench for daily operations
Review active rentals, overdue orders, deposits held, monthly rent and rental trends. Open the records behind each summary and review recent equipment and order changes in local activity.
Useful tools when you need them
Schedule local return reminders, attach current coordinates to an order or dictate a note. Voice input requires on-device recognition support for your device and selected language. Manual text entry remains available when recognition is unsupported.
Choose your currency
USD is the default. Available currencies are CNY, USD, EUR, JPY, GBP, HKD and TWD. Changing the currency also updates the units of existing equipment and orders. Numeric amounts stay the same and no exchange conversion is performed.
Backups under your control
Export a backup manually to Files or choose iCloud Drive for system-managed synchronization when connectivity is available. Restoring a backup replaces current local data. Automatic merging across devices is not provided.
Available in English and Simplified Chinese, with light, dark and system appearance options. Requires iOS 15 or later.

name: Ogbesa Go
description:
Ogbesa Go es la app de Ogbesa Multiservices para cuidar de los tuyos desde donde estés. Reserva, paga y sigue tus pedidos en un solo lugar.

RENTA DE AUTOS
Ve la disponibilidad al momento, elige tu auto y recibe tu voucher en minutos. Seguro, tasa de aeropuerto y kilómetros ilimitados incluidos.

TRÁMITES Y VISA ELECTRÓNICA
Visa express en menos de 10 minutos en horario de oficina, o normal en 1 a 3 días. Consulta precios y requisitos de cada trámite.

CASILLERO VIRTUAL

Hazte miembro y recibe saldo de regalo, descuentos en rentas y ofertas exclusivas.

name: OKOBox
description:
OKO Box，把你喜欢的视频、图片和音乐放在一起，随时打开，享受自己的时间。

无论是想重看一段视频、欣赏一张照片，还是听一首熟悉的歌，你都可以在这里整理和浏览自己的媒体内容。

视频播放
导入喜欢的视频，收藏常看的内容。支持记录观看进度，下次打开时接着看；也可以调整播放速度和画面显示方式。

图片浏览
将图片收纳在媒体库中，浏览或收藏喜欢的画面。

音乐聆听
整理你的音乐，收藏喜欢的歌曲，创建歌单。最近听过的音乐也可以在首页快速找到。

轻松查找
通过搜索找到想看的视频、图片或想听的音乐，让喜欢的内容触手可及。

随心选择外观

OKO Box，让观看与聆听回归简单。

name: Onscript: Teleprompter Camera
description:
Onscript is a teleprompter camera for iPhone. Your script scrolls right under the lens while you record, so you can read every word and still look your viewer in the eye.

The script is on your screen, never in your video. Onscript records only the camera and microphone, and your finished take goes straight into Photos.

HOW IT WORKS
• Bring your script: type it, paste it, import a file, or share it to Onscript from Notes, Pages, Mail or Files.
• Press record: a three-second countdown, then the script scrolls at your pace while you talk.
• Done: stop when you're finished and the video is waiting in Photos.

BUILT FOR TALKING TO CAMERA
• The script sits at the top of the screen, beside the front camera, so your eyes stay near the lens.
• Set the scroll speed, text size and how much of the screen the script uses.
• Tap the script to pause it, or drag it to go back a line.
• Use your Apple Watch as a remote: prop your iPhone up, step back, and start and stop the take from your wrist.
• Record in portrait or landscape. In landscape the script moves beside the camera.
• Switch to the back camera when someone else is reading.
• 1080p video with sound.
• Every script is saved with a word count and roughly how long it takes to read aloud.

IMPORT FROM ANYWHERE
Plain text, Markdown, RTF and PDF files, or text shared from other apps. Onscript tidies headings, bullets and spacing so it reads cleanly.

FREE TO TRY
Record takes of up to a minute and keep one script, free. A single unlock (no subscription) gives you takes of any length, unlimited scripts and the Apple Watch remote, and it's shared with your family through Family Sharing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no adverts and no server. Your scripts stay on your iPhone and your videos go to your Photos library.

name: OpenLeaf Notes
description:
OpenLeaf is a free, open-source note-taking app made for students. No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases. You don't need an account; your notes stay on your iPad.

NOTEBOOKS
• 8 covers with lined, grid, dotted or blank paper
• A4, A5 and Letter sizes
• Folders, favorites, trash, search and sorting
• Quick notes and a whiteboard

WRITE WITH APPLE PENCIL
• Ballpoint, fountain, pencil and brush pens with adjustable thickness
• Highlighter and lasso to select and move
• Partial eraser or whole-stroke eraser
• Double-tap Apple Pencil to switch to the eraser; squeeze Apple Pencil Pro for a quick menu
• Only the Pencil draws; your finger scrolls and turns pages

PAGES AND PDF
• Import PDFs and write on slides and lecture notes
• Export any notebook as a PDF
• Page overview, drag to reorder, duplicate pages
• Pinch to zoom with sharp paper at every zoom level

AND MORE
• Sticky notes: type or handwrite, move and resize
• Take a photo or add one from your library, then write on it
• Back up your whole library as a single file to Files or iCloud Drive
• Light and dark themes, English and Turkish

OPEN SOURCE
OpenLeaf's source code is public on GitHub (GPL-3.0). Report bugs, suggest ideas or contribute: github.com/biggypanda/openleaf

name: Opocita
description:
Opocita es una app de test para preparar las oposiciones de Auxiliar Administrativo del Estado.

CADA DÍA, UN TEST CORTO
• Diez preguntas seleccionadas para ti.
• Repaso automático de las que fallas.
• Tu progreso se guarda en el dispositivo.

CADA RESPUESTA, RESPALDADA POR LA LEY
• Cita literal del artículo del BOE.
• Enlace al texto consolidado oficial.
• Sin resúmenes inventados ni apuntes de academia.

CONTENIDO DE LA VERSIÓN 1
• Bloque I del programa de Auxiliar Administrativo del Estado.
• 16 temas: Constitución; Tribunal Constitucional, reforma y Corona; Cortes Generales y Defensor del Pueblo; Poder Judicial; Gobierno y Administración; Gobierno Abierto y Agenda 2030; transparencia y buen gobierno; Administración General del Estado; organización territorial; Unión Europea; procedimiento administrativo; protección de datos; personal funcionario; derechos y deberes; presupuesto del Estado; igualdad, discapacidad y dependencia.
• 510 preguntas verificadas con el texto consolidado del BOE.

Practica por temas, repasa tus fallos y llega al examen con el temario trabajado.

La versión 1 cubre el Bloque I. El Bloque II y las preguntas psicotécnicas llegarán en una actualización.

Opocita es una app independiente. No tiene relación con ninguna Administración Pública, con el BOE ni con academias.

SUSCRIPCIÓN OPOCITA PRO
• Acceso a todos los temas y preguntas.
• Se renueva automáticamente hasta que la canceles.
• Puedes gestionarla o cancelarla desde los ajustes de tu cuenta de Apple.
• Restaura tu compra en cualquier dispositivo.

Soporte: https://opocita.app/soporte

name: OpoMosso
description:
OpoMosso és una app independent de preparació d'oposicions. No és una app oficial ni està vinculada, avalada ni patrocinada pels Mossos d'Esquadra, el Departament d'Interior ni la Generalitat de Catalunya. Consulta sempre les convocatòries i el temari al DOGC i als canals oficials.

Prepara l'oposició a Mossos d'Esquadra fent tests cada dia. OpoMosso t'ajuda a estudiar el temari, detectar on falles i arribar a l'examen amb el ritme agafat.

TESTS PER TEMES
Tria un tema i respon 30 preguntes aleatòries. Cada test és diferent, així no et memoritzes l'ordre de les respostes.

SIMULACRES
Fes simulacres complets per acostumar-te al format de l'examen i saber en quin punt estàs.

TEST D'ERRORS
L'app guarda les preguntes que falles i les pots tornar a fer en un test només d'errors fins que les dominis.

PREGUNTES DESADES
Desa les preguntes que vulguis repassar i fes-ne un simulacre quan vulguis.

TESTS COOPERATIUS
Crea una sala o uneix-te a la d'un company, feu el mateix test alhora i compareu la vostra nota amb la mitjana del grup.

ESTADÍSTIQUES I RÀNQUINGS
Consulta els tests completats, la millor nota, la mitjana, els encerts i errors i el progrés per temes. Compara't amb altres opositors als rànquings.

REPORTA ERRORS
Si creus que una pregunta té un error, reporta-la des del mateix test i la revisarem.

PLA GRATUÏT I PREMIUM
Amb el pla gratuït pots fer 3 tests al dia, amb anuncis.
OpoMosso Premium et dona tests i simulacres il·limitats i sense anuncis per 7,99 € l'any.

Premium és una subscripció anual de renovació automàtica. El pagament es carrega al teu compte d'Apple en confirmar la compra. La subscripció es renova automàticament si no la cancel·les com a mínim 24 hores abans que acabi el període actual, i pots gestionar-la o cancel·lar-la des de la configuració del teu compte d'Apple.

El teu compte és teu: pots eliminar-lo, amb totes les teves dades, des de Perfil > Eliminar el meu compte.

Política de privacitat: https://vicodestudios.github.io/opomosso-privacy/
Condicions d'ús: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ORAE 塔羅
description:
ORAE 塔羅是完全免費的塔羅牌 App：沒有廣告、沒有付費牆、沒有點數。完整 78 張偉特塔羅與 20 種牌陣，每一次解牌都依照固定的牌義與解牌規則組合，不是 AI 生成。

【主要功能】
• 快速二選一：寫下 A、B 兩個選項，抽牌比較哪一邊的牌面比較順
• 20 種牌陣：單張、三張、凱爾特十字、感情、事業、財運……也能自訂 1–12 張
• 三種抽牌方式：親手選牌、系統洗牌、切牌，可開關逆位
• 簡要、深入、專業三種解讀深度
• 每日塔羅，以及週、月、年運勢，可自訂每日推播時間
• 78 張牌義大全、塔羅生日牌、月相
• 星座配對與 12 星座運勢、生命靈數完整報告
• 主畫面小工具：每天打開手機就看到今天的牌

塔羅與命理內容僅供娛樂與自我探索參考，不構成任何專業建議。

name: Orbit: Flight Log & Travel Map
description:
Orbit is a flight logbook for every flight you have ever taken: last month's, and the one from twenty years ago. Add two airports and a date, and Orbit draws the rest onto a travel map you can spin.

A FLIGHT LOG THAT DRAWS ITSELF

• An interactive 3D globe with an arc for every route you have flown
• Great-circle distance in miles or kilometres, hours in the air, airports, countries and continents, all worked out for you
• Trips group themselves, so a connection and its return become one journey without you filing anything
• 28 badges, earned by where you have actually been: polar routes, equator crossings, antipodes, every continent. None of them can be bought
• XP and levels tied to real distance flown
• Share your map, your numbers or your longest flight as an image

LOG FLIGHTS OFFLINE, EVEN AT 38,000 FEET

The airport database, around 8,800 airports, ships inside the app. Search by airport code, city or name with no signal at all. Log a flight mid-air and it saves to your iPhone, then syncs itself the moment you land.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED

Use Orbit as a guest and your flight log stays on your device. Sign in with Apple or Google whenever you like, and the flights on this device move into your new account, once, without duplicates.

YOUR TRAVEL DATA IS YOURS

Delete your account and everything in it from inside the app, in two taps. With Orbit Pro, export your entire flight log as CSV whenever you want. There is no password to lose, because sign-in goes through Apple or Google.

ORBIT PRO

Free covers your first 15 flights, with the full globe and the whole offline airport database. Orbit Pro removes the flight limit and adds CSV export. It comes as a yearly subscription or a one-time purchase that is yours for good. The free tier keeps working either way.

MADE FOR PEOPLE WHO FLY

Frequent flyers, aviation enthusiasts, digital nomads, cabin crew, and anyone who has ever wondered how far they have actually travelled. If you kept the boarding passes, this is the flight log for them.

Orbit is built by QwertyBit. No ads, no trackers following you around the web, and no interest in anything except where you have been.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS

Orbit Pro Yearly is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically each year unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Orbit Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://orbitflights.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://orbitflights.app/privacy

name: Orbital Jump Reloaded
description:
Your astronaut runs around a planet. Tap to jump, fly to the next one, land, and go again. Keep moving: the Sun behind you has caught fire, and it is coming.

A GALAXY TO CROSS
Ten worlds in two galaxies: Earth, the Moon, Mars, Venus, Europa and Titan, then on into Andromeda. Every world is a chain of short missions. Collect the stars and the spheres, reach the beacon, and the next mission opens.

ONE BUTTON, REAL FLIGHT
There is no set path. Every flight is your timing, your launch and the pull of the planets around you. Chain clean landings for combos and Space Coins.

THE GALAXY WANTS YOU GONE
• Deadly black holes that swallow you whole
• Wormholes that throw you across the sky
• Predator planets that hunt you down
• Asteroids, alien ships, and a wall of fire that never stops

THREE ITEMS FOR A BAD MOMENT
• Time slowdown: a big glove holds the Sun back to half speed
• Energy elixir: refills your energy at once
• Life capsule: a lost heart back, or one more go from the last safe planet
• Rare Star and Orb magnets on the planets pull the pickups to you

SUITS
Sky Explorer, Nebula Pulse, Emerald Orbit, Prismatic Voyager and Golden Legend. Each has its own trail, glow and landing sparks. Looks only, never an advantage.

ENDLESS MODE
Finish Earth and the classic endless run opens: drill soil on every planet, build gadgets in the Hangar, and fly the daily galaxy that is the same for everyone.

GAME CENTER
Leaderboards for your campaign score and your best endless run, and an achievement for every world and every combo tier.

FREE TO PLAY, NO ADS
The whole galaxy is free. You earn Space Coins in every mission and spend them on items and suits. Coin packs are there if you want a head start, never needed to finish a world. No ads, no timers, no subscriptions, no account. Questions or ideas: contact@goldenharbourgames.com.

Made in 2021 by the VRLab team in Vladivostok, rebuilt in 2026 by Golden Harbour Games.

name: OSC Station
description:
OSC Station turns your phone into an input for your computer. Pick what to send, press SEND, and the values arrive over OSC — ready for TouchDesigner (a ready-made oscStation component is included), Max, Unity, Resolume or anything that speaks OSC.

FREE
• Sensors: acceleration, gravity, gyroscope, orientation (quaternion and Euler), compass, GPS, pressure, magnetic field, sound level, battery
• Live view of every value as it goes out
• Built-in controllers: faders, knobs, XY pads, buttons, color picker, touchpad gestures and more, with ranges, steps and default values
• Scenes: keep a layout's values and call them back in one tap or over a fade, like a cue list
• Import layouts made by others
• Camera average colour and motion amount
• Replies from the target computer; setups you can switch and share
• OSC over UDP or TCP

PRO — one-time purchase
• Camera tracking on the device: body (33 points, with 3D), hands and gestures, face (478 points, 52 expressions, head rotation), person mask and cut-out, object detection
• NDI® camera out, with the person cut out as alpha and the microphone as audio
• NDI screen share
• NDI monitor: watch an NDI source on the phone
• Layout editor: make your own layouts
• Export your layouts to share them
The free version runs every Pro feature except export, with a watermark every 30 seconds (camera tracking pauses while it shows). Pro removes it.

Built for stages and installations: long-press STOP, warnings for low battery and heat, and a clean instrument-panel look.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data goes only to the computer you choose.

NDI® is a registered trademark of Vizrt NDI AB. https://ndi.video/

name: OTHERKIN
description:
OTHERKIN is an offline visual archive and character studio for original otherworldly life. Browse a local census of lifeforms, masks, and eyes, then carry those studies into designs that stay on this device.

Open a file and read its structure: shells, surfaces, irises, and pupils, marked on the plate. Compare up to three records. Save favorites, gather a collection, and keep a research project with notes and a board.

In the studio, start from a template or a blank sheet. Choose a lifeform, a mask, and an eye, set a palette, and save variants and snapshots. Export a design sheet as a PNG or PDF, and back up the personal archive on this device.

There is no account and no network sync. The studies are original design notes. They are not medical descriptions, and they are not drawn from an existing film or game.

name: Otomix
description:
Otomix turns home recordings into a studio sound with automatic mixing and mastering. Upload your beat, record your vocals on your phone or add them as files; Otomix processes every track on its own, balances it with the beat and delivers your song with a release-ready master.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Record over the beat: listen to the beat on headphones while you record; latency calibration and a level check keep your takes clean.
• Lead vocals, backing vocals and ad-libs in separate groups, each with its own style and effect.
• 12 genre presets: rap, pop, rock, jazz, Turkish rap, Turkish pop, melodic rap and more. Or fine-tune every track yourself.
• Editing: cut, split, move, join and undo. Edits never change the original recording.
• Before / after: compare the mix with the original at matched loudness and adjust the vocal–beat balance by ear.
• Re-process a single track: change one track's style, only that track is processed again, then run the mastering.
• Share video: a vertical clip of the best part of your song with visuals that react to the music, ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.
• Download MP3 and WAV, save to Files or share.
• Projects in the cloud: save your session and pick up where you left off.

SUBSCRIPTION
• Weekly: 5 mixes every week; first 3 days free (1 mix + 2 free re-mixes of that song), then it continues weekly. You can start the paid week right away during the trial.
• Monthly: 20 mixes every month; switching from weekly to monthly starts immediately.
• Extra pack: 3 mixes, one-time, never expire.
• Your first 2 re-mixes of a song on the same beat are free: change settings, add or remove tracks, redo a take. You can also adjust the vocal–beat balance once for free; after that it uses a mix credit.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://otomix.pages.dev/kosullar.html
Privacy policy: https://otomix.pages.dev/gizlilik.html

name: OttoQuest

Check the asking price before you commit to a car. OttoQuest brings listings, market estimates, and VIN history together so you can compare your options and see what changes.

Compare listings
Search by make, model, budget, location, and vehicle condition. See asking prices alongside market estimates where available and look for listings below market.

Track a car by VIN
Look up a VIN to see recorded asking prices and available vehicle details. Add cars to your watchlist and compare shortlisted options side by side.

Save your search
Keep the filters that matter to you. Use a free account to sync your watchlist with OttoQuest on the web and opt in to alerts for saved searches or tracked cars.

Follow the market
Explore price trends, market movers, and auction results. Coverage focuses on the United States. Estimates and listing history depend on available data.

Survey, manufacturing and fitting from one team. Contact us for a free survey.

name: Paceku
description:
Paceku menemani larimu dari hari ke hari. Kamu cukup bilang tujuanmu: lari sehat dan bugar, mulai dari nol, atau mengejar waktu di lomba. Paceku menyusun plan mingguan dan menyesuaikannya dengan kemampuan yang benar-benar kamu tunjukkan.

Yang bisa kamu lakukan:
- Plan lari mingguan sesuai tujuan dan jadwalmu, lengkap dengan penjelasan tiap sesi.
- Catat lari: rekam langsung dengan GPS, unggah screenshot dari aplikasi lari lain, atau isi sendiri.
- Lihat zona pace, perkiraan waktu lomba, dan kesiapanmu.
- Latihan kekuatan dan panduan singkat untuk pemula.
- Catatan kesehatan opsional: berat badan, detak jantung istirahat, tidur, dan nyeri.
- Tanya Paceku: tanya jawab seputar latihanmu.
- Pengingat malam kalau sesi larimu belum dicatat. Bisa dimatikan kapan saja.
- Rencana bisa diunduh sebagai PDF atau gambar.

Paceku bukan pengganti dokter atau pelatih. Kalau ada keluhan kesehatan, konsultasikan dulu sebelum berlatih.

Akun dan akses Paceku dibeli lewat paceku.com. Aplikasi ini untuk masuk ke akun yang sudah ada.

name: PackLoad
description:
PackLoad is a dedicated equipment weight distribution and equilibrium balancing platform engineered for backpackers, hikers, and alpine explorers.

Built strictly upon biomechanical leverage principles and the four-compartment rucksack model, PackLoad calculates the exact center-of-gravity elevation and spine lever arm to optimize carrying comfort and minimize lumbar strain.

KEY CAPABILITIES

1. BIOMECHANICAL EQUILIBRIUM BENCH
• Real-time Balance Efficiency Score (0-100%) calculated dynamically as gear items are organized.
• Center-of-Gravity (COG) height elevation ratio tracking (target 55-65%).
• Anterior torque lever index to prevent heavy gear from pulling rearward.

2. FOUR-COMPARTMENT CUTAWAY VISUALIZER
• Spine Core: Concentrates dense cookware, stove fuel, and water flasks close to the back.
• Base Sleeping: Cushions lightweight puffy sleep gear and down quilts at the bottom.
• Front Outer: Allocates quick-access rain gear and wind layers without leverage drag.
• Top Pocket: Houses trail navigation, headlamps, and first aid gear.

3. PAYLOAD & SYSTEM MASS BREAKDOWN
• Complete mass categorization across Shelter, Sleep System, Kitchen & Water, Essentials, and Apparel.
• Ultralight weight threshold classification (Ultralight, Lightweight, Standard Expedition).
• Instant target delta comparison against your custom base weight objective.

4. PACKING CHECKLIST & LEDGER

name: Parul Rotor
description:
Parul Rotor is a puzzle game about the machine inside the giant lanterns of San Fernando, Pampanga. It is made for Kapampangans and Filipinos everywhere, whether you have stood in the December crowd at the Ligligan Parul or grew up with a parol in the window.

A giant lantern's bulbs are wired in groups. Each group ends in a hairpin that rides on the rotor, a steel barrel turned by hand. Masking tape on the barrel breaks the current: taped means that group is off, bare steel means it is on. Whoever tapes the barrel writes the light show.

In Parul Rotor you do that job. Every lantern shows its circuits (star points, heart, tails, rings, petals, spokes, halo and more) next to a target show of 6 to 16 beats. Lay and peel tape strips on the unrolled rotor, one track per circuit and one column per beat, then crank to test your show. The lantern lights when every beat matches, and you earn stars for using as few strips as possible.

Later lanterns add twists taken from real wiring. Some hairpins sit a few beats ahead, two circuits can share one track, linked circuits need two tracks bare at once, and old tape stays stuck where it is.

- The Workshop opens straight onto tonight's lantern, a new rotor every day, with a streak to keep alive.
- The Lanterns path: 60 handmade lanterns across ten barangays, from a three-circuit window parol to festival giants with eleven circuits.
- Festival Night: every lantern you light replays its show on the plaza. Hang it in front of a photo of your own window and share it as an image.
- Sandbox Rotor: an empty lantern and barrel to compose your own shows, saved on your device.
- Rotor Notes: a plain explanation of rotors, hairpins, masking tape, bamboo and steel frames and papel de Hapon.
