name: Pelmorica
description:
Pelmorica keeps dimensions, end conditions and ideal resonance frequencies together in a traceable experiment. Begin with an open tube, a rigid-open tube or a cavity with a neck. Enter length, circular radius and independent cavity volume. The cross-section is labelled schematic: its outline does not establish a real volume. Dimension sources and shape assumptions stay beside the values.

Ends separates physical length from the two added lengths in a proportional strip. Every active opening needs an explicit correction coefficient and its applicable source, including a deliberately chosen ideal zero. A rigid end does not retain an open-end correction. Changing between tube and cavity clears incompatible boundary definitions and scan bounds whilst retaining annotations and inactive geometry in the draft. Nothing changes in the saved source until the draft is confirmed.

Modes uses a frequency comb to locate permitted frequencies, then shows the selected ideal pressure shape over effective length. Modal index and odd harmonic number remain separate for a rigid-open tube. The lumped cavity predicts one resonance and does not invent higher cavity modes. Tooth heights identify selection, not amplitude or measured spectral peaks. Supply sound speed directly or use the stated dry-air temperature law. There is no inferred Q. Without a sourced Q, there is no bandwidth; a sufficiently high supplied Q permits only a clearly labelled nominal f/Q value.

A dimension trial varies one supported length, radius, volume or temperature whilst holding the other conditions fixed. Changing radius updates circular area and active end additions together. Inspect local finite differences, relative frequency shifts and numerical samples. Temperature elasticity uses absolute Kelvin rather than the arbitrary Celsius zero. Exploration can be sent to a new draft for review without directly changing source geometry.

Freeze a trial record with its baseline, adopted comparison dimension, end conditions and scan range. Later source changes leave those input copies intact. Share an illustrated PDF, typed mode-and-sample CSV or complete JSON archive. Review imported copies before saving; source archiving, restoration and separate permanent removal preserve frozen records.

Pelmorica works offline in Australian English and Simplified Chinese. Its linear tube and lumped-cavity models do not acquire sound or provide measured spectra, response amplitude, absorption coefficients or acoustic certification. Declared wavelength-scale checks remain diagnostics rather than proof that every real geometry fits the approximation.

name: Pipewright Offset Calculator

name: Pipsong
description:
Pipsong is a songbook and set list app for worship teams and musicians. Keep your chord charts in one place, plan the next service, and play from your phone or iPad.

YOURS, ON YOUR DEVICE • Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking • Print a song, a set or the whole list through AirPrint, or save a PDF • Download a backup of every song any time • Name your songbook and pick a color, in light or dark mode

FREE AND PRO The free version has every feature and holds up to 15 songs. Pipsong Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the limit. No subscription.

Pipsong doesn't provide songs; it keeps the ones you add. Please use songs you have the right to use, such as public-domain hymns or songs covered by your church's license.

Unwind with Pixelpalet – color by number, one cell at a time.

name: Placivra
description:
The workshop moved upstairs. The poster by the door didn't get the memo.

Placivra helps staff at libraries, community centers, and shared spaces keep printed notices up to date. Log the copies at your entrances, service desks, and bulletin boards. When a date or venue changes, see exactly which copies need a check or a swap. When a notice expires, see where it needs to come down.

One notice, many copies. Keep dates, languages, sizes, and versions together, and compare the version on the wall with the one that should be there. Check, replace, or remove each copy in person, then record what you did. The history shows who confirmed it, where, and when.

Make a round of it. Choose your stops, estimate travel and task time, and see what might miss a deadline. Save the checklist and pick up where you left off. Need to find a board quickly? Search by name, area, or its printed location code.

Print what you need. Count replacements by exact language, size, and revision. See confirmed needs alongside estimates, factor in stock and spares, and save the print order for later.

Share the next checklist or a saved print order as a CSV, make plain-text location signs, and keep a full backup of your register. Start with your own workspace or try the editable example. Run your checks offline without an account.

name: PlantHQ
description:
PlantHQ is a maintenance system for manufacturing plants and facilities. Keep every machine, work order, maintenance plan and spare part in one place, and let anyone on the floor report a problem in seconds.

WORK ORDERS, START TO SIGN-OFF
• Requests from operators, approved and assigned by the maintenance team
• Checklists, photos, notes, job timer, labor hours, downtime and sign-off
• Board and calendar views on iPad and the web

PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE
• Plans by date, by running hours, or whichever comes first
• Work orders are created before things come due
• Ready-made plans for 42 equipment types: compressors, dryers, HVAC, forklifts, conveyors, pumps, motors, electrical gear and production machines

QR TAGS ON EVERY MACHINE
• Print a sheet of tags from the app
• Scan to open a machine, report a problem or see its history
• Keeps the asset tags and barcodes you already have

PARTS AND PURCHASING
• What is on the shelf, where it is, and what is running low
• Take parts out on a work order and the cost lands on the job
• Purchase requests, approvals, PO numbers and receiving

LOCKOUT/TAGOUT
• Energy sources for each machine, filled in by machine type

COSTS AND REPORTS

ASK A TECH

Operators who only report problems are always free. Works offline and syncs when you are back in range. Available in English, Spanish, French and Italian.

name: Pledge Note
description:
Pledge Note isn't a to-do list. It's an app for keeping the limits you set for yourself.

WHO IT'S FOR
• You drank canned coffee every day and want to cut down to once a week
• Chips, sweets, alcohol, phone in bed, impulse buys… the rules slip a little at a time
• "Just today" keeps adding up until you're right back where you started

FEATURES

Set a limit
"Up to once a week," "once a day," or "never." Make rules by day, week or month. See what's left at a glance with simple dots.

Write down your why
The trigger (add a photo, like a checkup result), who you want to become by keeping the rule, your promise to yourself, and how much it matters. Read it again whenever you need to.

Remember it right before you break it
When you're about to go over a limit, your own words appear full screen. If you hold back, it's counted as a win — and celebrated. Choose how strict the gate is: light, medium or strong. Loosening a limit goes through the same gate.

See when you tend to slip
Patterns by day of the week and time of day — "Friday nights," for example. We suggest reminder times based on them, but only reminders you add are ever sent.

Review
Weekly and monthly summaries, the reasons you went over, and a calendar.

Easy to start
Pick from example rules and the form fills in with a sample of what to write.

PRIVACY
No account needed. Everything stays on your device and is never sent anywhere. No ads, no tracking.

NOTE
This app is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis. For health concerns, please consult a doctor or other professional.

name: PMD Pro
description:
PMD Pro is a metronome and rhythm practice studio for iPhone. Build speed gradually, practise how rhythms fit together, and turn your own drum patterns into play-along tracks.

• Metronome & Speed Ramp — Set a starting and ending tempo, choose how many BPM to add at each step, and hold each tempo for a set number of bars or seconds. Add an audible cue for tempo changes and choose a pulse, full-circle flash, or wooden pendulum display.

• Polyrhythms — Hear how different rhythmic pulses line up and follow their relationships with animated visual guides.

• Metric Modulation — Explore changes in pulse and rhythmic grouping. Add accents and rests, loop bars or patterns, and work through subdivisions with the Table of Time.

• Displacement — Build grooves in the drum grid, see them on the stave, and mix individual percussion sounds. Import WAV or FLAC loops to practise alongside your patterns.

• Time Lab — Create odd-metre patterns and practise counting them with editable notation and spoken counting options.

Export practice tracks as WAV files to rehearse, teach, or use in a recording session.

name: Pnsrult
description:
Thanks for being with us! We are constantly iterating and improving—please feel free to leave your suggestions at any time.

Pnsrult is cash-envelope budgeting, done by hand. No bank linking, no feeds to untangle — just your month's income, poured into envelopes, and a clear answer to the only question that matters on a Tuesday afternoon: how much is safe to spend today?

POUR YOUR MONTH IN
Set this month's income, then pour it into envelopes: Rent, Groceries, Transport, Fun, Savings, or any you make yourself. Give each a budget and an icon. One tap fills every envelope up to its budget; or pour envelope by envelope with the built-in number pad. The jug shows what's still waiting to be poured.

SPEND IN TWO TAPS
Tap an envelope's copper seal, punch in the amount, seal it. Add a note if you like. Each envelope shows its money as liquid behind a little window — it sloshes down when you spend and rises when you pour, so you feel your balance, not just read it.

SAFE TO SPEND TODAY
Pnsrult takes what's left in your flexible envelopes and divides it by the days left in the month. One honest number at the top of your stack, every morning. Mark fixed bills like rent as "fixed" and they stay out of the daily math.

MOVE MONEY, SEE THE FLOW
Overspent on groceries? Move money from Fun in seconds. The Flow tab shows the whole month: poured versus spent, a daily-spend line drawn day by day, your biggest envelopes, and a log of every pour, spend and move, grouped by day and filterable. Past months are filed away so you can look back.

MONTH ROLLOVER, YOUR WAY
When a new month starts, Pnsrult copies your envelopes and asks what to do with each leftover: roll it over into the same envelope, or let it flow into Savings. You choose per envelope, and you can set a default.

MADE FOR DAILY USE
• Any currency, with local formatting
• Works offline; syncs when you're back
• Optional account (email, Google, or Sign in with Apple) so your envelopes follow you to a new phone
• Or skip sign-in and start right away — save your data to an account later
• Haptics you can switch off, VoiceOver labels, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion support
• Delete your account and every record from inside the app

Pnsrult is a budgeting notebook, not a bank: nothing is connected to your accounts, and nothing is shared or sold. Just your envelopes, your numbers, and a calm sense of where the month stands.

name: Pocket Shell by GHT
description:
Bring your servers with you. Pocket Shell is a native SSH terminal for iPhone and iPad, built for developers, administrators and anyone who works at a command line.

CONNECT YOUR WAY
Save your SSH hosts and connect with an Ed25519 key or password. Generate an identity on your device, copy the public key to your server, or import an unencrypted OpenSSH Ed25519 key. Private keys and saved passwords are stored in the iOS Keychain. No Pocket Shell account is required.

KEEP YOUR PLACE
Open multiple terminal tabs and switch between hosts. With tmux installed on your server, each tab can reconnect to its own remote session after a dropped connection or time away from the app.

A TERMINAL THAT FITS YOUR PHONE
Use an xterm-compatible terminal with scrollback, text selection, copy and paste, adjustable text size, and an extra-keys row for Escape, Tab, Control, arrows and shell punctuation. Choose Full, Minimal, or SSH & tmux keyboard presets.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from twenty terminal themes, including light, dark and OLED options. Adjust keep-alives and connection timeouts in Settings.

KNOW WHAT YOU CONNECT TO
Pocket Shell remembers accepted host keys and refuses connections when a known server key changes. Local diagnostics help troubleshoot connections without recording terminal content.

Works with your own SSH servers. Optional GHT shortcuts are provided for Glass House Technologies users. Pocket Shell does not include a local Linux environment, server hosting, Mosh or SFTP.

name: Point Fluid Simulator
description:
Point Fluid Simulator is a 3D fluid dynamics lab that runs in real time on your device's GPU. Every simulation is drawn as a living point cloud of tracer particles that you can orbit, zoom and push around.

NAVIER–STOKES SANDBOX
Solve the incompressible Navier–Stokes equations on a 3D grid and watch them work. Fire a vortex ring, roll up a Kelvin–Helmholtz shear layer, drive a lid-driven cavity, shoot a jet or let a Taylor–Green vortex break down into turbulence. Set the Reynolds number, add vorticity confinement, and colour the points by speed, pressure or vorticity. Switch to Push and drag to stir.

WIND TUNNEL
Put a cylinder or sphere in the flow and see a von Kármán vortex street appear behind it. Shape your own NACA airfoil with camber, thickness, chord and angle of attack. With Pro, add flaps and leading-edge droop, build a 3D wing with span, taper, sweep, dihedral, twist and winglets, save designs A, B and C to compare their lift and drag curves, and test a simple aircraft, a car, a cube or your own USDZ or OBJ model. Smoke streaklines and streamlines show the flow; surface points show the pressure coefficient. Lift, drag and pitching-moment coefficients update live and plot over time, and an angle-of-attack sweep draws the lift curve and marks the stall.

ENGINEERING WIND TUNNEL (PRO)
Import your own model (OBJ, USDZ, STL, PLY or GLB), set its units and orientation, check it is watertight and repair holes, then run it at real conditions: air or water, speed, temperature and altitude give the Reynolds and Mach numbers. A high-fidelity lattice-Boltzmann solver with an LES turbulence model runs on the GPU. Get forces and moments, Cd, Cl, Cs and Cm with your own reference area, length and moment centre, convergence monitoring, yaw, pitch and speed sweeps, a grid-sensitivity check, surface pressure maps and sections, surface oil-flow lines, a wake survey plane, Q-criterion vortices and lift spectra. Save projects, compare runs A, B and C with difference maps, and export CSV, ParaView (VTK and VTU), PLY, images and a one-tap PDF report. Built for early-stage screening in motorsport, drones, cycling, product design, architecture and teaching. It is a quick-look tool for concepts and trends, not certified CFD: the Validation page shows its measured accuracy.

PLAYGROUND (PRO)
Break a dam, drop a splash, pour from a spout or spin a rotating tank with thousands of particle-based liquid points. Light a fire or a smoke plume that rises by buoyancy.

LEARN THE PHYSICS
Clearly typeset explanations of every term, from advection and pressure to lift, drag and vortices.

HONEST NUMBERS
The solvers are tested against the Taylor–Green vortex, the Ghia lid-driven cavity, cylinder shedding, the sphere drag curve and the Ahmed body. Grids are coarse so it runs in real time; see the in-app Validation page.

EVERYWHERE
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro, where the flow floats in a volume or fills the room. Up to 120 fps on ProMotion displays, with quality tiers that keep your device cool.

POINT FLUID PRO
Free: the Navier–Stokes sandbox at Low and Medium resolution and the wind tunnel with a cylinder, a sphere and an editable NACA airfoil.
Pro adds High and Ultra resolution, the full wing editor (flaps, 3D wings, design comparison), every wind tunnel body and model import, angle-of-attack sweeps and polar plots, the liquid, smoke and fire playground, and export of video, PLY point clouds and CSV data.
Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Orchestr Education, a subscription that also unlocks Pro in other Orchestr learning apps, is offered too.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.

name: Point Hydrology Simulator
description:
Point Hydrology Simulator is a 3D hydrology lab that runs on your device's GPU. Real terrain becomes a living point cloud: rain falls on every cell, soaks in or runs off, gathers into streams and rivers, floods valleys and recharges the groundwater, all in front of you, from any angle.

REAL TERRAIN
Start in a Rocky Mountain catchment above Boulder, Colorado. With Pro, open a Himalayan valley at Kedarnath, the urban floodplain of Ellicott City, the Mississippi delta, or search any place on Earth and simulate a square of 1 to 40 km from real elevation data (USGS 3DEP, SRTM and other open datasets). Or sculpt your own synthetic valley.

RAIN, SOIL AND RUNOFF
Set rain intensity and duration, or (Pro) use SCS Type II and Chicago design storms for a chosen return period and send a storm cell across the map. Water infiltrates with the Green–Ampt model for 11 soil textures, or with the SCS Curve Number method. Land cover sets surface roughness, imperviousness and canopy interception; paint forest, fields or city onto the terrain and see the hydrograph change.

FLOODS AND RIVERS
The full 2D shallow-water equations are solved with a well-balanced finite-volume scheme that handles wet and dry ground, fast flood waves and dam breaks. A faster local inertial mode suits slow floodplain flow. Colour the water by depth, velocity, maximum depth or Froude number, and follow glowing flow particles down the channels.

GROUNDWATER AND EROSION (PRO)
An unconfined aquifer is recharged by infiltration and seeps back into valleys as baseflow. Optional bedload transport shows where channels erode and bars build up.

GAUGES AND HYDROGRAPHS
Watch rainfall and outflow plot live, with peak discharge, time to peak and the runoff coefficient. With Pro, drop gauges on rivers to record stage and discharge, and export everything as CSV or record a video.

HONEST SCIENCE
Every method is cited in the app. A built-in validation suite checks the solver against analytical solutions (Ritter and Stoker dam breaks, Thacker's oscillating basin, the kinematic-wave plane, Green–Ampt, the Dupuit–Thiem well) and conservation laws, and you can run it on your own device. A live water balance shows the closure error. Point Hydrology is an educational and planning-exploration tool, not for engineering design, flood warning or emergency decisions.

APPLE VISION PRO
Put the watershed on your table as a volume and walk around it while the storm passes.

POINT HYDROLOGY PRO
Free: the Rocky Mountain preset and synthetic terrain, constant rain, infiltration and surface flow at Low and Medium resolution. Pro adds any location, all presets, groundwater, erosion, design and moving storms, gauges with CSV export, High and Ultra resolution and video export. Monthly ($2.99) or yearly ($19.99, 7-day free trial) subscriptions, or a one-time lifetime unlock ($39.99). Orchestr Education also unlocks Pro here and in other Orchestr education apps.

name: Praxis Pulse by MKTPraxis
description:
Praxis Pulse by MKTPraxis is the official mobile qualitative research, consumer insight, and biometric response controller for the MktPraxis (mktpraxis.com) university marketing education platform.

Designed for university marketing courses, consumer behavior labs, and executive workshops, Praxis Pulse transforms every student's iPhone or iPad into a real-time qualitative & biometric research instrument—while giving instructors a walk-around remote to launch and moderate live activities from anywhere in the lecture hall.

THREE WAYS TO USE PRAXIS PULSE:
1. Join Live Classroom Activities (Student Controller):
   Enter your instructor's 4-character Room Code or scan the classroom projector QR code to join a live consumer research session in one tap. Sign in with your MktPraxis student account to link participation to your enrolled university course, or join immediately in Guest Mode.

2. 9-Tool Solo Sandbox & 28-Student Simulated Classroom Cohort:
   Explore all 9 qualitative and biometric research instruments anytime—even outside of class. Each tool runs with a realistic 28-student simulated classroom cohort so you can see live peer reactions, toggle between your personal input and the Class Debrief view, and study how qualitative consumer data aggregates into actionable marketing insights.

3. Instructor Walk-Around Remote (Host Mode):
   University instructors can sign in with their MktPraxis instructor account to launch live sessions across any of the 9 tools, switch stimulus rounds, reveal results on the classroom projector, and monitor live student participation counts while walking the room.

ALL 9 QUALITATIVE & BIOMETRIC RESEARCH TOOLS INCLUDED:
• Continuous Pulse Dial: Second-by-second affective response slider (-50 to +50 / 0 to 100) synced to video commercials with live classroom mean worm & controversy index.
• Video Tap Map: Frame-accurate spatial attention tracker—tap where your eye is drawn as a commercial plays, then scrub the cohort KDE attention heatmap.
• Spectrum Wall: Multi-dimensional semantic differential and brand positioning scales that reveal bimodal customer polarization in real time.
• Brand Portrait Studio: Guided 6-dimension projective personification studio (archetype, energy, style, expression, and palette).
• Card Sort Arena: Interactive Kano Model and mental-model categorization with instant classroom consensus vs. split-feature matrices.
• Hot Spot Map: Tap-to-mark visual stimulus evaluation comparing Attract vs. Repel attention zones on print and digital ads.
• Emoji Pulse: Rapid gut-reaction affect pad with live classmate reaction stream for testing advertising claims and scarcity framing.
• Collage Engine: Projective visual mood-board builder for uncovering deep emotional buying motives.
• Magnetic Poetry: Collaborative means-end chain whiteboard linking product attributes to functional benefits and core personal values.

name: PrépaRemorque - Permis BE
description:
PrépaRemorque t'aide à préparer le plateau du permis BE, l'épreuve hors circulation du permis voiture + remorque. Chaque jour, une séance d'environ 15 minutes te fait réviser les vérifications de l'ensemble, l'attelage et le dételage, et les fiches orales. Mets-toi ensuite en situation avec l'examen blanc.

TA SÉANCE DU JOUR
• Trois petites tâches par jour, adaptées à ton avancement : au début tu découvres, à la fin tu t'entraînes comme le jour J
• Les tâches se cochent toutes seules quand tu les termines
• Ta série de jours et ton niveau de préparation

L'ENSEMBLE EN PHOTOS
• 6 vues de la voiture et de la remorque : avant, poste de conduite, attelage, flancs, arrière et intérieur de la remorque
• 38 zones à toucher : ce que tu montres et ce que tu dis, à lire ou à écouter
• Les 6 thèmes de vérification, point par point
• Vérifications comme le jour J : un thème tiré au sort, tu montres et tu expliques chaque point à voix haute, puis tu te notes sur 3
• La checklist du plateau, dans l'ordre de l'examen, avec chronomètre

ATTELAGE ET DÉTELAGE
• 14 étapes en photos : 7 pour atteler, 7 pour dételer
• Pour chaque étape : ce que tu fais, ce que tu dis et l'erreur à éviter
• Exercice « remets dans l'ordre » pour retenir l'enchaînement

ORAL
• Les 12 fiches orales, à lire ou à écouter, avec vitesse réglable
• Écoute en continu de toutes tes fiches, même écran verrouillé : en voiture, à pied, partout
• Mode oral : tu réponds à voix haute, tu t'enregistres, tu te réécoutes et tu compares avec la réponse modèle

QUIZ ET MARCHE ARRIÈRE
• 200 questions avec corrections expliquées : le permis BE, les poids et la compatibilité, l'attelage et le freinage, les feux, le chargement, le plateau et les fiches orales
• Série chronométrée ou correction après chaque question
• Marche arrière : les 4 pistes en schéma animé vu de dessus, et la règle du volant à l'envers

EXAMEN BLANC
• Le plateau complet, dans l'ordre du jour J : contrôles, attelage, thème tiré au sort, interrogation orale, marche arrière, dételage, gestes et postures
• Chronomètre par étape, auto-évaluation et bilan des points sur 23
• L'examen pas à pas, avec un lexique des mots du permis BE : PTAC, PTRA, câble de rupture…

AU QUOTIDIEN
• Date du plateau facultative et compte à rebours
• Rappel quotidien à l'heure de ton choix
• Progression et badges pour repérer les points à travailler

GRATUIT POUR ESSAYER
La vue avant de l'ensemble, les 2 premières étapes de l'attelage, les fiches orales 1 à 3, 20 questions du quiz, un examen blanc, la checklist, les thèmes tirés au sort et la marche arrière. L'achat unique débloque tout le reste. Sans abonnement.

SANS PUB, SANS COMPTE
Aucune publicité ni compte à créer. Ta progression et tes enregistrements restent sur ton téléphone. Les photos, fiches et questions restent disponibles hors connexion ; l'achat et la restauration nécessitent une connexion aux stores.

Les photos sont des supports pédagogiques générés par IA : repère aussi les éléments sur ton véhicule de formation.

APPLICATION NON OFFICIELLE
PrépaRemorque est une application indépendante, sans lien avec l'État ni les organismes chargés des examens du permis de conduire. Son contenu est pédagogique : il ne remplace pas la formation, la réglementation en vigueur ou les consignes de l'examinateur. Nous ne garantissons pas la réussite et ne saurions être tenus responsables du résultat obtenu à l'examen, sous réserve des droits prévus par la loi.

name: Pro Shot Coach: Photo Guide
description:
Take pro-looking photos of everything except selfies — the view, the city at night, your dinner, the thing you're selling, your room and your pet. Plus the creative trick shots that make people ask "how did you take that?"

Pick a shot, compare the Before / After, and the coach camera tells you exactly what to do: where the horizon goes, which lens to use, how to tilt the phone. When the frame turns green, shoot a burst — or switch on auto shutter and let it fire for you. Slightly crooked? It straightens the photo for you before saving. Then share your best one straight to Instagram, X or LINE.

98 SHOTS FOR EVERYTHING BUT PEOPLE
• Pro Techniques — 18 composition techniques pros learn from textbooks: Room to Move, Group in Threes, Break the Pattern, S-Curve, Three Layers of Depth, Clean Background, Golden Spiral, Raking Light and more, each with a Before / After comparison
• Wow Tricks — Shop-Window Double Exposure, Ice-Cream Cloud, Hand-Mirror Portal, Photo Inside a Photo, Peek Through a Hole, Instant Mirror Lake
• Landscapes — Big Sky, Mirror Lake, Puddle Mirror, Stacked Mountain Layers, Tiny Subject in Huge Space
• Composition — Something in Front, Leading Road, Rule of Thirds, Perfect Symmetry, Frame in a Frame, Shadows Only, Straight Down From Above
• Light — Golden Hour, Sunset Silhouette, Sun Star, Glowing Backlight, Rainbow Prism Flare
• City & Night — Straight Buildings, Look Up, Blue Hour, Light Bokeh, Rainy Window, Color Pop Wall
• Food & Drinks — Top-Down Table, The 45° Angle, Window-Light Plate, The Noodle Lift, Dish in the Dark, Catch the Steam, The Cut Shot
• Small Things — Flat Lay, Studio on a Sheet of Paper, Clear-Glass Pedestal, Glass Light Patterns, Sell-It Photos
• Rooms, Pets and Nature — Symmetrical Room, Cozy Detail, Get Down to Their Eyes, Big Nose Close-Up, Flower Against the Sky
• iPhone Camera Tricks — Pano Glitch, Speed Blur From a Train, Bend the Horizon, Vertical Panorama, Silky Water, Night Mode

A CAMERA THAT COACHES YOU
• Horizon guide: it works out the tilt that puts the horizon exactly on the line, for the lens you picked
• Auto-straighten: slightly tilted photos are leveled and cropped before saving
• Composition guides: rule of thirds, center line, leading lines, foreground, frame, straight verticals, top-down
• The right lens for each shot (0.5×, 1×, 2×), auto shutter + burst, self-timer, upside-down detection
• Photo shapes for Instagram posts (4:5), Stories (9:16), square and full
• "Where are you?" — beach, mountains, city, night, café, home, park or sightseeing
• "Start here" — 10 easy shots with a clear Before / After
• Share to Instagram, X, LINE and more with the iOS share sheet
• Track the shots you've tried and unlock 16 badges
• English, 日本語, 한국어

PRIVATE AND FREE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Photos stay on your iPhone. Everything works offline.

Example images are AI-generated illustrations.

name: PRO Контроль
description:

УДАЛЁННЫЙ СТОЛ

name: ProLístky Vstup
description:
ProLístky Vstup je čtečka vstupenek pro pořadatele, kteří prodávají vstupenky přes ProLístky (prolistky.cz). Obsluha u vstupu s ní kontroluje vstupenky fotoaparátem telefonu.

Spárování bez účtu
Pořadatel v konzoli ProLístků vytvoří čtečku a uvaděč naskenuje párovací QR kód nebo otevře odkaz z e-mailu. Telefon pak kontroluje jen akce, které pořadatel určil, a jen do konce nastavené platnosti. Pořadatel může čtečku kdykoli odpojit.

Přihlášení člena týmu
Členové týmu pořadatele se mohou přihlásit e-mailem a heslem, případně s dvoufázovým ověřením.

Kontrola vstupenek
• Načtení QR kódu vstupenky fotoaparátem. Každý výsledek potvrzuje server ProLístků, takže tutéž vstupenku nepustíte dvakrát ani při kontrole na více vchodech.
• Ruční hledání podle jména nebo kódu vstupenky, když QR kód nejde načíst.
• Přehled vstupu: kolik lidí je uvnitř a kolik jich ještě dorazí.
• Zkušební režim pro zaškolení obsluhy na ukázkové akci.

Aplikace potřebuje připojení k internetu. Seznam vstupenek do telefonu neukládá a nezobrazuje reklamy. Je určená obsluze pořadatelů, návštěvníci akcí ji nepotřebují.

name: Pronteo: Invoice & Quote Maker
description:
Pronteo makes invoices, estimates and quotes on your iPhone in under a minute. No account, no sign-up, nothing to set up: open the app and write your first document.

Built for people who bill from their phone: contractors, plumbers, electricians, landscapers, cleaners, photographers, freelancers.

INVOICES, ESTIMATES AND QUOTES
Pick a client, add your items, done. Sales tax, VAT or GST (several rates if you need them), discounts, deposits, payment terms and notes are all there. Numbering is automatic, and your clients and items are saved for next time. Import a client from your Contacts in one tap.

CLEAN PDF DOCUMENTS
Choose one of four templates, add your logo and your color, sign with your finger. Every document is a proper PDF your client can open anywhere, in Letter or A4.

SEND IT YOUR WAY
Share by Mail, Messages or any app on your iPhone. Print with AirPrint or save to Files.

KNOW WHO HAS PAID
See what is draft, sent, paid or overdue. Record a partial payment or mark an invoice as paid in one tap, and see what you are owed and what you have collected.

SAVE TIME
Duplicate any document in one tap. Turn an accepted estimate into an invoice without retyping anything.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything is stored on your iPhone. There is no account and no server: we never see your clients or your invoices. Export a full backup whenever you want and restore it on a new phone. Export your documents as a CSV file for your accountant.

UNLIMITED MEANS UNLIMITED
Your first 3 documents are free, complete and without watermark. After that, one subscription gives you unlimited invoices, estimates and quotes. No tiers, no monthly caps. The price is shown before you start typing, never after.

Without a subscription you can still open, share, print and export every document you have created, and mark invoices as paid.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pronteo Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, weekly or yearly; the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Pronteo is not tax, legal or accounting advice. You are responsible for the legal mentions required on your documents in your country.

Terms of Use: https://pronteo.indigatellc.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pronteo.indigatellc.com/privacy

name: Pungo Score Pad
description:
Pungo Score Pad is your Mahjong companion, helping you accurately calculate scores, understand each scoring factor, and track the entire game. Simply enter the cards, and the app will analyze the combinations, explain each Yaku or Faan, and indicate the points each player needs to pay.

Supporting both Hong Kong and Japanese Riichi rules, the app allows you to enter cards by tapping on each card or typing symbols quickly. From Chow, Pung, Kong to special cases like Riichi, Dora, drawing cards yourself, or taking cards played, every factor is taken into account. The results clearly show Han, Fu, or Faan, the limits from Mangan to Yakuman, and how points are divided among players.

You can also use the analysis tool to see which cards are still available to complete the hand, the number of remaining cards, and the value of winning with Ron or Tsumo. With a 14-card hand, the app ranks discard options to help you retain the most useful choices. The number of tiles already on the table can be added to make the results more accurate to the actual situation.

When starting a game, Pungo Score Pad automatically tracks the wind direction, the dealer, Honba, and Riichi sticks. It records wins, draws, or draws, previews the results before saving, and allows easy editing or undoing of incorrect entries. After the game ends, you can view rankings, Uma and Oka scores, individual player statistics, or share results as text and CSV files.

Additionally, the Mahjong handbook integrates popular tile types, illustrative examples, and a glossary to help beginners learn the rules. Customize the scoring system according to your table rules and master the game with Pungo Score Pad.

name: Pupperz

**LESS STRESS. MORE TAIL WAGS.**

Because raising a puppy is enough work already. Keeping track of it shouldn't be.

Download Pupperz and start building better routines with your best friend today.

name: purpleBeacs
description:
purpleBeacs は、店舗での応対を録音し、ご契約先の本部へ届ける業務用アプリです。purpleBeacs をご契約の企業でお使いいただけます。

■ 紐付けるだけですぐに使えます
管理者が管理画面で発行した 8 文字のコードを入力すると、端末が店舗に紐付きます。紐付ける前に録音した分も端末に貯めておき、紐付けが済んだらまとめて送ります。

■ 録音していることを、いつでも確かめられます
使い始める前に、録るもの・送り先・聞ける人・止め方を説明し、同意をいただいてから使います。録音するのは「録音を開始」を押してから「録音を停止」を押すまでで、録音中はロック画面と Dynamic Island に「録音中」と経過時間を表示し続けます。

■ 業務中も録音が途切れません
録音中にほかのアプリを開いたり、端末を置いて画面が消えたりしても、録音は途切れません。電話などで中断した場合も、終わり次第自動で録音に戻ります。

■ 録音は自動で区切って送信
録音は 10 分ごと（設定で変更可）に区切り、区切るたびに本部へ送ります。電波の悪い場所では端末に貯めておき、つながったら自動で送り直します。「Wi-Fi 接続時のみ送信」にすると、モバイル回線の通信量を使いません。

■ 録音を守る暗号化
本部の設定に応じて、録音を端末に保存する時点で暗号化します。復号できるのはサービスのサーバだけで、端末を紛失しても録音の中身は読み取れません。

■ 止め忘れを防ぐお知らせ
一定時間ごとに「録音中です」と通知する設定があります。通知から録音を止めることもできます。

■ 送信状況がひと目でわかる
未送信の件数・容量、送信済みの件数、対応が必要な録音を一覧で確認できます。「今すぐ送信」で手動送信もできます。

録音の再生や文字起こしの確認は、ご契約先の管理画面で行います。アプリから録音を再生・書き出しすることはできません。

※ ご利用には purpleBeacs のご契約と、管理者による紐付けコードの発行が必要です。
※ 録音していることは、店頭の掲示などで必ずお客様にお知らせください（ご契約の条件です）。

name: QR ORDER STAFF

name: Qudurat: Saudi GAT Test Prep
description:
Prepare for the Saudi General Aptitude Test — Qudurat (GAT) and aim for 95+ with a 100% Free, 100% Offline, and completely Ad-Free study companion!

Built specifically for high school and university students in Saudi Arabia, Qudurat combines a realistic 96-question Computer-Based Test (CBT) simulator, 2,500 original Quantitative and Verbal questions, 30-second mental shortcuts, foundation cheat sheets, and a Saudi University Weighted Score Calculator — with zero subscriptions and no account required.

WHY STUDENTS LOVE QUDURAT:
• 100% Free & Unlocked: Every mock test, topic drill, step-by-step explanation, and formula sheet is completely free from day one.
• 100% Offline & Private: Works anywhere without an internet connection and collects zero personal data.
• Authentic Exam Formatting: Full Arabic RTL interface using Eastern Arabic numerals (٠-٩), Arabic algebraic variables (س، ص، ع), 286 crisp geometry diagrams, and 181 statistical charts.
• Dual Explanations on Every Question: Learn both the 30-second no-calculator mental shortcut and the full step-by-step mathematical or linguistic breakdown.

5 POWERFUL STUDY MODES IN ONE APP:

1. Realistic CBT Exam Simulator (96 Questions):
• 4 timed sections (24 questions & 25 minutes per section) mirroring real test-center pacing.
• Authentic section locking after submission, question flagging, in-section review grid, automatic session resume, and instant diagnostic score reports.

2. Topic-by-Topic Practice (2,500 Original Questions):
• Quantitative (1,360 questions): Quantitative Comparisons, Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, and Statistics & Data Interpretation.
• Verbal (1,140 questions): Verbal Analogies, Sentence Completion, Contextual Error, Odd Word Out, and Reading Comprehension (36 full passages).

3. Smart Mistake Notebook (Spaced Repetition):
• Automatically captures missed questions and schedules smart review intervals until every weak skill turns into a strength.

4. Foundation Rules & Cheat Sheets (16 Topics, 64 Golden Rules):
• Concise reference cards covering exponents, roots, percentages, speed/distance, circle & triangle geometry laws, and rapid verbal elimination strategies.

5. Saudi University Weighted Admission Calculator (الموزونة):
• Calculate your weighted university admission score combining High School GPA, Qudurat, Tahsili, and STEP with preset or custom weights — plus a Reverse Goal Calculator showing the exact exam score you need to reach your target admission percentage.

Disclaimer:

name: Quota – Flight Radar
description:
Quota shows what is really in the sky. Every position comes from the aircraft itself, received by community networks of ADS-B receivers. Nothing is invented: every value says whether it is live, cached or estimated.

RADAR
• Live aircraft worldwide, no account and no key needed
• Tap an aircraft: it comes into view with its departure and usual route
• Flight instruments that move: heading, altitude, vertical speed, ground speed
• Layers: SIGMET weather, estimated airport and no-fly zones, space stations and satellites, map styles
• "What plane is that?": point the camera at the sky and see the aircraft, the Moon, the ISS and the other satellites

SKY
• Passes of the ISS, the Chinese Tiangong station, the Hubble telescope and the latest Starlink trains, from where you stand
• A reminder 5 minutes before each visible pass, satellite by satellite
• Everything computed on your device

FOLLOW A FLIGHT
• Follow puts the aircraft in the Dynamic Island
• Save it to see it in My flights, in the widgets and as a Live Activity, with progress and an honest arrival window
• Share a card of the flight

AIRPORTS
• Map with runways, terminals, car parks and estimated drone zones
• Arrivals and departures happening now, from live traffic
• Weather (METAR/TAF decoded), runways, frequencies, local time
• Directions with Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze

FOR PILOTS
• A flight plan page like an onboard computer: airports, VOR, NDB and coordinates, with autocomplete
• Nav log with magnetic courses, wind correction, ground speed, times and fuel
• Winds and temperatures aloft from the NOAA GFS forecast, applied leg by leg at your cruise altitude
• Terrain profile, navaids along the route, METAR, runway wind, density altitude and daylight at both ends
• Flight mode for iPhone and iPad, portrait or landscape: moving map, GPS data, Direct-To, layers
• Flight computer, weight and balance, checklists and a logbook that fills itself
Quota is a support for planning and situational awareness, not a navigation instrument: always use official charts, NOTAMs and briefings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no account, no tracking. Location and camera stay on your device.

On a Mac with Apple silicon Quota runs as the iPad app; features that need the camera, motion sensors or GPS are hidden there.

Data: adsb.lol (ODbL), adsbdb.com, NOAA Aviation Weather Center, OurAirports, OpenStreetMap, Planespotters.net, CelesTrak, NOAA GFS, NOAA World Magnetic Model, AWS Terrain Tiles.
Quota does not show schedules, gates or delays: ADS-B does not carry them, so we do not pretend to.

name: Raventra
description:
# Pavelytix

**Pavement Engineering & Rehabilitation**

Pavelytix is ​​a professional pavement structure analysis and maintenance design tool for road engineers. It helps users manage road sections, organize inspection data, evaluate pavement performance, and develop maintenance plans.

### Core Functions

- **Road Section Management**: Organizes engineering data by road station number and tracks section inspection status.

- **FWD Deflection Analysis**: View deflection basin curves, sensor readings, and structural modulus back-calculation results.

- **Pavement Distress Detection**: Records the location and extent of distresses such as cracks, potholes, and loose surfaces.

- **Pavement Performance Analysis**: View rutting, smoothness, IRI, and pavement condition evaluation.

- **Structural Layer Management**: Records the thickness, material parameters, and core sample test results of each pavement layer.

- **Maintenance Plan Design**: Configures asphalt overlay, milling, and local repair plans.

- **Quantity Calculation**: Estimates treatment area, material volume, and engineering quantities.

- **Report Export:** Organize inspection results, structural analysis, and design schemes to generate engineering reports.

From site inspection to structural assessment and maintenance plan design, Pavelytix helps engineers establish a clear, coherent, and traceable pavement engineering workflow.

**Pavelytix — Measure. Evaluate. Rehabilitate.**

name: Rekenpret – Tafels & Sommen

name: resewise
description:
resewise puts your bookings and your schedule in one place. Book a place in a few taps, or put your open times on one link and watch the bookings come in.

FOR CLIENTS
• Find a time in search: what, when and where
• Book a time in seconds, with or without an account
• Pay at the visit, by card or PayPal, or the provider’s own way, like a bank transfer
• Follow a full time and hear the moment a place opens, or follow a whole schedule for its new times
• Choose someone on a team’s schedule to see only their times, and follow them for new ones
• Pick a service on a schedule to see only its times
• Get confirmations and reminders by email or in Telegram, up to three per booking, and add bookings to your calendar
• Cancel online under each booking’s terms
• Rate your visit with 1 to 5 stars and a comment, and read others’ reviews

FOR PROVIDERS
• Create paid or free services with their length, price and place: in person, online or both
• Add slots on several dates at once, or repeat them every week
• Manage your schedule with AI: write what to add, cancel or move, then confirm the changes

• Take cash, card payments straight to your own Stripe, LiqPay, monobank or PayPal account, or your own way, like a bank transfer

• See who booked each slot and who has paid, live, and mark no-shows

FOR EVERYONE

name: Resource Augmentation
description:
SITS Resource Augmentation (SITS.RA) is an enterprise talent sourcing and staffing management platform developed by Sampath Information Technology Solutions Limited (SITS). It bridges corporate client demand for specialized technical resources with verified recruitment partner supply under strict administrative, security, and compliance governance.

The platform provides dedicated, role-based workspaces tailored for clients, recruitment agency partners, and internal SITS management teams.

KEY WORKSPACES & CAPABILITIES:

FOR CORPORATE CLIENTS
• Sanitized CV Bank: Search and browse anonymized candidate profiles showcasing verified technical proficiencies, domain experience, and seniority.
• Selection Basket: Shortlist preferred talent and directly submit interview and augmentation requests.
• Request Tracking: Follow your staffing requisitions from submission to fulfilment with live status updates.

FOR RECRUITMENT AGENCIES & PARTNERS
• Open Vacancies: Access active client briefs and talent demands authorized by SITS.
• Streamlined CV Submissions: Submit vetted candidate profiles seamlessly against open roles.
• Candidate Pool Management: Track your talent pool, confirm candidate availability, manage revisions, and handle redeployments from one dashboard.

FOR SITS BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & HR TEAMS
• Vacancy Publishing: Draft, approve, and distribute client vacancies to designated agency partners.
• Submission Review: Evaluate cross-partner candidate submissions and match candidates to client requirements.
• Partner Onboarding & Governance: Multi-level vendor verification, compliance checks, and maker-checker approval workflows.
• Profile Quality & Sanitization: Review incoming submissions, sanitize candidate profiles to ensure privacy compliance, and publish vetted profiles to the CV Bank.

ENTERPRISE SECURITY & GOVERNANCE
• Role-Based Access Control: Strict workspace isolation ensuring partners and clients only access data authorized for their organization.
• Dual-Authorization Controls: Maker-checker verification for administrative privileges and role assignments.
• Immutable Audit Trails: Comprehensive activity tracking and email delivery logs for regulatory peace of mind.

name: Riddle Rally
description:
Riddle Rally is the car treasure hunt for clubs, schools, companies and friends.

Every car gets a riddle that hides a secret checkpoint in the city. Crack it together, drive there and scan the marshal’s QR code to unlock the next one. Fastest car wins!

• Riddles first, then help — stuck? A clue unlocks after a few minutes, then the full location with a map link.
• One game for the whole car — everyone joins with a 6-digit team code. When anyone scans, every phone updates instantly.
• Genius solves — reach a checkpoint before the clue appears and earn bragging rights.
• Lucky Draw chests — marshals hide mystery QR codes: win time bonuses… or get a flat tyre!
• Flash quests & road bingo — snap photos on the way for extra time off.
• Live leaderboard with podium, team stats and awards.

• No passwords — just your name and mobile number.

Organizers run events from the Riddle Rally dashboard: routes, timings, marshals, live control and results.

name: RidePilot Driver
description:
RidePilot Driver is the app for drivers of transfer, taxi and chauffeur companies that dispatch with RidePilot.

Your company assigns a ride, your phone alerts you, and you accept or decline right from the notification. Everything you need for the trip is on one card: pick-up time, addresses, client name and phone, flight number with live flight status, passengers and notes.

FOR THE DRIVER
• New ride alerts with Accept / Decline
• Today's and upcoming rides at a glance
• One-tap navigation to the pick-up and drop-off
• Call or WhatsApp the client
• Trip steps: Start trip → Arrived → Client on board → Completed
• Live flight status for airport pick-ups
• Messages from the office
• Your work hours: On duty, On pause, Off duty

FOR THE OFFICE
• Sees your position on the live map while you're on duty, so the next ride goes to the nearest driver
• Knows when you've arrived and when the client is on board

PRIVACY
Your location is shared only with the company you drive for, and only while you are On duty or on a ride. It stops when you go Off duty or log out.

You need a driver login from your company to use the app. Companies can sign up at ridepilot.org.

name: Rifle-Log
description:
Every rifle has a story. Rifle-Log keeps it.

Rifle-Log is the logbook for shooters who care where every round went: how many are on the barrel, how the last group measured, what the dope was at 800 yards, and when the rifle was last cleaned. It replaces the notebook in your range bag, the spreadsheet at home, and the tape on your stock.

LOG A RANGE DAY IN SECONDS
• Tap "I shot today" and your round counts stay current: rounds on the barrel, rounds since cleaning, and barrel life used.
• Record the ammo, suppressor, location, temperature, density altitude and wind for each session.
• Tag sessions as practice, match, load development or zero, then scroll back through the full history of any rifle.

KNOW YOUR BARREL
• See the round count and percentage of expected life for every barrel at a glance.
• Swap barrels without losing their history. Keep spares on the shelf and retired barrels in the archive.
• The cleaning tracker shows rounds fired since the last cleaning and flags a rifle when it's due.
• Keep your suppressors in the same place as your barrels.

MEASURE GROUPS FROM A PHOTO
• Photograph your target, tap each bullet hole, and Rifle-Log does the math.
• Get group size in inches, MIL and MOA, measured center to center.
• Go beyond extreme spread with mean radius, width and height.
• See where the group landed relative to your point of aim, along with the correction to dial.
• Already measured it with calipers? Type the group size in instead.

DOPE YOU CAN TRUST
• Build a dope card for every rifle and load, with elevation and wind for each distance.
• Check off each distance once it's confirmed on target, so you always know which numbers are proven.
• Each card carries its zero, muzzle velocity and the conditions it was built in.
• View any card in MIL or MOA.
• Your best group at each distance sits right beside your dope.
• Share your whole dope book as a PDF, one page per card, to print or keep on your phone.

BUILT FOR MORE THAN ONE RIFLE
Comp gun, elk rifle, rimfire trainer: each one gets its own barrels, loads, dope cards and session history. Note the action, chassis and trigger on every build. Serial numbers stay hidden until you tap to show them.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Precision rifle and rimfire competitors tracking barrel life through a season
• Hunters who want confirmed dope before opening day
• Handloaders working up a load and keeping the proof
• Anyone who has ever asked, "How many rounds are on this barrel?"

Your rifle is already writing its story, one round at a time. Download Rifle-Log and start keeping it.

name: Riva Walk: šetnja uz more
description:
Riva je srce svakog primorskog grada — mjesto gdje se sreću more, sunce i cijeli grad u šetnji pred večeru. Riva Walk je mali lokalni pratilac tog rituala: kaže vam kada je more najniže, kada zalazi sunce, puše li bura ili jugo i koji je danas najbolji termin za šetnju.

PLIME I OSEKE
Model plime prilagođen jadranskim gradovima — od Pule do Dubrovnika. Vidjet ćete visinu mora, sljedeću plimu i oseku, a vlastitim zapisima i kalibracijom model postaje vaš.

VEČERNJI RITUAL
Termin šetnje prije večere, zalazak sunca i jasna podsjetnica: povratak prije mraka. Ako želite, obavijesti vas obavijeste na vrijeme.

BURA ILI JUGO
Kažemo vam što obući i koju stranu rive izabrati. Bura traži vjetrovku i zavjetrinsku stranu, jugo gornju stranu šetnice, a maestral je najbolji pratilac rive.

VAŠE RUTE
Od pristaništa do trga — sa klupama, fontanama, sladoledom i znamenitostima uz put. Uređujete točke redoslijedom koji vama odgovara.

GUŽVA ILI MIR
Zapišite koliko je ljudi bilo na rivi. Vrijeme će pokazati koji su mjeseci i termini najmirniji — vaša osobna iskustva, vaša sezona.

GODINA NA RIVI
Koliko ste šetnji ove godine, koje godišnje doba najviše volite i koji mjesec vjetar nije dao. Sve na jednom kartici.

Aplikacija radi potpuno lokalno: bez računa, bez reklama i bez interneta. Svi podaci ostaju na vašem uređaju.

Napomena: procjene su prilagođene navikama šetnje uz hrvatsku obalu i služe samo za osobnu referencu. Ne zamjenjuju službene prognoze plime i vremena (DHMZ, HHI).

name: River Run: Race to the Sea
description:
You are a stream of water.

Drop from the clouds onto a mountain island, then race 79 AI streams downhill. Gravity is your engine. Lakes make you bigger. A well-timed cut absorbs a rival. First to the sea wins.

HOW TO PLAY

name: RLC AC Solver
description:
Build an AC circuit, watch the current move, and see the numbers behind it.

RLC AC Solver is a circuit editor and sinusoidal steady-state solver for students, teachers and electronics enthusiasts. Drag resistors, inductors, capacitors and wires onto a grid, set the AC source, and the app solves the whole circuit with complex Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) every time you make a change.

BUILD AND EXPLORE
• Drag R, L, C and wires onto a 5 × 6 grid. Tap a palette item to switch it between horizontal and vertical.
• Edit values with engineering units: pF to F, pH to H and Ω to MΩ. For L and C, the reactance at the source frequency is shown and stays linked to the value.
• Start from one of eight examples (RC, RL, LC and RLC, in series and in parallel) or build your own.
• Undo recent changes, or clear the board and keep the source.

WATCH THE CURRENT
• Moving dots on the wires show current direction and phase; their speed follows the current and the frequency.
• Tune the animation with speed, frequency cap and current cap. Resize components, labels and wires, and show or hide grid points and component values.

SEE THE NUMBERS
• AC source: set voltage, frequency and phase, then read the delivered current and the load impedance in polar or rectangular form.
• Power: active P, reactive Q, apparent S and power factor, labelled inductive, capacitive or resistive.
• Compensation: the parallel capacitor or inductor that cancels the reactive power.
• Every component: voltage and current phasors, plus power (R) or reactive power (L, C).

SAVE AND SHARE
• Your circuit is saved on the device automatically.
• Save and open editable XML circuits (.xml or .rlcsolver) with the Files app, share them with another user of the app, or export an image of the circuit with its measurement table.

Works on iPhone and iPad in 17 languages, including right-to-left Arabic. Everything runs on your device: it works offline and needs no account.

Calculations assume ideal components in sinusoidal steady state. Power values use RMS conventions.

name: RoadyAuto
description: Diagnose vehicle problems through a structured sequence of symptoms, checks, and results. Select what the car is doing and narrow the possible causes through an interactive diagnostic tree. Each answer changes the next recommended check and the ranking of likely causes. Follow a repeatable process from symptom to verification and action while keeping the entire diagnostic path visible. Review completed checks and compare outcomes across different diagnostic sessions. Clear safety guidance highlights situations that may require stopping vehicle use or consulting a qualified professional. The tool is designed for preliminary troubleshooting and does not replace professional mechanical inspection.

name: RollerBound: Marble Adventure
description:
RollerBound is a 3D marble puzzle adventure that you play by tilting your iPhone. Roll along paths of floating blocks, jump over gaps and spikes, and roll over the edge of a block: gravity turns with you, so walls and undersides become new floors.

TILT TO PLAY
• Tilt forward to roll, left or right to turn, toward you to turn around
• Tap to jump two cells, tap with two fingers to hop in place
• Accelerometer and gyroscope together, with adjustable sensitivity
• Swipes work as an alternative

150 LEVELS IN 15 WORLDS
Fun Fair, Future City, Pyramids of Egypt, The Sea, The Mountains, Steampunk, Cyberpunk, Space, The Moon, The Sun, The Milky Way, Interstellar Voyage, The Big Bang, The Black Hole and, at the very end, the Enchanted Forest. Every world has its own sky, blocks and music, and its 10 levels get harder one after another. Every level is checked by a solver, so there is always a way through.

FIND THE KEYS, REACH THE EXIT
Collect every key to open the exit before the clock runs out. Coins, gems and a hidden star raise your score. The hourglass flips time over: grab it at the right moment.

BONUS STAGES AND BALLS
After each world comes a speed bonus stage: no keys, the exit is already open and everything is worth points. Every bonus you complete unlocks a new ball inspired by the world that follows: 14 to win, plus the classic one.

ENTROPIA
Finish level 150 to unlock ENTROPIA, a final bonus level that is built again every time you play it. Fall, retry or come back later: the chaos never repeats.

• Plays offline
• No ads, no account, no tracking
• Original music for every world

RollerBound is made by MP Software, www.mpsoftware.it

name: Rowrest: Crochet & Knitting
description:
Follow the crochet and knitting patterns you already own, one row at a time.

Add a PDF from your files, and Rowrest turns the written instructions into a clean list of rows. Tap Next row as you work. Your place is always saved, so you can put your project down and pick it up right where you stopped.

- See your written pattern as a list of rows
- Mark each row as you finish it
- Your place is saved in every pattern
- Set a group of rows to repeat
- Open the original page at any time
- All your patterns in one library

Your patterns stay on your device. No account needed.

Start with the yearly plan: 7 days free, then $19.99 per year. Or pay once for $59.99 and keep Rowrest for good.

The yearly plan renews automatically until you cancel in your App Store settings, at least 24 hours before it renews.

Terms: https://rowrest.web.app/terms
Privacy: https://rowrest.web.app/app-privacy

Works with written row instructions. Charts and diagrams are not converted into rows, but you can always view them on the original page.

name: RuneManga - Manga Translator
description:
RuneManga translates manga, manhwa and comic pages into your language, right where you read them.

TRANSLATE AS YOU READ
Open a site in the built-in browser, tap Translate, and the pages on that site are translated as you scroll. The site remembers your choice.

PAGES FROM PHOTOS AND FILES
Saved a page or took a screenshot? Pick it from Photos or Files in the Translate tab. Tap a translated page to compare it with the original.

MADE FOR READING
• One language for the whole app, picked from a searchable list
• Text size for each site
• Ads and trackers blocked for faster, cleaner pages
• A history of what you translated
• Light and dark looks, made for iPhone and iPad

ONE ACCOUNT EVERYWHERE
Sign in with Apple, Google, Discord or email. Your RuneManga account and credits work in the app, on runemanga.com and in the browser extension. New accounts get free credits. One credit translates one page; pages that fail or are already in your language cost nothing.

PLANS AND CREDIT PACKS
The Supporter, Pro and Ultimate plans add fresh credits every month, and credit packs never expire. Subscriptions renew automatically each month until cancelled. Manage or cancel them in your Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://runemanga.com/privacy

name: Rush Hour
description: 집과 회사를 잇는 첫 도로부터, 강을 건너는 다리와 도시를 가로지르는 지하철까지. 러시 아워는 교통망을 설계하며 작은 마을을 키우는 도시 시뮬레이션 게임입니다. 집에서 일터와 상점, 공원까지 편하게 오갈 수 있도록 길을 연결해 보세요. 새 주민이 들어오고 건물이 높아지면 출근길도 달라집니다. 한곳에 차가 몰리면 새 길을 내고, 교통 흐름이 어떻게 바뀌는지 살펴보세요. 인구가 500명에 도달하면 지하철을 건설할 수 있습니다. 지하에 역을 놓고 선로를 연결해 시민들에게 새로운 출근길을 만들어 주세요.

name: Ruvano - Discover
description:
Ruvano is a local photo journal for doors, windows, and the details around them.

Add 1 to 5 photos of the same door or window, with an optional name, country or region, and note. Label an entry with your own style, shape, material, color, and detail tags; style labels are chosen by you, and Ruvano does not identify or verify architectural styles.

Search titles, countries or regions, and notes, or filter by style, shape, material, and color. One entry can belong to several collections, and a collection's cover comes from its most recently added entry.

Select exactly four entries to compose a titled collage. Ruvano renders a 2048 × 2560 JPEG with a fixed layout: a header label, your plate title, numbered photos, each entry's title and first style label, and a footer line. No brand watermark is added, and notes and country or region are not printed.

Your library is stored locally in encrypted form and is not uploaded to Ruvano's own servers. No account is required; there is no cloud sync or library restore, so keep your original photos. 

A clearly labeled sample collection is included and can be hidden in Settings. Privacy policy and Terms of use are linked in Settings.

name: Sacred Places Detective
description:
Chapels, churches, monasteries, mosques, synagogues, temples: everywhere you go, there are places that have shaped people for generations. With Sacred Places Detective you see them with fresh eyes. Places of worship around the world are waiting for you to visit them, photograph them from outside and collect them. On a hike, on a bike ride, during your lunch break or on holiday: every route becomes a small journey through architecture and history.

FROM OUTSIDE IS ENOUGH
You never need to go inside. A photo of the building from outside is all a find takes. That way you remain a guest and disturb no one.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a country and region: the map shows the known places of worship there.
• Go there and take a photo from outside: a find counts when your photo is taken on the spot, within 50 metres. The app checks your location to keep things fair.
• Note the features: tower or bell tower, dome, minaret, tower clock? You record what you see.
• Collect points: 10 points per find, plus bonuses for first discoverers.

ALL RELIGIONS ALIKE
Every place of worship counts the same, whether chapel or cathedral, mosque, synagogue or temple. No religion is favoured and there is no leaderboard by religion. The app shows buildings; it makes no statement about faith.

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• Four classes: chapel, place of worship, monastery and major place of worship.
• Collection album: all places of worship at a glance, filterable by "All", "Found" and "Missing".
• Leaderboard: compare yourself with friends and other players.
• Place of the day: one selected place of worship counts triple.
• Badges: keep a record of your discoveries.
• Lexicon: building types and terms from many religions, with sources.
• Feed and reactions: see other players' finds and react with emojis.
• Friends and teams: add friends, follow their finds and collect points together as a team.
• Profile with picture: choose an avatar or your own picture.
• Report a place: is one missing or no longer there? Report it right in the app.

RESPECT COMES FIRST
Places of worship are places of faith. Be quiet and respectful. Do not take photos during services, prayers, funerals or weddings. Do not photograph people. Leave cemeteries and graves in peace. Observe photo bans and house rules, and never enter closed-off areas or private property. Always watch out for traffic.

FAIR AND SAFE
• Sign-in by email: you get a link by email, after that you stay signed in.
• Faces and number plates are blurred on your phone before a photo is uploaded.
• You can report inappropriate content and block other players.
• You can delete your account and all your data yourself at any time in your profile.

WHO IS IT FOR?
Anyone aged 16 and over who likes to get out and about and is interested in architecture, history and cultures: hikers, cyclists, travellers, the curious. Your own beliefs play no part.

PIONEER DETECTIVE
Join now and become a Pioneer Detective – with perks that won’t be available later.

Sacred Places Detective is a project by benaapps from Winterthur, Switzerland, and is not affiliated with any religious community. The benaapps team welcomes feedback and ideas: info@benaapps.com

Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Salon.360
description:
Salon360 is the hiring platform built for the beauty industry. It connects beauty salons and beauty centers with skilled technicians – hair stylists, makeup artists, nail technicians, skin care specialists and more.

FOR SALONS
• Post a job in minutes: choose the category, salary range, working hours, days per week, required experience and deadline.
• See everyone who applied and open each applicant's full profile: bio, skills, education, work experience, certificates and available days.
• Invite applicants to a practical test and set the interview date and time.
• Rate applicants after the test so you remember who fits best.
• Track your hiring at a glance: shared jobs, applicants, employees contacted and candidates hired.
• Manage your salon profile, branches and photos.
• Edit, close or republish any job at any time.

FOR BEAUTY TECHNICIANS
• Browse available jobs from salons and beauty centers.
• See full job details before you apply: salary range, hours, working days, address and requirements.
• Apply with one tap.
• Build a professional profile with your skills, education, work experience, certificates and the days you are free for interviews.
• Get notified when a salon invites you to a test, and accept or decline right from the app.
• Follow every application: available, closed and approved.

MORE
• Arabic and English, switch any time.
• Push notifications for new updates, which you can turn off in Settings.
• Delete your account and data at any time from Settings.

Whether you are hiring for your salon or looking for your next job, Salon360 makes it simple.

name: Saloria: Website & Bookings
description:
Saloria is the app to run your salon from your phone: online bookings, calendar, client database and website, all connected. Made for hairdressers, barbers and beauticians.

ONLINE BOOKINGS
• Clients book 24/7 from your salon's page
• You get a notification and confirm or decline the request with a tap
• Today's calendar, new appointments and changes in seconds
• A link and QR code to share on social media and in the salon

YOUR SALON WEBSITE, FREE
• Your salon's website with services, opening hours, contacts and online booking
• Open it, share it and preview it from the app

CLIENT DATABASE AND CONTACTS
• All your clients in one place, with contacts, appointment history and consents
• Call, text, open WhatsApp or send an email with a tap
• Search and filter your clients in an instant

AI CONSULTATION FOR HAIRDRESSERS
• Guided haircut consultation on the salon's tablet, with face and hair analysis
• AI matching: look suggestions that suit the client's face
• An indicative AI preview of the new look
• Review consultations, the look plan and the PDF report from the app

NOTIFICATIONS
• New bookings, requests to confirm, changes and cancellations

Every change shows up on your computer right away. The app is in Italian and requires your salon's Saloria account.

name: Sandjar Puzzle
description:
Pour. Connect. Breathe.

Sandjar is a calm puzzle game made of colorful sand. Drop balls of sand into a glass jar and watch the grains flow, pile up and settle into every hollow. When one color connects the left wall to the right wall, the whole layer melts away — and the sand above slides down, sometimes into a satisfying chain.

ONE GESTURE
Drag to aim, release to drop. That's it. No rotation, no timer, no rush. The only pressure is the jar slowly filling up.

ONE LAST DROP
When sand rises over the dotted line, you get one last drop to bring it back down. Aim for the layer that can still connect both walls and watch the whole tray breathe again. Those "just made it!" moments are what keep you playing.

A NEW JAR EVERY DAY
• Daily Challenge: the same balls for everyone, one attempt per day.
• Share your result as a picture of your own sand-art jar, without spoilers.
• Keep your streak alive and climb today's leaderboard.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO
• 3 new missions every day.
• Earn XP, level up and unlock 9 jars: Dune, Lagoon, Sakura, Neon, Aurora and more.
• Chains, rescues and clean-jar bonuses for big scores.

MADE TO RELAX
• Soft, granular sounds and haptics (your silent switch is respected).
• Color-blind patterns available.
• Play offline. No account, no ads, no tracking — your progress stays on your device.
• iPhone and iPad.

Every jar you fill is a little piece of sand art. Pour the first ball and see.

name: Sarkar: Creator Command Center
description:
Sarkar is the command center for people who run a lot of things at once. It brings your owner dashboard, your daily briefs and alerts, your App Store apps and your personal tools into one fast, private app — with widgets, Siri and Control Center buttons.

**A briefing worth waking up for**
• Today composes a morning briefing on your device: weather, calendar, reminders, sleep and steps, tasks due, renewals coming up, sites that are down, apps waiting for review and your channel numbers
• Tap Play and it reads the briefing aloud in a natural British voice
• On devices with Apple Intelligence, get a one-line summary and ask questions about your own data — fully on device

**Every brief and alert, with push**
• Connect your owner dashboard and every brief, alert, published post and failure lands in Inbox as a notification
• Morning briefs open as a checklist of what needs you today
• Search, filter, pin, and have any message read aloud

**Your channels at a glance**
• Views gained, follower growth and posts across all your channels, for 24 hours up to all time
• Calendar of everything scheduled, with publish now, reschedule, edit and cancel
• Goals, notes, what's working and what isn't, per channel
• See what your automations are doing right now, and pause or resume them

**App Store Connect in your pocket**
• Review status, builds processing, ratings and the latest reviews for every app
• Reply to reviews and see daily units and proceeds
• Get notified the moment a status changes

**Tools you'd normally pay for — included**
• Vault: notes, photos and files encrypted on your device behind Face ID
• Scanner: scan documents to PDF with on-device text recognition
• Tasks: type "call the CA tomorrow 5pm" and it understands
• Subscriptions: every renewal, monthly and yearly totals, reminders before you're charged
• Focus: a Pomodoro timer on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Habits: streaks, a 12-week heatmap and tap-to-check widgets
• Uptime: watch your websites and get alerted when one goes down

**Private by design**
No account with us, no analytics, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device and goes only to the services you connect: your own dashboard, Apple and App Store Connect. Export everything or delete it all from Settings at any time.

The dashboard and Inbox features need a compatible owner dashboard server that you run yourself; everything else works on its own.

name: Save Your Chick: Push Up Game
description:
Push-ups are boring. Saving your chick is not.

Get stronger in a few minutes a day, with a game that makes you want to do just one more push-up.

Put your iPhone on the floor, get into position and start pushing. Every push-up slams down on the pixel monsters marching toward your little chick. Go too slow and they get through. Keep going and you crush them all.

HOW IT WORKS
• Place your phone flat on the floor and get into push-up position above it
• The camera sees your body and turns every push-up into a strike
• Crush the monsters before they reach your chick
• No equipment, no wearables, no account. Just you and your phone

GET STRONGER EVERY DAY
• Daily Challenge: one round a day, sized to you. Win it and tomorrow asks for one more
• Horde: endless waves when you want to see how far you can go
• Track your streak and watch your push-up count grow over time

MADE FOR REAL PEOPLE
• Starts at your level, whether that is 3 push-ups or 30
• Only a few minutes a day
• Big, easy-to-read screens you can see from the floor

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your camera image is processed on your iPhone and is never uploaded.

SUBSCRIPTION
Save Your Chick is free to download. Full access requires a subscription: yearly (with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers) or weekly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://qiwuez.github.io/pushup/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://qiwuez.github.io/pushup/privacy.html

name: Saydot
description:
Most teleprompters show you the words. Saydot shows you how to say them.

Paste a script, or describe an idea and let AI write one. Saydot marks it up like a voice coach would: which word to push, where to breathe, where your voice should lift for a question, and when a small gesture or a raised eyebrow makes the line land. Then it scrolls the words on a lane that rises and falls with your voice, so reading cold still sounds natural.

RECORD ONE BEAT AT A TIME
Big scripts are scary. Saydot splits yours into short beats and coaches you through each one before you record it: the feeling, the energy, what to rush and where to slow down. Retake any beat without starting over, then Saydot stitches them into one Reel.

BUILT FOR TALKING TO CAMERA
• Front-camera teleprompter that keeps your eyes near the lens
• Voice direction on every line: emphasis, pauses, pitch and pace
• Hand gesture and facial expression cues, with reference photos
• AI script writer for Reels, TikToks and Shorts, sized to your length
• Rehearse mode to practise without recording
• Every take kept, so you can pick the best one
• Export in 1080×1920 to Photos, then share to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook or WhatsApp

SAYDOT PRO
Your first 3 Reels are free, and practising is always free. Saydot Pro unlocks unlimited Reels, AI scripts and coaching.
• Yearly: $59.99 per year with a 3-day free trial
• Monthly: $12.99 per month
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://saydot-web.vercel.app/terms
Privacy: https://saydot-web.vercel.app/privacy

name: Scroll the Quran: With Meaning
description:
Scroll the Quran: With Meaning shows the Quran as a calm, full-screen feed: one ayah per screen, in mushaf order. Swipe up for the next ayah, hear it recited, and tap to understand it.

ONE AYAH AT A TIME
• The Arabic in the Uthmani script and font from Quran Foundation (Quran.com)
• The Saheeh International translation in English, or Tafheem-ul-Quran's translation in Urdu
• Every ayah recited by Mishary Rashid Alafasy as it comes on screen
• Turn on auto-scroll and the feed moves to the next ayah when the recitation ends

WITH MEANING
Tap any ayah to open three tools:
• Tafheem: Sayyid Abul A'la Maududi's Tafheem-ul-Quran, with every commentary note, in English (translated by Zafar Ishaq Ansari) and Urdu
• Surah intro: Tafheem's introduction to the surah, its background and its themes
• Word by word: the meaning of each Arabic word, in English or Urdu

Everything is shown exactly as published. Nothing is summarised, rewritten or generated by AI.

REMINDERS FOR HOW YOU FEEL
Up to five reminders a day, at times you choose: where you left off, or an ayah for moments when you feel worried, sad, alone, tired or grateful.

EASY ON THE EYES
• Five text sizes, up to large print, with A+ and A− right on the feed
• Pinch an ayah to look closely at its words
• Read with the translation, or the Arabic alone
• Light and dark themes

KEEP GOING
• Khatm progress that counts only the ayahs you actually read
• A daily streak you can share as a card
• Bookmarks and your five most recent places
• Jump to any surah, or drag along the edge to move through the ayahs of a surah

LISTEN ANYWHERE
• The recitation keeps playing with your screen off, with controls on the Lock Screen
• Download the recitation for one surah or the whole Quran (about 1.8 GB) and listen without internet
• The Quran text, translations and Tafheem are inside the app and work offline

SHARE AN AYAH
Share any ayah as a tall picture, or a short video with its recitation, made on your iPhone, for Stories, Status or a chat.

WIDGETS
• Home Screen: Ayah of the day (small, medium or large), Continue reading, and your Khatm ring
• Lock Screen: Ayah of the day, Continue reading, and Khatm and streak

SIMPLE ON PURPOSE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Free, with nothing locked. In English and Urdu.

We read every message: Settings → Send feedback, or support@scrollthequran.app.

name: Scupy - Golden Seam Puzzle
description:
Discover a quieter kind of puzzle with Scupy, a casual pottery experience inspired by kintsugi. Bring broken bowl pieces together, then trace golden seams to complete each restoration. Enjoy the simple satisfaction of transforming scattered fragments into a beautiful whole through gentle, hands-on interactions and a soothing approach to play.

### KEY FEATURES
- Piece together broken pottery bowls through engaging puzzle play.
- Trace golden seams to complete your pottery restorations.
- Enjoy a relaxing experience inspired by the art of kintsugi.

### EXPERTISE AREAS
- Pottery assembly puzzles
- Golden seam tracing
- Kintsugi-inspired restoration

Scupy combines the challenge of fitting fragments together with the pleasure of tracing their connections in gold. Each restored bowl offers a visible sense of completion, turning small actions into a rewarding creative process. Settle into a soothing pottery puzzle experience that celebrates imperfection, careful attention, and beauty in repair.

Download Scupy and discover the joy of bringing broken pieces together. Restore pottery, follow golden seams, and make a little room for a peaceful puzzle.

Note: Scupy is a digital puzzle experience inspired by kintsugi, not a guide to physical pottery repair.

name: Secret Santa - GiftGnome
description:
Run your Secret Santa in the room, on one phone. Pass it around and each person unwraps who they're buying for, with a photo or just an initial.

Someone not there? Send them a link of their own. It opens in their phone's browser, with no app to install.

No accounts and no sign-up. Keep your office, family and friends groups saved for next year.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add everyone in your group, with a photo or just their initial
• Mark who's here and who will get a link
• Tap Start Matching: nobody ever draws themselves
• Pass the phone: each person checks it's them, unwraps the present and sees who they're buying for
• Send each person who isn't there a link of their own, by WhatsApp, Messages or email

MADE FOR THE OFFICE AND THE FAMILY
• Several groups saved, so work, family and friends each get their own draw
• Forgotten who you're buying for? Tap your name to see it again
• Start again and redraw whenever you need to
• Photos stay on your phone, and nothing is stored on a server

PRIVACY
No account, and nothing that says who you are. GiftGnome counts anonymous app usage so we can make it better.

Made by Forgeyard Digital.

name: Secret Santa: Pass the Phone
description:
Secret Santa on one phone. No sign-ups, no emails, no app for anyone else to download.
