Add the names, pass the phone around the room, and let everyone break the seal on their own envelope. That's the whole thing.

ONE PHONE, WHOLE GROUP
• Paste a whole list of names at once. Commas, new lines, "and" all work.
• Any size: 3 friends or 50 coworkers.
• Pick a date and a budget in two taps.

A REVEAL WORTH PASSING AROUND
• Each person taps their name and gets a private screen.
• Pull the sealed envelope open to see who you're gifting.
• Seal it, pass it on. A seen name can't be opened again by the next person.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Nobody draws themselves.
• Keep couples apart so partners never match.
• Forgot who you got? The organizer can look it up with a long press.

COUNT DOWN TOGETHER
• See who's still to go, and how many days until the swap.
• Pin the countdown to your Lock Screen.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no server, no tracking. The names stay on this phone.

Perfect for family Christmas, office parties, friends, classrooms, roommates and Kris Kringle.

name: Sela Go
description:
Sela Go opens the restaurant or café in front of you with one tap.

Tap the table tag with your iPhone or scan its code, and everything is there:
• The menu, with your order brought to your table
• Join the Wi-Fi in one tap
• Call staff or ask for the bill
• A rewards card in Apple Wallet that collects stamps with every order
• Rate your visit; your rating goes straight to the manager

No download needed: the table tag opens Sela Go instantly on iPhone. Get the app to keep your favourite places and scan table codes with the camera.

Sela Go is made by Sela, the customer operations platform for restaurants and stores.

name: Selvage: Photo to Quilt
description:
Free to design. Pro unlocks the fabric list, cutting list, sew mode and the printable PDF.

Selvage turns a photo you love — a barn, a pet, a grandchild's drawing — into a quilt pattern you can actually sew. No design skills needed: your photo picks the colors, square by square.

FREE TO DESIGN
• Choose a photo or take one; position it in a quilt-shaped window.
• Pick a finished size from Crib to King, or set your own.
• Choose how much detail — Quick sew, Balanced or Fine detail — and see the pieces and sewing hours for your own photo before you start. Squares from ½" to 3", 2–15 fabrics.
• See it sewn: your pattern shown as a finished quilt, with quilting lines and binding, before you cut a single piece.
• Touch up single squares in a full-screen paint view you can zoom into, undo up to 150 steps, compare with the photo, and check your values in grayscale.
• Share a picture of your design — photo, quilt and size side by side — and ask friends before you buy fabric.
• Lock a color you already own, merge two fabrics, or recolor one — the numbers follow.

SELVAGE PRO — EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO SEW IT
• Fabric to buy, per fabric, rounded up to the eighth yard with waste included — a note when one fat quarter is enough, and a "Why this number?" explanation behind every amount.
• A cutting list that turns a thousand squares into a few hundred strip-cut pieces, with check-off rows.
• Sew mode: row-by-row piecing in sections of about 10", with cut sizes, progress that saves itself, and a screen that stays awake.
• A PDF pattern you can print or share: a cover showing your quilt sewn, shopping list, cutting instructions, a paged assembly map, row list in sections and finishing notes. US Letter or A4, with a large-print option.
• Backing figured for both seam directions (and as one piece of 108" wide backing), binding strips, and the right batting pack.

QUICK CALCULATORS, NO PRO NEEDED
Backing, binding, batting and bed-size calculators work without Pro — handy right at the shop.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Works offline. Your photos never leave your device.
• No accounts, no ads, ever.
• Every change saves automatically.
• Cancel the yearly plan anytime in Settings; PDFs you saved stay on your device.

Selvage Pro: $39.99 once, or $29.99 a year. Design first, see your pattern, then decide.

Measurements work in inches or centimeters, yards or meters. Assumptions (usable fabric width, waste, margins) are visible and changeable in Settings.

SELVAGE PRO PURCHASE DETAILS
• Selvage Pro Lifetime: a one-time purchase. Nothing renews.
• Selvage Pro Yearly: an auto-renewable subscription, billed once a year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current year; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the year ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
• Prices shown are in US dollars; the App Store shows the price for your country.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://alicanturfan.github.io/selvage-site/privacy.html

name: Sepiary: Family Photo Album
description:
Your family's photos, bound into a real album.

Sepiary gathers the photos already on your iPhone and lays them out month by month in an album that looks and feels like the one that used to sit on the shelf: a cloth or leather cover, brass corners, your family name in gold, and prints tucked onto each page by hand.

BUILT FOR IPHONE DUO
• Closed, the album's cover sits on the outer display.
• Start opening the phone and the cover lifts with it.
• Open it flat and the album lies open across the fold: two pages, side by side, like a real book.
• Stand it up half-open and the page sits above the fold with the controls below.
• Close it and the cover returns; open it again and you're back on the same page.

ON EVERY IPHONE
• Pages turn with a real page curl.
• Each month starts on a fresh page with its name at the top.
• Group by month or by year.
• Write scrapbook captions in handwriting under any photo.
• Choose an heirloom cover and give your album its title.
• Share any page as a picture.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos never leave your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Sepiary is free.

name: SetTimer
description:
Keep your workout moving with SetTimer, a free interval timer for iPhone and iPad.

Set the number of blocks and exercises per block, choose your exercise duration, and adjust rest between exercises and blocks. A ten-second countdown gives you time to get ready.

FOLLOW YOUR SESSION
See the current phase, remaining seconds, and your progress through each exercise and block. Sound cues count down the final seconds, signal the start of exercises and mark the end of your workout.

KEEP GOING WITH YOUR SCREEN LOCKED
Workout sound cues continue when your phone is locked or you switch to another app. If audio is interrupted, the session pauses so you can return to SetTimer and resume when ready.

SAVE YOUR TIMERS
Save up to three named timer configurations. Load a favourite, edit its settings or delete it when you no longer need it.

STAY IN CONTROL
Pause and resume your session, or cancel when you need to stop.

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
Switch languages using the globe menu on the setup screen.

Free, with no ads, in-app purchases or account required. Saved timers and your language preference are stored locally on your device.

Support: settimer.support@gmail.com

name: Sevina
description:
Turn a list of names into a saved result you can revisit.

Sevina is an iPhone workspace for name selection, pairing, and team organization. Add names manually, paste a list, or import a CSV or XLSX file. Choose a mode, review its settings, and start the reveal.

THREE WAYS TO ORGANIZE A LIST

Wheel draw
Select one to three entries, with or without replacement.

Pair bridge
Create pairs from the full list. When the list has an odd number of entries, choose one bye or make the final group contain three entries.

Team gate
Distribute the list across two to eight teams, limited by the number of available entries.

RESULTS THAT STAY USEFUL

- Save completed results in History
- Replay the same saved result without drawing again
- Rename and favorite important results
- Export a result image or CSV file
- Add optional voice commentary of up to 60 seconds

BUILT FOR REPEATED USE

- Save name lists for later activities
- Import CSV and XLSX files with a column preview
- Store up to 500 entries in a list
- Add an optional local guest name and profile picture
- Choose sound, reduced-motion, animation, and image-export preferences

Sevina stores its working data on the iPhone. No online account is required. Camera, Photos, and microphone access are requested only when you choose the related optional feature.

name: Shark Pass
description:
Shark Pass is the official app for Shark Fitness Club.

• Digital membership card
• Scan to enter the gym
• Track visits and progress
• Workout plans and Tabata
• Schedule and club messages

Everything you need for training — in one place.

name: ShetiSathi
description:
ShetiSathi हे शेतकरी, शेत व्यवस्थापक आणि सहकारी संस्थांसाठी शेतातील कामांचे नियोजन व नोंदी ठेवणारे अॅप आहे. भाताची रोपवाटिका, टप्प्याटप्प्याने लागवड आणि पुढील पीक व्यवस्थापनाची कामे शेत, हंगाम व बॅचनुसार एकत्र सांभाळा.

• **अंतिम तारखेनुसार नियोजन करा.** क्षेत्रफळ, रोपे व साहित्य पोहोचण्याची वेळ, कामांचा क्रम आणि उपलब्ध मनुष्यबळ नोंदवा. निश्चित केलेल्या क्षमतेनुसार काम वाटा आणि उर्वरित क्षेत्रासाठी पुढील व्यवस्था ठरवा.

• **माणसे आणि यंत्रांचा समन्वय साधा.** एकाच व्यक्तीची, यंत्राची किंवा शेताची वेळ एकमेकांवर येत असल्यास तपासा. वेळापत्रक बदलण्यापूर्वी पुढील कामांवरील आणि संबंधित बॅचवरील परिणाम पाहा.

• **प्रत्यक्ष कामाची प्रगती नोंदवा.** सुरुवातीची नमुना तपासणी, पूर्ण झालेले क्षेत्र, कामाची वेळ, साहित्याचा वापर, फोटो आणि थांबण्याची कारणे जतन करा. त्रुटी आढळल्यास सुधारणा व पुनर्तपासणीची नोंद ठेवा.

• **हवामान आणि शेतस्थिती तपासा.** अंदाज, प्रत्यक्ष निरीक्षणे आणि उपकरणांच्या नोंदी स्रोत व वेळेसह पाहा. काम सुरू करण्यापूर्वी जबाबदार व्यक्ती जमिनीची स्थिती, साचलेले पाणी, प्रवेशमार्ग आणि आवश्यक पूर्वअटी तपासून पुष्टी करू शकते.

• **खर्च आणि उत्पादनाच्या अंदाजाचा आढावा घ्या.** मजुरी, यंत्रभाडे, इंधन व साहित्याचा खर्च स्वतंत्रपणे नोंदवा. नमुना क्षेत्रातील मोजमापे, वजन आणि आर्द्रतेच्या आधारे उत्पादनाचा किमान व कमाल अंदाज आणि गणनेचा आधार पाहा.

इंटरनेट नसतानाही मसुदे आणि कामाच्या नोंदी जतन करा. जुन्या व सुधारित योजनांचा इतिहास पाहा आणि शेअर करण्यापूर्वी माहितीचे पूर्वावलोकन करा. प्रगती, विलंब, खर्च, तपासणी आणि मूळ मोजमापांच्या नोंदी CSV स्वरूपात निर्यात करा.

name: ShipConflicts
description:
Steuere dein blaues Segelschiff übers Meer, nimm Insel um Insel ein und vertreibe die rote Flotte. Auf jeder eroberten Insel wachsen neue Piraten heran. Wie du sie einsetzt, entscheidest du.

INSELN EINNEHMEN
Fahre an eine freie Insel, und 5 Mann gehen an Land. An eigenen Inseln lädst du deine Männer wieder an Bord. Legst du an einer roten Insel an, greifen sie an: Jeder Angreifer nimmt einen Verteidiger mit. Ist der letzte gefallen, wird die Insel neutral, und mit 5 Mann von deinem Schiff gehört sie dir.

BAUEN UND AUSBAUEN
• Bis zu 7 Kanonen pro Insel, die sich zum nächsten Gegner drehen und von selbst feuern
• Stege und bis zu 5 Schiffe pro Insel, die selbstständig segeln und angreifen
• Seilrutschen, über die deine Männer laufend von Insel zu Insel rutschen
• Reichweiten-Upgrades bis zur vierfachen Reichweite
• Inselausbau in zwei Stufen: Platz für 400, dann 600 Mann und bis zu doppelt so viele neue Männer
• Automatik: Eine Insel auf „Auto“ baut sich von selbst aus

LEVEL FÜR LEVEL MEHR MÖGLICHKEITEN
In Level 1 gibt es nur Kanonen. Danach kommt Schritt für Schritt mehr dazu: Stege und Schiffe, Seilrutschen, größere Reichweite, Inselausbau und Automatik. Die Levelkarte zeigt, was in welchem Level neu ist.

EIN GEGNER NACH DENSELBEN REGELN
Die rote Flotte erobert Inseln und baut nach denselben Regeln wie du. Beschieße ihre Inseln: Zuerst fallen Steg und Kanonen, dann die Männer.

12 LEVELS
Vom kleinen Meer mit 2 × 2 Quadranten bis zur großen Karte mit 6 × 6 Quadranten. Eine Hilfe in der App erklärt jedes Feature mit einer kurzen Animation.

BESTENLISTE
Sieh, wie gut du weltweit und in deinem Land bist: nach höchstem Level, versenkten Schiffen und eroberten Inseln, ohne Namen.

EINFACH SPIELEN
Steuern mit dem Knubbel oder einfach aufs Meer tippen. Keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe, kein Konto. Spielbar auch ohne Internetverbindung, nur die Bestenliste braucht eine. In 44 Sprachen, für iPhone und iPad.

Website: https://kainzner.net/shipconflicts.html
Datenschutz: https://kainzner.net/shipconflicts-datenschutz.html
AGB: https://kainzner.net/shipconflicts-agb.html

name: Shoirona
description:
Shoirona — she'riyat uchun yaratilgan sokin va zamonaviy makon. Bu yerda so'z birinchi o'rinda turadi: ortiqcha shovqin ham, chalg'ituvchi bezaklar ham yo'q.

O'QING
• Bosh sahifada eng yangi she'rlar
• Kashf etish bo'limida tahririyat tanlovi va mavzular bo'yicha she'rlar
• Meros: mumtoz va taniqli shoirlarning asarlari, manbasi ko'rsatilgan holda
• She'r, shoir va Meros asarlari bo'yicha qidiruv
• O'qish uchun hisob shart emas

YOZING
• Qoralamalar avtomatik saqlanadi
• She'rni o'z shaklida nashr qiling: qatorlar, bandlar va bo'shliqlar aynan siz yozgandek qoladi
• Mavzular bilan she'ringizni o'quvchilarga yaqinlashtiring

SAQLANG
• Yoqqan she'rlarni Kutubxonangizga saqlang va istalgan payt qayta o'qing

SIZ UCHUN QULAY
• Telefon raqami orqali kirish: tasdiqlash kodi Telegram orqali keladi
• Yoki elektron pochta va parol bilan
• Kunduzgi va tungi rejim
• O'zbek, rus va ingliz tillarida interfeys

XAVFSIZ HAMJAMIYAT
• Nomaqbul she'r haqida shikoyat qilish
• Istalgan muallifni bloklash
• Shikoyatlar Shoirona jamoasi tomonidan ko'rib chiqiladi
• Hisobingizni ilovaning o'zidan istalgan payt o'chirishingiz mumkin

Shoirona — so'zga nafas beradigan joy.

name: Shotmera: Timestamp Camera
description:
Proof, stamped the moment you shoot.

Shotmera puts the date, time, place and weather on your photo the instant you take it, in a clean stamp you'll actually want to share. Log today's workout, meal, study session or trip in one shot and watch your record grow.

■ Captured as it happened
• Date, time, place and weather come from the moment you press the shutter
• Date, time and place can't be edited in the app, so every photo stays as it was taken
• If your device clock differs from network time, the stamp says so

■ Style it like your Lock Screen
• 8 styles including Poster, Stack and Wide
• Depth effect: the big time slips behind people and objects
• Emphasize weather, place or a D-day instead of the time
• 8 fonts, a full color picker and Liquid text
• Swipe sideways to change style, up and down to move the stamp

■ A record that builds up
• Separate projects for workouts, meals, study and more
• Day count, streaks, calendar and activity grid at a glance
• Set a target date per project and the stamp shows "Exam D-12"
• Compare your first photo with today's
• Turn your photos into a 20-second recap video

■ Made to be easy
• Cover faces with emoji after shooting, and uncover anyone you like
• 1:1 ratio, flip, mirrored front camera
• Restyle the stamp on photos you've already taken
• Widgets, Shortcuts and the Action button for instant capture
• Face ID project lock and iCloud sync

■ No ads. No subscription.
Shooting, every design option, depth effect, face covering, recap videos, 3 projects, calendar and stats, comparison, D-day and widgets are all free.
Pro is a one-time purchase: remove the small app logo from your photos or replace it with your own name or logo, and create unlimited projects.
Try Pro free for 14 days.

Your photos are saved to your own photo library and stay there even if you delete the app.

name: Shotpot Capture
description:
Shotpot Capture is the high-speed camera companion for Shotpot Field. It's for golfers who have been invited to a Shotpot Field.

HOW IT WORKS
• In Shotpot Field, tap High-speed capture. You get a secure, short-lived link for one shot.
• The link opens Shotpot Capture. There's no separate account to sign in to.
• Set the phone down, frame the ball and its early flight, and record. Recording stops when you tap, or on its own after 15 seconds (or 30 if you choose).
• Keep the app open while the shot uploads to your Field. The original stays on your phone until the Field confirms it has been saved.
• Tap Watch the shot to open the replay in your browser.

CAPTURE
High-speed modes depend on your iPhone model. When your phone supports it, Shotpot Capture asks for 1080p at 240 frames per second. Other modes, such as 120 or 60, are there to choose. If a mode isn't available, the app says so. It never switches to a different one on its own. A Details panel shows what the camera actually reported for each take.

WHAT IT ISN'T
Shotpot Capture records video. It is not a launch monitor and doesn't promise ball speed, spin, carry or any other measurement.

PRIVACY
Uses the camera only. No microphone, no location, no Photos library access. No ads and no tracking. Recordings and capture details go to your Shotpot Field's private storage, where your field's team can review them.

REQUIREMENTS
• An invitation to a Shotpot Field
• An iPhone with a rear camera
• An internet connection to send shots

name: SHOVEYARD
description:
Grab the shovel, Mara — the dead are in the yard!

SHOVEYARD is a comic-book zombie puzzle game. Each yard is a grid maze crawling with zombies. Walk Mara into a sliding block to shove it — it slides until it hits something, and anything it hits gets squashed. Clear every zombie to clear the yard.

150 YARDS TO CLEAR
• 150 hand-built yards, from the first backyard to the final showdown
• A unique boss every tenth yard — 15 bosses with their own tricks
• Puzzles that start gentle and build to brain-benders

SPECIAL BLOCKS
• CRYO blocks freeze whatever they touch
• BLAST blocks explode and take out everything nearby
• MELT blocks dissolve through the horde
• Plain ice blocks slide, bounce and pin zombies against the walls

TOOLS IN THE SHED
• KICK a block from a distance when you can't reach it
• FREEZE the whole yard for a moment to set up the perfect shove
• A smooth on-screen joystick keeps Mara moving where you point

MADE FOR QUICK ROUNDS
• Every yard is a bite-sized puzzle you can finish in a minute or two
• No account, no sign-up — your progress is saved on your device
• Bold comic-book 3D art, a punchy soundtrack and squishy sound effects

SHOVEYARD is free to play. A short ad plays after a cleared yard. You can remove the ads with a 10-Day Ad-Free Pass or a one-time permanent Remove Ads purchase.

name: SignaFold
description:
SignaFold is an offline engineering workstation designed for independent bookbinders, printmakers, editorial designers, and small-press publishers. It solves the critical mathematical challenges of physical bookbinding: inner-leaf creep displacement, page imposition order, sewing station coordinates, and paper grain direction alignment.

KEY CAPABILITIES

1. CREEP & PROGRESSIVE SHINGLING
• Accurately calculates inner leaf extrusion caused by signature bulk and paper weight (GSM).
• Generates micro-inch progressive margin inset steps to prevent text trimming during final edge shearing.
• Projects total spine thickness and recommended spine board width based on binding swell factors.

2. SIGNATURE IMPOSITION MAPPING
• Visualizes physical print plate layouts for standard right-angle folio folds (4P, 8P, 16P, 32P).
• Displays outer and inner spreads, valley and mountain fold lines, and accompanied plate page numbers.
• Eliminates manual calculation errors in multi-signature section assembly.

3. PUNCHING & STITCH JIG
• Configures equidistant or paired sewing stations for Smyth sewn, Coptic, and stab binding styles.
• Visualizes a 1:1 precision ruler with head and tail kettle stitch offsets.
• Computes exact required linen or waxed thread consumption including knot slack factors.

4. PARENT SHEET YIELD & GRAIN DYNAMICS
• Evaluates cutting grids against standard parent sheet stocks (RA0, B1, and custom dimensions).
• Analyzes fiber grain direction relative to the spine fold to eliminate paper warping, stiff page turns, and hinge cracking.
• Provides leaf yield counts and material scrap efficiency percentages.

5. PRODUCTION SPEC LEDGER & OFFLINE EXPORT
• Archive multiple book project parameters with instant configuration recall.
• Generates comprehensive production spec sheets ready for bindery workshop execution.
• Native text and data export without requiring cloud accounts or internet connectivity.

PRIVACY & WORKFLOW INTEGRITY
SignaFold is completely self-contained. All calculations, dimensions, and saved book ledgers reside strictly on your device. No user tracking, no accounts required, and zero network dependency.

name: Silai Khata
description:
Silai Khata is the daily order book made for tailors, boutiques and stitching shops — a clean register that keeps every order, every measurement and every rupee in one place, working entirely on your phone.

No internet. No account. No monthly fee. Open the app and start writing, the way you would open a diary — except this diary calculates balances, remembers every naap, prints bills and never loses a page.

ONE JOURNAL, FIVE CHAPTERS
Everything lives in a single, beautifully organised journal: Today, Ledger, Clients, Figures and Colophon. Tap the masthead for the Index and jump to any chapter in one touch. No tangle of menus — just turn the page.

ORDERS, START TO FINISH
• File an order in seconds: garment, quantity, price, advance, fabric and delivery date
• Follow every piece through five stages — New, Cutting, Stitching, Ready, Delivered
• Today shows what is on the hook for the next seven days, with late work flagged clearly
• The date docket lays out upcoming deliveries day by day, so no promised date surprises you
• Every order gets its own bill number; settled work stays on file, searchable by client, garment or bill

MEASUREMENTS (NAAP), KEPT FOR GOOD
• Save each client's naap once — shirt, pant, kurta, blouse, dress, lehenga, suit and more
• Ready-made measurement templates for every garment, plus your own custom fields
• On every repeat order, the right naap is already on file — no more hunting through old diaries
• Fitting preferences and notes stay pinned to the client's file

PAYMENTS, BILLS & DUES
• Record advances and part payments; the balance works itself out, order by order
• Share a clean, branded PDF bill through any messaging app — your shop name on top
• One tap composes a polite dues-reminder note for any client who still owes you
• Set your rate card once and new orders fill in your usual stitching price automatically

KHARCHA & PROFIT
• Note shop expenses in seconds: thread, fabric, rent, electricity, karigar and more
• See each month's kharcha beside each month's collection — and the real profit between them

FIGURES & REPORTS
• A clear collection chart across the last six months
• Orders by stage, popular garments, and outstanding balances client by client
• Share a one-page PDF month report covering collection, kharcha, profit and dues — ready for your records or your accountant

REMINDERS & PEACE OF MIND
• Optional reminder at 9 AM on every delivery day, so nothing goes out late
• Optional Face ID lock keeps your register sealed from curious eyes
• Export your entire book to a single backup file and restore it on a new iPhone in seconds
• Export all orders to CSV for Excel or Numbers whenever you need them

MADE TO BE USED ALL DAY
• A calm, editorial design that reads like a well-set page — in full light and dark mode
• Big serif numerals, clear rules and generous type, easy on tired eyes after a long day at the machine
• Quick entry everywhere: a Done bar above every number pad, search across clients, garments and bill numbers

YOURS, COMPLETELY
Silai Khata collects nothing. There is no server, no analytics, no advertising, no subscription and no login — your clients' details and your business figures stay on your phone, where they belong. Delete the app and the data goes with it; keep a backup and it is yours forever.

Whether you run a one-chair silai shop, a ladies' boutique with heavy bridal work, or a busy unit with karigars, Silai Khata replaces the torn diary with a register that respects your craft: quick to write in, beautiful to read, and always exactly where you left it.

Stitch. File. Deliver. Repeat.

name: Silent Companion
description:
Silent Companion helps you understand the people you meet in a foreign country. Put your iPhone on the table, tap Listen and their words appear as subtitles: the translation in large type, the original underneath.

HOW IT WORKS
• Speech is recognized right on your iPhone. The sound never leaves the phone and is never stored.
• Each finished sentence is translated by DeepL.
• With Voice in ears, the translation is read quietly into your headphones, for example AirPods.
• Read aloud: the translation is spoken through the iPhone speaker, no headphones needed. It also helps people with low vision or blindness, and the app works with VoiceOver.
• After you tap Stop, the subtitles stay on screen. If you like, save the conversation as text, for example in Notes. The app itself stores nothing.

WHERE IT HELPS
• at a restaurant, café or shop on holiday,
• at a family party where people speak a language you only partly know,
• on a city tour, at a market or at a talk.

LANGUAGES
It hears more than 25 languages, for example Spanish, Italian, French, German, English, Greek, Turkish, Thai, Vietnamese, Japanese or Chinese. The exact list depends on your iPhone. Subtitles can be in English, Slovak, Czech, German, Polish, Hungarian, French, Ukrainian, Chinese, Thai or Vietnamese, and the app itself speaks all of these languages too.

WHAT YOU NEED
• an iPhone with iOS 26 or later,
• your own free DeepL API Free key (500,000 characters a month). Get it at deepl.com; DeepL verifies a payment card when you sign up. Paste it in the app's Settings with one tap and the app shows how much of the monthly limit is left,
• internet for translation. Without it, subtitles stay in the original language and are translated once you are back online,
• the spoken language downloaded in advance, ideally over Wi-Fi before you travel.

TIPS
• The noise filter helps in busy places.
• The microphone can be the iPhone's or your headphones'.
• During a phone call, listening pauses and then continues.

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Only the text of a finished sentence is sent for translation, straight to DeepL under your own key. A transcript exists only if you save one yourself. Details are in the privacy policy.

Silent Companion is not a replacement for an interpreter. Machine translation can be wrong, especially in noise or with strong dialects.

name: SimBoss
description:
SimBoss is a wireless remote control for GSPro, the golf simulator that runs on your Windows PC. Keep your phone or tablet in the hitting bay and drive GSPro without walking back to the keyboard and mouse.

Connects automatically over your WiFi — open the app and it finds your PC on the local network. No cables, no typing in addresses (a manual option is there if you need it).

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Control GSPro's on-screen buttons from a clean, high-contrast layout built for a hitting bay
- Use a trackpad on your phone to move and click in GSPro
- Give voice commands hands-free
- Keep the screen awake while you play
- It remembers your PC and opens straight to the controls next time

SimBoss talks only to your own PC on your own network. It doesn't collect your data, require an account, or need an internet connection.

You'll need a Windows PC running GSPro and the free SimBoss PC companion app on the same WiFi network.

name: SinceWell: Days Since Tracker
description:
See how many days it’s been since you changed the air filter, watered a plant, or backed up your laptop. SinceWell is a quiet, offline tracker for tasks you do every so often.

Add something you want to remember, log it when it’s done, and see how long it’s been. Set a target interval to see what’s due at a glance.

• Log completions in one tap and undo accidental taps.
• Add earlier dates and notes to keep an accurate history.
• Find tasks with categories and search.
• Export and restore your records with portable text backups.
• Choose light, dark, or system appearance.

Your task records stay on your device.

Start with a free seven-day trial. Continued task tracking requires a one-time in-app purchase. There’s no automatic charge.

name: Sing It Back: Reverse Singing
description:
Can you sing it backwards? Sing It Back is the reverse singing challenge, made simple and fair.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Record: sing or say a short line.
2. Listen backwards: we flip your clip. It sounds strange!
3. Sing it back: copy the backwards sound as well as you can.
4. The reveal: we flip your attempt forwards again. Sometimes it sounds like the original. Usually it sounds hilarious.

PRACTISE AT YOUR OWN SPEED
- Loop the backwards clip.
- Slow it down to 0.5× or 0.75×.
- Change the pitch to match your voice.
- Play the original once more as a hint.

SHARE THE FUN
- Make a vertical video of all 4 steps, with an animated waveform.
- Or share the audio only.
- Send it to your friends, or post it to your favourite video app.

KEEP YOUR BEST ATTEMPTS
Every challenge saves to your Library. Play the 4 clips one by one, or all in order. Rename and delete them at any time.

FAIR AND PRIVATE
- No ads. Ever.
- 3 free challenges every day.
- Your recordings stay on your iPhone. We never upload them.
- No account. No tracking.

SING IT BACK PRO
Get unlimited challenges and remove the small "Sing It Back" tag from your videos.
- Yearly: $24.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial.
- Weekly: $3.99 per week.
Prices are in US dollars and can be different in your country.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. If you cancel during the free trial, you are not charged.

Terms of Use: https://top-banana-apps.com/singitback/terms
Privacy Policy: https://top-banana-apps.com/singitback/privacy

name: SiteTempo FM
description:
SiteTempo FM connects office teams, engineers and clients around shared building and maintenance records.

FOR ENGINEERS
View assigned jobs and building details, record a named pre-job risk assessment, capture job and asset photographs, complete checklists and visit notes, and submit work for office review.

OR OFFICE TEAMS
Raise jobs, allocate engineers and review submissions before issuing numbered job cards. The connected office web workspace also provides building PPM planning, asset registers, quotation preparation, project budgets, captured costs, rates and variation approvals.

FOR CLIENTS
Report faults, follow work for authorised buildings, review quotes, approve or decline quoted work, and access issued job-card PDFs. An approved quote creates a job awaiting office allocation.

SHARED RECORDS, INDIVIDUAL ACCESS
Each person uses an individual account linked to their company. Company roles and building permissions control which records they can access. Saved operations have an attributed audit history and server timestamps.

WORK RECORDS AND EVIDENCE
Keep risk assessments, job results, photographs, labour time and materials with the relevant work record. Asset photographs help identify plant and retain identification details.

An internet connection is required for shared records and account actions. Protected device job drafts are separate from confirmed server records. The current native app records engineer location when the relevant shift or job controls are used; it does not continuously track in the background.

A SiteTempo company account and authorised membership are required. Your company administrator controls your role and building access.

name: SlimFile Atlas: Compress Video
description:
SlimFile Atlas makes your videos smaller so they take up less space and are easier to send, without uploading them anywhere.

Pick one video or a whole batch, tap Compress, and save the smaller copies to Photos or share them. Everything happens on your iPhone using its built-in hardware video encoder.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your videos never leave your phone
• No account, no sign-up
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics

SMART COMPRESSION
• Reads each video's resolution, frame rate and bitrate and picks a sensible target for it
• 4K videos are scaled to 1080p, which still looks sharp on any phone screen
• Shows the expected size before you start
• If a video is already compact, your original is kept and nothing is wasted

TWO SIMPLE CHOICES
• Smaller: HEVC, the smallest files. Keeps HDR colors.
• Compatible: H.264, plays on almost any device or website.

BUILT FOR BATCHES
• Compress many videos in one go with overall progress and time left
• On iOS 26 and later, compression keeps going if you leave the app
• Your originals are never changed or deleted

See how much space you've saved over time on the home screen.

name: SneRute
description:
SneRute hjælper dig med at forberede din cykelpendling gennem den danske vinter. Del din sædvanlige rute op, og markér broer, skygge, nedkørsler og skarpe sving. Indtast temperatur, nedbør og vejforhold inden afgang, så du kan se et skøn over risikoen for sort is, de vigtigste risikofaktorer og en tjekliste til udstyret. Gem også en alternativ metroplan, som vises ved høj risiko.

Notér is, saltning, snerydning og eventuelle fald. Når lignende forhold vender tilbage, kan SneRute minde dig om steder, hvor du tidligere har registreret is. Pigdækskalenderen foreslår datoer ud fra den valgte bys frostklima og giver plads til dine faktiske skiftedatoer og lokale påmindelser. Kernefunktionerne kræver ikke kontoregistrering.Risiko og datoer er skøn, som bør vurderes sammen med de aktuelle vejforhold.

name: SnoozeWarden: Snooze Detox
description:
Love "just five more minutes"? So do we. The problem is when five minutes becomes an hour.

SnoozeWarden is an alarm for chronic snoozers. It doesn't ban snoozing — it puts it on a budget and guarantees you're up on time.

SET A DEADLINE, NOT JUST AN ALARM
Ring at 7:00, be up by 7:30. You can snooze inside that window. Once the deadline hits, Warden Mode starts: no more snoozing, the alarm keeps coming back until you finish your mission.

SNOOZE DETOX
Every snooze costs a quick task — a math problem or a few shakes — so it's a decision, not a reflex. As your mornings improve, your snooze budget shrinks: Rookie, Trainee, Disciplined, Warden.

NO EASY WAY OUT
• Stop the alarm from the lock screen? It rings again a minute later.
• Missions to prove you're awake: Math, Typing, Shake, Barcode.
• Wake-up check: 5 minutes after your mission, confirm you're still up.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Streaks, streak freezes for the occasional bad morning, and a morning report that shows exactly how you did.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Rings in Silent mode and Focus using Apple's alarm system. Requires iOS 26.

name: Snow Pop: Maths Magic
description:
Snow Pop: Maths Magic turns maths into snowy magic for young children, with Isla the snow princess, Snowbie the snowman and Bramble the reindeer.

Every right answer makes sparkles, and children spend their sparkles building their very own ice palace: towers, lanterns, a frozen fountain, a skating pond, a carousel and more.

SEVEN GAMES, SIX LEVELS EACH
• Snowflakes: catch and count falling snowflakes, quick-look counting, tens and ones up to 100
• Snowman: give Snowbie his buttons, add groups, make 10, doubles, two-digit adding
• Carrots: Bramble munches carrots for take-away, more and fewer, fact families
• River Hop: hop Isla across the frozen river on a number line, count on and back, skip counting
• Patterns: patterns, shapes, halves and quarters in the ice palace hall
• Sleds: equal groups and arrays of snowballs, then the 2, 5 and 10 times tables and beyond
• Sharing: share presents fairly between sleighs, grouping, then division facts

PICTURES FIRST
Multiplication and division start as pictures (equal groups, arrays, fair sharing). The times and divide signs only appear at level 5, once the idea makes sense. Each game moves up gently after a run of right answers and steps back quietly after tricky ones.

KIND AND PATIENT
No timers and no failing. A wrong answer gets a gentle "Nearly! Let's try again", then "Let's work it out together", and the answer is counted out with your child. Every question is spoken, so children don't need to read.

TEACH TOGETHER, FOR GROWN-UPS
Ten short picture lessons you go through with your child at your own pace: counting on, make 10, take away, equal groups, arrays, sharing, grouping, halves and quarters, counting in 2s, 5s and 10s, and tens and ones.

FOR FAMILIES
• Up to four children, each with their own levels and palace
• Progress for every game, and you can set any level
• Play-time limit, music and sound switches
• Grown-ups area behind a simple question

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no tracking, and no internet needed. Names and progress stay on the device.

Isla, Snowbie and Bramble are original characters.

name: Snowbert
description:
Big boots. Small plan. Huge heart.

Snowbert, the clumsiest elf at the North Pole, is supposed to help Santa deliver the presents – and manages to fall into every snowdrift on the way. Cheeky goblins steal parcels, snowmen block the path, and the sleigh won't wait. Good thing you're here!

THE ADVENT CALENDAR YOU CAN PLAY
From December 1 to 24, a new door opens every day with its own adventure: intruders in the ice castle, chaos in the gift warehouse, rush hour in the elves' workshop, a starlit sleigh ride with Rudi, a power cut and the family sledding race. Every door has several locations, its own punchline and ends with a little Christmas movie. Each door you finish hangs a keepsake bauble on your tree. Missed doors stay open – and after Christmas the whole calendar is yours to play.

CHRISTMAS EVE: THE BIG FINALE
On December 24 the longest adventure awaits: Christmas Eve with the Lichterloh family. Thousands of lights on the roof, a cat, a dog and a dad who counts fairy lights in his sleep. Snowbert and Santa have to deliver the presents very quietly – or someone wakes up. In the end Snowbert flips the main switch and the whole house lights up.

SIX WINTER WORLDS
The enchanted Christmas forest, the snowy Christmas village, the wild ski slope, the great reindeer air show, the frozen Christmas lake and the goblin king's fortress: 144 scenes, each world with its own way to play, a grand finale and a closing movie.

SO SIMPLE EVERYONE CAN PLAY
Snowbert runs by himself. Swipe to change lanes, tap to throw a snowball, hold to roll a giant snowball. Hit, and the goblin takes a snow bath. Miss, and Snowbert lands nose-first in the snow – and gets up laughing. Three difficulty levels, help that never costs stars, and pause any time.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• No account, no chat, no ads, no subscription
• Works completely offline – even on the drive to Grandma's
• Purchases, sharing and Game Center only behind a parental gate
• No camera, no microphone, no tracking
• Original Christmas music for every world

The enchanted Christmas forest with 24 scenes and the first Advent door are ready to play right away. Five more worlds and the Advent pack with all 24 doors are available as one-time in-app purchases – with Family Sharing.

GAME CENTER (OPTIONAL)
Three leaderboards and five achievements – only if you choose to connect.

Snowbert – Save Christmas! A small adventure with a big Christmas heart. For iPhone and iPad.

name: So'z ustasi: so'z o'yini
description:
So'z o'yini o'zbek tilida - So'z ustasi! Harflarni barmog'ingiz bilan ulang, yashirin so'zlarni toping va krossvordni to'ldiring, har bir topilgan so'zning ma'nosini esa o'yin ichidagi izohli lug'atda o'qing. Oddiy boshlanadi, lekin har bosqichda qiziqroq bo'lib boradi!

O'YIN QANDAY O'YNALADI
- Aylanadagi harflarni ketma-ket ulab so'z tuzing.
- Topilgan so'z krossvorddagi o'z joyiga tushadi.
- Barcha so'zlarni topsangiz - bosqich yakunlandi!
- Krossvordda yo'q, lekin to'g'ri so'zlar uchun bonus tanga olasiz.

NIMA UCHUN SO'Z USTASI?
- 2500 ta bosqich: oson so'zlardan uzun va qiyin so'zlargacha. Har bir bosqich tekshirilgan.
- Izohli lug'at: 18 000 dan ortiq so'zning ma'nosi va misollari, internetsiz. "Mening lug'atim"da siz topgan barcha so'zlar jamlanadi.
- Kunlik o'yin: har kuni yangi jumboq va qo'shimcha tangalar. Kunlik seriyangizni uzmang!
- Haftalik turnir: har bir topilgan so'z ochko beradi, uzun so'z - ko'proq. Boshqa o'yinchilar bilan bellashing!
- Statistika va yutuqlar: topilgan so'zlar, eng uzun so'z, kunlik seriya va mukofotlar.
- Uchta yozuv: lotin, kirill va yangi lotin alifbosi (ö, ğ, ş, ç).
- Internetsiz o'ynash mumkin - yo'lda, navbatda, istalgan joyda.
- Yordamchilar: harf ochish, raketa, barmoq va boshqa yordamchilar qiyin so'zlarda yordam beradi.
- Sovg'alar, sehrli sandiqcha va baxtli g'ildirak. Video ko'rib tangalarni 2 baravar oling.
- Progress bulutda saqlanadi - yangi telefonda ham davom ettirasiz.
- O'zbekistonning go'zal manzaralari fonida o'ynaysiz.

MIYANI CHARXLASH UCHUN
So'z o'yinlari lug'at boyligini oshiradi, diqqat va xotirani mashq qildiradi, izohli lug'at esa notanish so'zlarning ma'nosini o'rgatadi. Kuniga bir necha daqiqa - va siz haqiqiy so'z ustasiga aylanasiz! O'yin bolalar va kattalar, o'quvchilar va ota-onalar uchun birdek qiziqarli.

Agar sizga krossvord, scrabble, so'z qidirish, anagramma yoki mantiqiy o'yinlar yoqsa - So'z ustasi aynan siz uchun.

СЎЗ ЎЙИНИ ЎЗБЕК ТИЛИДА
Сўз устаси - ҳарфларни улаб сўз топиш ва кроссвордни тўлдириш ўйини. 2500 та босқич, ўзбек тилининг изоҳли луғати, ҳар куни янги кунлик жумбоқ ва ҳафталик турнир. Кирилл, лотин ва янги лотин алифбосида ўйнаш мумкин. Интернетсиз ишлайди ва ҳар қандай ёшдагилар учун мос.

Taklif va savollar bo'lsa, o'yin menyusidagi "Biz bilan bog'laning" orqali yozing. Fikringiz biz uchun muhim!

name: Sofia Content
description:
Sofia Content — приложение сервиса Sofia Content для экспертов и авторов, которые ведут блог.

Наставник знакомится с тобой, разбирается в нише и предлагает темы. Ты выбираешь формат, а сервис находит историю, пишет текст и собирает карусель из 10–15 слайдов 1080×1350 с картинками.

Что внутри:
• Наставник: чат текстом или голосом, темы под нишу, стратегия блога.
• Четыре формата: полезные советы, личная история, придуманная история, история героя.
• Сборка в несколько шагов: формат, тема, детали. Прогресс виден на экране блокировки и в Dynamic Island.
• Редактор слайдов: текст, шрифт, цвета, фото, свои кадры и отмена правок.
• Все карусели в одном месте: поиск, просмотр, сохранение в Фото, «Поделиться».
• Свой призыв в конце каждой карусели и банк своих фото.
• Работает и без сети: уже открытое видно, правки не теряются.
• Виджеты, быстрые действия на значке и команды Siri.

Данные под контролем: перед первой работой приложение спрашивает согласие на обработку данных нейросетями. Отозвать согласие и удалить кабинет можно в Настройках.

Для входа нужен кабинет Sofia Content: ссылку для входа присылает бот сервиса в Telegram.

name: Softcoil
description:
Softcoil is an on-device living-room stretch coach for desk-time and sofa breaks.

Coach — Open Softcoil and start moving immediately. Resume your last stretch or launch Desk Reset. Pose motion plays from bundled offline pose libraries — no download wait.

Routines — Choose timed paths from 5 to 18 minutes. Filter desk-friendly sofa sessions or fuller floor flows. Star favorites with a swipe.

Library — Browse twenty individual stretches across neck, shoulders, chest, back, hips, hamstrings, calves, and wrists. Each move includes cues, hold timing, and cautions.

Session player — A local timer drives the pose loop. Slow playback to 0.35×, reverse the motion path, pause anytime, and auto-advance through multi-move routines.

Desk — Review on-device session history, toggle haptics, set reverse defaults, open the field guide and safety notes, and access comprehensive support and legal documentation.

Softcoil does not require an account and does not need a network connection after install. Airplane Mode still delivers every stretch session.

Softcoil provides general wellness stretch guidance for healthy adults. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis or treatment.

name: SOLEIL TECHNOLOGIE
description:
SOLEIL TECHNOLOGIE, c'est le marché des biens et des services en Guinée, réuni dans une seule application.

DES BIENS
• Des milliers de produits : téléphones, ordinateurs, électroménager, mode, maison et bien plus.
• Des boutiques de confiance, vérifiées par SOLEIL TECHNOLOGIE.
• Livraison à domicile à Conakry et dans votre quartier.
• Paiement en ligne ou à la livraison, avec facture immédiate.

DES SERVICES
• Cours à domicile ou en ligne avec des professeurs qualifiés.
• Prestataires et professionnels pour vos besoins du quotidien.
• Réservation simple et suivi de chaque séance.

VENDEZ ET PROPOSEZ VOS SERVICES
• Ouvrez votre boutique gratuitement et vendez vos produits.
• Devenez professeur ou prestataire et trouvez de nouveaux clients.
• Publiez vos annonces en quelques secondes.

SIMPLE ET SÛR
• Vos coordonnées restent protégées : les échanges passent par l'application.
• SOLEIL TECHNOLOGIE garantit chaque paiement.
• Notifications en temps réel pour suivre vos commandes et vos cours.
• Votre espace client : commandes, factures, cours et messages au même endroit.

Créez votre compte gratuitement avec votre numéro de téléphone et rejoignez le marché SOLEIL TECHNOLOGIE.

name: Sorba Charge
description:
Sorba Charge is a game of timing on horseback, built around tbourida, the Moroccan fantasia that UNESCO inscribed as intangible cultural heritage in 2021.

At a moussem, a sorba of riders in white turbans and djellabas gallops down the mahrak, the straight sand track. When their leader, the mqaddem, gives the call, the whole troupe discharges its long moukahla rifles together, loaded with blank powder only, so the line is heard as a single shot. A clean volley brings the crowd to its feet. A ragged one draws a groan. Sorba Charge is about chasing that one perfect shot.

THE CHARGE
Press and hold to set your sorba off at a walk, then a trot, then a gallop down the mahrak. Horses drift out of line as you ride, so swipe across a straggler to rein it back before it costs you the volley. Watch the mqaddem: he raises his rifle first, and a beat later comes the cry. Let go the instant you hear it. Your spread, the gap in milliseconds between the first shot and the last, and how straight your line held are scored and played back together as one dust and smoke replay, with the crowd's own reaction. Wind off the sea, wind off the plain, and a nervous horse shift the timing differently every run.

THE SORBA
Thirteen riders, each with a name, a story and a quirk that changes how they ride: old Hajj Bouchaib always fires a beat early, the grey Barb mare Zahra drifts left down the track, young Yassine rides steady but is slow to raise his rifle. Place them by slot, the wings wander more than the centre, and watch them sharpen with practice as your sorba rides more charges together.

THE MOUSSEM ROAD
A hand painted map of the Atlantic plain carries you from village moussems in Doukkala and Chaouia to the great gathering at Moulay Abdallah Amghar near El Jadida, and on to Tissa, Meknes and beyond. Each moussem has its own track length, dust, light and crowd. Clean volleys open the road ahead.

THE TENT
Every charge you have ridden is kept here, its spread, its line score, its replay, alongside your sorba's personal best. Share a charge's replay card with friends, or just sit with the ones that mattered.

Sorba Charge is built for anyone who has stood at the rope at a moussem and felt the ground move, and for anyone who has watched a fantasia once and wants to understand why the crowd erupts at a clean volley. It plays entirely offline, holds nothing back behind a paywall, and never shows the moukahla as anything but what it is at a moussem: a ceremonial powder rifle, fired into the air.

name: SourceNote
description:
Open a PDF. Add markup and page-linked notes. Send work that is ready for the next person.

• Import through Files, your own cloud drive or a compatible app.
• Keep handwriting and notes beside the original page.
• Export markup and notes in a PDF, then choose Outlook or another compatible app to review and send it.
• Store files locally by default. Connect your own drive when you need it. SourceNote does not host your documents.

Try editing free for 7 days. No ads. No subscription. No automatic charge. Unlock once to keep editing; the App Store shows the price before you confirm. Existing work stays readable and exportable.

Sharing options depend on installed apps and device policies. Purchases restore with the same App Store Apple Account; optional SourceNote sign-in is separate.

name: SpamCheck: Unknown Callers
description:
Missed a call from a number you don't know? SpamCheck calls it for you and records what happens from the first ring, so you can find out who it is without calling back.

HOW IT WORKS
Enter or paste a number, or share it from Messages, Mail or Safari. We call it from one of our numbers and record 45 seconds from the first ring. You hear exactly what any caller would: the ringing, a voicemail greeting, a business answering, a carrier message or a person picking up. Results usually arrive in about a minute.

THEY NEVER SEE YOUR NUMBER
The call comes from one of our numbers, a different one each time. Your number is never shown to the person you check.

FLAG SPAM AND BLOCK IT
After a check, mark a number as spam with a category like scam, robocall, telemarketing or debt collector. Turn on call blocking and your iPhone labels calls from flagged numbers and silences calls from numbers you block.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign up, no email and no name. No ads, analytics or tracking. Your results, labels, spam flags and blocked numbers stay on your iPhone, and we delete our copy of each result as soon as your phone has it.

SIMPLE CREDITS
Each check costs one credit. Buy credits as you need them with no subscription. Checks that fail because of us are refunded automatically.

Works with numbers in the United States and Canada.

Terms of Service: https://spamcheck.cryptobyte.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://spamcheck.cryptobyte.dev/privacy

name: Speaker First Aid: Water Eject
description:
Free speaker cleaner. No subscription, no ads, no review required to use Water Eject.

WATER EJECT, FREE
iPhone sounds muffled after getting wet? Water Eject plays a short, timed low-frequency tone through the iPhone speaker. Choose Standard or Gentle, stop any time, and run it up to three times. It works in Silent mode.

SPEAKER TEST
Play a reference tone and tell the app what you hear: clear, distorted or no sound. Each result is saved with the output iOS reports, so you can compare before and after drying.

FIX A MUFFLED, QUIET OR SILENT SPEAKER
Step-by-step guides for muffled, quiet, silent or distorted sound, quiet calls, Bluetooth and microphone problems. Every guide starts with the output iOS is actually using.

“LIQUID DETECTED” ALERT
What the alert means, how long to wait before connecting a cable, when wireless charging is fine, and what to avoid: heat, compressed air and rice.

HEADPHONE AND STEREO CHECK
Free left, center and right checks for stereo headphones.

PRO, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Microphone test: record two takes and compare them. Tone and frequency generator in Audio Lab. Bass, midrange and treble checks, stereo and frequency sweeps.

ULTIMATE, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Frequency spectra of recordings, multi-stage tone sequences, saved setups and session export.

Listening tests record what you hear. Sound can help clear the speaker grille, but it cannot confirm that an iPhone is dry or repair damage.

name: Spectrix
description:
Spectrix is a professional color debugging toolkit for designers, product teams, and anyone who needs precise color decisions on the go.
MIX ANY COLOR SPACE
Work fluidly across HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, and CIELAB. Dial hues on the interactive ring, fine-tune with sliders, paste hex values, and keep every space in sync.
HARMONIES THAT TRAVEL
Generate complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, split-complementary, monochromatic, shade, and tint sets—then save them as named palettes in one tap.
GRADIENT LAB
Compose linear or radial washes with multiple stops. Preview live, adjust angles and positions, and export ready-to-use CSS or SwiftUI snippets.
PALETTE LIBRARY + ASE EXPORT
Organize searchable swatch sets with notes. Duplicate, edit, and share Adobe Swatch Exchange (.ase) files for Illustrator, Photoshop, and other desktop tools. JSON export is included when you need a lightweight handoff.
CONTRAST YOU CAN TRUST
Validate WCAG 2.x AA and AAA for normal text, large text, and UI components. See a live preview board so readability issues show up before they ship.
BUILT FOR REAL WORK
• English interface designed for Western design workflows
• Local-first storage—palettes, gradients, and presets stay on your device
• No account required
• Designer guide, privacy policy, and support contact included
Spectrix is a complete offline utility: every tab is a working lab, not a placeholder. Open Mixer, dial a color, prove contrast, and export the palette your team actually needs.

name: Speedtest.az
description:
Speedtest.az is a free internet speed test made for Azerbaijan. Tap GO and in a few seconds you see your download and upload speed in Mbps, plus ping and jitter, measured against test servers in Baku and across the region.

It works on any connection: home or office Wi-Fi, or mobile data on 4G and 5G. Check what your internet provider really delivers, compare Wi-Fi with mobile data, or find out why a video call or game is lagging.

ONE-TAP SPEED TEST
• Download and upload speed in Mbps, with a live gauge while the test runs
• Ping (latency) and jitter in milliseconds, the numbers that matter for gaming, video calls and streaming
• The server is chosen automatically by lowest ping, or you can pick a city yourself
• When location is allowed, servers are sorted by distance from you

LIVE LATENCY MAP
• The Network tab shows a 3D globe with real-time ping from you to every test server, from Baku and Tbilisi to Istanbul and beyond
• See at a glance which servers respond fastest from where you are

RESULTS AND HISTORY
• Every result is saved on your device with the date, time and city
• Each result has its own link you can share
• See how you are connected: Wi-Fi network name or mobile network type (such as 4G or 5G), plus your internet provider

SIMPLE AND FREE
• Free to use, no account or sign-up
• Light and dark theme
• A short walkthrough on first launch shows how it works
• A "Rate Speedtest.az" option in the Other tab

PRIVACY
Location is optional and used only while the app is open. It helps find nearby servers and adds your result to the Azerbaijan coverage map. Precise coordinates are never shown publicly: shared results show only the city or district. Your Wi-Fi network name never leaves your device.

Speedtest.az is built for Azerbaijan: local servers, local internet providers, accurate numbers.

name: SpektraCamera
description:
SpektraCam is a film simulation camera for iPhone. Choose a film stock and, where available, a print paper. See the look in the live viewfinder before you take the shot.

• Explore 20 color negative, slide, and motion-picture film stocks. Pair supported stocks with print papers or motion-picture print film, or use a direct scan look for slide film.
• Shoot one Bayer RAW exposure at a time. SpektraFilm develops each exposure on your device and renders a JPEG with the selected film look, including grain and halation. Histogram-based middle-gray metering is the default for RAW development.
• Tap to focus on supported lenses. Switch lenses, pinch to zoom, adjust exposure compensation, or use the grid and self-timer.
• Review, zoom, share, and delete photos in the built-in gallery. See which film and paper you used, and save a copy to Apple Photos with your permission.
• Use SpektraCam in English or Simplified Chinese.

Capture requires a lens that supports Bayer RAW. Available lenses vary by iPhone model.

name: Spooky Blast NYC
description:
Hop in your taxi and save Halloween in New York City!

Spooky Blast NYC is a friendly Halloween driving game made for kids and fun for grown ups too. Your taxi drives itself across the city at night. You tap to blast candy at cartoon ghosts, bats and silly zombies, and press JUMP to hop over cones, slime puddles and open manholes. Every monster pops into candy, coins and confetti.

DRIVE ACROSS NEW YORK
Seven levels from Central Park to Times Square, the Subway, Coney Island, the Village Halloween Parade, the Brooklyn Bridge and the top of the Empire State Building.

DUEL SPOOKY BOSSES
Face off with a witch, a mummy, a vampire, a werewolf and Frankenbolt. Then take on the Headless Horseman and the Ghost King.

BUILD YOUR RIDE
Spend your coins in the garage. Unlock a pedicab, hot dog cart, pizza scooter, ice cream truck, fire truck and city bus. Add gun pods, pumpkin rockets, a tesla coil, buzz saws, monster wheels and bat wings. Paint it, give it underglow, and mix potions in the lab.

DRAW YOUR OWN MONSTER
Draw a monster with your finger and watch it show up in the game.

MADE FOR KIDS AND FAMILIES
Simple controls: tap to blast, press JUMP to hop. Nothing gory or scary, just cartoon monsters that pop into candy. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no data collected, and no internet needed.

name: St. Benedict Classical Academy
description:
Stay connected with St. Benedict Classical Academy.

The St. Benedict Classical Academy app brings school news, calendars, class updates, and our community together in one place for St. Benedict families, faculty, and staff.

With the app you can:
- Read school news and class updates in one feed
- See school calendars and upcoming events
- Check class schedules
- Find families, faculty, and staff in the school directory
- Follow your homerooms and school groups
- Get notifications so you never miss an update
- Find school resources and documents in one place

The app works with RavenWeb, our Blackbaud portal. Log in with the same account you use for RavenWeb, and the app shows the classes, groups, and events that belong to your family.

The St. Benedict Classical Academy app is for current St. Benedict families, faculty, and staff.

name: stage.church
description:
stage.church gives your church one online home.

This app is the members' companion to stage.church. After you sign in, you can:

1. Read announcements and see what is happening this week
2. Browse events, RSVP, and find the time and place
3. Join groups and teams, and see who else is involved
4. Follow serving rotas and reminders
5. Stay up to date with notifications so you do not miss what is next

You can also keep your profile up to date, submit prayer requests, fill in forms, and manage your account, including deleting it from inside the app.

Churches that use stage.church also get a public website with meeting times and simple admin tools on the web. Every plan includes every feature. New churches start with a 3-month free pilot, with no card required.

The app is available in English, Spanish, French, Bulgarian, Italian and Portuguese.

Questions: support@stage.church

name: StajNano
description:
StajNano is a companion app for the Nano Cortex amp-capture pedal by Neural DSP. It connects over Bluetooth and puts everything you need on stage on one landscape screen.

ON STAGE
• Preset name, number and the four footswitch slots, large enough to read from standing height
• Effects, gate, amp and cab as tiles: tap to switch on or off, long-press to edit
• The pedal's six knobs drawn live as knobs
• Tap tempo with a beat light; hold it to type a tempo
• Tuner with one LED per cent, in the lower half of the screen or full screen
• Swipe left or right to move to the next preset, bank or song

THREE MODES
• Preset: the slots as you assigned them, a swipe moves one preset
• Bank: the 64 presets as 16 banks of four, one swipe loads the next bank onto the footswitches in a single message
• Song: your own set list — a name, a tempo and four presets per song, each slot with its own label. Songs live on your phone and can be exported and imported as a file

EDIT
• Every effect's parameters laid out like the pedal's own editor: same names, order, units and steps
• Change the model of any effect, pick a capture or a cab IR
• SAVE when something changed

FOOT CONTROLLER
Connect a Bluetooth MIDI foot controller (for example an M-VAVE Chocolate or a CME WIDI link) and switch hands-free: previous / next, the four slots, tap tempo, and any effect, the amp or the cab on, off or toggled. The mapping is documented in the app.

DEMO
No pedal nearby? Tap DEMO on the connect screen to try every page on a simulated pedal.

StajNano is an independent, third-party app. It is not an official app and is not made, endorsed or supported by Neural DSP. Nano Cortex and Neural DSP are trademarks of Neural DSP Technologies; all other product names and trademarks belong to their owners and are named only to describe what this app works with. StajNano is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. We do not guarantee that it works correctly with every Nano Cortex unit or firmware version, and we are not responsible for any problem arising from its use. The app collects no data and needs no account.

name: Stashora
description:
Tired of tearing your house apart looking for your passport, keys, or that specific winter jacket? Meet Stashora, the intelligent personal inventory assistant that ensures you never lose track of your belongings again.Stashora is not just a list-making app; it is your home’s digital memory. Powered by advanced AI, simply snap a photo of your items, tell Stashora where you put them, and let the app do the heavy lifting. Whether you are organizing a single drawer or planning a massive house move, Stashora keeps your life clutter-free and organized.
 KEY FEATURES:
 AI Smart Search
Stop scrolling through endless lists. Just ask naturally: "Where is my passport?" or "Show me all my electronics." Stashora’s AI instantly scans your inventory and tells you exactly where your items are stored.
 AI Photo Recognition
Adding items has never been easier. Take a photo of an item, and our AI will automatically suggest its name, category, and description for you. No more typing!
 Visual Similarity Search
Can't remember the name of an item? Upload a photo, and Stashora will use AI to find visually similar items already saved in your inventory.
 Smart Locations & Moving Mode
Organize your stuff hierarchically by Room, Wardrobe, Drawer, or Box. Planning a move? Use the dedicated Moving Mode to create projects, track packed boxes, assign items, and know exactly what goes where in your new home.
 Value & Warranty Tracking
Keep a record of your purchase prices and estimated current values. Stashora gives you a complete breakdown of your total inventory value and helps you keep track of warranty expirations.
 AI Organization Assistant
Want a tidier home? Let the AI analyze your current inventory and suggest practical ways to group similar items and optimize your storage spaces.
Wishlist & Missing Items
Keep a separate wishlist for things you want to buy. If something goes missing, mark it in the app—Stashora remembers the last place you saw it and helps you keep track.

name: StickNTrack
description: Follow your StickNTrack devices live on the map, get alerts, navigate straight to them and find nearby tags with the built-in Bluetooth finder.

name: Stillsecond
description:
Let go a little early on the first hold? Give the second a little more time. In Stillsecond, you hold and release to fit two lengths of time into one moment. If your goal is 6 seconds and your first hold takes 2.60 seconds, you have 3.40 seconds left. Get close enough to clear the trial, then keep both holds steady to earn three stars.

Six islands, 24 timing trials
Try a hold with a brief opening guide, judge a duration without a running clock, or watch a glow and recreate its length from memory. Some trials ask for half or double that length. Others score two holds separately or leave you to work out the final hold of a three-part relay.

Keep the moments you repair
Earn Time Fragments in campaign trials to unlock each island's three-frame reel in the Moment Archive. Earn a Rule Rune for each first clear, an Island Banner for clearing all four trials on an island, and a Mastery Crown for getting three stars in all four.

Three hearts, five checkpoints
Take on an Expedition and build a streak of precise clears. Replay the same route and try to beat your own score.

Practice or pass the device
Pick a timing pattern in Time Rehearsal and practice how the second hold can make up for the first. Or pass one device among two to four players and compare your timing.

name: Stoppy - おでかけアルバムと駅ガチャ
description:
首都圏の駅に降りた思い出を、駅ごと・路線ごとに残すアルバムです。
対応エリアは東京・神奈川・埼玉・千葉の1,554駅(134路線)。ほかの地域は随時追加していきます。

■ 駅ごとの写真記録
降りた駅で写真を撮って、一言を添える。写真は路線ごとの紐にぶら下がって、駅の並びがそのまま路線図になります。ラーメン・カフェ・猫など、ジャンルや鉄道会社で見返せます。

■ 行き先に迷ったら、駅ガチャ
START を押して STOP で止める。止まった駅が今日の行き先です。よく使う路線の近くだけにしぼることもできます。駅ごとの短いガイドつき。

■ みんなで撮って、帰り道に現像
友だちを招待して一緒に旅。旅の途中はお互いの写真は見えず、「現像」を押すと自分の分が届きます。

■ 机いっぱいの写真を1枚に
みんなが撮った写真を、机いっぱいに並べた1枚に。X や Instagram にそのまま投稿できます。

デート、食べ歩き、ぬい撮りのお出かけにも。

・無料、広告なし
・iPhone(iOS 17 以上)。みんなで行く機能は、全員が iCloud にサインインした iPhone で使えます
・対応エリアは首都圏のみ(ほかの地域の駅は出ません。順次追加予定)
・駅データ: 駅データ.jp、Wikidata。駅ガイド: © OpenStreetMap contributors

name: StoriaPlay: Did You Know
description:
Did you know your phone could tell if you're getting sick? That one asteroid could end the internet? That a city can run without cash?

StoriaPlay: Did You Know turns big ideas into short, beautiful films you can watch in a minute. Swipe through more than 160 Shorts on science, space, history, technology, the body and the future, each one narrated and made to be remembered. New films are added regularly.

• Shorts: a full-screen feed of 1-minute films
• 3 languages: watch in English, Spanish or Portuguese
• Listen: every Short as audio, keeps playing with the screen off
• Daily Quiz: 7 questions from the films, the same for everyone; top score is King of the Day
• Games: True or False, Higher or Lower, Timeline, Memory and more
• Watch free: your first 5 Shorts each day have no ads

DYK Premium
• Download any Short and listen offline, anywhere
• No ads at all while you're Premium
• Premium-only films and Shorts, with new films first
• Widescreen deep-dive films as they're released
• $2.99 a month or $23.99 a year (save 33%). Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

No account needed. No tracking. Your viewing stays on your phone.

Questions? partners@yieldenza.com
Privacy: storiaplay.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: storiaplay.com/terms.html

name: Strand Tuck
description:
Strand Tuck keeps one eye splice on this iPhone. Enter the rope circumference in millimeters, choose synthetic or natural fiber, and set how many full tucks the eye needs.

Synthetic rope buries three times the circumference. Natural rope buries twice. The three strands rotate A, B, and C. Each tuck uses an equal share of the bury. The board shows the next strand and the bury still left. When the bury is shorter than one more tuck, or the full count is done, the tuck button stops.

Find a splice by name. Change the circumference, the fiber, or the tuck count. Delete a splice you no longer need. The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Stride – Walks & Runs
description:
Stride records your walks & runs precisely and keeps them on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics.

RECORD EVERY WALK & RUN
• GPS once per second, also with the screen locked and the phone in your pocket
• Optional automatic walk & run detection: Stride notices when you start walking or running and records it for you
• Breaks are recognised by themselves; pause and resume whenever you like
• A Live Activity on the Lock Screen while you walk or run

SEE HOW YOUR WALK/RUN WENT
• Your route on the map, as recorded by GPS or snapped to the streets you walked/run
• Distance, time, pace, speed, steps, climb and estimated energy
• Charts for pace, energy per km or every 5 minutes, cadence, stride length, even pace and hill-adjusted pace
• Intensity minutes towards the WHO's 150 minutes a week, and how each walk compares with your usual pace
• The weather of every walk/run
• Give a walk/run a name, a note and the photos you took on the way

PLAN ROUTES ON REAL STREETS
• Tap the map to plan a route along real streets, or turn one of your walks into a route
• Checkpoints along the way: a short vibration at each one while Stride is open, and a notification if you miss one or finish the route
• Walks that pass every required checkpoint of a route are added to it automatically
• Compare your walks on the same route
• Street maps for the area around you download quietly and then work offline, almost anywhere in the world

HISTORY AND STATS
• Your history with search and filters
• Day, week, month, year and all-time stats, personal records and your daily steps
• A heatmap that lights up every street you have walked

SHARE A WALK/RUN
• Turn a walk/run into a picture with your photo, route and numbers
• Photo effects, fonts and text styles, in post or story format

MAKE IT YOURS
• Three designs: Classic, Contour and Lumen, each in light and dark
• Alternate app icons to match, chosen separately
• Metric or imperial units

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your walks & runs, routes and photos stay on this phone and are never uploaded.

name: Studio Space: Photo Control
description:
Got a great space for killer photoshoots? Stop trying to keep it all in your head or scattered across random notes and chats! This app helps you organize every single detail of your studio: from room booking schedules and automated cleaning buffers to full inventory tracking for your lights, stands, and softboxes.

Keep tabs on room availability, track equipment health, plan repairs or gear upgrades, and get clear analytics on your studio's performance. Everything works completely offline, fast, and hassle free  so you can focus on creating the ultimate space for creativity and amazing photography.

name: Studvex
description:
Built for basketball fans and sneaker creators, Studvex helps you see how a colorway looks on a shoe. Start with a white low-top, mid-top, or high-top. Rotate the 3D model and tap the upper, laces, heel, or sole to try your team colors one part at a time.
See how the same blue looks on mesh, leather, or suede. Give the heel a metallic finish, add stripes to the upper, or blend two colors into a gradient. Place your name, jersey number, or a decal on the shoe, then adjust its size, angle, and position. Design the left and right shoes separately for a mismatched pair.
Wondering whether a darker sole would work better? Duplicate your design and compare both versions side by side. Undo an edit, try a new combination, and keep your favorites in your Library so you can pick up where you left off.
Open a full-screen preview to inspect the toe, sides, heel, and tread. Choose a background, find the angle that shows your best detail, and export an image to share with teammates or friends.

name: Stufg: Grocery List
description:
stufg is a shopping list that feels like a note on the fridge. write what you need, tick it into the bag, done.

You can Say It and You can Type It
tap the mic and say "milk, eggs and that good cheese". stufg splits it into three things. listening happens on your phone, so your words never leave it.

IT REMEMBERS FOR YOU
stufg notices how often you buy things. if it's been a week since bananas and you always buy bananas weekly, it asks "forgot these?". one tap adds it. no cloud, no account, just counting on your phone.

A PANTRY THAT KNOWS WHAT'S LOW
put jars on the shelf for the things you keep at home. when the milk runs low, stufg reminds you on your next shop.

SORTED BY AISLE
fruit and veg, cold stuff, cupboard stuff, other stuff. your list is in the order you walk the shop.

ONE QUIET POKE
if you want, stufg sends one gentle note when something's due. never more than one a day. away mode pauses everything while you're on holiday.

EASY ON THE EYES
• calm mode: no flying, no wobbling
• plain letters if crayon is hard to read
• three word sizes
• works with VoiceOver and larger text

A LITTLE BUDDY
lumpy cheers you on as you shop. finish a shop and earn shika, then spend it on new buddies, bags and paper colours. every item can be earned for free just by shopping. if you'd rather not wait, you can buy it outright instead.

FOR PARENTS
hide the shop with one tap in settings. bringing it back needs face id or your passcode.

YOUR STUFF STAYS YOURS
no account. no sign-up. no ads. no tracking. we can't see your list, and we don't want to. save a copy of everything whenever you like.

name: Sunseed Soar
description:
Welcome to Sunseed Soar, a charming garden adventure where a tiny seed dreams of growing into something wonderful!

Guide your little plant through colorful gardens and magical forests. Collect sunlight and water, grow into a beautiful flower, and launch your seeds to discover new places and meet your flower friends.

GROW YOUR LITTLE PLANT
Help your seedling grow by collecting sunshine and refreshing water along the way.

MASTER YOUR MOVEMENTS
Control your plant carefully, manage your energy, and find the right moments to move forward.

BLOOM AND SOAR
Once your flower is ready, launch your seed and keep your adventure going.

FIND YOUR FLOWER FRIENDS
Reach your blooming friends before the sunshine runs out to complete each level.

With cheerful characters, colorful scenery, and engaging platform challenges, Sunseed Soar offers a delightful little adventure for players who love nature-inspired games.

Plant a seed, chase the sunshine, and let your adventure soar!

name: Sunway Megalanes Staff
description:
Sunway Megalanes Staff is the counter app for Sunway Megalanes employees. It lets staff charge members and take counter top-ups quickly, without cards or cash changing hands.

This app is for Sunway Megalanes staff only. Accounts are created by the venue; there is no public sign-up. Members use the Sunway Megalanes app.

CHARGE A MEMBER
• Choose what the charge is for: Bowling, Proshop or Cafe
• Enter the amount on the keypad
• Scan the member's pay code from their Sunway Megalanes app
• The member approves the charge on their own phone, and the app shows the receipt

TAKE A COUNTER TOP-UP
• Scan the member's top-up code
• Confirm the payment received at the counter, and the Credits go straight to the member's wallet

YOUR COUNTER TODAY
• See today's charges and top-ups at a glance
• Every transaction has a receipt with its time and reference
• Recent transactions, newest first

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Members are found only by scanning their code, never by name or phone number
• Every charge needs the member's approval on their phone
• Each pay code works once

name: Synapt
description:
Synapt is a calm, simple place for everything you're thinking about: your days, your projects, the people you work with and the things you're learning. Every note is plain markdown, so it stays yours.

ONE PLACE FOR EVERYTHING Synapt gives every note a home with six simple folders: Inbox, Daily, Projects, Areas, Resources and Archive. Capture now, sort later, and always know where to look.

DAILY NOTES Open today's note with one tap. Plan your top three, jot down meetings and keep a running journal. Tomorrow starts fresh, and yesterday is always one search away.

PROJECTS, PEOPLE AND TASKS Link notes together with wikilinks. Each project shows its status and open tasks. Each person's page collects every note that mentions them, so you walk into your next conversation prepared. Every open task across your notes rolls up into one list.

QUICK CAPTURE AND SEARCH Grab an idea in seconds and it lands in your Inbox. Search every note instantly.

AN ASSISTANT THAT KNOWS YOUR WORK Ask questions about your own notes: "What did I promise people this week?" or "Prep me for my 1:1." The assistant can search, read and add to your notes, and only ever works from what you've written.

WORKS WITH THE AI YOU ALREADY USE (PRO) Connect ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants to your notes. You sign in and approve each tool, and you can see exactly what it can access.

YOUR NOTES STAY YOURS Plain markdown files, synced across your phone and the web at synapt.cloud. Import an existing folder of markdown notes, or export everything as a .zip any time. No ads, no tracking, and your notes are never used for advertising.

PLANS Free: up to 500 notes and 20 assistant messages a month. Synapt Pro: unlimited notes, 1,000 assistant messages a month, attachments, and ChatGPT/Claude connections. $7.99 a month or $79.99 a year.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Questions or ideas? Tap Feedback in the app or email support@synapt.cloud.

Terms of Use: https://synapt.cloud/terms Privacy Policy: https://synapt.cloud/privacy

name: Tabulo
description:
Tabulo é um editor de planilhas nativo para iPad, criado para trabalhar com documentos, cálculos e dados onde você estiver.

Abra e salve arquivos usando o app Arquivos e os provedores disponíveis no seu dispositivo, incluindo iCloud Drive e Google Drive. Trabalhe por toque ou aproveite mouse, trackpad e teclado para uma experiência mais próxima de um computador.

Principais recursos:

• Edição completa de células, linhas e colunas
• Fórmulas e funções com suporte a nomes em português
• Abertura e exportação de formatos populares de planilha
• Formatação de números, fontes, cores, bordas e alinhamento
• Gráficos e ferramentas de organização de dados
• Interface adaptada ao iPad
• Suporte a mouse, trackpad, teclado físico e teclado numérico integrado
• Integração com o app Arquivos, iCloud Drive e provedores de terceiros instalados
• Recuperação local do documento em edição

Privacidade:

O Tabulo não exige conta, não exibe anúncios e não coleta dados pessoais ou dados de uso. Seus documentos permanecem no dispositivo ou no provedor de arquivos escolhido por você.

Créditos:

O Tabulo foi desenvolvido com base no projeto de código aberto GridCraft/GridSheet, criado pela equipe ArtCraft e seus colaboradores. O projeto original é disponibilizado sob as licenças MIT ou Apache-2.0.

Projeto original: https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft

name: Taikyoku Shogi
description:
THE LARGEST SHOGI EVER DEVISED
Taikyoku shogi ("ultimate shogi") is a centuries-old shogi variant played on 1,296 squares. Each side commands 402 wedge-shaped pieces, and almost every kind moves in its own way. Nobody knows who made it, and it is known from a single old record. This is a playable version, rebuilt in 3D and set in a painted courtyard at dusk.

PIECES LIKE NOTHING ELSE
• Over two hundred kinds of piece in the opening position, 301 in the encyclopedia.
