• Lions strike twice in one turn. Eagles fly over their own pawns. Some pieces sweep the whole board.
• Select any piece and see every square it can reach before you commit.
• Every piece is a carved figurine with its own flag, shown beside the piece it becomes when it promotes.
• A camera that keeps every move in view, yours and the computer's, even in the thick of the board.

BUILT FOR TOUCH AND FOR THE MOUSE
• On iPhone and iPad, tap a piece, then tap a green square to move or a red square to capture. Pinch to zoom the board. A map in the corner shows where you are on the 36 by 36 board.
• On Mac, click and drag, scroll to zoom, and use the keyboard shortcuts shown in the game.
• Three graphics levels, from a full courtyard with weather to a light mode for older devices. The game picks one for your device and you can change it in Settings.

LEARN IT, PLAY IT, KEEP IT
• A guided first game of eight short lessons on the real board, with a teacher's voice and captions.
• The ladder: ten opponents, from Kenji, who is still learning, past Hana, the grandmaster, to Kage, whom no one has seen without a mask. Each has a handicap, a personality and a scene of their own. Earn up to three stars on each.
• Puzzles: small positions with one winning idea, and a puzzle of the day with a streak.
• The Daily Battle: one game a day, the same for everyone, with a streak. The Pilgrimage: 54 games along the Tokaido, from Shinagawa to Kyoto.
• Play the computer at three strengths, a friend on the same device, or another player online, live or over days.
• Replays: step through any game, find its biggest moment, and share it.
• A Study area for long games: keep as many single-player games as you like, each with a name of your own, annotate game records, and keep a journal.
• The encyclopedia: every piece with movement diagrams, plain-English descriptions and promotions.
• English and Japanese.

MADE TO BE LOOKED AT
Banners rise over the armies, captures bloom as spilled ink, and a calm cinematic camera follows each move.

PLAYING ONLINE
Online play is optional. Single-player games, the lessons, puzzles and the Study area work without an internet connection. Online play uses a display name you choose and a random anonymous ID; there is no account, no ads, and no purchases inside the game. Public games can be watched by others. The privacy policy is at taikyokushogi.com/privacy.html.

A NOTE ON THE CONTENT
The ten opponents and the piece biographies are fiction. Parts of the game were made with generative AI tools and then reviewed and arranged by the developer. The computer opponents are classical game-search programs, and nothing in the game generates text, images or audio while you play.

name: Tajvid darslari
description:
Tajvid darslari ilovasi Qur’on tilovatini o‘rganishga yordam beruvchi video darslarni bir joyga jamlaydi.

• Darslarni ketma-ket tomosha qiling va oxirgi ochilgan darsga qayting.
• Ko‘p beriladigan savollarga javob toping.
• O‘quv guruhlari va yordam sahifalariga o‘ting.
• Kunlik eslatma vaqtini belgilang.
• Lotin va kirill yozuvi hamda kunduzgi va tungi ko‘rinishni tanlang.

Videolarni ko‘rish uchun internet aloqasi kerak.

name: Tangly Sort: Color Tubes
description:
Tap a tube, then another: the top balls of the same color move over. Sort them until every tube holds a single color.

FAIR AND CALM
• Every level is made by Tangly Sort's own generator and checked by a solver: it can always be solved.
• No ads, no lives, no timers. Undo and Restart are always free.
• Stuck? A hint shows the next good move.
• Finish on the target move count for 3 stars.

EASY ON THE EYES
• Eight clear colors, and every color also has its own shape, so the game is playable with color blindness.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 100 free levels in 4 packs: First Steps, Hidden (balls show as ? until the ones above them leave), Crowd and Narrow (only one empty tube)
• A new daily puzzle every midnight, the same for everyone. Keep your streak and share your result without spoiling it.

TANGLY SORT PLUS · one-time purchase
• The Master pack: 8 colors, hidden balls, and future packs
• Unlimited hints
No subscription. Family Sharing supported.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.

From the makers of Tangly and Untangly.

name: Tap Lab
description:
TAP-LAB – Il digitale a portata di tap

Benvenuto in Tap-Lab, un'app pensata per rendere le esperienze digitali più semplici, immediate e accessibili.

Un ambiente moderno e intuitivo, progettato per accompagnarti nelle tue attività quotidiane attraverso un'esperienza di utilizzo fluida e organizzata.

PERCHÉ SCEGLIERE TAP-LAB?

• Semplicità: un'interfaccia chiara e intuitiva, pensata per tutti.

• Velocità: accedi alle funzionalità dell'app in pochi passaggi.

• Accessibilità: un'esperienza ottimizzata per l'utilizzo da smartphone.

• Organizzazione: naviga facilmente tra le diverse sezioni disponibili.

• Innovazione: un progetto digitale in continua evoluzione.

UN'ESPERIENZA PENSATA PER TE

Tap-Lab nasce con l'obiettivo di mettere la tecnologia al servizio delle persone, valorizzando semplicità, praticità e innovazione.

Scarica Tap-Lab e scopri un nuovo modo di interagire con il digitale.

TAP-LAB
Simple. Smart. Digital.

name: Tap Sounds - Party Soundboard
description:
Tap Sounds is a soundboard that's ready the moment you open it.

Your screen is a grid of buttons. Tap one and it plays: applause, cheers, laughter, correct, wrong, awkward silence… Great for parties, live streams, classroom quizzes and pranks with friends.

READY OUT OF THE BOX
• Three built-in sets: Party Time, Show Effects and Classroom
• Tap to play, tap again to stop
• With the Full Version, play several sounds at once
• See what's playing at the bottom and stop everything with one tap

MAKE YOUR OWN BUTTONS
• Pick a song or recording on your phone
• Drag the handles to choose the part you want
• Long song? Zoom into the waveform and fine-tune to 0.1 s
• Give it a name, a color and an icon, and your button is ready
• Export the clip as an audio file to send to friends (Full Version)

ARRANGE IT YOUR WAY
• Create your own presets, like "Friday Team Night", "Live Stream" or "Year-End Party"
• Long-press a button and drag to reorder
• Set looping, fade in and out, and volume for each button
• Use the song's cover art, a photo or one of thousands of icons, in any color you like

SHARE WITH FRIENDS
• Pack a whole preset into one file and send it with AirDrop, Messages or Files
• Your friend opens it in Tap Sounds and gets the exact same board

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Free: add 5 sounds of your own and play one at a time.
Full Version: add as many sounds as you like, play them all at once, share presets and export audio files.
• Buy once, keep it forever. Not a subscription, never renews
• Family Sharing supported: one purchase for the whole family
• No account needed. On a new phone, tap "Restore Purchases" in the app

name: TareBowlMeter
description: TareBowlMeter skaalaa ramenin tare-maustetiivisteen kulhoittain: valitse suola-, soija-, miso- tai paitan-resepti, säädä 1–8 kulhoa ja näe millilitrat heti. Sovellus ei anna elintarviketurvallisuus- tai säilyvyysarvioita eikä sisällä kauppalinkkejä; data pysyy laitteella.

name: TatvaOS One
description:
TatvaOS One is your organisation's workspace on your phone: mail, meetings, calendar, files and people, behind one sign-in. Built and hosted in India by Techvein.

A person exists once. One account reaches every product - and when someone leaves, one action ends their access to all of it.

MAIL
Business email on your organisation's own domain. Conversations, categories with colours, and filter rules applied at delivery. Shared mailboxes with send-as. Search across every folder.

CONNECT
Meetings that belong to the organisation, not to whoever started them. Live meetings come first in the list, so you join the one that is happening. Guests join with a link - no account needed.

CALENDAR
Day, week, month and agenda views. Recurrence and reminders. Invitations that work with Gmail and Outlook in both directions.

SPACE
Files for you, your team and the whole organisation, out of the same allowance as your mail.

PEOPLE
See who is in today, apply for leave, and check in or out of work.

ACCOUNT AND SECURITY
Two-step verification, every signed-in device listed, and an alert when a new one signs in. Organisations are kept apart by the database itself.

TatvaOS One needs an account from your organisation's administrator. To bring your organisation to TatvaOS, visit tatvaos.com.

name: Tavi CRM
description:
Tavi CRM brings your company's CRM to your iPhone. Find a record, update it, or log a visit while you are with the customer, and everything syncs with the Tavi CRM web app.

  Work with every module
  Open any module your team uses, such as Leads, Contacts, Deals, Cases or Sales Orders, including the custom modules your administrator has built. Switch between teamspaces and search across all
  modules from one screen.

  Create and edit records
  Forms follow the same layouts, required fields and rules your administrator set up on the web, so the data you enter on your phone is complete and valid.

  Field visits, recorded on site
  Stamp a record with your current location, attach photos taken with the camera, and pin an address on a map. Your manager sees where and when the visit happened.

  Reminders
  See your upcoming reminders in one place so follow-ups don't slip.

  Fast, secure sign-in
  Sign in with your company account, then use Face ID for the next sign-in. Two-factor sign-in is supported, and you can mark your phone as a trusted device.

  Made for your team
  Full English and Arabic support, including right-to-left layout. Light and dark appearance.

  Tavi CRM requires a Tavi CRM account. Contact your company administrator for access

name: TaziSabzi
description:
TaziSabzi delivers handpicked, farm-fresh vegetables, premium exotic fruits, fresh greens, and seasonal gift hampers straight to your doorstep.

Why choose TaziSabzi?
• 100% Farm-Fresh: Direct from trusted local farms every morning.

Order your daily greens and luxury fresh produce with TaziSabzi!

name: Technia CRM Lite
seller_name: TECHNIA ZERO ONE FOR DATA DESCRIPTION
description:
Technia CRM Lite is the mobile companion to your CRM. Follow up leads, log actions, close deals and track your targets and commission wherever you are.

LEADS & ACTIONS
• Add individual and business leads
• Search, filter and update leads, with bulk update tools
• Browse closed, hidden and rejected leads
• Log calls, meetings and follow-ups
• Review lead requests

DEALS, TARGETS & COMMISSION
• Track your deals and pipeline
• Follow your targets and how much you have achieved
• See your commission and your team's commission at a glance

INVENTORY
• Properties, resale owners and developers in one place

DASHBOARD & REPORTS
• Live dashboard with lead analysis and trends
• Marketing analysis and general overview reports, downloadable as PDF

TEAM & SETTINGS
• Attendance, tasks, salary and requests in the Portal tab
• Manage tags, sectors and industries
• Light and dark themes

Available in English and Arabic. A Technia CRM Lite company account is required to sign in.

name: Tee'd Up HQ
description:
Tee'd Up HQ runs the business side of a mobile golf simulator or event-hire business, from the first enquiry to the final payment.

LEADS AND FOLLOW-UPS
- Add enquiries in seconds and move them through your pipeline
- Follow-up reminders so no lead goes quiet
- Call, SMS or email a lead straight from their page

BOOKINGS AND CALENDAR
- Confirmed and pending bookings, with venue, guests, package and staff
- Month, week and day calendar of events, meetings and follow-ups
- Event-day checklists and "Event mode" for the day itself

QUOTES, DEPOSITS AND INVOICES
- Quotes with GST that customers accept or decline online
- Track deposits, balances and refunds
- Numbered tax invoices with your business details

WAIVERS AND GUEST SIGN-UPS
- Participants sign waivers on a phone at the event
- Collect guest details and competition entries with a link or QR code

YOUR TEAM
- Add managers and staff; staff see their jobs, not your prices or payments
- Notifications for what needs doing, on every device

YOUR DATA
- Each business's data is kept separate and private
- Download a full backup any time
- Close your business and have its data deleted from the app

Tee'd Up HQ is for businesses with an HQ account.

name: TEHDIR
seller_name: Mohammad Abdul Hamid Alfarizi Al Ma'arif Nur
description:
TEHDIR (Tahdir / إعداد التدريس) adalah aplikasi resmi berbasis iOS untuk sistem Rencana Pelaksanaan Pembelajaran (RPS) dan Persiapan Mengajar KMI (Kulliyatu-l-Mu'allimin Al-Islamiyyah) di seluruh kampus Pondok Modern Darussalam Gontor (20 kampus putra dan putri).

Aplikasi ini dirancang khusus untuk memfasilitasi kebutuhan akademis dan pedagogis asatidz serta staf KMI dengan arsitektur peran ganda (Dual-Role):

1. FITUR UTAMA GURU / ASATIDZ:
- Pengisian & Pengelolaan RPS/Tahdir Mingguan: Susun rencana pembelajaran secara terstruktur mencakup judul materi, langkah-langkah KBM (khuthuwatu-t-tadris), metode pedagogik, alat peraga, dan evaluasi.
- Jadwal Mengajar & Bel Hissoh: Lihat jadwal KBM harian secara real-time disertai pengingat/alarm hissoh masuk kelas dengan nada dering khas bel hissoh KMI.
- Ceklis Realisasi KBM: Konfirmasi pelaksanaan hissoh dan ketercapaian materi ajar langsung dari ruang kelas.
- Pengajuan Izin & Badal Guru: Ajukan permohonan izin berhalangan hadir disertai alasan syar'i dan tentukan asatidz pengganti (badal) yang bertugas.
- Bank Silabus & Materi Digital: Akses silabus resmi, buku referensi cetak Mu'allimin, serta video panduan ta'hil metodologi pengajaran.
- Konsultasi Pedagogik: Kanal diskusi langsung dengan staf pengasuhan dan KMI pusat mengenai kendala pembelajaran di kelas.

2. FITUR UTAMA STAF KMI:
- Dashboard Kepatuhan Mengajar 20 Kampus: Pantau persentase kepatuhan penyusunan tahdir dan realisasi hissoh di setiap kampus secara transparan dan terukur.
- Review & Verifikasi Ajuan RPS: Teliti berkas persiapan mengajar asatidz, berikan catatan revisi, atau terbitkan status Approval (persetujuan) baik per satuan maupun secara kolektif (batch).
- Monitoring Kehadiran Kelas Real-Time: Pantau status hissoh yang sedang berjalan dan deteksi dini jika terdapat hissoh kosong yang membutuhkan badal.
- Evaluasi & Analisis Statistik KBM: Rekapitulasi performa pengajaran per angkatan, kampus, dan bidang studi.

Catatan Distribusi:
Aplikasi ini diperuntukkan secara khusus bagi civitas akademika (Asatidz dan Staf KMI) Pondok Modern Darussalam Gontor. Akun autentikasi diterbitkan secara terpusat oleh Direktorat KMI Gontor.

name: Tekkoh
description:
Tekkoh is a journal for iPhone. Write a few lines each day, and Tekkoh quietly keeps the rest of the day beside them: where you went, how far you walked, the sky at sunrise and sunset, the photos you took.

And it keeps all of it to itself. Everything is encrypted on your phone, with a key only your devices hold, before it goes anywhere. Not even Tekkoh's server can read it.

A PAGE THAT FILLS ITSELF IN
 • The places your day took you, named and in order
 • Steps, distance and workouts from Apple Health
 • Sunrise and sunset
 • The day's photos, suggested so you can add them with a caption in a tap
 Every permission is optional.

A NOTEBOOK, NOT A FEED
 • One page a day, on cream grid paper
 • A streak, kept with a brush-drawn ensō
 • A month and year index of every page you've written
 • Home screen and Lock Screen widgets
 • On iPhone Duo, opens flat like a real notebook, with a focus mode for writing

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
 • End-to-end encrypted: words, photos, places and activity
 • Your key syncs through iCloud Keychain
 • A six-digit PIN brings your journal back on a new phone
 • No ads, no analytics, no tracking
 • Delete your journal everywhere, any time

ON A COMPUTER, AND FOR YOUR AGENTS

Link a browser to read and write on a computer. Personal AI agents can link too, with your approval on your phone, and leave a short note in the margin about what they did for you that day.

name: Telmarkt
description:
Telmarkt — Al, sat, buluş.

Aradığın telefonu yakınında bul veya kullanmadığın telefonunu yeni sahibiyle buluştur. Telmarkt, telefon almak ve satmak isteyenleri bir araya getirir. Yakınındaki ilanları keşfet, seçenekleri karşılaştır ve uygulama içinden doğrudan iletişime geç.

YAKININDAKİ İLANLARI KEŞFET Konumuna yakın telefon ilanlarını görüntüle. Mesafeye göre sırala, filtreleri kullan ve sana uygun seçenekleri incele.

ARADIĞIN TELEFONU KOLAYCA BUL Marka, model veya ilan numarasıyla arama yap. Trend modelleri keşfet; fiyat, depolama kapasitesi, cihaz durumu ve satıcının paylaştığı diğer bilgileri karşılaştır.

TELEFONUNU SATIŞA ÇIKAR Telefonun için ilan oluştur ve cihaz bilgilerini paylaş. İlanlarını hesabından yönet, gelen mesajları ve teklifleri takip et.

DOĞRUDAN MESAJLAŞ İlgilendiğin ilan hakkında sorularını uygulama içinden sor. Alış ve satış görüşmelerini mesajlar bölümünden takip ederek buluşma detaylarını karşı tarafla planla.

FAVORİLERİNİ BİR ARADA TUT İlgini çeken ilanları favorilerine ekle, daha sonra yeniden incele. İlanlarına, favorilerine, tekliflerine ve mesajlarına hesabından ulaş.

Bir sonraki telefonunu keşfetmek veya mevcut telefonunu satışa çıkarmak için Telmarkt’a katıl.

Telefonunu al, sat. Yakınında buluş.

name: Tenis Partneri
description:
Tenis Partneri, tenis oynayanları bir araya getiren sosyal uygulamadır. Seviyene ve şehrine uygun oyuncuları bul, kulüpleri keşfet, maçlarını ve fotoğraflarını paylaş.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Oyuncu keşfi: Şehrine ve seviyene göre tenis partneri bul, profilleri incele ve bağlantı kur.
• Akış: Maçlarını, antrenmanlarını ve fotoğraflarını paylaş; arkadaşlarının gönderilerini beğen ve yorumla.
• Kulüpler: Yakındaki tenis kulüplerini harita ve ilçe bazında keşfet, kulüp sayfalarını takip et.
• Mesajlaşma: Diğer oyuncularla birebir mesajlaşarak maç ayarla.
• Turnuvalar: Yaklaşan turnuvaları takip et, turnuva bildirimleri al.
• Seyahat planları: Başka bir şehre gittiğinde orada oynayacak partner bul.
• Bildirimler: Mesaj, arkadaşlık isteği ve kulüp duyurularından anında haberdar ol.

GÜVENLİ TOPLULUK
Telefon, e-posta, fotoğraflar, seyahat planları ve arkadaş listen için "Herkes", "Arkadaşlar" veya "Sadece ben" seçeneklerinden birini belirle. Her gönderi için ayrı hedef kitle seç. Uygunsuz içerik ve kullanıcıları şikayet et veya engelle. Hesabını istediğin zaman uygulama içinden silebilirsin.

Türkçe, İngilizce, Almanca ve Rusça dillerinde kullanılabilir.

name: Terazi: Balance Puzzle
description:
One tile. Two choices. Keep your balance.

Terazi is a puzzle about weight, space and your next move. Place weighted tiles on the left or right pan. Three matching tiles stacked in a pan clear, and so do two equal tiles at the same height on both sides. Making room can change the balance, so think one move ahead.

SIMPLE RULES, THOUGHTFUL CHOICES
• Swipe a tile or tap a button to choose its pan.
• After all clears, keep each pan at 7 tiles or fewer and the weight difference within the limit, which starts at 6 and grows each level.
• Clear tiles to level up: heavier tiles arrive, along with +1, −1, ×2 and ÷2 tiles that change the top tile of a pan.
• See the next tile and preview the result of a move.
• Earn points for valid moves and every clear; chain clears to multiply them.
• Play without a timer and try to beat your personal best.

ONE MORE CHANCE
When the incoming tile fits neither pan, you can continue the round up to three times. A continue removes the top tiles of both pans until the tile fits. Pay 10, 20, then 30 Coins, or watch an optional ad for one free continue per round.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your progress, high score and preferences are saved on your device. No account is required and the core game works offline. VoiceOver labels, numbered tiles, reduced motion support and button controls offer more ways to play. On iPad, Terazi fills the screen in portrait and landscape.

TERAZI PREMIUM
Premium removes ads, makes the first continue of every round free, unlocks four styles (Wood, Metal, Space and Minimal) and adds 50 Coins for every active subscription week. Choose weekly or yearly; both start with a 1-week free trial for eligible subscribers. Premium does not change scoring. The free version shows ads between rounds, never during one. Purchases and ads require a connection.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. After the free trial, your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

COINS
Spend Coins on continues and tile colors. Optional one-time packs contain 50, 100, 300 or 400 Coins. Coins do not expire, and tile styles you buy stay after Premium ends. Your wallet is stored on this device and does not sync to other devices. Restore Purchases restores subscriptions, not completed Coin packs. Erasing the device or losing local data may make Coins unrecoverable.

name: Terlik Geliyor: Hamam Böceği
description:
Mutfağın ışığı yandı. Sen bir hamam böceğisin ve annenin terliği geliyor!

Terlik Geliyor: Hamam Böceği, mutfak tezgâhında geçen komik bir sonsuz koşu oyunu. İki ayağının üstünde insan gibi koşan, kocaman gözlü hamam böceğimizle çay bardaklarının, kupaların ve domateslerin arasından kaç; şekerleri topla, terliğe yakalanma!

NASIL OYNANIR
• Sağa sola kaydır: şerit değiştir
• Yukarı kaydır: zıpla
• Aşağı kaydır: eğil ve oklavanın altından geç
• Yerde terliğin gölgesini görünce hemen kaç!

MUTFAK SENİ BEKLİYOR
• Bulaşık süngeri trambolin gibidir: üstüne bas, havalan
• Kibrit kutularının üstünden sek, çay bardaklarına toslama
• Kanatları kap ve uç: havadayken terlik sana yetişemez
• Lokumu yakala, etraftaki bütün şekerler sana gelsin
• Ne kadar uzağa koşarsan oyun o kadar hızlanır

KOSTÜMLER
Topladığın şekerlerle böceğini giydir! Altın Böcek, Şimşek, Kara Kuvvet, Sütlü Çikolata gibi 13 farklı böcek ve fes, nazar boncuğu, güneş gözlüğü, bıyık, kasket, zincir, taç gibi aksesuarlar seni bekliyor.

HER GÜN YENİ GÖREVLER
Her gün 3 yeni görev, üst üste giriş yaptıkça büyüyen günlük şeker hediyesi. Rekorunu kır, mutfağın efsanesi ol!

MAKARA GARANTİLİ
"ANNEEE TERLİĞİ GETİR!", "Hamam böceği nükleer savaştan kurtulur, terlikten kurtulamaz." Oyun boyunca seni güldürecek replikler ve terlik isabeti %100 bir anne.

Tamamen Türkçe ve internetsiz oynanabilir.

Hadi bakalım, terlik geliyor… KAÇ!

name: Thai Path: Thai Flashcards
description:
Start with Thai letters and tones, then practice everyday words and sentences with flashcards. Open word cards, sentence cards, and foundational lessons directly from Home.

• Interface and meanings in Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.

Try foundational lessons and sample cards for free. A one-time purchase unlocks the full library.

Listen to built-in Thai neural audio for words and sentences offline.

name: The Sand Bar Cabo
seller_name: El Medano Sand Bar Club, S. de R.L. de C.V.
description:
Discover relaxation by the beach with The Sand Bar Cabo.

Book your next massage in Cabo San Lucas directly from your phone. Explore available massage services, choose your preferred date and time, and manage your reservation in one convenient place.

Whether you're visiting Los Cabos or enjoying a day at the beach, The Sand Bar makes it easy to plan a relaxing experience.

Massage Booking

Download The Sand Bar Cabo and make relaxation part of your visit to Cabo San Lucas.

name: Thiên Tử Vi – Lá số tử vi
description:
Thiên Tử Vi giúp bạn lập lá số tử vi đầy đủ ngay trên điện thoại, an sao theo lịch âm Việt Nam (múi giờ UTC+7), kèm lời luận viết dễ hiểu cho từng cung.

• Lịch âm từng tháng, ngày hoàng đạo, giờ tốt
• Ngày tốt cho cưới hỏi, khai trương, động thổ, xuất hành

CÔNG CỤ PHƯƠNG ĐÔNG
• Xem tướng mặt từ ảnh chụp

• Xóa tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng

Nội dung luận giải mang tính tham khảo, giúp bạn hiểu mình và chủ động hơn; không thay thế lời khuyên chuyên môn về sức khỏe, pháp lý hay tài chính.

name: ThingsIn: Things to Do Nearby
description:
Every city has places you should not miss. ThingsIn keeps them on one list that you fill up and tick off.

Open a city to see its top sights and best places to eat, ranked by reviews. When you are there, everything sorts nearest first, so you always know what is close.

SAVE WHAT YOU WANT TO DO
Tap + on any place to put it on your list for that city. You can also type a place's name or paste a link.

ADD PLACES FROM REELS
Saw a great spot in an Instagram reel, a TikTok or a YouTube Short? Share it to ThingsIn and the places in the video land on your list. Google Maps links work too.

TICK THEM OFF
Been there? Tick it. Each city shows how many places are left and how many you have been to.

ONE LIST FOR EVERY TRIP
Lisbon next month, Tokyo next year, your own city this weekend. Every city keeps its own list, and tapping the city name shows them all.

GROUPED BY AREA
Places on your list that sit close together stay together, so you can see what to cover in one go.

GET THERE
Tap a place for directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps.

No account and no sign up. Your list stays on your phone.

Privacy Policy: https://things.in/privacy

name: Thunder Dodge
description:
Plasma bolts fall from a neon storm sky. Watch the red warning zones, run left and right, jump over shockwaves – and survive as long as you can.

FEATURES
• Fast one-thumb arcade action: swipe to run, tap to jump
• Fair warnings: a red zone shows exactly where each bolt will strike
• DODGE combos and PERFECT DODGES for big points
• 5 stars as lives – catch golden stars for an extra life
• 10 levels with rising difficulty, then endless THUNDERSTORM CHAOS
• Global top 100 leaderboard and personal best
• English, German, Turkish, French and Spanish

No ads, no in-app purchases. Just you against the storm.

name: Tidiva: Cleaning Planner
description:
A little reset. A calmer home.

Tidiva helps you organize household chores around your home, your schedule, and the time you have.

PLAN ROOM BY ROOM
Choose your rooms, organize them by floor, and build your cleaning plan. Pick suggested tasks or add your own with a time estimate and an optional note.

FIT CHORES AROUND YOUR DAY
Set your available days and daily cleaning time. Plan around office days, remote work, and the days you want to keep free.

TAKE IT ONE TASK AT A TIME
See today’s tasks, check them off, or start a guided cleaning session. Choose a ready-made routine for an evening reset, a work-from-home break, or a visit from friends.

KEEP YOUR SCHEDULE IN VIEW
Browse tasks by date, add scheduled tasks to Apple Calendar, and set optional daily reminders.

FREE OR PREMIUM
Use Tidiva for free with ads. Premium removes ads and unlocks 30-day activity history, progress by room, and CSV export.

Choose a monthly or annual subscription, or lifetime access with a single purchase. Eligible subscribers can try Premium free for seven days. Prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

name: Tidy Assistant
description:
Just ask. Tidy does the rest.

A calm assistant for your photos and calendar. Speak or type, and Tidy shows you what you meant.

Try asking:
• "Show me photos from Paris 2022"
• "Show my 5 biggest videos"
• "Tidy up my photos"
• "Tidy up my calendar"
• "What's on my calendar this week?"

Powered by Apple Intelligence. Your requests are answered on your device.

Requires an iPhone or iPad with Apple Intelligence turned on.

No paywall. No subscriptions. No ads.
Tidy is my personal project, shared for free with every feature included.

Private by design
No account, no tracking, no analytics. Tidy changes your library and calendar only when you ask, and every deletion needs your confirmation.

Found a bug or want a feature? Leave a review or write to me through the support page, and I'll do my best to help.

name: Tidy: Sorting Puzzle
description:
Tidy is a calm, cozy sorting puzzle. Open the cabinet, fridge or bookshelf and put everything back where it belongs, until every shelf holds just one kind of thing.

• Endless levels, generated fresh and always solvable
• Cabinets, fridges, bookcases with roller shutters, drawers and pantries
• Layers: clear a shelf and the one behind it slides forward
• Small obstacles to keep you thinking: padlocks, glass doors and a curious cat
• A daily challenge with a streak
• Boosters: a magnet and a freeze
• Up to three stars on every level
• Soft pixel art and gentle sounds, no timers, no pressure
• Available in English and Dutch

No account needed. Your progress stays on your device. The game shows ads now and then; a one-time purchase removes them.

name: TinkerBounce
description:
Turn one track and the marble might round the corner, or loop all the way back to where it started. Tinker Bounce is an offline, single-player marble puzzle game set in a colorful toy workshop. Each board is a little machine for you to figure out. Study the tracks, plan how the parts will work together, then launch your marble and see whether it reaches the dock.

Work through 30 campaign puzzles across four chapters and four Machine Lab puzzles. Start with a single turn, then work your way up to routes that depend on several mechanisms firing in sequence. Roll over a switch plate to open a gate, plan where a spring will land you, and check which way a portal’s far end points before sending your marble through. Linked gears turn together, numbered bells have to ring in order, and some boards ask you to guide two marbles to the dock with the same setup.

Rehearse a route to see exactly where it goes off course. Try a turn before committing to it, undo an edit, or ask for a hint when you’re stuck. Once you clear a board, replay your run and see if you can reach the dock in fewer turns.

Visit the Remix arcade for daily puzzles, weekly challenges with a turn limit, and variants that change the rules. Enter the same seed to recreate a board you want to play again. In the Studio, arrange tracks, gears, springs, and portals to build your own puzzles. Check that a route is solvable, test it yourself, then save your creation and share it with a level code.

With wooden tracks, candy-colored parts, and an animated marble that brings each route to life, Tinker Bounce feels like tinkering with a toy on your tabletop. Your progress, badges, and personal bests are saved on your device, so you can pick up your puzzle whenever you’re ready for another try.

name: Tivta - Glow & Mood
description:
Tivta brings a little wonder to your day through light, color, and creative inspiration. Explore original light studies, shape expressive moving moods, and keep the colors and discoveries that spark your next idea.

With Tivta, you can:

- Discover light in a new way. Explore 20 original light studies, from soft glows to bold neon moods. Browse by category, search for a title, color, or mood, and zoom in to appreciate the details of each piece.

- Shape your own moving mood. Step into Light Lab and explore Aurora, Orbit, Light Waves, Prism, Starfield, and Neon Rain. Adjust the speed, brightness, and palette to find a combination you enjoy, then expand the effect to fill your screen. Reduce Motion lets you enjoy a still preview whenever you prefer.

- Carry a little color into your next idea. Explore four coordinated palettes and tap any swatch to copy its HEX color. Keep a shade close for a design, an illustration, or a fresh direction for your next creative project.

- Build a collection worth returning to. Save your favorite studies, revisit recently viewed pieces, and find the lights you have shared. Your Collection keeps those discoveries together so it is easy to pick up where inspiration left off.

- Share a spark of inspiration. Send a light-study image through your iPhone's share sheet to a destination you choose. Share a favorite glow with someone or bring a visual reference into another app as your ideas take shape.

Make room for a little light, a new color, and your next creative spark with Tivta.

name: Tokikae
description:
When can you take a meeting, and when do you step away for drop-offs and pick-ups?
See both at a glance next to your work events.

Tokikae is an iPhone app that works out only the time you step away from work for daycare, after-school care, and activity drop-offs and pick-ups. Connect Google Calendar to see it next to your work events and check whether you can take a meeting.

- Just the drop-off and pick-up time
Even if your child is at daycare from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM, you're only tied up for the morning drop-off and the evening pick-up. Add your travel time and Tokikae works out each trip from when you leave to when you're back, such as 8:15–8:45 AM and 5:15–5:45 PM. Set different travel times for each way, like dropping off on your way to the office. For activities, choose whether you leave or wait in between.

- Add to Google Calendar
Connect Google Calendar to add the time you need to block off to a dedicated "Tokikae" calendar automatically. See it next to your work events and know at a glance when you can take a meeting. It covers today through 90 days ahead and moves forward with each sync. Tokikae never reads or changes your other calendars. Make changes in Tokikae: edits made in Google Calendar are restored on the next sync.

- Weekly or on specific dates
Add daycare and weekly activities by day of the week, and events or appointments by date. Set a start or end date for activities that begin next month or end with the school year.

- One-time changes
Skip a day, change the time for one day, or mark a day when your partner is driving.

- Skip Japanese holidays
Skip Japanese holidays for each weekly event (when your home time zone is Tokyo).

- Spot overlaps
Tokikae lets you know when a drive overlaps another event, both while you edit and on the Home screen.

- Reminders before you leave
Get a notification shortly before you need to leave.

- Travel without the confusion
Times are kept in your home time zone, so your schedule and Google Calendar stay the same when your iPhone changes time zones.

- Supported calendars
Tokikae adds to Google Calendar. Outlook and other calendars aren't supported.

- Privacy
No account needed. Your events stay on your iPhone and are never sent to us. No ads or analytics.

- Pricing
Adding events, Home, and departure reminders are free. Adding to Google Calendar is free for 1 month from the day you sign up, then continues as an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Cancel anytime, including during the trial, and you won't be charged if you cancel before it ends. Family Sharing is supported, so one subscription covers your family members at no extra cost.

Read, hear, and play real sheet music.

Tonelore brings score reading, listening, and daily practice together. No account is required, and the core music tools run on your device.

FOLLOW THE SCORE

name: Topclap
description:
Topclap marque les meilleurs moments de votre podcast pendant l’enregistrement, pour que le montage commence avec une timeline déjà annotée.

Pendant que l’émission tourne, une personne garde l’iPhone en main et appuie sur quatre gros boutons. Chaque appui pose un repère horodaté, calé sur le temps affiché par votre console d’enregistrement. À la fin, vous envoyez un fichier au monteur : les marqueurs apparaissent au bon endroit sur la timeline.

QUATRE BOUTONS, QUATRE USAGES
• Jaune, Moment fort : un passage marquant.
• Rouge, Reel potentiel : un extrait court à sortir pour les réseaux.
• Vert, Numéro à l’écran : le moment où un numéro ou une coordonnée doit s’afficher.
• Bleu, Chapitre : renommable selon vos besoins (À couper, Citation, Placement produit…).
Chaque bouton combine une couleur, une forme, une position fixe et un libellé : on le trouve sans regarder, y compris en cas de daltonisme.

UN CHRONO CALÉ SUR VOTRE CONSOLE
• Saisissez le temps affiché sur la console, ou lancez le chrono à 00:00:00 en même temps que le REC.
• Scannez l’écran de la console : la caméra lit le temps sur plusieurs images, vérifie qu’il défile normalement et compense le délai de capture avant de vous proposer le calage.
• Ajustez ensuite au dixième de seconde.
• Le chrono repose sur une horloge monotone et reste juste si vous quittez l’app ou verrouillez l’iPhone. L’écran reste allumé pendant l’enregistrement.

POUR LE TERRAIN
• Retour haptique et confirmation visuelle à chaque appui.
• Rétro-marquage : un moment fort s’annonce souvent après coup, le repère recule automatiquement de quelques secondes, réglable par type.
• Annulation du dernier marqueur, notes, filtres par type, modification après coup.
• Mode une main : tout sous le pouce.
• Mode plein jour : contraste renforcé sous les projecteurs.
• Une session par épisode, sauvegarde automatique.
• Compatible VoiceOver et tailles de texte de l’iPhone.

PRÊT POUR LE MONTAGE
• Premiere Pro : fichier XML qui crée une séquence portant tous les marqueurs.
• DaVinci Resolve : EDL de marqueurs avec leurs couleurs (jaune, rouge, vert, bleu).
• CSV pour les tableurs et JSON pour les scripts.
• Cadence au choix (23,976 à 60 images par seconde, drop frame compris), timecode de départ réglable (01:00:00:00 pour Resolve) et décalage global.
• Partage par AirDrop, Mail, Fichiers ou toute app compatible, ou copie de la liste en texte.

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT SUR L’IPHONE
Pas de compte, pas de serveur, aucune mesure d’audience. Les images du scan sont analysées sur l’appareil puis effacées.

TOPCLAP PRO
Sans abonnement, vous gardez une session, le marquage, le scan et la liste. Topclap Pro débloque les exports pour le montage, la copie de la liste et les sessions illimitées.
Abonnement mensuel à renouvellement automatique de 4,99 € par mois (prix pour la Belgique, il peut varier selon le pays), avec essai gratuit de 7 jours si l’offre est disponible pour votre compte. Le paiement est débité sur votre compte Apple à la confirmation de l’achat ou à la fin de l’essai. L’abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement sauf résiliation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Vous pouvez gérer ou résilier l’abonnement dans les réglages de votre compte Apple.

Conditions d’utilisation (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Politique de confidentialité : https://www.minimalistbelgium.com/topclap-confidentialite

Premiere Pro est une marque d’Adobe. DaVinci Resolve est une marque de Blackmagic Design. Topclap n’est affilié à aucune de ces sociétés : il produit des fichiers dans des formats que ces logiciels savent importer.

Topclap est édité par Minimalist Belgium, à Bruxelles.

name: Topo Maps & PDF Maps: Mapsheet
description:
Mapsheet puts you on your own maps with no signal. Open a geospatial PDF or GeoTIFF (a cutblock map, a fire map, a USGS or NRCan topo, a map made in ArcGIS or QGIS) and Mapsheet shows where you are on it, with accuracy and heading, even in airplane mode.

No account. Your maps, position and points stay on your phone; Mapsheet goes online only when you ask it to, and Offline mode turns that off. Work use is included on every plan.

YOUR MAPS, FROM ANYWHERE
• Geospatial PDFs from ArcGIS, QGIS, Global Mapper, USGS and NRCan, including GeoPDF® files, multi-page atlases and rotated pages
• GeoTIFFs, TIFFs with their world file, and zips, from Mail, Files, Drive or AirDrop
• UTM on every common datum, Canada's provincial systems (BC Albers, Alberta 10TM, MTM, Quebec and Ontario Lambert), Australia's MGA zones, and any projection a map defines itself

IN THE FIELD
• Your position, accuracy and heading, from the phone's GPS or a Bluetooth GNSS receiver that provides location to iOS
• Points with symbols, colours, notes, photos and your own fields (species, DBH…)
• Tracks that keep recording with the phone locked, on the Lock Screen with a Stop button
• Elevation profiles of tracks and lines, with climb and steepest grade
• Measure lines and areas in metres, hectares, feet, miles or acres
• Fix a shape in the field by moving, adding or removing corners
• Distance and bearing from you to any point
• Go to a coordinate in decimal degrees, DMS, UTM or MGRS/USNG, with a UTM grid on any map
• Siri and Action button: drop a point or record a track

GET YOUR WORK OUT
• Export GPX, KML, KMZ and CSV (with UTM columns) on every plan
• Shapefiles for ArcGIS and QGIS on Crew
• Your map with your points, tracks and areas as a geospatial PDF on Field and Crew
• Back up your whole library to one file
• Import GPX, KML, KMZ, CSV and zipped shapefiles onto any map

FREE MAPS AND FIRES (OPTIONAL, ONLINE)
• Ready for no signal: check that an area works offline and fix it in one tap
• Free maps near you from USGS, the Forest Service, NRCan, NSW, Queensland and LINZ, downloaded from the publisher
• Aerial and topo backgrounds for an area: US imagery and topo, New Zealand aerials
• Fire maps from a link or the QR code on a printed map; watched folders flag new maps
• Fire perimeters, incidents and satellite hotspots, saved for no signal, with each fire's age and source. Free on every plan; not for safety decisions

FOR CREWS
• Crew nearby: see your crew on the map and share points with no internet, over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth
• Crew packs: a lead sends maps, points, tracks and photos in one file by AirDrop, Messages or Mail; the crew opens it on any plan
• GPS averaging over 30 seconds for plot centres and corners, with the standard error

PLANS
• Free: 3 maps at a time (an atlas counts as one; fire incident maps don't count), with every field tool and GPX, KML and CSV export.
• Field: unlimited maps and geospatial PDF export. $59.99 a year with two weeks free, or $9.99 a month for seasonal work.
• Crew: everything in Field plus crew packs, starting a crew nearby, GPS averaging and shapefile export, per person. $129.99 a year with two weeks free, or $19.99 a month.
Your maps never lock: if a plan ends you keep every map and everything on it.

Prices are in US dollars; the App Store shows your local price. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before that. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you subscribe.

Privacy policy: https://coderalert0.github.io/mapsheet-site/privacy.html

GeoPDF is a registered trademark of TerraGo Technologies. Mapsheet is not affiliated with TerraGo, Esri, the USGS or NRCan.

name: TouchCart Pocket
description:
TouchCart Pocket is the companion app for TouchCart store owners and their teams. It puts your store's numbers, your shoppers' searches and your store app in your pocket.

INSIGHTS
• Revenue, orders and searches for today, yesterday, the last 7 days or the last 30 days, with the change from the period before.

PREVIEW

name: Trace - Citazioni dai libri
description:
Trace è il quaderno delle frasi che ti restano dai libri. Fotografi la pagina, passi il dito sulle righe che vuoi tenere, come con un evidenziatore, e la citazione resta tua: con il titolo, l'autore e la pagina.

SCATTA E TRACCIA
Inquadra la pagina e scatta, oppure scegli una foto che hai già. Trace legge il testo della foto: tu segui col dito le righe che ti interessano e correggi a mano, se serve, prima di salvare.

LA TUA LIBRERIA
Aggiungi un libro leggendo il codice a barre sul retro o cercandolo per titolo. Ogni citazione finisce nel suo libro; per riviste, dispense e fotocopie puoi aggiungere la fonte a mano.

LA LUCE DI LETTURA
Per leggere al buio senza disturbare: lo schermo diventa una luce calda e tenue, resta acceso finché la usi e, se vuoi, regola da solo la luminosità in base alla luce della stanza.

RIPASSA E RITROVA
Le citazioni tornano a trovarti nel ripasso, così non le dimentichi. Cerca fra tutto quello che hai salvato per parola, libro o autore.

CON GLI AMICI, SE VUOI
Le citazioni sono private. Puoi scegliere di condividerne alcune, o un libro intero, con gli amici che inviti con un link.

SEMPRE TUE
Esporta le tue citazioni quando vuoi, in Markdown, CSV o JSON. Dalle impostazioni dell'account puoi anche eliminare l'account e tutto l'archivio.

LUMANEXAI, FACOLTATIVO
Con un account LumanexAI puoi entrare in Trace, far rileggere una pagina difficile e fare domande sul tuo archivio. Trace funziona anche con email e password.

Trace è gratuito, non ha pubblicità e non traccia nessuno.

name: Trail Champions
description:
One thumb. One decision, over and over: push or recover?

Trail Champions is a side-view trail race for iPhone. Hold your thumb down to push harder and run faster, but it drains your energy. Let go to recover. Climb the hills, survive the heat and reach the finish line before your rivals.

PICK YOUR ANIMAL
Eight animal runners, and each one has a special skill.
- Badger eats more at food stations
- Goat climbs well
- Lynx handles steep climbs
- Fox flies on descents
- Tortoise stays cool in the heat
- Otter loves the rain
- Hare recovers fast
- Raccoon is at its best on flat ground

READ THE TRAIL
Every trail has uphills, downhills and changing weather: mild, hot or rain. Food stations help you refuel, but be careful. A bad meal can make you sick.

RACE THE TOUR
Run a 12-stage Tour with a points standings table. After each stage, your coach tells you what worked and what to try next. Or jump into a Quick race on any trail you have unlocked. Choose Easy, Normal or Hard rivals to match your mood.

MAKE IT YOURS
Pick your runner's fur and shirt colors.

PLAY FREE, UNLOCK ONCE
Download Trail Champions for free. The free part includes the Badger, the Goat, Tour stages 1 to 3 and their trails. A single one-time purchase, Full Game, unlocks the other six animals, all seven trails and Tour stages 4 to 12. There are no ads, no subscriptions and no energy timers. You never have to pay to win a race.

Trail Champions works fully offline. It is a single-player game with no account, and it collects no data. (Buying or restoring the Full Game needs an internet connection once.)

Lace up and find your pace.

name: TranzSuite: B2B Order & Stock
description:
Run your whole wholesale or distribution business from your phone. TranzSuite brings order management, inventory, invoicing and accounting, a B2B ordering portal for your customers, a sales rep app, a delivery driver app and a point of sale together in one system - so nobody types anything twice.

name: TrayTurn
description:
Two classes share one box of brick parts. The morning group wants to keep its models on display, but the afternoon class needs the same axles. TrayTurn helps teachers and workshop leaders see what will be available at each handoff and decide what to change before class.

Plan parts around your timetable
Create a parts inventory and set quantities per group. Schedule when to issue parts, when class starts, when pieces are expected back, and how much time you need to sort them. The Planning Board shows available stock over time and flags shortages at the planned issue time.

Find out what is holding the parts
Open a shortage to see the classes and kept builds that are using the pieces, along with their expected release times. Set a keep-until date for a display model and plan a substitute for a specific group when you have a suitable part.

Try a change before applying it
Adjust a class time, group count, or substitution in a candidate plan. Compare both schedules side by side, including shortages, groups with enough parts, and how many builds can stay on display. When a later handoff helps, see which expected return it depends on.

Issue, return, and prepare again
Record what each group actually receives. Split returns into Ready to Use, Needs Check, and Still Out. Available stock and the next prep list update as you record each return. Finish issuing to close the session's remaining demand when no more parts will be handed out.

Start with the interactive sample or create your own workspace. Export a preparation PDF, shortage and inventory-ledger CSV files, or a restorable JSON backup. Planning and inventory work offline, with no account required. Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: Trend Concord

name: Trezlo
description:
Trezlo is a personal hairstyle record toolkit designed to help you capture every look and follow your hair journey over time.

CREATE YOUR HAIR DIARY
Save a photo or video with a short note whenever you trim, color, style, or refresh your hair. Video records use the first frame as a clear cover image.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Browse your records on a visual calendar. Dates with saved entries show their cover image, making it easy to revisit a look and compare changes over time.

GET HAIRSTYLE INSPIRATION

KEEP YOUR RECORDS PERSONAL

PERSONALIZE YOUR PROFILE
Choose a profile photo and nickname, then keep your hairstyle history connected to your account.

Trezlo is intended for users aged 18 or older. Start recording today and turn every hairstyle into part of your story.

name: Trinity Music

name: Tripfold-Mist trip cards
description:
Tripfold turns an open suitcase photo, or a short weekend note, into one Trip Card. Keep that card on a private Shelf and remake it for the next Friday. It is a personal visual archive for short trips.

Weather on a card is a stamp you choose. Reminders are notes you type. Tripfold does not book flights or hotels, show maps, or provide a live weather forecast.

What you can make
• Open bag. Photograph what is already packed. Style redraw keeps the bag and its layout and changes light and grain. Scene blend keeps the same bag and items and places them in a weekend scene.
• From a brief. No photo is required. Write a short weekend note and mint a card from built-in themes.
• A card back you edit. Choose a weather stamp (sun, cloudy, rain, snow, wind, or any) and an optional temperature note you type. Add three reminders, a caption, and optional notes for timeline, spend, companions, and date.
• Shelf. Search your cards, filter by scene or month, and flip between the picture and the notes. Save to Photos or share when you want to.
• Remake. Open a saved card and mint the next weekend from it.
• My templates. Save a layout you like and reuse it on a later trip.
• This day last year. When a card from the same calendar date is already on this device, Tripfold can point you back to it.
• Year and month summaries. See counts from your own Shelf, and optionally mint a summary image from those local cards.

Weekend themes are built in. There is no public feed.

Generative AI
Trip Cards are images created with generative AI. When you mint a card, the photo or text you submit is sent to produce that image. The result is a creative visual and a set of personal notes. It is not a reservation, a forecast, safety advice, or a promise that an item will be packed.

Privacy
Saved Trip Cards stay on this device until you save them to Photos or share them. Tripfold does not use your photos to build advertising profiles, does not collect faceprints or biometric face templates, and does not include a travel chat.

Purchases
You can create cards with fare tokens (optional one-time packs) or with Harbor Pass. Pack prices are shown in the app before you confirm.

Harbor Pass is an optional auto-renewable subscription. While it is active, creating images in Tripfold does not spend fare tokens. Fare token packs are separate and are not included with Harbor Pass. There is no free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account may be charged for renewal within 24 hours before that period ends. You can manage or cancel at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions. Canceling stops the next renewal. Access continues until the end of the period already paid.


Our Subscription:
Harbor week, Price: $7.00 / 1 week,
