name: TROVIA – Save. Store. Reuse.
description:
Stop losing the things you copy.

TROVIA keeps every link, verification code, address, phone number and note you copy — beautifully organized, instantly searchable and synced across your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

SAVE — AUTOMATICALLY
• On Mac, TROVIA quietly saves everything you copy in any app. A Liquid Glass notification shows what was saved, then gets out of your way.
• On iPhone and iPad, new copies are saved the moment you open TROVIA — or choose to be asked first.
• Prefer control? Switch between Save automatically, Ask me and Off at any time.

STORE — SMART AND ORGANIZED
• Smart categories detect links, one-time codes, contacts, addresses, notes and text automatically.
• A beautiful Home dashboard shows your vault at a glance, with your recent items and quick actions.
• History groups everything by day, with search, category filters and newest/oldest sorting.
• Duplicate finder spots the same text saved twice and merges it in one tap.
• Pin what matters to the top and star your favorites.

REUSE — IN A TAP
• Copy anything back with one tap or click.
• On Mac, the menu bar keeps your latest items one click away — press ⌘1–⌘9 to copy instantly, search your vault, or delete with a quick undo.
• Open links, call numbers, send emails and open addresses in Maps right from an item.
• Save reusable snippets — email replies, addresses, code — and find them instantly with search.
• Select many items at once to copy, favorite or delete them together.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No analytics. No tracking.
• Your vault lives on your devices and syncs only through your own private iCloud database.
• Verification codes are masked by default, copied with an auto-expiring clipboard entry, and can be deleted automatically after 15 minutes, 1 hour or 24 hours.
• Passwords copied from password managers are skipped on Mac.
• Export everything to JSON whenever you like.

DESIGNED FOR APPLE PLATFORMS
• Native SwiftUI app for iPhone, iPad and Mac with smooth animations and Liquid Glass touches.
• Light and Dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support.
• Pull down to sync, open at login on Mac, and a menu bar item that's always ready.

Save it. Store it. Reuse it. That's TROVIA.

name: TruLine Golf
description:
TruLine Golf puts your 24/7 TrackMan iO studio in your pocket.

BOOK SIMULATOR TIME
Open TruLine's booking page in one tap and reserve your time.

YOUR BOOKINGS AND MEMBERSHIP
See your upcoming reservations and how many membership hours you have left. Not a member yet? Browse TruLine's membership plans.

LEAGUE STANDINGS
Follow the TruLine league week by week: points standings, team results and hole-by-hole scorecards.

CLUBHOUSE NEWS
Announcements, events and offers from the studio.

No account is needed to book, see the standings or read the news. Sign in with your email to see your team and choose your notifications.

Bookings, payments and memberships are handled by TruLine's booking system, Your Golf Booking.

name: Truth Train: True or False
description:
The eye of an ostrich is bigger than its brain. True or false? The train is already rolling toward the switch, and you have 30 seconds to decide

Truth Train is an endless true or false game with a roguelike twist. The train drives itself and every switch is a fact. Get it right and a perk waits at the next switch. Get it wrong and the train smashes a barrier and loses a wagon

HOW A RUN GOES
• Read the fact at the switch
• Tap True or False before the 30 seconds are up
• Right: your streak grows and you pick 1 of 2 perks
• Wrong or out of time: the train breaks through the barrier and a wagon falls off
• You start with 3 wagons, and every wagon is a life
• With no wagons left the locomotive rides alone, and the next mistake ends the run

DISTANCE IS YOUR SCORE
Every fact adds meters. Harder facts and longer streaks add more, so a hot streak sends your train flying. The longest distance wins

11 PERKS
• Wagon: one more life
• Coupler: two more lives
• Fork: a skip you keep until you use it
• Hourglass: +10 seconds on each of the next 3 facts
• Coal: +300 meters right away
• Route Map: pick the topic of the next 3 facts
• Express: double meters on the next 3 right answers
• Insurance: your next mistake costs no wagon and keeps your streak
• Turbo: +15% meters for the rest of the run
• Both Ways: take both perks at the next perk switch
• Lucky Clover: each mistake has a 20% chance to cost no wagon

500 FACTS, 10 TOPICS
Space, animals, human body, history, geography, science, food, inventions, culture and nature. Every answer comes with a short explanation, so even a mistake teaches you something. The ostrich? It was true: each eye is about 5 cm across, bigger than the bird's brain. Early facts are easy, later ones get tricky, and no fact comes back until you have seen them all

THE FURTHER YOU RIDE
The scenery changes as the train rolls on: meadows, forests, deserts, snow, even night

LEADERBOARD
Weekly and all-time leaderboards rank the longest runs. Your best distance and best streak stay on your device

WHAT YOU GET
• Free, no account
• Plays offline, only leaderboard runs need internet
• 10 languages
• Sound you can mute, plus a reduced motion setting
• Share your run with friends

Three wagons, one train. How far can you go?

name: TuGPS24 Ultra
description:
TuGPS24 Ultra es la nueva app de TuGPS24 para ver y proteger tus vehículos desde el celular.

• Ubicación en tiempo real de toda tu flota en el mapa.
• Recorridos y paradas de cada día, con velocidad y dirección.
• Alertas de encendido, apagado, entrada y salida de zonas, batería y botón de pánico.
• Apagado y encendido del motor de forma segura, con confirmación.
• Apagados programados a la hora que elijas.
• Documentos del vehículo (SOAT y revisión técnico-mecánica) con avisos antes de que venzan.
• Reportes descargables de recorridos y uso.
• Facturas y pagos en línea, y reporte de pagos con la foto del comprobante.
• GPSito, tu asistente con inteligencia artificial: te dice dónde está tu vehículo, cuánto recorrió y más.
• Contacto directo con la central de monitoreo.

Para usar la app necesitas el servicio de rastreo de TuGPS24. Si eres empleado de TuGPS24, la app también te permite gestionar órdenes de servicio, asistencia e inspecciones de oficina.

name: TuHotelia
description:
TuHotelia es el sistema de gestión para hoteles, hostales y apartamentos turísticos. Con la app, todo tu equipo trabaja desde el celular o el iPad con la misma cuenta del panel web.

- Recepción: calendario de habitaciones, reservas, check-in y check-out, folio y pagos.
- Camareras: tareas de limpieza con cronómetro y evidencia en foto o video, revisada por Raúl, el supervisor con inteligencia artificial.
- Caja y punto de venta: turnos, cierre ciego con fotos del sobre e inventario por área.
- Avisos al instante: reservas nuevas, llamados a camareras, tareas y descuadres llegan como notificación.
- Reservas de Booking.com, Airbnb y Expedia sincronizadas con un channel manager certificado.
- Varios hoteles en una sola cuenta: cada persona ve solo los hoteles que tiene asignados.

La app es para hoteles que ya tienen cuenta de TuHotelia. Las cuentas las crea el administrador de cada hotel desde el panel. Para conocer los planes, visita tuhotelia.com.

name: Tumbleroo Dice Pet
description:
A team of three pets, unpredictable dice rolls, and countless tactical combinations. Tumbleroo is a turn-based combat game where victory depends not only on the dice roll but also on how you use each die face.

Each round, you can save favorable results and reroll the remaining dice up to two times. Consider attacks, defenses, healing, and special abilities before confirming your turn. Importantly, you can always preview your enemy's next action to make the right decision.

Find ways to combine actions to activate Combos and Super Combos, creating stronger attacks or superior defenses. Not all combinations are the same: double hits and electric attacks still count as attacks, while taunts can act as defenses.

Six pets offer six distinct skill sets. Dinko specializes in offense, Zorbo offers tanking, Bumbee provides healing support, Chilly controls ice, Sparky uses electrical magic, and Clubby boosts teammates' power. Unlock new members, upgrade your dice with food, and change your team composition to adapt to each opponent.

Conquer 40 levels across five lands, face monsters with unique fighting styles, and defeat final bosses to earn bonus stars. When ready for a bigger challenge, step into the Tumble Tower.

Here, each floor is a new battle, and your team's health is carried throughout the journey. Spells received after each floor will change the rules of the game, from increasing damage and strengthening shields to expanding cast possibilities and amplifying combos. Build a powerful combination, leverage accumulated advantages, and see how far you can climb.

name: Turneeps
description:
Meet the Turneeps — cheerful little garden friends who only walk the way their arrows point. You can’t turn them by hand. Set off the right events, in the right order, and guide every Turneep onto the home that matches its colour.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a Turneep. It walks until something stops it.
• Bumps, spinners, paint puddles, portals, rafts, belts, gates, snow and sticky honey all switch traits in different ways.
• Finish in as few moves as you can. Par earns three stars.

WHAT’S INSIDE
• 217 handcrafted story levels across eight worlds: The Garden, The Paint Shed, The Pond, The Workshop, The Greenhouse, The Winter Garden, The Orchard and The Bee Meadow.
• New ideas in every world — from high-fives and rainbow homes to lily-pad rafts, conveyor belts, sleepy Dozers, Frosty pushes, mushrooms and honey.
• Endless Garden: unlimited generated puzzles that grow harder as you go.
• Daily Puzzle: one shared puzzle each day, with a streak.
• Optional hints (the wand), Twist and Swap boosters when you want a nudge — every level can still be solved without paying.
• A gentle soundtrack for each world, plus soft sound effects. Music, sound and reduce-motion toggles live in Settings.

FREE TO PLAY
Turneeps is free to download. Optional rewarded videos can earn hints or boosters when you choose them. Short ad breaks may appear between levels (never mid-puzzle). Remove ads and supporter packs are available as one-time purchases. Restore purchases is in the Shop.

Made for calm puzzle fans who like planning a few moves ahead. No chat, no player-to-player contact, no timers that rush you during a puzzle.

Made by Onda Interactive Studios.

name: Turnly: Work Shift Calendar
description:
Your shifts at a glance. Turnly helps you plan mornings, afternoons, nights, 24-hour shifts, post-night days and days off, without an account, ads, purchases or an internet connection.

Paint days or apply a rotating shift pattern, 24/72, 4x4 or your own rotation. Add several shifts to a day and see each one with a color, code and times. View the month or year and add your notes.

A WIDGET THAT CHANGES DAY ON ITS OWN
Check today, the week or the month without opening the app. Day changes depend on system permissions and restrictions.

BACKUPS YOU CAN CHECK
Create local backups and use Test restore to check that they can be recovered. Review the contents before restoring. To change phones, save a .turnly file outside the app and take it to your new device: local backups are lost when you uninstall.

BRING YOUR SHIFTS
Import your .Shifter backup from LRHSoft (Calendario de Turnos) and review the preview before saving. You can also import from your phone’s calendar, .ics or CSV.

PUBLIC HOLIDAYS AND HOURS
Check the included national and regional public holidays for Spain offline. Use the local holidays available for your municipality or add your own manually. Check the summary of worked hours, night and public holiday hours, overtime and early leave. An hourly rate and a fixed allowance per shift help you estimate the month.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Español, català, galego, euskara and English, with a language selector. For healthcare, police, firefighters, industry and anyone who works shifts.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
Everything in the app is free, and the code is open: you can review it and build it yourself. No accounts, no ads, no purchases and no subscriptions.

name: Twist Jam: Bakery Puzzle
description:
Tap the tangled twists and slide them out, one by one.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap a twist and it slides out the way its face points.
- If something blocks the way, it bumps and you lose a heart.
- Freed twists drop into the bag slots below. Collect three of the same flavor to pack them away.
- Clear the board before the bag fills up.

FEATURES
- Boards in many shapes: heart, donut, teddy bear, cat and more
- Five flavors: sugar, chocolate, strawberry, matcha and black sesame rice
- Tied-up twists must be untied before they can slide out
- Tools for when you get stuck: hint, undo and an extra bag slot
- Earn coins and upgrade your bakery step by step: oven, bread display, coffee machine and more

name: UCELI
description:
UCELI brings your cloud resources to your phone. Sign in to view cloud servers, GPU cloud servers, domains, balances and bills, and stay in touch with support.

ACCOUNT OVERVIEW
Check your balance, resource counts, upcoming expirations and recent activity.

CLOUD AND GPU SERVERS
View instance configurations, status and billing details. Available actions depend on the resource you select.

DOMAINS AND DNS
Review domain status, expiration dates, DNS records and renewal settings in one place.

RESOURCE MONITORING
View available CPU, memory, network and disk metrics. Metrics depend on resource type and monitoring setup.

BILLING AND SUPPORT
Review spending, renewals and balance changes. Keep support conversations and track ticket progress.

ACCOUNT SECURITY
Manage security settings and review signed-in devices and login history.

A UCELI account is required. Resources and services may be billed separately. Available locations, configurations, prices and actions are shown in the app.

Support: support@uceli.com
Website: https://uceli.com

name: UCKosher
description:
UCKosher shows the kosher menus at campus dining halls in one simple place.

• Every hall and meal: Bartlett, Cathey, Woodlawn and Baker, for breakfast, lunch and dinner
• Today and tomorrow at a glance
• Filter by hall and meal in a tap
• Tap any dish for ingredients and nutrition
• Color-coded labels: green for dietary, amber for contains, dashed for may contain
• Clear notices when dining halls are closed for a break

Menus are checked for obvious errors but can still be incomplete or change during the day. Always check labels and ask dining staff about allergens. UCKosher is not a kosher certification.

UCKosher is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of Chicago or DineOnCampus. Menu data is sourced from DineOnCampus.

name: Uit de Hoed: Secret Santa
description:
Drawing names for Christmas or Secret Santa at work? With Uit de Hoed it's sorted in a minute. Everyone joins on their own phone, with no account, email address or password.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a group and choose the occasion, date and budget.
2. Share the code or link in the family or team chat.
3. Everyone adds their wishlist, with links and prices.
4. Draw the names. Everyone only sees their own match.

DRAW LIVE TOGETHER
Draw names together, even when you're apart. Everyone joins the waiting room, the organizer presses start and every phone counts down at the same time. The hat shakes and everyone gets their own match.

TRULY SECRET
Only you see who you drew. Not even the organizer can peek.

WISHLISTS
Add your wishes with a link to the shop, the price and a note like your size. Your giver sees right away what you'd like.

ASK ANONYMOUSLY
Not sure about size or colour? Ask your match a question. They can reply, but won't know it's you.

HANDY FOR EVERY GROUP
• Exclusions: partners or housemates don't draw each other
• Participants without a phone, like grandma: the organizer manages their match
• Notifications when names are drawn and when there's a message for you
• See anonymously how many gifts have been bought and wrapped
• Next year again, without the same pairs
• Organize without taking part yourself, ideal for Secret Santa at work
• The Dutch Sinterklaas tradition with surprise and poem is built in too
• New phone? Move your spot with your recovery code

PRIVACY FIRST
No ads, no tracking and no account needed. Your data is stored on servers in the EU and you can delete it yourself with one tap.

Uit de Hoed is made by JansenDigital.nl. Want an app or website built? Visit jansendigital.nl.

name: Unbottle
description:
Say what's been bottled up.

Most couples talk all day about bills, chores and plans. Unbottle makes room for the rest, with one good question a day to talk about, out loud and together.

HOW IT WORKS
One of you asks. The other answers, and you just listen. Then you swap. Tap any card for three follow-up questions that go deeper.

A DECK FOR EVERY KIND OF NIGHT
Love. Affirmations. Dating. Self. Family & Roots. Intimacy. Pick what fits the mood.

MADE FOR THE TWO OF YOU
• Link with your partner using a private invite
• Get the same question each day
• Save the cards you want to come back to
• Keep your streak of nights talked going
• Set a gentle daily reminder

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your answers are spoken, never recorded. The app doesn't use your microphone. Journal notes are only for you, and your partner can't read them. No ads, and we never sell your data.

IF IT FEELS HEAVY
Pause any card to take a breath, skip it, or find support. There's no score and no rush.

Unbottle is for adults aged 18 and over. It offers conversation prompts and is not a replacement for therapy or professional care.

Terms: https://unbottle.life/terms

name: Unsent: No Contact Breakup
description:
Unsent is the app you open instead of texting them.

It's 2am and your thumb is already on their name. Open Unsent. You get a chat screen that looks like a real thread. Type everything you want to say and hit send. It never leaves your phone. The message folds into an envelope and goes into your private vault.

Then you breathe for about a minute while the reasons you wrote down on day one show up on screen. The urge drops. Your streak is still there.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- A big "I want to text them" button on the home screen. One tap when the urge hits.
- The unsent chat. Say it exactly how you'd say it. Nothing gets delivered, ever.
- Breathing, about a minute, with your own "remember why" reasons.
- Your no-contact streak, with milestones at 1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days.
- The vault. Every text you didn't send, with the date and time. Reading them back a month later hits different.
- A 10-second daily check-in.
- If you slip and text them, the streak resets quietly and your longest streak stays on record. Nobody lectures you.

MILESTONE CARDS
Day 7, day 30, day 90. Share a card to your story when you hit one. Their name never shows up on it.

PRIVATE
No account and no sign-up. Your letters stay on your phone.

ALWAYS FREE
The panic button, your streak, the breathing and the helplines are free forever. We won't put those behind a paywall.

UNSENT PRO
Pro gets you:
- Your whole letter vault. On the free plan your latest 5 letters stay readable and older ones stay saved but sealed.
- Unsent postcards
- Your patterns, like your hardest hour and your mood trend
- Extra card styles

Start with a 3-day free trial, then pick one:
- Yearly: $39.99/year
- Weekly: $6.99/week
- Lifetime: $79.99, paid once

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. Prices are in USD and may vary by country.

PLEASE READ
Unsent is a self-help journal for getting through a breakup. It is not a medical or mental health service and it doesn't replace professional help. If you're in crisis or thinking about hurting yourself, call local emergency services or a crisis line now. US: call or text 988. UK: Samaritans 116 123. India: Tele-MANAS 14416. Anywhere else: findahelpline.com. If you type something that sounds like a crisis, Unsent shows you these numbers.

Questions: deepanshu1422+unsent@gmail.com
Privacy Policy: https://getunsent.up.railway.app/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://getunsent.up.railway.app/terms
Support: https://getunsent.up.railway.app/support

name: Untangly: Arrow Logic Puzzles
description:
Untangle the arrows, one tap at a time.

Every arrow moves the way its tip points, and its body follows. If the path is clear, it slides off the board. If something is in the way, it stops right in front of it, and that can open or close the way for others. Clear every arrow in as few moves as you can.

MORE THAN TAPPING
• After the first few warm-up levels, every level needs a plan: sometimes you must slide an arrow partway first to make room for another.
• No lives, no hearts, no timers. Undo and restart are always free.
• Stuck? A hint shows the next good move.
• Earn up to 3 stars by finishing on the target move count.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 100 free levels in 4 packs: First Steps, Twists, Stones and Knots
• Stones: fixed blocks that arrows stop against
• A new daily puzzle every midnight, the same for everyone. Keep your streak and share your result without spoiling it.
• Every level is made by Untangly's own generator and checked by a solver

UNTANGLY PLUS · one-time purchase
• The Maze pack with bigger 8×8 boards, and future packs
• Unlimited hints
No subscription. Family Sharing supported.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone.

From the makers of Tangly.

name: UseCurve
description:
Pay per visit, buy a pack, or get a pass? UseCurve shows what each option would cost for the dates you plan to go.

Imagine twelve trips to the climbing gym. Make them in the first few weeks and a pass might come out ahead. Spread those same trips across three months and paying at the door might cost less. With Schedule Lab, you can try both before you decide.

COMPARE YOUR OPTIONS
Enter your own prices for a gym, class, study room, or coworking space. Compare up to three payment plans on one calendar and trace their cost curves. See when you'd need another pack or pass, how many pack credits might expire, and when adding visits changes the cheapest option.

KEEP TRACK AS YOU GO
Save your estimate, then tap "I used it" to log a visit. Add missed visits in batches and record payments separately. Review shows how often you planned to go, how often you went, and what you paid per visit on average.

REPLAY THE DATES YOU WENT
Planned twelve visits and made six? Run those six dates through the prices and rules you saved with your estimate. See what each option would have cost alongside what you actually paid.

Works offline without an account. Set optional expiry reminders, export activity to CSV, share PDF reports, and back up or restore your library.

Prices are entered in USD. Passes are calculated using a set number of days.

name: Vahanex - GPS Vehicle Tracking
description:
Vahanex is a state-of-the-art GPS tracking and intelligent fleet management platform designed to keep your vehicles secure, optimize routes, and provide complete peace of mind. Whether you manage a commercial fleet, transport vehicles, or want 24/7 security for your personal car or bike, Vahanex delivers powerful real-time tracking, advanced anti-theft controls, and in-depth operational analytics right at your fingertips.

Track Smarter, Go Further with Vahanex.

KEY FEATURES:

• Real-Time Live Tracking
View the exact location of all your vehicles on high-precision interactive maps with live speed, direction, ignition status (ON/OFF), and motion trails updated second by second.

• Interactive Route History & Playback
Never lose track of where your vehicles have been. Replay past journeys with full speed data, stops, idle time, and distance covered over any selected date range.

• Smart Geofences & Safe Zones
Create customized circular and polygonal geofences around warehouses, offices, homes, or frequent destinations. Receive instant entry and exit notifications whenever a vehicle crosses the perimeter.

• Anti-Theft & Instant Security Alerts
Protect your asset against unauthorized use. Get immediate push notifications for:
- Ignition ON / OFF status
- Unauthorized vehicle movement & towing
- Overspeeding violations
- Power cut & wire tampering alerts
- Emergency SOS button triggers
- Parking mode & vibration detection

• Comprehensive Reports & Export
Make data-driven decisions with rich analytical reports:
- Trip & Route Summary Reports
- Ignition & Idle Time Analysis
- Stoppage & Parking Duration Reports
- Activity & Event Logs
- E-Lock Status & History
Export your reports to PDF and CSV directly from your device for easy sharing and record-keeping.

• Multi-Vehicle & Fleet Grouping
Easily manage 1 to 10,000+ vehicles under a single account. Group vehicles by branch, driver, or operational zones, and delegate role-based access to team members.

• In-App Support & Device Health
Directly raise support tickets, troubleshoot connectivity, and monitor tracker hardware health without leaving the app.

WHO IS VAHANEX FOR?
- Fleet owners & logistics operators
- Cab, taxi, and delivery services
- School bus & employee transport operators
- Personal car, motorcycle, and EV owners

name: ValimoKankaa
description: ValimoKankaa on optisen linssin hionta- ja kiillotuslaskin. Sovellus laskee hiomalaikan säteen, pyörimisnopeuden, paineen, hiomarakeisuuden ja kiillotustuloksen. Liukusäätimillä säädetään kaarevuutta, vettä ja hionta-ainetta, jotta pinta on optisen kirkas. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta, ja kaikki toimii täysin offline-tilassa.

name: VANTA Events
description:
Your night starts here.

VANTA is the official app for VANTA events. See what's coming up, grab your ticket in seconds and have it right on your phone on the night – no printing, no digging through your inbox, no signal needed.

It all kicks off with VANTA INIT on December 11, 2026, at LA18 Foundation in Berlin.


FOR GUESTS

DISCOVER
• All upcoming VANTA events at a glance
• Date, doors, city, venue and line-up – everything you need for the night
• See right away how many days are left

TICKETS IN SECONDS
• Ticket phases like Early Bird and Regular – see instantly which one is live and what it costs
• Up to 10 tickets per order, so your whole crew is covered
• The price you see is the final price – no hidden fees
• Pay securely via Stripe: card, Apple Pay, Klarna, Amazon Pay or Link
• You only enter payment details on Stripe's checkout page – never in the app

YOUR TICKET. ALWAYS WITH YOU.
• Your ticket is in “Meine Tickets” (My Tickets) right after you buy it
• Show the QR code at the door – done
• Works offline too, even in a club with zero signal
• You also get every ticket by email

TICKETS FROM THE WEB
• Bought on tickets.hellovanta.com? Sign in to the app with the same email address and your tickets show up in “Meine Tickets” automatically

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR DATA
• No tracking, no ads
• Delete your account anytime, right in the app


FOR THE VANTA TEAM

Every night has a team behind it. The app is their tool too – from the first idea to the last guest.

EVENTS
• Create events with cover, line-up, ticket phases and capacity
• Prepare them as drafts and publish with a single tap

PLANNING
• Overview with countdown, milestones and everything due this week
• Tasks as list, board or calendar – with owners, deadlines and comments
• Areas like tech, staff, security & awareness, promo or finance
• Start planning in seconds with a template

TICKETING
• Revenue, tickets sold and guests inside – live
• Manage ticket categories and quotas
• Guest list with search, filters and check-in – including groups with plus-ones

DOOR
• Scan tickets with the camera and get the result instantly: valid, already inside, refunded or invalid
• Keeps working without internet and syncs as soon as it's back online
• Several doors at once, each with its own name

LIVE COUNTER
• How many guests are inside right now – against capacity, with a warning at 90 %
• Entries per door and per hour, including the peak
• Count box office sales and guests leaving with a single tap

TEAM
• Invite members by email
• Set roles and door access for each person

Team features are only available to invited members of the VANTA team.

VANTA events are strictly 18+.

The app is currently in German.

See you on the dancefloor.

name: Vault Secure Store
description:
Vault keeps your two-factor codes and payment cards in one small, fast app, encrypted with keys only your devices hold.

CODES
• Time-based and counter-based codes, and Steam Guard codes
• Add accounts by scanning a QR code, choosing a screenshot, pasting a setup link or typing the key
• Import from other authenticator apps
• Tap or click a code to copy it. Copied codes stay on your device and clear themselves
• Codes stay hidden until you need them
• Sort by name, by date added or in your own order

CARDS
• Keep card numbers, expiry dates and security codes, with the card network’s logo
• Numbers stay masked until you choose to show them, and each detail copies with one tap

SECURITY
• Everything is encrypted with AES-256 on your device
• Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or your vault password, never your device passcode
• The synced copy needs your password and a Secret Key that never leaves your devices, so it can’t be read even with full access to your iCloud account
• Vault hides itself in the app switcher and from screen recordings
• On the Mac, Vault can’t connect to the internet at all
• No accounts, no analytics, no tracking

SYNC
• Sync your iPhone, iPad and Mac through a folder you choose in your own iCloud Drive
• Changes merge code by code and card by card

Vault is made by R.N.A.

name: Vectomorph
description:
Enter Vectomorph, a neon puzzle laboratory where every arrow is a reactive experiment.

Red arrows split into smaller forms, blue arrows fuse into stronger levels, yellow arrows rotate after moving, and purple arrows consume weaker targets. Select an arrow, study the board, and trigger the right transformation to complete each objective.

Explore five distinct modes: recreate exact formations in Morph Puzzle, build powerful






Enter Vectomorph, a futuristic puzzle laboratory where arrows are living energy experiments. Every arrow follows a distinct mutation rule: red arrows split into smaller forms, blue arrows fuse into stronger levels, yellow arrows rotate after moving, and purple arrows consume weaker targets.

Explore five specialized modes. Recreate exact formations in Morph Puzzle, plan powerful combinations in Fusion Lab, cover target cells in Split Challenge, prepare cascading reactions in Chain Mutation, or manage an evolving board in Endless Experiment.

Select an arrow and move it to an adjacent cell while considering direction, level, terrain, and available space. Use undo, restart, and hints to refine each solution. Complete 210 handcrafted stages, earn stars, unlock new experiments, track detailed statistics, and pursue laboratory achievements.

Master every mutation, discover efficient reaction sequences, and turn a simple grid of arrows into a carefully controlled scientific chain reaction.

name: Vegastars Reels
description:
Make every fishing trip part of your story with Vegastars Reels!

Vegastars Reels is a personal fishing journal designed for anglers who want to organize their catches, equipment, favorite locations, and fishing experiences in one convenient app.

Record what you catch, keep track of rods, reels, and tackle, save fishing spots on the map, and explore weather conditions and moon phases when planning your next fishing adventure.

Whether you enjoy weekend fishing, exploring new lakes, or returning to your favorite spots, Vegastars Reels helps you build a personal history of your fishing experiences.

YOUR PERSONAL FISHING JOURNAL

• Record catches from fishing trips
• Save fish species and catch details
• Keep track of fishing rods and reels
• Organize lures, bait, and tackle
• Mark favorite fishing locations on the map
• Review weather conditions
• Explore moon phases and fishing activity indicators
• Keep a history of fishing adventures
• Compare previous fishing experiences
• Prepare for upcoming trips

KEY FEATURES

• Catch Journal — Record your catches, dates, fish species, and personal observations.

• Fishing Gear Tracker — Organize information about your rods, reels, lures, bait, and other fishing equipment.

• Fishing Spots Map — Save favorite lakes, rivers, and fishing locations for future visits.

• Weather Information — Review weather conditions to help organize your fishing activities.

• Moon Phase Guide — Explore lunar phases and traditional moon-based fishing activity indicators.

• Trip History — Keep records of previous fishing sessions and memorable catches.

• Personal Fishing Notes — Save useful observations about fishing conditions, equipment, and locations.

• Fishing Experience Tracker — Build a personal record of your adventures over time.

PLAN YOUR NEXT FISHING ADVENTURE

Vegastars Reels combines fishing records, equipment organization, and location tracking in one simple experience.

Keep your favorite spots, remember successful trips, and discover patterns in your personal fishing history.

Moon-based fishing indicators are provided for general informational purposes and do not guarantee fish activity or successful catches. Weather information should not replace official forecasts or safety warnings.

name: Velferdsappen
description:
Velferdsappen er appen til velferdsklubben på arbeidsplassen din. Her ser du hva klubben arrangerer, melder deg på, booker hytta og finner rabattene medlemmene har.

Aktiviteter

Booking

Avtaler og faste tilbud

• Faste tilbud som billetter og utlån av utstyr.

Nyheter og Dialog
• Nyheter og notiser fra klubben, med bilder, faktabokser og kart.
• Send forslag til klubben og følg svaret, stem i avstemninger, ta ukens quiz og spill daglige spill.

Kontakt
• Se hvem som sitter i styret, og send en henvendelse til klubben.

Varsler
• Få varslene klubben sender ut, som påminnelser og nye arrangementer, rett på iPhonen.

Tilgang
• Du får tilgang gjennom velferdsklubben på arbeidsplassen din, med en invitasjon eller en tilgangskode.

name: Velkoryn
description:
Velkoryn to mały warsztat z dwoma stołami. Na szlifie ustawiasz ziarno, olej, nacisk i czas, a czytasz klarowność i ciepło. Na oprawie ustawiasz napięcie, żar, zwoje, gniazdo i kolejność, a czytasz chwyt i blask.

Jeden krok naraz. Bez żyć, bez stopera, bez reklam i bez konta. To, co zapiszesz, zostaje w tym telefonie.

• 64 kroki szlifu — poleruj bursztyn i czytaj klarowność
• 78 kroków oprawy — osadź kamień i czytaj chwyt
• Księga trzyma tylko rozwiązania, które sam wybierzesz
• Ścieżka otwiera się po kolei; zamknij okno, a otworzy się następny krok

Velkoryn nie zbiera i nie wysyła danych. Bez analityki i bez reklam. Jeśli usuniesz aplikację, warsztat znika.

name: VelloSea: Tides of Light
description:
The light has gone out of the reef. Only Auri can bring it back.

VelloSea: Tides of Light is a calm, glowing ocean arcade game. Drag Auri through the dark water to draw trails of light, then close each trail to reclaim that part of the reef. Fill the level's light target before the tide runs out, and keep clear of the creatures that guard the shadows.

124 LEVELS ACROSS 13 COVES
• Journey from the Pearl Shallows through Lantern Kelp, the Moonlit Trench, Coralglass Reach and beyond to the Aurora Sanctuary
• Every cove ends with a guardian boss: the Prism Spear, the Opal Choir, the Velvet Eclipse, the Gyre Keeper and more
• Wake the sleeping buds hidden in each level to restore the reef

LEARN THE CREATURES
• Siltfin and Driftveil wander, Brinewisp and Glassdart charge, Siphon Ray pulls the water, Echojelly, Mirrorfin, Inkmoth, Thornwarden and the Crown Nautilus each have their own tricks
• Watch for the warning before a dash and slip past sideways
• The deeper you go, the faster and more possessive the guardians become

EASY TO PICK UP
• One-finger controls: drag Auri where you want her to swim and tap Reel to close your trail
• Collect power-ups and use them when the shadows close in
• Hand-crafted 3D sea creatures that swim, drift and glide like the real thing
• Short, relaxing levels made for a quiet moment

VelloSea is free to play with ads between levels. Remove Ads is a one-time purchase, or pick up a 10-Day Ad-Free Pass.

Bring the tide of light home.

name: Vendezo
description:
O Vendezo é o CRM de vendas e atendimento pelo WhatsApp da sua empresa: todas as conversas, de todos os números, num lugar só, com uma assistente de IA atendendo junto com a equipe.

Importante: o Vendezo é para empresas que já usam o sistema. Para entrar, você precisa de um usuário criado pela sua empresa no Vendezo. Não há cadastro pelo app.

CAIXA DE ENTRADA ÚNICA
• Conversas de todos os números da empresa juntas, pela API oficial do WhatsApp (Meta) ou pelo QR code
• Filtros por não lidas, etiqueta e departamento
• Transfira a conversa para outra pessoa ou departamento sem perder o histórico
• Envie texto, áudio, fotos, vídeos e arquivos
• Respostas rápidas: digite / e escolha

ASSISTENTE DE IA
• Responde na hora seguindo as instruções da sua empresa: produtos, prazos e jeito de falar

FUNIL E ACOMPANHAMENTO
• Etiquetas e etapas do seu jeito
• Aviso de compra para a equipe
• Follow-up para quem parou de responder e pós-venda
• Início com o resumo do dia: conversas, clientes aguardando, tempo de resposta e desempenho da equipe

EQUIPE

name: Venora Store
description:
Discover your perfect style with VENORA. Explore a carefully selected collection of modern clothing designed to combine elegance, comfort, and everyday style.

Shop a variety of fashion essentials for men and women, including stylish outfits, shirts, jeans, and more. Find your favorite looks, explore the latest collections, and enjoy a convenient shopping experience all in one place.

VENORA – Elegance That Fits You.

name: VeriPhone Lite
description:
VeriPhone Lite checks that your iPhone's hardware works. Tap a test, follow the steps on the screen and see the result: passed or failed.

Whether you are buying, selling or just curious about the condition of a phone, VeriPhone Lite gives you a quick and clear picture.

WHAT YOU CAN TEST
• Screen: touchscreen, multitouch and dead pixels
• Audio: speakers and microphones
• Cameras: rear camera, front camera, autofocus and TrueDepth
• Hardware: buttons, flash, vibration and storage
• Motion: gyroscope, accelerometer and compass
• Sensors: proximity, light sensor and biometrics
• Wireless: Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and NFC
• Connectivity: charging and GPS

HOW IT WORKS
Run all the tests in one go, pick only the ones you want, or start a whole group. Your latest results are saved on your phone so you can review them at any time.

PRIVACY

name: Veylune · Paisajes sonoros
description:
Veylune convierte sonidos naturales que desaparecen en una voz visual que respira.

Acércate al trino de un pájaro, la lluvia en las hojas, un arroyo, la cigarra, la marea, el viento, la leña crepitando o las gotas del alero. La app crea una voz visual única en tiempo real. Ajusta suavidad, partículas, color, opacidad y ritmo, guarda la imagen o conserva el audio y la imagen juntos.

Las estaciones y los paisajes cambian el carácter de la voz; también puedes fijar lluvia, bosque o mar. En la Sonoteca puedes escuchar, marcar, escribir lo que sentiste y guardar tus imágenes. En Deriva, encuentra un fragmento natural anónimo y escúchalo sin prisa.

Cada obra nace de tus propias grabaciones. Todo se guarda en tu dispositivo.

name: Viantryp
description:
Viantryp es la plataforma moderna para viajeros y organizadores de viajes que transforma la forma de planificar, estructurar y compartir itinerarios.

Reúne todos los detalles de tu próximo viaje en un lienzo visual, interactivo y siempre accesible desde tu iPhone o iPad:

• Diseño de Itinerarios día a día: Organiza vuelos, alojamientos, traslados y actividades en una línea de tiempo clara y atractiva.
• Mapas y Ubicaciones integradas: Visualiza tus paradas y lugares de interés directamente en el itinerario.
• Asistente Inteligente Tryp IA: Obtén sugerencias e ideas para complementar tus rutas en segundos.
• Documentos y Soportes en un solo lugar: Adjunta reservas, vouchers y archivos importantes a cada actividad.

name: Vinilogy: precios de vinilos
description:
Vinilogy compara los precios de hoy de discos de vinilo en más de 50 tiendas de España, online y físicas, de Madrid a Barcelona, Bilbao, Valencia o Sevilla.

Busca un disco o un grupo y verás en qué tiendas está, a qué precio y con el enlace para comprarlo. Si hay varias ediciones (la estándar, la de color, la de aniversario), aparecen separadas para que sepas qué estás comprando.

AVISOS DE TU WISHLIST
Guarda discos en tu wishlist (el corazón) y la app te avisa cuando uno baja de precio o vuelve a estar en tienda. No hace falta crear cuenta.

ESCÁNER DE CÓDIGO DE BARRAS
En la tienda o en casa, apunta la cámara al código de barras de un disco y mira al momento dónde más lo tienen y a qué precio.

DESCUBRE MÚSICA
Recomendaciones de discos afines a los que te gustan, colecciones por estilo, novedades y preventas, y una forma de buscar por «vibra»: qué te apetece escuchar, no solo el nombre de un grupo.

TU COLECCIÓN
Si usas Discogs o Last.fm, conecta tu cuenta: la app sabe qué discos ya tienes, importa tu wantlist y afina las recomendaciones con lo que escuchas.

TIENDAS DE AQUÍ
Vinilogy enlaza a tiendas de discos de España. No vendemos nada ni cobramos a las tiendas por aparecer.

Sin publicidad y sin rastreadores de terceros.

name: VisionSub
description:
VisionSub - Spatial Cinema Subtitles for visionOS

VisionSub is a dedicated web extension for visionOS designed to restore subtitle visibility when watching Netflix in Fullscreen and Environment modes.

Key Features:
• Seamless Spatial Cinema Support: Integrates directly with the native WebVTT subtitle engine on visionOS to render crisp, perfectly synchronized subtitles in your 3D spatial viewing environment.

name: Vistal
description:
Your eyes sound sure of themselves. They are often wrong.
Vistal turns classic perception tricks into one hundred short experiments. Look, make a call, then see the answer and why it happened: matching lines, a circle that never moved, the one detail you skipped. The fun is realizing how cleanly you were fooled.
Experiments cover visual illusions, motion that only seems to move, spatial judgment, and attention. Take the daily one, try a random challenge, or browse by type.
For anyone who likes to play with what they see, and wants to know why it worked.
illusion,optical,perception,attention,spatial,puzzle,brain,motion,vision,trick,focus,quiz,mind,geometry,color
Vistal is a perception-illusion app. The person looks at a figure, makes a judgment, and then reads the correct answer and a short account of why the illusion works. There are one hundred experiments in four groups: Visual Illusions, Motion Illusions, Spatial Illusions, and Attention Tests.
Two appearances are part of the design. A motion figure looks as if it rotates or drifts, but the drawing stays still. That is the illusion. Some attention figures disappear after about two seconds, so they should be read before they vanish. After an answer is submitted, the figure may add guide marks that show the true length, color, or position.
The tab bar has Home, Explore, and My Lab.
On Home, Daily Experiment opens the one experiment set for the day. Start Now opens a single experiment at random. Experiment Library has four cards. A card opens that whole group, and Next walks through it in order. Today's Progress shows how many of the day's five experiments are done.
On the experiment screen, read the question, study the figure, and tap one answer. The app judges the choice at once. The answer buttons close. A banner shows whether the choice was right and states the correct answer. The heading "Why does this happen?" introduces the principle. Retry repeats the same experiment. Next opens the following one. On the last experiment the button says Done. The upper-left control goes back. The heart at the upper right marks a favorite, and a second tap clears that mark.
Explore lists every experiment. The chips All, Visual, Motion, Spatial, and Attention filter the list. Tap a row to start there and continue through the later rows of the current filter.
My Lab shows Completed, Accuracy, Attempts, and Favorites, followed by Accuracy by Category, the Favorites list, and Recent Trials. Tap a row to open that experiment again. Terms of Use and Privacy Policy are at the bottom and open inside the app. Those two pages need a network connection. If a page cannot load, the app asks the reviewer to check the connection and try again.
A useful review pass is: on Home, tap Start Now and finish one experiment; open Motion Illusions and confirm that the figure only seems to move; then visit Explore and My Lab, and open both policy pages.

name: VNSNews
description:
VNSNews là ứng dụng đọc tin công nghệ nội bộ dành cho nhân viên công ty.

• Tin công nghệ và AI từ nhiều nguồn trong nước và quốc tế, đã được tóm tắt và dịch sang tiếng Việt

name: Voksis
description:
Voksis, metin tabanlı ve mekan odaklı bir sosyal platformdur. Fotoğraf yok, gösteriş yok: sadece düşünceler, sorular ve yakınındaki insanlar.

İZ BIRAK — Aklındakini paylaş, kelimeleri bağla, başkalarının izlerini yeniden vokslat. İzlere yorum yap, yanıtla ve beğen.

MEKANLARA KATIL — Bulunduğun kafede, parkta, kampüste odaya gir. Kimler aktif gör, mekanın tahtını ele geçir. Odadaki herkesle birlikte şarkı dinle.

TAKİP VE GİZLİLİK — Hesabını gizli yapabilir, kimlerin sana mesaj atabileceğini sen seçebilirsin.

name: VolleyTrack: Volleyball Scorer
description:
Keep score from the stands with one tap.

VolleyTrack is a volleyball scorekeeper for parents, coaches and players. Tap the team that won each point, and the app keeps the score, the sets and who is serving, so you can watch the match instead of keeping it in your head. Afterwards, see how each set swung and share the result with the team.

SCORE EVERY POINT WITH ONE TAP
• Two big team cards on a court: tap the one that won the point
• Sets to 25 and a deciding set to 15, best of 3 or best of 5, or your own targets
• Who serves, shown on the card; Ace +1 for a quick ace
• Timeouts for each team, with how many are left
• Undo any point
• Works with no signal; every point is saved on your phone as you go

ADD WHO SCORED, IF YOU SAW IT
Choose Simple for one-tap scoring, Detailed to add how the point was won (ace, kill, block, opponent error), or Players to credit the jersey number from your roster. Every detail is optional, and you can switch styles during the match.

SEE HOW EACH SET SWUNG
• Momentum: every point of every set, the leads and the runs
• Points won, biggest lead, side-out and points won on your own serve
• Aces, kills, blocks and errors, from the points you recorded
• Player credits for each jersey number
Numbers only count what you tapped. Nothing extra to track.

SHARE IT WITH THE TEAM
Share a picture of the final score by Messages or any app. A PDF season report and CSV files are there for anyone who wants every number.

KEEP THE WEEKEND TOGETHER
Group matches by tournament, keep saved opponents with your record against them, and see each team's season: wins, losses and every match.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Teams, rosters and matches stay on your phone. Nothing leaves it unless you share or export it. Back up and restore everything with one file.

SUBSCRIPTION
VolleyTrack is free to download. Starting new matches needs a subscription: $2.99 a month or $9.99 a year, each with a one-month free trial for new subscribers. Prices may vary by country. Matches you've already saved stay yours to view, share and export, with or without a subscription. With Family Sharing, one subscription covers your family.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends, or when you confirm if no trial applies. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Vyro turns every practice and match into real data. See how far you ran, how fast you went, and where you spent your time on the field.

TRACK YOUR GAME
• Distance covered, top speed and sprint count for every session
• Heat maps that show where you played on the pitch
• Your route, replayed on the field

TWO WAYS TO TRACK
• Vyro Tracker: wear the tracker during play, then import your sessions over Bluetooth in seconds

COMPARE AND IMPROVE

name: Waddle Glide
description:
Waddle Glide is a cozy sliding puzzle game where every swipe counts!

Help adorable penguins slide across the ice and reach their warm igloo. But be careful: penguins keep sliding until something stops them. Plan your moves, use the ice blocks, and avoid holes and sneaky seals.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe in any direction to slide your penguin
• Stop at the right spot using ice blocks and walls
• Gather all penguins at the igloo to finish the level
• Beat each level in fewer moves to earn more stars

FEATURES
• 60+ handcrafted puzzle levels
• Multiple icy worlds, each with a new twist: cracking ice, moving floes and more
• Simple one-finger controls, easy to learn and hard to master
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level
• Cute, colorful arctic art and relaxing sounds
• Works offline, play anywhere
• Perfect for quick breaks or long puzzle sessions

Whether you love brain teasers, logic puzzles or just adorable penguins, Waddle Glide is a fun way to train your mind.

Download now and start sliding!

name: Waitiii - Interval Timer
description:
A beep, right on time. Waitiii - Interval Timer is an interval beep timer for everyday routines: brushing your teeth, working out, working in focused blocks.

TWO WAYS TO TIME
• Simple mode: one duration and a regular beep. Two minutes of brushing, a beep every 30 seconds.
• Sequences: named steps, repeated as often as you need. 40 s work, 20 s rest, 8 rounds. Pomodoro 25/5 × 4. A beep at every step change, and a 3-2-1 countdown if you want one.

SEVERAL TIMERS AT ONCE
Run up to four timers at the same time. Each has its own color and sound, and you switch between them with a swipe.

EVEN WHEN LOCKED
The beeps keep going when your phone is locked, and so does your music: its volume dips for a moment at each beep, then comes back. On iPhone, the time left and the current step show on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. On Android, in the notification.

AN ENDING YOU CHOOSE
A short sound, or a real alarm that rings until you stop it, like the iPhone timer.

SIX SOUNDS
Crystal, Wood, Bell, Drop, Pulse, Singing bowl: sounds that ring out until silence. Pick one for the beeps and one for the end, for each timer.

PRECISE AND POLISHED
Time is measured against the real clock, never by adding up seconds: no drift, even after an hour. French and English, light and dark themes, fixed-width digits, haptic feedback.

No account, no ads, no data collected. Everything stays on your phone.

name: Wakelant
description:
The keeper left the road dark on purpose. Sixteen lanterns still remember their names. Light them in order, and the night will answer.
Wakelant is a journey down a keeper’s road of sixteen seals. Each chapter hides a different lock: repeat a pattern of flames, lead a spark through the ash to a door, wake a hall of lamps, turn soot back into words, answer a whisper, mend a broken seal, match twin sparks, and read the failed attempts on a vault dial.
Later seals use the same locks, wound tighter. Hints from the keeper are there when the dark gets stubborn. Your progress stays on the device, so the road is still lit when you return.
Sixteen chapters. No timer. One night, waiting.

name: Warehouse Rush
description:
Start your first shift in a small Landover depot. A receiving computer prints a customer order. Find each named item on the racks, move bulky freight with a pallet jack, shrink-wrap the pallet, and load the truck.

Choose James, Eve, or Remy from the Neighborhood Empire crew. Customize their look and guide them through the warehouse in landscape. Tap a destination to walk there or drag and hold to steer.

Quick, accurate deliveries earn more. You can finish a late order and collect its remaining pay. Invest your earnings in more floor space and workers. As the business grows, receive supplier pallets, replenish empty racks, rearrange aisles, and earn larger orders from returning customers.

Play offline. Your business progress stays on your device.
An Algorithm World Production.

name: Wasl - وصل: Shared Clipboard
description:
Wasl is one clipboard for all your devices. Copy on one and paste on the others: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows.

WHAT IT DOES
- Copy text, pictures and files and they show on your other devices in a second or two.
- History of everything you copied: search, pin, copy again or send again.
- Wasl keyboard on iPhone and iPad: send what you copied and paste from your other devices without leaving the app you are in.
- Back Tap and Shortcuts: send with a double tap on the back of your iPhone.
- Self-destructing items: one-time codes and secrets delete themselves after a short time.
- Arabic and English, light and dark.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything is end-to-end encrypted with AES-256 on your devices. Your devices pair by scanning a code, and only they hold the key.
- On the same Wi-Fi, devices talk directly. With Sync anywhere, encrypted copies pass through our relay and are deleted after 24 hours at most. We never see what you copy.
- No ads, no tracking.

PLANS
Wasl is free on the same Wi-Fi with the last 50 items.
- Plus: sync anywhere, files up to 10 MB, 500 items.
- Pro: everything in Plus, unlimited encrypted history, self-destructing items.
- Pro AI: everything in Pro, plus AI actions (translate, rewrite, summarize).
- Family: Pro for up to 5 people.
Every plan starts with 7 days free. Monthly or yearly. One plan covers all your paired devices.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Privacy: https://fwz.ai/wasl/privacy

name: Water Softener Buddy
description:
Never run out of softener salt again. No sensor to buy. No subscription, no account, no ads, no tracking.

Softener Buddy works out when your water softener's brine tank will run empty and reminds you a few days before. It works with any ordinary softener: nothing to install and no Wi-Fi needed in the basement.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set up in about a minute: tank size, water hardness (or a ZIP code for a starting guess), people at home and salt type. Every question has an "I don't know" answer.
• Now and then, lift the lid and slide to where the salt is. That's a level check, and it takes a few seconds.
• Each check teaches the app how fast your household really uses salt. A label on the home screen shows how sure it is: Estimate, Learning or Confident.
• When the salt gets low, you get a reminder. Tap Added salt right on the notification, or snooze it to the weekend or by two days.

FREE
• Days of salt left, the predicted refill date and a tank gauge in percent and pounds or kilograms
• Refill reminders and occasional level-check nudges, with buttons on the notification
• A history of refills and level checks, with a 30-day chart
• A home-screen widget that shows days left
• Two maintenance tasks on schedule, with steps: the monthly salt bridge check and the yearly brine tank clean
• Troubleshooting for water that isn't soft, salt that isn't going down, and a brine tank full of water
• A guide to salt types: pellets, solar crystals, rock salt, blocks and potassium chloride
• JSON backup and CSV export, free for good

PRO: $2.99 ONCE
Share the softener with your household through iCloud:
• Invite the people you live with. Everyone sees the same tank and history, and anyone can log a refill.
• One refill clears the reminder on everyone's phone.
• History shows who did what, such as "Jen added 2 bags".
• Tap "I'll buy salt" so nobody else buys a second bag.
• Assign a maintenance task to one person.
• Each person chooses when they're reminded: always, only if nobody has added salt a couple of days later, or never.
• Joining a shared softener is free, and Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers your Apple family.
Also in Pro:
• Problem alerts for a salt bridge, a jump in salt use that can mean a leak or running toilet, and a softener that stopped regenerating
• The full maintenance library, including resin cleaner, pre-filters, the injector, clock checks, hardness tests and RO filters, plus your own tasks
• A settings calculator: the hardness and salt dose to set, and how many bags a year a lower dose would save
• Insights: salt per month, bags and cost per year, and what your settings predict versus what your checks show
• Salt on hand, with a reminder to buy more before you run short
• Log salt from the lock screen, a medium widget with an Added salt button, Control Center or Siri
• More than one softener, for a cabin or a rental
• Equipment records: photos, the manual, the warranty date with a reminder, and a photo of your settings
• All seven troubleshooting guides
• Vacation mode: reminders pause while you're away, and the prediction accounts for it
• Refill and maintenance days in a calendar you choose, such as a shared family calendar
• A QR sticker for the tank: scan it to log salt
• A PDF service history for your records or a new owner
• Alternate app icons and accent colors

LIMITS
• These are estimates, not measurements. They get more accurate as you log level checks.
• It doesn't connect to smart softeners, salt sensors or brand apps.
• Household sharing uses iCloud, so it works between iPhones and iPads only. A refill someone else logs can take a few minutes to show up.
• A ZIP code only suggests a county average from public data, not your exact tap; well water usually runs harder.

PRIVACY
Your data stays on your device and in your own iCloud account. There's no account to create, no analytics and no ads, and the developer never sees your data.

Questions or ideas: support@wanderingdev.dev

name: Water Tiles
description:
Drain the water off glazed floors. Glaze clings to its film, so only a heavy enough film can pull a tile dry. Sometimes the way to remove water is to add more.

THREE RULES
• Films: wet tiles that share grout form one film. Its weight is the number of tiles it covers.
• Grip: every tile holds its water from one (gloss) to five (matte).
• Drains: a film touching a drain empties every tile whose grip is lower than its weight. The rest stay wet.

EVERY DROP COUNTS
Each floor gives you exactly as many drops as its shortest solution needs. Drop water in the right place and a whole region empties. Drop it in the wrong one and tiles are stranded for good.

NEW IDEAS ALL THE WAY
Basins that spill into chain reactions. Stone inlays and brass grates. Waxed tiles that stay dry once dry. Springs that never stop. Dyes that mix, red and blue making purple, and coloured drains that only take their own colour. Sponges that drink exactly once. Soap that loosens every grip in a film.

110 FLOORS, 30 TILINGS
Squares, hexagons, herringbone, basketweave, chevron, Cairo streets, tumbling blocks, Penrose and more, in 17 worlds. Every floor is checked by a solver, so every puzzle has a solution and no move budget is padded.

WATER THAT LOOKS LIKE WATER
Thin films darken and deepen the glaze beneath them, catch the sky, bend the tiles at their edges and drain away in a front from the drain.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Unlimited undo and reset
• Hints when you're stuck, and a mark for every floor solved without one
• A legend that explains everything on the floor
• Three player slots
• Grip numbers instead of pips, colour-blind patterns and letters, reduced motion
• Day and night themes
• No timers. No ads. No in-app purchases. No data collected. Plays offline.

From Short Reprieve Games.

name: WayPassport
description:
Remember where you went, how you got there, and what made it memorable.

WayPassport brings your travel memories together in a private journal for iPhone and iPad. Create a trip, save the places you visited, link photos from Apple Photos, and write the little details you want to keep.

A JOURNAL FOR EVERY JOURNEY
Give each trip a title, optional dates, tags, and a favorite cover. Find memories with search, favorites, year filters, and sorting.

YOUR PLACES, ON THE MAP
Save places with Apple Maps search or drop a pin. Explore your trips on interactive maps and in a timeline you can arrange yourself. Browse saved places across your journals in the Atlas.

REMEMBER HOW YOU GOT THERE
Add flights, trains, ferries, drives, bus rides, bike rides, walks, and other connections. Keep departure details, service information, and notes alongside your memories. Map lines illustrate connections rather than exact recorded routes.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY IN APPLE PHOTOS
Link existing pictures, add captions, choose a cover, and revisit them in your trip gallery. Removing a link never deletes an original. Photos must remain available in your Apple Photos library; unavailable links can be relinked.

A LITTLE PERSPECTIVE
See an overview of your trips, saved places, countries, linked photos, and transport entries, based on what you have recorded.

PRIVATE AND READY TO TRAVEL
No WayPassport account, advertising, or third-party analytics. Your journal is saved on your device. Create and edit memories offline; online maps, place search, and cloud-only photos need a connection. Version 1.0 uses manual metadata backups to move journals between devices; journal iCloud sync is not available.

KEEP A BACKUP
Export journal metadata to Files and restore from a validated backup. Backups contain notes, places, and photo links, without original images. Keep your original Photos library and store exported files securely.

Make yourself at home with light, dark, or system appearance, native iPad layouts, and adjustable system text sizes.

Go places. Keep the feeling.

Support: timdevb2b@gmail.com

name: WeldAmp: Bead Amp Wizard
description:
WeldAmp is for fab and repair welders who need a quick working amp window from plate thickness and joint type — not a generic calculator, because it walks a short bead wizard (process, metal, thickness, then joint) and saves bead cards with consumable and polarity tips.

HOW IT WORKS
• Weld tab: step through Stick / MIG / flux-core, base metal, plate wall, and joint.
• Live arc dial updates as you change thickness and joint.
• Finish step shows amp band, electrode or wire size, and travel tip.
• Beads: save setups for trailer hitches, patches, and handrails.
• More: privacy and support — fully on-device.

This is a field estimate helper, not a Welding Procedure Specification or code certification.

name: WeldWitness
description:
WeldWitness keeps a clear, traceable record of visual weld inspections. Start with a weld number, then build a dated trail of what was checked, what was seen, and what happened next — without an account or an internet connection.

START WITH THE WELD
• Weld number, joint ID, and the drawing and revision used for reference
• Work area, welder name and ID, process, and material in the same record
• Inspection requirements and checkpoints shown before findings are recorded

DATED VISUAL EXAMINATIONS
• Each examination is its own dated entry with stage, inspector, and location
• Weld profile as observed, with notes
• Undercut and surface indications recorded by finding type
• Precise positions: surface, distance from a datum, clock position, and length
• A short description of what the inspector saw

MEASUREMENTS WITH CONTEXT
• Every value saved with its unit: mm, in, degrees, percent, or count
• A reference note alongside each measurement

REPAIR FOLLOW-UP
• See every finding that still needs repair attention
• Update repair status with dated notes as work develops
• Plan reinspections with optional reminders on the planned day
• Start a reinspection with the earlier open findings already in view

TRACE AND COMPARE
• A visual history for each weld: examinations and repair updates in sequence
• Insights by finding type, work area, welder, and surface, plus repeat indications
• Tap any count to open the inspection entries behind it

DATA
• Export findings as CSV and back up everything to a file
• No account, no ads, no tracking — your records stay on your iPhone

WeldWitness records observations and keeps them separate from acceptance decisions. It does not judge whether a weld is acceptable. Use qualified judgment and your approved inspection procedures.

name: Where Life Was
description:
Discover the stories behind Canada’s forgotten settlements.
 Where Life Was is a field guide to Canadian ghost towns and historic townsites. Explore their origins, learn about the people and industries that shaped them, and discover what remains today.
Browse town descriptions, coordinates, and periods of prosperity. Save your favourite places, share discoveries, and open locations in your device’s maps app.
 Compare illustrative views of the past and present, accompanied by stories about how each settlement changed. Comparison images are illustrative reconstructions, not archival photographs.
 Discover 20 historical objects and architectural or industrial details. Learn their purpose, star interesting entries, and share them with others.
 Answer 10 randomly selected questions from a collection of 36. Explore the guide, check your results, and try a new set.
 Choose your historical interests, preferred outing duration, and difficulty, or request a random suggestion. Outing profiles are suggestions, not verified trail ratings or route durations.
 Write personal notes about the towns you explore and keep your favourite discoveries together.
 Use the compass and save a starting point for your journey. Return mode shows the straight-line direction and distance to that point; it does not provide turn-by-turn directions or retrace your route.
 Explore short articles and links to English-language heritage resources.
Map tiles and external resources require an internet connection. Location features require permission, and compass readings depend on compatible device sensors. Some townsites have restricted access; check local conditions and access rules before visiting.

name: Who Stole My Takeout?
description:
"Someone stole your takeout."

Late at night your delivery lands on the pickup rack. A shadow grabs the bag and runs — and so begins a chase across the whole campus.

Who Stole My Takeout? is a one-way endless runner. The thief stays a few steps ahead: run faster and he speeds up, hesitate and he vanishes into the crowd.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe up to jump, swipe down to slide, tap also jumps (swipe up again mid-air for a double jump)
• Banners, branches, clotheslines, scaffolding, hoops — those high obstacles can only be slid under
• Speed bumps and ditches must be jumped; banana peels and puddles cost you a heart
• Sliding uses stamina: 1.2s max, 0.8s recovery when drained

COLLECT & BOOST
Milk tea, burgers and energy drinks give points and heal you. Scooters and e-bikes make you briefly invincible and smash obstacles aside.

CAN YOU CATCH HIM?
The chase bar shows the gap. Fall too far behind and he pulls away — three seconds at full gap and he is gone for good. The longer you run, the higher the score and the faster the pace.

MORE
• 12 achievements, plus Game Center leaderboards (This Week and All Time)
• Share a result card of how your run ended
• Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean
• Fully playable offline, collects no personal data
• Optional in-app purchase: support the developer with one extra life (4 hearts per run)

name: Wildcard: Party Games
description:
Wildcard is a party game where every player uses their own phone. One person creates a room, everyone else joins with a 4-letter code, and the whole group plays at the same time. Nobody passes a phone around, and nobody reads over anyone's shoulder.

That is the point, because the best part is what the others can't see: the imposter who doesn't know the word, the question nobody signed, the vote that stays secret until the reveal.

EIGHT MODES
• Standard – draw from card packs full of dares, questions and group challenges. Tap to flip, swipe for the next one.
• Pandora's Box – everyone writes anonymous questions before the game. Then the box opens and players take the hot seat one at a time. Nobody can trace a question back to you.
• Imposter – everyone sees a secret word except the imposter, who has to bluff through the clues. Play Classic, or one of the blind variants where the imposters get a slightly different word or question and nobody is told, not even them.
• Exposed – "Who's most likely to…?" appears on every phone. Vote in secret, watch the votes come in live, and let the host decide whether to reveal who voted for whom. Everyone also gets a secret side mission.
• One Word Story – build one story together, one word each, against the clock. Optional twists turn up along the way and make it worse.
• Guess the Liar – the players on the spot all answer the same question. One of them was told to lie. Everyone else votes on who.
• Mind Match – everyone answers the same prompt at once. Match somebody and score; stand alone and take a forfeit.
• They're a 10, but… – a made-up someone is a 10, but there's a catch. Everyone rates them again in private, from 0 to 10, and the ratings are revealed together. Then you argue about it.

FORFEITS, NOT POINTS
Lose a round and Wildcard deals you a forfeit: a short, harmless, silly task, like talking like a sports commentator for two minutes. Every phone shows the same one, so there's no wriggling out of it. Every dare and forfeit is optional: skip anything you're not comfortable with.

MADE FOR THE GROUP
• Everyone on their own phone. No passing, no peeking.
• Joining a room is always free.
• The host tunes every mode: timers, rounds, who takes the forfeit and more.
• Haptic feedback on every flip, vote and reveal.
• Available in 11 languages.

WILDCARD PREMIUM
Standard mode and two card packs are free. Wildcard Premium lets the host open rooms in the other seven modes and use every card pack. It is a subscription billed monthly or yearly through your Apple ID, and it renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it under Subscriptions in your Apple ID settings. Only the host needs it; everyone else joins for free.

Wildcard is made for adults (17+). Some packs get flirty and personal. Dares that involve another player need their yes.

Privacy policy: https://slegiot.github.io/wildcard/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://slegiot.github.io/wildcard/terms.html

name: Wilken Poelker
description:
Die offizielle App von Wilken Poelker – Ihrem Fachhändler für E-Bikes & Fahrräder, Motor- und Gartengeräte und Reinigungstechnik in Ostrhauderfehn. Familienbetrieb seit 1951.

Sehen Sie, in welchem Schritt sich Ihre Reparatur befindet – direkt aus unserer Werkstatt. Sobald Ihr Gerät fertig ist, bekommen Sie eine Push-Nachricht: „Abholbereit!“

SERVICE-ANFRAGEN MIT FOTO & CHAT

KI-ASSISTENT
Schnelle Antworten auf Fragen rund um E-Bikes, Garten- und Reinigungstechnik – rund um die Uhr (freiwillig, mit Einwilligung).

NEUIGKEITEN & ÖFFNUNGSZEITEN
Aktionen, Neuheiten und Tipps aus unserem Haus sowie die aktuellen Öffnungszeiten auf einen Blick.

IHRE KUNDENNUMMER
Bestandskunden werden bei der Registrierung automatisch erkannt – oder fragen ihre Kundennummer bequem in der App an.
